name: Bizline
description:
Bizline turns your VoIP.ms phone number into a business line on the iPhone you already carry. Texts with pictures, calls and voicemail sit in one app, separate from your personal calls and texts.

TEXTING (FREE)
• Send and receive texts and picture messages, with pictures shown right in the conversation
• Long replies go as one message instead of being split up
• Reactions: press and hold a message to react, and see your customers' reactions
• Quick Replies: send a saved message with one tap, with Undo
• Save pictures to Photos or share them to another app
• Use several VoIP.ms numbers, one at a time or all together
• Search, archive and contact names

BIZLINE PRO
• Instant Alerts: new texts arrive within seconds, on every phone that uses your number
• Calls from your VoIP.ms number over an encrypted connection; incoming calls ring while Bizline is open on screen
• Voicemails with transcripts, and call recordings
• Your VoIP.ms settings in plain words: business hours, where calls go, call forwarding, blocked numbers, texts to email and more

CALLS AND HISTORY
• See every call on your account, including calls answered on your other phones and devices
• 911 calls always go to your iPhone's own phone app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Bizline talks to VoIP.ms directly. There is no Bizline server holding your messages, no ads and no tracking.
• Your API password stays in your iPhone's secure storage.
• Export your messages to an encrypted file.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A VoIP.ms account with the API turned on, and a number with texting (SMS/MMS) enabled
• Texts, calls and numbers are billed by VoIP.ms at your account's rates

SUBSCRIPTION
Bizline Pro is $2.99 a month or $24.99 a year, each with a 14-day free trial, or $99 once for life. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://middletnautorepair.com/bizline/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://middletnautorepair.com/bizline/privacy/

Bizline is not made by VoIP.ms and is not affiliated with or endorsed by VoIP.ms.

name: Protractor Fold
description:
Protractor Fold uses the hinge of iPhone Duo as a protractor. It reads the hinge sensor live and shows angles to a thousandth of a degree.

INSIDE CORNERS
Room corners, cabinets and window bays, read on the inner screen.

OUTSIDE CORNERS
Box edges, walls and beams, read on the outer screen.

PIPES AND CURVES
Radius, diameter and curvature of pipes, arches and curved walls.

TARGETS
Set an angle or radius with a tolerance. A tone sounds on target, and each saved reading keeps how far off it was.

LOGS
Save readings with notes and photos, keep them in named logs, and export them as a spreadsheet or PDF.

ALSO
- Five color themes and a night mode
- No account, no ads, no tracking. Anonymous crash reports are sent only if you agree.

Requires iPhone Duo.

name: Bark.AI BarkNotes
description:
Let your notes work for you.

BarkNotes brings notes, to-do lists and handwriting together in one clean, calm app – for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Capture ideas, plan tasks, and turn documents, photos and voice recordings into searchable notes with just a few taps.

NOTES THE WAY YOU NEED THEM
• Write in Markdown or formatted text – with headings, lists, checklists, tables and code
• Switch anytime between editing, formatted view and reading mode
• Draw and write by hand right inside your notes – perfect with Apple Pencil
• Attach files, images and documents
• Organize everything in notebooks and find any note in seconds with search

TO-DO LISTS AT A GLANCE
• Create to-do lists and shopping lists
• Keep bigger projects on track with the Kanban view
• Set due dates and get reminded in time
• See overdue tasks at a glance

AI IMPORT: TURN FILES INTO NOTES
Drop documents, photos, scans or voice recordings into BarkNotes: text is recognized, speech is transcribed, and a new note is created with the original files attached. With Apple Intelligence, you also get summaries, and detected tasks go straight into your to-do lists. Text and speech recognition run on your device.

ALWAYS IN SYNC
• Sync notes, to-dos and attachments across iPhone, iPad and Mac via your private iCloud storage
• Or pair your devices directly with your Mac on your local network using a QR code – no cloud required

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Notes and lists are stored as open Markdown files – visible in the Files app and, on Mac, in a folder of your choice
• Open them with other apps such as Obsidian or iA Writer whenever you like
• Export entire notebooks with attachments and import them on another device
• Deleted something by mistake? Restore notes and lists from Recently Deleted

THOUGHTFUL IN EVERY DETAIL
• Elegant design with light and dark mode
• Optimized for iPhone, iPad and Mac – including foldable iPhones
• Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Dutch, Polish and Hungarian

Feedback and support: www.barkey.at

name: DQM4 Companion
description:
An unofficial companion for DQM4. It is not the game, and it is not a Square Enix guide.

A recipe chart tells you what can be bred. It does not tell you what to do next. This app links four steps into one loop: a route that subtracts your inventory, the next action, a round trip to the map, and team analysis.

[The loop only this app runs]
1. A route that subtracts your inventory
Choose the monster you want. Parents and intermediate monsters you already hold come off the route first. The app shows how many steps your inventory covered and how many syntheses and acquisitions remain.

2. The next action
The top of the screen holds one line: "Acquire X first" or "Synthesize X next". Tap Owned or confirm a synthesis, inventory changes, and the next action takes its place.

3. Go to the map, come back to the route
When the next monster to acquire has a confirmed location, open a map that shows only that monster. Tap Add to inventory, then Return to route, and the same route continues.

4. From team analysis back to breeding
From 8-slot capacity, attack attributes, and shared weaknesses, the app lists up to three gaps to fix first, each with a reason. It suggests replacements from your inventory. If you have none, start a breeding route from there.

[Breeding routes]
- Compare candidates with balanced, fewer syntheses, or fewer catches
- Review every known parent pair. The current route stays until you choose another
- Save more than one target and resume it later
- Marking a catch as owned updates both inventory and the dex record
- Confirming a synthesis spends the parents and adds the result. The step you just finished can be undone

[Monster dex]
- Search the 381 announced monsters by name. Demo data you can use now is marked apart
- Filter by collected, not collected, catch, synthesis, S or L, family, and rank
- Open how to get it, six stats, action count, resistances, traits, skills, and recipes
- Compare two to four monsters on one page: size, stats, actions, and resistances
- "Collected before" and "held for breeding now" stay separate
- Set a breeding target or add the monster to the 8-slot team from the same page

[Skills, traits, and talents]
- Switch the dex among monsters, talents, skills, and traits
- Open a skill effect, a trait description, and a talent's points and unlocks
- Go from a trait to the monsters that have it, or from a skill back to the talent that unlocks it

[Maps]
- See monsters, strong enemies, chests, flowers, roots, and entrances on the map and in the list
- Day, night, and other conditions appear only where they are confirmed
- Zoom in and monster dots become portraits
- Mark chests, flowers, and roots complete, and undo that mark
- Long-press empty map space to drop your own marker

[8-slot team]
- S uses 1 slot and L uses 2. Build the eight slots with the monster art
- Record three talents and their points for each member
- Demo team examples show who you already have and who is missing before you apply them
- There is no single power score. You see the facts, and what is missing

[Demo assistants]
- Scout Q checks the current inventory, team, and training notes, then opens the dex, route, map, or team
- NPC pairings separate the offered monster, parents you can use from inventory, and whether the current recipe data has one result
- A mark in the app is not a turn-in inside the game. Check the condition, then finish it in the game yourself

[Stays on this device]
- Collection, inventory, routes, team, training, map records, and assistant progress stay on the device
- Export a file only when you want one, and import it later
- Switch the interface among Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English
- There is no account. Progress is not sent out unless you use the system share sheet yourself

The map round trip covers monsters whose location is confirmed in the demo data. What is not confirmed stays unknown instead of becoming a guessed number.

name: Hopper Relay
description:
Hopper Relay is the iPhone half of Hopper, a terminal app for the Mac that hands work to an agent through the Claude Code harness, across your projects and Claude logins. Pair your phone with Hopper on your Mac and take your work with you.

• See the work: drafts, what's running, what's waiting on you and what's up next, in the order Hopper keeps them.
• Answer Claude: open a conversation to follow it as it runs, and reply, press 1, 2 or 3, or interrupt, as you would at the keyboard.
• Start work: write a prompt, pick the project, account, model and effort, and start it now, queue it, or leave it for tonight.
• Keep things moving: put a conversation on hold, archive it, run or pause a routine, read its reports.
• Watch your limits: each Claude login's session and weekly usage.

The work stays on your Mac: agents runs there, in your projects, with your logins. The phone follows it and answers whenever Hopper is open.

Private by design. There are no accounts and nothing is collected. Pairing is a one-time code your Mac shows; everything between phone and Mac is encrypted end to end, through a relay that can't read it. The app locks behind Face ID or your passcode.

No Mac to hand? "Try it without a Mac" opens a demo with made-up projects.

Requires Hopper on a Mac (free and open source, hopper.saltbark.com) and Claude Code. Hopper is made by Saltbark and is not affiliated with Anthropic.

name: Smileo.
description:
Smileo keeps a clear aligner or retainer day in one place. You note when the shell goes on and when it comes off. The hours add up against the time you plan to wear it, so lunch does not wipe out the morning.
Each shell can hold smile photos from the front, the left, the right, or the full face. Snap one, or choose one from Photos. Tag the shell number and the time. A short note can be typed, or spoken and written into the note.
To see what changed, put an earlier photo next to a later one and move the line between them.
The month is shown week by week. A past day can take a wear note. Chair visits share that calendar: the day, the time, and a line for where to go or what to ask. Reminders can ask you to put the shell back, change it on the due morning, rinse, or leave for a visit.
Your orthodontist decides when a shell changes. Smileo keeps the hours, the photos, and the visit dates on this phone, so you are not searching a camera roll.

name: WatchIPTV: Live TV & Sports
description:
Bring your own IPTV playlist and watch it the way Apple devices should: a fast TV guide, sports games you can find by team, Multiview for up to four streams, and one purchase that works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro.

MULTIVIEW, INCLUDED

A GUIDE THAT KEEPS UP

MOVIES AND SERIES

BUILT FOR EVERY APPLE SCREEN
• Native apps for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro, not a stretched iPad app

name: 해요 heyoo: 할 일·일정
description:
해요(heyoo)는 하루 할 일과 일정을 가볍게 적고 한눈에 보는 앱이에요.

· 시간 보기: 하루를 시간표처럼 보면서 할 일을 시간에 맞춰 배치해요
· 할 일 보기: 오늘, 내일, 이번 주 할 일을 목록으로 확인하고 체크해요

name: 漢字パズル 和同開珎
description:
4つの二字熟語に共通する「真ん中の1字」を当てる漢字パズルです。古いお金・和同開珎のように、四角い穴の上下左右に漢字が並びます。

上と左の字は答えの前に、右と下の字は答えの後に付きます。たとえば上が「純」、左が「写」、右が「似」、下が「空」なら、答えは「真」（純真・写真・真似・真空）。

■ 遊びやすさにこだわりました
・大きな文字で読みやすい画面。iPhone の文字の大きさの設定にも合わせます
・「やさしい」「ふつう」は8つの候補から選ぶだけ。「難しい」はかなで打って漢字に変換して答えます
・困ったときはヒントが2つ。それでも分からなければ答えを見られます
・解いた後は4つの熟語の読みと意味を表示。言葉の復習にもなります
・答えが1つに決まる問題だけを収録しています

■ 主な機能
・無料で遊べる200問（やさしい・ふつう・難しいの3段階）
・毎日0時に新しい問題になる「今日の1問」と、続けて解いた日数の記録
・遊んだ記録は iCloud にも保存され、同じ Apple アカウントの iPhone で続きから遊べます
・通信できない場所でも遊べます。会員登録やログインは不要

■ 問題パック（追加購入）
新しい100問が遊べる問題パックがあります。パックを買うと広告も表示されなくなります。

■ 広告について
一覧の途中と、問題を何問か解いた後に広告が表示されます。問題を解いている最中には広告は出ません。アプリ内の「広告を消す」（買い切り）を購入すると、広告が表示されなくなります。

ファミリー共有に対応しています。
熟語の確かめには JMdict・KANJIDIC2（EDRDG）を使っています。

name: 7 Days Closer
description:
Want to read the Bible every day, but never know where to start?

You're not alone. Most of us open it, read a page that has nothing to do with our week, and put it down. Then a few busy mornings go by, and it's been a month.

7 Days Closer makes it simple. Every morning you get one passage picked for what you're going through, an easy explanation of what it means, and one question to think about. Write a few honest sentences back any time before midnight, and you've done your day.

Do that day after day, and reading the Bible stops being something you mean to do. It becomes part of your morning.

EVERY MORNING 

• One passage picked for your life right now, never a repeat 
• Make It Make Sense Tab: what you just read, in plain words 
• One question to think about 
• A few words of encouragement after you reflect

FREE GIFTS FOR SHOWING UP 

Keep your streak going and we'll mail you gifts, free: 

• 3 stickers at 30 days 
• An ornament at 180 days 
• A Bible at one full year You also earn points for every day you reflect, to spend in our shop.

DAY AFTER DAY 

• A streak to keep, and a garden that grows every day you show up 
• Every reflection you've written, saved in My History 
• Community Chat, with people reading alongside you

ON YOUR PHONE 

• Today's passage on your home screen and lock screen 
• A morning notification, so your passage finds you 
• The World English Bible, King James Version or Berean Standard Bible

MEMBERSHIP 

Your daily passage is free, and it stays free. Membership adds: 

• Your passage by text every morning, with a reminder if you haven't reflected 
• Audio readings of every passage 
• Passage Q&A, for questions about what you read 
• Behind the Passage: one word from the original language, and a map of where it happened 
• A way to save your streak if you miss a day, once a month

Membership is $5.00 a month. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Passages are selected and reflections are read with the help of AI.

Terms: https://7dayscloser.com/terms 
Privacy: https://7dayscloser.com/privacy

name: Ahjiz | احجز
description:
رحلتك في السودان تبدأ من هنا.

احجز تذكرة الحافلة بين مدن السودان من هاتفك، دون مشوار إلى الموقف أو انتظار في الطابور. ابحث عن رحلتك، قارن بين المواعيد والأسعار، اختر مقعدك بنفسك، وادفع بالطريقة التي تناسبك.

ابحث عن رحلتك بضغطة زر
اختر مدينة المغادرة ومدينة الوصول وتاريخ السفر وعدد الركاب، وستظهر لك كل الحافلات المتاحة.

قارن الرحلات واختر الأنسب
لكل رحلة تظهر أمامك مواعيد المغادرة والوصول، والمدة المتوقعة، والسعر، والمقاعد المتاحة، والعروض إن وُجدت.

اختر مقعدك بنفسك
خريطة مقاعد واضحة تُظهر المقعد المتاح والمحدد والمحجوز، فتختار المكان اليريحك. واعرف قبل الحجز خدمات الحافلة مثل التكييف والواي فاي ومنفذ الشحن.

ادفع بالطريقة التي تناسبك
أدخل بيانات الراكب، ثم ادفع بالمحفظة الرقمية أو بالتحويل البنكي.

حجوزاتك ومحفظتك في مكان واحد
تابع حجوزاتك القادمة والسابقة من تبويب الحجوزات، واطّلع على رصيد محفظتك في أي وقت.

احجز عبر واتساب
تفضّل المحادثة؟ احجز رحلتك عبر واتساب مباشرة من التطبيق.

مصمّم لك
• واجهة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية
• وضع داكن مريح للعين
• تصميم بسيط وواضح يناسب الجميع

من الخرطوم إلى بورتسودان وعطبرة وكسلا ودنقلا وود مدني وغيرها، حمّل التطبيق الآن واحجز رحلتك القادمة في دقائق.

name: Airshow Simulator
description:
Fly the act. Own the crowd. Airshow Simulator puts you in a nimble aerobatic plane in front of thousands of fans: loops, rolls, smoke and a wall of fire, with an Air Boss on the radio and an announcer who loves every second.

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
Half-fold it for a handheld cockpit: the sky on top, the stick, throttle and gauges below. Unfold it for one wide view, or a split with your routine and the crowd meter. Also great on iPhone and iPad.

FLY FORMATION WITH FRIENDS
Invite a friend through Game Center: one of you leads the act, the other holds the wing. No friend online? A computer wingman flies with you.

FUN FROM THE FIRST MINUTE
- A 30-second lesson, then your first show: a smoke pass, one big loop and a wave to the crowd
- Guided assist gives you a wide glowing ribbon, gentle controls, wings that level themselves and auto throttle
- One thing at a time: new figures, wind and tighter judges arrive gradually
- Three good shows in a row? Try Standard or Expert when you are ready

EIGHT SHOWS, THIRTEEN FIGURES
Smoke passes, loops, aileron and barrel rolls, inverted passes, the Immelmann, split S, Cuban eight, knife-edge pass, and the big ones: the hammerhead, the snap roll and the tailslide. Earn one to three stars on every show.

TWO VENUES AND A NIGHT SHOW
The Florida Spring Fly-In airfield, the Coastal Beach Show over the water, and After Dark: wingtip sparks, a wall of fire on the pyro team's call, and fireworks for the finale.

PRACTICE, FREE FLIGHT AND YOUR OWN ROUTINES
Practice any figure with instant retry and a ghost of your best run. Take off for a free flight and land on the runway. Build, save and fly your own routines.

A SHOW THAT TALKS BACK
A calm Air Boss on the radio, a big-voiced announcer and a friendly crew chief, with subtitles. Fly from the cockpit with real working gauges, or watch from the crowd.

CRASHES ARE CARTOON FUN
The pilot always floats down under a bright parachute, the plane comes apart in slow motion, and one tap puts you back in the air.

EARN YOUR WAY UP
Experience and show money after every show: pilot levels unlock new shows, and the hangar has smoke colors, paint schemes and small upgrades. Show money is earned by flying only, never sold.

YOUR CONTROLS
Tilt, a touch stick, or any game controller. Adjustable sensitivity and stick size. Menus follow your text size.

FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no purchases, no account, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device. Game Center is used only when you start a friend formation.

name: Al-Ittihad: News & Matches
description:
Al-Ittihad Club is the official app of Saudi Arabia's first and oldest football club.
Your home for live scores, fixtures, news and exclusive content from the Tigers. Follow every Roshn Saudi League match, every transfer, every moment.

Founded in 1927 in Jeddah, Al-Ittihad has built a century of Saudi football history and this app puts that story, and every new chapter, The ultimate ITTI fan companion is here. 
 
LIVE MATCH CENTRE
Real-time scores, line-ups, goals and match events for every Al-Ittihad fixture in the Saudi Pro League, AFC competitions and domestic cups.
 
LATEST NEWS
Breaking news, match reports, press conferences and exclusive interviews. straight from the club newsroom, first.
 
FIXTURES & RESULTS
Full Al-Ittihad fixture list, results, and Saudi Pro League standings. Set reminders so you never miss kick-off.
 
SQUAD & PLAYER PROFILES
Profiles, stats, and stories from across the senior team and academy.
 
EXCLUSIVE CONTENT
Behind-the-scenes video, training-ground footage, long-read features, and audio from the club's media team. Available nowhere else.
 
OUR LEGACY
Step inside 100 years of Al-Ittihad. Explore the moments, players, and trophies that built the club with new heritage content every season.
 
PERSONALISED FOR YOU
Custom push notifications for goals, team news, and the players you follow. Set your favourites and get pre-match reminders so you never miss a Tigers moment.
 
BILINGUAL
Full English and Arabic experience.
 
Whether you've worn the yellow and black for life, or you're discovering Saudi football for the first time, this is the official home for every Al-Ittihad fan.
 
Download the Al-Ittihad app. Follow the Tigers. Live every match.

name: Alien Outlaw: Crop Circles
description:
Give every flying saucer a place to land.

Alien Outlaw: Crop Circles is a calm logic puzzle with a friendly cowboy alien, colorful fields, and one simple challenge: place one saucer in every row, every column, and every colored region. Saucers cannot touch, even at the corners.

MEET BUCKAROO
Your cowboy-hatted guide welcomes you with a short training flight and explains the rules as you play. Start with a small 5×5 field and unlock larger puzzles, all the way to 12×12.

HINTS THAT HELP YOU LEARN
Every puzzle has one solution. When you need a hand, a hint explains the next logical step in plain English. Tap again to apply it, or keep working it out yourself. Mark squares, undo moves, and play at your own pace.

A NEW PLACE TO LAND
Wins unlock painted scenes, different saucers, and sighting stories. Explore 16 landscapes, from Roswell Heights and Miller’s Farm to snowy peaks and quiet coastal towns. After a win, enjoy a fictional local newspaper celebrating your landing.

MAKE TIME FOR TODAY’S PUZZLE
Return for a daily challenge, replay any board size you have unlocked, and follow your progress through new ranks and rewards.

QUIET BY DESIGN
• No ads, account, or internet connection needed to play
• No countdown pressuring your next move
• Progress and settings saved on your device
• Optional sounds and animations
• Made for iPhone and iPad

A small field. One right landing. Take your time.

name: Alterno : ton alternance
description:
Toujours pas d'alternance ? Laisse Alterno s'en charger.

Alterno est le moteur qui cherche ton alternance avec toi. Tu règles ton métier, ton point de départ et le temps de trajet que tu acceptes, jusqu'à 2 heures. Le reste se pilote depuis ton iPhone.

LE RADAR
Alterno parcourt 2,7 millions d'établissements français et te montre les structures de ton domaine à portée de trajet, rangées de la plus intéressante à la moins intéressante.

DES LETTRES QUI TE RESSEMBLENT
Pour chaque structure, Alterno lit son site et écrit une candidature à partir de ton profil et de ton CV. Tu relis, tu réécris, tu envoies.

TES ENVOIS, DEPUIS TA BOÎTE
Les lettres partent de ta propre adresse Gmail ou Outlook, les jours ouvrés. Alterno relance à ta place. LinkedIn est disponible en option.

LE POSTE DE COMMANDE
Envoyées, réponses, entretiens : tout se lit d'un coup d'œil. Maintiens un bouton pour faire décoller ou atterrir le pilote automatique.

SANS ABONNEMENT
Alterno fonctionne avec des crédits. Chaque offre se paie une seule fois, rien ne se renouvelle.

Alterno est ouvert dès 16 ans. Entre 16 et 18 ans, utilise-le avec l'accord de ton représentant légal. Alterno n'est affilié à aucune école et ne garantit pas la signature d'un contrat.

Confidentialité : https://alterno.app/confidentialite
Conditions de vente : https://alterno.app/cgv

name: Amon: The Mystic Oracle
description:
Hold the fingerprint, ask your question out loud and release. The crystal ball comes alive and AMON answers.

TEN ENTITIES, TEN PERSONALITIES
Every entity answers in its own voice: the original hooded oracle, a prankster, a toxic one, a zoomer, a robot, a strongman, a cat overlord, a pirate captain, an alien and a zen master.

COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
Open Mystic Boxes to get cards and unlock entities, crystal balls and backgrounds. Drop rates are always shown before you open a box, and boxes only contain cosmetic items. You get a free box every day.

SHARE YOUR PROPHECY
Turn any answer into an image with your question and the spirit's reply, ready to send to your friends.

· 10 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, Indonesian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
· No account needed. Your progress stays on your phone.
· The microphone is only used while you hold the fingerprint. AMON does not record or store your voice.
· Free with ads. Remove ads with a one-time purchase.

AMON is for entertainment only. Its answers are random and are not advice.

name: Anasu Keyboard
description:
Anasu Keyboard puts the boards of Anasu into every app.

Anasu is a free augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app for adults who speak little or not at all. With this keyboard, the same tiles, with the same ARASAAC pictograms and at the same places, write in Messages, WhatsApp, Mail, Notes and every other app.

• A tile writes its word in the text.
• The speaker key says the sentence aloud, with the voice of the iPhone or iPad.
• The voice is chosen in the app, among those of the iPhone or iPad.
• Pages and folders, as in Anasu.
• The boards change in the app itself: add, move, rename or remove tiles, make folders, choose pictures or take photos.
• Boards come from Anasu (anasu.wizit.org) with one file, and leave the same way, to share them.
• Starter boards for nine regions: French (Switzerland, France, Canada), German (Switzerland, Germany), Italian (Switzerland) and English (United Kingdom, United States, Canada).

Private
The keyboard has no network code: what is written stays on the device. No account, no advertising, no tracking. Full Access is needed only for the voice and to read the person's own boards; without it, the keyboard still writes.

Free
Anasu and its keyboard are free. They are made by the WizIT Association, in Switzerland. Pictograms: Sergio Palao, ARASAAC (Government of Aragon, Spain), licence CC BY-NC-SA.

Anasu is not a medical device.

name: Anglais 6e – Cours et jeux
description:
Anglais 6e accompagne les élèves de sixième (niveau A1) avec des cours en français, des mots à écouter et des jeux.

LE PROGRAMME DE 6e
• Me and my world : se présenter, les nombres, l'heure, la famille, l'école, la nourriture, la maison, les animaux
• Grammar tools : pronoms et possessifs (his/her), questions, présent simple et présent en -ing, a/an, pluriels
• The English-speaking world : Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, Irlande, Australie, les fêtes (Halloween, Bonfire Night, Thanksgiving), Robin Hood et le roi Arthur

ÉCOUTER ET PRONONCER
Chaque mot et chaque phrase en anglais peut être écouté avec un bouton .

APPRENDRE EN JOUANT
• Exercices à l'infini : vocabulaire, dictée audio, nombres, heure, 3e personne, -ing, pluriels
• Situations de la vie réelle pas à pas : au café à Londres, se présenter, décrire sa chambre
• « Who am I? » sur la culture anglophone
• Quiz, vrai/faux, classements, évaluation de fin d'année
• Révision automatique des erreurs

CONÇU POUR LES ENFANTS
• Sans publicité, sans compte, sans achat
• Aucune donnée collectée : la progression reste sur l'appareil
• Fonctionne hors connexion

name: AniyaX
description:
AniyaX drafts X posts and replies in your own voice and checks each one against rules learned from your own posts. It never logs in to your X account: you read the draft, then post it yourself.

This is the iPhone app for your AniyaX account. Your drafts, rules and history are the same here as on the web and on your Mac.

• Today: what to post next, fresh posts worth a reply, and drafts ready to go.
• Replies: paste a post's link, or share it to AniyaX from X, and get replies drafted in your voice.
• Ladder feed: new posts from bigger accounts in your niche, while a reply still gets seen.
• Plan: your month on a calendar, with what went out, what's scheduled and what's waiting.
• Rules: learned from what worked for you, and checked against every draft.
• Analytics: what went out, what it did, and a weekly review of your rules.

Copy and open X puts a reply on your clipboard and opens the post in X, so posting stays one tap and stays yours.

A notification tells you when a ladder post is fresh enough to reply to, and the icon badge counts the ones still waiting. Long-press the icon for Quick draft.

Drafting uses your own Anthropic or OpenAI key.

Signing in needs an AniyaX account.

name: APEX DRIVERS
description:
APEX DRIVERS es la app oficial para los equipos y pilotos de Endurance Drivers, el campeonato de resistencia organizado por APEX DRIVERS.

Reúne la gestión de tu temporada en un mismo lugar, desde la preparación de cada carrera hasta la llegada al circuito:

- Gestiona tu equipo, sus pilotos y el vehículo.
- Consulta el calendario, la información de las carreras y los horarios.
- Gestiona inscripciones a carreras, Desafíos y campeonato.
- Revisa tus Driver Points, pedidos y estado de pagos.
- Accede a la normativa y la documentación de los eventos.
- Lleva el QR de tu equipo para el check-in en el circuito.
- Recibe avisos y notificaciones de la organización.

Las funciones disponibles dependen de tu perfil y de tus inscripciones. Necesitas una cuenta de APEX DRIVERS. La participación en los eventos se contrata por separado.

name: APEX MOTO
description:
APEX MOTO is the official app of a motorcycle riders' community in Baku, Azerbaijan. Everything a rider needs before and during a ride, in one place.

RIDER MAP
Places marked by riders themselves: coffee and tea stops, scenic roads, fuel, service and mechanics, moto shops, parking and meeting points. Dangerous roads and places that are "not worth it" are shown as warnings. Start navigation to any place with Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze in one tap.

ROUTE + WEATHER
Plan a route and check the weather along the way — rain, wind and temperature — before you leave.

EVENTS
Club rides, meetups and trainings. Register, save your spot and get a reminder when the event is near.

NOTIFICATIONS
Club announcements, event news and personal notifications arrive straight to your phone, with images. Tap to open the full message; clear or delete them any time.

MEMBER CARD
Your digital membership card with a QR code, always with you.

MEMBERS
The APEX family: roles, bikes and rider profiles.

The map, routes, events and members are open to everyone without an account. Other sections are for club members; you can apply for membership from the app. The app interface is in Azerbaijani.

Anyone can ride. Not everyone can be APEX.

name: Arena of Cards
description:
Arena of Cards is a fast real-time card game. In three-minute battles you send units, buildings and spells onto the field and try to bring down your opponent's towers before they get yours.

How to play
• Build a deck of eight cards. You can save up to three decks.
• Every card costs mana. Use it wisely: attack, defend, or both at once.
• Destroy the king tower for an instant win. If it ends in a draw, the weakest tower decides.

What awaits you
• 82 cards: knights, dragons, golems, witches, cannons, fireballs and much more
• Ten regions from Mossdale to the Sky Citadel, each with its own cards
• The story "The Chronicle of the Grey Cards" with a new chapter every month
• Daily quests, chests with gold, cards and crystals
• League points, leaderboard and seasons
• Battle real players, or computer-controlled opponents when nobody suitable is online
• Fully in English and German

Fair play
No ads, no tracking. The odds for every chest are shown in the game. Move your account to a new phone with a transfer code, and delete it yourself at any time.

See you in the arena!

name: ATABAY Hukuk
description:
ATABAY Hukuk, Atabay Hukuk Bürosu müvekkilleri ve avukatları için geliştirilmiş özel bir uygulamadır.

Müvekkiller için:
• Dosyalarınızın güncel durumunu ve süreç kayıtlarını görün
• Yaklaşan duruşmalarınızı takip edin
• Büronun paylaştığı belgeleri açın, sizden istenen belgeleri yükleyin
• Avukatınızla dosya üzerinden yazışın
• Mali durumunuzu görün
• Yeni gelişmelerden bildirimle haberdar olun

Avukatlar için:
• Size atanmış dosyalar ve duruşmalar
• Müvekkil mesajları ve yüklemeleri için bildirimler

Hesaplar büro tarafından açılır; uygulama içinden kayıt olunmaz. Giriş bilgilerinizi büronuzdan alırsınız.

name: Atomica: Periodic Table
description:
Explore the elements with Atomica, an illustrated periodic table and offline chemistry guide from Moondrop Studios.

Find an element by name, symbol or atomic number. Filter by family, browse a focused periodic table, or open the full table and pan and zoom to explore.

Element profiles bring together atomic facts, properties, uses, origins, discovery stories and source notes. Illustrated introductions make familiar materials and unusual research elements easier to explore.

Free for every element: names, symbols, atomic numbers, search, family filters, images and introductions. The first 20 elements, plus Iron, Copper, Silver, Gold and Bismuth, include their full profiles for free.

One optional lifetime purchase unlocks all 118 full profiles. Pay once, with no subscription or recurring charge. Purchases and restoration use your Apple Account.

Element articles and artwork are bundled, so browsing works offline. Purchases and restoration may need an internet connection. Atomica remembers local searches, filters and your place without requiring an Atomica account or using advertising or analytics SDKs.

name: Bagsman: Football RPG
description:
What does it take to become a football legend? In BAGSMAN, your career is in your hands.

Start your journey as an aspiring footballer and work your way through the world of professional football. Develop your attributes, unlock powerful perks, make career-defining decisions and prove yourself on the pitch.

BAGSMAN combines football gameplay with RPG progression, giving you control over the kind of player you become and the career you build.

BUILD YOUR PLAYER

Develop your attributes and improve the skills that matter. Will you become a powerful striker, a technically gifted playmaker or an all-round footballer? Your progression shapes your strengths and weaknesses.

UNLOCK TRAITS & PERKS

Discover powerful perks and traits that define your playing style. Build your character around the abilities that suit your approach to the game.

MAKE YOUR OWN DECISIONS

Your career isn't just about what happens on the pitch. Navigate decisions, handle media interactions and use your attributes to influence the opportunities that come your way.

CLIMB THE FOOTBALL PYRAMID

Start your journey and fight your way through the divisions. Earn your place, attract opportunities and establish yourself at the highest level.

TRAIN TO IMPROVE

Put in the work away from matchday. Develop your abilities through training and become a better footballer.

BUILD A CAREER WORTH REMEMBERING

Chase achievements, overcome challenges and create your own footballing legacy.

Your journey. Your decisions. Your career.

Are you good enough to make it?

name: Bằng Lái Ơi: Ôn thi GPLX 2027
description:
Ôn thi lý thuyết bằng lái xe miễn phí, hiểu luật chứ không học thuộc. Mỗi câu đều có giải thích, câu luật nào cũng ghi rõ điều luật. Hiểu rồi thì nhớ lâu.

Đủ bộ 600 câu
• Bộ 600 câu hỏi sát hạch của Cục CSGT, có hình biển báo và sa hình.
• Đủ các hạng theo luật mới: xe máy A1 và A, ô tô B, cùng các hạng xe tải, xe khách và kéo rơ moóc. Bạn chọn hạng khi mở app lần đầu, muốn đổi lúc nào cũng được.
• Câu điểm liệt có danh sách riêng. Sai một câu điểm liệt là không đạt, dù đủ điểm.

Thi thử giống đề thật
• 30 đề đánh số và đề ngẫu nhiên, đúng số câu, thời gian và điểm đạt của hạng bạn chọn.
• Ví dụ: hạng A1 có 25 câu, làm trong 19 phút, đúng 21 câu là đạt. Hạng B có 30 câu, làm trong 20 phút, đúng 27 câu là đạt.
• Làm xong, xem lại từng câu sai.

Ôn mỗi ngày, vừa sức
• App chia bài cho từng ngày theo ngày thi bạn chọn.
• Câu sai quay lại đúng lúc để bạn nhớ lâu. Câu sai, câu khó và câu đã lưu đều có danh sách riêng.
• Mức sẵn sàng cho biết bạn đã ôn vững tới đâu.
• Nhắc học mỗi ngày đúng giờ bạn chọn.
• Tìm câu theo số câu hoặc theo chữ trong câu.
• Có giao diện sáng và tối, chỉnh được cỡ chữ.

Thấy sai thì báo
Bấm Báo lỗi ở câu bạn thấy sai. Mình đọc từng báo lỗi và so lại với văn bản luật trong 48 giờ.

Không cần tài khoản
• Tiến độ lưu trên máy bạn. Học được khi không có mạng.
• App chỉ gửi dữ liệu sử dụng ẩn danh nếu bạn đồng ý. Tắt lúc nào cũng được trong Cài đặt.
• Quyền riêng tư: https://banglaioi.com/quyen-rieng-tu

Nguồn
• Câu hỏi và đáp án theo bộ 600 câu của Cục CSGT (Công văn 2262/CSGT-P5). Quy chế thi theo Thông tư 12/2025/TT-BCA, áp dụng đến hết 28/2/2027.
• Từ 1/3/2027, thi lý thuyết theo Thông tư 108/2026/TT-BCA. Mình cập nhật app khi có bộ câu hỏi mới của Cục CSGT.
• Văn bản gốc: https://vanban.bocongan.gov.vn/co-so-du-lieu-van-ban/thong-tu-quy-dinh-ve-sat-hach-cap-giay-phep-lai-xe-cap-su-dung-giay-phep-lai-xe-quoc-te-1246
• Giải thích có thể có sai sót.

Bằng Lái Ơi không phải ứng dụng của cơ quan nhà nước và không liên kết với cơ quan nhà nước nào. Số liệu lấy từ văn bản chính thức của Bộ Công an.

name: Batchabox
description:
Batchabox for iPhone and iPad is the remote for Batchabox on your Mac. It needs the Mac app (free, from batchabox.app) or batchad on a Linux server.

Pair once, and your projects, cards and even unsaved edits are right where you left them at the desk.

Git

Any branch against its base, word by word
The log with its graph, worktrees and stashes
Stage, commit, push and pull
Files

Read the code with syntax colours and go to definition
Quick fixes in place, then save
Databases

PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite
Tables with filters and foreign keys you can follow
Run a query and read its result
A prod pill on the connections that matter
Search

Branches, files, tables, cards and commands from one field
Agent worktrees

Every worktree your agents made, with what needs you now
Private by design

It talks straight to your Mac, at home or over Tailscale
HTTPS with a pinned certificate and a key per device, revoke any time
Edits, Git writes and commands are off until you allow them on the Mac
No account, no telemetry, nothing collected

name: Beatpocket: Beat Maker
description:
Record the sounds around you. Beatpocket turns them into a 16-pad kit in seconds, and you can take it all the way to a finished song.

Knock on a desk, clink a glass, clap, hum. Beatpocket cuts your recording into one-shots and sorts them into kick, snare, hats, perc, melody and ambience.

• Low-latency 16 pads. Hit harder, play louder
• Melody pads follow the song's key, so nothing clashes
• Pick a style and get three beats built from your sounds
• Tap along while it plays and your rhythm goes straight into the beat
• Intro to outro, the whole song laid out for you
• Beats up to 4 bars. See the whole song as a waveform and arrange its parts
• Record your voice over the song and change it: tuned, robot, echo and 6 more
• Export WAV, stems or a vertical video for social
• Release package with a master WAV, 3000×3000 cover art and credits. Upload it to a distributor and get on Spotify, Apple Music and more

Nothing to record? Start from one of 8 sound packs: 808 Trap, Lo-fi Dust, Boom Bap, House Club, 8-bit Game, Kitchen, Latin Perc and Glass & Bells. Every sound is made inside the app, so songs you make with them can be posted and sold too.

name: Black Signal
description:
Draw tarot, cast Elder Futhark runes and I Ching, and explore your local sky with paced breathing and rituals. An interactive graphic novel brings those practices into a story, and a private journal shows which symbols return over time.

Original illustrations and reflections cover all 78 tarot cards, 24 runes, and 64 hexagrams. Each reading gives you a question to consider. The ink-print interface follows your device’s dark or light appearance.

STORY MODE
Open Story Mode from Journal and follow seven illustrated chapters through a flooded city. Read terminal messages from Root, make choices, and use the same readings and rituals as the story unfolds. Readings made in the story are marked with their chapter in your journal.

TAROT
Reveal a card at full size, then open its reading and reflection. Search the full illustrated deck by name or codename.

CAST
Cast an Elder Futhark rune on an illustrated rooftop cloth or toss coins to build a six-line I Ching hexagram. Browse the complete hexagram index.

Full Signal adds tropical placements from the Sun through Pluto, with a reflection for each, plus major aspects and optional Birth Sky with your birth placements and today's transits. Birth details stay on your device.

BREATH

RITUALS
Pair a card draw with paced breathing in Card Contemplation. With Full Signal, cast a hexagram line by line in Breath-Cast I Ching or trace a rune in Rune Carving. The local moon phase suggests a ritual. Optional suit tones vary by the card drawn in Full Signal Card Contemplation. Cutting, shaking on supported devices, or tapping on an exhale can mix your timing or motion into system randomness without weighting the draw.

JOURNAL
Revisit readings, rituals, and breathing sessions. Edit your questions and reflections, see what keeps coming back, and revisit earlier reflections through journal echoes. Export your journal as Markdown or JSON.

SOUND

PRIVACY
Your journal, readings, and preferences stay on your device. You can skip first-launch personalization. Saved name and birth details stay on your device. The app works offline and has no accounts, ads, or tracking. Apple handles purchases and restores.

WHAT’S FREE
Draw one card from the 22 Major Arcana, draw one rune, and cast a six-line I Ching hexagram with its primary reading. Browse the full tarot and hexagram indexes. Choose your sky location, check the local moon phase and rise and set times, use three minutes of silent box breathing, or try silent Card Contemplation with a Major Arcana card and two minutes of box breathing. Read the first two story chapters. Journal, recurrence, echoes, and export are included.

FULL SIGNAL
Draw one card from all 78 cards or reveal the three-card Past / Present / Next Step spread. Cast three runes and see I Ching changing lines and the relating hexagram. View sky placements and aspects, save optional birth details, and see birth placements and daily transits. Unlock every Breath pattern and duration, adjustable stereo tones and previews, the full deck and more patterns, durations, and optional suit tones in Card Contemplation, plus Breath-Cast I Ching and Rune Carving. Continue through the remaining five story chapters. One purchase unlocks Full Signal across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No subscription.

Start with a question and come back to what you wrote.

name: Brick Dino Racer

A joystick to steer and drive, plus big BRAKE and FIRE buttons. Switch between chase, first-person and overhead cameras. Get stuck and a rescue helicopter lifts you back onto the track.

name: Builtence
description:
Builtence is the field app for technical due diligence inspections of commercial and residential buildings. It is made for building consultants and advisory firms.

Walk the building and say what you see. Take photos as you go. Type a note when you need one. Everything lands on one timeline, so each photo sits next to what you said when you took it.

WHAT IT DOES
• Records your spoken observations and turns them into text.

START RIGHT AWAY

You are told what is recorded before the first recording. Speech is transcribed on your device when it can be. If that fails, the audio is transcribed on our servers. Transcripts and photos are analysed with AI to draft findings. No ads. No tracking.

The app is in English and Norwegian.

name: BurrLens: Wooden Puzzle Guide
description:
Look closer. Understand the pieces. Find a way through a wooden interlocking puzzle.

BurrLens is a local puzzle workshop for inspecting notch geometry and following verified straight sliding solutions.

COMPARE A PHOTO
Capture a lock or select a photo. On-device silhouette comparison orders four rendered model examples as visual suggestions. Use a plain background, count the pieces and compare each shape. This is not a universal lock identifier: photos cannot reveal hidden notches, and unrelated objects may return suggestions. Manually confirm every slot and the assembled orientation before following a solution.

INSPECT EVERY PIECE
Explore four original geometric examples: a three-piece cross, a six-piece burr, a six-piece lattice and a nine-piece lattice. These exact notch layouts do not represent all traditional or commercial variants. Rotate the model, expand the pieces, and inspect X/Y/Z slices. Letter labels work alongside colors. Edit unit-cube slots within each template piece's bounds plus one grid cell, keeping a shared scale and assembled orientation. Unknown geometry requires manual modeling.

FOLLOW A CHECKED PATH
The offline solver checks straight axis-aligned separation of pieces and groups, verifies occupied-cell collisions along each path and replays the complete partition before saving. Follow signed axes and lettered groups, then mark each completed step. Assembly reverses the order and direction, with diagrams showing the target fit. View rotation does not change model axes. Arrows show direction, not distance. The app does not track physical movements; Previous diagram changes the displayed step only.

KEEP YOUR WORKSHOP
Save verified models, steps, notes and progress locally. Resume after relaunch. Share a chosen solution as text with notes and exact model coordinates, or delete a saved record after confirmation.

KNOW THE BOUNDARIES
Supports 2–9 connected, nonoverlapping unit-cube pieces in a −8…8 grid per axis, with a 120,000-direction-check search limit. Preliminary short shifts, rotations, diagonal motion, bending and force are not supported. A missing result means this solver found no supported separation, not that the physical puzzle is impossible. Some assembled locks cannot reveal their geometry without an already-known disassembly. Never force wooden joints.

PRIVATE AND LOCAL
Photos remain temporary in memory during the photo workflow, are not saved to history and are not uploaded. No account, ads, analytics, tracking, third-party AI, developer cloud, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Apple device backups follow system settings.

English and Simplified Chinese. iPhone and iPad.

The kingdom of Calcolandia lies buried under a fog of numbers. Only those who can calculate can defeat the monsters that dwell there.

Calcolandia is a pixel art role-playing game where every battle is won with math: explore the map, meet a monster and answer before time runs out.

name: Callfetti: Meme Calls & Voices

EVEN THE TINY VERSION COUNTS

name: ChatCrafar

Download ChatCrafar and practice the chat before you send.

name: Chi Bepazam: Persian Meals

What should I cook today? Answer a few quick questions and get Persian dish ideas that fit your mood, your hunger, your time and the ingredients you actually have.

THE APP SPEAKS PERSIAN

HOW IT WORKS

MORE THAN 160 PERSIAN DISHES

SMART PICKS, YOUR WAY
• Apple Intelligence on your device when it is available
• Or your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini API key if you want to add one

name: Code crack
description:
Sau cánh cửa két sắt là một mã bí mật. Hãy đoán, đọc các chốt gợi ý và thu hẹp dần cho tới khi két bật mở.

Codecrack là trò giải mã cổ điển theo kiểu Bulls and Cows. Sau mỗi lần đoán, bạn nhận hai loại manh mối:
● đúng ký hiệu, đúng chỗ
○ có trong mã nhưng sai chỗ
Manh mối không cho biết ứng với ô nào — đó chính là lúc cần suy luận.

BỐN CÁCH CHƠI
• Chơi một mình — giải mã máy giấu với ít lượt nhất.
• Đua với máy — bạn đặt mã cho máy, máy đặt mã cho bạn, hai bên thay phiên đoán. Xem bàn của máy để biết nó suy luận ra sao. Máy có 3 mức: Dễ, Vừa, Khó.
• Hai người — đặt mã, đưa máy cho bạn đoán, rồi đổi vai. Ai ít lượt hơn thắng.
• Hằng ngày — mỗi ngày một mã mới, giống nhau cho mọi người. Giữ chuỗi ngày và chia sẻ kết quả dạng lưới emoji, không lộ đáp án.

TỪ DỄ ĐẾN CHUYÊN GIA
• Dễ: 4 ô, 6 ký hiệu, không trùng, 12 lượt
• Vừa: 4 ô, 6 ký hiệu, có trùng, 10 lượt
• Khó: 5 ô, 8 ký hiệu, có trùng, 10 lượt
• Chuyên gia: 6 ô, 8 ký hiệu, có trùng, 12 lượt

TRỢ GIÚP KHI CẦN
• Tối đa 2 gợi ý mỗi ván: đếm số mã còn khả dĩ hoặc loại một ký hiệu
• Chạm giữ ký hiệu trong khay để đánh dấu "loại"
• Chế độ học (tuỳ chọn) cảnh báo khi lần đoán mâu thuẫn với manh mối trước
• Phản hồi dạng chấm hoặc dạng số
• Tự điền lại lần đoán trước để sửa nhanh
• Hướng dẫn tương tác ngắn gọn khi mới bắt đầu

THEO DÕI TIẾN BỘ
• Ít lần nhất, nhanh nhất và tỉ lệ thắng theo từng mức
• Biểu đồ phân bố số lần đoán, chuỗi ngày
• Thành tích đua với máy
• 3 thành tựu để mở khoá

CHỌN BỘ KÝ HIỆU
• Màu — mỗi màu đi kèm một hình riêng
• Trái cây & bánh
• Động vật
• Đồ vật

TRỢ NĂNG
• Màu luôn đi kèm hình riêng, chốt gợi ý phân biệt đặc/rỗng — không phụ thuộc vào màu
• Nhãn đọc màn hình cho mọi ô, lần đoán và manh mối
• Tôn trọng cài đặt Giảm chuyển động của hệ thống
• Giao diện sáng và tối
• Mọi thao tác đều làm được bằng chạm — kéo-thả chỉ là tuỳ chọn

THÔNG TIN THÊM
• Chơi hoàn toàn không cần mạng
• Không quảng cáo, không tài khoản, không mua trong ứng dụng

Quyền riêng tư: Không thu thập dữ liệu. Thống kê và cài đặt chỉ lưu trên thiết bị của bạn.

Cross Math Metro is a number puzzle drawn as a metro map. Every row and every column is a small sum, and every sum is a metro line.

HOW IT WORKS
Fill the empty stations with numbers from the tray below. When every row and column is true, the puzzle is solved. When a line adds up it turns solid and a train runs along it. × and ÷ (square discs) come before + and − (round discs); you can switch every line to read left to right in Settings.

BIG NUMBERS, EASY ON THE EYES
Clear, heavy numbers and roomy squares. Three text sizes and day, paper and night themes. Colours always mean the same thing: red adds, blue subtracts, green multiplies, amber divides.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
The same daily puzzle for everyone. Monday starts easy, Sunday ends with Expert. Solve every day of a month to put its trophy on your profile shelf; missed days can be played later. Chests at 7 and 15 days pay out coins.

YOUR OWN METRO NETWORK
Twenty cities from Istanbul to Barcelona, twenty stations each. Every level you solve adds a stop to your map; finish a city and its line runs end to end.

A GENTLE HAND WHEN YOU SLIP
A wrong number shows as a hatched square and tells you what to do. You have three lives; when they run out, continue with an ad or coins, or keep playing without lives. When you're stuck, a hint fills one square for you.

FROM EASY TO EXPERT
Easy has short sums with + and −; Expert has long lines and order of operations. Free play gives you as many puzzles as you like at any difficulty.

YOUR PACE
No account, plays offline; your progress is kept on your phone and in iCloud. A puzzle you leave halfway waits where you left it. The daily reminder is optional and only comes on days you haven't played. On iPad the board and the tray sit side by side.

FREE
Cross Math Metro is free and supported by ads: from level 12, a short ad between some levels. Ads for a life, a hint or coins only start when you choose. Coins buy hints, extra lives, streak freezes and new train looks. A one-time "Remove ads" takes away the ads between levels; coin packs are optional.

name: DECIBRA
description:
DECIBRA turns your iPhone into a live sound laboratory. Measure how loud things are, see what frequencies make up a sound, and understand what that noise means for your hearing. Everything is analysed on your device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

METER
• Live sound level in dBA, dBC or dBZ with Fast, Slow and Impulse time weighting
• Radial gauge or LED bar display with peak hold
• Minimum, maximum, average (Leq) and peak statistics
• 60-second level trend and everyday sound comparisons
• Loud sound alerts with haptics and a log of every loud event

ANALYZE
• Real-time 1/3-octave and FFT spectrum with peak hold
• Touch to read any frequency band
• Scrolling spectrogram (waterfall) and oscilloscope
• Freeze a reference spectrum and compare before and after

INSIGHTS
• On-device sound identification for hundreds of everyday sounds
• Pitch tuner with musical note and cents
• Tone character: brightness, tonality and spikiness
• Perceived loudness and noise dose against NIOSH, OSHA or WHO limits
• Level distribution and detailed technical readouts

LAB
• Signal generator: sine, square and triangle tones, white and pink noise, and frequency sweeps
• Reverberation time (RT60) from a handclap
• Calibration against a reference meter
• Interactive sound ladder from a whisper to a jet engine

HISTORY AND WIDGETS
• Record sessions and review level charts, spectra and exposure
• Export CSV data, PDF reports and shareable images
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island while recording
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for today's noise exposure

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
DECIBRA uses the microphone only to measure. Audio never leaves your device and is never saved. No account, no tracking, no ads.

Please note: smartphone microphones are not certified measurement instruments. Readings are indicative. Calibrate against a reference meter for best accuracy. DECIBRA is not a medical device.

description:

**SOLVE EACH CASE WITH LOGIC**

Exactly one person belongs in each row and each column. People can stand on cells with a rug, chair, or bench, but not on cells occupied by a table, bookshelf, potted plant, or case item. Follow the clues, eliminate impossible positions, and find everyone's place. Each case has one unique solution and can be solved without guessing. Think you know the culprit early? Make your accusation before completing the whole map.

**TOOLS FOR DEDUCTION**

Place suspects on the map. Mark impossible cells with Cell X and rule out positions for specific people with Person X. Check off clues you've used, and use undo or redo as you reason through the scene.

**LEARN STEP BY STEP**

A 7-step How to Play guide explains the rules and controls. Practice what you've learned in the tutorial cases of Chapter 1.

**HINTS THAT EXPLAIN WHY**

**A QUIET MYSTERY BREAK**

Enjoy small, everyday mysteries rather than grim crimes. Play puzzles offline without signing in. There are no banner ads or forced ads; rewarded ads are entirely optional. Your progress is stored on your device.

- Languages: English and Korean
- Season Pro: a separate, one-time in-app purchase for each season
- Internet connection required for rewarded ads and purchases.

name: Dhiya
description:

The lamp is tended, not kept alive. Its oil lowers and the thiri burns down only while you sit with it. Pour oil from the brass kindi; lay a fresh thiri from the thattu. Close the app and the lamp sleeps; open it and it brightens back to where you left it.

By night, set it as a dim bedside lamp with a soft clock, for an hour or up to twelve. Swipe past the brightest for lantern mode, a warm full-screen glow to light a dark room. If you like, play a quiet sound while it burns: the flame’s flutter, a recording from Keralam, rain and thunder, a stream, or ocean waves.

No streaks. No reminders. No account. No ads. Nothing to chase — just a flame.

name: DuoBall Roll: Arcade Alley
description:
Flick a wooden ball up the lane, hop it over the hump, and drop it in the rings.

DuoBall Roll is a boardwalk alley-roll game built as a whole 3D machine you hold in your hand. The ball skids, rolls, climbs the hump, lands with topspin and drops into whichever hole it reaches. The same flick from the same spot does the same thing every time, so every point comes from your aim and your touch.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Touch the ball and drag it across the lane to aim.
- Flick up to roll. A harder flick rolls faster; too soft and the ball rolls back to you.
- 10 and 20 sit low on the board, 30, 40 and 50 climb the middle, and the two chrome cans in the top corners are worth 100. For a 100, roll a little firmer than for the 50, from against a side rail.
- Nine balls a game. Chase your best score.

A MACHINE WITH SOME SHINE
- Chasing marquee bulbs and lightning-bolt cabinet art
- A ball return that hands you the next ball
- A strip of paper tickets that feeds out when the game ends: pull it or tap it, and watch the tickets fly into your count
- Wooden knocks, a bell for every score that rings higher for bigger ones, and a fanfare with lights and confetti for every 100
- On iPhone, you feel the ball roll, land and drop

FOLD IT INTO A CABINET
DuoBall Roll works with iPhone Duo. Stand it half open like a laptop and the whole phone becomes the machine: the lane lies flat on the bottom half, the ring board stands up on the top half, and the cabinet bends right at the fold, with its own START and PRIZES buttons. Closed, open, held tall, held wide or folded like a book, the game fits the screen you're using.

SEE IT YOUR WAY
Full Lane shows the whole lane and ring board at once and holds still. Follow rides along with the ball and moves in on the rings as it arrives. Switch between them whenever the ball is in your hand. On other iPhones it plays in portrait, and on iPad in any orientation.

THE PRIZE COUNTER
Every finished game earns tickets by fixed rules: one for every 10 points, plus bonus tickets for each 100, for a game of 400 or more, and for a new best score. Spend them at the prize counter on new looks for every part of your machine: the balls, lane felt, bulbs, light chase, board, 100 cans, marquee, cabinet and even the tickets. Try any look on before you spend a single ticket, complete a set and its marquee is yours too, and earn awards for milestones like your first 100.

Prizes change only how your machine looks, never how the ball rolls or how you score. Tickets come only from playing. There is nothing to buy inside the game and there are no ads.

NEW TO THE LANE?
Tap PRIZES to open the prize counter, then tap How to Play in its top bar. The (?) beside it explains how tickets work.

FOR EVERY PLAYER
- VoiceOver and Switch Control: move the ball across the lane, then roll softly, medium, firmly or hard. With VoiceOver, every ball's result is spoken.
- Reduce Motion holds the bulbs steady and keeps the view on Full Lane.
- Game sounds mix with your music and go quiet when your device is set to silent. The Sound control turns them off.

NO ACCOUNT, NO INTERNET
There's nothing to sign up for and nothing to connect to. Your scores, tickets and machine stay on your device.

description:

• Ähli welaýatlar: Aşgabat, Ahal, Balkan, Daşoguz, Lebap we Mary.
• Aňsat gözleg: şäher, etrap, welaýat, baha, otag sany we emläk görnüşi boýunça süzgüçler; emläk belgisi (mysal üçin AG-0012) boýunça gözleg.
