In English: emläkçi is a map-first listings service for finding, buying, selling and renting homes, apartments, land and commercial property in Turkmenistan. Every listing has an exact pin on the map; every region is covered; filter by city, price, rooms and property type; phone numbers are confirmed by SMS and new listings are checked by a moderator before they go live. Report listings, block users and delete your account right in the app. Property in Turkmenistan, including for Turkmens living abroad.

name: EquiliRatio
description:
EquiliRatio
Focus Economics & Cognitive Workload Balance

Modern knowledge work is constantly disrupted by superficial administrative tasks, rapid pings, and reactive communications. EquiliRatio provides a structured focus economics framework to balance high-impact deep concentration against essential administrative obligations.

Based on cognitive workload models, EquiliRatio tracks your real-time work allocation toward the recommended 70:30 golden ratio (70% Deep Focus vs 30% Shallow Admin).

KEY CAPABILITIES:

1. Dynamic Dual-Arc Ratio Dial
- Real-time circular ratio visualizer displaying your current cognitive allocation.
- Tracks deep focus versus shallow admin duration with clean, high-contrast metrics.
- Instant balance feedback to keep daily productivity within sustainable boundaries.

2. Sprint Engine & Friction Lab
- Dedicated work session manager supporting 25, 45, and 90-minute structured sprints.
- Cognitive Friction Index rating (1 to 5) after each sprint to evaluate distraction levels.
- Interruption counter to document focus disruptions and context switches.

3. Flow Heatmap & 7-Day Stacked Trends
- Multi-dimensional stacked bar charts revealing daily time investments.
- Hourly flow heatmap identifying your personal peak productivity windows.
- Weekly efficiency ratings, goal completion percentages, and distraction resistance metrics.

4. Historical Ledger & Offline CSV Export
- Comprehensive local archive of all completed focus sprints and friction ratings.
- Categorical filtering by work mode, friction level, and tags.
- Direct CSV data export via native system share sheet for offline backups and personal analysis.

5. Complete Privacy & Offline Reliability
- Built with a 100% on-device architecture.
- No user account creation, no cloud registration, and no tracking libraries.
- Immediate utility from the moment you launch the application.

EquiliRatio helps software engineers, researchers, writers, and students reclaim deep mental flow and eliminate cognitive fatigue.

name: ESUN VIP
description: In terms of content presentation, we strive for simplicity, clarity, and non piling up. Reasonable information layering, clear focus at a glance, avoiding distractions among complex elements. We believe that restrained design often brings long-lasting comfort more than excessive decoration.

name: Evce: Shared Home Planner
description:
Evce is a shared household notebook for couples, families and housemates. Create a household, invite the people you live with using an invite code, and keep your lists and calendar the same on everyone’s phone.

• Today: the day’s chores, calendar and shopping on one page, with tomorrow right underneath.
• Lists: shared Shopping and Household chores lists. Start more shared lists, or keep personal lists only you can see.
• Calendar: appointments and special dates. Events you mark “Only me” stay visible only to you.
• Reminders: give chores a date and time, and get event reminders 30 minutes before. Jobs like changing a filter come back a few months after you complete them.
• One “Add” button: a shopping item, a chore or an event, all from the same place.
• Notifications: when someone in your household changes something shared, you get a short alert that never shows the content. You can turn these off.

Evce is free, with no ads or tracking. It is available in English and Turkish. An internet connection is needed to share changes with your household.

name: EzSoft Pager
description:
EzSoft Pager هو بيجر رقمي لمتابعة الطلبات لدى المنشآت التي تستخدم نظام EzSoft.

افتح رابط متابعة طلبك لعرض رقم الطلب واسم المنشأة وحالته، من التجهيز إلى الجاهزية والاستلام. ويمكنك تفعيل التحديثات المباشرة لمتابعة الحالة على شاشة القفل وعلى Dynamic Island في الأجهزة المدعومة.

لا يحتاج الاستخدام إلى إنشاء حساب أو تسجيل الدخول. يتطلب متابعة الطلب رابطًا صالحًا صادرًا من إحدى المنشآت المشاركة. ويمكن إيقاف المتابعة من التطبيق دون إلغاء الطلب.

يدعم التطبيق اللغة العربية، ويعرض هوية المنشأة المرتبطة بالطلب. تعتمد التحديثات على اتصال الإنترنت وتحديث المنشأة لحالة الطلب.

name: Fairways & Greens
description:
Track every shot and every bet in one place.

Fairways & Greens is built for groups who play for more than bragging rights. Record scores hole by hole, run the games your group actually plays, and see exactly where everyone stands as you go.

GAMES BUILT IN
Banker, Bloody Banker, Skins, Nassau, Stockton 6’s, Wolf, Nine Points, FBO, and open side bets for anything else your group dreams up.

WORKS WHERE YOU PLAY
Enter scores with no signal and they save on your phone, then sync automatically when you’re back in range. No lost holes, no re-entering a round at the clubhouse.

HANDICAPS HANDLED
Net scores calculate automatically so mixed-ability groups stay competitive.

SHARE THE DAMAGE
Send the scorecard to the group when the round’s done.

Fairways & Greens tracks wagers between players for scorekeeping only. No money is processed, transferred, or held in the app.

name: FaithView
description:
FaithView begleitet dich im Glaubensalltag – ob Christ oder Muslim. Mit Nuri, einem kleinen Spatz, der dich jeden Tag ein Stück weiterbringt.

• Bibel und Koran: lesen wie in einem Buch, Verse farbig markieren, Notizzettel, mit dem Stift schreiben, Suche und Paralleltext
• Lernpfad: kurze Lektionen Schritt für Schritt, dazu Lesepläne – die Evangelien in 30 Tagen, Psalmen, den Koran in 30 Tagen
• Vers des Tages: jeden Morgen neu, als schönes Bild gestalten – mit Vorlagen oder ganz nach deinem Geschmack – und teilen
• Vorlesen: Vers für Vers mit Wort-Markierung und natürlichen iPhone-Stimmen
• Frag Nuri: Antworten mit echten Bibel- und Koranstellen, kostenlos und offline
• Gebet: die fünf Gebete mit Countdown und Qibla-Kompass, christliche Gebetszeiten am Morgen, Mittag und Abend – mit sanften Erinnerungen
• Dranbleiben: Serien-Flamme, Tracker, Karteikarten zum Auswendiglernen und kleine Bibel- und Koran-Spiele
• Deine Gemeinde: Gottesdienste, Termine, Neuigkeiten und Gebetsanliegen deiner Kirche oder Moschee
• Mehrere Farbwelten, auch dunkel – auf Deutsch, Englisch, Türkisch und Arabisch

Ohne Werbung, ohne Tracking. Deine Daten gehören dir – du kannst dein Konto jederzeit in der App löschen.

name: FiloQ – Filament Manager
description:
FiloQ is the mobile app for Spoolman, the self-hosted inventory for 3D printing filament. Connect your own Spoolman server and keep track of every spool – at the printer, in the workshop or on the go.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
FiloQ has no servers of its own and needs no account. All data lives on the Spoolman instance you run yourself. No tracking, no ads, no analytics.

AT A GLANCE
• Dashboard with active spools, remaining weight and inventory value
• Overview by location, material or vendor
• “Almost empty” list and recently used spools

FAST IN DAILY USE
• Book usage in grams or meters – with quick amounts
• Weigh a spool: enter the gross weight, the rest is calculated
• Change location, archive or duplicate with a swipe

SCAN INSTEAD OF TYPING
• Scan Spoolman QR labels to open a spool instantly
• Recognize product barcodes (EAN/UPC) and find the filament
• Look up, link and move NFC tags
• Fill barcode fields with the camera

NEW SPOOLS IN SECONDS
• Create wizard for spool, filament and vendor in one flow
• Import filaments from the community database SpoolmanDB
• Add several identical spools at once
• Create new locations right while typing

EVERYTHING UNDER CONTROL
• Library with filters, sorting and search – even by color
• Multicolor filaments, extra fields, locations
• Live updates when something changes in the Spoolman web UI
• Export as CSV or JSON, trigger a backup

MADE FOR YOUR SETUP
• Several Spoolman servers, HTTP and HTTPS
• Reverse proxies with Basic Auth, bearer token or custom headers (e.g. Cloudflare Access)
• Self-signed certificates via fingerprint pinning
• Read-only cache when you are offline
• Dark mode, iPad layout, large text, VoiceOver
• English and German

TRY IT WITHOUT A SERVER
The demo mode shows every feature with sample data.

REQUIREMENTS
Your own Spoolman server (version 0.27 or newer recommended). Spoolman is free and open source: github.com/Donkie/Spoolman

FiloQ is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with the Spoolman project.

name: Firstworks: Kids Art Museum
description:
Your kid makes something amazing every day. Firstworks gives it a museum.

Snap a photo of a drawing, a LEGO build or a clay creature. Firstworks straightens the paper, suggests a title, and hangs it on the wall of a beautiful 3D gallery — one room for every age.

SHARE WITH FAMILY
Send one link. Grandparents tap it and walk through the museum right in their browser — no app, no account. They can leave a heart or a note in the guestbook, which you approve first.

MADE FOR BUSY PARENTS
• Edge detection straightens tilted photos automatically
• Optional AI title suggestions, so you just check and hang
• Record your child's voice telling the story of the piece
• Location data is removed from every photo

A ROOM FOR EVERY AGE
When your child turns five, the Age 5 Room opens. Earlier rooms stay, connected by doors, so you can walk through the years.

PUBLIC GALLERY
Want to inspire other families? Submit a piece to the Firstworks Public Gallery. We review every artwork, only the age, title and a display name are shown, and you can withdraw it anytime.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your museum is private to your account. Nothing is shared until you create a link, and you can turn it off at any time. No ads, no tracking.

FIRSTWORKS PREMIUM
• Up to 10 rooms — make a room for any age
• 20 artworks per room (Free: 12)
• Every room theme and music track
• More AI title suggestions
Choose yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Terms of Use: https://firstworks.app/terms/en/
Privacy Policy: https://firstworks.app/privacy/en/

name: Fish Bread Stand
description:
On a winter night you open a tiny fish-bread stall at the end of an alley.

Tap an empty mold to pour batter, tap again the moment the ring glows gold to flip, and tap once more when the other side is golden to move the bread to the warming shelf. Customers in line buy on their own. Not burnt, not raw. One hand.

■ 10 streets
Alley Entrance → Bus Stop → Schoolyard Gate → Market Gate → Subway Rush → Rainy Day → Campus Night → Snowy Night → Christmas Street → Winter Festival.
Molds grow from 2 to 6; fillings from red bean alone to red bean, custard, pizza and sweet potato.

■ 8 kinds of customers
Kids who only eat custard, grannies who wait for three red bean, office workers who arrive in crowds, couples who take two fillings together, groups of five, a YouTuber who brings a crowd if you serve golden, and an inspector who fines you for raw bread.

■ Events
Bus arrival, golden batter, takeout order, weak gas, wind blowing out a flame, a sudden shower, running out of a filling. One per day from day 3.

■ Shop upgrades
Heat, Touch (a wider golden zone), Warming shelf, Regulars, Flavor, Sign. Every coin you earn is spent here. Leveling up unlocks titles and griddle skins.

■ Today's Stall
The same 90-second day for everyone. Compete on the Game Center daily leaderboard.

No ads · No in-app purchases · No internet needed · No data collected
All music and sound effects are synthesized inside the game.

name: Focus Today: Tasks & Timer
description:
Write today's tasks, pick one, focus for 25 minutes. Take a 5-minute break, and a longer one every fourth session.

• Big ring timer — focus, short break and long break in their own colors
• Each task collects a tomato for every focus session
• Today's sessions and minutes, day streak, 7-day chart
• Accurate even when the app is closed, with a notification at the end
• Custom lengths (5–90 min focus), optional auto-start
• On iPhone Duo, unfold it: tasks on the left, a big desk-clock timer on the right

Everything is free. Just a small banner under the task list — never on the timer. Buy the developer a coffee once to remove the banner and unlock 4 timer themes.

name: Français 4e – Cours et jeux
description:
Français 4e accompagne les élèves de quatrième avec des cours clairs, des jeux et des exercices corrigés à l'infini.

LE PROGRAMME DE 4e
• Grammaire : propositions relatives, complétives et circonstancielles, voix passive, discours rapporté
• Conjugaison et orthographe : subjonctif et conditionnel, passé simple, accord du participe passé avec les verbes pronominaux
• Vocabulaire et style : figures de style, fait et opinion, vérifier une information
• Lectures : dire l'amour (Ronsard, Roméo et Juliette, Le Cid), individu et société (Antigone), la fiction réaliste (Maupassant, Zola), informer et s'informer, la ville

APPRENDRE EN JOUANT
• Exercices à l'infini avec correction : subjonctif, conditionnel, passé simple, voix passive, discours indirect, pronoms relatifs, participes passés
• Analyses de textes pas à pas, dont une fausse information à démasquer
• « Qui suis-je ? » sur les personnages et les auteurs du programme
• Quiz, vrai/faux, classements, évaluation de fin d'année
• Révision automatique des erreurs

CONÇU POUR LES ENFANTS
• Sans publicité, sans compte, sans achat
• Aucune donnée collectée : la progression reste sur l'appareil
• Fonctionne hors connexion

name: Français 6e – Cours et jeux
description:
Français 6e accompagne les élèves de sixième toute l'année : des cours courts et clairs, des jeux, et des exercices de conjugaison et d'orthographe à l'infini.

TOUT LE PROGRAMME DE 6e (rentrée 2025)
• Grammaire : classes de mots, types et formes de phrases, sujet et accord du verbe, COD, COI et attribut du sujet, compléments circonstanciels, groupe nominal, pronoms, phrase complexe
• Conjugaison et orthographe : présent, imparfait, passé simple, futur, conditionnel, passé composé, plus-que-parfait, impératif, accord du participe passé, homophones, pluriels et féminins
• Vocabulaire : préfixes et suffixes, familles de mots, synonymes, sens figuré, registres de langue, mots venus du latin, du grec et de la mythologie
• Lire et écrire : schéma narratif, récits des origines (Prométhée, Pandore), poésie, théâtre de Molière, l'Odyssée d'Ulysse, les monstres des mythes et des contes

Chaque fiche explique pas à pas, avec des exemples, des pièges à éviter et une mini-question pour vérifier qu'on a compris.

APPRENDRE EN JOUANT
• Exercices à l'infini avec correction : conjugue tous les temps, accorde les participes, choisis le bon homophone
• Analyses de phrases et de textes pas à pas
• « Qui suis-je ? » sur les héros et les monstres de la mythologie
• Quiz, vrai/faux, classements, remettre dans l'ordre
• Évaluation de fin d'année
• Révision automatique des erreurs

MOTIVANT
Grades, badges, série de jours et lexique de tous les mots de grammaire.

CONÇU POUR LES ENFANTS
• Sans publicité, sans compte, sans achat
• Aucune donnée collectée : la progression reste sur l'appareil
• Fonctionne hors connexion

name: FreeWalkable
description:
Walk anywhere. Watch your city fill in.

FreeWalkable does one thing: it colors in the places you have been. Streets you pass turn violet and the buildings around them rise in 3D. Everywhere else stays flat and grey until you go there.

JUST MOVE
Put your phone in your pocket. FreeWalkable notices when you walk, run or ride and fills in your map automatically. There are no buttons to press.

SLIDE BY SPEED
Show only your walks, add your runs, or look at your bike rides on their own.

CHOOSE YOUR BUILDINGS
Show buildings only where you walked, a little further around your path, or whole.

WORKS OFFLINE
Your city's map is saved on your iPhone. Buildings for new streets load the next time you are online.

YOURS ALONE
Free forever. No ads, no subscription, no account, no tracking. Your walks are stored only on your iPhone. The app only downloads map tiles and building shapes, which tells those map servers roughly which area you are viewing.

Background location use can reduce battery life. FreeWalkable turns GPS off while you sit still to save power.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: FuqneliDastor
description: Bucket-wheel excavator calculator for open-pit mining and dredging. Compute per-bucket heaped volume, digging rate, swing cycle, mass throughput, tooth cutting force, boom reach envelope and engine specific energy. Review a one-page spec sheet and export PDF, CSV or DXF. Built for quarry planners, dredge supervisors and mining engineers working with bucket-wheel excavators and continuous surface miners.

name: Ganacsade
description:
Ganacsade is your Somali e-commerce app for shopping products and services anytime. Browse categories, add items to your cart or wishlist, checkout with local payment options, and track your orders from your phone.

Features:
• Browse products, categories, and featured deals
• Cart, wishlist, and order history
• Local payment options including mobile money and cash on delivery
• Delivery address management
• Push notifications for order updates
• Profile settings, language options, and in-app account deletion
• Help & support with email and phone contact

name: Gapfly: Slip the Gaps
description:
Gapfly is a courier game on a sunlit city map. Tap where you want to go and your scooter finds a route through the gaps between stopped cars. Pick up the parcel, ride to the doorstep, flick it onto the red stamp and collect the tip.

One shift lasts a minute or two, so it fits between other things. Every stop is a small puzzle: wait for a gap to open, squeeze through it, and be at the door before the clock runs out.

HOW A SHIFT GOES
- Tap a spot on the road. The scooter plans the route and rides it.
- Pick up parcels at the shop: envelopes, boxes and bags.
- Swipe toward the red stamp at the door to drop the parcel. A fresh, well-aimed drop pays more.
- Squeeze through tight gaps for extra tips. A bump costs parcel care and tips, so ride with a plan.
- Fill the tip jar up to three notches and collect stamps for optional bonus goals.

SIXTY SHIFTS, FOUR DISTRICTS
Start in the Market, then earn reputation to open the Harbour, Old Town and the Campus. Each district has its own streets, its own stops and its own twists: hot orders that cool quickly, fragile loads, cobblestones, big days with two shops.

POWER-UPS
- Horn: one honk and nearby cars make room.
- Shortcut: opens a narrow gap for a few seconds.
- Thermal bag: absorbs the next bump.
Bring one on each shift, or pick up a free charge.

THE DEPOT
Spend your tip coins on new bikes: a scooter, a moped and a cargo bike with a bigger parcel rack. Dress them with paint, bags, boxes and stickers. Looks are cosmetic, so every bike on the same frame rides alike.

OVERTIME
Finish shift 40 to open Overtime, an endless shift where every delivery adds time and the streets keep tightening. Beat your best tip.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Plays offline. No account and no sign-in; your progress stays on your device.
- A daily tip bonus rewards coming back.
- Available in 20 languages, including right-to-left Arabic.
- Gapfly is free to play with ads and optional purchases: coin packs and Remove Ads. Rewarded ads are always optional.
- For ages 13 and up.

Questions or ideas? The support page is linked from the app and from this listing.

name: Global Salawat Tracker
description:
Global Ṣalawāt brings Muslims around the world together in sending Ṣalawāt (blessings) upon our beloved Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), every day and wherever you are.

Sending Ṣalawāt keeps our Prophet (peace be upon him). present in our hearts and on our tongues, and draws us nearer to him. Every Ṣalawāt you send is saved to your own record and added to one global tally, joining the voices of believers around the world. In shā' Allāh, the more we recite, the more the Ummah grows in khayr and barakah, in this world and the next.

SEND ṢALAWĀT
Choose how many Ṣalawāt you have recited, add your name or stay anonymous, and send. The global counter shows today, this week and the total, and grows with every Ṣalawāt sent across the world.

ṢALAWĀT FROM AROUND THE WORLD
See which countries are sending the most Ṣalawāt and watch recent Ṣalawāt arrive from every corner of the Ummah, a gentle encouragement to add your own.

TASBIH COUNTER
Tap to count as you recite, at your own pace. Your count is kept safe even if you close the app or lose your connection, and it is added to the global tally.

DAILY PLEDGE
Pledge to recite 1,000 Ṣalawāt or more each day and build a lasting habit of love for our Prophet (peace be upon him).. Follow your progress each day, raise your pledge whenever you are ready, and receive a personal certificate to keep or share.

MY ṢALAWĀT
Your own record of every Ṣalawāt you have sent: today, this week and in total, with a month-by-month history and a calendar of each day. If you send just after midnight, you can choose whether it counts for yesterday or today.

SUB-ACCOUNTS FOR YOUR CHILDREN
Raise your children with love for our Prophet (peace be upon him). Add a sub-account for each child under your own account, with no email address needed. Each child builds their own count and history, and when they are older their sub-account can be moved to their own email.

LEARN AND REFLECT
Browse a collection of Ṣalawāt in Arabic with transliteration and translation, and watch short video reminders about the Prophet (peace be upon him).

DESIGNED FOR THE WORLD
Global Ṣalawāt is made for Muslims in every country, with more languages coming soon.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
Global Ṣalawāt is free and shows no advertising. You can send Ṣalawāt without an account, or sign in with Google, Apple or your email to keep your record, pledge and sub-accounts safe on every device. You can delete your account at any time from Settings.

name: Golf Practice Log
description:
Golf Practice turns a practice plan into a habit you can see. Plan a week of drills, log each one with a quick 0–10 score, and watch the trends that show what is improving and what still needs work.

It is built around a golf handbook's practice method: Block, Random and Performance practice in a 30 / 50 / 20 balance, a drill list with a target for every drill, and a default week to start from.

Free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account to create.

PLAN THE WEEK
• A week plan with drills for each day, starting on the day you choose
• Planned minutes by practice type against the 30 / 50 / 20 target
• Reset a week to your default plan, or save a good week as the new default
• Share the week's plan as an image

LOG EVERY DRILL
• Today's practice comes straight from the plan — mark drills done as you go
• Minutes, count, a 0–10 score, a measured value and a short reflection, each with a one-thumb slider
• Move between days or pick a date to edit any past entry

SEE THE TRENDS
• Home shows the last 7 days: practice days, minutes, average score and your practice-type balance
• Trends charts entries and minutes by category, practice-type share, drill scores, measured values, met-target rate, a practice heatmap and a drill summary
• Date ranges from today to the last two years, or your own, and filters for category, drill, location, score and more
• Share any chart as an image

YOUR DRILLS, YOUR LISTS
• Built-in drills with what to do and a target score, plus your own
• Edit the categories, locations, statuses and practice types, and drag them into your order
• The handbook opens from every tab and reopens where you left off — or use your own PDF

WORKS WITH THE PRACTICE LOG WORKBOOK
• Export a player's practice as an Excel workbook (.xlsm) that keeps its formulas, charts and macros
• Edit it in Excel and import it back — rows match by ID, so nothing is duplicated
• Export or back up as JSON, and restore a backup on a new device

FOR EVERY PLAYER IN THE FAMILY
• Several players on one device, each with their own log, plan, drills, reminders and avatar
• A weekly reminder to share the week's log and next week's plan, with an optional Calendar event

Your practice stays yours: it is stored in your own private iCloud database and syncs between your iPhone and iPad. Nothing is sent to any other server.

name: Green Plant Care Daily Guide
description:
A practical mobile application designed to help users organize and manage the care of indoor plants. Explore different plant species, plan watering routines, evaluate lighting conditions, identify possible plant problems, and keep track of daily care activities.

The Plant Library provides a collection of indoor plants with detailed profiles, including growth characteristics, watering needs, lighting preferences, and general care information. Browse plant categories, search for specific species, and create a personal collection of your houseplants.

With the Watering Planner, users can create personalized watering routines based on plant type, pot size, soil conditions, and environmental factors. Check soil moisture, receive watering guidance, and record completed watering activities.

The Light Requirements feature helps users evaluate indoor lighting conditions. Select a plant, specify window direction, distance, and sunlight exposure, and receive recommendations for suitable plant placement.

The Plant Problem Checker offers an interactive way to explore common plant problems, including yellow leaves, brown tips, drooping foliage, and visible pests. Answer simple questions about symptoms and growing conditions to discover possible causes and practical care recommendations.

The Care Calendar allows users to schedule and manage plant care activities, including watering checks, fertilizing, pruning, leaf cleaning, and repotting. Create recurring tasks, track completed activities, and organize upcoming care routines.

Whether you are caring for your first houseplant or managing a larger indoor collection, the app combines five useful plant care tools to help keep plant information, care schedules, and maintenance records organized in one place.

name: Grupo 220
seller_name: DEVN-X DESENVOLVIMENTO WEB E SOLUCOES DE MARKETING LTDA
description:
O Grupo 220 reúne, em um só lugar, o que o empresário membro da comunidade 220 usa no dia a dia do programa e dos eventos.

Com o app você:

• Vê no Início o seu próximo evento, o Radar do CEO e o andamento da sua jornada.
• Consulta a agenda de mentorias, reuniões, imersões e encontros do Business 220 e do Level Up, com a data e a hora de cada compromisso.
• Recebe o ingresso do evento com QR Code para a entrada.
• Encontra no Quick Guide como chegar à sede, hotéis próximos, almoço e as aulas bônus do evento.
• Preenche o diagnóstico do empresário, que orienta o trabalho da equipe 220 com a sua empresa.
• Ouve os livros narrados com o player integrado, inclusive com a tela bloqueada.
• Guarda em Meus documentos os PDFs e fotos de comprovantes, exercícios e materiais.
• Usa as ferramentas do método 220: teste DISC, Plano de Ação (5W2H), PMVV, descrição de cargos e outras.

O acesso é exclusivo para membros, empresas atendidas e participantes dos eventos do Grupo 220. Entre com o e-mail e a senha do seu cadastro ou, se você comprou uma palestra, toque em "Primeiro acesso pelo WhatsApp": digite o celular da compra, confirme o código e o seu ingresso já aparece no Início.

name: Halo Floor
description:
Halo Floor is the app for hotel teams that use Halo, Twinlite's hotel operations platform. Room attendants, supervisors and maintenance technicians see their work for the day and record it as they go.

You need an account from your hotel to use Halo Floor.

FOR ROOM ATTENDANTS
• My day: your rooms in order, with arrival times, back-to-backs, VIPs, Do Not Disturb, linen changes and service notes.
• Room checklists with photo proof, so nothing is missed.
• Start, pause and finish each room. The front desk sees it straight away.
• Report something broken, an item left behind or supplies you need, with a photo.

FOR SUPERVISORS
• Inspect rooms with a scored checklist, photos and notes, then pass them or send them back.

FOR MAINTENANCE
• Your work orders: on site, waiting for parts or a contractor, done, with the time spent.
• Scan an asset's label to see its history and manuals, or to report a fault.

FOR EVERYONE
• Tasks and guest requests, with their deadlines.
• Work alerts as notifications.
• Keeps working without a signal: what you do is saved on your phone or iPad and sent in order when you are back online.
• In English and Spanish.

Sign in with your hotel's Microsoft work account, or with the email and password your manager sets up for you. If you don't have an account yet, ask your manager.

name: Hayırla: Namaz Vakti ve Zikir
description:
Hayırla; namaz vakitlerini, Kur'an-ı Kerim'i, meali, sesli okumayı, kitaplığı, zikri ve Ramazan'ı tek bir sakin uygulamada toplar. Hesap istemez, ibadet kayıtlarını yalnızca senin cihazında tutar. İbadetle ilgili tüm özellikler herkese ücretsizdir.

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ
• Bulunduğun konuma göre, Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı yöntemiyle cihazında hesaplanan vakitler
• Sıradaki vakte geri sayım, haftalık vakitler ve 30 günlük takvim
• Kıble pusulası ve hicri takvim

HATIRLATMALAR
• Her vakit için vaktinde bildirim
• Erken uyarı: vakitten 5–60 dakika önce
• Vakit çıkmadan uyarı: vaktin çıkmasına 15–60 dakika kala; “Kıldım” dersen gelmez
• Ramazan'da sahur ve iftar hatırlatması
• Cuma, Pazartesi–Perşembe orucu, teheccüd, kandil ve bayram hatırlatmaları
• Sessiz saatler

NAMAZ KAYDI VE KAZA
• Beş vakti “Kıldım” ya da “Daha sonra” olarak işaretle, istersen his ve not ekle
• Haftalık ritim, namaz serisi ve Cuma serisi
• Kaza namazı ve kaza orucu takibi

ZİKİRMATİK
• Salavat, Sübhanallah, Elhamdülillah, Allahu Ekber ve diğer hazır zikirler
• Kendi zikirlerini ve hedeflerini ekle
• Günün virdi

RAMAZAN
• Ramazan'a geri sayım, imsakiye, oruç ve teravih kaydı
• Kaynağıyla birlikte iftar duaları
• Ramazan ve dini gün tarihleri Diyanet'in resmî takviminden

KUR'AN-I KERİM
• 604 sayfalık Medine Mushafı düzeninde, sağdan sola sayfa sayfa okuma
• Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır meali (1935 orijinal metin) ile meal görünümü
• Ayet ayet sesli okuma: 6 kâri, okunan ayet vurgulanır, sayfa kendiliğinden çevrilir
• Dilediğin kâriyi sure sure indir, internetsiz dinle
• Ayete dokun: meal ve Fahreddin Râzî'nin Mefâtîhu'l-Gayb tefsiri (Arapça)
• Sureler, cüzler ve sayfaya git; kaldığın yerden devam

KİTAPLIK
• Mesnevî (Ahmed Avni Konuk tercümesi), Yunus Emre, Dîvân-ı Hikmet, Mevlid-i Şerîf
• Kırk Hadis (Arapça ve Türkçe), seçme hadisler
• Kur'an'dan dualar, Esmâü'l-Hüsnâ, Yâsîn, Mülk, Vâkıa, Kehf
• Açtığın bölümler telefonunda kalır, internetsiz okunur

KUR'AN ÖĞREN
• Elif-Ba: 28 harf ve Lam-Elif, sesli harf adları ve heceler
• Harekeler, uzatma, kelimeler ve kısa sureler
• Dinleyerek ve okuyarak alıştırma

GÜNCEL KONULAR
• Keşfet'te editörlerimizin hazırladığı yeni yazılar

DEPREMLER
• AFAD'ın yayımladığı son depremler, harita ve büyüklük filtresi
• İstersen yakınındaki depremler için bildirim (varsayılan olarak kapalı)

APPLE WATCH VE WIDGET
• Saatinden namazı "kıldım" diye işaretle; kayıt iPhone'daki serine eklenir
• Ramazan'da saatinde iftar ve sahur sayacı
• Saatinde vakitler, zikirmatik ve kıble; kadran komplikasyonu
• Ana ekran ve kilit ekranı widget'ları

GİZLİLİK
Hesap yok. Namaz kayıtların, notların ve zikirlerin yalnızca cihazında durur. Konumun hiçbir yere gönderilmez; bulunduğun yerin adı bile telefonda bulunur. Uygulama yalnızca kendi sunucumuzla konuşur. Zikirmatik, namaz kaydı, kıble, Kur'an, kitaplık ve deprem ekranlarında hiçbir zaman reklam gösterilmez.

Gizlilik politikası: https://hayir.la/gizlilik

name: Health Gym
description:
LEVE SUA EVOLUÇÃO PARA O PRÓXIMO NÍVEL COM O Health Gym!

O Health Gym é o seu parceiro definitivo na jornada fitness. Projetado para oferecer praticidade e resultados, ele coloca tudo o que você precisa para transformar seu corpo e sua saúde na palma da sua mão.

POR QUE ESCOLHER O Health Gym?

- SEU TREINO EM QUALQUER LUGAR: Receba rotinas personalizadas criadas diretamente pelos seus professores e acompanhe cada série, repetição e carga pelo celular.
- HIDRATAÇÃO INTELIGENTE: Nunca mais esqueça de beber água! Receba lembretes baseados no seu perfil e objetivos.
- EVOLUÇÃO REAL: Acesse avaliações físicas detalhadas com gráficos e dados que mostram seu progresso real.
- FIQUE POR DENTRO: Notificações em tempo real sobre aulas, agendamentos e dicas do seu personal.

IMPORTANTE: Aplicativo exclusivo para alunos matriculados em academias parceiras da Pacto Soluções.

PRIVACIDADE E TERMOS:

name: Heimgast – Ferienvermietung
description:
Heimgast ist die Software für Gastgeberinnen und Gastgeber von Ferienwohnungen und Ferienhäusern – vom Einzelvermieter bis zur Verwaltung mit vielen Einheiten. Mit der App haben Sie Ihren Betrieb auch unterwegs im Blick.

Heute auf einen Blick
• Anreisen, Abreisen und offene Aufgaben des Tages
• Hinweise, wenn etwas fehlt – etwa ein Online-Check-in oder eine Registrierungsnummer

Kalender und Buchungen
• Alle Objekte in einem Belegungskalender
• Buchungen aus Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo und weiteren Portalen über den Kalender-Abgleich
• Direktbuchungen und Sperrzeiten in Sekunden anlegen – der Preis wird automatisch berechnet
• Eigene Buchungsseite und Widget für Ihre Website: Gäste buchen direkt bei Ihnen, ohne Portalprovision – bezahlt wird per Überweisung oder vor Ort
• Grundpreise, Saisons, Tagespreise und Mindestaufenthalte pflegen
• Objekte und Buchungen per CSV aus Ihrem bisherigen System übernehmen

Gästekommunikation
• Nachrichten an Gäste per E-Mail direkt aus der Buchung – Antworten der Gäste landen wieder dort
• Gespräche im Team zuweisen und als erledigt markieren
• Automatische Nachrichten mit Vorlagen und Bedingungen – etwa nur für Direktbuchungen oder ab einer bestimmten Zahl von Nächten
• Mitteilungen an die Gäste eines Objekts, zum Beispiel bei einer Baustelle
• Mit KI: Antwortvorschläge und Übersetzungen im Posteingang

Online-Check-in und Gästemappe
• Gäste checken auf dem eigenen Handy ein – auf Deutsch, Englisch, Spanisch oder Französisch
• Meldeschein für ausländische Gäste vorab ausgefüllt – zum Ausdrucken und Unterschreiben bei Ankunft
• Auf Wunsch mit Mietvertrag zum Unterschreiben
• Digitale Gästemappe je Objekt mit QR-Code – Zugang und Türcode sehen Gäste nur während ihres Aufenthalts
• Kontakte und Gästeprofile mit automatischer Löschfrist

Reinigung, Aufgaben und Team
• Reinigungsaufgaben entstehen automatisch zu jeder Abreise
• Reinigungskräfte sehen nur ihre Aufgaben – mit abhakbarer Checkliste
• Aufgaben als Board und wiederkehrende Aufgaben wie Grundreinigung oder Rauchmelder-Prüfung
• Schäden mit Fotos direkt aus der Wohnung melden
• Rollen und Rechte für Ihr ganzes Team

Regeln und Vorgaben
• Registrierungsnummer je Einheit
• Nächte-Grenze je Objekt mit Hinweis bei 80 und 100 Prozent – etwa für Regeln zur Zweckentfremdung
• Gästeabgaben wie die Kurtaxe mit Monatsübersicht je Gemeinde
• Heimgast hält die neuen Airbnb-Regeln automatisch ein – für Booking.com und Direktbuchungen bleibt alles, wie Sie es eingestellt haben

Rechnungen, Finanzen und Berichte
• Rechnungen mit fortlaufender Nummer als PDF und E-Rechnung (ZUGFeRD)
• Kosten je Objekt mit Beleg – Belege per Foto, auf Wunsch von der KI ausgelesen
• Ergebnis je Objekt und Steuerübersichten für die Steuerberatung
• Für Verwalter: Eigentümerabrechnung mit PDF und SEPA-Datei
• Umsatz, Auslastung und Buchungsquellen im Überblick
• Fragen an Ihre Zahlen: Die KI antwortet aus Ihren Berichten – mit Zeitraum und Grundlage
• Export für Buchhaltung und Steuerberatung

Hilfe und Mitteilungen
• Push-Mitteilungen bei neuen Buchungen, Stornierungen, Gästenachrichten und Schadensmeldungen
• KI-Assistent in der Hilfe – Antworten zur Bedienung direkt in der App
• Die App spricht Deutsch, Englisch, Spanisch und Französisch – für internationale Teams und Reinigungskräfte

Datenschutz
Ihre Daten liegen in Rechenzentren in Frankfurt am Main, KI-Funktionen laufen in Rechenzentren in der EU. Keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

Für die App benötigen Sie ein Heimgast-Konto Ihres Unternehmens. Mitarbeitende und Reinigungskräfte erhalten ihren Zugang per Einladung. Der Funktionsumfang richtet sich nach dem Tarif Ihres Unternehmens.

name: HelloBarley
description:
HelloBarley is the tasting companion for whisky lovers and the clubs that pour for them. Keep a record of every bottle you try, score it in your own words, and see how the rest of the club rated it.

AT A TASTING
• Join with the event code from your host
• Score each pour of the line-up as it comes round
• See the club's results when the host closes the tasting

ON YOUR OWN
• Search a catalog of more than 1,800 whiskies and spirits by name or distillery
• Scan a bottle's barcode to open its page
• Write tasting notes at your own pace and keep a history of everything you've tried
• Compare your scores with the club average on every bottle

FOR HOSTS
• Build an event line-up and share the code
• Follow scores as they come in
• Share an anonymous results report with sponsors and guests

Sign in with your email address. Your reviews stay yours: delete your account at any time from Your account.

HelloBarley is for adults of legal drinking age. Please enjoy responsibly.

name: Herzfaden: Wedding Website
description:
Your own wedding website – in minutes, right on your phone.

Herzfaden guides you step by step through everything your guests need to know. Answer a few simple questions and Herzfaden turns them into a beautiful site with an envelope to open, falling petals and your own cover illustration.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add your names and date
• Find your venue – Herzfaden paints it as an embroidered or watercolour illustration
• Pick colours: matching your venue, a preset or your own
• Add schedule, dress code, travel and hotels
• Send the link or QR code to your guests

FOR YOUR GUESTS
• RSVP with plus-one, kids and allergies
• Countdown, schedule and directions
• Hotels nearby with prices and links
• Photo hunt, "Who of us?" quiz and live gallery
• Optionally bilingual (German, French, Italian, English)

FOR YOU
• All replies live in the app, with a list for the kitchen
• Guest list as an Excel file, all photos as a ZIP
• Changes appear instantly on your site
• Browser access for your partner

PRICING
Try it for free and see the preview. Pay once to publish, no subscription:
• Herzfaden: everything you need in one language
• Herzfaden Plus: bilingual site and unlimited new images
Your site stays online until one year after the wedding.

Privacy: guest data is stored in Europe and deleted automatically after the wedding.

name: Hội Xuân - Game Dân Gian
description:
Mang không khí hội vui dân gian vào điện thoại với Hội Xuân: ba trò chơi Bầu Cua, Tài Xỉu và Lô Tô trong cùng một ứng dụng.

• Bầu Cua: chọn một linh vật để dự đoán, rồi lắc và mở bát.
• Tài Xỉu: dự đoán Tài hoặc Xỉu, mở ba xúc xắc và xem lịch sử kết quả.
• Lô Tô: bốc số từ 1 đến 90 không trùng, tự gọi số hoặc bốc từng số, theo dõi trên vé tự đánh dấu.
• Giọng đọc tiếng Việt trên thiết bị, âm thanh mở bát và hiệu ứng vỗ tay.
• Giao diện đỏ vàng, bát sứ mây vàng và bát rồng đen riêng cho từng trò.
• Tiến trình lưu trên thiết bị, không cần tài khoản.

Chế độ luyện tập kết hợp yếu tố ngẫu nhiên và quy tắc định sẵn. Bầu Cua và Tài Xỉu sử dụng chế độ này.

Mỗi lượt cho biết dự đoán đúng hay chưa đúng.

Các trò chơi hoạt động offline. Giọng đọc sử dụng giọng tiếng Việt có sẵn trên thiết bị; cần kiểm tra giọng đã có và thử tắt mạng trước khi sử dụng offline.

name: Home Switchboard
description:
Control your home lights and switches from a list grouped by room.

Open a room to see its devices. Tap a switch to turn it on or off.

name: Hosqi.io
description:
Keep your customer conversations moving, wherever you work. Hosqi brings your team's inbox, contacts, sales opportunities and automations to iPhone and iPad.

ONE INBOX FOR YOUR TEAM
Read and reply to conversations from the messaging accounts connected to your Hosqi workspace, including WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram. Send messages and attachments, organize chats with labels, and find the conversations that need attention.

KEEP THE CUSTOMER CONTEXT
View contact details alongside your work. Search your contacts, keep useful information organized, assign conversations to teammates and use internal notes to coordinate the next reply.

FOLLOW UP ON SALES
Track leads and deals in Hosqi CRM. See your pipeline, update opportunities and keep the next step close to the conversation.

MANAGE YOUR AUTOMATIONS
Review your workflows, manage their status and follow execution activity. Keep your team's conversations and automation work in the same workspace.

STAY INFORMED
Choose the notifications you need, get alerts on your device and return to the relevant conversation.

BUILT FOR YOUR WORKSPACE
Sign in with Apple or your existing Hosqi sign-in method. Switch between the workspaces you belong to, with your existing permissions. Use the app in English or Armenian.

A Hosqi account and workspace are required. Features depend on your workspace plan and your role. Messaging connections require eligible service accounts and the relevant permissions. An internet connection is required.

name: HRD RoutePulse
description:
RoutePulse is the field app for teams that use HRDeeds. It records a field employee's working day: where they travelled, the clients they visited, and the fuel they are owed, so nobody has to fill in a km log or a visit sheet by hand.

A COMPANY ACCOUNT IS NEEDED
RoutePulse works with your company's HRDeeds account. Your company must have RoutePulse switched on and HR must mark you as field staff. Sign in with your HRDeeds login, or open RoutePulse straight from the HRDeeds app.

START AND END YOUR DAY
• Tap Start Day, check in on HRDeeds, or punch in at a site to begin.
• Nothing is recorded while you are off duty. Tracking runs only between Start Day and End Day.
• The header always shows whether your day is being recorded.

TRIPS AND KILOMETRES
• Set a destination: a client, home, office, or any place on the map, and get directions.
• The trip ends by itself when you arrive or punch in there.
• Paid km is the distance you actually drive during a trip, checked against the suggested route.
• Drove for work without setting a destination? Ask your manager to add a missed trip.

CLIENT VISITS
• Find clients near you, those due for a visit, and prospects, in a list or on a map.
• Punch in at a client site with a photo. Your location is recorded with the visit.
• Add new clients and their sites as you find them.
• Follow today's route plan of stops, in order.

FUEL AND EXPENSES
• At the end of the day a fuel claim is drafted from your trip km and your vehicle's rate. There is nothing to submit.
• Claim toll, parking and other bills with a receipt photo.
• Claims go to your manager for approval in HRDeeds and are usually paid with salary.

YOUR HISTORY
• See your days, km, visits and fuel claims for the last 3, 7 or 30 days, or any dates you choose.

FOR MANAGERS AND HR
Managers follow their team in HRDeeds on the web or on their phone: who is out now, today's km and visits, alerts, and claims waiting for approval.

PRIVACY
You accept a short privacy notice before anything is recorded. Location is used only while you are on duty, to measure work travel and confirm client visits.

Continued use of location in the background can reduce battery life. RoutePulse records only while you are on duty.

name: HRDeeds
description:
HRDeeds puts your company's HR in your pocket. Check in for work, apply for leave, claim expenses and see your payslips, all from one app, with your manager approving on the go.

HRDeeds is for employees and managers of organisations that use HRDeeds. Your employer creates your account; sign in with the email and password they give you.

CHECK IN IN SECONDS

Check in and out with a photo and your location
A live timer shows how long you've worked today
Reminders before your shift starts and ends
Late arrivals, early check-outs and missed check-outs are flagged for you, so nothing comes as a surprise
WORK PUNCHES AT SITES

Punch in at a client site or factory with a photo and location
Record the client, purpose of visit and remarks
Your manager reviews each punch once you punch out
For departments that record attendance by work punch, your punches are your attendance
ATTENDANCE AT A GLANCE

Monthly calendar of present, half-day, leave and absent days
Request a correction (regularization) for a missed or wrong day
Request overtime for extra hours
LEAVE WITHOUT THE PAPERWORK

See your balance for every leave type
Apply for full or half-day leave in a few taps
Follow each request from pending to approved
Company holidays and events in one calendar
EXPENSES, CLAIMED AND PAID

Claim travel, food and other expenses with a photo of the bill
Track each claim until it's paid
PAYSLIPS AND DOCUMENTS

View your payslips and salary details
Keep your documents and company notices in one place
FOR MANAGERS AND HR

Approve leave, regularizations, overtime, claims and work punches from your phone
See who's in, on leave or late across your team
Employee directory and profiles
Built for Indian companies: INR, Indian holidays, financial year from April, and the Saturday-off rules your company follows.

Help is built in: open Help Center from the menu, or visit hrdeeds.com/help.

name: Hue Is It?
description:
Can you name it from its colors?

Every puzzle in Hue Is It? is a pie chart of the colors of a flag or a logo, each slice sized by how much of the image that color covers. Read the slices, fill one square for each letter, and find out if you got it. It sounds easy, until you try it.

HOW IT WORKS
• Read the pie: each slice is a color from the image.
• Fill the squares: one for each letter of the answer.
• Collect coins: every solve pays, and solving without hints pays the most.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• A daily puzzle, the same for everyone. Come back and grow your streak.
• Level after level of flags and logos. Solve 7 of 10 to open the next level.
• Hints when you're stuck: see the first letter, open any square you choose, or get a clue like the continent or the industry.
• No spoilers. Skip a puzzle whenever you like. It waits for you, and the game never gives away the answer.
• Ads only between puzzles, never in the middle of one. One payment removes them.
• The whole game in English or Hebrew.
• No account needed. Sign in with Apple or Google only to keep your progress when you change phones.

Free to play, with optional coin packs and a one-time purchase that removes ads.

name: Hum: Human Design Chart
description:
Your Human Design chart, drawn as a glowing body you can touch.
Enter your birth details to see your bodygraph, Type, Strategy and Authority in plain English, all calculated on your iPhone.
Then build a daily streak, ask Wren about one decision, and see how your chart meets a friend's.

YOUR BODYGRAPH
- A body-shaped, interactive chart with 9 centers, 64 gates and 36 channels
- Tap any center, gate or channel to read what it means, with jargon explained as you go
- Type, Strategy, Authority, Profile, Incarnation Cross and variables, each with a plain English summary

TODAY
- A short daily energy brief that connects the day to your own chart
- A daily card to turn over: collect the gates and channels the sky is lighting up, and build your collection
- A streak to keep the flame lit, with freezes you earn along the way
- 7-day experiments: try one small thing at a time and notice what changes

WREN, YOUR DECISION PARTNER
- Wren walks you through one decision at a time using your own Authority
- It asks questions and gives you space to listen to yourself
- It never predicts the future and never tells you what to do

PEOPLE
- Add a friend, partner or family member and read how your charts meet
- See a connection reading and score, and share it as a card
- Invite friends with Orbit (18+) to see each other's Type, Profile and Authority, never birth details

LEARN AT YOUR PACE
- A library and glossary covering every gate, channel, center and profile line
- Beautiful share cards for your Type and your connections

Hum is free to download. Hum Plus unlocks the full experience with a monthly or yearly subscription, and full readings are also available as one-time purchases. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Hum is for entertainment and self-reflection. It does not give medical, legal, financial or psychological advice, and it does not predict the future.

Privacy Policy: https://twelvehouses.space/hum/privacy
Terms of Use: https://twelvehouses.space/hum/terms
Support: support@twelvehouses.space

name: iDoc - Book & Document Reader
description:
Your books. Your pace.

iDoc is a document reader for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Keep PDFs, image ZIPs, and text documents in one library.

FOCUS ON READING
Controls appear when you tap the page. Choose a single page, a two-page spread, or automatic layout. Landscape images can fill a landscape screen one page at a time.

TURN PAGES YOUR WAY
Switch between page turns and vertical scrolling. Change reading direction and shift a spread by one page to align comic pages. Tap or drag the seek bar to jump to a page. On Mac, use the arrow keys or Shift with an arrow key for a half-page step.

ORGANIZE WITH FOLDERS
Import files into the folder you have open. Add documents from the share menu, or drag them into the library on Mac. Select multiple books to move, delete, or export. Sort by newest, oldest, or file name in either direction.

OPTIONAL ICLOUD SYNC
Books start on your device only. Enable iCloud sync to share your library and reading positions across devices using the same Apple Account. Wi-Fi only controls when iDoc starts syncing; iCloud may continue transfers already in progress.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose English or Japanese and set your default reading layout and direction. Require device authentication for selected folders. Folder protection is an access check, not a separate file-encryption system.

Supported formats: PDF, image ZIP/CBZ, TXT, RTF, RTFD with images, Markdown, and HTML. Read CSV, TSV, JSON, XML, YAML, logs, source code, and extensionless files as text. Text documents can be up to 5 MB; RTF and RTFD can be up to 20 MB. Common encodings include UTF-8, UTF-16, Shift_JIS, and EUC-JP. External HTML resources and JavaScript are not loaded. Documents are converted into a reading PDF on your device, while the original is retained.

No iDoc account, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: iKK Voice Mic
description:
iKK Voice Mic is the companion app to iKK Voice for people who are hard of hearing. It turns your iPhone into a microphone: you speak into your own phone, and what you say appears as text on the hard-of-hearing person's phone – large, easy to read and with your name.

HOW IT WORKS

1. The hard-of-hearing person starts the "Hearing impaired" mode in iKK Voice and shows a QR code.
2. You enter your name and scan the code.
3. Tap the microphone and speak – that's it.

Everyone who joins sees the conversation as a chat: each person with their name, each sentence on its own line. Several people around a table can take part at the same time, each with their phone as a microphone.

CONNECTION

• Directly over the local Wi‑Fi or the hotspot of the iKK Voice phone – no internet, no server.
• Or over the internet through an MQTT broker of your own that the hard-of-hearing person sets up in iKK Voice.
• Audio and text are end-to-end encrypted either way. The key is in the QR code and is valid for that session only.

NO SETUP NEEDED

iKK Voice Mic needs no account, no speech service and no API key. Speech recognition is done by iKK Voice on the hard-of-hearing person's phone – with the service chosen there.

PRIVACY

The app stores only your name and a random device identifier. We run no servers and receive no recordings or texts.

NOTE

iKK Voice Mic only works together with iKK Voice (iPhone, Mac or Android) and cannot be used on its own.

name: Immigrow
description:
Imigrantes e futuros imigrantes conectados nos EUA. O Immigrow cruza o seu perfil com os caminhos da lei americana, mostra as empresas que já contrataram estrangeiros e coloca um Agente de IA para trabalhar por você.

IMMIGROW AGENT: UM AGENTE DE IA QUE TRABALHA POR VOCÊ
Converse com o Agente e peça o que precisa: "acha empresas que dão green card sem experiência no Texas e escreve pra elas". Ele encontra as empresas, escreve do seu próprio Gmail com o seu currículo em anexo, faz os follow-ups e avisa quando alguém responde. Você aprova cada envio.

ANÁLISE DO SEU PERFIL
Responda poucas perguntas e veja, em linguagem simples, os caminhos que podem fazer sentido para você, em ordem: EB-2 NIW, EB-3, H-2A, H-2B, H-1B e outros. Você vê também o que ainda precisa ser confirmado.

VAGAS COM PATROCÍNIO
Vagas abertas de trabalho temporário H-2A e H-2B, com salário em dólar, cidade e estado.

EMPRESAS QUE JÁ CONTRATARAM ESTRANGEIROS
Pesquise empresas por tipo de visto e por estado, com base em dados públicos do governo americano.

COMUNIDADE
Veja quem está no mesmo caminho que você, onde está e qual visto segue. Conecte-se com outros imigrantes indo para os EUA ou que já estão lá.

AULAS DE INGLÊS E CURSOS
Inglês do zero, explicado em português, com lições de 5 minutos para o aeroporto, o mercado, o aluguel, o trabalho e o médico. E cursos sobre caminhos de imigração.

CURRÍCULO AMERICANO
O Agente monta o seu currículo no padrão dos EUA com o que você contar. Você revisa cada linha.

AVISOS
Receba notificações quando houver novidade sobre as empresas e vagas que você acompanha.

VOCÊ DECIDE
O Immigrow não é aconselhamento jurídico e não é um escritório de advocacia. Mostramos informações para você escolher o seu caminho, sozinho ou com um advogado de imigração. Não garantimos visto, emprego nem aprovação.

FONTES E AVISO
O Immigrow é uma empresa privada e não tem vínculo com o governo dos Estados Unidos. Os dados vêm de fontes públicas:
- Departamento do Trabalho dos EUA: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/eta/foreign-labor/performance
- USCIS: https://www.uscis.gov/tools/reports-and-studies/immigration-and-citizenship-data

name: IntraIA
description:
IntraIA est l'intranet de votre entreprise, avec son assistant IA. L'application ouvre votre espace IntraIA sur l'iPhone et sur l'iPad : les mêmes écrans que sur l'ordinateur, aux couleurs de votre entreprise, toujours à la dernière version.

L'application se relie au compte que votre entreprise vous a ouvert dans IntraIA.

SE CONNECTER EN QUELQUES SECONDES
Sur l'ordinateur, ouvrez Mon profil, puis « Sur mon téléphone », et scannez le QR code avec l'application. Elle s'ouvre directement sur votre organisation. Ensuite, elle se déverrouille par Face ID, Touch ID ou le code de l'appareil.

CE QUE VOUS Y TROUVEZ
• Votre assistant IA. Posez votre question au clavier ou au micro. Il répond avec les documents et les ressources que votre entreprise lui a confiés, et indique ses sources.
• Votre journal d'entreprise. Les nouvelles, les photos et les annonces de l'équipe.
• Votre messagerie interne. Écrivez à un collègue, ou dictez votre message.
• Vos agendas. La semaine de travail d'un coup d'œil, les rendez-vous à venir, et un nouveau rendez-vous d'un geste.
• Vos notes de frais. Photographiez le justificatif, vérifiez la ligne, transmettez le mois, et retrouvez le récapitulatif en PDF.
• Le pilotage de l'entreprise, pour la direction. L'économie, le social, l'environnement et la trésorerie, comparés d'un exercice à l'autre.
• Pour les clients d'un cabinet : leur espace, avec leurs rendez-vous, leurs pièces, leurs frais et leur dossier, et un assistant qui parle de leur dossier.

Ce que vous voyez suit vos droits, comme sur l'ordinateur, et les modules choisis par votre entreprise.

À LA TAILLE DE VOTRE ÉCRAN
Sur l'iPhone, tout tient d'une main : le menu en haut, le geste du moment en bas. Sur l'iPhone Duo ouvert et sur l'iPad en portrait, la liste et son détail se placent côte à côte. Sur l'iPad en paysage, vous retrouvez la disposition de l'ordinateur. L'affichage suit l'écran en direct, quand vous ouvrez l'iPhone Duo ou que vous tournez l'iPad.

VOS DONNÉES RESTENT À VOTRE ENTREPRISE
L'application affiche votre espace IntraIA, en ligne, et vos documents restent chez votre entreprise. L'instance, les données et la mémoire de l'assistant appartiennent à votre entreprise. Les liens vers un autre site s'ouvrent dans votre navigateur.

name: Intreccio
description:
Intreccio è il gioco di parole crociate in cerchio, tutto in italiano.

Trascina il dito sulle lettere della ruota per comporre le parole e riempire lo schema. Ogni livello è un piccolo cruciverba: trova tutte le parole e passa al successivo.

• 1.200 livelli, con una difficoltà che cresce piano piano
• Solo parole italiane comuni: niente nomi propri e niente parole straniere
• Parole bonus: ogni parola valida in più riempie il barattolo e ti regala monete
• Aiuti quando servono: Lettera, Mirino e Mescola
• Obiettivi del giorno, forziere e traguardi da sbloccare
• 60 capitoli fra colline, boschi, laghi, borghi, mare, montagne e notti stellate
• Musiche originali rilassanti e animazioni in 3D

GIOCA IN COPPIA
Invita una persona di famiglia o un amico con un link, anche se ha un altro ID Apple: giocate la stessa partita e ripartite sempre dal livello più alto raggiunto da uno dei due.

E inoltre
• Classifiche con Game Center
• Progressi salvati su iCloud: li ritrovi su tutti i tuoi iPhone
• Funziona anche senza internet
• Niente pubblicità e nessun dato personale raccolto

Bastano pochi minuti al giorno per allenare la mente e scoprire parole nuove.

name: Inyeon: Relationship Coach
description:
■ NEW · Our chats
Export a chat from KakaoTalk, WhatsApp or LINE and pick Inyeon in the share sheet. See who reaches out first, how fast and warm the replies are, when the mood changed, and the words you both use. Three counselors sum it up in one line and answer questions like "Should I text first?". Share the verdict as a card. Chats are read only on your device; the original messages are never stored.

Good relationships don't keep themselves going. We miss a birthday, go quiet for a while, forget what someone told us last time, and slowly drift apart.

Inyeon is a relationship manager. Keep the people around you in one place, and know when to reach out and what to remember.

■ Check in today
People with a birthday or anniversary coming up, and people you haven't contacted in a while, right on the first screen. Set a contact rhythm per person (weekly, every 2 weeks, monthly, every 3 months) and get reminded when it's time.

■ Birthday & anniversary reminders
By default, the day before at 9 AM. Change the day (same day, 2 days, a week before) and the time. Lunar birthdays are supported too. Reminders are scheduled on your device only.

■ Add from Contacts at once
Pick several people from Contacts and set their relationship and contact rhythm in one go. Saved birthdays fill in automatically; missing ones can be added right there. Only the people you pick are imported.

■ Your log
Log calls, meetups and notes in one tap, and jot down what to remember next time: favorites, family, what's on their mind. See at a glance how long it's been.

■ Talk coach
Short tips on how to talk with each person, what to avoid, gift ideas, and coaching for situations like getting closer or making up (just for fun).

■ Calendar
Birthdays and anniversaries in a calendar and an "Upcoming" list.

■ Stays on your device
No sign-up, no login. Names, birthdays and notes are never sent to a server. Back up to a file and import Android backups. Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese, switchable in the app.

Contact & feature requests: sayblackday@gmail.com

name: Jaarkom
description:
Jaarkom est l'application de référence pour toutes vos petites annonces au Maroc.

Explorez des milliers d'annonces vérifiées :
• Immobilier : Appartements, maisons, villas et terrains à vendre ou à louer.
• Véhicules : Voitures d'occasion, motos et utilitaires.
• Multimédia & Électronique : Smartphones, ordinateurs, TV et accessoires.
• Maison & Jardin : Mobilier, électroménager et décoration.
• Emploi & Services de proximité.

Fonctionnalités clés :
- Consultation libre et rapide du catalogue partout au Maroc sans obligation d'inscription immédiate.
- Filtres précis par catégorie, prix, région et ville.
- Contact direct avec les annonceurs par appel téléphonique ou WhatsApp.
- Publication simple et rapide de vos propres annonces avec photos.
- Gestion sécurisée de vos annonces et de vos favoris.

name: Jungle Alarm Clock: Wake Up
description:
Your alarm goes off. You hit snooze. Then again. Jungle Alarm ends that.

It rings with a real lion, tiger, wolf, gorilla, bear or elephant, and it doesn't stop until you're out of bed and moving. No snooze button. No sleeping through it.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick the animal that wakes you. Every roar is a real recording.
• The alarm rings through Silent mode and Focus.
• To turn it off, get up and do your animal's move: push-ups, squats, high knees, chest beats and more.
• Your iPhone counts the reps with the camera or its motion sensors. Nothing is recorded.
• Silence it with a button and it rings again a minute later. The morning only ends when the move is done.

PICK YOUR LEVEL
Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced, or set each rep count yourself. 5 push-ups or 25. Your call.

BUILD THE STREAK
• Your Log shows every morning you won, as a calendar or a month dial. Tap a day to see how it went.
• Only alarm days count, so a day off never breaks your streak.
• A perfect run earns a rest token that covers one bad morning.
• Every Sunday, a recap: mornings won, fastest wake-up and your streak.

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
• Start a pack with up to 8 friends and see who's up first every morning.
• Put a coffee or a dinner on the week. Last one out of bed buys.
• Bring a friend in and earn streak shields.
Jungle Alarm keeps score. It never handles money.

FALL ASLEEP IN THE DEN
Mix rain, thunder, a campfire and the jungle at night, then turn the lights out. The sounds keep playing with your phone locked.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets
• A bedtime check the night before each alarm
• Last night's sleep from Apple Health, if you want it
• Your mornings backed up to your own iCloud. No account needed.

SUBSCRIPTION
Jungle Alarm requires a Jungle Alarm Pro subscription. The yearly plan starts with a free 3-day trial; a weekly plan is also available. Prices are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it's cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://junglealarm.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Jungle Sprouts
description:
Jungle Sprouts turns the TV into a calm, playful learning space for children aged 5 to 7. Every game is made for the big screen and the Siri Remote: just swipe to choose and click to answer. Friendly voices read every instruction aloud, so early readers can play on their own.

FREE TO PLAY
• Numbers: count pictures from 1 to 20 and match amounts to numbers.
• Shapes: name shapes, spot them when they're turned, and finish patterns.

WONDER SPROUTS PRO (one-time purchase, in the Parents area)
• Letters: learn letter names, match capital and small letters, and find beginning sounds.
• Math: simple addition and missing numbers, within 10 and then within 20.
• Silly Faces: mix eyes, noses, mouths and hats to build funny faces, and keep a gallery on your Apple TV.

MADE FOR YOUNG LEARNERS
• Short sessions of about 3 to 5 minutes, with the choice to play more.
• Gentle retries: no timers, no lives, no streaks and no losing.
• Games get easier or harder based on how your child is doing.
• Big text, strong colors, and shapes and icons that don't rely on color alone.
• Works with VoiceOver, and music, sound effects and speech can each be switched off.

FOR GROWN-UPS
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking and no data collected.
• No links out of the app, and no buy buttons on children's screens.
• The Parents area is behind a grown-up check. There you can unlock Pro, restore purchases, change sound and session length, see progress and reset it.
• Progress stays on your Apple TV.
• Pro is a single purchase with no subscription.

name: Just Cool it
description:
Just Cool It is a free sales tool for contractors who offer CoolCote, the heat-reflective exterior wall coating by Just Cool It Inc.

ESTIMATE SAVINGS AT THE KITCHEN TABLE
Enter the property ZIP code, wall area, current color, building age, sun and the electric rate. The app estimates the yearly cooling savings, using Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory cool-wall research for that climate. Add your prices and it also estimates the savings from fewer repaints (based on CoolCote's 20-year written warranty), the total over 20 years and the payback on the price difference.

SHOW YOUR CUSTOMER
Turn your phone around: a clean full-screen view shows the estimated savings and how much more sunlight the walls would reflect.

SEND A REPORT WITH YOUR LOGO
Create a clean one-page PDF with your company name, logo and colors, in English or Spanish: energy savings + longer-lasting walls = estimated total savings over 20 years. Send it by text or email.

FOLLOW UP WITHOUT FORGETTING
Every customer you send a report to lands in your list. A reminder tells you who to follow up with today. Mark "They said yes" or "Not interested", pick a later reminder, or call or text with the report attached.

ORDER COOLCOTE
Order CoolCote any time, with or without a customer. Type a wall area and the app sizes the primer and finish gallons. Just Cool It calls you to confirm price and delivery. No payment in the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your customers' names, phone numbers and addresses stay on your phone. No ads, no tracking, no account to create.

All savings figures are estimates, not guarantees. They use research averages and the details entered, and cannot account for every factor (insulation, windows, air conditioning, how the home is used, shade, weather, future rates). Actual savings may be higher, lower or none. Terms: https://lcantillo84.github.io/justcoolit-app/terms.html

name: Kiduzz
description:
Kiduzz makes it easy for parents to find and book great things to do with their kids across the UAE.

Browse play areas, gaming lounges, sports academies, classes, camps and family events in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and more. Every listing shows real prices, photos, opening times and live availability, so you know what's free before you book.

FIND THE RIGHT ACTIVITY
• Explore handpicked experiences and featured venues
• Search by name or browse by category
• Switch emirate or tap "Near Me" to see what's close by
• Save your favourites to come back to later

BOOK IN A FEW TAPS
• Choose the experience, duration, date and time slot
• Add your children from saved profiles, one ticket each
• Apply a coupon code and see the final price before paying
• Pay securely by card on our payment provider's protected page, or use your Kiduzz Wallet balance
• Free trial sessions book instantly, with no payment needed

YOUR TICKETS, READY AT THE DOOR
• Get a QR ticket as soon as your booking is confirmed
• See all upcoming and past bookings in one place
• Get a reminder before your booking starts

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• Kids profiles so you don't retype names every time
• Earn Kiduzz points on your bookings
• Full English and Arabic support, including right-to-left layout
• Light and dark mode

Kiduzz is for parents and guardians booking activities for their children. Questions or feedback? Reach us any time from the Support link in the app.

name: Kindtime: Pomodoro Focus Timer
description:
Focus for real life.

Classic Pomodoro assumes you have 25 clean minutes and the attention to use them. Most days, you have neither. Kindtime starts with what you've actually got and helps you grow from there. If 25 minutes feels impossible, start with 5.

JUST 5 MINUTES
One tap starts five minutes of focus. No setup, no planning. Starting is the hardest part, so Kindtime makes it effortless. Still going when it ends? One tap to keep going.

GROW GENTLY
Kindtime notices the lengths you actually finish and, now and then, suggests one step longer: "You've finished three blocks of 10 minutes this week. Try 15?" Say yes or stay where you are. It never shrinks your progress or makes you feel bad for going shorter.

FITS YOUR DAY (PRO)
Kindtime reads your calendar on your iPhone and shows today's real free windows, like "40 min before your 2pm". One tap starts a block that ends two minutes before your next meeting, with an optional gentle wrap-up warning.

INTERRUPTIONS ARE NORMAL
Kids, colleagues, life. Stop early with one tap and it's logged as "got pulled away". Partial blocks still count. No failure states, no red, no streaks.

A QUIET PHONE
A one-tap shortcut turns on Do Not Disturb for exactly the length of your block, then switches it off again.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
The running timer sits on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with pause and stop. Start a block from a Home Screen widget without opening the app (Pro).

A WEEK, NOT A SCORE
See how long you focused this week, how your typical block is growing and when you focus best (Pro). No productivity scores, no leaderboards.

Choose from 5, 10, 15, 25, 40, 50 and 90 minutes, with breaks scaled to match. Classic 25/5 is there whenever you want it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No tracking. Your focus history and your calendar stay on your iPhone.

KINDTIME PRO
Free forever: Just 5 minutes, every block length, gentle growth, the Lock Screen timer, intentions, today's history and your weekly total.
Pro adds every free window in your day, meeting wrap-up warnings, widgets and weekly insights.
Yearly with a 7-day free trial, monthly, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Cancel anytime in Settings.

Terms of use: https://sitexuk.github.io/kindtime-site/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://sitexuk.github.io/kindtime-site/privacy.html

name: KingBomb - Classic Guandan
description:
KingBomb is Guandan (掼蛋) — the fast, bomb-happy partnership card game that over 100 million people play in China — built for English-speaking tables.

Two standard decks, four players in two teams. Shed your cards before the other team does, climb from level 2 to Ace, and watch for the one hand that beats everything: the King Bomb — all four jokers.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Partnership play: you and the player across the table are a team. No talking — read each other through the cards.
• Combinations you already know: singles, pairs, triples, full houses, straights — plus Guandan's stairs, plates and bombs.
• Wild hearts: the heart of the current level is wild.
• Levels: win a hand and your team climbs. First team to win at the target level takes the match.
• Tribute: the losing side gives its best card to the winners before the next deal.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX
• Quick (to 10) and Classic (to Ace) matches against three computer opponents with their own styles.
• Play with friends: open a private table and share a 6-letter code or a link; empty chairs are filled by computer players.
• Training table: a Sort drill that grades how you arrange a hand, and a Response drill that grades your answer to a lead.
• Hint, Group, Undo and Sort for when you are still learning.
• Card counter, emotes, ten music tracks and five sound packs.
• Friends and messages, Sign in with Apple — or just play as a guest.

A short tutorial teaches everything you need. No ads, no coins, no purchases.

name: KniTale: Knitting Row Counter
seller_name: TURKA YAZILIM VE DANISMANLIK TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
KniTale is the calm, cozy companion for knitters and crocheters. Keep every project, pattern and counter in one place and never lose your row again.

FOLLOW YOUR PATTERN, ROW BY ROW
• Import PDF or image patterns from Files or Photos
• Highlight the row you are working on with a movable row marker
• Zoom into charts and keep your place while you knit
• Add session notes right next to your pattern

ROW & STITCH COUNTERS
• Multiple counters per project: rows, stitches, repeats, decreases
• Big, easy tap targets in your project colors
• Counters stay linked to your project and pattern

COUNT FROM YOUR WRIST
• Apple Watch app: count rows without putting your needles or hook down
• Counts sync between your iPhone and Apple Watch

ORGANIZE YOUR PROJECTS
• Keep every WIP and finished object in one place
• Add a cover photo, link patterns and track your progress
• See your active projects and today's rows at a glance

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your projects and patterns are stored on your device
• No ads, no tracking

KNITALE PRO
Start with a 3-day free trial of the yearly plan, or unlock KniTale forever with a one-time Lifetime purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://seydaceylan.github.io/knitale-legal/privacy/

name: Koimono: ASCII Koi Fish Pond
description:
I love ASCII animation, and I wanted to make something fun and calming for the iPhone Duo and every other iPhone. Koimono is a koi pond drawn entirely in text characters, and it moves far more smoothly than letters and symbols have any right to.

The whole pond is redrawn up to 120 times a second on ProMotion displays. The koi bend and glide as they swim, ripples spread out wherever you touch the water, and the light on the surface changes through the day. I wanted it to show how beautiful plain ASCII can be.

Nine koi live in your pond, each with its own name. Rest a finger in the water and they come to see what it is. Hold one to see its name and age, and rename it any time. Feed them a handful, call them over, or scatter them.

A new koi arrives every five days until there are twelve. Then you can free one to make room for the next.

The pond mirrors the time of day, the phase of the moon and the seasons: blossom in spring, extra lily pads in summer, falling leaves in autumn and snow in winter. Rain comes and goes, and now and then a visitor stops by: a frog, a dragonfly, a turtle, a heron or a cat. A quiet pond song plays under it all, and the music sign turns it off.

ON THE IPHONE DUO
The pond is shaped by the hinge. Fold and unfold the phone and the water and environment shift with it. Closed, the pond runs as a stream down the outer display.

A HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Small and medium widgets show your own koi, the sky for the hour and tonight's moon.

ONE PURCHASE, NO ADS, NO TRACKING
You pay once. There are no in-app purchases, no account and no ads. Koimono doesn't collect any data and works offline.

name: L'Hombre
description:
L'Hombre is the classic Danish card game for three, as it has been played for generations: with spadille, manille and basta, with fish and counters, with Game, Tourné, Simple Nolo, Solo and Grand.

Play against the computer
• Three levels: Casual, Strong and Master. Strong thinks its way through thousands of simulated games; Master bids with a self-trained network.
• The coach shows what the computer would bid and play while you learn.
• Three or four at the table – with four, one sits out each game.
• Scoring in fish and counters as at a real table, and a pass pool when everybody passes.

Play online with friends
• Create a table and send the link. The computer takes the seats nobody sits in.
• Every player sees only their own cards – nobody can cheat by peeking.
• Lose the connection and the computer plays for you until you are back.

The rules are included
• Every bid with its price, throwing in, laying the cards down, tout, Simple Nolo with several players and the player sitting out joining in.
• The house rule about the black aces can be turned on.

No ads, no account, no subscription. Danish and English.

name: Leave It! Dog Walk
description:
Dozer is a good boy. Mostly. He barks at everyone, and he loves to give sloppy kisses to people who did not ask for them.

Leave It! is an endless dog-walking reflex game. The walk goes on its own; your job is to spot trouble and give the right command in time. A wrong command, or a moment too late, and the walk is over.

EVERY COMMAND HAS ITS OWN JOB
• Tap your dog: "Look at me." When he first barks at a person.
• Swipe down: "Sit." For cars, other dogs, and anyone he's growling at.
• Swipe sideways: "Leave it." For garbage, squirrels, bunnies, cats and more.
• Tap anywhere: a treat. When a loud noise spooks him. You only have a few.

DON'T STOP HIM FOR FAMILY
When someone with a heart over their head comes along, that's his family. Do nothing and let him run to them for big points. Same for a stick on the sidewalk.

THREE DOGS TO WALK
• Dozer, a Boston Terrier who barks at everyone
• Maggie, a pit bull / lab mix, sweet as can be
• Tucker, a near-sighted pug who walks into everything

IT GETS HARDER THE FARTHER YOU GO
Joggers, kids, the mail carrier, a grandpa with a cane, squirrels, foxes, a skunk, cats on fences, cars and other dogs. The pace picks up, your reaction time shrinks, and the weather turns from sunshine to rain, sunset and snow.

• Streaks build a score multiplier, and last-second saves count double
• Bones on the sidewalk refill your treats
• A paw print marks your best walk, so you know when you're about to beat it
• Short walks: one to five minutes
• iPhone and iPad, one hand

No ads. No accounts. No tracking. Works offline.

name: LebenTest: Citizenship Test
description:
Prepare for Germany’s citizenship test. Study German questions with translations, learn from the answers and practise under exam conditions. Includes questions for all 16 federal states.

An independent study app by WebJow, unaffiliated with any government agency or BAMF.
