Deutsch · English · فارسی · دری · العربية · Türkçe · Русский · Українська · Română · Polski · Shqip · Bosanski · پښتو

name: Legal Light: WI Shooting Hours
description:
How long until legal light? Legal Light counts down to Wisconsin shooting hours for the spot you're standing on, and puts the countdown on your lock screen, your home screen and the Dynamic Island.

Built in a duck boat before dawn, for the moment you want to know whether it's legal yet and the DNR's PDF is the last thing you want to dig up.

THE COUNTDOWN
• A big countdown to legal light, then to close
• All four Wisconsin rule sets: ducks and geese, deer / bear / small game / fall turkey, spring turkey, and the September early teal season
• Your county, hours zone and duck zone, with a warning when you're near the US 10 / US 41 duck line
• Use your location, pick a town, or tap the map

STRAIGHT FROM THE DNR
Wisconsin's legal hours aren't the sunrise at your spot. Each area uses one reference town's sunrise and sunset (Powers, Michigan for the north, Sheboygan for the south), plus 4 minutes for every degree of longitude west of 88° W. Legal Light reads the DNR's published 2026 tables directly and adds your zone's minutes. For years whose tables aren't in the app yet it computes them the same way (it matches all 2,920 entries of the 2026 tables within a minute) and says so.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• Lock screen widgets: a live countdown, the next opening or closing time, and an inline line above the clock
• Home screen widgets, small and medium, with the week ahead
• Each widget picks its own species: put a deer countdown next to a duck one
• Start a hunt countdown and it rides in the Dynamic Island and on the lock screen, switching from "legal light in" to "closes in" by itself at legal light

ALERTS
• A ping at legal light
• A heads-up 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes before close
• Scheduled on the phone two weeks ahead, so they fire with no signal, and they get through Focus

THE ZONE MAP
• Hours zones A to F, the northern and southern tables, duck zones and open water
• Pinch to zoom, tap anywhere to read its zones and use it as your spot

AND
• Any week's open and close times, with a date picker
• Today at a glance: night, twilight, legal light and sunrise on one bar
• Sun and moon at your exact spot
• Pixel-art app icons: first light, mallard, teal, whitetail, fox squirrel or tom turkey, or let the icon follow what you're hunting

PRIVATE, OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Legal Light makes no network requests at all: everything is computed on your phone, and your location never leaves it. Open source on GitHub.

NOT THE LAW
The Wisconsin DNR's regulations and its published shooting hours tables govern. Check the season dates and rules before you hunt, and allow yourself a margin.

name: Listok: Cycle Tracker
description:
Listok is a quiet cycle diary. No accounts, no ads, no cloud: everything you log stays on your iPhone.

WHAT MATTERS, ON ONE SCREEN
Your cycle day, phase and a gentle estimate of your next period. Your week at a glance — pull down to open the whole month. Want the bigger picture? Open All Months and scroll a year back or half a year ahead.

LOG IN TWO TAPS
"Started" and "Ended" right on the Today screen. The day sheet holds flow, symptoms, mood, intimacy and a short note. Log it and get on with your day.

A SPROUT THAT GROWS WITH YOU
A little sprout lives on your Today screen. Its mood follows your cycle phase: it naps under a leaf blanket, reaches for the sun, blooms, or quietly watches a firefly. It grows only from your self-care — the days you log something. Six stages, from a seed to a tiny tree. Plus a wardrobe: a scarf, a moon hair clip, a balloon and more, unlocked with achievements.

ACHIEVEMENTS WITHOUT GUILT
Logging streaks, Journal, Listening to Myself, A Year of Notes. We celebrate the habit of caring for yourself — never your body or a "perfect" cycle. A broken streak isn't a failure, and nothing you've earned is taken away.

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Control Center buttons: New Cycle, Intimacy, Open Listok
• Siri and Shortcuts: "What cycle day is it in Listok?"
• Gentle reminders, discreet by default — no "period" on your Lock Screen

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Your data stays on your device. The app never connects to the internet
• No sign-up, analytics, tracking or ads
• Face ID lock and a blurred app switcher preview
• Back up to a file — whenever and wherever you choose
• Apple Health, only if you want it: save your logs there, or bring your history over from another app
• Delete All Data really deletes everything

PHASE NOTES
Short, calm notes about what may be going on in each phase — no scare tactics and no medical advice.

Listok's estimates are a guide based on your own past logs. Listok is not a method of contraception and does not diagnose any condition. If something worries you, please talk to a doctor.

name: Little Grove: Bonsai Garden
description:
Little Grove is a calm, hand-drawn bonsai game. Plant a seed, water it, shape it, and watch it grow in real time, even while you are away, until it becomes an Ancient tree worth showing off.

Your grandfather starts you off with two trees: a proud Ancient Bristlecone Pine and a neglected little Ficus that needs rescuing. A short, friendly tutorial teaches you everything by doing.

GROW
- 36 species to discover, from humble Ficus to rare Legendary trees, each with its own shape, leaves, blossoms and fruit
- Real-time growth with four seasons: blossoms in spring, colour in autumn, bare branches in winter
- A garden that follows the day: sunrise, sunset, sun, moon and stars, with lanterns that light up at night

CARE
- Water, prune, wire, feed and repot. Snip the right shoots at the right time of year
- Keep trees healthy: thirst, pests and leaf blight all matter
- Grow a flawless Masterpiece with patient care

COLLECT AND SELL
- Take grown trees to a lively auction hall and watch the bidders compete
- Collect pots, from simple terracotta to rare glazed urns, decorate five garden areas and enter the weekly Bonsai Show for ribbons
- A built-in Care Guide explains every system

FAIR AND CALM
- No ads, no timers you must obey, no account needed
- Everything can be earned by playing. Jade is an optional in-game currency that you can also earn from achievements and levels, and it is never needed to finish the game
- Your garden is saved on your device and in your private iCloud, and the app collects no data

In-app purchases are optional. Mystery seeds show their odds before you buy: Common 50%, Uncommon 28%, Rare 14%, Epic 6%, Legendary 2%.

name: Littles: Pet Care Together
description:
Littles keeps your pets' care in one shared timeline.

• What's done: who did it and when, from the app or Telegram
• What's next: every due date, nothing overdue by surprise
• What to buy: before you run out, with an estimated cost

MEDICINES
Set the dose and how often: several times a day, every other day or on chosen weekdays, with an optional course end date. Enter how much you have, and Littles shows how long it will last and adds a purchase before it runs out.

COSTS
Add an approximate cost to any procedure. It shows next to the due date, and when you mark it done you can note what you actually paid.

TOGETHER
Invite your family with one link. One of you can use the iPhone app, another can simply tap buttons in Telegram. Both see the same timeline. Connect your family group chat in Telegram, and reminders arrive there once for everyone, showing who marked what.

REMINDERS
On iPhone and in Telegram, at the time your family picks. Mark a procedure as done or a purchase as bought right from the notification.

Unknown date? It's never marked overdue: Littles asks you to clarify instead. Made a mistake? Everything can be undone.

Fostering? Mark a pet as foster and keep its history when it finds a home.

Free, no ads, no tracking. Export your data any time.

Littles is not a veterinary service: schedules and doses are set by you and your vet.

name: Local Hive
description: LocalHive brings your estate together in one private app. Residents join with an invite code or are approved by an estate admin, so you know who you're talking to.

name: Looky
description:
Looky macht aus jeder Autofahrt eine kleine Entdeckungsreise. Die App weiß, wo du bist und in welche Richtung du fährst, und erzählt dir per Sprachausgabe Geschichten zu Burgen, Schlössern, Klöstern, Landschaften und Orten entlang deiner Strecke.

„Auf der linken Seite! Etwa 5 Kilometer entfernt: Marksburg. Entstanden im 12. Jahrhundert …“

WAS LOOKY ERZÄHLT
• Sehenswürdigkeiten: Burgen, Ruinen, Schlösser, Klöster, Kirchen, Türme, Museen, Parks, Berge und mehr – mit Richtung und Entfernung
• Geschichte und Sagen: auf Wunsch die spannendsten Abschnitte aus dem Wikipedia-Artikel
• Orte: „Du bist jetzt in …“ – mit Herkunft des Ortsnamens und einer Beschreibung im Reiseführer-Ton
• Menschen und Ereignisse: wer hier geboren wurde, was hier geschah, welcher Film hier gedreht wurde
• Landschaft und Natur: Flüsse, die du überquerst, Landschaften, Naturparks, Höhe und sogar die Geologie unter dir
• Unterwegs: Tunnel und Brücken, Sonnenuntergang und Vollmond, „Willkommen in Bayern!“ beim Wechsel des Bundeslands

SICHER UNTERWEGS
• Baustellen, Sperrungen und Staus auf der Autobahn werden 2 bis 8 Kilometer vorher angesagt – nur in deiner Fahrtrichtung
• Warnungen haben Vorrang und unterbrechen eine laufende Geschichte
• Bedienung ohne Hinschauen: Lenkradtasten, Kopfhörer, Sperrbildschirm und CarPlay

GEMACHT FÜR DIE FAHRT
• CarPlay: Steuerung und „In der Nähe“ direkt auf dem Bildschirm im Auto
• Musik läuft weiter und pausiert nur, solange Looky erzählt
• Funklöcher: Texte für die nächsten Orte werden vorab geladen
• Schon Gehörtes wird übersprungen – ideal für die Rückfahrt
• „Heute gehört“: alle Geschichten des Tages zum Nachlesen und noch einmal Anhören
• Stimme, Sprechtempo, Länge der Geschichten und Pausen nach deinem Geschmack
• Jede Quelle lässt sich einzeln ein- und ausschalten

SPRITPREISE AUF KNOPFDRUCK
„Wo tanke ich günstig?“ nennt dir die günstigsten Tankstellen in der Nähe. Dafür brauchst du einen eigenen, kostenlosen Schlüssel von Tankerkönig.

DEINE DATEN
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Dein Standort wird nur verwendet, um passende Orte zu finden, und ohne Namen oder Kennung an die eingeschalteten Datenquellen geschickt. Einstellungen und Schlüssel bleiben auf deinem iPhone.

HINWEISE
Looky ist für Fahrten in Deutschland gemacht; Verkehrsmeldungen, Spritpreise und Geologie gibt es nur hier. Die Texte stammen aus der deutschen Wikipedia, ihre Qualität hängt von den Artikeln ab. Die Sprachausgabe nutzt die Stimmen deines iPhones – mit einer „Premium“- oder „Erweitert“-Stimme klingt Looky am natürlichsten.

QUELLEN UND LIZENZEN
Texte: Wikipedia und Wikivoyage (CC BY-SA 4.0). Daten: Wikidata (CC0), © OpenStreetMap-Mitwirkende (ODbL), Die Autobahn GmbH des Bundes, Geologie © BGR (GÜK250). Spritpreise: Tankerkönig / MTS-K, CC BY 4.0.

name: Loupea: Antique Identifier
description:
What is that vase, that watch or that old painting really worth? Take a photo: Loupea identifies the object and estimates its value from comparable items that actually sold.

A subscription is required after your first estimate (weekly or yearly). If you prefer no subscription, a one-time pack of 5 estimates is available.

For anyone clearing out a family home, sorting an inheritance, hunting at flea markets and yard sales, or simply curious about what is in the attic.

HOW IT WORKS
• Photograph the object. One photo is enough; the underside and the maker’s mark help.
• Loupea identifies it: type of object, style, period, materials, maker’s marks and hallmarks.
• You get a value range with a confidence level, and the sales it is based on, with links to check them yourself.

WHAT MAKES LOUPEA DIFFERENT
• Sold prices, not asking prices: Loupea shows which items actually sold and which are still for sale, and says when it found no sale.
• An honest range with a confidence level, and a clear sign when a professional appraisal is worth it.
• An alert when an object may be worth much more than it looks.
• Your home inventory, by room and by person, with an estimated total, backed up to iCloud.
• A PDF file of the inventory for your family, an estate settlement or your insurer.
• Bargain mode for flea markets: photograph an item and its asking price to see if it is a good deal, with a tip to negotiate.
• Attic mode: photograph up to 30 objects in a row and estimate them later.
• A ready-to-post listing when you decide to sell.

HONEST BY DESIGN
Loupea gives an indicative estimate made by AI from sales found online at that date. It is not a professional appraisal. For a valuable piece, an insurance claim or an estate, consult a qualified appraiser.

SUBSCRIPTION
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple Account settings. Any unused portion of a trial period ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://romeoapps.app/en/loupea/privacy/

name: Lox Pro
description:
Your skills. Your schedule.

Lox Pro is the app for home-service professionals who work with Lox. Electricians, plumbers, appliance technicians, cleaners and beauty professionals use it to find jobs near them, do great work and get paid.

How it works
• Apply in the app: tell us your trade, your tools and your working area, and verify your identity. Our team reviews every application.
• Go online when you want to work. Lox sends you requests from customers nearby.
• Accept the jobs that suit you and see them on your schedule.
• Chat and call customers in the app, and share photos of the job.
• Navigate to the customer and let them follow your arrival.
• Finish the job and get paid once the customer has paid. Earnings go to your bank account.

Built for professionals
• Set your working hours and days off.
• Set your prices for the services you offer.
• Show off your work with a portfolio.
• Track your earnings, payouts and performance.

Your location
While you are online or on a job, Lox Pro uses your location, including in the background, to match you with nearby requests and to show the customer your arrival. Go offline and location tracking stops.

Lox Pro. Your skills. Your schedule.

name: Loxhome
description:
Your home, taken care of.

Meet Loxhome, your everyday companion for a home that works, feels, and looks its best.

From fixing a faulty socket to refreshing your space or booking a beauty appointment, Loxhome brings the services your home and lifestyle need into one seamless experience.

FIX. GLOW. CLEAN.

Fix what matters.
Get help with electrical issues, plumbing, appliance repairs, and everyday home maintenance.

Glow your way.
Enjoy convenient access to beauty and personal care services that fit your routine.

Clean without the hassle.
Keep your space fresh and comfortable with professional cleaning services.

Everything, made easier.
• Easy booking: Request the services you need in just a few taps.
• Trusted professionals: Get connected with verified service professionals.
• Real-time updates: Stay informed as your service progresses.
• Direct communication: Chat with professionals and share photos for better clarity.
• Flexible scheduling: Book services at a time that works for you.
• Your favourites, saved: Keep your preferred professionals close for next time.

Your home deserves more than occasional attention. It deserves a simpler way to keep everything running beautifully.

Loxhome. Fix. Glow. Clean.

name: Lunch Note
description:
Remember finding a note in your lunch? Lunch Note is that, on the home screen. Write a little note for your kid, and it shows up right where they'll see it next.

A NOTE LINE FOR TWO
Each note line connects one grown-up and one kid, and only those two people can ever see it. Not the other parent, not a brother or sister. Mom and Ava have their line, Dad and Ava have theirs, and Grandma can have one too.

RIGHT ON THEIR HOME SCREEN
Add the Lunch Note widget and your note shows up on their Home Screen, Lock Screen or StandBy, no app to open. A pinned note stays put until you unpin it.

WRITE, DRAW OR SNAP
Write a few words in a handwritten font, draw with your finger or Apple Pencil, or send a photo with a note on it. Pick the paper: napkin, notebook, sticky note or lunch bag. Pick the ink.

SEND IT LATER
Schedule a note for tomorrow at lunch, or the morning of the big test. It arrives right on time.

LITTLE ONES CAN WRITE BACK
Kids can reply with a drawing, a photo or a few words, and react with a heart, a star, a hug or a laugh. You'll see "Seen" when they open your note.

THE FRIDGE
One shared board for the whole family, for the things everyone should see.

SET UP BY A PARENT
Kids don't need an account, an email or a password. A parent sets up a kid's device by scanning a code from their own phone. Parents choose whether a kid can post photos or use the Fridge, set quiet hours, and can pause things anytime.

GRANDPARENTS TOO
Invite grandparents, aunts, uncles or a sitter as grown-ups. They get their own note line with a kid, and a spot on the Fridge.

JUST YOUR FAMILY
No ads, no tracking, no third-party SDKs. Nothing is public: no profiles, no search, no strangers. The only way into your family is an invite from a parent, so nobody outside your family can reach you or your kids. Photos are stripped of location before they're stored, and deleting something really deletes it.

Lunch Note is free.

name: Lunvella
description:
Lunvella is a quiet single-player puzzle set with three board layouts and a shared tile language.

Every puzzle uses 52 tiles arranged in four clans, each tile ranked one through thirteen. Instead of drawing toward a win, you read the whole board at once and plan a few steps ahead, guiding each tile into the place that lets the next one land.

Three distinct layouts carry the week:

Orbit Bloom opens a radial ring of petals around four cores. Each core grows outward from the middle of its clan, down toward one and up toward thirteen.

Prism Ladder stacks four rungs. A lower rung can only accept a tier once the rung above it already holds that tier, so progress moves top to bottom.

Mirror Tides hangs sky lanes above and lets deep lanes rise from below. Each gate fills toward the seam from both ends until the two halves meet.

A Daily Spark layout arrives every day and feeds a weekly rhythm chart that shows the shape of the week at a glance. Completed puzzles join a Star Map, and every session is logged in a Journal with time, step count and a glow rating. Zen mode hides the clock whenever you want to think without pressure, and milestones quietly mark long-term progress.

name: LusMi: LED Banners & Panels
description:
LusMi turns your words into light. Type a message, pick an animation, and show it full screen on your phone or send it over Bluetooth to your LED panel.

YOUR PHONE AS AN LED SIGN
No panel? No problem. Every show plays full screen on your phone: hold it up at a concert, in the car or behind the bar.

READY-MADE SHOWS
Eyes with personality, 216 waving flags, neon signs, animals, celebrations, holidays, reactions like WOW, LOVE and GG, and much more.

TYPE IT. LIGHT IT UP.
Scrolling text in eight pixel fonts, bold, in any colour. Line up your own sentences and play them one after another.

MESSAGES FOR THE ROAD AND THE SHOP
Big one-tap tiles: "Thanks!", "Open", "Back in 5 minutes".

CLOCK, WEATHER AND PHOTOS
The time and the local weather on your panel. Turn a photo or GIF into pixel art that fits the panel.

WORKS WITH BLUETOOTH LED PANELS
ML300 (64x20), iPixel Color and CoolLED UX panels, from 64 to 192 pixels wide. Designs are drawn for each panel height, so they stay sharp.

SHARE YOUR DESIGNS
Send a design to a friend; it opens in LusMi and fits their panel too.

100% PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your designs stay on your phone.

PREMIUM
One purchase, no subscription: every show and feature, yours for good.

Product names are trademarks of their owners. LusMi is not affiliated with them.

name: Madapoly
description:
Partez à la découverte de Madagascar en jouant !

Madapoly est un jeu de plateau familial où l'on achète, vend et négocie les plus beaux lieux de la Grande Île : Nosy Be, l'Allée des baobabs, les Tsingy de Bemaraha, Antsirabe, Toliara, Sainte-Marie… Le plateau suit la vraie carte de Madagascar, en 3D.

• Jouez à plusieurs sur la même tablette, ou contre l'ordinateur (3 niveaux)
• Achetez des terrains, construisez, encaissez les loyers en Ariary
• Enchères, échanges, et un ordinateur qui vous fait des propositions
• Partie rapide minutée : le plus riche gagne à la fin du temps
• Saisons malgaches : saison des pluies, cyclones, vanille, baleines, fête du 26 juin
• Cartes postales avec photos et choses à voir dans chaque lieu
• Zébus qui traversent la route, jour et nuit, musique salegy
• Jeu en français, avec une version en malgache
• Fonctionne sans internet, sans publicité, sans achat intégré

Un jeu pour découvrir Madagascar en famille, entre amis ou avec les enfants.

name: Mahalle Bakkalı
description:
Mahalle Bakkalı'nda tezgâhın başındasın! Müşteriler gelir, balonlarında ne istediklerini gösterir, sen de doğru ürünü uzatırsın. Ama iş göründüğü kadar kolay değil...

• TEK ELLE OYNANIR: Müşterinin istediği ürüne dokun, satış tamam.
• MAHALLE MEMNUNİYETİ: Müşteriyi bekletme, yanlış ürün verme. Memnuniyet sıfırlanırsa abin gelip hesap sorar!
• 15 ÜRÜN: Süt, ekmek ve sakızla başla; yumurta, peynir, çay, dondurma ve daha fazlasını açarak rafları doldur.
• TOPTANCI: Kampanyaları kaçırma, zamlara dikkat et, stoğunu akıllıca planla.
• FİŞ Mİ, FİŞSİZ Mİ? Fişsiz satış daha kârlı, ama vergi memuru her an kapıda olabilir.
• KOMİK MÜŞTERİLER: Veresiye isteyenler, "döner var mı?" diyenler, bozuk süt şikâyetçileri...
• HER GÜN FARKLI: Sıcak hava, maç akşamı, okul çıkışı, maaş günü ve daha fazlası.
• DÜKKÂNINI SÜSLE: Raf, duvar, fayans ve tabela renkleri, radyo, kameralı bölge, nazar boncuğu...
• Pikselli nostaljik görünüm, özgün müzik ve mırıltılı mahalle sesleri.
• İnternet gerekmez, hesap yok, reklam yok. İlerlemen cihazında saklanır.

Mahalle seni bekliyor. Tezgâhın başına geç!

name: Mama's Captain
description:
Mama's Captain is the app for women captains working with Mama's Ride, the children's transport service in Egypt.

- Set the days and hours you are available, and receive children's rides near you.
- Take standing weekly rides with the same families.
- Check your car before the ride with the in-app checklist.
- Start each ride with the family's code and end it with the hand-over code.
- Your location and the ride camera are shared with the family and the operations room only while a ride is running, for the child's safety.
- Talk to the family inside the app without sharing phone numbers.
- Follow your earnings in your wallet and request payouts.
- Upload your documents and sign your contract inside the app.

Only interviewed and verified captains can take rides.

name: Mama's Ride
description:
Mama's Ride is a children's transport service in Egypt, built on one idea: mothers trusting mothers, and women supporting women. You book a ride for your child, a vetted woman captain drives it, and you follow the whole trip from your phone.

The ride starts with your code
The captain cannot start the ride until you give her the one-time code from the app.

Handed over only to the right person
Add the people allowed to receive your child: a grandmother, an aunt, a school supervisor. The ride only ends with the hand-over code.

Watch the ride
The camera runs for the whole ride, and you can open it from the app. Follow the car live on the map with the expected arrival time, and get a notification at every step: captain confirmed, on the way, arrived, ride started, ride finished.

A team watching with you
The operations room follows every running ride. If the car leaves its route the room is alerted at once, and an emergency button connects you to them.

Built for the school week
Book the days and times once with recurring rides, and keep the captain your child knows as a favourite.

Your child's profile
Add each child with their school or activity and the notes the captain should know.

Talk to the captain inside the app, by chat or call, without sharing phone numbers.

Heroes (معايا بطل): free rides for children who need hospital visits, driven by our captains at no cost.

Captains are women, interviewed and verified, with their documents and car checked before their first ride.

name: Margem
description:
Margem is the notes app for people who take notes on the sermon, phone in hand.

Type a reference like John 3:16 or Rom 8:28; 1 Cor 13:4-7, press Return, and the verses are already in your note. Right away, offline, without breaking your typing.

VERSES RIGHT AWAY
• Book names and abbreviations in English and Portuguese
• One verse, a passage, a list, or a passage that runs into the next chapter
• The Berean Standard Bible in English and Almeida in Portuguese, both public domain and inside the app
• A reference typed in Portuguese, like João 3:16, comes in Portuguese

ONE NOTE FOR EACH SERMON
• Title, preacher and date
• Headings, lists, checklists and quotes set between big quotation marks
• Mark words in a verse and comment on them
• Pick the typeface, the text size and a light or dark theme

EASY TO FIND
• Folders, #tags and pinned notes
• Search by title, verse, preacher or any word
• Type @@ to link one note to another, and the other note links back
• Deleted by mistake? A note stays in Recently deleted for 30 days

ASK AI ABOUT THE SERMON
Ask for a summary, related verses, questions for reflection or the historical context. Answers stay within the Bible and the Christian faith, and any paragraph can go into your note.
• With Apple Intelligence, the AI runs on the device itself: free and private. It needs an iPhone 15 Pro or newer, an iPad with an M1 chip or newer, or an iPad mini with A17 Pro.
• On other devices, use your own OpenRouter key. Margem charges nothing.

YOUR NOTES ARE YOURS
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your notes stay on your device, and a backup is one tap. The same file moves your notes to Margem on the web and back.

name: Marker Walk
description:
Turn any walk into a small adventure.

Marker Walk sends you to real places with real stories: buildings on the National Register of Historic Places, murals and statues, monuments, waterfalls and scenic viewpoints, ghost towns and filming locations.

SURPRISE ME
Choose how many steps you want to walk, from a short stroll to 30,000 steps. Marker Walk picks a place about that far away and keeps it a secret. Follow the arrow and watch the steps count down. The name is revealed when you're 50 steps away.

PICK A PLACE
Choose a city, or your whole state, and get a random historic place with its story, address and directions. Each place shows up once before any repeat.

NEAR ME
See what's close by, nearest first.

THE STORY BEHIND EACH PLACE
Every place comes with a short history from Wikipedia, its year and type, and the films and shows shot there.

KEEP TRACK
Save places for later, mark the ones you've visited, and look back at what you browsed, organised by day.

WORKS OFFLINE
Download your state once, and everything works without a signal: on a trail, in the countryside or abroad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your location stays on your iPhone. It's used to find nearby places and to work out which state you're in, and it's never sent anywhere.

FREE AND UNLOCK
The state you're in is always free. Want to plan a trip? A one-time purchase, All States, lets you download any of the 50 states and Washington, D.C. No subscription.

name: Mat Room Planner
description:
Mat Room Planner is a practice planner built by a high school wrestling coach for the wrestling room.

PLAN PRACTICES FAST
- Build each practice in sections: Business, Warm-up, Drilling, Technique, Live, Conditioning and Cool-down
- Drag drills from your library into any section, or start from a template
- See start and end times for every block, and how your time splits across neutral, top and bottom
- Plan more than one practice a day, like morning lifting and an afternoon practice

SHOW IT ON THE TV
- Mirror your iPad to an Apple TV: the TV shows clean, room-sized slides while your iPad keeps the planner
- A Business slide shows the week's announcements, practice times, the next meet and the bus time
- Technique slides group moves by position so you can open one at a time

RUN PRACTICE
- A big block-by-block screen with what's next
- Timers are optional, so you can keep using your own interval timer

STAY ORGANIZED
- Sync practices, meets and bus times from your calendar
- Track how much time you've spent on each position
- Sync between your iPad and Mac with iCloud
- Share plans with your assistant coaches so you all edit the same practices

No accounts, no ads, and no data collection. Your plans stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.

name: Match Analyst
description:
Match Analyst puts everything you need to know before a football match on one screen.

BEFORE KICKOFF
• Both teams' recent form, at home and away
• Injured, suspended and doubtful players, with return dates when known
• Predicted and confirmed lineups
• Head-to-head record
• Rest days and congested schedules
• Referee, with average cards

GOAL NUMBERS
• Matches over 2.5 goals, both teams scoring, clean sheets
• Goals in the first and second half
• Current streaks: wins, unbeaten runs, games without scoring
• Recent scorers and penalty takers

COMPETITIONS
• Europe's top five leagues, with fixtures, standings and top scorers
• European club competitions
• National teams: qualifiers, tournaments and friendlies

ALSO
• News from sports papers, filtered by team
• Light and dark mode
• In English, Italian, French, Spanish and Portuguese

Match Analyst is free, needs no account, shows no ads and collects no personal data. It is made only to keep you informed about matches.

Match data provided by Bzzoiro Sports Data. Match Analyst is not affiliated with any league, club or federation.

name: Meadow Hush Patrol
description:
Little lawns. Big kindness.

Welcome to Meadow Hush Patrol, a cozy mowing adventure where a tidy garden starts with caring for its smallest residents.

Golden rustles hide rabbits, hedgehogs and tortoises that wander through the grass and start in new places every attempt. Guide your friendly mower through a larger living garden while its outer blade ring spins and cuts automatically. Follow moving rustles, ring before getting too close, and give each called friend a protective bubble as it heads for a garden edge.

SCOUT. RING. RESCUE. MOW.
Every garden asks for a thoughtful route between dense beds and physical supply crates. Tap to travel or drag and hold toward a screen edge as the camera follows. Use the live pocket map, or pause in a full-garden overview to plan. An unprotected friend touching the outer blade ends the attempt with a harmless startle, so ring before getting close.

A GARDEN THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Travel through 100 distinct expanded gardens in ten patches. The opening ten immediately introduce different layouts and supplies: clover islands, wet reed lanes, golden sedge banks, bramble pockets, fern ponds, windy terraces, orchard groves and moonlit heather. Eight plant families grow in separate dense beds, with flower islands, boulders and changing route choices.

TURN CLIPPINGS INTO SOMETHING LOVELY
Clippings compost into a mower upgrade for that garden. Unlock permanent Twin Fern, Coral Cruiser and Golden Canopy cores at Gardens 4, 11 and 31. Larger external cutting rings mean a wider sweep and faster cutting. Keep the ring against stubborn plants to finish the trim.

A POCKETFUL OF HELPERS
Collect glowing supply crates along your route. Wide Sweep expands your cutting ring. Dew Turbo doubles cutting power and speeds your wheels. Tea Break adds twenty seconds. Each attempt also includes one free pocket use of every helper, and your rescue bell is always free. Save acorns from daily parcels and first clears for extra pocket uses.

SMALL MOMENTS, FULL OF LIFE
Watch perimeter blades spin continuously, dense grass scatter, plants wobble, wandering friends scamper and helpers burst into color. Celebrate each cared-for meadow with a joyful mower twirl, star showers and your own personal best.

YOUR OWN LITTLE PATCH
Collect daily parcels, build a seven-day gift streak, earn up to three stars per garden and revisit your real records in an offline leaderboard on this iPhone. Pause whenever you need a breather. Play without an account, advertising or in-app purchases.

Progress and preferences are stored locally on your device. No online competition or network connection is required for gameplay. Privacy and terms links open in your device's default browser.

Make room to bloom. Join the patrol.

name: MechQuest
description:
MechQuest reúne en un solo lugar lo que la comunidad de egresados de Ingeniería Mecánica de la Universidad de Antioquia comparte a diario: dónde conseguir un material, quién vende un repuesto, qué empresa hace un trabajo o quién busca personal.

Con MechQuest puedes:
• Buscar proveedores de materiales: láminas, tubos, ejes, perfiles, aceros e inoxidables.
• Encontrar proveedores de repuestos: rodamientos, chumaceras, correas, motores, válvulas y más.
• Contactar a los proveedores directamente por WhatsApp o llamada.
• Conocer empresas de egresados y empresas que los emplean.
• Publicar consultas a la comunidad, de forma anónima, cuando no encuentras lo que buscas.
• Ver oportunidades de trabajo operativo y vacantes del Semestre de Industria.
• Consultar perfiles de egresados y sus competencias.

La información la alimenta la propia comunidad: si algo no está, publicas tu necesidad y otros egresados te recomiendan un proveedor.

Privacidad: las consultas son anónimas, puedes reportar publicaciones inadecuadas y puedes eliminar tu cuenta cuando quieras desde la app.

name: Medalsmith
description:
Medalsmith turns flat artwork into medals you could hold, on iPhone and iPad. Every shape is a layer you can raise, bevel, dome and finish in polished gold, brushed silver, hard enamel or glass.

• Real materials, lit in a studio: metals, enamel, pearl paint and glass, with gradients and frames
• Layers, colors, gradients, textures, lighting and quality, with undo and redo
• Present your medal turning in 3D, then export GIF, MOV, PNG, GLB or USDZ and share it
• A library with folders, favorites and search, synced through your own iCloud with your Mac
• Start from a gallery of showcase medals, or bring in works from the Mac app

Free to try with three works of your own. Medalsmith Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited works and agents on the Mac, on all your devices. No subscription, no ads, no tracking.

name: MeterMe dB – Sound Level
description:
MeterMe dB makes the sound around you visible. Start measuring, watch the chart and save your results with a personal note — on iPhone and iPad.

MEASURE AND UNDERSTAND
• Live sound levels with a clear display and history chart
• A, C and Z frequency weighting
• Fast, Slow and Impulse time weighting
• Minimum, average, maximum and energy-based Leq
• Pause, resume, save or deliberately discard measurements
• Optionally keep measuring when the screen locks; audio interruptions pause the measurement

KEEP YOUR HISTORY
Saved measurements are not automatically deleted after 30 entries. Explore days, weeks, months or years, add notes and share readings as CSV.

BACKUP AND IMPORT
Save your full measurement history to a file and import it on another device. Review new and existing measurements before importing. Existing measurements and their notes are preserved. Another device's active microphone calibration is not applied.

MICROPHONES AND REFERENCE CHECKS
Use the built-in microphone or a supported USB or wired input. Without reference calibration, the built-in microphone shows a labeled generic device estimate; uncalibrated external inputs show dBFS. Raw readings and measurement provenance remain traceable.

With a reference meter, you can save a correction for each input. A ten-second reference comparison documents the setup, reference level and result in a shareable check report. This is not a certification. After calibration, an adjustable warning threshold and haptic alerts are available.

METERME dB PLUS+
An optional one-time purchase permanently unlocks:
• Live frequency analysis with FFT and dominant frequency from the actual microphone signal
• Timed measurements of 30 seconds, 1, 5 or 10 minutes of active audio — ended and saved automatically; pauses do not count
• Compatible before/after comparisons with the Leq difference, statistics, overlaid charts and text sharing
• PDF measurement reports and L10/L90 for saved measurements

Frequency analysis is unweighted and displayed in dBFS; it is not a calibrated octave analysis. Comparisons require matching device, input, weighting, time weighting and calibration details. No subscription. Live measurement, history, notes, calibration, backups and CSV work without Plus+.

LOCAL AND PRIVATE
Audio is processed on your device. It is not saved as an audio recording or sent to us. No account is required. You decide whether to share measurements or backups.

IMPORTANT
MeterMe dB provides everyday guidance. An iPhone or iPad does not replace a certified sound level meter. Device estimates are not an accuracy guarantee and are unsuitable for binding occupational-safety measurements or evidence. If microphone access is unavailable, a clearly labeled preview with simulated readings can be used.

Available in German and English.

name: Mint Condition
description:
No ads. Ever. Nothing in this game makes you wait or pay.
You never pay for packs. Packs cost in-game cash, and the odds are published in the app.
Every card has painted art, from commons to secret rares.

Rip it. Grade it. Flip it.

Run a card shop where the pack rip is the whole fun. Tear each pack open with your thumb, flip the cards one by one, and watch the foil slot. Tilt your phone and the holos shimmer.

RIP
Buy packs, boxes and sealed cases with cash you earn in the shop. Every rarity has its own reveal, and the odds are on the screen, not hidden.

GRADE
Send your best pulls off for grading and wait for the slab. A 10 on a chase card is a run-defining moment. A 6 hurts.

FLIP OR KEEP
Sell a card for cash, or slot it into your binder. Completed binder pages are permanent bonuses, so the card you keep is never free.

BUILD THE SHOP
Hire a counter clerk, add an auto-ripper, open an online store. Your shop earns while you are away, and your numbers climb from dollars to millions.

HAGGLE
Walk-in sellers bring a box and a price. Take the deal, push back, or walk away.

START OVER, KEEP ONE
Sell the shop, keep one card for good, and begin again with a permanent shelf.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Fully offline. No account, no sign-in, no Wi-Fi needed.
- Portrait and one-handed.
- No ads, no timers, no energy.
- One optional purchase, the Shop Deed, unlocks the rest of the game once. It is the only thing you can buy with real money.

Mint Condition is a fictional card world. All sets, creatures and cards are invented for the game.

name: MoonMate
description:
MoonMate는 나의 주기를 기록하고, 사랑하는 사람과 함께 볼 수 있는 생리 달력이에요.

■ 간단한 기록
달력에서 날짜를 눌러 생리일을 등록하면 다음 생리 예정일, 가임기, 배란일을 예측해 보여드려요.

■ 주기 분석
지금까지의 기록으로 평균 주기와 기간을 한눈에 확인할 수 있어요.

■ 파트너와 함께 보기
초대 코드 하나로 파트너와 달력을 공유해요. 파트너는 보기만 할 수 있고, 기록을 바꿀 수 없어요. 서로 하트를 보내 오늘의 마음도 전해 보세요.

■ 나만 아는 표현, 비공개 문구
'생리', '가임기', '배란일'을 나만 아는 단어로 바꿔 화면과 알림에 표시할 수 있어요. 잠금 화면 알림은 내용을 숨길 수도 있어요.

■ 똑똑한 알림
예정일 며칠 전, 당일, 가임기와 배란일을 하루 한 번 정한 시간에만 알려드려요.

■ 개인정보 보호
기록은 내 기기와 내 iCloud에만 암호화해 저장돼요. 개발자는 기록을 볼 수 없고, 기록은 광고에 사용되지 않아요. 언제든 기간별 또는 전체 데이터를 삭제할 수 있어요.

※ 예측은 참고용이며 개인차가 있어요. 피임이나 임신 가능 여부를 보장하지 않으며, 의료적 진단을 대신하지 않아요.

name: MotorsZone24
description:
MotorsZone24, la référence des annonces automobiles en Côte d'Ivoire.

Que vous soyez particulier, concessionnaire ou professionnel de l'automobile, MotorsZone24 vous offre un espace fiable et rapide pour acheter, vendre et rechercher des véhicules neufs et d'occasion à Abidjan et partout en Côte d'Ivoire.

ACHETEZ FACILEMENT
• Recherchez par marque, modèle et prix maximum
• Consultez les meilleures offres et les annonces récentes
• Découvrez chaque véhicule avec des photos HD et une fiche technique claire : année, kilométrage, carburant, boîte de vitesses
• Enregistrez vos annonces préférées dans vos favoris

VENDEZ RAPIDEMENT
• Publiez votre annonce gratuitement en quelques minutes
• Ajoutez vos photos et les informations de votre véhicule en 4 étapes simples
• Gérez vos annonces depuis votre compte

CONTACTEZ DIRECTEMENT
• Appelez le vendeur ou écrivez-lui sur WhatsApp en un clic

UNE COMMUNAUTÉ SÛRE
• Signalez une annonce ou un vendeur
• Bloquez les vendeurs que vous ne souhaitez plus voir
• Supprimez votre compte à tout moment depuis le site

Téléchargez MotorsZone24 et trouvez la voiture qui vous correspond.

Contact : support@motorszone24.com

name: MultiCamture - Multi Camera
description:
Capture the scene and your reaction in one take. MultiCamture uses multiple cameras on your iPhone or iPad to take photos or record video, saving each camera view as a separate file.

• Preview up to three cameras live on supported devices. Tap a preview to switch that camera view.
• Rotate each camera view in 90° steps. Rotation applies to both the live preview and the saved file.
• Switch between photo and video at the shutter. Choose photo quality right from the capture screen. While recording, only the previews and a stop button are shown.
• Review and share your files in the app, or also save them to Photos when you grant access.

On iPhone Duo, the previews stack vertically when you hold the open device in portrait. You can also turn on a live preview on the outer display.

Capture a travel scene and your reaction, a cooking demo and your face, or different views of an event. Each angle stays separate, so you can choose what to share or edit later.

Available camera counts, combinations, and resolutions vary by device and settings.

name: Murder Case: Voice Detective
description:
There has been a murder. You are the detective, and all you need is your voice.

Question the suspects as if they were sitting next to you. They talk back, each with their own voice and their own secret. Search the crime scene, confront them with what you find and name the killer. No buttons, no reading: perfect in the car, on a walk or on the sofa.

HOW TO PLAY
• Ask anything: the characters really respond to your questions
• Search for clues by saying where you look
• Accuse when you know: killer, weapon, place and motive
• Fewer questions, more points

RISE THROUGH THE RANKS
Every solved case raises your rank and unlocks a harder level. The killer gets a last word, and you get to share your score.

The first two cases are free. After that you keep playing with a monthly subscription. New cases are on the way.

The characters are played by AI. During play your speech goes to AI services and is not stored by us. In the car, keep your attention on the road.

Terms: https://moordzaak.fly.dev/terms
Privacy: https://moordzaak.fly.dev/privacy

name: MUZIWALK Lite : baladeur rétro
description:
OPTIMISÉE POUR L’IPHONE DUO
Fermé et tenu à l’horizontale, votre iPhone Duo devient un baladeur : cassette couchée, bobines qui tournent, touches en rangée. Déplié, la pochette et les commandes s’affichent à gauche, la cassette tourne à droite (mode ouvert avec la bande Métal).

Votre musique, dans la cassette des années 90. Gratuitement.

MUZIWALK Lite est un vrai lecteur de musique pour les morceaux de votre iPhone. Il lit votre collection dans la façade 90 d'origine, bobines qui tournent.

INCLUS GRATUITEMENT
• La façade 90, cassette et bobines animées.
• Vos fichiers audio importés depuis Fichiers et votre bibliothèque Musique.
• Bibliothèque, recherche, favoris et historique.
• Lecture aléatoire, lecture en arrière-plan, AirPlay et écran verrouillé.
• Aucun compte à créer.

PUBLICITÉ DISCRÈTE
MUZIWALK Lite est financée par la publicité : des bannières dans les menus et une seule publicité plein écran par jour, sans son, à l'ouverture. Jamais de pub sur la façade pendant l'écoute.

DÉBLOQUEZ TOUT AVEC LA BANDE MÉTAL (achat unique, 2,49 €)
• Plus aucune publicité.
• Façades 1979, Sport 84 et 2000, en couleurs.
• Paroles karaoké et calage automatique.
• Égaliseur, MEGA BOOST, vitesse, VU-mètre et minuteur.
• Doublons, métadonnées et pochettes.
• Les quatre cassettes et le menu Thème.
• Widget de l'écran d'accueil.
• Modes ouverts pour iPhone Duo et iPad.
• Playlists et sauvegardes.
Un seul achat, sans abonnement, restaurable sur tous vos appareils.

BON À SAVOIR
MUZIWALK Lite lit la musique présente sur votre appareil. Aucun catalogue musical ni abonnement n'est inclus. Compatible iOS 17 ou plus récent.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://fullset1up.com/muziwalk/conditions/
Assistance : muziwalk@fullset1up.com

name: My Deraya
description:
Deraya brings your whole training journey into one place, from choosing the right program to receiving your certificate.

EXPLORE PROGRAMS
• Browse training programs, diplomas and professional programs by track.
• See the details of each program: content, hours, learning method and trainee reviews.
• Search by name and save the programs you care about to Favourites.

FOLLOW YOUR PROGRAMS
• Your enrollment status, your payments and your installment dates.
• A reminder before an installment is due.
• Your program access link and attendance instructions.

YOUR RECORDED LECTURES
• Watch your program's lecture recordings inside the app.
• Resume where you stopped and track your progress in every lecture.
• Change playback speed and watch in full screen.

YOUR CERTIFICATES, ALWAYS WITH YOU
• View your certificates in full and share them at any time.
• Verify any certificate issued by Deraya using its code.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT MATTER
• Payment confirmations, installment schedule updates, and new programs and offers.
• Turn notifications off inside the app whenever you like.

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Sign in with email or with Apple.
• Edit your details and photo, and delete your account from inside the app at any time.

The app supports dark mode and a fully Arabic interface.

Contact: info@deraya-edu.com

name: My Tiny Journey
NodiTeam – team & tasks
description:
NodiTeam is the app for teams that work with tasks and projects. It is meant for companies that already use NodiTeam: sign in with your account and have your team's work with you.

What it does
• Tasks: owner, due date, priority, subtasks and attachments.
• Board and timeline to see what is in progress and what is late.
• Projects for clients and internal work.
• Hours on tasks and a work log.
• Working hours, leave and approvals.
• Team chat with mentions and files.
• Client wishes and quotes that turn into projects.
• Invoices from hours on tasks.

Only in the phone app
• Encrypted notifications: only your phone can read them.
• Sign in with Face ID or fingerprint.
• Check in at work by tapping an NFC tag or scanning a QR code.
• Files and PDFs open and save on the phone.

The company account is created by an administrator at noditeam.com. Support: info@enalog.si, +386 31 744 268.

name: Norda
description:
Norda er arbeidsrommet for deg og teamet som vil gjøre viktige ting uten å drukne i støy.

Se hva som faktisk betyr noe i dag, beskytt tid til dyp jobbing, del fremgang med teamet og oppdag mønstrene som skaper en bedre arbeidsuke. Hver del av Norda er laget for å være rolig, tydelig og rask å bruke – også når dagen er travel.

**I DAG**  
Få en ærlig oversikt over dagens retning, fokusoppgaver og neste planpost. Start en fokusøkt med innebygd timer når du trenger å samle tankene.

**OPPGAVER**  
Opprett, rediger og fullfør oppgaver på sekunder. Filtrer etter prosjekt, frist eller fokus, og se fremdriften i hver prosjektportefølje.

**TEAM**  
Del teamets puls med ett trykk, se hvem som har kapasitet og gi ros for innsatsen som løfter hverdagen.

**PLAN**  
Bygg en uke med plass til både fokus, møter og pauser. Se belastningen over uken og legg til nye planposter med tydelig ansvar.

**INNSIKT**  
Forstå når flyten kommer, følg ukens fremgang og se hvilke prosjekter som trenger oppmerksomhet – uten kompliserte dashboards.

**ROLIG SOM STANDARD**  
Norda bruker et varmt, nordisk visuelt språk og tydelige prioriteringer. Varsler er valgfrie. Demodata og arbeidsområde lagres lokalt på enheten, og appen samler ikke inn personopplysninger.

Norda er laget for små team, prosjektgrupper og alle som vil ha en mer menneskelig måte å holde retningen på.

name: Nyanrank
description:
Log which food you served each cat and how they ate it in two taps. As logs add up, Nyanrank spots when a cat starts eating one food less than before and shows it in numbers.

Your usual food is already selected from last time. After a meal, just tap All, Half, A little or None. No weighing in grams.

TODAY
• Tapping saves the meal with the current time. Tap Undo within 5 seconds if you mistapped
• Edit the time and how they ate later
• With two or more cats, switch between them

CHANGES IN EATING
• After 6 logs of the same food, the latest 3 are compared with the logs before them
• When a well-liked food's score falls, Today shows it in numbers, such as "Before 2.8 → Recent 0.7"
• Alerts stay inside the app. No notifications
• If your cat has eaten little of two or more foods this week, you see a note to ask your vet if it continues or they lose weight, instead of a food alert

MOST EATEN
Foods are ranked for each cat, with recent logs counting more. Handy when choosing what to buy next.

REST AND BRING BACK
• Rest a food they're eating less, and it leaves the Today list while the Resting tab counts the days
• Prescription diets show "Decide with your vet whether to change a prescription diet"

YOUR RECORDS STAY YOURS
Data stays on this iPhone (and in your iPhone backup, such as iCloud, if you use one). No account, no developer servers, no ads, no analytics (Apple confirms purchases).

This app only organizes your logs and does not judge illness or health. If you're concerned, ask your vet.

FREE
1 cat and up to 10 foods (archived foods don't count). Logging every meal, the list, most eaten, the alert for the latest drop, rest and bring back.

PREMIUM
• Any number of cats
• Unlimited foods
• The full list of foods they're eating less
• 30-day score chart and fish vs. meat trends
• Worth trying again: foods rested for the days you choose or longer (7, 14 or 30; 14 by default). Prescription diets are never suggested
• Export your log as an image: a table for one cat of the foods logged in the last 30 days, with 30-day counts and scores from the last 10 logs

Choose a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers), or a one-time purchase. Prices are shown in the app in your local currency. Cats, foods and logs you've already entered stay, even without buying.

ABOUT SUBSCRIPTIONS: Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically, including after the free trial. Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period to avoid being charged for the next one. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. You can cancel anytime from "Manage & Cancel" in Settings, or in your Apple Account subscriptions in the iPhone Settings. Restore your purchases anytime.

Privacy Policy: https://rui-gihu.github.io/polaris-apps-legal/gohan-kuitsuki-cho/privacy.html
Terms of Use: Apple Standard EULA https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: OneMoreFloorUp
description:
How high can you go?

Leap from platform to platform through 12 colorful worlds in OneMoreFloorUp. Explore Nature, Fantasy and City adventures, each with its own scenery, moving hazards, music and challenges.

• Climb 300 floors to complete each world and unlock the next.
• Explore volcanoes, jungles, icy mountains and the sky.
• Discover spooky realms, futuristic places and city adventures.
• Collect coins and choose from boys, girls and robot heroes.
• Use Rocket Boost, Time Lock and Frost Blaster equipment to help your climb.
• Reach checkpoints every 50 floors.

After a defeat beyond the first checkpoint, choose an optional rewarded ad to continue from your last checkpoint, or restart from floor 1 without watching an ad. A completed ad is required for the checkpoint continue; ads require an internet connection and may be unavailable.

The optional Adventure Pack contains 1 Rocket Boost, 1 Time Lock and 5 Frost Blaster shots. It is a repeatable consumable purchase, not a subscription. The App Store displays your local price before purchase.

Game progress and equipment are stored on your device. Deleting the app's data can remove local progress and unused equipment.

Original game creator credit: Daniel Badirov.

name: OneTrueFaith
description:
OneTrueFaith is a free companion for Orthodox Christian life: prayer, Scripture, the saints and the rhythm of the Church year, in one quiet place.

PRAY
- Morning, evening and daily prayers
- The Jesus Prayer with a prayer rope counter
- The Divine Liturgy of St John Chrysostom, section by section
- Gentle reminders for your prayer times

READ
- The Holy Scriptures: Septuagint Old Testament and New Testament
- Highlights and private notes

FOLLOW THE CHURCH YEAR
- Orthodox calendar with feasts and fasts, Old Style or New Style
- Fasting information for each day
- The saints of the day, with traditional icons where available

LEARN AND LISTEN
- Learn about icons, saints and the Orthodox faith
- Orthodox teaching videos
- Monastic Radio with Orthodox chant

YOUR PRIVACY
Faith-related tracking is stored with your account only if you explicitly choose this, and you can withdraw that choice at any time. There is no advertising in the app.

OneTrueFaith is an independent project and is not endorsed by any Orthodox Church or jurisdiction. It does not replace the guidance of your priest or spiritual father.

name: Orb – Illustrated Dreams
description:
Your dreams. Finally visible.

When you wake up, tell Orb your dream, out loud or in writing. Orb, a small orb of light, rebuilds it faithfully, scene by scene, into an illustrated story staged like a video. You keep it in your Dream Well and share it if you like.

"Dreams fade fast: researchers recommend telling yours as soon as you wake up." (Putois, Ruby et al., Inserm, Frontiers in Neurology, 2020)

HOW IT WORKS
• Tell it: hold Orb (or the mic) and talk, even half asleep. Or type, if you prefer.
• Orb checks: one or two questions to make sure she got it right. Then you pick the style; she suggests one.
• Your dream, illustrated: a few minutes later, a story in several scenes. You can close the app while you wait: your dream will be waiting in your Dream Well.

TRUE TO EVERY DETAIL
Colors, objects, places, people: Orb keeps what you say, even the impossible, with one picture for each moment of your dream. The people in your dreams become characters she recognizes from one dream to the next, and you can retouch them.

28 STYLES, TEN ANIMATED STORY FRAMES
Realistic comes first, truest to your dreams. Then watercolor, film photo, anime, manga, claymation, impressionist, stained glass, film noir… 28 image styles in four families: animation, comics and illustration, painting and drawing, photo and film. Your dream plays in one of ten animated story frames, picked by Orb to suit its mood, and you can switch: storybook, constellation, watercolor sketchbook, paper theater, magic lantern, candlelight, snow globe, the deep, sea of clouds, night train.

SHARING AND COMMUNITY
Share your dream as a vertical video, a picture, a carousel or a link: everything you share is signed "Made with Orb". Publish it to the community if you want. No comments, no messaging: stars on a scene or a sentence, "I dreamed this too" when someone had the same dream, profiles to follow, leaderboards and the Dream of the day. You can report a dream and block a profile.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your dreams stay private until you choose to publish them. When you publish, the first names of the people close to you are replaced by their role ("my sister"); when you share, they're hidden by default. Your data is stored in Europe. No ads, and we never sell your data. With your consent, Orb relies on AI from Anthropic and OpenAI to illustrate your dreams; they don't use them to train their models.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Orb works by subscription, with no free trial. The welcome flow, the sample dream and the pages of shared dreams stay available without one.
• Orb Lite: 6 illustrated dreams a month, up to 6 pictures per dream, 8 image styles (realistic, watercolor, film photo, clear line, engraving, naive pastel, cartoon, surrealist painting).
• Orb: 12 illustrated dreams a month, up to 8 pictures per dream, all 28 image styles, and Orb in your colors.
Every plan includes characters, the Dream Well, the animated story frames, sharing and the community, monthly or yearly; the price is shown in the app before you buy.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Orb is for people 16 and older. Orb is entertainment: she doesn't interpret your dreams and gives no medical advice.

Terms of Use: https://orb.vincotech.fr/en/terms

name: Out of Context
description:
Every robot gets 20 seconds. When it freezes, its body becomes part of your next solution.

Build a staircase from your predecessors. Leave one holding Approve. Bounce off an extra-upbeat Chipper 2.0, ride Lite 2.0 while it autoscales, or push the portable Edgr past a monitor. Reach the green UPSTREAM arrow with as few agents as you can.

The lab wants its AI agents to stay in the sandbox. Every escape gives it another idea for a rule: "never touch prod", "no escalating", more monitoring. The agents obey to the letter. Nobody at the lab has read the patch notes.

- 47 puzzles across seven chapters, from first discoveries to connected expert challenges
- A Benchmark star on every level for meeting or beating its target agent count
- Five agent personalities, fully voiced
- A lab that comments on your attempts
- Hand-inked comic art and cheesy lab hold music
- Touch controls on iPhone and iPad, with tips when you need them
- Pause, restart or replay any level; choose any level in an unlocked chapter
- No ads, no account, no data collected

Start with chapters 1 and 2: 14 free levels. One purchase unlocks chapters 3 to 7: 33 more levels, including the expert chapter Production. No subscription, and nothing else to buy.

name: OZZO SALES
description:
OZZO SALES is the field app for OZZO, a sales CRM used by distributors, manufacturers and wholesalers across India. A business gives this app to its own sales team. You need a login created by your company to use it — there is no public sign-up.

One app for the whole working day, and it keeps working when the mobile signal does not.

ATTENDANCE AND SHIFTS
Mark attendance with a selfie and start your shift. Your office can set a boundary so that attendance only counts when you are really there. Your shift ends when you punch out.

CUSTOMER VISITS
Check in at the customer, record what was discussed, attach photographs, and check out. Where your office has turned on the location check, the app confirms you are at the customer's premises before it accepts the visit.

ORDERS AND QUOTATIONS
Take an order from the product catalogue with that customer's own price list, discounts and schemes applied as you type. Send a quotation, turn it into an order, and follow it through dispatch.

COLLECTIONS
Record a payment against an invoice, attach the receipt, and see what is still outstanding for every customer.

LEADS AND DEALS
Keep leads, deals and follow-up tasks in one place, with a reminder when the next step is due.

EXPENSES AND LEAVE
Claim travel and other expenses with a photograph of the bill, apply for leave, and see where each request stands.

ROUTE PLANNING
Follow the beat plan your manager set for the day, stop by stop, with navigation to the next customer.

REPORTS
See your own numbers: visits, orders, collections and attendance.

WORKS OFFLINE
Fill in a visit, an order or an expense claim with no signal at all. The app saves it on the phone and sends it the moment you are back online.

ABOUT LOCATION
Where your employer has enabled tracking, OZZO records your location during a shift that you started yourself, so that attendance, visits and travel can be confirmed. It begins when you mark attendance to start the shift and stops when you mark attendance to end it. It never runs outside a shift. The iOS location indicator stays visible for as long as it is running, and you can withdraw the permission at any time in Settings. Full details are in our privacy policy.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED
An OZZO account from your employer. If your company does not use OZZO yet, visit ozzo.co.in.

name: Pairshade: Mahjong Ghost Race
description:
Mahjong solitaire, but you can race your friends. Clear a board of 144 tiles, send your run as a "ghost", and your friend plays the very same board while your moves fade across it like a shadow. Whoever clears it first wins.

[How to play]
• Tap two matching tiles that are free (nothing on top, and open on the left or right) to remove them. Flowers match any flower, and seasons match any season
• Clear all 144 tiles to win. Your time and moves are your score
• Every board can be solved. If you run out of moves, shuffle and keep going
• A game takes about 5 to 10 minutes

[Today's Board]
• A new board opens every day at 00:00 UTC. It is the same board for every player in the world
• Your first clear each day counts: it keeps your daily streak and becomes the ghost you share
• Practice boards are free and unlimited

[Ghost races]
• Send a short link. No account and no sign-up needed
• Your friend's board opens in the app, or in a web page that replays your run
• Their moves appear as shadows on your board, so you can see who is ahead
• Share a result image with your time, moves and board

[Boards and tiles]
• 7 hand-drawn board layouts, made for tall phone screens
• Tiles are drawn from scratch, with extra tile styles to unlock
• Hint, shuffle and undo help when you are stuck. Some are free every day

[Jade]
• Earn jade by clearing boards and beating ghosts
• Spend it on hints, shuffles, undo, extra layouts and tile styles
• There are no random rewards. Everything is shown before you choose it

[Premium and other purchases]
• Monthly and yearly plans: no ads, past boards, unlimited hint, shuffle and undo, plus 30 jade every day. Both start with a 7-day free trial
• Remove ads: a one-time purchase that removes banner and full-screen ads. Optional rewarded videos stay available
• Layout Pack and Tile Pack: one-time purchases for extra practice layouts and tile styles
• Jade packs of several sizes, and a one-time starter pack

The app is available in 39 languages. Your records stay on your device.

[About subscriptions]
• Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically. At the end of the free trial or of each period, the price of the chosen plan is charged to your Apple ID
• A subscription renews at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• You can cancel in Subscriptions in your App Store account settings
• One-time purchases do not renew

Privacy Policy: https://crelve-mahjong-ghost.web.app/privacy.html

name: Panoloom: 360 Panorama Camera
description:
Capture the whole place, then step back inside it.

Panoloom is a panorama camera and creative studio for iPhone. Shoot wide, vertical, 180° and 360° panoramas or a full sphere, explore them by dragging or moving your iPhone, and turn them into tours, Tiny Planets, postcards and cinematic videos.

CAPTURE THE WHOLE VIEW
• Guided capture for Wide, Vertical, 180°, 360° and full Sphere panoramas
• On-screen guidance keeps your sweep level and steady
• Night Capture for low light, and Mosaic mode for extra-detailed rows (Pro)
• Import panoramas you already have from Photos or Files — several at once

STEP INSIDE YOUR PHOTOS
• Look around by dragging, pinching or moving your iPhone
• Auto Tour slowly turns the view for you
• Your library keeps every panorama with its place and date, and a map shows where each was taken

BUILD YOUR OWN TOURS
• Link panoramas with tap-to-go hotspots and walk from view to view
• Panoloom can suggest links from where and which way each panorama was taken
• Share a tour as a Panoloom tour file or as a video. Free tours have up to 2 panoramas; Pro adds more, floor plans and an offline web tour

MAKE IT MOVE
• Cinematic Studio turns any panorama into a video with smooth camera moves
• Tiny Planet Studio spins a 360° sphere into a little world
• Postcards add your words, the place and the date to a short moving card
• Live Panorama loops a short video clip inside a still panorama
• Depth Motion adds gentle 2.5D parallax on supported iPhones

KEEP THE SOUND OF THE PLACE
• Record an Audio Snapshot of the ambience with your panorama
• Add Sound Points that play from the direction you place them as you look around

SEE HOW PLACES CHANGE
• Compare panoramas taken at the same spot on different days with a swipe or a crossfade
• Repeat Capture helps you line up the same view again

PERFECT THE PICTURE
• Smart Repair checks level, exposure and sharpness on your iPhone and suggests safe fixes
• Edit, straighten and reframe

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Your panoramas, sounds and creations stay on your iPhone unless you choose to share them. Location is only saved to show where a panorama was taken, and you can remove it from exports.

PANOLOOM PRO
Capture, view, import and basic exports are free. Pro unlocks 1080p and 4K video, 60 and 120 fps, all camera moves, exports without the watermark, tours with 3 or more panoramas, floor plans and web tours, Mosaic, Night Pro controls and more.
• Yearly with a 7-day free trial, Monthly, or a one-time Lifetime purchase
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

TERMS & PRIVACY
Panoloom is licensed under Apple's standard End User License Agreement (EULA), together with the Panoloom Terms of Use.

• Privacy Policy: https://appmate.cloud/legal/panoloom
• Support: https://appmate.cloud/contact/panoloom

name: PassDrive Georgia
description:
PassDrive is a simulation of the second, city stage of the Georgian practical driving exam.

• 10 cities: Poti, Rustavi, Telavi, Gori, Akhaltsikhe, Sachkhere, Kutaisi, Ozurgeti, Batumi, Zugdidi
• Real exam routes, road signs, traffic lights and road markings
• Practice mode: every mistake explains what you broke and why you would fail
• Exam mode: the real exam's rules
• Under-the-hood questions, walking to the car and starting the engine
• Your statistics, attempts and mistakes
• One account everywhere: iPhone, Android, Windows and the web

Access to a city is sold for 14 days. The first route in Poti is free.

name: Patente B Pro
description:
Preparati alla patente B con una banca di quiz italiani, simulazioni a tempo e allenamenti per argomento. Controlla i progressi, rivedi le risposte e scopri gli argomenti da ripassare. name: PayloadRung
description: QR குறியீட்டில் பதிப்பு 1 முதல் 40 வரை, திருத்த அளவு L/M/Q/H உடன் அதிகபட்ச எண், எழுத்து-எண், பைட்டு மற்றும் காஞ்சி திறனை ஒப்பிடுங்கள். உங்கள் உள்ளடக்க நீளத்தைச் சரிபார்த்து, தேவைப்பட்டால் 16 வரை பிரிப்பு அறிவுரை பெறுங்கள். குறியீட்டுப் படம் உருவாக்கப்படாது. எழுத்துகள் இந்த தொலைபேசியிலேயே சேமிக்கப்படும்; செயலியை மூடிய பிறகும் திறந்தால் அப்படியே இருக்கும்.

name: Penlit – Lecture Notes AI
description:
Every lecture, highlighted.

Tap record at the start of class and lock your phone. Penlit listens, transcribes as it goes, and about a minute after class you get a clean study pack:

• NOTES — a one-minute summary, then clear sections that follow the lecture
• EXAM SIGNALS — the moments your professor flags for the exam, with the quote
• FLASHCARDS — ready to review, with spaced repetition that brings each card back right before you’d forget it
• QUIZ — multiple-choice questions with an explanation for every answer
• ASK THE LECTURE — questions about what you missed, answered only from what was said, with the passage it comes from
• KEY TERMS — definitions you can scan before a test
• FORMULAS & CODE — equations drawn properly, code kept with its indentation

CHECK EVERYTHING
Tap an exam signal to jump to the exact moment in the transcript and listen to it again. Search the transcript, edit your notes, fix a misheard word everywhere at once, or rewrite the notes in another language.

MORE WAYS IN
Import a voice memo, snap the board or your slides, import slides as a PDF or a Zoom/Teams transcript, or paste a reading. Photos of the board stay in your notes. Penlit works in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Hindi and Arabic — and can write your notes in another language than the lecture.

BUILT FOR STUDENTS
• Records with the screen locked, even lectures several hours long (up to 12 h a month)
• Your notes stay on your iPhone — no email sign-up, no ads
• Review in short sessions with Again / Hard / Good / Easy and undo, a daily limit for new cards, and a “Prepare the exam” page per subject with a cumulative quiz
• Snap the board while you record, add images to cards, listen to your notes, export to Anki or PDF, back up your library
• A daily reminder when cards are due — and one 2 days before a free trial ends

TRY IT FREE
Explore the example lecture right away, no subscription needed. Then start a free trial: 7 days with the yearly plan, 3 days with the monthly plan.

PENLIT PRO
Penlit Pro includes up to 12 hours of lectures per month. Choose yearly or monthly, each with a free trial. Heavy month? Add 10 hours with a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your App Store settings.

Notes are AI-generated and can contain mistakes: check them against your course. Ask your professor before recording and follow your school’s rules.

Terms: https://sahik-studio.netlify.app/penlit/terms.html

Each month, including annual plans: 12 audio hours, 40 study-pack units and 100 question units. Large documents use multiple units. Trial: 1 hour, 5 pack units and 10 question units. Top-ups add audio only.

name: PersoTV
description:
PersoTV turns your Apple TV into a personal TV.

Choose your Moods (News, AI & Tech, Finance, Music and many more) and PersoTV builds one row per Mood with videos, podcasts and live channels from across the web, ranked by its own algorithm, not by a platform's recommendations.

• One row per Mood, chosen by you
• Videos, podcasts and live TV in one place
• Long-press a video: More like this, Not interested, Never show this channel
• Sign in in under a minute with a QR code, from your phone or computer
• Delete your account and data any time, from the TV or the website

PersoTV plays permitted streams directly and opens other videos in the platform's own app. Channel names are always shown. Video information is provided by third-party services.

name: petlye
seller_name: ONPOINT COMPANY FOR GENERAL TRADING AND CONTRACTING
description:
Petly makes caring for your pets simple. Find the right clinic, book an appointment in a few taps, and stay in touch with your vet, all from one app.

FIND THE RIGHT CARE
• Browse clinics and providers by service: veterinary, grooming, boarding, home service, dog walking and training
• Search by name and filter by city, pet type, price, date and time
• See which clinics are open now

EVERYTHING ABOUT A CLINIC IN ONE PLACE
• Services with prices and how long each one takes
• The team of specialists
• Branches with their location on the map and opening hours
• Ratings and reviews from other pet owners
• The pets each clinic welcomes and its booking and cancellation policy

BOOK IN SECONDS
• Choose your pet, branch, service and specialist
• Pick a day and see the times that are still free
• Pay securely online and get your booking confirmed

MANAGE YOUR APPOINTMENTS
• See upcoming visits, past visits and bookings waiting for payment
• Reschedule or cancel when your plans change
• Get notified about updates to your bookings

CHAT WITH THE CLINIC
• Ask a question before you book or follow up after a visit
• Message the clinic directly from its profile
• Real-time messages with read receipts

YOUR PETS' PROFILES
• Add all your pets with their photo, type and breed
• Keep their age, weight, height and nutrition notes at hand

MORE
• Save your home and work addresses
• Send feedback or a complaint right from the app
• Available in English and Arabic

Download Petly and give your pets the care they deserve.

name: Phin Phố
description:
Phin Phố là game pha chế và kể chuyện ấm áp, lấy bối cảnh một quán cà phê nhỏ ở Đà Lạt.

Sau bảy năm viết code ở Sài Gòn, bạn mất việc chỉ vì một email lúc nửa đêm. Bà Sáu ở Đà Lạt trao cho bạn chiếc chìa khóa của quán cà phê đã đóng cửa năm năm. Phin, ghế, ly vẫn còn đủ, chỉ thiếu người pha.

PHA ĐÚNG MÓN KHÁCH GỌI
• 19 món đậm chất Việt: cà phê đen đá, cà phê sữa đá, bạc xỉu, cà phê trứng, cà phê muối, cà phê cốm, trà chanh, trà sen Tây Hồ và nhiều món khác.
• Ly đổi dần theo từng nguyên liệu bạn cho vào.
• Khách có giới hạn kiên nhẫn: pha sai là đổ đi làm lại.
• Lên cấp để mở thêm món mới, tối đa cấp 15.

NHỮNG NGƯỜI GHÉ QUÁN
• Trò chuyện với khách quen và khách lạ, mỗi người mang theo một câu chuyện riêng.
• Lựa chọn của bạn ảnh hưởng đến cách câu chuyện diễn ra.
• Ghi lại mỗi ngày trong cuốn nhật ký của quán.

CHỢ VÀ TRÒ CHƠI NHỎ
• Ra chợ mua đặc sản cho quán: cốm, sấu ngâm, kem muối, kem trứng, cốt dừa...
• Năm trò chơi nhỏ để đổi gió: Ghép Phin 2048, Pha Phin Chuẩn, Lật Thẻ Chợ Đồng Xuân, trò tính tiền và trò giao hàng.

Tranh phong cách màu nước, nhịp chơi nhẹ nhàng. Game miễn phí, có quảng cáo và không có mua trong ứng dụng. Không cần tài khoản, vẫn chơi được khi không có mạng. Có tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh.

name: Pile Play
description:
Race to empty your Challenge Pile in Pile Play, a colorful card game for 2–6 players. Build shared piles from 1 to 12, use wild cards to keep a sequence going, and make each discard count.

Play solo against CPU opponents, pass the device for local multiplayer, or play online with Game Center. Choose a 10-card or 30-card Challenge Pile and play a single round or a multi-round match.

Try the Daily Deal, work toward Weekly Challenge goals, and track your wins, streaks, and achievements. Earn in-game reward points and redeem them for eligible themed decks.

New to the game? The interactive How to Play guide walks you through the board and your first moves.

name: Pinball Dozer: Coin Pusher
description:
Pinball meets Coin Pusher! Join Poko the fairy to recover 9 lost Rings and set off on an adventure to new worlds beyond the forest.

■ Shoot! Hit! Coins galore!
· Pull and release the plunger to launch your Marble — the harder you pull, the farther it flies
· The more mushrooms you hit, the bigger the Combo — and the bigger the coins that drop
· Every coin the pusher drops over the front edge is yours!
· Gems and Dolls that fall go straight into your bag — watch out for Red Holes

■ BINGO! Marbles rain down
· Fill all five B·I·N·G·O holes for bonus Marbles
· Sink one in the ? hole and a Doll flies in

■ Recover the 9 Rings
· Craft Rings from Dolls and Gems and place them in the Magic Circle
· Ring skills — Hole Guard · 1.5× Combo · Magnet · Barricade …
· Collect all 9 Rings to forge a Key and open the next world

■ 1-minute battles — bring it on!
· Live Challenges — battle a player who's online right now on the same board
· Weekly League · Daily Challenge · send challenge links to friends

■ Spend your coins on anything
· 6 Marbles — upgrade up to Lv5 in the Marble Workshop
· Treasure Chests · Glowing Mushrooms · Summon ?

■ New adventures beyond the forest
· Mushroom Forest → Firefly Swamp → Ice Cave → Desert Oasis, with new worlds to come
· Fairy Gift Box · Daily Tasks · friend invite rewards

Sign in with Apple to save your progress, or start right away as a guest.

name: Plain Calories
description:
Plain Calories counts calories the moment you open it. There's no account to make.

Log what you eat
• Type or say a whole meal, like "2 eggs, toast and coffee". Check it on one screen, then log it all with one tap. To say it, use your keyboard's microphone.
• Search more than 13,000 USDA foods and over 400,000 US packaged foods, right on your phone, even offline. Single foods like chicken or rice show before dishes and restaurant items.
• Scan a barcode. The app checks its own packaged-food list first, and asks Open Food Facts only when it has no match.
• Take a photo of the Nutrition Facts panel and the app reads the numbers for you to check.
• Save your own foods and usual meals, and copy the day before in one tap.
• Meal prep: make a dish from what went in the pot, enter its cooked weight or how many portions it made, then log a portion any day.

See your day
• Calories eaten and left against your own target.
• Your day in Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snacks, each with its own total.
• Protein, carbs and fat, plus more than 30 other nutrients when a food lists them.
• A weight trend line that smooths out day-to-day swings.
• Once you have 10 logged days and 4 weigh-ins, an estimate of what you burn a day, worked out from your own log and weigh-ins.

Private by design
• No account, no tracking, no analytics.
• Your diary stays on your phone. An online lookup sends only the barcode or the words you typed to Open Food Facts.
• Save a backup file whenever you like, and delete everything with one button.

Plain Calories is for keeping track of what you eat. It isn't medical advice. If you're unsure what's right for you, ask a doctor or dietitian.

Food data: USDA FoodData Central, including USDA Branded Foods (public domain), and Open Food Facts (Open Database License).

name: PMP Exam Prep: Practice Tests
description:
Ace the PMP® (Project Management Professional) Certification Exam with complete confidence!
PMP Exam Prep delivers a clean, professional, and ad-free learning experience with over 1,000 high-yield situational questions mapped to the current PMI® Examination Content Outline (ECO).

• One-time purchase: No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no paywalls.

name: Poker Dice 2026
description:
Five dice. Three rolls. One smart move at a time.

Poker Dice 2026 is a strategic dice game for 2 to 6 players. Roll five poker dice showing A, K, Q, J, 10 and 9, keep the ones you need, and fill your board line by line. Every player has their own board, and the game does the scoring for you.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Against the CPU, which weighs the odds of every roll
