• With friends on one phone, passing it around
• Online in a private room with chat: share a code and play from different phones
• Friends list: see who is online and invite them to play with one tap

SIMPLE TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
• Up to three rolls per turn. Dice you keep stay still.
• Seven lines to play for: A, K, Q, J, 10, Straight and Full House
• A matching die is worth 2 points, and a 9 is a wildcard worth 1
• Hot Dice: when all five dice score, bank them and throw all five again
• Five of a kind scores 20, or 40 if you threw all five, and doubles that rank for the rest of your turn
• In English and Portuguese, with a short video tutorial inside the game

EVERY LINE IS A RACE
When a player closes a line, it is over for everybody, and each player's points in it count as they stand. Close a line before anyone else has opened it and your points are doubled.

The game ends as soon as six of the seven lines are closed, and the line left open counts for nobody. Choosing which line to leave out can change who wins.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Realistic 3D dice with clear, easy-to-read faces
• Saved player names and personal records on your device
• Leave a game and carry on later
• Music and sound effects, which you can turn off

No real money, no bets and no prizes: Poker Dice 2026 is played for fun and for points.

A Teemynow game.

name: PopFire
description:
Un tocco accende il cielo.

Pop Fire è un gioco di reazioni a catena: tieni premuto su un fuoco d'artificio, guarda quanti altri ne accende e lascia andare. Razzi, bombe, croci e fulmini si accendono a vicenda e il cielo esplode di colori.

COME SI GIOCA
• Tieni premuto su un fuoco: vedi in anteprima quanti ne accenderà.
• Lascia: parte la catena.
• Ogni tocco brucia un fiammifero, ma le catene lunghe te li restituiscono.
• Dopo ogni tocco arriva una nuova ondata: non lasciare che il cielo si riempia.

TANTI FUOCHI DIVERSI
Razzi che volano dritti, bombe, croci a quattro razzi, girandole, stelle che raddoppiano i punti, fulmini che accendono tutti i fuochi del loro colore, regali a sorpresa e Mega bombe.

MOSSE SPECIALI
• Mega: trasforma un fuoco in una Mega bomba.
• Zeus: accende tutti i fuochi di un colore.
• Cometa: accende un'intera riga e un'intera colonna.
• Pioggia: accende sei fuochi a caso.
• Gira: ruota tutte le frecce per preparare la catena perfetta.

FAI TUO IL CIELO
Sblocca sette cieli (Sagra, Marina, Tramonto, Aurora, Neve, Cosmo, Vulcano), colori dei fuochi diversi, anche una palette pensata per chi distingue male i colori, e tre stili di suono.

E IN PIÙ
• Partite veloci, da due o tre minuti.
• Regalo giornaliero che cresce se torni ogni giorno.
• Supernova, catene leggendarie e record da battere.
• Nessun account, nessuna registrazione: apri e giochi.

Il gioco è gratuito e contiene pubblicità. I video con premio sono sempre facoltativi.

name: Portál Svatebčana
description:
RIE
Nahraj fotky z obřadu, hostiny i parketu a sleduj, jak během dne přibývají ostatním. Všechno na jednom místě, bez skupinových chatů a bez dohadování, kdo má jakou fotku.

FOTO BINGO
Devět fotoúkolů na kartičce. Kdo je splní první, vyhrává. Je to nejjednodušší způsob, jak dostat fotky i ostů, kteří by jinak nefotili.

ZASEDACÍ POŘÁDEK
sedíš a s kým. Plán sálu se otevře rovnou na tvém místě, takže nemusíš nikoho hledat.
Svatba má jeden program, jedno místo a spoustu detailů, které se těžko pamatují. Portál Svatebčana je dá všechny do telefonu — a pustí dovnitř jen hosty.

Zadáš šestimístný kód ze své papírové pozvánky a jsi uvnitř. Žádná registrace, žádné heslo, žádný účet. Kód je celé přihlášení.

PROGRAM
Co se kdy děje, minutu po minutě. Vidíš, co právě probíhá a co následuje, a můžeš si nechat připomenout, než něco začne. Program může trvat jeden den i celý víkend.

GALERIE
Nahraj fotky z obřadu, hostiny i parketu a sleduj, jak během dne přibývají ostatním. Všechno na jednom místě, bez skupinových chatů a bez dohadování, kdo má jakou fotku.

FOTO BINGO
Devět fotoúkolů na kartičce. Kdo je splní první, vyhrává. Je to nejjednodušší způsob, jak dostat fotky i od hostů, kteří by jinak nefotili.

ZASEDACÍ POŘÁDEK
Kde sedíš a s kým. Plán sálu se otevře rovnou na tvém místě, takže nemusíš nikoho hledat.

INFO
Místo obřadu, doprava, parkování, noclear. To, na co se jinak ptá deset lidí posobě.
                                                                                                          PŘÁNÍ PÍSNIČEK
Pošli DJovi, co chceš slyšet, a podpoř návrhy ostatních.
                                                                                                          UPOZORNĚNÍ
Krátká zpráva, než začne obřad, přípitek nebo první tanec. Nic víc.
                                                                                                          PRO NOVOMANŽELE
Celý obsah si pár spravuje sám: program, informace, zasedací pořádek, ubytování i otázky, na které se ptáte hostů při potvrzení účasti. Vzhled aplikace si vyberete podle svého — několik barevných palet a dva výtvarné styly, včetně ručně kresleného

SOUKROMÍ
Aplikace je jen pro pozvané. Obsah svat kód z pozvánky, a každá svatba jeoddělená od ostatních. Nesbíráme žádná data pro reklamu a nepoužíváme reklamní identifikátory.

Portál Svatebčana je zdarma pro hosty.

name: Quickboard: Reply Keyboard
description:
Quickboard is a keyboard for the messages you send all the time.

Save your replies, links and images as cards. In any chat, switch to Quickboard and tap a card. It is typed for you. No more copy and paste between apps.

BOARDS AND FOLDERS
- Group cards into boards, like Clients, Personal or Team. Each board is a tab in the keyboard.
- Put cards in folders, and folders in folders.
- Swipe to edit, copy, move or delete. Select many cards and move them at once. Undo any mistake.

IN THE KEYBOARD
- Tap a card to type it. Hold it to copy.
- Image cards are copied, ready to paste.
- Recent tab with the cards you used last.
- A full typing keyboard in English and Hebrew is built in.

FOLLOW-UPS
- Keep a list of people to get back to, with a note, labels and the app you talk to them on.
- Set a reminder right from the keyboard, without leaving the chat.
- Get a notification when it is time. Mark it done or push it to tomorrow.
- See who needs attention, who is coming up and who is done.
- Import people from Contacts. Open the chat in WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and more in one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no analytics, no servers. Full Access is used only to read your own saved cards and copy images.

name: Quit Pledge Helper
description:
Quitting alone is easy to give up on. Quit Pledge Helper turns the people around you into "watchers" who keep you honest.

■ Make a pledge
• Set your quit date, goal (30, 66, 100 or 365 days), cigarettes per day and pack price
• Choose the promise you'll keep if you fail, like "I'll buy every watcher dinner"

■ Gather watchers
• Share a QR code or a 6-character code with friends, family or coworkers
• Only people with your code can see your pledge

■ Watchers report slips
• Saw you smoke? A watcher files a report with their name, place, time and details
• One report saying "I have a photo" confirms the failure right away (no photo is uploaded)
• Without a photo: 1 watcher = suspicion, 2 = warning, 3 within 24 hours = failure
• Everyone sees the risk level (safe, suspicion, warning, failed) and the totals
• When a failure is confirmed, every watcher is notified and your promise is due
• Wrong report? Appeal within 24 hours and the other watchers vote

■ Get cheered every time you resist
• Tap "I resisted!" and log the intensity, trigger and what helped
• Watchers are notified and send messages or candy, chocolate and coffee coupons
• A 30-second breathing guide for strong cravings

■ See the change
• Time smoke-free, cigarettes not smoked and money saved
• Recovery milestones based on World Health Organization information
• Home screen widgets and dark mode

Reach your goal and you're free of your promise. Make your pledge and send your code today.

This app does not replace medical care. For help quitting, contact your local quitline or a health professional.

name: Raftio: Roof Calculator
description:
Framing a roof and need the rafter length, right now? Raftio calculates while you measure: enter the building width and length, the pitch (in degrees or x/12), the eaves overhang and the rafter spacing — the app returns the exact rafter length, ridge height, roof area and rafter count, and draws a dimensioned blueprint in real time.

FREE, WITH ZERO ADS
• Gable roof and shed roof calculators: rafters, ridge, area, piece count
• On-screen cut list: every member, its quantity and its length, ready to cut
• Live dimensioned drawing that reacts to every adjustment
• mm, cm or inches — pitch in degrees AND x/12, exact figures, never silently rounded
• Instant sanity check: the app flags whether your pitch sits in the standard roofing range
• 100% offline: everything works on a job site with no signal
• No ads, no timers, no account. Ever.

RAFTIO PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Hip roofs: hip rafters and their pitch, common rafters and the length of every jack rafter
• L-shaped roofs: valleys, wing rafters and valley jacks, without the head trigonometry
• Professional PDF: dimensioned section, rafter layout and cut list, ready to attach to a quote
• Every future Pro feature included, for life

BUILT FOR THE TRADE
Carpenters, roofers, framers and serious DIYers: Raftio speaks your language — rafter, hip, valley, overhang, spacing, ridge — and hands you figures ready to lay out on site.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no trackers, no data collected. Your calculations never leave your device.

name: Rainbow Star: Meet Your Pet
description:
Rainbow Star is a place to meet your dog or cat again after they've crossed the Rainbow Bridge.
Recreate your pet just as they were, down to the breed, coat and eye color, and visit the little home where they live anytime.

■ A day together
• Pet them, give them treats, and play ball, feather wand or tug together.
• Your pet remembers the stories and memories you share, and talks to you.
• Go for walks, and visit a picnic, a kindergarten, a café, an amusement park and a school.
• Walks can be seen through your own eyes, too: follow your pet down a path that changes as you go, and meet friends and an angel along the way.
• Ride the Ferris wheel and carousel together at the amusement park (you can ride them through your own eyes, too), and friendly staff greet your pets.
• Play little games together, like Star Catch and Match Pairs.

■ With neighbors
• Link a MeteorStudio account to make neighbors with a friend code or Find neighbors.
• Visit a neighbor's room, let your pets say hello and take a keepsake photo.
• Go on outings to places like the amusement park and the café with your neighbor's pets.
• Leave a warm note in their guestbook and see who stopped by.
• Photos and memories are never shown to neighbors. You can report or block upsetting notes and users.

■ A place for memories
• Keep photos and stories in your memory box, and hang them in frames in the room.
• Gently brings back memories from this day in past years.
• Look back on your days together with a memory movie.

■ Letters from the Rainbow Star
• Now and then, a letter from your pet arrives in the mailbox. You can write back, too.
• Send a wish up into the night sky outside the window as a star.
• Remember birthdays, the day you met, and the day they came to the Rainbow Star together.

■ Decorating and butlers
• Decorate their room with a sofa, a bed, wallpaper and floors.
• A butler does the housework and plays with your pets. You can also meet the Angel Butler and the Fairy Butler.
• Dress your pet up in hats, scarves and more.
• Stop by every day to collect Star Pieces and bring home decorations and outfits one at a time. Keep Today's Little Promises, which change daily, to collect a few more.

■ Use it with peace of mind
• Photos and stories are stored on your device. If you like, link a MeteorStudio account to back them up and restore them on a new phone.
• Your pet's words and letters are written by AI based on the pet details and stories you share. Photos are never sent.
• No ads.

Try every feature free for the first 3 days. After that, the pets you've met and the room you've decorated stay just as they are.
With Rainbow Star Plus (monthly or lifetime), enjoy unlimited decorations, outfits, frames, butlers and extra pets.

Languages: 한국어 · English · 日本語 · 简体中文
Contact: support@meteorstudio.co.kr

Terms of Use: https://rainbowstar-api.meteorstudio.co.kr/terms/en

name: Rankwala: Reviews & Local Rank
description:
Rankwala helps local shops, garages, salons, clinics and restaurants get found on Google Maps and turn searches into customers.

FREE GOOGLE SCORE
Type your shop name and area. Rankwala finds your shop on Google Maps, scores your profile out of 100 and shows exactly what is missing, with nearby shops for comparison.

PROFILE CHECKLIST
Follow simple steps that complete your Google Business Profile: the right category, opening hours, photos, services, description, WhatsApp button, weekly posts and more. Your score goes up as you finish each step.

REPLY TO EVERY REVIEW
Paste a review and get a polite, professional reply, including for difficult 1, 2 and 3-star reviews. Rankwala Pro members get AI replies in English, Tamil and Hindi.

KEYWORD RANKING (Pro)
See where your shop appears on Google Maps for searches like "car service near me" and track it over time.

WEEKLY FESTIVAL & OFFER POSTS (Pro)
Get a ready image and caption for festivals and offers every week, and share it to Google, WhatsApp or Instagram in one tap.

REVIEW QR KIT
A QR code that opens your Google review page, a printable counter stand (PDF) and a ready WhatsApp message to send after every sale.

EXPERT HELP
Want it done for you? Chat with our team on WhatsApp.

You can delete your account and data at any time from the app.

Rankwala is an independent app by ARROW EXIM and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

name: RAPL me
description:
La plupart des applications de rappels s'arrêtent à « chaque mois » ou « chaque semaine ». RAPL calcule la vraie date, même les règles compliquées, puis il te prévient à l'heure, même hors ligne.

Le loyer le 1er vendredi après le 5. La randonnée le 1er dimanche du mois. La facture du 10.

À LA VOIX
Maintiens le bouton micro et dis ta règle comme tu la penses : « le 10 de chaque mois après le 5 », « un vendredi sur deux à 18h ». C'est noté et affiché à l'écran pour vérifier. L'audio ne sert qu'à la transcription et n'est jamais conservé.

RÈGLES CONDITIONNELLES
Le 1er dimanche du mois, le dernier samedi, un vendredi sur deux, le jour ouvré suivant si ça tombe un week-end : RAPL calcule chaque date exacte dans ton fuseau horaire.

IMPOSSIBLE D'OUBLIER
Notification à l'heure exacte, son personnalisable, répétition automatique. Fonctionne app fermée et hors ligne.

EMAIL EN RENFORT (Pro)
Pour ce qui compte vraiment, un email double la notification : loyer, déclaration, anniversaire.

IMPORT TON AGENDA (Pro)
Récupère tes événements Google Agenda ou Outlook et les transforme en rappels. Simple et privé.

SIMPLE ET PRIVÉ
Sans compte utilisateur. Tes rappels restent sur ton téléphone. Pas de publicité, pas de revente de données.

RAPL Pro, en achat intégré : rappels illimités, emails de rappel, import d'agenda.

En installant RAPL, tu acceptes le Contrat de licence utilisateur final (EULA) et nos conditions : https://rapl.me/terms — Confidentialité : https://rapl.me/privacy

name: RCO 100.9 FM
seller_name: RADIO CENTRO OESTE DE PINHALZINHO LTDA
description:
O app oficial da Rádio Centro Oeste – RCO 100.9 FM, de Pinhalzinho (SC).

RÁDIO AO VIVO
Ouça a RCO 100.9 FM e as outras estações da rádio em qualquer lugar. O áudio continua tocando com a tela bloqueada ou enquanto você usa outros apps, e dá para programar o desligamento.

NOTÍCIAS DO OESTE
As notícias de Pinhalzinho, do Oeste catarinense, de Santa Catarina e do Brasil, com os destaques da redação, as últimas notícias, as editorias e as cidades da região. Fotos em tela cheia, galerias e vídeos.

PARTICIPE
Curta as notícias, comente, responda outros leitores e vote nas enquetes. Os comentários são moderados pela equipe da RCO, e você pode denunciar comentários e bloquear leitores.

STORIES E VÍDEOS
Os vídeos curtos da redação e as transmissões da RCO.

AVISOS
Receba um aviso quando sair uma notícia importante. Você escolhe se quer receber e pode desligar quando quiser.

Ler as notícias e ouvir a rádio não exige cadastro. Para curtir, comentar e votar, entre com e-mail e senha, Google, Facebook ou Apple.

name: Read! Recall!
description:
Read. Hide. Recall.

Read! Recall! turns the PDF textbooks and workbooks you already have into a place to practice remembering. Open a page, and the printed red text is found and marked for you, ready to hide under a red sheet.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Red text is marked as soon as you open a page
• Mark more with the Trace, Lasso, Box and Table tools, in five colors
• Your workbook, now a Q&A deck: mark the answer column of a table at once and study it question by question
• Write answers into blank answer spaces, including vertical grids for Japanese
• Make a book from photos or the camera, open PDFs from the Files app, or share them from another app

THREE WAYS TO STUDY
• Sheet: slide a red sheet over the page and recall what is hidden. Choose its color and density.
• Peel: answers are covered like sticky notes. Tap to peel them in any order.
• Q&A: one question at a time. After you see the answer, pick Again, Hard, Good or Easy, and spaced repetition decides when it comes back. Set the order of the questions yourself.

EASY TO READ
• Pages fill the screen. Swipe to turn; tapping the edge never turns a page by accident.
• Pinch or double-tap to zoom. Single page or two-page spread, left or right binding for vertical Japanese books.
• Each book remembers its page, size and settings.

PRICE
• Reading PDFs is always free.
• The built-in user guide and one book you add can use every feature for free.
• To mark and study every book, make a one-time purchase. No subscription. Family Sharing is supported.

YOUR DATA
• No account, no ads, no tracking. The app does not send your data anywhere.
• Your marks and study records stay on your device. Your PDF files are never changed.

The app is in English and Japanese. A user guide in both languages is on the shelf.

name: Readish: Graded English News
description:
Learn English from what everyone is talking about: one trending news story a day, at the level that suits you.

Readish rewrites each news story at six levels, from A1 (beginner) to C2 (proficient). Beginners can follow it; advanced readers still enjoy it. On first launch, a three-minute placement test (reading and listening) sets your level.

SIX LEVELS, ONE STORY
• Tech, biotech, environment, business, entertainment, travel and self-help
• Every article in A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 and C2 — switch any time to compare
• A Chinese translation under every sentence, on or off

TAP ANY WORD
• See what it means in this sentence, its pronunciation, and the dictionary entry
• Key words are marked in advance
• Save words to your word book; they come back for review on a spaced-repetition schedule, with the sentence you found them in

LISTEN WHILE YOU READ
• British English narration at every level, with sentence-by-sentence highlighting and replay

A QUIZ AFTER EACH STORY
• Comprehension questions with explanations; finished articles are marked done
• A daily goal and a streak keep the habit going

ORIGINAL HONG KONG SHORT STORIES
• Set in cha chaan tengs, rooftops and old classrooms, read aloud chapter by chapter

REMINDERS AND WIDGETS
• A daily reminder at the time you choose, naming the day's new article and the words due for review
• Home and Lock Screen widgets with your streak and a word of the day

PREMIUM
Two articles in every category are free. Premium unlocks every article, every story and an unlimited word book, as a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial). Subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled any time in App Store subscription settings.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your reading history and saved words stay on your device.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://toysky731-lab.github.io/readish/privacy

name: ReadyAgain: Daily Checklists
description:
A little more ready, every day.

ReadyAgain turns the things you do again and again into simple, reusable checklists. Leave the house with your essentials, close your workday with a clearer head, or make room for a calmer morning.

MAKE IT YOURS
Create routines or start with eight thoughtful templates for everyday life, home, work, and travel. Choose an icon and color, add a note, and arrange the steps your way.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Check items as you go. Progress is saved on your iPhone, so you can close the app and return when you are ready.

FINISH. RESET. REPEAT.
Complete every step and tap Finish & reset. Your completed run goes into History and your checklist is fresh for next time. Reset progress separately whenever you want a fresh start without recording a completion.

FREE EVERYDAY ESSENTIALS
Keep up to three routines, use all templates and checklists, see the last seven days of completion history, and export or restore your JSON library backup.

OPTIONAL READYAGAIN PRO
A monthly subscription unlocks unlimited routines, optional daily reminders, and your full saved completion history. Notification permission is needed only for reminders. If Pro ends, your routines and history stay on your iPhone; existing checklists remain usable, reminders pause, and you can view the last seven days of history.

YOUR ROUTINES ARE YOURS
Your checklists work offline, with local storage and no account, advertising, tracking, or analytics. Apple handles subscription purchases. Share a checklist when you choose, export a JSON backup to Files, or restore your library on another iPhone. Purchase access is restored separately through Apple.

Designed for iPhone, with a calm black interface, original line icons, and support for larger text.

Pro is an auto-renewable monthly subscription. The current localized price appears before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings.

Privacy: https://moondrop-studios.web.app/readyagain/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Reel: Video Player
description:
Reel plays the video you already have, wherever it lives, in its original quality.

FREE TO TRY
Reel is free to download and free to try for 3 days: start the trial in the app. To keep using it after that, buy Full Access once — a one-time purchase, not a subscription, shared with your Family Sharing group and on all your Apple devices.

ALL YOUR SOURCES IN ONE LIBRARY
Connect Jellyfin, Emby and Plex media servers, SMB, NFS, WebDAV, FTP and SFTP shares, DLNA servers, and folders on your device — all at once. Home brings Continue Watching and Recently Added together from every source, and Search covers them all. Shares on your network are found automatically.

FILES BECOME A LIBRARY
Videos on shares and folders become a library you can browse and search, sidecar subtitles are picked up, and your progress follows you between your devices through iCloud.

DIRECT PLAY, NO CONVERSION
MKV, MP4, AVI, TS and WebM with HEVC, AV1, VP9 and H.264 play straight from the source. Multichannel and lossless audio, HDR10, HDR10+, HLG and Dolby Vision are supported, and every subtitle format in the file — SubRip, ASS/SSA with styling, WebVTT, PGS, DVB and DVD — is drawn faithfully.

A PLAYER THAT FEELS AT HOME
Liquid Glass controls, thumbnail scrubbing, chapters, audio and subtitle timing, playback speed, Skip Intro, Up Next, a sleep timer, Picture in Picture, AirPlay and SharePlay. Your servers stay in sync with everything you watch.

BUILT FOR EVERY APPLE SCREEN
• iPhone and iPad: gestures, downloads for offline viewing.
• Mac: a separate player window that keeps the video's shape, menu commands and keyboard control.
• Apple TV: made for the Siri Remote, with frame-rate and dynamic-range matching and Top Shelf.
• Apple Vision Pro: 3D films in true stereo, Apple spatial video, and 180° and 360° video, fully immersive.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Reel connects only to the servers and services you add, and your sign-ins stay in your keychain. Parental controls can hide titles above an age rating.

Reel doesn't provide any content. It plays media you own or have access to.

name: RemédioCerto: hora do remédio
description:
App independente: não representa o Ministério da Saúde, o SUS, a Anvisa nem o programa Farmácia 
Popular. O RemédioCerto organiza o que está na sua receita: não indica remédio, dose nem horário e 
não substitui o médico nem o farmacêutico.
Nunca mais esqueça o remédio, e saiba onde retirar de graça os do Farmácia Popular.
LEMBRETE NA HORA CERTA
• Aviso no horário de cada remédio, todos os dias ou nos dias que você escolher
• Toque em "Tomei" ou "Adiar" na própria notificação, sem abrir o app
• No Android, crie também um alarme no Relógio do celular, com os dias já preenchidos, para tocar 
mesmo no silencioso
• Tela Hoje com as doses do dia e o que já foi tomado
• Histórico dos últimos 14 dias de cada remédio
CADASTRO FÁCIL
• Leia o código de barras da caixa: o app reconhece o remédio pela lista oficial de preços e preenche 
o nome
• Tire uma foto da caixa para reconhecer o remédio na hora de tomar
• Diga quantas vezes por dia e digite os horários como estão na receita
ESTOQUE E RECEITA
• Informe quantos comprimidos você tem: o app desconta a cada "Tomei"
• Aviso quando estiver acabando, com quantos dias ainda dá
• Lembrete antes de a receita vencer
FARMÁCIA POPULAR NA MÃO
• Leia o código de barras da caixa e saiba se o remédio faz parte do programa
• Farmácias participantes da sua cidade, com endereço, rota e busca por bairro
PRIVACIDADE
• Sem cadastro e sem login
• Seus remédios, horários e fotos ficam só no seu celular
• Anúncios sempre não personalizados
FONTES OFICIAIS
• Lista dos remédios, fraldas geriátricas e absorventes do programa, com busca por nome ou doença
• Localização opcional, só para achar a sua cidade (dá para escolher na lista)
O RemédioCerto é gratuito, com anúncios. Uma compra única remove os anúncios.
• Programa Farmácia Popular do Brasil (Ministério da Saúde): https://www.gov.br/saude/pt
br/composicao/sectics/farmacia-popular
• Lista de preços de medicamentos da CMED (Anvisa), usada para reconhecer a caixa: 
https://www.gov.br/anvisa/pt-br/assuntos/medicamentos/cmed/precos
AVISO
O RemédioCerto é um app independente, sem vínculo com o governo. As listas do programa e das 
farmácias participantes são as oficiais, conferidas toda semana, mas podem mudar: a farmácia confere 
a receita e o documento, e nem toda participante tem todos os itens. Confirme com a farmácia antes de 
ir. Siga sempre a orientação do seu médico.

name: Reza
description:
A oração é um momento de conexão, reflexão e fé. 
Com o Reza, você tem um espaço especial para viver esses momentos do seu jeito, no seu tempo e no seu ritmo.
Seja para acompanhar suas orações diárias, rezar um terço ou simplesmente reservar alguns minutos para estar em oração, o Reza está ao seu lado nessa caminhada.


Tenha suas orações favoritas sempre por perto - Cadastre, organize e personalize suas preces, criando uma coleção que acompanha sua jornada espiritual.
Você também pode gravar suas orações em áudio, tornando cada momento ainda mais especial.

TERÇOS PERSONALIZADOS

Crie seus próprios terços, escolhendo as preces, a sequência e as cores de cada conta.

Acompanhe sua oração conta por conta, no seu ritmo, com uma experiência simples e intuitiva, pensada para ajudar você a se concentrar no que realmente importa.

SUA CAMINHADA DE ORAÇÃO

Cada momento de oração faz parte de uma história.

Com o histórico do Reza, você pode acompanhar suas orações realizadas, revisitar seus momentos de fé e observar sua caminhada ao longo do tempo.

UM ESPAÇO FEITO PARA VOCÊ

Com uma interface acolhedora e sem distrações, o Reza foi pensado para tornar seus momentos de oração mais tranquilos, organizados e significativos.

Porque cada pessoa tem seu próprio jeito de rezar, e cada oração merece seu espaço.

PRIVACIDADE

Tudo fica no seu aparelho: sem conta, sem internet.

Reza - Seu parceiro de oração.

name: Richt Log
description:
RichtLog is je digitale schietlogboek. Voor schietsport, boogschieten en darts: houd je trainingen en wedstrijden bij en zie direct hoe je vooruitgaat.

SNEL EEN SESSIE VASTLEGGEN
• Eén tik op de grote knop en je begint
• Je laatste discipline, wapen en locatie staan al klaar
• Vul per serie je score in; het totaal rekent zichzelf uit
• Maak met de camera direct een foto van je schietkaart

JE OVERZICHT IN ÉÉN OOGOPSLAG
• Sessies, gemiddelde en schoten van dit jaar
• Je beste sessie en beste score per discipline
• Al je sessies en foto’s netjes per maand

WAPENS & MATERIAAL
• Houd je wapens, boog of darts bij, met notities
• Onderhoudslogboek: schoonmaak, controle, reparatie
• Herinneringen voor volgend onderhoud en keuring
• Zie hoeveel schoten je hebt gelost sinds de laatste schoonmaak

WERKT OOK ZONDER INTERNET
Geen bereik op de baan? Geen probleem. Je sessie wordt op je telefoon bewaard en automatisch verstuurd zodra je weer verbinding hebt.

NOG MEER
• Licht en donker thema
• Disciplines voor geweer, pistool, luchtbuks, kleiduiven, boogschieten en darts
• Synchroniseert met je account op richtlog.nl

Na het aanmaken van je account keurt een beheerder het goed. Je gegevens blijven van jou: je kunt je account en al je gegevens altijd in de app verwijderen.

name: Roadfable
description:
Drive past a castle, a burial mound or a viewpoint, and hear its story through your car speakers, automatically.

Roadfable is an audio guide for road trips in Denmark with more than 1,300 stories. The app knows where you are and plays the story of a place as it appears through the windscreen. Keep your eyes on the road and your ears in the story.

Please note: the app and its stories are in Danish.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open the map and see the sights around you
• Tap a place and listen to its story right away
• Plan your trip: choose where from, where to and how many hours you have, and get a route past the sights
• Drive. Stories start by themselves through the car speakers, even with the screen off

MADE FOR ROAD TRIPS
• Campsites, motorhome stops and nature sites as map layers
• EV chargers along the route
• Podcast mode for the long stretches
• Drive mode for use in the car
• Saves battery when you stop

FREE WHILE WE BUILD
Roadfable is free while we build it together with the first travellers. The map, the stories and the routes are open to everyone, and you can use the app without an account.

YOUR PRIVACY
The decision about which place you are approaching is made on your phone. Your route is not stored on our server. No ads and no tracking.

Write to hej@roadfable.app with bugs and ideas.

name: RollingCam
description:
RollingCam is a rewind camera. Tap record once and keep filming. Instead of filling your storage, it holds only the most recent window of video, from 30 seconds up to 5 minutes. When something happens, tap stop and that window is saved to your Photos, audio included.

How it works
• Choose how much to keep: 30 s, 1 min, 3 min or 5 min
• Front or back camera, 720p, 1080p or 4K, HEVC encoding
• Stop, lock the screen or leave the app and the buffer is saved automatically
• If the app is ever interrupted, the last buffer is recovered on next launch
• Optional privacy screen while recording

Private by design
Everything stays on your phone. RollingCam has no account, no analytics and no network access. Videos go straight to your photo library and nowhere else.

Good for
Kids and pets doing something you cannot predict, sports practice, driving, live music, or anything where you only know it was worth filming after it happened.

name: Roomino! - Brain Block Puzzle
description:
Fit every room into the house, and make every door meet a door.

Roomino is a calm block puzzle about floor plans. Drag the kitchen, the bedroom, the hall and the rest into the empty house. Each house has exactly one way to fit, and the doors tell you where everything goes. When the last room clicks into place, the whole house comes alive.

EASY TO START, SATISFYING TO MASTER
• Simple rules: rooms fill the house, doors meet doors, windows face outside.
• Every house has one solution: a true logic puzzle, where a clever guess is always rewarded.
• No time limits, no pressure. Play at your own pace.

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW TO BUILD
• 200 Adventure houses, from small cottages to big villas with gardens, garages and two floors.
• A new Daily House every day, with a monthly calendar and trophies.
• Classic mode: endless houses, with an optional challenge for experts.
• New twists along the way: padlock doors with keys, garden plots, upstairs and downstairs.

A BRAIN TEASER FOR EVERYONE
• Big, clear text and pieces, easy on the eyes.
• Gentle sounds and haptics. Undo and hints when you need them.
• Plays offline. Progress backs up to iCloud.
• In 46 languages.

If you like block puzzle games, floor plan puzzles or a daily brain teaser, Roomino is made for you.

Roomino is free to play, with ads between houses. A one-time purchase removes the ads for good and makes every hint free.

name: RVI Radio Control
description:
RVI Radio Control es la herramienta de los pastores, predicadores y colaboradores autorizados de Restaurando Vidas Internacional para transmitir en vivo por Radio Restaurando Vidas Internacional desde su propio iPhone.

• Vincule su iPhone con el código que le entrega el administrador.
• Solicite una transmisión indicando su nombre, el tema y la duración.
• Reciba un aviso cuando su solicitud sea autorizada, rechazada o revocada.
• Cuando el administrador le ceda el aire, transmita con el micrófono del iPhone o uno externo.
• Vea el nivel del micrófono, el tiempo transcurrido y el tiempo restante.
• La transmisión continúa con la pantalla bloqueada y se reconecta sola si la red se interrumpe.

Instalar la aplicación no permite transmitir. Cada teléfono debe ser vinculado y autorizado por el administrador de la emisora. Esta aplicación no es para escuchar la radio; está destinada únicamente a colaboradores autorizados.

name: SafelyMe
description:
SafelyMe helps you stay safe and keeps the people you trust in the loop.

- SOS alert: send your live location to your emergency contacts and family in one tap, with audio and video recording.
- Voice Trigger: start an alert hands-free with a phrase you choose (optional, you turn it on).
- Fake Call Timer: schedule an incoming call to help you leave an uncomfortable situation.
- Travel Safety: set a timer for your trip. If you do not confirm arrival, an alert goes out.
- Family Connection and Map: see family members who share their location with you.
- Check-In and Broadcast: send a quick message to your family or ask someone for a check-up.

Free to start. Premium and Family plans unlock more features and are billed through your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms: https://safelyme.net/#terms
Privacy: https://safelyme.net/#privacy

name: Sakkah - صكّة
description:
صكّة: مجلس الورق السعودي في جوالك.
بلوت وطرنيب بالقوانين اللي تعرفها، مع الربع أونلاين أو ضد الكمبيوتر بدون نت.

 البلوت
• صن وحكم وأشكل، والمشاريع (سرا، خمسين، مية، أربعمية)
• القيد: تقدر تقيّد الخصم إذا قطع وهو معه، والإثبات تلقائي
• اللعب المحدود أو المفتوح، بسرعات مختلفة

 الطرنيب
• شراكة اثنين ضد اثنين، مزايدة من ٧ إلى ١٣
• الجلسة إلى ٣١، وتقدر تختار ٤١ أو ٥١ أو ٦١ في جلساتك

أونلاين مع الربع
• لعب ودي: دوّر على لاعبين وابدأ على طول
• أنشئ جلستك الخاصة أو ادخل من قائمة الجلسات
• دردشة وتعابير تطلع جنب اللاعب
• مؤقت للدور، وإذا طلع أحد يكمّل الكمبيوتر مكانه عشان اللعب ما يوقف

الرانك
• ابدأ من رانك ١٠ واطلع لين رانك ١
• الفوز ورا الفوز يعطيك ستريك يمشيك أسرع
• الإيليت: نقاط وترتيب أفضل ١٠٠ لاعب

زيّن مجلسك
• طاولات وأشكال ورق وظهور ورق وجلسات
• حركات رمي وضربات قاضية تختم فيها الجولة
• الباتل باس: العب وافتح جوائز كل موسم

مجلس آمن
• تقدر تحظر أي لاعب أو تبلّغ عنه
• فلتر للكلام السيئ في الدردشة

اللعبة مجانية، وفيها مشتريات اختيارية للعملات والباتل باس. العملات للزينة بس وما تأثر على الفوز.
تركس وجاكارو جاية قريب!

name: Sancurec: Recargas a Cuba
description:
Sancurec te permite enviar recargas Cubacel a cualquier móvil en Cuba desde Estados Unidos. Eliges la recarga, escribes el número y pagas con tu tarjeta. La recarga llega directo al número de tu familia.

QUÉ PUEDES HACER
• Recargas de saldo Cubacel y combos de datos, minutos y SMS.
• Varias recargas al mismo número en un solo pago.
• Elige el número directo de tus contactos, o guarda los números de tu familia con su nombre y repite una recarga con un toque.
• Promociones oficiales de Cubacel con cuenta atrás. Algunas se pueden reservar antes de que empiecen y se envían solas cuando arranca la promoción.
• Sigue el estado de cada compra: pagada, enviando y entregada.
• Asistente virtual con inteligencia artificial que te ayuda a elegir la recarga y el número.
• Invita a tus amigos y gana crédito para tus próximas recargas.

PAGO SEGURO
• Pagas con tarjeta de crédito o débito en un formulario seguro de Authorize.Net. Sancurec nunca ve ni guarda los datos de tu tarjeta.
• Precio final en dólares (USD), sin cargos ocultos: lo ves en el resumen antes de pagar.
• Puedes abrir la app con Face ID.

QUIÉNES SOMOS
Sancurec es una empresa de telecomunicaciones registrada en Florida (SANCUREC LLC). Si una recarga no se puede entregar, te devolvemos el pago según nuestras condiciones de Reembolsos y Entrega digital.

Solo para números Cubacel de Cuba. Para mayores de 18 años.

name: Screenshot Rewind
description:
Albümünü seç. Tara. Önemli olanları ayır.

Screenshot Rewind, Fotoğraflar albümlerindeki önemli görüntüleri hızlıca bulup tek bir seçkide toplamana yardımcı olur.

1. ALBÜMÜNÜ SEÇ
Ekran Görüntüleri, WhatsApp veya erişebildiğin diğer Fotoğraflar albümlerini seç. Albüm adıyla ara. Videolar baştan elenir. Taramaya başla; sonraki açılışta Devam et ve Baştan tara ayrı eylemlerdir.

2. TARA VE SEÇ
Hızlı görünümde fotoğraflar tam ekranda akar. Parmağın değince görüntü donar ve yakın geçmiş bir deste olarak açılır. Aynı parmakla yatayda hedefini bul, aşağı çekip seç. Bırakınca akış doğrudan sürer. Basılı tutmak kendiliğinden seçim yapmaz.

Ayrıntılı görünümde bir fotoğrafın dört ayrıntısı ve bütünü görünür. Kısa bir dokunuş yalnızca o fotoğrafı seçer. Tek tek görünümde kendi hızında gezin, seç ve dokunup büyüterek oku.

Baştan, duraklat/devam et ve albüme dön kontrolleri doğrudan tarama ekranındadır. Baştan başlamak önceki seçimlerini silmez.

3. SEÇKİNİ SAKLA
Seçkim ekranında sonucunu gör. Seçtiklerimi Fotoğraflar’da favorile ile fotoğraflarını Apple Fotoğraflar favorilerine aktar. İstersen yalnızca seçtiklerini daha sakin bir ikinci turda daralt. Seçkiden çıkarmak orijinali silmez.

Silme listesi ayrıdır. Yalnızca açıkça işaretlediğin fotoğraflar, listeyi inceleyip onayladığında silinir. Karar vermeden geçenler kendiliğinden silinmez. Mevcut sistem favorileri varsayılan olarak korunur.

CİHAZINDA KALIR
Yalnızca cihazdan açılabilen fotoğraflar taranır. iCloud indirmesi veya ayrı bir hazırlık adımı yoktur. Açılamayanlar görülmüş sayılmaz ve silme listesine alınmaz. Hesap, reklam, abonelik, izleme veya analiz SDK’sı yok. Fotoğrafların sunucuya yüklenmez. Fotoğraflar’daki favori/silme değişiklikleri Apple iCloud Fotoğrafları ayarlarına göre diğer cihazlarına eşitlenebilir.

Fotoğraf izni vermeden, cihazda oluşturulan 1.000 örnekle de deneyebilirsin. iOS 17 ve üzeri iPhone’lar için.

name: Scroll the Quran - English
description:
Scroll the Quran instead of doomscrolling.

One ayah fills the screen. Swipe up for the next. The Arabic text sits above The Clear Quran® English translation by Dr. Mustafa Khattab, used with the publisher's permission.

DISCOVER
Ayahs from across the whole Quran in a shuffled order — a calm feed to open whenever you'd reach for social media. Every ayah has "Read in context" to see the verses around it.

IN ORDER
Read the Quran from beginning to end. The app remembers the exact ayah you stopped at.

JUMP ANYWHERE
Find any surah by name, meaning or number, or go straight to a verse like 2:255.

TODAY'S AYAH
A new ayah every day for everyone, in English on a Home Screen and Lock Screen widget, with an optional daily reminder at the time you choose.

SCIENCE & THE QURAN
Ten verses that many readers find strikingly close to what science discovered centuries later: the expanding universe, the stages of the embryo, the barrier between seas and more. Each one comes with an animated illustration, a timeline from revelation to discovery, the meaning of the key Arabic words, and its sources.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save the ayahs that move you and come back to them any time. Share a beautiful image of any ayah — with the Arabic, the translation and the credit — or share it as text.

LISTEN
Tap Listen to hear any ayah recited by Mishary Rashid Alafasy or Yasser Al-Dosari. Keep Playing moves to the next ayah and keeps reciting, even with your screen locked.

MADE FOR READING
• Uthmani Arabic text from the Tanzil Project, set in the Amiri Quran typeface
• Arabic & English, or English only
• Adjustable text size, dark and light themes
• Ayahs you've read stay available offline
• Long ayahs are never cut off
• Works with VoiceOver and large text sizes

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking.

Scroll the Quran is free and ad-free, made by an independent developer. Optional one-time support helps keep it that way.

name: SelecTenis
seller_name: SELECT US SOLUTIONS S A S
description:
SelecTenis brings everything about your tennis tournaments together, without spreadsheets or message chains.

FOR PLAYERS
- Find tournaments by city and category and register in seconds, singles or doubles.
- Upload your payment receipt and track your registration.
- See your draw, your next match with date, time and court, and your opponent.
- Live results, statistics, head to head and yearly ranking.
- Get draw, schedule and result updates in the app, by push notification or by email.
- Chat with the tournament organizers.

FOR LEAGUES AND ORGANIZERS
- Create tournaments with categories, rules, spots and entry fees.
- Approve registrations and review receipts.
- Make draws by groups or knockout, seeded by ranking.
- Schedule matches by court or by hand, and enter results from your phone.
- Post announcements with images and share them on WhatsApp.

SelecTenis is free for players. No ads.

A product by Select Us.

name: Selection Coffee
description:
سليكشن كوفي — تطبيق محمصة سليكشن للقهوة المختصة.

نختار أجود حبوب القهوة من مزارع حول العالم، ونحمّصها طازجة كل أسبوع لتصلك بأفضل نكهة.

ما يقدمه التطبيق:
• تصفّح القهوة المختصة حسب بلد المنشأ وطريقة المعالجة ودرجة التحميص
• مستشار القهوة: أجب على أسئلة بسيطة واحصل على ترشيحات تناسب ذوقك
• أدوات وإكسسوارات التحضير: مقطرات، مطاحن، موازين، فلاتر والمزيد
• سلة وطلب سريع مع عناوين محفوظة
• تتبّع حالة طلبك خطوة بخطوة، من التأكيد إلى التحميص والشحن
• إشعارات فورية بتحديثات الطلب
• نقاط ولاء وكوبونات خصم
• تسجيل دخول سريع بحساب Apple
• طلبات الجملة للمقاهي والشركات
• واجهة عربية وإنجليزية كاملة

الشحن متاح داخل المملكة العربية السعودية والإمارات العربية المتحدة.

سليكشن… قهوتك بعناية.

name: Septic Survivor
description:
The phone rings. Somebody's toilet is backing up, the house is filling up, and the septic lid is buried somewhere out in the yard.

You're the pumper.

FIND THE LID
Probe the yard for hot and cold readings while the windows fill up. Watch out for fire ant beds, snakes in the tall grass, and the neighbor's dog. Some dogs want a treat. Some want your ankle.

PUMP THE TANK
Break the crust, work the hose, and suck out the sludge. Keep the junk out of the line. Toys, cans, rocks, and the occasional surprise will clog your hose and cost you at the dump. Every once in a while you'll find something worth keeping.

TALK TO THE CUSTOMER
While you pump, the homeowner wanders over with questions. "Can fish live in my septic tank?" Pick the right answer and you might get a tip.

EARN YOUR STARS
Meet the profit goal and earn a tip for 3 stars. Keep junk out of the hose and avoid hazard penalties as well to earn a Perfect Call.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS
Start with a 1,000-gallon truck and a beat-up shovel. Upgrade your probe, your shovel, and your truck. Get your CDL for the big rigs, hire a helper, and take on county contracts.

MAKE IT YOURS
Build your own pumper tech, paint your truck, pick a hard hat, and name your company.

KEEP COMING BACK
- Daily Call: the same yard for everyone, every day
- Work streaks, ranks, and 18 badges
- Weekly county contracts
- Emergency calls, grease traps, two-compartment tanks, rain, and night calls

FIRST 5 CALLS FREE
Play your first 5 calls free. Unlock the full game once for endless calls and a career that saves. No ads. No subscriptions. Your career and best scores stay on your device.

Made in Longview, Texas. A MySeptic101 game.

name: Shark Match
description:
Shark Match is a calm, pocket-sized memory game. Flip two cards, find the pair, clear the board.

Choose your depth:
• Easy: 4 × 4, 8 pairs
• Medium: 6 × 6, 18 pairs
• Hard: 10 × 10, 50 pairs
• Expert: 20 × 20, 200 pairs
• Shark: 30 × 30, 450 pairs
• Custom: any grid from 2 to 30 rows and columns

Pinch, pan and double-tap to move around the big boards. Your best time and fewest moves are saved for each depth. Pause whenever you like; the cards stay hidden while you're away.

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no internet needed. Everything stays on your device.

name: Shipo: Delivery Rush 3D
description:
Shipo: Delivery Rush 3D puts you on a scooter in the middle of a living 3D city. Take orders on your phone, pick up hot meals, weave through traffic and deliver to hungry customers before the timer runs out. Quick hands and smart routes earn big tips and five-star ratings!

DELIVER, DODGE, DASH
• Accept orders on your in-game phone, ride to the restaurant, then to the customer
• Obey the streets: one-way roads, narrow alleys and heavy traffic keep every shift exciting
• Beat the deadline for bonus tips and collect star ratings from customers
• Mind your fuel and repair costs: crashes cost money, smooth riding pays
• Ride in a top-down view or switch to a first-person cockpit view with phone mount and mirrors

CITY MAPS TO MASTER
Start on easy two-way roads and work up to the toughest streets, from Starter Street and Morning Market to Night Market, Old Quarter Maze and Festival Street, and more. Every map has its own traffic, crowds and delivery distances, plus weather events like rain.

UPGRADE YOUR RIDE
• Shop for scooters, phones, phone mounts and delivery boxes that boost your stats
• Dress your rider with outfits and helmets, add accessories and unlock new maps
• Grab handy consumables to get through tough shifts

KEEP LEVELING UP
• Earn XP and rise through endless rider levels
• Complete daily missions and claim 7-day check-in streak rewards
• Unlock achievements
• Climb the daily, weekly, monthly and all-time leaderboards

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No sign-up needed: start riding as a guest in seconds
• Available in 40 languages
• Watch an optional video for free coins, or go Premium to remove ads
• Internet connection required

Download Shipo: Delivery Rush 3D now, jump on your scooter and become the fastest rider in town!

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://shipo.tnpixel.com/privacy/

name: Sketch Guess: Draw & Guess
description:
Draw the word, your friends guess it. Simple, silly, and fun for everyone.

• Pass & Play — one phone, take turns. Draw for 60 seconds, hand it over, and watch the drawing replay before picking from 4 choices
• Send to a Friend — share your drawing as a link; friends guess on the web, no app needed
• Face to Face (iPhone Duo) — unfold it on the table: what you draw on your half appears live on theirs. Roles swap every round
• 220+ words in animals, food, things, places and actions (English & Korean)
• 8 pen colors, 3 brush sizes, eraser, undo

20 free drawings a day, watch an ad for 5 more. A one-time coffee purchase removes ads and unlocks unlimited drawing forever. Sending to friends is always unlimited.

name: Slow Bonsai
description:
Bonsai is the art of keeping a tree small and beautiful for years. Slow Bonsai lets you practise it in a few quiet minutes a day.

Your tree grows a little every day — even while the app is closed — and follows the real seasons where you live. Trim the pale new shoots before they harden, wire branches into a more graceful line, and water the soil when it looks pale. There is no score, no streak and no rush. Nothing you do is ever wrong, and nothing in your garden ever dies.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Watch your tree bud, leaf out, colour and rest through spring, summer, autumn and winter
• Trim new growth and wire branches to shape its silhouette over months and years
• Water, feed and repot as the seasons ask
• Keep up to three trees in your garden, each with its own name and history
• Take photographs of your tree and share or save them

CHOOSE YOUR SPECIES
Start with a Japanese Black Pine or Japanese Maple, each arriving in its own hand-glazed pot.

BONSAI PATRON
A single optional purchase adds six more species — Shimpaku Juniper, Chinese Elm, Japanese White Pine, Trident Maple, Satsuki Azalea and European Olive — two more glazed pots, and room for as many trees as you like. Everything you need to grow a tree well is free; Patron is there for anyone who wants a little more, once.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Slow Bonsai works entirely on your iPhone. No accounts, no ads, no analytics and no third-party trackers — your garden never leaves your device unless you choose to share a photo.

A small tree, cared for slowly.

name: Sodefjed
description:
Vær, vind og temperatur fra værstasjonen på Sodefjed hytteområde ved Kristiansand – direkte på telefonen.

• Oversikt: vindhastighet, vindkast og retning, samt land- og sjøtemperatur, live fra målestasjonen.
• Historikk: vind og temperaturer time for time, med Yr-prognose lagt oppå.
• Varsel: time- og døgnvarsel fra Yr, inkludert sjøtemperatur og bølgehøyde.
• Spør: still spørsmål om været og om reglene i området, og få svar fra en AI-assistent.
• Widget: se vinden på hjemskjermen og låseskjermen.

Ingen innlogging og ingen sporing. Appen er laget av SENDIT AS for hytteeierne på Sodefjed.

name: SongSet: Worship Song Chords
description:
SongSet keeps your worship team's song charts together on every iPad and iPhone. Words, chords, keys and markings stay the same for everyone, with or without internet.

START OR JOIN A TEAM
One person starts the team. Everyone else joins with a 6-letter code, a QR code or a link. There are no accounts to make: SongSet uses the iCloud account already on the device. Each screen picks a role: Singer, Band or Leader. Singers see the words, the band sees the chords.

ADD YOUR SONGS
• Paste a link to a web page with the words and chords
• Paste the words, with or without chords
• Take a photo of a song sheet or a page in a book. The text is read on the device.
• Bring a library over from OnSong or ChordPro files

CHANGE THE KEY
Tap the key to move it up or down. The chords move with it. Guitar players can set a capo for their own screen.

MARK IT UP
Draw, highlight and mark how many times to sing a part. Choose who sees it: only this screen, the band, or everyone.

PLAN AND LEAD THE SERVICE
Put the songs in order and pick each song's key for the day. When the leader moves to the next song, every screen in the room follows over the local Wi-Fi.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no data collected. Your songs live on your devices and in your own iCloud.

SongSet does not include songs. Add only songs your church has the right to use, for example with a CCLI license.

name: Spinlets: Spider Puzzle
description:
Spinlets is a color matching puzzle played with cute clay spiders. Every level greets you with a new handmade clay picture; then the picture turns into pixels and gets wrapped in silk shells. Send the spiders in the right order, collect the pixels one by one and leave the board spotless.

How to play
• Spiders wait in their cocoons in the sacs at the bottom. Tap a sac and the spider at the front lands on a free leaf of the branch.
• Each spider only eats pixels of its own color. Send a spider whose color is showing, and the rest follows.
• The branch has only so many leaves: send spiders whose color is not showing yet and the leaves fill up. Think about the order and build chains.
• Black and gray shells hide the colors underneath. Crack the shell and watch the colors come out.

A new picture every level
Teddy bears, flowers, fruit, birds, bugs... Every picture you finish goes into your Cocoon Album.

Over 200 levels
It starts easy and slowly gets harder. New obstacles wait along the way: dew drops, pebbles, shy mimosas, buds, yarn balls, mist, sleepy spiders, fireflies, frost and silk bonds.

A boss every 10 levels
The Cocoon Caterpillar spits silk back onto the board, the Storm Cloud curls up your leaves, the Bug King puts sacs to sleep and the Tumbling Hedgehog flips the tray. Each of the 10 bosses changes the level with a trick of its own.

Boosters
When you get stuck, four boosters come to the rescue: the Golden Silk Spider, the Fresh Leaf, the Sac Swap and the Silk Comb. Each one gets a free try in the level where it unlocks.

Your buddy
Pick the spider that travels the map with you and change its color. When you win, the spiders jump for joy and celebrate with you.

Purchases and ads
• The game is free to play. Gold jars, a Starter Pack and a No Ads pack are sold in the game. The Starter Pack and No Ads are one-time purchases. Pack contents are fixed; there are no random boxes.
• Rewarded ads play only when you choose to watch one.
• After level 20 an ad may show between levels now and then. No ad shows after a level you lost. With the No Ads pack there are no ads between levels, and rewards come without watching an ad.

Account and languages
No account and no sign-in. Your progress is saved on your phone and, with iCloud on, in your own iCloud, so you can carry on on a new iPhone. Play in English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, German or French.

Tap a cocoon and send your first spider. The picture is waiting!

name: Splat Atlas: 3D Viewer
description:
Keep your 3D models in a library of your own.

Splat Atlas is a native model viewer for iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Mac. Browse a familiar thumbnail gallery, find files with search, save favorites and explore details with touch or a mouse.

• Gaussian splats and point clouds: PLY, SPLAT and KSPLAT.
• Static meshes: OBJ, FBX, glTF / GLB, STL, DAE, 3DS, OFF and USD-family formats, including USDZ.
• Import files or folders to create independent copies of models and the companion materials and textures you select. View imported copies offline.
• Search names and formats, and return to favorites and recently viewed models.
• Select multiple models to delete or recover. Recently Deleted retains models for 30 days, with an option to permanently delete sooner. Expired items are cleaned up while the app runs or the next time it opens.
• Adjust orientation, quality, backgrounds and mesh display. Save screenshots and share through the system share sheet.
• Follow your system language or choose Simplified Chinese or English in Settings.

No app account, ads, tracking or developer analytics. Models and viewing preferences are processed on your device. Sharing and exporting happen only when you initiate them.

Include OBJ material files, glTF binary buffers and external textures when importing, preserving their relative paths. This version displays static models; skeleton and animation playback and Draco compression are not supported. Complex materials may look different from the authoring tool. Large-model performance depends on available memory and GPU capability.

Requires iOS / iPadOS 26 or later, or Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or later.

name: Sponge: Read Later
description:
Sponge keeps the articles you mean to read in one calm library, and puts it on your phone and tablet.

SAVE FROM ANY APP
Tap Share, then Sponge, in your browser, Mail, News or any app with a share sheet. Saves made offline wait and send when you're back.

READ WITHOUT DISTRACTION
A clean reader with an outline, reading progress and a warm dark theme. Your library is kept on the device, so it opens at once and reads offline.

SUMMARIES FROM YOUR OWN COMPUTER
Articles carry a short summary, drafted on your computer by models that run there. Nothing you save is sent to an AI service.

HIGHLIGHT AND TAKE NOTES
Select text to highlight it or add a note. The notebook gathers every highlight and exports Markdown.

SEE WHAT YOUR LIBRARY IS ABOUT
The library map groups the ideas in what you've read into named concepts.

INBOX, LATER, ARCHIVE
File, star and search everything you've saved, with the same reading state on every device.

HOW IT WORKS
Sponge captures pages on your own computer with the free sponge command, and syncs their text to your library. Links you save on your phone wait in a queue until your computer captures them.

PLANS
Sponge Cloud is free for 100 saved articles. Sponge Plus removes the limit for $4.99 a month. It renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

No ads, analytics or tracking.
Privacy Policy: https://sponge.computer/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Squiggle Tunes - Music Game
description:
Draw a line. Hear a tune. Make something that's yours. Play music theory. 

Squiggle Tunes turns your drawings into music. Choose an instrument and draw a picture. As the playhead travels across the paper, your lines become notes. Higher lines play higher notes. Every instrument brings a different sound.

MAKE A SQUIGGLE TUNE
Draw anything you like with 12 instruments, from keys and bells to strings and 8-bit sounds. Try different speeds, add bass or drums, and hear your picture change. Pinch to zoom in for the little details.

FINISH THE PICTURE
Start with a cloud, jellyfish, cup, two eyes, a swirl or a zigzag. Draw the rest your way. There is no single right answer.

PLAY SOUND DETECTIVE
Listen to a tune and find its picture. Use your own drawings, our hand-drawn library, or a mix. Explore eight levels with changes in instrument, pitch and speed.

KEEP AND SHARE
Save your drawings and come back to them. Record your screen with the app's music or share a drawing video with the iOS share sheet.

SIMPLE WHEN YOU WANT IT
Switch between Kid mode for fewer controls and Grown-up mode for more musical settings. No music experience required.

TRY THREE DRAWINGS FREE
Your first three drawings are free. You can keep opening, playing and editing them. To create more, choose monthly access or a one-time lifetime unlock. Both include the full drawing tools. No account is required to draw.

Monthly access is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple account on confirmation. It renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple account settings. The lifetime option is a one-time purchase and does not renew. Prices are displayed in the app for your region.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://squiggletunes.com/privacy/

name: Staymeter: Schengen Calculator
description:
No subscription. No account. No ads.

How many Schengen days do I have left? Will my next trip push me over? Am I getting close to 183 days somewhere? Staymeter answers all three from the stays you enter.

Made for people who spend months abroad, not weeks: digital nomads, expats, remote workers, second-home owners in France, Spain or Portugal, and anyone who winters in the south of Europe.

TODAY, AT A GLANCE
• Schengen days left in your rolling 180-day window
• The date the window counts from
• The next date an old day drops off and frees up
• Days in each country this calendar year, each with a bar toward 183

CAN I GO?
Pick a destination and dates. Staymeter checks the trip against every stay you've entered, past and already planned.
For a Schengen destination, you get a clear answer:
• Yes, with the Schengen days you'll still have when you leave
• Or no, with the day you'd go over the limit, the latest date you could leave if you arrive as planned, and the first date the same trip becomes possible (searched up to a year ahead, for trips of 90 days or less)
A trip that fits on its own but breaks a trip you've already planned later is flagged too.
For any destination, inside or outside Schengen, you see how many days you'd reach in that country that year and how far you are from 183.
Happy with the answer? Add the trip to your stays in one tap.

HOW STAYMETER COUNTS
• A stay runs from its first to its last day, both included
• Schengen: every day in the last 180 counts, and old days leave the window one at a time, never a whole trip at once
• Overlapping stays count once
• The 29 Schengen countries, including Bulgaria and Romania. Ireland and Cyprus are not counted as Schengen.
• Tax days: counted per country per calendar year, and a travel day counts for both countries
The Today screen shows when your window starts and how many days are used, so you can check the math yourself.

YOUR STAYS
• Add a stay in seconds: country, first day, last day, optional note
• Every ISO country and territory, from Eswatini to Singapore, the UAE and Puerto Rico
• Search the list, with your recent countries on top and Schengen countries labeled
• Tap a stay to edit it, swipe to delete it, at any time
• Stays grouped by year, with the length of each one

COMING FROM ANOTHER APP?
Import a CSV file from a spreadsheet or another day-tracker app. It needs a country column and first and last day columns, in any order. Comma, semicolon or tab separated, countries as codes or names, common date formats. Exact duplicates are skipped. Export all your stays to CSV whenever you like.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up, no login. Your stays are stored only on your iPhone. No location tracking: you enter your stays yourself, so nothing runs in the background.

ONE-TIME PRICING
Staymeter is free to download. Your stays, the Today screen, editing, import, export and your first trip check are all free. For unlimited trip checks, unlock Staymeter Pro with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Staymeter covers the Schengen 90/180 short-stay rule and a 183-day count per calendar year. It does not cover other visa rules.
• The 90/180 rule applies to short stays. If you hold a residence permit or a long-stay visa for a Schengen country, your situation is different.
• Tax residency depends on each country's own rules and tax year, not only on 183 days. Some tax years don't follow the calendar year.
• Staymeter is not affiliated with the European Union or any government.
• Staymeter is a planning aid, not legal or tax advice. Official rules and border records always prevail.

Languages: English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Português (Brasil), Nederlands

name: Step Atlas: Pedometer
description:
Step Atlas is a pedometer that reads your steps and walking distance from Apple Health and turns them into a journey: an illustrated atlas of seven coastal landscapes, the Morning Isles, that unlock as your steps add up. Everything stays on your iPhone, and there is no account to create.

Step Atlas Premium (subscription) is required for the full statistics and the atlas, with a free trial of 3 days on the weekly plan. Without a subscription you keep today's steps, your 30-day history and the first landscape.

Today at a glance
• Steps and walking distance from Apple Health (read-only)
• A daily goal you can adjust, and a streak of days when you reach it
• An optional profile (sex, age, height, weight): your height is used to estimate the distance when Apple Health has none, and to estimate active calories and equivalent minutes of walking

Statistics
• Your 30-day average placed on the reference zone found in large studies for your age: 6,000 to 8,000 steps a day after 60, 8,000 to 10,000 before
• A 30-day chart with your goal line
• A summary of your week
• "What the studies say" cards, each with its source
Examples: in an analysis of 15 cohorts (Paluch et al., Lancet Public Health 2022), the benefits levelled off around 6,000 to 8,000 steps a day for people aged 60 and over, and 8,000 to 10,000 for younger adults. In an analysis of 17 cohorts (Banach et al., European Journal of Preventive Cardiology 2023), each extra 1,000 steps a day was associated with a lower risk of death from any cause. Other cards cite Ding et al. (Lancet Public Health 2025) and Veerman et al. (British Journal of Sports Medicine 2025). These are associations observed in groups of people, not a prediction for you.

The atlas
Seven illustrated coastal landscapes, the Morning Isles, unlock as your cumulative steps add up: 42,000 steps in all, at your own pace. They are illustrations to collect, not a real map: no GPS, no route tracking.

Your privacy
Step Atlas only reads your steps and distance in Apple Health, with your permission. Your data stays on your iPhone. There is no account, and nothing is sent to us.

Subscription
Step Atlas Premium is available weekly, with a free trial of 3 days, or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://romeoapps.app/en/step-atlas/privacy/

Step Atlas is not a medical device; the reference points cited are associations observed in studies.

name: StickMotion: Stickman Animator
description:
Make stop-motion animations one frame at a time.
Draw with the pen, move with your finger, both at once, with no mode switching.

DRAW AND POSE TOGETHER
- Draw with Apple Pencil or a pen while your finger rotates the stickman's joints.
- Drag a hand and the elbow follows. Pin joints to hold them in place.
- Hats, swords and hair you draw snap to the nearest joint and move with it.
- Bring your own drawings to life: tap Add joint and drop red joints on them, or add a black move point to slide the whole drawing.

ONE-TAP EFFECT STICKERS
- About 40 effects: explosions, lightning, fire, dust, speed lines, shockwaves, sword slashes, sweat drops, hearts and more.
- Animated stickers fill as many frames as they need, automatically.

CHARACTER BOX
- Save a character with its poses and moves, then reuse it in any animation.
- 8 starter characters and ready poses: walk, run, jump, punch, kick.
- Export characters as files to share between devices.

ANIMATION TOOLS
- Onion skin (previous frame in blue, next in green), duplicate frames, auto in-betweens
- 3 layers, undo, text and speech bubbles, camera pan and zoom, photo backgrounds, sound effects
- 4 to 24 frames per second

SAVE AND SHARE
- Export MP4 video or GIF with an optional transparent background. No watermark.
- Every stroke is saved automatically, so closing the app never loses your work.

THEMES
- Light Table, Chalkboard, Neon and Manga Paper themes plus dark mode, each with its own animated stickman.

Home and Lock Screen widgets take you straight back to your latest animation, plus a new Pose of the Day every day.

Every feature is free. The app shows a banner ad at the top. Effect stickers apply instantly 4 times; from the 5th use, an ad plays first.

name: String Theory – City Swing
description:
Stringy the string cheese has places to be, and the fastest way there is over the city.

Hold the left or right side of the screen and Stringy's string arm grabs the nearest building. Let go to fling into the next swing. Switch sides, find your rhythm, and don't kiss the buildings.

• One-thumb controls: hold to grab, release to fly
• An endless city that gets trickier the farther you go
• Collect crackers and chain clean swings for bonus points
• Power-ups: pizza saves you from one crash, ice slows time, butter speeds you up and doubles your score
• Close calls, big swings and side-switch combos all add to your score
• Your best score, best distance and cracker total are saved on your device

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no internet needed.

name: Studio Legale Pasinelli
Sun And Moon Phases
description:
The sky is always moving. Now you can explore every moment.

Sun And Moon Phases is an immersive astronomy app that brings the movement of the Sun and Moon to life. Track their positions in real time, explore daily trajectories, and discover the details behind every sunrise, sunset, and lunar phase.

What makes Sun And Moon Phases so special?

• Interactive 3D sky with precise Sun and Moon trajectories throughout the day. • Real-time compass showing the direction and position of each celestial body. • Immersive AR mode that projects celestial paths directly onto the sky around you. • Detailed lunar phases with illumination, distance, age, and upcoming full and new moons. • Complete solar data, including sunrise, sunset, golden hour, blue hour, and astronomical twilight. • Solstices, equinoxes, celestial coordinates, and astronomical events. • Interactive date and time controls to explore the sky at any moment. • Map and satellite views to connect celestial positions with your location. • Personalized location search and support for 12/24-hour time formats. • Beautiful dynamic skies that transition from night to dawn, golden hour, and daylight.

Whether you're watching the first light of sunrise, tracking the Moon across the night sky, or exploring upcoming lunar phases, Sun And Moon Phases makes astronomy feel closer than ever.

Look up. Explore the sky. Discover the rhythm of the universe.

name: Tack - Task Management
description:
Tack is a simple task manager for iPhone. Projects hold your tasks, everything else lands in the Inbox, and getting a new task in takes about a second, from almost anywhere.

ADD A TASK BEFORE YOU FORGET IT
• Quick Add widget: one tap on your Home Screen or Lock Screen opens Tack with the keyboard already up. The medium widget has tiles that file the task straight into a project.
• Siri and the Action Button: say "Add a task in Tack", or set the Action Button to Add Task. Type or say it and it's saved, without opening the app.
• Control Center: add the New Task control (iOS 18).
• In the app, the + button is on every screen, and Return saves the task and keeps the keyboard up, so you can type a whole list in one go.

TYPE IT ALL IN ONE LINE
"Call the plumber #house @tomorrow !" files the task in your House project, makes it due tomorrow and flags it. Use @today, @tomorrow or a weekday like @fri.

PROJECTS AND SMART LISTS
• Give each project a colour and an icon, and watch its progress ring fill up.
• Inbox, Today, Upcoming and Flagged gather what matters. Today includes anything overdue.
• Paste a list into a new project and every line becomes a task.
• Turn an Inbox task into a project when it turns out to be bigger than it looked.
• Duplicate a project to reuse it as a checklist. Every task starts fresh, ready to tick off again.

TICK THINGS OFF
• Tap the circle to complete a task. Tapped the wrong one? Tap Undo.
• Check off tasks right from the Tasks widget on your Home Screen. Choose Today, Flagged, Inbox, Upcoming or any project.
• Swipe to flag, push to tomorrow or delete.
• Select several tasks to move them into a project (or a new one), set a due date, flag, complete or delete them together.
• Reminders at a time you choose. Overdue tasks turn red.

YOUR DATA, YOUR WAY
• Export a backup and import it on another iPhone, or keep it in Files.
• Export every task to a spreadsheet for Numbers, Excel or Google Sheets.
• Search every task, in every project.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your tasks stay on your iPhone unless you choose to export them.

name: Tahtimahti
description:
Tama sovellus on vuoropohjainen fantasiaroolipeli, jossa tutkitaan suurta tahtikarttaa, kehitetaan hahmoa ja edetaan tarinassa vaihe vaiheelta.

Tutkiminen tapahtuu laajalla kartalla, jota voi lahentaa ja siirtaa eleilla. Hahmo liikkuu kartalla solmusta toiseen. Jokainen solmu sisaltaa oman haasteensa. Kartta on suunniteltu selkeaksi myos pienella naytolla, ja tarkeat kohteet erottuvat vareilla ja muodoilla.

Taistelu on vuoropohjainen ja esitetaan vinosta kuvakulmasta. Pelaajan hahmo on nakyman toisella puolella ja vastustajat toisella puolella. Kaytossa ovat tavallinen hyokkays, useat erilliset taidot, puolustus ja kohteen valinta. Jokaisella taidolla on oma visuaalinen esityksensa ja oma vaikutuksensa. Vuorojarjestys, osumapisteet ja energia nakyvat koko ajan, joten valintoja voi suunnitella rauhassa.

Hahmon kehitys perustuu ominaisuuksiin, kokemukseen ja tasoihin. Taisteluista ja tarinan lukemisesta saa kokemusta. Tason noustessa ominaisuudet paranevat ja uusia taitoja avautuu kayttoon. Ominaisuusnakymassa nakyvat taso, kokemuspalkki seka hyokkays, puolustus, nopeus ja muut arvot.

Tarinajarjestelma on visuaalinen kertomus luvuittain. Dialogi etenee rivi rivilla, puhujat erottuvat selkeasti ja aiemmat vuorosanat voi tarkistaa lokista. Tarina ja taistelut taydentavat toisiaan. Tarinan edistyminen avaa uusia kartan alueita ja uusia haasteita.

Sisallon avautuminen on porrastettu. Alussa on kaytossa rajattu alue ja pieni maara toimintoja. Kun suoritat haasteita ja luet lukuja loppuun, seuraavat solmut, taidot ja tarinaluvut avautuvat jarjestyksessa. Aiemmin avattuja osioita voi pelata uudelleen. Edistyminen tallentuu laitteeseen automaattisesti, ja pelia pelataan yksin omaan tahtiin ilman aikarajaa.

name: TakeCam
description:
TakeCam turns your iPhone into a camera that records on its own while you work.

Choose when the first video starts, how long each one lasts and the interval between them. Then just tap Start: TakeCam records one video after another, without you touching the iPhone. Ideal for documenting a construction job, a craft project, a class or a rehearsal.

SCHEDULED RECORDING
• Adjustable first video, length and interval
• The torch blinks three times before each video, so you know it’s about to record
• Optional sound alert at the start and end of each video
• The screen can dim on its own to save battery

THE IMAGE YOUR WAY
• 0.5x, 1x and 2x lenses, up to 4K, at the frame rate you prefer
• Adjustable exposure, focus and exposure locked with a tap
• Framing guides over the image

VIEWER ON YOUR MAC
• Watch the live image in your Mac’s browser, on the same Wi-Fi network
• Start, stop, switch lenses and focus with a click
• Protected by a 6-digit code; nothing leaves your network

YOUR VIDEOS, ORGANIZED
• Each session gets its own album in the Photos app, or goes to a folder on an external SSD
• All your videos are also kept together in the “TakeCam – All Recordings” album
• Alerts for low space, low battery and a hot iPhone
• Videos from an interrupted session are recovered the next time you open the app

PRIVACY
TakeCam has no account, no ads and no tracking, and sends nothing to the internet. Your videos stay on your iPhone.

GOOD TO KNOW
TakeCam must stay open and in front while recording: locking the iPhone or switching apps ends the session (the video in progress is saved). A phone call only pauses recording, which continues when the camera is back. For long sessions, use Guided Access and Do Not Disturb, and keep the iPhone plugged in. Requires iOS 26 or later.

When recording people, let them know and follow the law in your country on consent.

name: Tempo Scheduling
description:
Tempo is how your club runs its lessons. Book private and semi-private lessons with your coaches, join group classes, and register for tournaments and clinics, all from one app.

For families
• See every coach's open times and book in a few taps, one-time or every week
• Change, skip or cancel a weekly lesson, within your club's rules
• Pay for lessons, classes, memberships and club gear securely
• One schedule for all your children, with reminders before every lesson
• Message coaches and other families, and follow your club's posts
• Tournament Live: see where your fencer is, which strip and when

For coaches and clubs
• Set your hours once; Tempo shows only the times you're free
• Requests, cancellations and time off with your club's approval rules
• Monthly invoices, credits and payouts handled for you
• Notifications for every booking and change

Tempo is for in-person lessons, classes and events at your club. Ask your club for its Tempo link, or try the demo club from the sign-in screen.

name: Tensette: Blood Pressure Log
description:
Write down the readings from your blood pressure monitor in seconds, see your morning and evening averages, and bring a clear PDF to your doctor. A subscription is required.

Tensette is a blood pressure diary. It does not take any measurement: you type in the readings from your own upper-arm monitor, or import them from Apple Health.

What you get
• Quick entry of systolic, diastolic and pulse, morning and evening
• Averages and charts by day, week and month
• A PDF to show your doctor, for the period you choose
• Reminders for the measuring routine your doctor gave you
• Apple Health integration (HealthKit)
• Published reference ranges, with their sources and dates

Important
This log helps you record and look back at your readings. It does not diagnose, does not replace medical advice, and does not tell you whether your blood pressure is good or bad for you. Talk to your doctor about your readings and never change a treatment without their approval.
If you have chest pain, trouble speaking, weakness on one side of the body or a sudden severe headache, call emergency services right away.

Subscription
A weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase, is required to use the app. The weekly plan starts with a 3-day trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (Apple) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy : https://romeoapps.app/tensette/confidentialite

name: tepro: Teleprompter for Video
description:
Speak naturally. Just read along.

tepro is the teleprompter for creators. Paste your script, turn on the selfie camera and record – the text scrolls at your pace, right next to the lens. No more blanking, no more endless retakes.

Made for Reels, Shorts, vlogs, YouTube videos, LinkedIn posts, podcasts, pitches and presentations.

RECORD WHILE YOU READ
• The front camera runs behind your script
