name: ProbeLab
description:
Probe Lab is a pocket digital-security lab. It shows what is really going on in your network and around you, and explains what it finds in plain words.

NETWORK
• Every device on your Wi-Fi: name, maker, model, open ports and when it first appeared.
• Open ports rated by risk: Telnet, router admin pages without encryption, open shares, remote access.
• Ports your router forwards over UPnP: which devices the internet can reach.
• A notification when a new device joins; label your own devices and mark them trusted.

BLUETOOTH
• Bluetooth Low Energy devices around you, with signal strength and its history.
• Tile, Samsung SmartTag, Chipolo and Find My Device tags, with a warning when a tag away from its owner stays near you.
• GATT services and characteristics, with standard values decoded.

LINKS AND QR CODES
• Phishing checks run on the iPhone, including from the Share menu in Mail, Safari and Messages.
• The site's certificate and the domain's age: a days-old domain is a common sign of a scam.
• Redirects expanded without opening the page; QR codes read with the camera or from a photo.

CONNECTION
• Internet, gateway, DNS, public address and provider.
• Signs of HTTPS interception by a proxy or antivirus, and who really answers your DNS lookups.
• A traceroute from the phone and paths toward you from other countries; which countries' sites open.
• Which of your router's ports the internet can see.
• A full speed test: download, upload, latency under load and a bufferbloat grade, against Cloudflare or a Measurement Lab server you pick.

PRIVACY
No accounts, ads or analytics. Results stay on your iPhone. The services contacted during checks are listed in the privacy policy and on the About screen.

iOS limits: the app hears Bluetooth Low Energy advertisements only, and iOS withholds Apple's data in them, so AirTags are not recognised — iOS itself warns you about an AirTag that is not yours. The device scan works on networks with IPv4.

name: SchakelKern
description:
SchakelKern brengt berekeningen, ontwerpvergelijkingen en labnotities voor schakelende voedingen samen. Voor engineers die hun invoer, aannames en meetresultaten per project en printrevisie willen vastleggen.

• **Twintig hulpmiddelen voor voedingsontwerp.** Werk aan Buck-, Boost-, Buck-Boost-, SEPIC- en POL-ontwerpen. Onderzoek onder meer regelkringcompensatie, spoelrimpel, MOSFET-verliezen, rendement, softstart, ingangfilters en spanningsdips bij belastingssprongen.

• **Volg elke berekening.** Voer componentparameters in en bekijk formules, eenheden, ingevulde waarden en modelaannames naast het resultaat. Ontbrekende gegevens, ongeldige invoer en overschreden grenzen worden duidelijk aangegeven.

• **Vergelijk ontwerpvarianten.** Varieer ingangsspanning, belasting of componentwaarden en bekijk curves en tabellen. Bewaar benoemde momentopnamen met de gebruikte formuleversie en zie welke parameters tussen revisies zijn gewijzigd.

• **Documenteer je metingen.** Leg regelkringmetingen, belastingssprongen, rendement en temperatuurpunten vast met instrumentinstellingen, belasting en omgeving. Voeg golfvormen, Bode-diagrammen, warmtebeelden en reviewnotities toe.

• **Orden meerdere voedingsrails.** Registreer afhankelijkheden, vertragingen en voorwaarden voor in- en uitschakelen. Spoor kringverwijzingen op en bewaar de volgordetabel bij je project.

SchakelKern werkt offline en bewaart projecten, berekeningen en bijlagen lokaal op je apparaat. Raadpleeg formule-uitleg en codevoorbeelden, stel herinneringen voor nieuwe metingen in en exporteer gegevens als CSV. Bekijk vooraf welke projectnamen, onderdeelnummers en andere ontwerpgegevens je deelt.

name: Organization: Shadow Rule
description:
A small neighborhood gang, a single country and one big goal: rule the world from the shadows before the Interpol File fills up.

Organization is a strategy game of expansion played on a world map. Spread your organization from its home country to its neighbors, then by sea and by air to distant continents. On a map of 90 regions, every move brings you power, but every move also leaves a trace.

GROW YOUR ORGANIZATION
Choose from 100 skills across the Network, Operations and Shield tabs. Open land, sea and air routes, boost your income and shore up your defenses. Put the right skills together and powerful combos emerge.

KEEP THE HEAT DOWN
Every country has its own Heat. The more noise you make, the harder governments crack down and the faster the Interpol File fills. If the File reaches 100%, your leader is arrested and the game is over. You decide when to expand and when to lie low.

KEEP YOUR PEOPLE LOYAL
An organization that grows too fast rots from within. Informants and betrayals can bring you down before Interpol ever does.

LAUNDER THE DIRTY MONEY
Operations bring in dirty money, but skills cost clean money. Collect the cash bags that pop up on the map and expand your laundering capacity.

RIVALS AND EVENTS
Rival gangs hold their own turf on the map: go to war or forge an alliance. Dock strikes, market crashes, nosy journalists... each of the 25 event cards demands a decision.

FOUR GANGS, THREE DIFFICULTIES
Mafia Family, Cartel, Street Gang and Cyber Gang: each has its own strengths and weaknesses. Earn victory badges on Easy, Normal and Hard.

NO ADS
There are no ads in the game. Mafia Family and Cartel on Easy and Normal are always free. A one-time Full Version purchase unlocks Street Gang, Cyber Gang and Hard difficulty, and it restores on a new device. Purchases never change the Interpol File, arrest or victory.

No internet connection required. Playable in 12 languages.

Organization is a fictional strategy game: it shows no real criminal methods and contains no graphic violence.

description:

Check something off and the ink strikes it through, like a fountain pen. Tape what matters with washi tape. Underline today's focus. And at the end of the day, your page gets a stamp – a quiet red seal that shows how your day went. No streaks, no guilt.

FROM SPROUT TO COMET
Your total steps decide what you are. A sprout becomes a plant, a snail, a tree, a whale, a lighthouse, a mountain and one day a planet. Every stage has its own colors from Sanzo Wada's "Dictionary of Color Combinations".

Steps earn coins. Spend them on your own little 3D world: over 100 buildings, a lagoon, paths, day and night. No in-app purchases, you can only get it all by walking.

name: Abscise: Sunk Cost Severance

Start with what comes next
Acknowledge what you have already invested, then look at the effort and spending still ahead. Include the costs of leaving, so your reflection considers the whole next step.

Find a clearer perspective
Work through guided questions about your motivation, the strain you feel, and the other possibilities you could choose. Review a summary based on your answers.

Choose your own direction
Let a commitment go, continue with intention, or give it a defined review period. Set a condition for what would make continuing worthwhile and return to your reflection when it is time to reassess.

See the space you could make
View estimated time freed and future spending avoided from commitments you choose to release. Estimates account for exit costs and keep different currencies separate.

Keep your reflections close
Save drafts, revisit previous decisions, and explore examples when you need a starting point. Works offline, with reflections stored locally on your device. No account required.

Designed for iPhone and iPad, with a calm botanical style and a focused, step-by-step flow.

Scores are reflection guides. Time and money figures are estimates based on your inputs, not guaranteed outcomes. The final choice is yours.

Less weight. More possibility.

name: Action Translation

Action Translation turns any text into a clear translation — right where you read it.

Select text in Safari, Notes, Mail or any other app, tap Share and choose Action Translation. The text opens in a translator card: edit it if you like and tap Translate.

MORE THAN A TRANSLATION
• Words and expressions get a dictionary entry: the dictionary form with part of speech or gender, synonyms, numbered meanings and 5–8 usage examples with translations.

• The source language is detected automatically — or pick it yourself.

YOUR AI, YOUR KEY
Choose the provider — Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude or OpenAI — and the model. Use your own API key; it's stored securely in the Keychain. Your text goes straight from your device to the provider you chose: no account, no server of ours in between.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY USE
• 20 target languages, your most used ones at the top
• History of your last 50 translations — swipe to repeat or delete
• Copy the whole result with one tap
• Full VoiceOver support: originals and translations are read in their own language
• Light and dark appearance, iPhone and iPad

You need an API key from Google AI Studio, Anthropic or OpenAI. Usage is billed by the provider to your account; Google offers a free tier.

name: ADHDawn - Heavy Sleeper Alarm
description:
Ever wake up to find you already turned off your alarm? ADHDawn is designed for people with ADHD, heavy sleepers, and anyone who can tap Stop and fall back asleep without remembering it.

If you tap Stop while you’re still half asleep, ADHDawn can ring again after the interval you choose. When you’re ready to get up, tap Start my morning, walk to the bathroom, and take a photo of your sink, faucet, shower head, or toilet. Once ADHDawn recognizes the fixture, the follow-up alarms for that morning end.

On-device photo recognition
ADHDawn uses Apple Intelligence to recognize bathroom fixtures as small as a faucet or shower head, right on your iPhone or iPad. It works with a fresh camera photo and never needs access to your Photo Library. The image stays in memory during the check. ADHDawn never saves it, uploads it, or sends it to an external AI service.

Make mornings work for you
• Try a practice alarm during setup to learn how to finish your first morning.
• Choose the system alarm sound or preview ten original tones.
• Choose how soon a follow-up can ring after you stop an alarm, for up to one hour from the first ring.
• Wake up at your chosen local time, even when you travel.

One-time alarms are free, including follow-up rings and photo verification. An optional monthly subscription unlocks Weekly schedules. Set an early alarm on workdays and sleep in on weekends, or choose a different time for each day. The subscription renews automatically until canceled. You can manage it in your Apple Account settings.

ADHDawn requires iOS 27 or iPadOS 27 or later and an Apple Intelligence device with AFM 3 Core or AFM 3 Core Advanced ready to use. Setup checks your device before you set an alarm.

https://lithium.is/privacy-policy/
https://lithium.is/terms-of-use/

name: Admitly: QR Guest Check-In
description:
Admitly turns your iPhone or iPad into a guest check-in desk. Import your list, send every guest a branded QR ticket, and scan them at the door: green to enter, red to stop.

Everything stays on your device. There are no accounts, no servers and no subscriptions, and check-in works with no internet at all.

IMPORT YOUR LIST
• Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, from any spreadsheet or ticketing tool
• Start from the built-in template, or add guests by hand
• Admitly creates a secure code for every guest who doesn't have one

SEND TICKETS
• Three ticket designs with your logo and colours
• Printable PDF, one image per guest, or a list with codes for a mail merge
• Optional venue map pin: guests tap "Venue map" to open Google Maps

SCAN AT THE DOOR
• Big, clear results: Welcome, Already checked in or Not on the list
• Each code works once, a set number of times, or unlimited
• Family and group tickets: give one guest several entries
• Front or back camera, enter a code by hand, sound and haptics
• Exit PIN keeps the scanner locked for door staff

KNOW WHO'S HERE
• Live count, arrivals over time and arrivals by category
• Full scan log, including rejected and repeat scans
• Export the check-in report to Excel

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your guest list never leaves your device. Admitly collects no data and has no analytics, ads or tracking.

name: Adultishing
description:
Adulthood can be a lot. Adultishing makes a little room for you in it.

Meet Pip: a small green rabbit with a rust scarf, a soft heart, and strong opinions about carrots. Every day brings one kind note, why it matters, and three tiny things you can try. Nothing to catch up on. No streaks to protect.

A LITTLE SOMETHING EACH DAY
Discover 365 daily cards across 52 themed weeks, from being brave and beginning again to saying no and making room for rest. Each card has three small actions and two optional extra notes. The year loops when you reach the end.

PIP IS HERE
Tap Pip to say hello, stroke him to pet him, drag beside him to turn him, and feed him carrots. Each little thing you tick earns a carrot, and a new day brings one too. Mallow the bear and Cleo the cat visit during their own themed weeks.

GO AT YOUR OWN PACE
Look back at the days you have reached, tick something when it helps, and leave the rest. Pip never gets sick or leaves because you have been away.

QUIET BY DESIGN
Your progress stays on your device. No account, ads, analytics, or tracking. Daily content and companions work offline. Optional reminders are scheduled locally. An internet connection is needed to purchase or restore through the App Store.

ADULTISHING PLUS
Days 1 and 2 are free. An optional yearly auto-renewing subscription opens the daily cards from day 3 onward, including their actions, extra notes, and lookback. Pip, petting, feeding, and visiting friends remain available without a subscription.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Adultishing Plus renews automatically each year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. The price is shown in the app before purchase.

Adultishing offers everyday encouragement, not medical care or professional counselling.

Privacy policy: https://adultishing.pages.dev/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Advance Study Planner
description:
Advance Study keeps your whole semester in one calm place: your timetable, assignments, exams, study timer, revisions and flashcards. Built for school, college and entrance-exam students: B.Tech, MBBS, NEET, JEE, UPSC, GATE, CBSE and more.

PLAN YOUR DAY
• Today shows your next class, planned study blocks and what is due
• Weekly timetable with rotating (A/B week) schedules and days off
• Assignments and tasks with due-date reminders
• Exam countdowns with a revision plan that rebalances when you miss a day

FOCUS
• Pomodoro and stopwatch timer tagged to subject, topic and medium (notes, video, books, MCQs)
• Lock-screen timer with Live Activity, plus home-screen widgets

REMEMBER
• Spaced revision on a 1 · 7 · 21 · 45 day rhythm, so topics come back before you forget them
• Flashcards scheduled with FSRS, the modern spaced-repetition algorithm
• Notes and ready-made topic lists for popular courses and exams

TRACK
• Study stats by day, week and month, with streaks and a daily goal
• Attendance tracker that tells you how many classes you can miss and stay above 75%
• Practice and mock-test log with accuracy, score trends and weak topics
• Grades and SGPA, semester archive, calendar sync and an Apple Watch app

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Everything works without an account and stays on your iPhone. Export your data to a file any time.

name: Advent Calendar Xmas
description:
A snowy village street at night, painted in the style of a vintage children's book. Behind every shutter, door and cat flap lives a small, warm scene: a grandfather asleep under the tree with a cat on his lap, a choir of children singing far too loudly, a hedgehog in a basket by the stove, two mice stealing a mince pie.

In December, one door opens each day. Tap a number and the paper flap folds back. Tap again to step closer and look around the room. What you open stays open, so the street slowly fills with light as Christmas comes nearer.

That is all it does. No accounts, no ads, no notifications, no internet. Just a street, 24 doors, and a little something to look forward to every morning.

- 24 hand-painted scenes, each one different
- Paper flaps that fold open like a real advent calendar
- Step closer to any open door and explore the details
- Press and hold to close a door again
- Nothing is collected or sent anywhere
- In Dutch, German, French, Spanish and English

name: Aeros Mail
description:
Aeros Mail is a fast, keyboard-first email app for Gmail, Outlook and Microsoft 365, with AI that helps you get through your inbox without giving your mail to anyone new.

SPLIT INBOX
Mail is sorted for you into Important, Team, Calendar, Newsletters, Notifications and Promotions, so what needs you is always at the top. Each thread is tagged "Act today" or "Needs reply". Move a thread to another split once and Aeros Mail remembers.

BUILT FOR SPEED
• Single-key shortcuts: E to archive, R to reply, S to star, H to snooze, / to search
• A command palette (⌘K) for every action
• Local-first: your recent mail is stored on your device, so lists and search are instant, even offline
• Undo send, send later and snooze

AI THAT STAYS ON YOUR SIDE
• Thread summaries with action items and open questions
• Suggested replies and full drafts in your own writing style
• Search in plain language ("invoices from Priya last month")
• Runs on Apple's on-device intelligence by default. Optional Claude support uses your own Anthropic API key, and the app masks card numbers, long number runs and passwords before anything is sent.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No Aeros account and no Aeros servers: the app talks directly to Google or Microsoft
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Sign-in tokens live in your Keychain

WORKS WITH
Gmail and Google Workspace, Outlook.com, Hotmail and Microsoft 365 work or school accounts. Use several accounts side by side.

Try it right away with the built-in demo inbox, no sign-in needed.

name: Afterglow XR
description:
Put your iPhone in a viewer and step inside. Afterglow XR turns the phone in your pocket into a headset with real head tracking, your own hands as the controller, and your room around you.

YOUR ROOM, YOUR HANDS
Move and lean with six degrees of freedom. Your room shows through the cameras, with depth, so glass windows hang in it and stay where you put them. Pinch to select, grab to move, point to aim. No controllers, nothing to charge.

YOUR LIBRARY IN THREE DIMENSIONS
Spatial photos and videos play back in stereo. Panoramas wrap around you. 360 photos become the room itself. 180 and 360 video, side by side and top and bottom. Browse your Photos library, or your own folders in Files, including folders from cloud storage apps, and read them in place.

A WEB BROWSER YOU CAN REACH INTO
Tabs, bookmarks, history, saved logins and private browsing, with text sized to read through a lens. Pages built with WebXR open immersive VR and AR sessions, with your hands as the input, and an Exit button at your feet whenever you want to leave.

TWENTY-FOUR PLACES TO BE
Sit in a Japanese garden, a grand library or a starship cabin. Twenty-four photospheres are built in, and your own 360 photos join them. The one you pick is still there next time.

TWELVE GAMES
Paint glowing ribbons in the air. Putt eighteen holes of mini golf at your feet. Ride a coaster on a course that is new every time. Blast blobs with a punch, vacuum your real floor, wake a toy box, step through a portal, and play rhythm to your own music. Stack a tower on your real table, grow a glowing garden, keep a ball in orbit with your palms, and drive a neon road by looking where you want to go.

YOUR MUSIC, YOUR WATCH, YOUR CONTROLLER
Control Apple Music from inside. Use Apple Watch as a clicker with Double Tap and the Digital Crown, or pair a game controller.

TUNED FOR COMFORT
Head smoothing you can adjust, 3DoF mode on the ultra-wide camera, and adjustable render scale and frame rate.

WHAT YOU NEED
A phone viewer you can put your iPhone in, and an iPhone with a LiDAR Scanner. For the best experience, use iPhone 17 Pro Max or iPhone 18 Pro Max. Any other iPhone Pro with a LiDAR Scanner, such as iPhone 15 Pro, can work too. You can print a viewer yourself from the published plans. No viewer to hand? Phone view runs it all in your hand.

No account and no ads. It is open source, and it does not collect your data: your camera, your hands and your voice stay on your iPhone.

name: AgeReel: Face Timelapse
description:
Watch the years go by in seconds.

AgeReel turns the photos you already have into a timelapse of one face over time: your child from the first day to today, you across a decade, your dog from puppy to grey muzzle. The eyes stay locked in the same spot in every frame, so the face changes smoothly while the years roll past.

FINDS EVERY PHOTO FOR YOU
Show AgeReel a few photos of someone and smart scan searches your whole library for them, including photos stored in iCloud. It picks sharp, front-facing shots and spreads them across the years. You review the picks before anything is added.

EYES LOCKED, EVERY FRAME
Each photo is aligned on the eyes, turned level and scaled to the same head size. Tilted heads, group photos and old scans all line up.

MADE FOR THE PEOPLE YOU LOVE
• Kids, partners, friends, yourself, and cats and dogs
• Their age on every photo, from their birthday: "8 months", "Age 3"
• A date bar that counts the years as they pass
• A before-and-after card: the first face beside the last
• Film styles: Classic, Black & white, Vintage and Print
• Music to set the mood

YOUR PHOTOS, YOUR WAY
• Pick from your library, a folder, a ZIP file or one long video
• Dates are read automatically and easy to fix by hand
• Drag, pinch or turn any photo into place
• A yearly reminder to add the newest photos

SHARE IT
Export in 9:16 for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, or in 1:1 or 16:9. Save as a video or a GIF.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Face detection and alignment run entirely on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded, and there's no account and no tracking.

AGEREEL PRO
Free makes 720p videos with a small AgeReel watermark. Pro unlocks smart scan, the date bar, videos up to 4K without a watermark, and clean re-exports whenever you add new photos. Get Pro as a monthly subscription or with a one-time Lifetime purchase.

The monthly subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://agereel.com/privacy/

name: AI Image Label Remover
description:
Took a real photo, made a small edit, and got an "AI" label anyway?

Many apps and editors embed hidden tags in your photos: Content Credentials (C2PA), XMP edit history, and EXIF data. Some social platforms read those tags and attach an AI label automatically, even when the edit was tiny.

AI Image Label Remover strips those hidden tags and saves a clean copy. Your pixels are never touched.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open a photo in Photos, tap Share, then Remove AI Label
• A clean copy saves as your newest photo
• Post that copy

WHAT GETS REMOVED
• Content Credentials (C2PA)
• XMP edit history and creator-tool tags
• EXIF: camera, device, timestamps and GPS location
• AI prompt text embedded in some PNG files

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
• Lossless for JPEG and PNG: the image data is copied byte for byte, never re-compressed
• Keeps orientation and color profile, so photos look identical
• Everything happens on your iPhone. No uploads, no account, no tracking
• Batches of up to 30 photos
• Your original is never changed

PRICING
Your first clean is free. Unlock unlimited with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

GOOD TO KNOW
This app removes metadata stored in the file. It can't remove invisible watermarks built into the pixels, and platforms can label content in other ways, including when you disclose AI use yourself. Please follow each platform's rules about disclosing AI-generated content.

name: AI Rubix Cube Solver
description:
Unlock the magic of the 3x3 cube with AI Rubix Cube Solver 3D — your ultimate spatial intelligence companion, trainer, and speedcubing arena.

Whether you are holding a scrambled cube for the very first time or training to smash your personal best, our state-of-the-art on-device computer vision and 3D guidance engine will guide you to a complete solve in seconds!

KEY FEATURES:

◆ REAL-TIME AI CAMERA SCANNER
No more tedious manual entry. Simply point your iPhone camera at each side of the cube. Our neural vision classifier instantly captures facelets, maps colors across variable lighting, and generates an optimal step-by-step solution.

◆ INTERACTIVE 3D VIRTUAL SOLVER
Watch real-time 3D animations rendered in crisp 60 FPS SceneKit graphics. Rotate, inspect, and follow moves at your own speed with dynamic playback controls (Play, Pause, Step-by-Step, Slider).

◆ AI VOICE COACH & FINGER TRICK ADVICE
Turn on the Voice Coach to hear real-time notation callouts (R, U', F2) in natural English. Learn professional fingertricks and ergonomic execution tips to increase your turning efficiency and transition into speedcubing.

◆ 1v1 SPEED BATTLE ARENA (MULTIPLAYER)
Challenge yourself against intelligent AI bots across multiple difficulty tiers (Novice 60s, Master 25s, WR 4.8s) or pass-and-play with friends on a single device with synchronized scrambles.

◆ WCA PRO COMPETITION TIMER
Practice just like in official World Cube Association (WCA) tournaments. Includes two-finger hold sensor start, inspection, scramble generators, and real-time calculation of your PB, Ao5, and Ao12 statistics.

◆ MAGIC PATTERN LAB
Bored of standard solves? Transform your cube into dazzling geometric art forms! Explore iconic patterns including Checkerboard, Six Spots, Cube in a Cube, Superflip, and Anaconda with one-tap 3D previews and formula breakdowns.

◆ STEP-BY-STEP SPEEDCUBING ACADEMY
Master the beginner layer-by-layer method and transition towards CFOP. Includes concise guides for the White Cross, First Layer, Second Layer, OLL, PLL, and a complete WCA notation cheat sheet.

◆ 100% PRIVATE & ON-DEVICE
All computer vision scanning and algorithmic computations run completely offline on your device. Zero camera data, photos, or personal telemetry are uploaded to external servers.

---------------------------------

"Rubik's" and "Rubik's Cube" are registered trademarks of Rubik's Brand Ltd (Spin Master Corp). AI Rubix Cube Solver 3D is an independent software tool developed for educational purposes and is NOT affiliated with, sponsored, authorized, or endorsed by Rubik's Brand Ltd or Spin Master.

name: Airea Property
description:
Airea helps you explore property for sale and rent in Malaysia.

SEARCH IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Describe your preferred location, budget and property type. AI-assisted search helps turn your request into property results.

EXPLORE PROPERTY DETAILS
Browse listing photos, asking prices and available information such as bedrooms, bathrooms, floor area and furnishing. View nearby rail-station information where available.

SAVE YOUR FAVOURITES
Sign in to save properties and return to your shortlist in the Saved tab.

ASK AI CHAT
Ask property-search questions and receive suggestions to help you explore your options.

CONTACT LISTING AGENTS
Use available call or WhatsApp links to contact the listing agent. Calls and messages open in compatible external apps.

An internet connection is required. Saving properties requires an Airea account. AI features require permission to send prompts for processing.

Listings are supplied by property advertisers. Prices, availability and details may change. Confirm information directly with the listing agent. AI responses may be inaccurate and are not professional advice.

name: AI手持弹幕
description:
不知道举牌写什么？AI 帮你把话写好，选个场景，举起手机就能用。

AI手持弹幕把手机变成一块醒目的大字灯牌：演唱会应援、接机加油、生日表白、现场喊话，隔着人群和噪音，把一句话清晰递到对方眼前。

【AI 写文案】
· 给个关键词，或结合当前场景，生成多条短弹幕候选，点选即用
· AI 只生成适合全屏展示的短句，不做闲聊对话
· 生成内容经服务端与本地双重过滤，命中即剔除

【六套场景，成套观感】
· 喊话、应援、加油、表白、祝福、日常，背景、字色、发光、光斑与动效整套切换
· 编辑态停留整句展示，进入全屏自动滚动；字号、速度、发光按文案与场景自动适配

【干净好用】
· 大号文字自动适配，长文案也能完整显示
· 歌单与历史，常用句子一键复用；内置符号快捷插入
· 可选照片背景、荧光棒色板、SOS 求救闪烁屏
· 无账号、无社区、不收集个人信息；基础展示离线可用
· 运行期间保持屏幕常亮，不会中途熄灭

适用场景：演唱会/音乐节应援、机场车站接机、赛场加油、生日/表白/求婚、聚会喊话、现场导览、紧急示意。

注：AI 文案生成需联网；本地文案与展示功能离线可用。

name: ALAN — карточки для речи
description:
ALAN назван в честь нашего сына. Он особый ребёнок, и когда мы искали занятия для развития речи, нам не хватало простого приложения на русском языке, где слово, картинка и надпись работают вместе, а задания не перегружают ребёнка. Поэтому мы сделали его сами — и делимся им с другими семьями.

ЧТО ВНУТРИ
• Предлоги: на, под, в, рядом — ребёнок сам переносит предметы.
• Вопросы: что это? кто это? где? что делает?
• Предложения и формы слов: «дай мяч», «нет мяча», «мой, моя, моё».
• «Скажи сам» — ребёнок отвечает голосом, приложение слушает и хвалит.
• Счёт, цвета и размеры, «Мой день», «Слушай и делай», «Почему? Зачем?».
• Руки и ритм: перенос через середину, повтори ритм, слоги, дорожки.

КАК ЭТО РАБОТАЕТ
• Каждое задание озвучено живым голосом, на экране — картинка и крупная надпись.
• Подсказки уменьшаются сами: после 5 верных ответов подряд — меньше подсказок, после ошибок — снова больше.
• Повторы без скуки: вопросы идут по кругу, а трудные возвращаются чуть позже.
• За старание — «Друзья Чипа»: коллекция весёлых роботов.
• Можно добавить свои фото: «мама ест», «папа читает».
• Отчёт для логопеда: что получается и что пока трудно.
• Тихий режим: меньше анимации для чувствительных детей.

ДЛЯ РОДИТЕЛЕЙ
• Без рекламы и без регистрации. Данные ребёнка хранятся только на устройстве.
• Настройки и покупка закрыты родительской проверкой.
• Бесплатно: первый уровень в каждой игре. Полная версия — все уровни, разовая покупка без подписки.

Мы продолжаем добавлять упражнения. Напишите нам, чего не хватает вашему ребёнку: islam.safarov@gmail.com

name: Alicia Reader
description:
Alicia Reader is a reading app that runs entirely on your iPhone. No account, no ads: your books, notes and diary stay on your phone.

Everything except the optional AI is free; you can use the app fully without paying.

BOOKS IN
· TXT reads as well as EPUB: encodings detected, chapters found, ads and junk cleaned from web novels.
· Open a book from the Files app, send it from your computer over Wi-Fi, or connect your own book servers (WebDAV, OPDS, Calibre).
· Six public-domain Chinese classics included, by Lu Xun, Shen Fu, Wang Guowei and Yu Dafu, each in simplified and traditional characters.

READING
· Its own typesetting: Chinese punctuation, line-start and line-end rules, no widows; traditional books set vertically by default.
· Choose a paper and a typeface. The fonts come with the app; night is a warm grey, not black.
· Pages slide, or lift like paper.
· On iPhone Duo, open it for two pages side by side; half-open, it stands as a listening console, and it can keep reading aloud when you close it.

MARKS, DOG-EARS AND A DIARY
· Press on a line and drag to mark it in vermilion, and add a note. Dog-ears and a ribbon keep your places.
· What you read each day becomes an entry in a reading diary.
· Search the full text, or by memory: “the bit with snow I read on a train last winter”.
· A private bookcase opens with Face ID.

LISTENING
· Read aloud with the system voices, with controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and a sleep timer.
· On iPhones with 8 GB of memory or more, four Chinese voices generated on the device (they use more battery; not for long sessions).

AI (OPTIONAL, THE ONLY PAID FEATURE)
· Explains words as you read, keeps track of the people in a book (their names underlined), prepares whole books, and helps polish your diary.
· Off by default. With the on-device model (iPhones with 8 GB of memory or more) it all stays on the phone; or use your own API key with Claude or an OpenAI-compatible service.
· Free for 5 days, then a one-time purchase — not a subscription. Family Sharing included.

YOURS
· No data collected.
· Export everything in one ZIP (books, marks, dog-ears, diary, reading history) and restore it as it was.
· Interface in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English and French, with VoiceOver and larger text.

name: AlpTraverse - Haute Route
description:
The Haute Route from Chamonix to Zermatt – plan your adventure, explore every stage and keep essential route information at your fingertips, even without mobile reception.

AlpTraverse is your digital guide to one of the most iconic multi-day ski traverses in the European Alps.

THREE ROUTE VARIANTS

Explore the classic Verbier Route and the more demanding alternatives via Grand Combin and Grand Lui.

Compare stages, explore different overnight stops and choose the route that best suits your plans.

INTERACTIVE MAPS & GPX TRACKS

• Interactive 2D and 3D terrain maps
• Carefully curated GPX tracks for individual stages
• Detailed route visualization and elevation profiles
• Offline maps for remote alpine terrain

DETAILED STAGE INFORMATION

Prepare for each day with information on ascents, descents, elevation gain and the character of the terrain.

Explore stage descriptions, alternative routes and potential overnight stops to help plan your traverse.

KNOW THE KEY PASSAGES

From glacier crossings to challenging mountain passes, AlpTraverse highlights important sections along the Haute Route.

Understand the terrain ahead and prepare for demanding passages before setting out.

MOUNTAIN HUT DIRECTORY

Discover mountain huts along the Haute Route, with useful information to help plan your overnight stays.

INTERACTIVE PACKING CHECKLIST

Getting your equipment right is essential for a multi-day ski traverse.

Use the built-in packing checklist to organize your ski touring gear, safety equipment, clothing and personal essentials.

Check off items as you prepare and keep track of what is still missing.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE

AlpTraverse brings together curated routes, interactive maps, stage descriptions, mountain huts, packing lists and practical planning information.

Spend less time searching across websites, maps and GPX files – and more time preparing for your adventure.

TRY BEFORE YOU BUY

Explore the first stage for free.

Unlock the complete Haute Route package with a one-time in-app purchase. No subscription required.

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

The Haute Route crosses remote, high-altitude and glaciated mountain terrain. Conditions can change rapidly, and routes may become unsafe or impassable due to weather, avalanche hazards, crevasses or other alpine risks.

AlpTraverse is a planning and reference tool. It does not provide real-time safety assessments and cannot replace current local information, appropriate equipment, mountain experience or professional mountain guides.

Always assess conditions independently and make responsible decisions in the mountains.

name: AltiMark
description:
Stamp every summit with precise elevation, GPS coordinates, place name, and your own motto — then keep a clean alpine logbook of the climbs that matter.

AltiMark is an altitude camera and summit journal. Point, preview, and capture: what you see in the viewfinder is what gets stamped into the photo. No account. No cloud. Built to work offline on the trail.

CAMERA & LIVE WATERMARK
• Capture scenic check-in photos with a real-time watermark overlay
• Switch aspect ratios (4:3, 1:1, 16:9) and optional rule-of-thirds grid
• Flash control: Auto / On / Off

name: Ambu Gauge Thuli
description:
A softener's history means more when every reading belongs to the right unit.
AmbuGaugeThuli keeps industrial water-softener records together in a private offline workspace.
SOFTENER IDENTITY
Create a profile with the equipment name and operating area.
Keep capacity and resin-bed details beside the asset.
Return to the profile whenever a new service cycle is recorded.
HARDNESS EVIDENCE
Add dated feed-water and treated-water hardness readings.
Keep recorded units visible alongside the values.
Review changes across the checks you have entered.
Compare calculated values only when measurement units match.
Avoid drawing conclusions from incompatible unit entries.
REGENERATION & THROUGHPUT
Record processed water volume for the relevant softener.
Log regeneration events within its equipment history.
Include salt usage as an observed operational quantity.
See each event in context with earlier measurements.
RESIN & SERVICE CONTINUITY
Document changes to the resin bed without losing past observations.
Keep dated notes connected to the affected equipment.
Set reminders for future hardness testing and service review.
Use search and filters to locate a softener or past entry.
Revisit the recorded facts before planning the next check.
Every insight reflects the information that has been saved.
The app does not operate softeners or verify treated-water quality.
It does not prescribe chemical dosing or make compliance decisions.
AmbuGaugeThuli makes manual softener history easier to follow.

name: Angel Mgmnt Talent
description:
Angel Mgmnt Talent is the private app for models and creators represented by Angel Mgmnt.

See today's work at a glance, with call times, addresses and what to bring. Answer holds in a tap, book out days, upload digitals and castings, and let your agent know when you've arrived or you're running late.

Track what you've earned, what's on its way and what's been paid, with a clear breakdown for every job. Message the agency, share updates and keep your profile, measurements and portfolio up to date.

Sign-in is by invitation from Angel Mgmnt.

name: Anicca - Chakra Tracker
description:
Nothing you feel is permanent, but all of it is worth noticing.

Anicca is a calm mood and energy journal for iPhone. Name how you feel, see it across seven chakras from Root to Crown, and notice your patterns over time.

SAY IT IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Type how you feel, the way you'd say it to a friend. Anicca matches your words to emotions right on your iPhone, using Apple's built-in language tools. Nothing is sent anywhere for analysis. Your typed text isn't stored, and only the emotions you confirm are saved.

OR FIND THE EXACT WORD
Browse a library of 70+ emotions. Rate how strongly you feel it from 1 to 5, and add a note if you want to remember why.

SEE WHERE YOUR ENERGY GATHERS
Every check-in belongs to one of seven energy centers: Root, Sacral, Solar Plexus, Heart, Throat, Third Eye, and Crown. Chakra balance shows which centers have been coming up most lately. Some weeks gather in the Heart. Some stay close to the Root.

SEE HOW YOUR WEEK WENT
The mood timeline shows how you moved from day to day, with your recent check-ins close by.

A SHORT LOOK BACK AT YOUR WEEK
With Pro, Anicca writes a short weekly reflection and suggests a simple practice to try. It's made on your iPhone from your own entries, with no AI service and nothing sent away.

DAILY REMINDERS, AND EXPORTS YOU KEEP
• A gentle daily reminder at the time you pick
• JSON export of every check-in, free
• PDF export as a readable journal, with Pro

ONLY YOU CAN READ YOUR CHECK-INS
Sign in with Apple, Google, or email. Your check-ins sync to your account as a backup that only you can read. There are no ads and no third-party analytics in the app, and we never sell your data.

START FREE, AND UPGRADE WHEN YOU WANT MORE
Free: 30 check-ins a month, daily reminders, and JSON export. No subscription needed.
Anicca Pro: unlimited check-ins, weekly reflections with practice suggestions, streaks, 14-day and monthly timelines, and PDF export.

Anicca Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.screenseiji.com/apps/anicca/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.screenseiji.com/apps/anicca/privacy

Anicca is a tool for self-reflection. It isn't medical advice, therapy, or a diagnosis.

Anicca is the Pali word for impermanence. Made by Screen Sage Studios, where spirituality, science, and story meet.

name: Anki Flash: Exam Prep Cards
description:
Anki Flash helps you remember what licensing and certification exams test, with flashcards and spaced repetition. Cards come back just before you would forget them, so short daily sessions add up.

Choose your country, then the exam you are preparing for:

United States
- Real estate salesperson license: California, Texas, Florida, New York, Arizona and Pennsylvania (national and state portions, one pack per state)
- Food Protection Manager certification
- Pharmacy technician certification
- Commercial driver's license (CDL) knowledge tests
- U.S. citizenship civics test

Philippines
- Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers (Professional Education)

HOW THE CARDS ARE MADE
Every card is written from primary sources such as state statutes and commission rules, federal regulations, the FDA Food Code and the official exam outlines. Each pack is checked against those sources and reviewed again before release, and we revise cards when laws or outlines change.

FEATURES
- Spaced repetition that schedules each card for you
- Try sample cards in every deck for free
- Make your own decks and cards, with photos
- Study statistics and streaks
- Sign in with Apple or Google to sync across devices

PRICING
Download free. Each exam pack is a one-time purchase that unlocks all of its decks. No subscription and no ads.

Anki Flash is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any exam provider, licensing agency or certification body, and its cards are not actual exam questions. Always confirm current requirements with the official agency for your exam.

name: Arborio
description:
Arborio est un livre de famille que l'on ouvre comme un vieux grimoire. Il vous aide à construire, conserver et partager l'arbre généalogique de votre famille, simplement et élégamment.

UN LIVRE QUI S'OUVRE
Au lancement, la couverture dorée vous attend : glissez le doigt pour tourner la page. Sur un écran large (iPad, iPhone pliant déplié), le livre s'ouvre en deux pages, avec l'intérieur de la couverture à gauche.

VOS FAMILLES, VOS FICHES
• Créez plusieurs familles et ajoutez-en les membres.
• Chaque fiche : prénom, nom, nom de naissance, naissance, décès, parents, conjoints, enfants et notes.
• Une photo dans un cadre ancien, avec recadrage.
• Sur grand écran, la liste des membres et la fiche s'affichent côte à côte.

UNE VUE D'ENSEMBLE CLAIRE
• Un arbre épuré qui se lit de haut en bas, avec zoom.
• Les couples sont réunis dans un cartouche doré ; un couple séparé apparaît en pointillés.
• Une personne qui a eu plusieurs unions est placée entre ses conjoints.
• Touchez une personne de l'arbre pour ouvrir sa fiche.
• Exportez l'arbre en image PNG pour le partager ou l'imprimer.

VOS DONNÉES VOUS APPARTIENNENT
• Tout reste sur votre appareil. Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucun suivi.
• Sauvegarde et restauration dans iCloud Drive, automatique si vous le souhaitez.
• Import et export au format GEDCOM, compatible avec les autres logiciels de généalogie.

Arborio est fait pour les familles qui veulent garder une trace, pas pour les mettre en ligne.

name: ArcFormMax
description:
ArcFormMax is an offline architectural reference for domes, arches, vaults, and the structure that carries them.

Study the form, then keep the work. Read a dome or an arch, open its parts, compare it with another, and gather the studies into a research project. Everything stays on your iPhone. There is no account and no network connection.

EXPLORE
Dome forms, arches, vaults, supports, classical orders, and building studies. Each record explains the geometry, the construction logic, and the space the form makes.

UNDERSTAND
The Structure Explorer separates a drawing into layers. Select a part to read its role, and follow a load path step by step. These diagrams show direction and relationship. They are not structural calculations, and they give no loads, stresses, or safety factors.

COMPARE
Place two or three dome forms, structural systems, orders, details, or building studies side by side. Save the comparison and return to it later.

RESEARCH
Open a project, add references, and write notes. Pin a note, tag it, and attach it to the studies it belongs to. A knowledge graph shows how a part connects to the forms and buildings around it.

EXPORT
Export a project, a study, or a saved comparison as a PDF. Back up favorites, notes, tags, history, projects, and comparisons, then restore them on this device.

ArcFormMax is a study library. It is not a travel guide, a map, or an engineering calculator.

name: Arcly: Workout Planner
description:
Arcly gives you a personal training plan and a clear way to see it working.

Answer a few questions about your goal, body, experience and equipment. Arcly builds a realistic plan around them, built on training research: the right number of sets for each muscle, steady progression and proper rest.

FILL YOUR ARCS Every workout fills the arcs of the body parts it trains. Fill your Arc to level up.

RANK UP EVERY BODY PART Chest, back, shoulders, arms, legs and core each earn a rank from Bronze to Elite, based on how strong you are for your body weight.

SEE WHERE YOUR PLAN TAKES YOU Compare where you start with where your plan takes you in 12 weeks.

LOG EVERY SET A fast workout logger with a rest timer, warm-ups, plate maths and clear demos for 134 exercises. Swap any exercise for an easier, harder or similar one, and edit upcoming workouts.

HIT CALORIES AND PROTEIN Daily calories and protein from your plan's goal, or set your own. Search foods, add your own, or scan a barcode.

ALSO • Log any sport: volleyball, rowing, BJJ, running and more • Streaks, history and charts for every lift • Home-screen and lock-screen widgets • kg or lb

SUBSCRIPTION Start with 7 days free, then $59.99 a year. Or $9.99 a month. Everything is included: your plan and its progression, arc levels and muscle ranks, live workouts with demos, progress and full history, and food tracking with barcode scan.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Arcly offers general fitness guidance and is not medical advice.

name: ArmorAtlas
description:
ArmorAtlas is an offline reference and research workspace for natural protective structures and biomimicry.

Study how shells, scales, plates, spines, and segmented armor are organized. Read case studies, explore structural diagrams, compare arrangements, and keep your own design research on your device.

What you can do:

Browse a curated atlas of natural protective structures, from tortoise shells and pangolin scales to exoskeletons, spines, and layered shells.
Explore construction in Structure Lab. Select components, show or hide layers, and read what each part does.
Study surface patterns in the Texture Library.
Compare up to three structures side by side. Summaries are drawn from the stored descriptions. There are no invented strength scores.
Build research projects, milestones, and field notes around a design question.
Follow a relationship map of explicitly linked cases, analyses, textures, and articles.
Save a personal collection, then export or restore it as a local backup.
ArmorAtlas works entirely offline. There is no account and no network connection. Your notes, projects, and collection stay on your device unless you export a backup yourself.

The library is a qualitative structural reference for design research. It describes materials, layers, joints, and arrangements. It does not invent measurements or present hypotheses as established facts.

name: Artem: Speak With Your Hands
description:
Your hands have something to say. Artem gives them a voice.

Hold a gesture. A word appears. Pause, and Artem turns your words into one natural sentence and says it out loud.

Eight gestures. One voice.
Stop. Yes. No. You. I. Help. More. Love. Eight words, each with its own distinct hand pose. Easy to make. Easy to read.

From a few words to a full thought.
Apple Intelligence fills in the rest, shaping your words into a natural sentence or question, right on your iPhone. Without it, Artem speaks your words just as you made them.

Private by design.
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your camera feed is never recorded or uploaded. No account. No network connection. Nothing to sign in to.

Artem is a communication tool. It isn't a medical device and doesn't translate sign language.

name: Artisans ENR
description:
Un projet de borne de recharge, de panneaux solaires, de batterie domestique ou de pompe à chaleur ? Décrivez-le en deux minutes.

Une appli de Tesla Mag, média indépendant de la mobilité électrique depuis 2013.

name: ArtTent
description:
Turn your iPhone into a digital art frame. Open ArtTent, place your phone in landscape, and let the artwork fill the display.

Explore Impressionist Light, an included exhibition with eight paintings by Monet, Pissarro and Sisley. Choose a frame and display the full artwork with a mat or let the image fill the frame. Works change with a soft dissolve and a subtle zoom.

Show the time, date and weather for a selected city over the artwork. Create your own slideshow with museum works and personal photos.

On iPhone Duo, open ArtTent and set your phone in tent position to enjoy the exhibition on the outer display.

Three exhibitions are included. Five optional one-time purchases add Japanese Prints, Beyond Impressionism, Sea and Storms, Still Lifes and Master Portraits.

name: Ascend: Gym
description:
Ascend helps you get a little stronger every week, and makes showing up to the gym feel like a game.

A COACH FOR EVERY SET
Ascend suggests your next weight and reps from your last session and how each set felt, even on your first workout. No guessing, just steady progress. Rest timer alerts tell you when to go again.

BEAT LAST TIME
Every workout comes with a small mission to top your last session, plus a weekly mini-boss that's a little heavier. Track your PRs, volume and streak, and earn XP and levels that unlock gear for your pixel avatar.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Chest, back, legs and arms each get a rank from Bronze to Legend, based on your best lifts for your bodyweight. It's your strength made visible: see which lifts count and exactly how close you are to the next tier.

BEAT THE BOSS TO LEVEL UP
When you've outgrown a rank, a boss shows up in your next workout. Hit the target set, record a clip, and your friends judge it. Win and you move up.

FUEL YOUR GAINS
Log meals by just typing, talking or snapping a photo, and the food AI counts calories and macros. Pick a goal (cut, bulk or maintain), track your weight, and follow your journey map.

YOUR WEEK, WRAPPED
Every Saturday you get a recap of your week: training and diet grades, PRs, medals, and one tip to make next week better.

BETTER WITH FRIENDS
Add friends to keep each other accountable: see their progress, judge their boss fights, go head to head, and train together live with Gym Sync.

Ascend is free, with no ads.

Privacy Policy: https://ascend-standalone.black-base-1186.workers.dev/privacy
Terms of Use: https://ascend-standalone.black-base-1186.workers.dev/terms

name: Ask Holy Bible
description:
Ask Holy Bible brings the Holy Bible together with the explanations of the Coptic Orthodox Church: read any chapter, tap a verse, and see what the Fathers say about it.

THE HOLY BIBLE
• The Arabic Van Dyck Bible and the King James Version, with the deuterocanonical books (Tobit, Judith, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch, Maccabees)
• Read it in 30 languages, from Coptic and Greek to Chinese
• Bookmarks, four highlight colours and notes
• Listen to human recordings of every chapter, with the verse being read followed on screen

EXPLANATIONS OF EVERY CHAPTER AND VERSE
• Fr. Tadros Yacoub Malaty and Fr. Antonious Fekry on every book, the Church Encyclopedia of Bible Commentary (St. Mark Church, Heliopolis), H.H. Pope Shenouda III and other pastors
• Fr. Malaty's own English edition for English readers

STUDY TOOLS
• Cross-references for every verse (Treasury of Scripture Knowledge)
• Word study: tap a word to see the Hebrew or Greek behind it, what it means and everywhere it appears (Strong's)
• More than 5,300 Bible topics (Nave's), with the verses in your own language
• Compare a verse in all 30 versions, or read with a second version under each verse

THE CHURCH DAY BY DAY
• Today: the verse of the day, the day's readings and the Synaxarium
• The Katameros readings and the Synaxarium, following the Coptic calendar
• The Agpeya: every hour, with a contents list
• Hymns and sermons in Coptic, Arabic and English that keep playing in the background

THE BIBLE HELPER
• Ask a question in Arabic or English. Answers come from the stored explanations, with the source of every point to open and read.
• AI-written answers only if you allow them; otherwise the phone answers by itself.

AND MORE
• Search the whole Bible, reading plans, a church library and a Bible dictionary
• More than 150 free classic Christian books in English, from the Desert Fathers to the History of the Coptic Patriarchs
• A daily reading reminder
• Share a verse as a beautiful picture
• Works offline: everything you open stays on your phone, or download the whole Bible at once
• Arabic and English, light, dark and classic themes, adjustable text size

Free, with no ads, no tracking and no account needed.

name: Asterra LinkScope Tools
seller_name: Qingyu Xinghe Information Technology (wuhan) Co., Ltd
description:
Understand your connection. Find the weak spots. Keep track of what changes.

LinkScope brings network diagnostic tools and everyday network management into one app. Check connection performance, investigate website issues, and save useful results for later.

CHECK YOUR CONNECTION
• Measure download and upload speeds.
• Check HTTPS response times, latency variation, and connection stability.
• Compare response times when your connection is idle and under load.
• Run a network check to help guide troubleshooting.

LOOK BEYOND THE SPEED TEST
• Look up IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and compare DNS resolver performance.
• Test TCP ports and inspect HTTP status codes and response headers.
• View TLS certificate details, including issuer and expiration.
• Trace IPv4 network paths and probe packet sizes with MTU testing.
• View public and local IP information.
• Compare reachability to regional endpoints from your connection.
• Check for captive portal signals, HTTPS access, and DNS responses on public networks.

ORGANIZE YOUR EVERYDAY NETWORKS
• Keep profiles for home, work, and other locations.
• Sample connection performance room by room to identify weaker spots.
• Maintain a device inventory with trust labels and on-demand reachability checks.
• Check saved websites in batches and review failure records.
• Set a monthly data budget and manually log usage.

TURN RESULTS INTO A USEFUL HISTORY
Save reports with names and notes, mark favorites, and search or filter past results. Compare compatible speed test reports to see what changed, then export results as CSV using the system share sheet.

Profiles and reports are stored locally on your device. Website checks run when you start them, device inventories are managed manually, and data budgets use the usage entries you record.

From a slow connection at home to an unreachable website at work, LinkScope helps you understand what your network is doing.

name: Astory 慢慢星
description:
Astory 慢慢星是繁體中文的習慣遊戲，免費就能玩，沒練也不會被罰。你有一顆自己的小星球，今天練了什麼就記一筆，每一筆都會變成星光，星球就跟著長一點。

【記一筆，拿星光】
・運動、學習、藝術、生活保養、陪伴，五個方向都能記；選常用項目，也能自己取名
・每記一筆就有星光，每天第一筆、連續記滿 7 天另外加碼
・行事曆看這個月做了什麼，也能先排好之後要練的

【星光長出陸地】
・第一天星球幾乎是空的，只有小紅貴賓「可麗露」陪你，一步一步帶你蓋好家
・星光拿來開新的陸地，星球一塊一塊變大
・家、教室、練習區和家具都在商店買，想擺哪就擺哪，也能轉方向
・設施蓋好之後還能升級，施工要等一下，等的時候照樣可以記
・白天黑夜跟著現實時間；看到喜歡的畫面，可以拍下來存進相簿

【五顆星球，一顆一顆打開】
・一開始只有一顆星球，某一類練得夠多，對應的那顆就能打開，一天最多開一顆
・每顆星球分開蓋，各有自己的樣子和住民

【夥伴搭慢慢號來】
・星球長大了，夥伴會被吸引過來，搭慢慢號列車來住幾天，走之前留一封信給你
・每隻夥伴喜歡的地方不一樣，把星球蓋成牠喜歡的樣子，牠就比較會來
・也可以送夥伴去上課，拳擊、鋼琴、日文都有；下課回來會帶信，上到一定堂數還會寄明信片
・來過的夥伴、收到的信和明信片，都收在圖鑑裡慢慢翻

【每天打開看一下】
・黑板每天換一則小知識
・練得越多，能看的職人小故事就越多
・可麗露偶爾會拜託你一點小事，做完有獎勵

【和場館連結】
・加入合作場館（場館使用 Kemanla）後，可以在 App 內預約課程
・沒有場館也能完整玩

【先說清楚】
・自己記的紀錄算給自己看，不會被擋
・幾天沒記也不會扣東西，星球和夥伴都還在
・不用付費就能玩
・設定裡可以刪除帳號，星球、夥伴、練習紀錄會一起刪掉

Astory 慢慢星是記錄習慣的遊戲，不提供醫療或健康建議。
部分場館資料來自政府開放資料（財政部、教育部、運動部），依政府資料開放授權條款－第1版。

name: AstroHarvest
description:
Fly your harvesting ship into the strangest sectors in the universe and haul out whatever you can find.

AstroHarvest is a pixel-art idle game about exploring, patience and a very slow climb toward somewhere deep in the universe.

HARVEST RESOURCES
Ore, gas and crystal, each with its own nodes, used to upgrade your ship.
Sell it all for gold, then put the gold straight back into your ship. Prestige and come back stronger than ever.

PROGRESS WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Set the autopilot and put your phone in your pocket. Resources keep gathering while you're gone, waiting to be sold when you get back. The game is built to be walked away from, not to punish you for leaving.

YOUR SAVE FOLLOWS YOU
Your progress is backed up automatically with Game Center or Sign in with Apple, so a new phone does not cost you your game.

NO PAY TO WIN
Real money buys cosmetics, the Founder's Pack and an Ad-Free Pass. Nothing you can buy makes you stronger. Ads are optional, rewarded, and never forced on you.

DATA AND PRIVACY
Signing in creates an account so your saves and purchases can follow you between devices. We collect anonymous analytics to find bugs and balance the game. You can delete your account and everything stored with it from inside the game, in Settings.

name: Atlas Belli
description:
Atlas Belli explains history’s great battles phase by phase, with animated maps and the look of an old atlas.

Choose a battle and see how the armies were deployed, which troops they were made of and how everything changed minute by minute, from the first move to its aftermath.

FOUR BATTLES, FROM ANTIQUITY TO NAPOLEON
• Cannae (216 BC): the perfect pincer. A smaller army surrounds and wipes out a much larger one.
• Agincourt (1415): mud, arrows and stakes. An exhausted English army destroys the flower of the French nobility.
• Nördlingen (1634): assault after assault, the Swedes crash against a hill defended by the tercios.
• Waterloo (1815): Napoleon stakes his empire on a single afternoon.

IN EVERY BATTLE
• The sides, with their flags, command, strength and casualties.
• An introduction with the background and the key facts.
• The order of battle: every unit has its own card, with who commanded it, how it fought and what part it played in the battle.
• An animated map, phase by phase, with automatic playback and the narrative of each phase. Tap a unit on the map to open its card.
• Full screen, with the map and the narrative together.
• The aftermath, with a chart of forces and casualties. Where the sources disagree, the chart shows the range.

EASY TO EXPLORE
• A timeline of all the battles, with a filter by era.
• In English and Spanish, with the established names in each language (Cannae and Cannas, Agincourt and Azincourt).
• Works offline: everything is inside the app.
• On iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape.
• Works with VoiceOver, larger text sizes and Reduce Motion.
• No accounts, no ads and no data collection.

Schematic maps for a general audience. The figures are estimates: the sources do not always agree.

name: Atom Up: Chemistry Climb
description:
Atom Up is a fast arcade climber about one small oxygen atom with big plans.

Pull back and fling your atom up from a kitchen stove, through the clouds and the storm belt, all the way to the stratosphere and beyond. The bottom of the screen keeps rising, so keep moving.

EVERY BUMP IS A CHOICE
Hit a hot pan, a soda can, a lightning bolt or a jet stream and pick one of three reaction cards. Play it safe, go bold or try something absurd. Become water, rust, ozone or carbon monoxide, and each form moves in its own way.

SKILL, NOT LUCK
- Land head-on hits for PERFECT reactions and bigger scores

name: auxCord Listen
description:
auxCord Listen plays the mix from a studio session on your phone, live, over the studio Wi-Fi. The engineer runs the auxCord plugin in their DAW, you open the app and tap the studio. That's it.

HEAR IT WHERE PEOPLE WILL HEAR IT
Most songs end up on a phone. Listen on its speaker or on your earbuds while the mix is still being made, not after the bounce.

PLATFORM PREVIEWS
Swipe through previews for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Spotify, Spotify Loud and Apple Music. Each card plays the mix at the volume that platform would turn it to and through the same kind of codec, and four lights tell you about level, low end, peaks and mono. Compare puts all six side by side. The previews are our models of each platform, not the platforms themselves.

METERS
Direct shows the mix's integrated and short-term loudness, loudness range, true peak, low end, mono loss and stereo correlation.

NOTES
Type a note while the mix plays (e.g. "Chorus is better") and it lands in the plugin, where the engineer reads it and can reply. It stays there after you've gone home.

RECORD A TAKE
If the engineer allows it, record the mix on your phone and play it back later. The studio sees that you're recording.

STUDIO CONNECT
Scan the studio's code to join its Wi-Fi without spelling out the password.

Keeps playing with the screen locked, with controls on the lock screen.

TRY IT WITHOUT A STUDIO
The Demo tile plays a built-in track through everything the app does, no plugin needed.

WHAT YOU NEED
- The auxCord 3.0 plugin (AAX, AU, VST3 for macOS and Windows) running in the studio, sold separately at mountainroaddsp.com

Free. No account, no ads, no tracking.

BeeWise LMS – Theo dõi lớp học thuận tiện, quản lý lịch trình chủ động và trao đổi dễ dàng trong mỗi hành trình học tập.

name: BeninConnect
description:
BéninConnect est l'application qui réunit les Béninoises et les Béninois, où qu'ils vivent : à Paris, Lyon, Bruxelles, Montréal, Cotonou ou ailleurs.

Retrouvez les gens de votre ville, partagez vos nouvelles, découvrez les événements de la communauté et gardez le lien avec le pays.

COMMUNAUTÉS
• Rejoignez les communautés de votre ville, de votre région ou de vos centres d'intérêt
• Études, entrepreneuriat, culture, entraide, sport : il y en a pour tous les profils
• Créez votre propre communauté, publique ou privée

FIL D'ACTUALITÉ
• Publiez vos nouvelles, vos photos et vos bons plans
• Réagissez et commentez les publications des membres
• Suivez l'actualité de chacune de vos communautés

ÉVÉNEMENTS
• Afterworks, fêtes, ateliers, rencontres professionnelles, cours en ligne…
• Filtrez par ville, par catégorie et par date
• Inscrivez-vous en un geste et retrouvez vos événements à venir
• Organisez vos propres événements pour votre communauté

MESSAGERIE
• Discutez en privé avec les autres membres
• Réagissez aux messages avec des emojis
• Recevez une notification dès qu'on vous écrit

VOTRE PROFIL
• Photo de profil, photo de couverture, présentation et centres d'intérêt
• Indiquez votre ville et votre parcours pour être retrouvé facilement
• Choisissez ce que vous partagez : profil privé, affichage de la ville, messages

NOTIFICATIONS
• Nouveaux messages, réactions, demandes d'adhésion, événements…
