Que vous veniez d'arriver dans une nouvelle ville ou que vous y viviez depuis longtemps, BéninConnect vous aide à créer des liens, à vous entraider et à faire vivre la culture béninoise.

Une question ou une suggestion ? Écrivez-nous depuis l'application ou sur notre site.

name: Bete Kristiyan – Church Order
description:
The Church and Church Order (Bete Kristiyan) is an Amharic book prepared by the education department of the Gospel Truth Church. It presents the teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ and his apostles that members of every local church should know, support and protect.

16 CHAPTERS
• Introduction
• What the church is
• Names and images of the church
• The local church
• The four gatherings of the local church
• Baptism
• Gifts of grace
• Discipleship
• Women's ministry
• The ministry of giving
• Local church membership
• Church leadership by elders
• Guidelines for church discipline
• False teachings and practices
• Engagement and marriage
• Statement of faith

READ COMFORTABLY
• Each chapter opens as the original printed pages
• Pinch to zoom and scroll through the pages
• Continue reading where you stopped
• Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: BEYEGA
description:
BEYEGA is your neighborhood marketplace for Addis Ababa. Find shops near you, see what's really in stock today, and order for pickup or delivery - paying by cash or mobile money directly with the seller.

Buy
- Search in Amharic or English and discover nearby shops with the items you need.
- See today's real availability, not stale listings.
- Choose pickup or delivery and arrange payment directly with the seller.

Sell
- Open a shop in minutes and list your products.
- Update what's available each day - even by voice.
- Reach buyers in your neighborhood.

One account works for both buying and selling. BEYEGA is Amharic-first and works on everyday connections.

Safe marketplace: report or block any shop from its page, and review our Community Guidelines in the app. We act on reports.

name: Bible by doing
description:
Bring a little scripture into everyday life.

Bible by doing pairs one short Bible passage with a gentle invitation and three practical actions for your day. Read, reflect, and mark the actions you choose to try.

A WHOLE YEAR OF PRACTICE
Explore 366 different readings and 1,098 original actions about kindness, patience, forgiveness, generosity, courage, and everyday faith.

YOUR YEAR, AT YOUR PACE
See your checkmarks in a yearly calendar. Revisit an earlier day, finish an unfinished practice, or begin a day again. Your progress stays on your device.

QUIET, NATIVE, AND OFFLINE
Read and practise without an app account, advertising, or analytics. Choose light, dark, or system appearance and a comfortable text size using your device settings.

FOUR LANGUAGES
English, French, Latin American Spanish, and German are included. Change the language in Settings without losing your checkmarks. Scripture editions are World English Bible, Louis Segond 1910, Reina-Valera 1909, and Lutherbibel 1912. The historical scripture translations retain their original wording; invitations and actions are separate application prompts.

TWO DAYS TO BEGIN
Your first two days are free. From day 3, one optional Full Year Unlock purchase gives permanent access to the whole collection and future revisits. No subscription. The price appears in your local App Store currency. Internet is needed to buy or restore; reading stays available offline after purchase.

A small beginning, every day.

name: BIDSSIGNAL
description:
Cocolume är en fokuserad fältjournal för kokosodlare, småbrukare och odlingsteam som vill förstå avkastningen per palm utan att fastna i kalkylark. Registrera varje insamling, bevara sammanhanget bakom siffrorna och se mönstren som betyder något över tid.

LOGGA DET SOM SPELAR ROLL
• Registrera antal nötter, nettovikt, skördedatum och fältväder
• Lägg till kvalitet A, B och C som valfria uppgifter
• Spara anteckningar om klasar, köpare och fältförhållanden
• Organisera skördarna per lund

FÖRSTÅ DIN LUND
• Jämför avkastning per palm mellan lundar och sorter
• Utforska 30 dagar, 90 dagar, ett år och all tid
• Se skörderytm, totalvikt och genomsnittlig skördestorlek
• Följ kvalitetsfördelning och journalens fullständighet
• Använd sortreferenser som planeringsstöd, inte som löften

BYGGD FÖR ARBETE I FÄLT
• Snabb registrering med stora kontroller och praktiska genvägar
• Fem fokuserade delar: Idag, Lundar, Logga, Insikter och Almanacka
• Praktisk säsongsalmanacka, skötselchecklistor och sortprofiler
• Svenska och engelska i hela appen
• Valfri veckopåminnelse

PRIVAT FRÅN BÖRJAN
BIDSISIlGINAL kräver inget konto. Dina poster stannar på din iPhone, utan molnkrav, analysverktyg eller annons-SDK:er. Exportera en CSV när du vill skapa en säkerhetskopia eller arbeta vidare i ett kalkylark.

Cocolume är ett verktyg för dokumentation och planering. Skörderesultat varierar med klimat, palmålder, jord och skötsel. Appen förutsäger inte skörd och ersätter inte lokal agronomisk rådgivning.

name: Big Fish, Blue Sea™
seller_name: What It Is What It Do LLC
description:
Hook a legend.

Big Fish, Blue Sea is big-game fishing the way you remember it — and then some. Read the morning forecast, rig your tackle, drive your own boat across a sea that moves like the real thing, and fight blue marlin, giant bluefin and swordfish from the chair. At four o'clock the whole marina turns out for the weigh-in.

TEN TOURNAMENTS, REAL WATERS
Start in the warm shallows of Coral Key and work your way through Bimini, the Dominican Republic, the Gulf's five states, North Carolina, Cape Cod and the Virgin Islands to the Big Blue Championship. 32 fishing spots, each on a hand-painted map.

FIND THE FISH
Watch for diving birds, bait balls, billfish shadows and whales. Troll slow past the action, keep the sun off your bow, and wait for the reel to scream.

THE FIGHT
Face the fish, pump the rod, reel on the way down, thumb the spool and set the drag. He'll run, sound, charge the boat and tail-walk across the surface — drop the rod tip when he jumps or he'll throw the hook. Big fish fight for a long time.

THE GAFF
Bring him alongside and watch him come up out of the water and over the side. Keep him for the scale or let him go.

A SEA THAT'S ALIVE
Glassy calm one morning, whitecaps and a rolling boat the next. Wind and current push you off your line, head seas slow you down, and sometimes it rains.

11 FISH, 8 LURES, REAL TACKLE CHOICES
Blue, black, striped and white marlin, sailfish, swordfish, yellowfin and giant bluefin tuna, makos, barracuda and dorado. Four line tests, line length and depth — rig wrong and the fish will tell you.

YOUR CREW, YOUR RIVAL
Twenty anglers to play as. Cap'n Ray Boudreaux coaches every move. Vance Sterling wants your trophy.

PLAY ANYONE, LIVE
Quick Match finds an angler at your level, or send a friend a code. Everyone fishes the same water, the same weather and the same clock, with a live leaderboard.

LEVEL UP
Muscle, Body and Skill grow from D to AA as you fish, and open up the trophy fish.

FREE TO START
Land your first 3 fish free. One purchase unlocks the full game on iPhone, iPad and Mac. No ads, no subscriptions.

All characters and tournaments are fictional.

name: BikeCastix
description:
What will the weather be like when you get there?

BikeCastix combines your GPX route with the forecast for your planned ride. Choose a date, departure time and average speed to see the conditions you are likely to encounter along the way.

YOUR TOUR AT A GLANCE
• Import a GPX file through Files or the file picker.
• View your route on the map with direction arrows and an elevation profile when elevation data is available.
• Plan using your preferred departure time and speed.

WEATHER ALONG YOUR ROUTE
• Temperature, rain probability, precipitation amount, wind and available UV data.
• Weather symbols and charts along the route.
• Arrival times that account for planned breaks.
• An additional wind estimate shows how wind might affect riding time.

BREAKS AND REFUELLING
• Find cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, fuel stations and drinking water near your route.
• Plan break durations and bicycle-routed detours.
• Check available opening hours for your estimated arrival.

TAKE YOUR PLAN WITH YOU
• Export your updated route as GPX.
• Create a PDF planning report with a map, charts and breaks.

NO ACCOUNT REQUIRED
Your GPX file is read on your device, not uploaded as a file. After you enable online services, coordinates and technical connection data are sent to external providers for maps, weather, routing and places. You can withdraw this choice at any time under Privacy. Local GPX import remains available without online services.

BikeCastix is free to use. The optional Coffee Donation in-app purchase lets you support development. It unlocks no features and is not a subscription.

IMPORTANT
Online planning requires an internet connection. Weather is available only within the provider's forecast period. Forecasts, routes, elevation and opening hours may be inaccurate or incomplete. The wind estimate is a simplified model, not a guaranteed riding time. Check official weather warnings, traffic rules and actual conditions on site. BikeCastix is a planning tool, not live navigation or a safety or weather-alert service.

Data sources: Apple Maps, Open-Meteo, OpenStreetMap contributors and BRouter.

name: Bingo 90 Assistant
description:
Lots of tickets, no stress: Bingo 90 Assistant reads your paper tickets and alerts you as soon as one of them wins. Perfect for bingo at the club, a charity night or a family game.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan your tickets: hold your phone over a ticket. The app reads the 15 numbers, the ticket number and the paper colour. Uncertain fields are highlighted. You can correct anything or type the numbers in by hand.
2. Type the numbers: enter each number as it is called. The app checks all your tickets at once.
3. See the win: one line, two lines or a full house, the alert shows the scan number, ticket number and colour, so you pick up the right ticket straight away.

FEATURES
• Prizes: one line, two lines, full house and several full houses, plus ambo, terno and quaterna
• "Almost there": which tickets need just one more number, and which number
• Games and ticket sets: new game with the same or with new tickets, play only some tickets or colours
• History: add a missed number, fix a typo, wins are recalculated; look back at earlier games
• Torch for scanning in dark halls
• The screen stays on during the game
• Light or dark mode
• English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español

HOST AND FAMILY GAMES
• Call the numbers: the app draws each number and reads it out, or you enter the ball from your drum. Board 1–90, landscape on a tablet or TV too.
• Join with a code: players without paper tickets get digital tickets on their phone with the host’s code.
• Check a win: the host scans the paper ticket or the digital ticket’s QR code, or types the numbers. Green means valid.

WHICH TICKETS?
For 90-ball tickets: 3 rows, 9 columns, 15 numbers per ticket (column 1: 1–9, column 2: 10–19 … column 9: 80–90). This is the standard ticket for bingo in the UK and Ireland, Lotto in Switzerland, Loto in France, Tombola in Italy and bingo in Spain.
Not suitable for 75-ball bingo (5×5 cards) or for 80-ball or 30-ball games.

PRICE
Your first 4 tickets are free. The full version unlocks unlimited tickets (up to 50 per set) and handing out digital tickets. Joining with a code is free for up to 4 tickets per game. A one-off purchase: no subscription, no ads.

PRIVACY
No account needed. Your tickets and numbers stay on your phone. Photos are deleted right after recognition.

PLEASE NOTE
The app is a helper for players with paper tickets. It does not sell tickets, take stakes or pay out prizes. Your paper ticket and the organiser's decision always count.

Questions or ideas? In the app under Settings → Contact.

name: Biome: Breathing & Grounding
description:
Biome is a small garden for the moments that feel like too much.

When you need a minute, Biome gives you something small and real to do. Breathe with a soft guide: a slow breath, a sigh breath, box breathing, 4-7-8, or a pattern of your own, with a gentle tap at every step so you can close your eyes. Name five things you can see, hear and touch. Or play something soft that holds your attention, solved with one finger, sitting up or lying down.

Luna, a small black cat, keeps you company. She shows you around, curls up nearby, and never needs anything from you.

Every moment you spend here helps your Biome grow. It grows slowly over the year, finds something new now and then, and never takes anything away. No scores, no timers pressing on you, nothing to fail. Biome counts the different days you came, not days in a row.

Make it yours. Name your Biome and share a picture of it; with Biome+, arrange it as you like. The colours follow the time of day, from a warm morning to a quiet night, and so does the music: soft recorded soundscapes, nature sounds and real bells that ease in and never rush you. One tap mutes the music.

Private by design. Everything stays on your phone: no account, no tracking, no ads. Lock your journal with Face ID, export everything as a file, or delete it all in Settings.

Free, for good: every breathing pattern, Five senses, three calming games, the daily rituals and Today's three, your Biome as it grows with its gifts, and every journal page you have written, to read, lock and export.

Biome+ adds seven more moments (Lantern release, Reset, Pebble, Firefly trace, Pulse tap, Constellation and Petal spectrum) and the keepsakes they bring, writing new pages in your journal, and arranging your Biome. Yearly with a 7-day free trial, monthly, or once for good. You can also say thanks with a heart lantern; it unlocks nothing.

Biome+ yearly and monthly renew automatically until you cancel, at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple Account settings. Terms: https://rhinecom.com/biome/terms. Privacy: https://rhinecom.com/biome/privacy.

Biome is a place to pause. It is not a medical service and not a substitute for professional care.

name: Biophony: Bug Chorus
description:
Biophony is a spatial-audio instrument you walk through.

Put on headphones, scan your floor, and place singing creatures on it: a bullfrog, a green frog, a cicada, a katydid, a tree cricket and a field cricket. Each one is painted like a plate from a naturalist's notebook. Then walk among them.

Every creature listens to its neighbours and nudges the timing of its next call, the way real insect and frog choruses do. Nudge one way and a species falls into calling together. Nudge the other way and it takes turns. Near neighbours pull on each other harder than distant ones, so calls roll across the room in waves. Nobody tells them to synchronize. A gauge shows how together each species is.

Each creature is rendered binaurally in the app, from measured head-related impulse responses, so you hear it from the spot where you put it. Walk away from a group and it fades out behind you.

Two pages:
• Field: place creatures on the floor and listen.
• Tune: shape each species. Behavior (together or apart), call rate, register, how many notes, how melodic, brightness, texture, width, and the room's space.

The voices are synthesized, not sampled. Each call is rebuilt from measurements of a real field recording: pulse rate, spectral peaks, call shape. The recordists are credited in the app.

Slide a species' Voice from Bug toward its instrument and the call turns into it: bullfrog into bass, green frog into plucked bass, field cricket into glockenspiel, tree cricket into flute, katydid into pizzicato, cicada into a bowed drone. The rhythm stays. The notes come from a shared harmony that moves slowly.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing leaves your phone.

Needs headphones and an iPhone that supports ARKit. The phone is the listener: turn the phone, not just your head.

Biophony puts published science together in one instrument: phase-response models of animal choruses and binaural rendering. It makes no new scientific claim. Field notes in the app says exactly what it builds on.

name: BJJ Timer: Roll & Round Clock
description:
BJJ Timer is a round timer built for the mat. Set your rounds once, put the phone down and train.

ROUNDS YOUR WAY
• Rounds, roll time, rest and a get-ready countdown
• Presets for class rolls, open mat, positional sparring, drilling, shark tank and competition prep
• IBJJF adult match lengths by belt, from 5 minutes for white belts to 10 minutes for black belts

CUES YOU CAN HEAR ACROSS THE GYM
• A bell to start each round and a triple bell to end it
• A clapper warning before time runs out
• A halfway cue for switching sides or swapping top and bottom
• Countdown beeps at the end of get-ready and rest
• Vibration cues and sounds that play in silent mode and over your music

BIG, CLEAR SCREEN
• Full-screen colours for get-ready, rolling, the last seconds and rest
• Huge digits, a progress ring and a round tracker in portrait or landscape
• The screen stays awake while the timer runs

LOCK-SCREEN COUNTDOWN
• Follow the countdown on the iPhone Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island with a Live Activity
• The timer and bells keep going when the phone is locked

No account, ads or tracking. Your settings stay on your device.

Try the full timer free for 10 days. After the trial, a one-time in-app purchase unlocks it permanently. There is no automatic charge or subscription.

name: Black Friday World
description:
Black Friday World brings the best Black Friday, White Friday and Efsane Cuma deals from 30 countries into one premium app.

• Pick your market - the app detects your country and shows deals curated for it
• Live deals - local offers, updated daily for each country
• Countdown - know exactly how long until the big day, with optional reminders the day before and on the day
• Discount calculator - stack a discount and an extra coupon, see your real price in your local currency
• Native in your language - English, Spanish, Italian, German, French, Arabic, Turkish, Czech, Slovak, Slovenian, Croatian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Icelandic, Greek and more

Available markets include the United States, Canada, Australia, Ireland, India, South Africa, Singapore, Mexico, Spain, Italy, Belgium, Luxembourg, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Turkey, Czechia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Croatia, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Cyprus, Iceland and Liechtenstein.

name: Black Market Boss Mafia Story
description:
How far would you go to save your father?

You are a port clerk with $18.42 in the bank. Then your father collapses at the Kane depot. The doctors find an industrial toxin in his blood. Someone has been poisoning him for months. The treatment costs $50,000 a dose, and he needs three.

Your partner won't pick up the phone. Your boss takes the credit for your work. And a quiet man in a grey suit has an offer: $10,000 for every container you clear through customs. No questions asked.

In Black Market Boss, you choose who you are: play as a man or a woman. Every choice is yours, and every choice has a price.

YOUR CHOICES, YOUR STORY
Every chapter puts you in front of a real decision. Take the envelope or walk away. Confront the cheater or read their secrets. Lie to the detective or play along. Your choices change who trusts you, who betrays you and how your story ends.

FROM CLERK TO BLACK MARKET BOSS
Start at the bottom: a desk at Harbor Line Logistics and a stack of cargo manifests nobody reads. Learn the tricks of the trade, clear your first illegal container and watch $10,000 land in your account. Then build something bigger: your own freight firm, your own crew, your own rules.

THE CLOCK IS TICKING
Your father's next dose is always days away. Every run brings you closer to the money, and closer to getting caught. Can you raise $150,000 in 42 days?

A CITY FULL OF SECRETS
• Victor Kane: the crime boss who owns most of the port
• The Man in Grey: Kane's quiet fixer, watching you from day one
• Detective Alvarez: the customs cop who already has your name
• Your partner: never there when you needed them most
• Dr. Ruiz: the doctor fighting to keep your father alive

Who really poisoned your father? The answer is closer than you think.

KEY FEATURES
• A cinematic interactive crime story told in short, gripping chapters
• Play as a man or a woman
• Choices that matter, with premium choices that unlock secret scenes
• Fully voiced characters and a dramatic soundtrack
• Romance, betrayal, money and power: a mafia drama in your pocket
• New chapters keep the story going

From a broke clerk to the boss of the port's black market, the journey is yours. But in this world, every dollar comes with a debt.

Download Black Market Boss now and decide how far you would go for family.

name: Blast Off!
description:
Launch from the pad and fly as high as you can. Tilt your phone to steer, or drag your finger. Touch anything and it's over.

The climb follows the real order of things: birds and hot-air balloons low down, airliners at cruising height, then the edge of space, satellites and laser fences, meteor showers, an alien blockade and the planets beyond. Past that, deep space keeps changing: asteroid belts, ion storms, black holes, space stations and alien armadas. There's no end: the only limit is you.

- Tilt or drag to steer, whichever you like, sitting up or lying down
- Hard from the first second, and one tap to try again
- Skim past things for close-call combos
- Grab fuel orbs or your engine cuts out
- A laser comes online in space: blast rocks and alien fighters
- Fit one gadget per flight: an orb magnet, slow motion, a shield or a heavy laser
- Missions to finish and pilot ranks to climb, each adding to your score
- 15 rockets, paint jobs, wing colours, decals, flames, smoke trails and glowing trails, plus collections that win items you can't buy
- Weather and seasons at the launch pad: sun, dusk, rain, snow, desert and autumn
- Distance leaderboard on Game Center

Free to play, with ads. Optional orb packs, Remove Ads, a Supporter Pack and a once-only Starter Pack. Everything can also be earned by playing.

Contains a short white flash when you crash. Turn on Less Flashing in Settings to soften it.

name: Blkbropro
description: How far are Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana from their recorded highs? Enter daily open, high, low, close and volume figures, or import your existing records from a CSV file. Compare closing prices and days of data coverage side by side, then tap an asset to explore its history. Slide across the candlestick chart to inspect prices and volume, and follow the seven-day moving average to see how the trend changes. Use the drawdown curve to spot the deepest decline and revisit the records for that period. Search by asset or date to find a particular session. Your research stays on your device, ready to edit or export whenever you like, with no account required.

name: Blob Blend
description:
Slide. Mix. Fill.

Blob Blend is a cozy color-mixing puzzle. Swipe a blob of paint and it slides until something stops it. Bump two blobs together and they mix: red and yellow make orange, yellow and blue make green, red and blue make purple. Pour the right color into every glass cup to finish the palette.

But careful: mix all three and you get mud.

• 150 puzzles in 6 chapters, from tiny 5×6 tables to 7×9 masterpieces
• Every puzzle checked by a solver, always fair, always a way through
• Earn 3 stars by finding the shortest solution
• A new Daily Blend puzzle every day
• No timers, no lives. Undo and restart anytime, hints for free
• Squishy blobs, juicy splats, chiming cups
• Color letters option for color-vision accessibility, Reduce Motion support
• Plays offline, no account needed

Made by Moonlit Arcade.

name: Blog Julien Delmas
description:
L’application Blog Julien Delmas rassemble les contenus et les outils du blog pour les personnels de l’Éducation nationale.

• Consultez les articles du blog et recherchez les sujets qui vous intéressent.

Application personnelle et non officielle, publiée par l’auteur du blog. Elle n’est ni éditée ni soutenue par le ministère de l’Éducation nationale, les académies ou Index Éducation (Pronote).

name: Blubing
description:
Blubing connects people nearby over Bluetooth, without an internet connection, account or phone number.

CHAT NEARBY
Send direct and group messages, photos, voice notes, files, polls and original animated Blu stickers. Direct and group conversations are end-to-end encrypted. Pin useful messages and organize shared checklists.

MEET AND SHARE
See nearby people on Radar, choose what your profile shares and post to the local board. Nearby board posts are visible to people in range.

PLAY TOGETHER
Invite nearby friends to Chess, Crazy Eights, Imposter, Four in a Row, Reversi, Dots and Boxes, Gomoku and Bluff Dice. Supported games also offer solo play against Blu or in-person play with private roles, cards or votes on each player’s own phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Blubing has no messaging server, advertising or analytics. Your identity and chat history stay on your device.

Bluetooth must be enabled and the required permissions allowed. Nearby communication depends on range, obstacles and your phone’s background restrictions. Other players need a compatible Blubing version.

name: Blueee
description:
Blueee remembers where you were when a Bluetooth device leaves you, then helps you look for it nearby. It is for bands, earbuds, key tags and other Bluetooth Low Energy devices you add yourself.

The last place
These devices have no GPS of their own. Blueee uses your iPhone’s location instead. The moment a device connects or disconnects, it saves where you were. If you allow location in the background, it can do this while the app is not open, and it keeps the trail from the day before the device left. Open the map and walk there.

Find it up close
Pick a device and watch the live signal. The colour warms and the phone buzzes faster as you get closer, and eases off when you move away.

Walk to locate
A phone cannot point straight at an ordinary Bluetooth device. Hold the phone upright and walk a short L-shape. Blueee combines that path with the signal and shows an arrow, then a hot-and-cold cue when you are close. With headphones, a tone can suggest a direction. AirPods that support head tracking keep the cue aimed as you turn your head. This is an estimate. A dark room or a blank wall can make the path tracking fail.

On this iPhone
Devices, places and trails stay on this phone. There is no account, and nothing is uploaded. You can erase all of it in Settings.

Blueee only sees Bluetooth Low Energy devices you add in the app. Classic Bluetooth accessories that do not advertise over BLE will not appear. A pin is where your phone was, not a location inside the device. You decide whether to go.

name: Body Fat Calc: US Navy Method
description:
Your abdomen or waist circumference goes into Apple Health, together with body fat percentage, weight, BMI and lean mass. Saving is part of the one-time in-app purchase; calculating and the measuring guide are free.

With a tape measure and a scale you can estimate your body fat percentage yourself. You enter your measurements, the app applies the classic US Navy formula (Hodgdon & Beckett 1984) and shows your body fat percentage, BMI and lean mass.

What you measure
Men: height, weight, neck and abdomen at navel height.
Women: height, weight, neck, waist at its narrowest point and hips.
The measuring guide shows in a picture where the tape goes. You can work in centimetres and kilograms or in inches and pounds.

Next time
Your measurements stay filled in for the next session. Anything left over from before is labelled "from last time", so an old weight does not pass as a new measurement.

Saving to Apple Health (in-app purchase)
With the in-app purchase, the app writes your measurement to Apple Health with one tap. The circumference saved is the abdomen for men and the waist for women. The app asks for write access only and reads nothing from Apple Health.

History in the app (in-app purchase)
The in-app purchase also lists every saved measurement in the history with its date, including hip circumference, which Apple Health has no data type for. You can delete single entries.

One-time purchase, no subscription
Calculating and the measuring guide are free. Saving to Apple Health and the history are unlocked with a single in-app purchase. There is no subscription, no ads and no account.

Your data
The app does not send your measurements to any server. Only if you agree, it transmits which features are used for anonymous usage statistics, never measurements or health data. You can turn this off at any time in Settings. Purchases are managed by the RevenueCat service using a random identifier, with no link to your measurements.

Important
The result is an estimate based on body measurements. This app is not a medical device, makes no diagnoses and gives no treatment or diet advice. If you have questions about your health, talk to a doctor.

This app is made by LinguaFlow e.U. and has no connection to the US Navy or the US Department of Defense. "US Navy" only refers to where the formula comes from.

name: BokiNova 簿記3級 仕訳・模擬試験
description:
BokiNova（ボキノバ）は、日商簿記検定 3 級の対策アプリです。ネット試験・統一試験のどちらにも対応した本番形式で、テキスト・一問一答・模擬試験を一つのアプリで。弱点の分析と合格予測が、次に何をやるかを決めてくれます。

■ 今日の学習（弱点の分析と合格予測）
一問一答の正誤と模擬試験の採点結果を単元ごとに集め、正答率の低い単元を弱点として出します。復習の期限が来た問題（忘却曲線: 1 → 3 → 7 → 14 → 30 日）、弱点の単元、まだ解いていない問題を 20 問に組んだ「今日の学習」をホームに用意します。本番の配点に出来を当てはめた合格予測の点も毎日更新されます。

■ テキスト（35 本）
単元ごとに、要点・仕訳の型・迷いやすいところ・「ここが出る」を短くまとめました。読んだらそのまま単元の問題へ進めます。

■ 一問一答（501 問）
7 つの科目・35 の単元に分けた問題を、1 問ずつ解いてすぐ解説を読めます。仕訳のほか、○× と金額の計算も。
・現金・預金: 現金過不足、当座預金と当座借越、小口現金、普通預金・定期預金
・商品売買: 仕入と売上、返品、諸掛、前払金・前受金、クレジット売掛金・受取商品券
・債権・債務: 売掛金・買掛金、手形・電子記録債権、貸付金・借入金、未収入金・未払金、立替金・預り金、仮払金・仮受金、差入保証金
・固定資産: 取得、減価償却、売却、修繕と改良
・税金・資本: 租税公課、法人税等、消費税、株式会社の資本、配当と利益剰余金
・決算: 貸倒引当金、経過勘定、貯蔵品、決算振替、精算表・財務諸表、試算表
・帳簿・伝票: 補助簿、勘定記入、伝票、証ひょう
仕訳は本番と同じく、候補の勘定科目から選んで借方・貸方に金額を入れる形式です。間違えた問題とブックマークで、苦手なところだけを繰り返せます。

■ 模擬試験（本番形式・15 回分）
第1問 仕訳 15 問（45 点）、第2問（20 点）、第3問 精算表・財務諸表（35 点）。制限時間 60 分、100 点満点で 70 点以上が合格の目安です。筆記と同じ流れで解き、自動で採点します。全問の正解と解説で見直せ、その回で落とした単元はテキストにつながります。
問題冊子・答案用紙・採点表を印刷して紙で解き、答えを入れて採点することもできます。

■ 通知
毎日のリマインダー（時刻を選べます）は、その日の復習の数と弱点の単元を本文にします。本番の日を入れると、ホームに残り日数が出て、1 週間前・3 日前・前日・当日にも知らせます。

■ 記録
合格予測（大問ごと）、弱点の単元、科目ごとの正答率、模擬試験の点の推移、日ごとの学習量を残します。

■ 料金
無料: 各科目の最初の 20 問と最初の単元のテキスト、模擬試験の第1回（印刷・紙の採点を含む）。弱点の分析・合格予測・通知は無料で使えます。
すべての問題（買い切り ¥980、1 回払い）: すべての一問一答・テキスト・模擬試験。今後の版で増える問題も追加料金なしで使えます。
・サブスクリプションではありません。自動更新はなく、お支払いは 1 回だけです。
・機種を変えたときは、同じ Apple ID で「購入を復元」を押すと引き継げます。

■ 安心してお使いいただくために
通信をしません。アカウントも広告もありません。記録はこの iPhone の中だけに残り、通知もこの iPhone の中で組みます。

■ 問題について
問題と解説はすべて当社の書き下ろしで、実際の試験の過去問ではありません。出題範囲は日本商工会議所の出題区分表（2026 年度）に合わせています。誤りに気づかれた場合は、サポートページからお知らせください。

• Five new phrases a day, each with an example sentence

• Spaced repetition: phrases you're unsure of come back until they stick

name: Bonne Note: examen civique
description:
Prepare for the examen civique, France's civic exam, the way it is really taken: 40 multiple-choice questions in French, 45 minutes, pass with 32 correct answers. Since January 1, 2026, it is required for a first carte de séjour pluriannuelle (multi-year residence permit), a first carte de résident (10-year resident card) and naturalisation (French citizenship). Bonne Note follows the official list for your application.

Independent app, not affiliated with the French Ministry of the Interior (Ministère de l'Intérieur) or any public service. The official questions come from the lists the ministry publishes on formation-civique.interieur.gouv.fr and immigration.interieur.gouv.fr, reproduced unchanged. The answer options, corrections, translations and practical scenarios are written by Trifoil Trailblazer.

EVERY OFFICIAL QUESTION, FREE
• Every knowledge question from the official lists, word for word in French, with its source and date: 191 for the carte de séjour pluriannuelle (CSP), 209 for the carte de résident, 259 for naturalisation.
• Four answer options and a short correction for each question, with the official fact sheet it is based on.
• A "Report an error" button on every question.

MOCK EXAMS LIKE THE REAL ONE
• 40 questions in the official mix: 28 knowledge questions and 12 practical scenarios.
• A 45-minute clock and the 32/40 pass mark.
• Valider (confirm), Passer la question (skip), no going back, as in France Éducation international's candidate manual.
• Your result by theme, then every answer reviewed with its correction.

PRACTICE A LITTLE EVERY DAY
• Practice by theme: the five exam themes, from the principles and values of the Republic to daily life in France.
• My mistakes: questions you got wrong come back until you know them.
• Questions: the full list for your track with the right answer, plus search.
• Review by listening: a French voice reads the question, the four options, then the right answer.

120 PRACTICAL SCENARIOS
The exam's practical scenarios are not published. We wrote 120 practice questions on everyday situations (secularism, equality between women and men, discrimination, work, school), always labeled as written by Bonne Note.

YOUR LANGUAGE, FRENCH FIRST
Every question, its options and its correction are translated into English, Arabic, Turkish, Chinese, Spanish and Portuguese, under the French text, which is the reference. The real exam is in French only, so mock exams hide the translation by default.

FREE OR PRO
Free: every official question with corrections and translations, practice by theme, My mistakes, the question list, review by listening and one full mock exam.
Pro, one payment, no subscription: unlimited mock exams and the 120 practical scenarios. Everything that comes from the ministry stays free.

No account, no ads, works offline. Bonne Note is a study aid: it does not replace the official websites and does not guarantee a pass.

name: BookFlat: Book & Doc Scanner

BookFlat turns printed books and documents into flat, clean, searchable files.

POINT, HOLD, DONE

• Turn the page and it captures the next one — scan a whole chapter in one go
• Prefer control? Switch to manual and tap the shutter yourself

KNOWS A BOOK FROM A DOCUMENT
• Smart mode splits an open book into left and right pages, and keeps single sheets as one page

TEXT RECOGNITION

• Copy all the text in one tap, and search your library by what’s on the page

EXPORT & SHARE

• Four quality levels; share anywhere or save to Files

STAY ORGANIZED
• Books, Documents and Favorites
• Reorder, add or delete pages, rename documents
• Light and Dark appearance

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Capturing, cropping and text recognition all happen on your iPhone. No photos or text are uploaded. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

BOOKFLAT PRO

name: Boolith
description:
Boolith is an offline Karnaugh-map studio for digital logic design. Enter minterms, set don’t-care cells, and get a minimal sum-of-products with clear visual group boundaries on the map.

WHAT YOU CAN DO • Work with 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 variables
• Tap cells to cycle 0 → 1 → X, or paste minterm lists and ranges
• Auto-generate prime-implicant covers with color-coded overlays
• Review simplified SOP and POS expressions
• Open a truth table to verify the cover
• Save maps locally, pin favorites, and search your library
• Compare two maps to see how don’t-cares change cost and cover
• Share expressions and map snapshots via the system share sheet
• Read a short field guide plus built-in examples

BUILT FOR REAL DESIGN WORK Boolith is a simplification and visualization tool — not a quiz or homework grader. Use it for lecture prep, lab notes, circuit write-ups, or quick cover checks when you need a readable K-map result.

PRIVACY-FIRST AND OFFLINE Maps and preferences stay on your device. No account. No ads. No analytics SDKs. Delete individual maps anytime, or erase all local data from Settings.

Open Boolith, enter a few minterms, and see the groups form.

name: Box O' Games
description:
Grab a phone. Start the party.

Box O' Games is a toy box of party games the whole family plays together on one phone. No setup, no boards, no pieces to lose. It's made for waiting in line, road trips, restaurants and family game night.

GUESS UP
Hold the phone to your forehead while everyone shouts clues. Tilt down when you get it, tilt up to pass. Every card has a picture, so kids who can't read yet can join in.

PASS IT
Describe the word fast, then pass the phone before the buzzer goes off. Play it hot-potato style around the circle, or take timed turns.

ROUNDS
Fill the hat, then play the same cards three ways: describe them, act them out, then make noises only. It gets sillier every round.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• 22 decks and more than 2,600 cards: animals, food, feelings, space, holidays, fairy tales, movie night, made-up superpowers and more
• Grown-up decks with trickier words for older players
• Add your own words, like family names, inside jokes or your last trip
• Teams of any size, with player names
• Tilt or tap controls for little hands
• Fresh cards first, so you're not stuck seeing the same words
• Bouncy sounds, music and vibration, each with its own off switch
• No ads, no subscriptions, no accounts, no data collected
• Works offline
• A grown-up check before every purchase

Guess Up and three starter decks are free. Add Pass It, Rounds and extra decks one at a time, or unlock everything at once.

Bạn đang bán hàng online và muốn lưu lại quá trình đóng gói để làm bằng chứng khi có khiếu nại về đơn hàng?

- Hỗ trợ tra cứu video khi cần kiểm tra hoặc xử lý khiếu nại.

- Cân bằng chất lượng hình ảnh và dung lượng lưu trữ.

- Cửa hàng kinh doanh thương mại điện tử.
- Đơn vị cần lưu video làm bằng chứng đóng gói.

name: BranchTalk: Conversation Paths
description:
Practice Every Conversation.

An interview. A client deadline. A thoughtful piece of feedback. Some conversations deserve a little preparation.

BranchTalk is a private notebook for planning what you might say and exploring what could happen next. Write an opening situation, add possible replies, and give each direction its own follow-up or ending. Then rehearse a path at your own pace.

MAKE ROOM FOR POSSIBILITIES
Build and edit branching conversation plans. Reorder replies, duplicate a branch, keep preparation notes, and view the structure on a map you can zoom and explore.

START WITH SOMETHING USEFUL
Make six offline templates your own: Job Interview, Client Deadline Discussion, Salary Discussion, Project Presentation Q&A, Constructive Feedback and Customer Support Conversation.

PRACTICE WITHOUT PRESSURE
Choose replies from your saved plan, step back to try another direction, and reflect on the path you explored. No scores. No judgments.

KEEP YOUR THOUGHTS CLOSE
Your scenarios and completed rehearsals are stored on your iPhone. There are no accounts, ads, analytics or AI services. Every feature works offline. Export a JSON backup to a destination you choose in Files, and restore it when needed.

YOUR SPACE, YOUR WAY
Find scenarios with local search and category filters, pin important plans, and choose light, dark or system appearance.

BranchTalk presents authored conversation paths. It does not generate replies, recognize speech, or predict how another person will respond.

name: Branthel

Branthel är en liten verkstad med två bänkar. På blandningsbänken ställer du malning, klister och fukt, och läser jämnhet och klimp. På sigillbänken ställer du tryck, spår, tork och ordning, och läser brinntid och brott.

Branthel samlar inte in och skickar inte data. Ingen analys och ingen reklam. Tar du bort appen töms verkstaden.

name: Breath for Singers – Appoggio
description:
Appoggio is Italian for "support" — the bel canto technique of supporting the voice with the breath. This app is breath training for classical singers, musical theater and contemporary vocalists, aspiring singers, and anyone who wants to sing better.

■ 4 TRAINING METHODS
• Extended Inhale Training — build breath support with long, steady inhalations
• Foundational Breath Support — balance a slow inhale and exhale
• Diaphragm Agility Warm-up — wake up the diaphragm with quick breaths
• Real Singing Breath Simulation — a short inhale and a long exhale, just like singing

■ LEVELS
Beginner, intermediate, advanced, or a custom level with your own seconds. You see the seconds for each step before you start.

■ STEP-BY-STEP TIMER
Inhale → open the throat → exhale → release: always see which step you're in. Sound and vibration cues mark each change, and the screen stays on while you train. 5 timer styles (circle, bar, wave, ring, equalizer).

■ HISTORY & REMINDERS
Current streak, total days, and a progress calendar that fills in when you complete all four methods in a day. Up to 5 daily reminders.

■ DISPLAY
Korean, English, German and Italian, dark mode, and 3 color themes (navy, bordeaux, charcoal).

■ EVERYTHING FREE
No sign-up, no purchases. Your training history stays on your device, and we collect no personal data.

Looking for a singing teacher? welegato, the music-lesson platform by Vicino Labs (the makers of Appoggio), connects you with teachers in Germany and Austria.

Note: breathing exercises do not replace medical advice or lessons with a qualified teacher. If you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally.

name: Breathland: Relax & Sleep
description:
Calm down in three minutes. A small light walks a mountain ridge: up means breathe in, flat means hold, down means breathe out. Hold the screen as it climbs, let go as it falls. No counting, no timers to watch.

BREATHING YOU CAN SEE
Box breathing, 4-7-8, coherent breathing and ten more patterns, each drawn as the ridge you walk. You always know what comes next, so your mind can rest.

TEN LANDS, AND MORE ON THE WAY
Dusk Range, Night Crossing, Coastal Shelf, Glacier Lakes, Autumn Larches, Rain Cedars, Storm Peaks, Cloud Sea, Fjord Cliffs and Blossom Terraces. Each one is hand-crafted, with its own weather, wildlife and moments: fireflies as the dusk deepens, the aurora over falling snow, a whale off the coast, a rainbow after the rain. Every breath is a ridge, and three minutes a day opens a new land every week or so. New lands, each with its own soundtrack, are on the way.

MUSIC THAT BREATHES WITH YOU
Every land has its own soundtrack, made live as you breathe, so it is never the same twice. The music opens as you breathe in; on the coast the waves keep time with you. Two hand bells mark each breath. Best with earphones in.

FOR SLEEP, STRESS AND FOCUS
- 4-7-8 and the long exhale to wind down at night
- Box and coherent breathing to steady a busy day
- Double sigh for a quick reset
- Wake and power breathing for a clear head
- Sessions of 1, 3, 5 or 10 minutes, and a gentle daily reminder if you want one

FELT AS WELL AS SEEN
A soft wave of vibration rises as you breathe in and slows as you breathe out, so you can close your eyes and follow along.

YOUR JOURNEY
A streak, an in-step score and a postcard of every session. Your progress follows you to a new phone when you sign in.

NO ADS, EVER
No tracking, nothing sold. Export or delete your data any time.

ONE HONEST THING
Breathland is a relaxation aid, not medical treatment. If you feel dizzy or short of breath, stop and breathe normally.

SUBSCRIPTION
Breathland needs a subscription: yearly (with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Breathland terms: https://breathland.renaiss.cc/terms
Privacy policy: https://breathland.renaiss.cc/privacy

name: BrewJournal
description:
BrewJournal is a thoughtful coffee notebook for the moments between opening a fresh bag and finding a cup you want to brew again. Bring your beans, recipes, grinder settings and tasting notes together in one place, so each adjustment has a little more context.

Build a coffee shelf with the name, roaster, origin, processing method and roast date of every bag. Keep track of the grams remaining and see roughly how many cups are waiting to be brewed. When you record a cup, its coffee dose is allocated from the selected bag. Your bean profile also gathers the cups made with that coffee, making it easier to revisit the parameters that suited it.

Create recipes for V60, AeroPress, French Press or espresso. Set the coffee dose, water weight, temperature, grind guide and target duration, then add your own technique notes. A ratio calculator helps you explore the relationship between dose and water before saving a new recipe. Suggested pour targets give filter brews a practical starting structure, while immersion methods have their own steeping and pressing guidance.

Use the brew timer to follow elapsed time alongside the recipe and water targets. Pause when needed and finish by recording the actual details of your cup. Choose a grinder, note its setting and capture the variables that matter to your routine. Each cup preserves its own coffee and recipe details, helping your journal remain meaningful as your collection changes.

After tasting, rate the cup and record acidity, sweetness, body, flavors and finish. Compare two recorded brews in aligned columns to see differences in ratio, grind, temperature, duration and tasting. Brew insights show the methods you use, your recorded coffee consumption and the ratings of recent cups. Clear light and dark appearances keep the notebook comfortable to read throughout the day.

BrewJournal begins with sample beans, recipes and cups to show how a brewing notebook can fit together. Replace them with your own coffee and build a record at your own pace. Your next excellent cup can start with a useful note from the last one.

name: BubbleJournal: Scuba Dive Log
description:
BubbleJournal is a dive log for every dive computer. Download your dives over Bluetooth, keep your whole diving life in one logbook, and see it on your iPhone or on the web.

DOWNLOAD STRAIGHT FROM YOUR DIVE COMPUTER
The app downloads dives over Bluetooth from Shearwater, Suunto (EON Steel, EON Core, D5), Oceanic, Aqualung, Apeks, Sherwood, Scubapro, Mares, 
Divesoft and Heinrichs Weikamp computers, picking up where the last download stopped. Dives without GPS get your phone's location from just
after the dive.                                                                                                                                

BRING IN EVERY OTHER DIVE                                                                                                                      
At bubblejournal.com, import the files your dive software already saves:
• Shearwater Cloud, logs and CSV                                                                                                               
• Garmin and Suunto watches (.fit)
• Suunto app and Suunto Dive Manager
• Oceanic DiverLog+, Mares Dive Organizer, Scubapro SmartTrak
• Divesoft, SeacSync, Seabear, Heinrichs Weikamp OSTC, Poseidon MkVI, Sensus
• Subsurface, MacDive, Diving Log, Divelogs.de, JDiveLog
• DAN DL7, UDDF and spreadsheets (CSV)
Log paper-logbook dives by hand, and count the dives you made before you kept records.

YOUR DIVING LIFE, SEEN
• A logbook of every dive, numbered in order
• Each dive's depth profile, NDL, tissue loading and air consumption
• Every dive site on a map
• Trips and stats across all your diving
• Swipe from one dive to the next

YOUR ORIGINALS, KEPT
Every file is stored exactly as uploaded. What your computer measured stays apart from what BubbleJournal calculates.

YOURS TO KEEP
No ads, and your data is never sold. Download everything as a zip, with every original file plus your whole logbook as JSON, or delete your account and everything in it, whenever you like.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Password, Apple, Google or a passkey, with an authenticator app to guard your password too.

BubbleJournal is free for now. If paid features ever come, you hear about it before you pay anything, and what you already have stays yours.

Made by an independent diver-developer in Pennsylvania, USA. No investors, no ads.

name: BuffetCue
description:
Tabletempo helps you plan a buffet before the first plate lands: where each dish goes, how much to put out, and when a refill may be needed.

Ten extra guests? One less table? A dessert that deserves a later entrance? Make room for the what-ifs before service begins.

BUILD YOUR SPREAD
Add dishes with names and emoji, set portions per tray, and keep opening trays separate from reserve stock. Enter expected arrivals by time window, counting each guest once.

GIVE EVERY TRAY A PLACE
Arrange dishes on a table layout with real position limits. Move or swap trays, mark dishes that must be served at opening, and plan later serving waves.

FIND YOUR REFILL RHYTHM
Use your guest counts, take-up estimates and preparation times to explore demand across the service. See planned refill trays, reserve use and potential shortfalls by dish and time window.

TRY ANOTHER PLAN
Compare more guests, extra reserves, fewer opening trays or longer preparation times. See which dishes and service windows need attention, then apply the changes to your event.

WHEN THE GUESTS ARRIVE
Record a tray added, enter a portion quantity, confirm what's left, or leave a note. Entries retain their time and optional operator name, and mistakes can be undone. Remaining counts show when they were last confirmed.

MAKE THE NEXT GATHERING EASIER
Compare planned refill timing with recorded additions, save review notes, and carry the settings you confirm into your next event. Export your plan and service records as CSV to save or share.

Forecasts are estimates based on your inputs. Staff-confirmed counts and additions are labeled separately.

Made for iPhone and iPad, with editable example data and plans saved locally on your device.

name: BulbZone: Room Lumen Map
description:
BulbZone maps a room as a floor grid. Mark cells for general, reading, kitchen, or accent light and the app totals the lumens and a bulb count for that layout.

The first screen opens on a sample living room. Change a use chip, tap cells, and save the layout. Bulb comparisons and saved rooms are on the other tabs. Planning numbers only — not an electrical design or certification.

Free. No accounts, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: Bumper-Bowling Breeze
description:
Bumper-Bowling Breeze is ten-pin bowling the way a pinball table would do it. Press the ball, pull back for power, slide to aim, set a curve with the HOOK slider and let go. The lane does the rest: ramps that launch the ball over the gutter, banked bends it hugs at speed, conveyors that carry it, bumpers that pay out when you bounce off them. Two balls a frame, ten pins, a real strike — and every lane plays differently.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• QUICK: five frames on five lanes, about three minutes
• FULL: all ten lanes of a course, the score that counts
• DAILY: everyone gets the same lane each day; keep your streak going
• PRACTICE: any lane you own, unlimited balls, no score
• Easy, Medium or Hard: the lanes get tighter and the aim line shorter; the hook is yours on every level

CRAZY LANES
• Boardwalk Lanes, free: ten lanes along a seaside pier, from a straight warm-up to a leap of faith over open water
• Bank bonus for a bumper hit, Air bonus for a jump, and Strike Targets: land in the bucket or ring the bell for a strike
• Shipwreck Lanes: a spinning capstan, a kraken's arm that sweeps the lane, powder barrels to plough through and a cannon that fires your ball
• Glacier Lanes: a spiral slide a storey down, a yeti in your lane, avalanches, a crevasse that opens, a curling house
• Two lanes of every pack are free to try

THE PRO SHOP
• Five power balls, each with a trick at the pins: the Seeker steers to the pocket, the Splitter becomes two balls, the Expander grows, the Graviton pulls pins in, the Shockwave sends out a pulse
• Buy once, keep forever, on every device with your store account
• Or play the house ball: every lane can be beaten with it

NO HASSLE
• No ads. No energy. No timers. No sign-in.
• Top-5 scores per course, mode and difficulty
• Your game is saved as you go, so a phone call never costs you a frame
• Works offline, on phones and tablets

All of the fun, none of the hassle.

name: Bunny Dash: Carrot Runner
description:
Hop, dash and dodge your way through a bright retro world in Bunny Dash, the one-tap runner where every carrot counts!

Guide your bunny across three levels of ground, rocky ledges and tree branches. Tap to hop, double tap for a big hop up high, and swipe down to drop or duck. The faster you go, the wilder it gets: hedgehogs, bees, crows and swooping hawks are all in your way.

FEATURES
• Simple one-tap controls that are easy to learn and hard to master
• Three heights to run on, with bouncy mushrooms and cloud steps
• Power-ups: Bubble Shield, Carrot Magnet, 2× Carrots, Slow-Mo and Rainbow Rush
• 12 Challenge levels with twists like moon gravity, lights out, air raids and rush hour
• Daily gifts with a 7-day streak and fresh missions every day
• Unlock new bunnies and beautiful scenes: Sunset, Autumn, Blossom, Winter and Starry Night
• A day-to-night sky full of balloons, planes and shooting stars
• Golden carrots hidden up high for the bravest hoppers

How far can your bunny dash? Chase your high score, beat every challenge and collect them all!

name: Business Flow
description:
Business Flow helps small business owners turn scattered ideas into a clear working plan. Draft posts, stories, reel scripts and ad copy, attach a photo and choose a preparation date. Keep a weekly agenda and return to your content when you are ready to share it.

Record customer requests and prepare reply drafts without losing the details. Build promotion briefs with planned budgets, keep business notes and check off the next task. Enter daily results to review charts and compare your content using your own recorded figures.

Business Flow saves plans and notes; it does not connect to social accounts, publish posts, send messages or retrieve live performance data.

Key Features
- Content drafts with photos, captions, channels and preparation status
- Weekly planner and searchable content library
- Customer request notes, tags and reply drafts
- Promotion briefs with planned budgets and recorded spending
- Dated result journal, charts and content comparisons
- Tasks, event notes and deliberate text/JSON sharing

name: ButtonBass Soundboard
description:
Hit the air horn. Buzz a wrong answer. Cue the drum roll. ButtonBass Soundboard puts over 200 sound effects at your fingertips, in six boards made for the moments that need them.

SIX SOUNDBOARDS IN ONE APP
• Classic – air horn, sad trombone, ba-dum-tss, applause, crickets, record scratch, retro game blips, drum hits and more
• Halloween – ghost howls, witch cackles, wolf howls, thunder, bubbling cauldrons and a real creaking door
• Game Show & Quiz – correct and wrong answer buzzers, round openers, thinking music, countdowns, winner fanfares, plus a built-in quiz timer
• Funny & Cartoon – boings, pops, squeaks, slide whistles, comic crashes and perfectly timed stings
• DJ Sound Effects – rally horns, dub sirens, scratches, risers and drops, with pitch control and beat-synced repeat
• Christmas – sleigh bells, Ho Ho Ho, elf giggles, reindeer, church bells and a rooftop landing

MADE FOR THE MOMENT
• Teachers: run a classroom quiz with buzzers and a big on-screen timer
• Streamers and podcasters: drop reactions live, right on cue
• Parties and game nights: be the host with the perfect sound for every win and fail
• Pranks, birthdays, holidays and everyday comedy

FEATURES
• Tap to play instantly, layer sounds on top of each other, or loop them
• Star your favourites and find any sound with search
• Record a take of your own mix and save it
• Save any sound as a WAV file – keep it in Files, share it, or set it as a ringtone
• Record your own sounds with the microphone and add them to your board
• Feel every hit with haptic feedback (can be turned off)
• Plays even when your phone is on silent
• Works completely offline – every sound is synthesized right on your device
• No ads, no account, no tracking

From ButtonBass, making free music toys online since 2006.

name: Cadenzia: Recovery for Women
description:
Cadenzia is the recovery app for women on iPhone and Apple Watch. Every morning it shows how recovered you are – and why. Your cycle and life stage are context, not a verdict.

ONE DECISION EVERY MORNING
The ring shows your score from 0 to 100 and a clear call: Push, Hold or Recover – plus the three drivers behind it.

NO BLACK BOX
Tap “Why?” to see every factor in points: HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, training load – and your cycle phase as its own factor.

YOUR CYCLE AS CONTEXT
Cadenzia compares today with your own values from the same cycle phase. No one-size-fits-all rules, only your measured patterns. The luteal phase is detected retrospectively from nightly wrist temperature; estimates are clearly marked.

FOR EVERY LIFE STAGE
Natural cycle, hormonal contraception, perimenopause, postmenopause or no cycle tracking at all. Scores pause during pregnancy.

START RIGHT AWAY
Cadenzia reads your existing history from Apple Health, so your score can be ready on day one. No mandatory input.

PLAN CHECK, SLEEP, TRENDS, CYCLE COMPARISON
A traffic light for your planned session with a lighter alternative. Sleep against your own average. Fitness, fatigue and form over six weeks. The same cycle day across your last cycles.

APPLE WATCH
Score, Why, plan check and the last seven days on your wrist, plus widget and complication. Cycle details stay hidden there by default.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All calculations run on your iPhone and Watch. No account, no server, no tracking, no ads.

BUY ONCE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Free: score, ring, three drivers, check-in, sleep, widget and CSV export. Cadenzia Pro as a one-time purchase unlocks the full Why view, plan check, trends, cycle comparison, 30-day history and the Watch app. Family Sharing supported.

NOTE
Cadenzia is a wellness app for training and recovery. It does not diagnose, assess symptoms or give treatment or nutrition advice. Available in English and German.

name: Cafe POS - Staff
description:
Cafe POS - Staff helps waiters and kitchen teams coordinate service through one shared app. An existing staff account from your cafe administrator and a connection to its Cafe POS service are required.

Waiter workspace
Choose a table or takeaway order, browse the menu, select variants and modifiers, add kitchen instructions and send orders. See dishes ready for service and mark them served.

Kitchen workspace
View active tickets by station, read quantities and instructions, and move dishes from new to preparing to ready. Receive new-order notifications when enabled and configured by your cafe.

One app for both roles
Your assigned permissions determine the workspaces available to you. Staff with waiter and kitchen access can choose a workspace at sign-in and switch from their profile.

Service at a glance
Supported iPhones can display kitchen workload in a Live Activity. Status refreshes while the app is active. Notifications are optional.

Cafe POS requires an internet connection. Contact your cafe administrator for account access, branch assignments and business support.

name: Campaign Studio
description:
Campaign Studio helps independent marketers keep campaign plans and entered results together. Define a campaign objective, budget and schedule, then organize audiences, placements and creative drafts inside ad sets. Add your own photos, headlines and primary text to explore a message before using it elsewhere.

Record daily spend, impressions, reach, link clicks and results from your own records. Review a performance journal, compare campaigns with matching objectives and dates, and see how recorded spending relates to your planned limits. Practical setup checks and short field notes help you revisit missing details. Separate workspaces keep different projects organized, and an example workspace gives you a place to explore.

**Key Features**
- Campaign, ad set and creative planning
- Photo, headline, primary text and call-to-action drafts
- Dated result records with cost per result and link click-through rate
- Same-objective campaign comparison
- Campaign budgets and workspace spending limits
- Setup checks, field notes and deliberate CSV-text sharing

name: CamXera
description:
CamXera is a simple, friendly camera for beautiful photos of you, your friends and family.

BEAUTIFUL PEOPLE
• Smooth: gentle skin smoothing that keeps eyes and hair sharp
• Vibes: a set of colour looks you can see live before you shoot
• AI auto adjust: exposure follows faces, with richer colour

HANDS-FREE SHOTS
• Show your open palm to the camera and the countdown starts, perfect for group photos
• Self-timer of 3, 5 or 10 seconds, and flash

SHARP, CLEAN RESULTS
• Anti-blur: focuses on faces, waits for steady hands and keeps the sharpest of 3 shots with everyone's eyes open
• Auto sharpen for crisp details
• Video stabilizer for smooth clips
• Night mode: merges several shots for cleaner photos in the dark
• Choose photo size and 1080p or 4K video

EDIT AND SHARE
• Built-in gallery with the photos and videos you take in CamXera
• Edit: enhance, smooth, filters, brightness, contrast, warmth, and remove unwanted objects
• Portrait: keep the person sharp and blur the background as much as you like
• Edit videos: trim, auto, enhance, smooth and filters
• Share straight to your favourite apps

HANDY EXTRAS
• Grid and level lines for straight photos
• QR code scanner
• Home Screen widget and shortcuts for photo, selfie and video
• Turn the shutter sound on or off

Your photos never leave your phone: no account, no ads, no cloud.

name: Carrom Daily: Multiplayer Game
description:
Carrom Daily brings the classic board game to your phone: flick the striker, pocket your coins, cover the queen and win. Play quick online matches against real players, team up in 2v2, challenge your friends or practise against the computer.

REAL CARROM, REAL PHYSICS
- Smooth, natural striker and coin physics: rebounds, cuts and doubles behave the way you expect
- Place the striker on your baseline, aim with a clear guide line and set your power
- Traditional rules: pocket all your coins, cover the queen and watch out for fouls
- Every match is played on our servers, so results are always fair

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Quick Match 1v1 – find an opponent in seconds
- Team Match 2v2 – play with a partner against another team
- Play with Friends – create a private room and share the code
- vs Computer – Easy, Medium and Hard opponents to sharpen your aim
- Practice – pass and play on one device

WORLD TOUR
- Travel to India, Japan, Tokyo, Paris, London, New York and Dubai
- Every destination has its own board, backdrop and atmosphere
- Higher stakes and bigger prizes as you level up
- Seasonal reward track with missions, levels, and exclusive rewards

PROGRESS AND REWARDS
- Earn coins and XP from every match and level up
- Daily rewards – log in every day for bigger prizes
- Daily and weekly missions
- Leaderboards to see how you rank

MAKE IT YOURS
- Collect strikers, boards and avatar frames
- Choose a built-in avatar or use your Google or Facebook profile photo
- Animated emotes to celebrate a great shot

SOCIAL
- Add friends by code or search, and see who is online
- Quick chat and match chat while you play
- Tap any player to see their profile and stats

Carrom Daily is free to play. It contains ads and offers optional in-app purchases. Coins and gems are in-game items only: they have no real-money value and cannot be exchanged for cash or prizes.

Questions or feedback? Email us at hello@techavenuelabs.com
Privacy policy: https://carromdaily.techavenuelabs.com/privacy
Terms of service: https://carromdaily.techavenuelabs.com/terms

name: CastHop: Screen Mirroring
description:
CastHop is a free, open-source screen mirroring app that casts your iPhone or iPad screen wirelessly to Pardus ETAP smart boards, Android TV, Windows and Mac computers. Built for teachers: run your lesson from anywhere in the classroom with no cables, no account and no internet connection.

SMART BOARD SCREEN MIRRORING IN TWO STEPS
1. Install the CastHop receiver on the board (a one-click setup guide is at ozkanceng.github.io/casthop).
2. On your iPhone or iPad, tap "Connect to a screen" and scan the QR code shown on the board. Start mirroring. Done.

CastHop remembers every screen you have connected to, so next lesson you reconnect with a single tap.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Show your iPhone or iPad screen and app audio on the smart board: PDFs, slides, videos, digital notebooks and drawing apps.
• Mirror the camera: send a book, notebook or worksheet to the board and use the device as a document camera.
• Hold the device in landscape or portrait; the picture follows the rotation without interruption.
• If the network slows down, picture quality adjusts automatically so delay does not build up.
• Can't scan the QR code? Connect with the 6-digit code shown on the screen.

WHERE YOU CAN MIRROR
• Pardus ETAP 23 smart boards
• Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV
• Windows 10 and later computers
• macOS 14 and later Macs
All receiver apps are free and available at ozkanceng.github.io/casthop.

THE ANDROID APP IS LIVE TOO
CastHop for Android tablets and phones is on Google Play: play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sorumatik.casthop

NO CABLES, NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
• The device and the screen must be on the same Wi-Fi network. Mirroring stays on your local network; your screen is never sent over the internet.
• Connections are encrypted with TLS 1.3. Each screen is paired by QR code or a single-use PIN, so an unknown device cannot cast without permission.
• No sign-up, no accounts, no ads and no tracking.

OPEN SOURCE
The source code is published under the Apache-2.0 license at github.com/ozkanceng/casthop. Visit the page to report issues or contribute.

PERMISSIONS
• Screen recording (broadcast): only to mirror the screen when you start it.
• Camera: to scan the QR code and for optional camera mirroring.
• Local network: to find and connect to the screen on the same network.

GOOD TO KNOW
• DRM-protected content (some streaming services) cannot be mirrored; this is an iOS restriction.
• Requires iOS or iPadOS 17 or later.
• CastHop is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with Pardus, TÜBİTAK, the Turkish Ministry of National Education or any other trademark owner.

name: Cat Match Studio
description:
Snow is falling, the fire is crackling, and a little cat is waiting for you to make its world cozy.

Cat Match is a warm, relaxing match-3 puzzle game. Swap soft, glossy pieces to make rows of three or more, reach each level's goals and earn gold. Spend it to dress up your cat and decorate its little home, one choice at a time. When a cat is finished, it shines in the spotlight, moves into your gallery, and a new cat arrives with a new home to make cozy.

MATCH AND BLAST
• Swap neighboring pieces to line up three or more of a kind
• Make firecrackers, snow bombs and laser dots from bigger matches
• Swap two specials together for a giant combo
• Every blast fills the explosion wheel, which sends yarn swirls onto the board
• Free sled kittens, unwrap gifts, crack the ice and knock the hats off snowmen

DRESS UP AND DECORATE
• Pick one of three options for each outfit piece and each corner of the home
• Sweaters, hats, scarves and boots appear right on your cat
• Beds, rugs, lamps and fireplaces bring every home to life
• Your cat sits beside the board in its new outfit and cheers you on

COLLECT AND SHARE
• Every finished cat poses in the spotlight and joins your gallery
• Re-dress finished cats whenever you like, free of charge
• Share a portrait of your cat with family and friends

COZY BY DESIGN
• No timers, no lives, no energy: try again as often as you like, always free
• Something new to discover as you play, with a gentle guide for every new idea
• Soft snowfall, warm music, gentle vibrations on iPhone and plenty of purrs
• Every cat, piece, sound and song is made in code, with lots of love
• Plays offline: no account, no data collected
• Made for iPhone and iPad, in English and German

Grab a warm blanket, make a match and give a little cat the coziest winter ever!

name: CatPoro: Cozy Pomodoro Cat
description:
Some days, all you need to get started is a little friend by your side.

Meet Bun: a round, fluffy kitty in a starry witch hat, living inside a soft watercolor storybook. While you focus, Bun keeps you company. When you take a break, Bun stretches right along with you.

A CLOCK OF FALLING LEAVES
• 25-minute focus sessions and 5-minute breaks, the classic Pomodoro rhythm.
• A wreath of 25 leaves circles the clock, and one drifts down every minute, so you can see how far you've come at a glance.
• Tap to start or pause, swipe to switch to a break, double-tap to start over.
• If time is up while you're away, a gentle notification calls you back.

A KITTY WHO LOVES YOU BACK
• Bun has a little life of its own: strolling, leaf-watching, chasing a ball, snacking, and napping soundly while you work.
• Tap Bun for a happy "mew" and a cozy, sleepy squint.
• Give a gentle rub and Bun purrs, with soft vibrations that feel like holding a real cat.
• Every session you finish brings the two of you a little closer.

A TINY PANTRY
• Unlock crunchy kibble, dried fish, tuna pâté, salmon sushi and more as you complete sessions.
• Pick a treat and serve Bun a happy little meal.

FOUR SEASONS, THREE COZY PLACES
• Spring blossoms, summer sun, golden autumn, snowy winter. Seasons follow the calendar or your mood.
• A stone bridge over a stream, a quiet little village, a breezy lakeside pier. Bun leads you somewhere new as you keep going.
• Swipe to send fallen leaves rustling, and touch the water to hear it ripple.
• Drag the scenery to look around, then tap the little cat button to hop back to Bun.

SOFT, SOOTHING SOUNDS
• Rain, wind and a babbling stream to help you sink into your work.
• A handful of gentle songs that play one after another, then start again.
• Switch between nature sounds and music right on the wooden sign.

GENTLE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, and it works offline.
• Your progress stays right on your device.
• Speaks 20 languages, and you can switch any time right inside the app.

Brew a cup of tea, open CatPoro, and let Bun save you a cozy spot to focus.

name: Catstellation
description:
Catstellation is a gentle game for everyone who loves cats.

Create a cat that looks like yours: coat, eyes, markings, collar, name. Then help them climb from cloud to cloud, higher and higher, through the dusk, the sea of clouds, the starry night and all the way to cat paradise.

GONE, OR STILL HERE?
• If your cat has left, help them climb to the stars. When their nine lives are spent, they settle on a cloud with the cats who reached the same height, and their star lights up forever.
• If your cat still sleeps beside you, take them to visit the ones who came before: your past companions, and all the cats of long ago. Then they come home for a nap and dream of their friends in the sky.

A SKY THAT NEVER ENDS
Hand-painted skies that change as you climb: dusk, blue hour, constellations, auroras, star gardens, and beyond. Three original soft melodies keep you company.

YOUR FAMILY AND FRIENDS
• Play as a family with the same cat on every phone, thanks to a household code.
• Share your cat’s poetic ID (like Joye-Vega-27) or a QR code: your cats will sleep on the same cloud.
• Visit the family cloud and give each cat a cuddle.

LITTLE NOTES
Turn on little notes to receive, on the days and at the time you choose, a gentle thought about cats or a few words from your cat.

WIDGETS
Keep today’s little note on your lock screen, and your cat asleep on your home screen. One tap to visit them or start a climb.

LANTERNS AND TREATS
Light a lantern for a cat in the sky, or give a treat to a cat who still lives at home: their family will know someone is thinking of them. One gift is free every week. For every lantern or treat bought, Catstellation gives $0.25 to a cat shelter.

BEAUTIFUL KEEPSAKES
Save or share lovely images of your cat: on their cloud, under the auroras, beneath their constellation, or at home by the window.

NO ADS, NO ACCOUNT
One cat and the whole game are free. A one-time Full Access unlock adds more cats, the household code, the widgets and every share image. No ads, no account, no tracking. Just you, your cat and the stars.

Made in Québec, in memory of Joye, a Siamese cat who loved sunbeams.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://catstellation.app/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://catstellation.app/en/privacy/

name: Cepte360
description:
Cepte360, yaşadığın şehirde ihtiyaç duyduğun bilgileri tek yerde toplar. Şu an Malatya'da; diğer şehirler yakında.

ŞEHRE SOR
"Bu akşam nereye gidilir?", "Kağıt kebabı nerede yenir?", "Hangi eczane açık?" Sorunu yaz, Cepte360 şehirdeki güncel bilgilerle yanıtlasın.

NÖBETÇİ ECZANE VE NOTER
Bugün nöbet tutan eczaneleri ve noterleri adres, telefon ve yol tarifiyle gör; tek dokunuşla ara.

NE YENİR?
Malatya'nın imza lezzetleri ve onları en iyi yapan adresler. Malatyalıların oylarıyla öne çıkan sofraları keşfet.

ETKİNLİKLER VE PLANLAR
Konser, tiyatro ve stand-up takvimi. Kendi planını kur: kahve, okey, doğa yürüyüşü ya da maç; kimlerin katıldığını gör, kontenjanı sen belirle.

MALATYA AKIŞ
Şehirde kim nerede? Fotoğraf paylaş, check-in yap, arkadaşlarını takip et. Profilini herkese açık, yalnızca takipçilere açık ya da gizli tutabilirsin.

GEZİLECEK YERLER
Kanyonlar, şelaleler, tarihi yapılar, müzeler ve aktiviteler; ilçe ilçe.

FİRMA REHBERİ
Lokantadan diş hekimine, mobilyacıdan kuyumcuya; telefon, adres ve yol tarifiyle Malatya işletmeleri. İşletmeni ücretsiz ekle, sayfanı kendin yönet.

ŞEHRİN GÜNDEMİ
Malatya haberleri, hava durumu, namaz vakitleri, altın ve döviz kurları.

BİLDİRİMLER
Planına katılan, seni takip eden ya da paylaşımına yorum yapan olduğunda haberin olsun. Bildirimleri istediğin zaman Hesabım'dan kapatabilirsin.

GİZLİLİK
Konumun yalnızca check-in yaptığında ya da yakındaki yerleri istediğinde kullanılır. Hesabını ve verilerini uygulamanın içinden istediğin zaman silebilirsin.

name: Cert IT Trainer
description:
Cert IT Trainer is an independent study companion for IT professionals preparing across security, cloud, networking, infrastructure, data, DevOps, and project-management certification tracks.

Practise with original questions across CompTIA, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco, Kubernetes, ISC2, ISACA, HashiCorp, Red Hat, and more. Retired exams stay available as legacy practice.

Features:
• Flexible quizzes with detailed answer explanations
• Practice Exam Mode with feedback held until the end
• Optional exam timer and topic filters
• Flashcards, bookmarks, and missed-question review
• Spaced repetition for long-term retention
• Progress history, daily goals, streaks, XP, and achievements
• Official study-resource links
• Custom CSV quiz imports with All Access
• Offline question banks with no account required
• No ads and no tracking

Free and subscription plans:
• Free: CompTIA A+ Core 1 with every study tool.
• Popular 10: ten popular certifications. Monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription.
• All Access: every certification in the app, plus custom CSV quiz imports. Monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription.
