name: Chamada: Controle de Faltas
description:
Quantas faltas você ainda pode tomar em Cálculo?

Monte sua grade uma vez: matérias, dias, horários e a regra da sua faculdade (75% de presença ou um número fixo de faltas).

MARQUE NO FIM DA AULA
• No fim de cada aula chega um aviso com Fui, Faltei e Não teve.
• Esqueceu? As aulas sem marcação ficam juntas em "Pra marcar", com "Fui em todas".
• Chegou atrasado ou saiu mais cedo? Marque só parte da aula dupla.
• Falta abonada e aula que não teve não contam contra você.

SAIBA ONDE ESTÁ O RISCO
• Faltas restantes de cada matéria, desenhadas como risquinhos de caderno.
• Destaque em Hoje quando uma matéria chega perto do limite.
• Simulador: "e se eu faltar mais 2?"

SUA SEMANA INTEIRA
• Grade horária da semana com o que já foi marcado.
• Aulas a cada 2 semanas, aulas que valem duas faltas, reposições e sábados letivos.
• Feriados e recesso tiram as aulas da conta (e os feriados nacionais entram com um toque).

CHAMADA PRO (pagamento único)
• Matérias ilimitadas
• Vários períodos, com o histórico dos anteriores
• Widgets: próxima aula e faltas restantes (no iPhone, também na tela bloqueada)
• Lembrete antes da aula, com a sala

Grátis para até 4 matérias por período. Disponível em português, inglês, espanhol e chinês.

name: Channel Surf for Media Servers
description:
Remember channel surfing? Landing on a movie halfway through and staying for the rest of it? Channel Surf brings that back, with your own library.

Channel Surf turns the movies and shows on your Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server into a full lineup of live channels, with a guide that looks right at home on Apple TV. Every channel plays around the clock. There's no pause, no skipping and no endless scrolling: just pick a channel and watch what's on.

CHANNELS, MADE FOR YOU
Channel Surf builds channels automatically from your library: Comedy, Drama and Sci-Fi; kids' shows and anime; 80s and 90s movies; channels for your favorite directors, actors and studios; show marathons; and every collection, back to back. Choose how big your lineup is, from a handful of genre channels to hundreds.

MAKE IT YOURS
Put a show on at the same time every day: a sitcom block at 8 every weeknight, cartoons on Saturday morning, a movie at 9. Choose which channels play their shows in order and which shuffle. Hide anything you don't want on, from one channel or all of them, and move a show to the channels where it belongs. Just hold select on anything in the guide.

A REAL TV GUIDE
See what's on now and what's coming up across every channel. Rest on a channel and it starts playing, then press select to go full screen. Rather browse without changing what's on? Switch the guide to Preview.

NEVER THE SAME TWICE
Schedules are shuffled, shows never air back to back, and you choose how long before a show can come back around. Things you just added stay off the channels for a while, so they're yours to watch on purpose.

WORKS WITH YOUR SERVER
Sign in to Plex with a code, connect to Jellyfin with Quick Connect, or sign in to Emby with your username and password.

FREE LIVE TV, IF YOU WANT IT
Turn on Free Live TV and free live channels from the iptv-org directory join your guide: news, sports, movies, classic TV and more for your country. Take every channel of a kind or pick just a few, and add single channels from anywhere, in any language. It's off until you turn it on.

BUILT FOR APPLE TV
Fast, native, and made for the Siri Remote. Plays files straight from your server whenever Apple TV can, in up to 4K HDR, with subtitles when you want them.

TRY IT FREE
Channel Surf is free for 3 days. After that, unlock it with a one-time purchase. No subscription. No server? Try the sample channels, with classic and open-licensed films built in.

Works with Plex Media Server, Jellyfin and Emby. Channel Surf isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Plex, Inc., the Jellyfin project or Emby LLC.

name: ChannelSat
description:
Lost a channel? Find its new frequency in seconds.

ChannelSat covers 12,000+ TV channels on 58 satellite positions: Nilesat, Eutelsat 7°W, Hotbird 13°E, Astra 19.2°E, Arabsat, Badr, Türksat and many more. Every channel comes with everything you need to tune it: frequency, polarization, symbol rate, FEC, system and SID.

ALERTS, SO YOU NEVER LOSE A CHANNEL
Follow your favourite channels. When one moves frequency, appears or disappears, ChannelSat tells you, with the new values to tune.

INSTANT SEARCH
Type a channel name or a frequency (e.g. 11470) to see every frequency it airs on, satellite by satellite.

UPDATED EVERY WEEK
Frequencies are refreshed weekly and confirmed by real scans from ChannelSat users. Tell us whether a channel works for you, and you help everyone.

WORKS OFFLINE
The whole database lives on your phone: handy on the roof, next to the dish.

SHARE A FREQUENCY AS AN IMAGE
Send a channel card to WhatsApp or Facebook, with the frequency in big type.

FIX YOUR TV'S CHANNEL LIST
With the free editor on channelsat.com, sort, clean up and add channels on Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips, TCL, Hisense and Panasonic TVs, and on Enigma2 receivers.

FREE. ChannelSat Premium is one payment with no subscription. It removes the ads, lets you follow whole satellites and transponders, and gives you unlimited channels.

In English, French and Arabic.

Privacy policy: https://channelsat.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://channelsat.com/terms

name: CharaTore
description:
CharaTore turns your daily steps and workouts into a pixel pet you raise. It makes keeping a healthy habit a little more fun.

■ Walk, and your pet perks up
• Reads today's step count from the Health app on your iPhone
• Footprints fill up as you get closer to your step goal

■ Pick your exercises, then check them off
• Register your own exercises, like squats or stretches
• Each morning, pick a few and check them off when you're done — or let "Surprise me" choose

■ Up to 100 points a day
• Up to 50 points for steps and 50 for exercises. Your total helps your pet grow
• Baby → Kid → Adult, little by little
• Your pet's mood follows your last three days — never scolding
• Take one rest day a week

■ Three pets
• Easygoing Mochi, cheerful Chick, and clingy Ghost
• A short line of encouragement every day
• When your pet is an adult, it can graduate whenever you like. Visit it anytime in the Album

■ Widgets
• Home Screen (small, medium, large) and Lock Screen
• Check off exercises right from the large widget

■ Morning reminder
• A gentle nudge to pick today's exercises at the time you choose

■ Your data stays on this iPhone
• Steps and records are stored only on this iPhone and never sent anywhere
• No account needed

■ Free, and CharaTore Plus (one-time purchase)
• Free: steps, exercises, all three pets, graduation, the Album, the last 7 days of history, and widgets
• CharaTore Plus (one-time purchase): the Cream Soda and Night Walk themes, plus a history calendar and chart
• No subscriptions

name: Charutaria Curitiba
description:
O aplicativo oficial da Charutaria Curitiba para clientes cadastrados.

Consulte o catálogo completo da loja, monte seus pedidos com praticidade e acompanhe cada etapa até a entrega — tudo em um só lugar.

CATÁLOGO COMPLETO
• Charutos, cigarrilhas, palheiros e tabacos para cachimbo, cigarro e narguilé
• Acessórios: isqueiros, cortadores, piteiras, filtros, sedas, facas e canivetes
• Fotos, descrição, marca e preço de cada produto
• Busca rápida e navegação por categorias

PEDIDOS SIMPLES
• Adicione produtos ao carrinho e envie o pedido em poucos toques
• Seu carrinho fica salvo na sua conta, mesmo se trocar de aparelho
• Veja o valor do frete e o total antes de enviar
• Pagamento e entrega combinados diretamente com a loja

ACOMPANHAMENTO
• Histórico de todos os seus pedidos
• Status atualizado de cada pedido

ATENDIMENTO PERSONALIZADO
• Cada cliente conta com um vendedor responsável
• Fale com a loja pelo WhatsApp direto do app

ACESSO EXCLUSIVO
O acesso é liberado pela Charutaria Curitiba para clientes atendidos pela loja. Para solicitar sua conta, fale conosco pelo WhatsApp (41) 99248-7840.

Aplicativo destinado exclusivamente a maiores de 18 anos.

name: Chef Oby
description:
Learn why food turns out the way it does, by cooking it with your own fingers.

Chef Oby is a cooking course in short lessons, with Oby, an eggplant in a chef's hat, cooking along. Each lesson starts with a few cards of theory. Then you cook in an interactive scene: set the heat, slice, whisk, pour and season. At the end, a breakdown shows what you did, what it changed and what to try next time. No recipes to memorize.

14 CHAPTERS
Knife and Board, Heat, Dry heat, Slow heat, Butchery, Salt and Acid, Water, Eggs and emulsions, Oil and frying, Dough, sugar and cold, Sauces, Preserving and fermenting, Flavors, and Chef's week, where you run a whole menu on several burners.

HANDS ON
Swipe to cut, drag to pour, pinch and circle to knead and whisk. Some steps use the phone itself: shake it to salt, tilt it to pour. Short time-lapses show what minutes or days of cooking do.

YOUR PACE
- A five-question quick start suggests where to begin. You can skip it.
- Review tab: a quick practice round from a lesson you've finished.
- Endless modes open as you finish lessons: Endless baguette, Onion peel, Fridge or pantry, Hold the heat, Crack an egg and Chef's blitz. Game Center leaderboards are optional.
- An optional weekly goal. Missing days pauses your streak instead of resetting it.
- Deep dive: extra cards with more science, if you want them.
- Cards for a lesson, your week or your kitchen rank, with an optional photo of your dish. Nothing leaves your phone until you tap Share.
- Temperatures in °C or °F. English and Ukrainian.

FREE AND PRO
The first three lessons of every chapter are free, along with the quick start, the Review tab and the endless modes. Chef Oby Pro, a yearly or monthly subscription, opens every other lesson. You see the App Store price and period before you confirm. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your Apple Account settings. If Pro ends, the lessons you finished stay yours.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your iPhone; leaderboard scores go to Game Center only if you sign in. The simulations are simplified models of real cooking.

Terms of Use: https://datatch.com/apps/maillart/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://datatch.com/apps/maillart/privacy/

name: ChessFormAtlas
description:
ChessFormAtlas is an offline reference for the structures of Chinese Chess (Xiangqi).

Open a formation and see how the Chariot, Horse, Cannon, Elephant, Advisor, and Soldier are arranged. Read what that shape tends to control, where it is thin, and which other formations share the idea. Compare two patterns by the intersections that stay, appear, or change. Follow an evolution from an opening shape into a later shape, and mark a study step when you have read it.

The library includes 24 patterns, 8 formation studies, 13 tactical diagrams, 30 articles, 40 glossary entries, and 6 reading paths. Diagrams are identified as classical names, common structures, or simplified teaching positions.

Keep favorites, notes, research records, and your own board diagrams on the device. Export that personal file and import it later. The app stores this research locally, does not require an account, and does not send it to a server.

Use Chess Form Atlas to study structures. It does not play a game or recommend a move.

name: CHOMPION: Eating Challenges
description:
Welcome to the arena where every bite counts: film your eating challenge, rack up the score and battle for the top of the CHOMPION League.

CHOMPION is built for food challenge fans who live for the clock, the crowd and the leaderboard. Burgers, pizza, hot wings, hot dogs, tacos: pick your food, set the timer and go for glory.

LIVE CHALLENGE RECORDING
Hit record and tap to count every item as it goes down. Choose a 5, 10 or 15 minute time limit, set your own, or go untimed. The live counter keeps the scoreboard ticking for everyone watching.

LIVE NUTRITION TOTALS
Watch the numbers climb in real time. CHOMPION tallies calories, protein, carbs and fat as you eat, for preset foods or your own custom food. Got something unusual on the plate? Snap a photo and the AI food scan fills in the nutrition values for you.

THE FEED
Catch the action in the video feed with For You, Completed and Top This Week tabs. Relive the big finishes in the Challenge Complete carousel and pay tribute to the legends in the Hall of Fame.

THE CHOMPION LEAGUE
This is where reputations are made. Climb the weekly and all-time leaderboards, ranked by most eaten or most calories, and filter by food to find your speciality. Every week is a fresh shot at the crown.

VERIFIED SCORES
Fair play matters. The CHOMPION team checks big or unusual scores before they rank, so every spot on the table is earned.

YOUR PROFILE, YOUR RECORD
Track lifetime stats, personal bests and every challenge you've posted. Build your highlight reel and show the world what you're made of.

A COMMUNITY THAT PLAYS FAIR
Like, comment and share your favourite moments. Report and block tools help keep the community friendly and safe.

CHOMPION PRO
Free players get a taste of the action first. Go Pro to unlock unlimited videos, unlimited recording and full CHOMPION League access. Choose a monthly, annual or lifetime plan. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

PLAY IT SAFE
CHOMPION is an entertainment app for food challenge fans, not a diet, health or weight-loss app. Eat responsibly, know your limits and never push past what feels safe. Suitable for ages 13+.

The clock is ready. The League is waiting. Download CHOMPION and take your seat at the table.

Terms of Use: https://chompion.rork.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://chompion.rork.app/privacy

name: Chord Expert: Guitar & Ukulele
description:
Chord Expert brings chords, music theory, a tuner and a metronome together for guitar, ukulele, mandolin, bass and banjo – in one app that works completely offline, with no ads, no account and no tracking.

WHY CHORD EXPERT
• Worked out from music theory, not a database – every chord is built from its notes and the shapes are calculated for your instrument, tuning and capo, so no chord or position is ever missing
• Smooth progressions – shapes are chosen across the whole progression so your hand moves as little as possible
• Works both ways – tap a shape to get the chord name, enter a few chords to get the key
• Real instrument sounds – hear every chord strummed or picked
• Private by design – the app has no internet access at all

CHORDS
• Diagrams for any chord in every position along the neck
• Difficulty rating and finger numbers for every shape, with an option to show only easy ones
• Inversions and slash chords such as C/E or D/F#
• Find a chord by shape, including inversions and incomplete chords
• Favorites for each instrument

THEORY
• Keys and scales: diatonic triads and seventh chords for major, minor, modes, pentatonic, blues and more
• Find the most likely key from the chords of a song
• Interactive circle of fifths
• Scales and chord tones on the fretboard, with intervals or note names
• Easiest capo positions for any key

PROGRESSIONS
• Typical progressions for pop, rock, jazz, blues, classical and flamenco in any key
• Random progressions built on functional harmony
• Play along in a loop with the metronome

TOOLS
• Chromatic tuner with reference tones and A4 calibration (430–450 Hz)
• Alternate and custom tunings: Drop D, DADGAD, Open G, half step down and your own
• Metronome with tap tempo, time signatures, subdivisions and accents

MADE FOR YOU
• Left-handed mode
• Dark mode and tablet layout
• English, German (H) or Latin (Do Re Mi) note names
• Available in more than 60 languages

name: ChordSight: Guitar Chords 3D
description:
Chord charts show where your fingers end up. ChordSight shows how they get there.

Lifelike 3D hands play an acoustic guitar in time with real guitar sound. Pinch in on either hand, turn the view, or look straight down the fretboard like a chord chart.

LEARN THE CHORDS
• 10 essential chords: C, Am, Em, D, G, A, E, Dm, F and Bm, including full barres
• A live chord chart with finger numbers, open and muted strings
• Smooth, natural finger movement between every pair of chords

PRACTISE THE CHANGES
• Slow changes gives each chord switch extra time
• Tempo from 48 to 120 BPM
• Hold one chord as long as you like, or let it cycle

PLAY THE RIGHT HAND
• Fingerstyle picking with thumb and fingers (P-i-m-a)
• Strum with a pick: steady downstrokes, alternating eighths or skipped stroke

PLAY SONGS
• Build chord sheets with sections, repeats, half bars and per-chord patterns
• Two starter sheets to play right away

FAIR PRICING
C, Am and Em with fingerstyle are free forever. Start a free 1-day trial to try everything else — no payment needed. One purchase then unlocks it for good: no subscription, no account, no ads, and Family Sharing is supported.

name: Christina Cooks
description:
Christina Cooks turns "what do I even make tonight?" into dinner.

Snap a photo of your ingredients — or a dish you loved at a restaurant — and get a real recipe in seconds, with clear steps and suggested seasonings. Or just tap in what's in your fridge and let the kitchen do the thinking. It's cooking help built around Christina's real food, not generic internet recipes.

COOK WITH WHAT YOU HAVE
• Enter your ingredients or snap a photo, and get recipe + drink ideas you can actually make
• Detailed, numbered steps and suggested seasonings for every recipe
• Juices, smoothies and mocktails too (cocktails for adults only)
• Save your favorites and, if you like, share them with the community

CHRISTINA'S KITCHEN
• Browse Christina's recipes and the current menu
• Order ahead for pickup
• A hands-free cooking mode that keeps your screen awake, step by step
• Kitchen stories and a travel map from the road

MADE FOR REAL LIFE
• Works without an account — sign in only if you want to save and sync
• Fast, friendly, and designed to be used one-handed while you cook

AI can make mistakes, so always check ingredients for your own allergies before cooking. Please enjoy any drinks responsibly.

Download Christina Cooks and make the most of what's already in your kitchen.

name: Chromacy
description:
Is it blue or green? Navy or black? Chromacy settles it.

Take a photo or pick one from your library. Chromacy finds the main color of the thing in it, sets the background aside, and tells you what people call that color. Ask a question in your own words, like "is it blue or green?" or "is it navy?", and you get an answer, the reason in plain words, and how close the call is.

NAMES PEOPLE ACTUALLY USE
Color names come from a survey in which about 222,500 people named colors on their own screens. "Navy" means the color people call navy, from 920 names, along with the basic color word most people would use.

REAL COLOR SCIENCE
Perceptual hue (OKLCh) decides between colorful colors, and overall difference (CIEDE2000) between near-greys. The familiar color wheel is shown too, with a note when it disagrees. And Chromacy shows how much of each unique hue a color appears to contain (CAM16): when it's a near-even split, that's exactly why people argue.

THROUGH OTHER EYES
See the color as it looks with red-green or blue-yellow color vision deficiency, or with no color at all, and what each would call it.

AND MORE
White-balance mode removes a color cast: tap something white or grey. Tap anywhere on the photo to measure a different spot. Color harmonies, a history of your results, and share images made on your iPhone.

TRY IT FREE, THEN PAY ONCE
Try Chromacy free for 5 photos. Pro is a single purchase, with no subscription: unlimited photos, on-device AI that finds the subject, explains each result in plain words and reads questions in your own words (on iPhones that support Apple Intelligence), live camera color picking, iCloud sync across your devices, palette export, and share images without the trial watermark. Your saved results stay yours after the trial.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos and results stay on your iPhone. There's no account and no server of ours, and no analytics, advertising or tracking. The only network use is optional iCloud sync, in your own private iCloud.

name: Chromicle
description:
Chromicle is a private color journal for designers, illustrators, and anyone who thinks in color.
Capture a shade from the camera, a photo, or a manual picker. Write down where you found it, how it feels, and where you might use it. Then turn those notes into palettes you can take into your work.
JOURNAL
• Save colors with a title, notes, tags, and a reference photo
• Search by title, notes, HEX, or tags
• Filter favorites, warm, cool, muted, and vivid
• Sort by recent or hue, as a grid or a list
PALETTES
• Build brand, UI, art, and mood palettes
• Generate harmonies: complementary, split complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, monochromatic, tints, shades, and tones
• Check WCAG contrast between text and background
• Preview a palette for protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia
• Export a HEX list, a PDF swatch sheet, or an ASE file
LIBRARY
An offline field guide to hue, harmony, color psychology, accessibility, and practical notes for brand, UI, print, and illustration.
EXTRACTOR
Sample from the camera or your photo library, or set a color by hand. Read HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK, and LAB, then send it straight to a journal entry or a palette.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Journal entries, palettes, and reference images stay on your device. Export or import a JSON backup whenever you want. There is no cloud copy.

name: Cinematic Pro: Video Editor
description:
The video editor designed for iPhone Duo. Open your iPhone Duo and Cinematic Pro unfolds with you: your video on one screen, every tool on the other, so you see your edit full size while you work.

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO
The editor splits right at the hinge: preview on the left screen, timeline and tools on the right. Close it and keep editing on the outer screen; open it again and your project unfolds exactly where you left off. Cinematic Pro also adapts to iPad and to every iPhone size.

EDIT LIKE A PRO
A real multi-track timeline with trim, split, reorder, speed, overlays, text, captions, music and sound effects. Move, resize and rotate anything on the canvas, with Undo and Redo that never lose your place.

COLOR THAT TELLS THE STORY
Filters, curves, HSL, color wheels and one-tap Auto. Preview and export use the same project, so what you see is what you get.

EFFECTS WITH INTENT
A searchable library of looks and video effects, previewed live on your own shot.

CAPTIONS YOU CONTROL
Create captions with editable timing, text, placement and designed templates, and correct them before export.

CLEARER CREATOR AUDIO
Clean up voices, add in-app music and sound effects, or bring your own audio.

START RIGHT AWAY
Use the video editor as a guest, with no account. Sign in with Apple or Google only when you open account or cloud features. Your original media stays on your device unless you choose an online feature; see the Privacy Policy for exactly what is processed where.

CINEMATIC PRO PREMIUM
Cinematic Pro is free to use with ads. Premium removes all ads and unlocks every effect, transition, animation and filter, Pro color (HSL, Curves, color wheels), 4K and 60 fps export and one-tap Storage Cleaner.

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription: weekly, monthly or yearly (the yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://cinematicpro.app/privacy.html

name: CineReady: Film Light Meter
description:
CineReady turns your iPhone into the light meter, sun planner and scout log you keep reaching for on set and on the recce.

READ THE LIGHT
• Live color temperature in Kelvin and green/magenta tint from the iPhone camera, updating as you move.
• Spot mode balances on a grey card for the most accurate reading.
• The gel that gets you to your target: CTO, CTB and their fractions.
• Calibrate each lens against your color meter.

EXPOSE FOR YOUR CINEMA CAMERA
• Enter your camera's frame rate, shutter angle, ISO and ND. CineReady meters the scene and gives you the T-stop.
• The ND you need to shoot at the stop you want.
• Histogram with clipping warnings, plus zebras and false color over the live image.

SHOOT WITHOUT FLICKER
• Know instantly if your shutter will flicker under 50 or 60 Hz lighting.
• Safe shutter angles and frame rates, applied to your setup with one tap.
• A light test measures the flicker of the lights in front of you.

FRAME FOR ANY CAMERA

description:

PAIR ONCE

SEE WHY, NOT JUST WHAT

PREVIEW MODE
Don't have the gauge yet? Turn on Preview Mode and design your layout with simulated readings. Everything is labelled as simulated, and nothing pretends to be connected.

FIRMWARE UPDATES
The gauge updates wirelessly from the app. Updates are free for the life of the product, and an interrupted update can't damage the gauge.

NO ACCOUNT, NO DATA
There is no sign-up. The app collects nothing: no analytics, no crash reports, no location. It makes exactly two kinds of network request, and you start both by tapping a button — checking for a firmware update, and an optional VIN lookup with NHTSA's public database. Read the full policy at corsaline.com/privacy.

REQUIREMENTS
A Corsaline gauge and a Bluetooth Low Energy OBD-II adapter (the Vgate iCar Pro is the one we test on). Works with 1996 and newer US-market gas and diesel cars; most hybrids and EVs need the iCar Pro 2S. WiFi and classic-Bluetooth adapters are not supported.

Corsaline is an accessory display. It does not replace your factory instruments or warning lights. Set it up while parked, and never adjust the gauge or the app while driving.
