name: CritterRiches
description:
CritterRiches 猴雞狗豬大富翁，將擲骰買地的桌遊樂趣帶到 iPad。與靈巧猴、報曉雞、忠義狗、福氣豬一起，在 28 格棋盤上累積資產，展開充滿驚喜的對局。

【一台 iPad，四位角色同樂】
四位角色輪流行動，可自由指定真人玩家，其餘角色交由電腦控制。一個人也能與電腦對戰，或與親友共用同一台 iPad 遊玩。

【買地、升級與資產策略】
擲兩顆骰子前進，購買地產、升級房屋並收取租金。集齊同一街區可提高租金；遇到資金不足時，需衡量變賣地產的時機。結算時依總資產排名。

【機會與命運，讓每局都有變化】
抽取事件卡，迎接獎勵、支出與局勢變動。搭配稅務、休息及禁閉等棋盤事件，每一步都可能帶來新的轉機。

【四款主題，隨心切換】
提供經典原版、新春賀歲、中秋團圓、溫馨聖誕四種主題，為對局換上不同氣氛。

【適合共桌遊玩的顯示方式】
平板模式讓資訊統一朝向；桌遊模式則將玩家資訊與棋盤內容朝向各自座位。中央回合面板可拖曳移動，雙擊手把即可歸位。

【依照時間安排對局】
可選擇不同起始資金，以及 20、30、50 回合或無上限的遊戲長度。

【離線遊玩，自動保存進度】
不需登入帳號或連接網路。對局會自動儲存在裝置上，重新開啟 App 後可繼續未完成的遊戲，並可自行切換音效。

準備好與猴雞狗豬一起，展開下一場資產競賽了嗎？

name: Crumbs by CanonDraft
description:
Ideas don't wait for you to sit down at your desk. Crumbs catches them.

Crumbs is the pocket companion to CanonDraft, the screenwriting app. Type or say an idea, pick the script it belongs to, and tap Canny. Your idea is stamped, sealed and posted to that script's beat board, ready when you sit down to write.

• One job, done fast: the note is open and the keyboard is up the moment you open Crumbs.
• Say it instead: tap the mic and talk. Your characters' and places' names come out spelled right.
• Colour and tag ideas the way your beat board does.
• Sent today: fix a typo, or move an idea to another script.
• Works without a signal: ideas wait on your phone and post when you're back online.
• Start and rename scripts right from your phone.

Sign in with the CanonDraft account you write with, using Apple or Google. Crumbs is free with a CanonDraft account.

name: Cue: Song Tracker for Shows
description:
Ever wondered how many songs are left before intermission, or what the number you just loved was called? Cue puts the show’s song list on your wrist, so you can follow along without opening your program or lighting up your phone in a dark theater.

SNAP THE PROGRAM
Take a picture of the “Musical Numbers” page in your program. Cue reads the song titles and who sings them on your iPhone, splits them into acts, and lets you fix anything it misread. You can also choose a photo you already took, or type or paste a list.

FOLLOW ALONG ON YOUR WATCH
The current song fills the screen in dim red on black, with the next number underneath and your place in the act at the top. Turn the Digital Crown one click when a new song starts, and feel a quiet tap instead of a sound.

MADE FOR A DARK THEATER
• Dim red text that’s easy on your eyes and your neighbors’
• Double-tap to advance on Apple Watch Series 9, Ultra 2 and later (watchOS 11)
• Works with Always On: the title stays visible, dimmed, with your wrist down
• Before the Show, Intermission and Curtain Call, so the screen matches the stage
• Jump to any song from the full list if you lose your place
• Remembers where you are if you leave the app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Text recognition happens on your iPhone. Your shows sync straight to your watch. Nothing is uploaded, and there are no accounts, ads or tracking.

name: CueSight: Pool Aiming Guide
description:
CueSight is a practice app that shows you where to hit the object ball in pool.

Take a photo of the table from where you stand. Tap the 2 far corner pockets, the 2 side pockets, the cue ball and the object ball. CueSight then shows the ball hit (1/2, 1/4 and so on), the clock direction and the aiming line on your photo, along with how to line up the cue tip.

The angle shown is the angle to aim, not just the cut angle. When the balls rub against each other, the object ball is pushed slightly off the line (this is called "throw"). CueSight adds this to the cut so the object ball still heads into the pocket. You can adjust the throw correction from 0° to 6° to match your own shots.

No table nearby? Practice mode lets you drag the balls on a drawn table and check the ball hit for any layout.

After each shot, tap Made, Missed Thick or Missed Thin. Your shots are saved in the Shot Log, and you can export them as a CSV file.

KEY FEATURES
- Ball hit from your own photo: 1 (full), 3/4, 1/2, 1/4 and 1/8
- Clock direction and the angle to aim
- How to line up the cue tip with the object ball
- Throw correction you can adjust (0° to 6°)
- A magnifier for placing points accurately
- Practice mode with a drawn table, diamonds and a grid
- Shot Log with CSV export
- Works in English and Japanese

HOW TO USE
1. Stand where you will shoot and take a photo of the table
2. Tap the far-left corner pocket, the far-right corner pocket, the right side pocket and the left side pocket, in that order
3. Tap the center of the cue ball, then the object ball
4. Check the ball hit and aiming line. Tap another pocket to change the target
5. After the shot, record the result

PRICING
CueSight is free to download. Photo mode is free 3 times a day. Unlimited Photo Mode, a one-time in-app purchase, removes the limit. Buy once and keep it. Practice mode and the Shot Log are always free.
On a new iPhone, tap "Restore Purchases" on the purchase screen.

NOTES
- CueSight does not detect the table or balls automatically. You tap them on the photo yourself.
- Take the photo from behind the near short rail. Photos taken from the long rail side are not supported yet.
- Distances are calculated for a 9-foot table.
- The throw correction is a starting value. Results depend on speed, spin, the balls and the cloth, so please use the display as a practice guide.
- How to line up a 1/8 hit has not been checked on a real table yet.

name: Cursor Flow
description:
Cursor Flow turns your iPad or iPhone into a pen tablet and trackpad for your Mac. Draw with Apple Pencil in Photoshop, Affinity, Krita, Figma, Blender or any other Mac app, click and scroll with your fingers, all over your local Wi‑Fi.

REQUIRES THE FREE MAC APP
Cursor Flow needs its companion “Cursor Flow Computer” on the Mac. It is a free download at myn.to/info/cursorflow (not on the Mac App Store). Both devices must be on the same Wi‑Fi.

DRAW LIKE ON A PEN TABLET
• Tablet mode maps Apple Pencil 1:1 to your Mac display, letterboxed to the display’s aspect ratio.
• Pen down draws, pen up stops. Works with every Mac app that understands mouse input.
• Click bar above the surface: click, right click and double click exactly where the pointer is, without moving it.
• Finger drawing, drag lock, modifier keys (Shift, Option, Command, Control).
• Rotate and lock the view in 90° steps for comfortable drawing.

A HUGE TRACKPAD
• One finger moves, tap clicks, two fingers scroll, two‑finger tap opens the context menu.
• Adjustable sensitivity, natural scrolling, left‑ or right‑handed layout.

SECURE AND PRIVATE
• Pair once with a QR code or a 32‑character code. Every iPad gets its own device key, stored in the Keychain.
• Every connection is TLS‑encrypted. Nothing leaves your local network: no account, no server, no tracking, no ads.
• Emergency stop releases all held buttons immediately.

MULTIPLE DISPLAYS
• Choose which Mac display you control. If the layout changes, Cursor Flow asks again instead of guessing.

DIAGNOSTICS
• Round‑trip latency, frame counters and connection state at a glance. Counters only, never content.

Note: Apple Pencil pressure and tilt are transmitted, but macOS currently offers no way to pass them on to other apps. Set brush size in the app you draw in.

Requirements: iPad or iPhone with iOS/iPadOS 17 or later, a Mac with macOS 14 or later running the free Cursor Flow Computer app, both on the same Wi‑Fi. Apple Pencil optional.

name: Custody Log: Co-Parenting App
description:
Calmcase is a custody log for parents in a custody dispute. You write down what happens on the day it happens, and Calmcase keeps it in an order your attorney can follow.

WRITE IT DOWN WHILE IT'S FRESH
• Log handovers, incidents, messages, expenses and notes about your children.
• Attach photos, screenshots of texts, PDFs and voice notes. Dictate when typing is too much.
• Each entry keeps the time and, if you allow it, the place and how accurate it was.

SEALED WHEN YOU SAVE
• Every entry gets a SHA-256 fingerprint linked to the entry before it, and a timestamp from an independent timestamp authority (RFC 3161).
• Saved entries can't be edited. A correction is added as an amendment, and a deleted entry leaves a record with your reason. The original stays.
• Seal check shows that every entry still matches its fingerprint.

TIME EVERY HANDOVER
• Start the timer when you arrive. Calmcase saves the wait, your calls, and when the other parent arrived or didn't.
• The timer keeps running on your Lock Screen.
• Get a reminder 30 minutes before, or when you reach the handover place.

THE PLAN NEXT TO WHAT HAPPENED
• Enter your schedule: alternating weeks, 2-2-3, every other weekend or your own.
• The calendar shows planned nights next to actual ones and counts your share.

REPORTS YOUR ATTORNEY CAN FOLLOW
• A PDF that starts with a summary: handovers, late arrivals, no-shows, incidents and shared expenses. Then every entry by date, then the seals.
• Choose the period, the children and the kinds of entries.
• Send it by encrypted link. The key is part of the link, so we can't read the record. You set when it expires and can revoke it any time.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account. Your record stays on your iPhone or iPad.
• Face ID, Touch ID or an app passcode that isn't your phone's.
• Export an encrypted backup when you want a copy.

CALMCASE PRO
Reading, searching and exporting your record are free. New entries and handovers need Calmcase Pro: $8.99 a month, or $59.99 a year with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings. Prices may differ by country.

Calmcase is not legal advice. The court decides what evidence it admits.

Terms of Use: https://getcalmcaseapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://getcalmcaseapp.com/privacy

name: Custody Logs & Calendar: Kept
description:
Your custody logs in one private record: your custody schedule, every handoff, expenses, messages and notes. Kept saves it in your own iCloud and makes a short report for your attorney or mediator.

KNOWS YOUR SCHEDULE
• Pick your pattern: every other weekend, every other weekend plus a weekday, week on and week off, 2-2-3, 2-2-5-5, or your own.
• Set whose weekend is next, handoff times and the place. Change a single day without touching the rest.
• The calendar shows your plan next to what happened, with overnights counted for you.

LOG A HANDOFF IN TWO TAPS
• Tap Log it now, then Save. Kept puts in the time and your planned time beside it.
• Pick your own label: As planned, Different time, Didn't happen, or Changed by agreement.
• Add a note or photos later. An optional reminder before each planned handoff opens the log for you, and it never shows what you wrote.

EXPENSES, MESSAGES AND NOTES
• Log what you paid with a receipt photo and the split you agreed. Kept adds up what you logged.
• Add a screenshot of a message and Kept reads its words into text on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.
• Up to 6 photos on any entry.

EVERY CHANGE IS KEPT
• Edit any entry and the earlier version stays, with its time. Nothing is overwritten.
• Removed entries are listed in the change history too.

A SHORT REPORT FOR YOUR ATTORNEY
• Make a PDF for any range: a summary page first, then your entries and their change history.
• Export a CSV, or download a copy of everything with your photos.
• Share a read only copy with your attorney through iCloud. They can't change anything, and you can stop sharing at any time.

YOUR RECORD STAYS YOURS
• Your entries, photos and names go only to your own iCloud. There's no Kept account.
• Records safety shows where your record lives and when it last synced, and lets you download, restore or erase it.
• Viewing and exporting your record are always free, even if you stop paying.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• A Kept passcode separate from your phone's, with Face ID on top.
• An optional neutral app icon.
• Kept never contacts the other parent. There's no messaging and no shared account.

KEPT PRO
Try Kept Pro free for 7 days with the yearly subscription, then $59.99 per year. Or choose monthly at $9.99 per month, with no free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm, or when the free trial ends. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your App Store account settings.

A NOTE ON WHAT THIS IS
Kept is a record keeping tool, not legal advice. It doesn't check what you write.

Terms of Use: https://gizmobench.com/kept/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gizmobench.com/kept/privacy

name: Cutora: Background Remover
seller_name: INTLABS VIETNAM TECHNOLOGY JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
Studio-quality cutouts, product listings and passport photos — on your phone, no upload.

Pick a photo and Cutora lifts the subject off the background in about a second. Products, people, pets, plants. The AI runs on your device, so your photos stay private and it works offline.

ONE-TAP BACKGROUND REMOVER
Clean edges, automatic touch-ups and a refine brush with zoom when you want pixel-perfect results. Export a transparent PNG or a JPG.

BACKGROUNDS THAT MATCH YOUR PRODUCT
Smart Palette reads your product's colors and suggests six backgrounds that flatter it. Or choose white, solid colors, gradients, a blurred original or studio backdrops like marble, linen and wood.

REAL SHADOWS
Add a soft contact shadow, a drop shadow or a glossy reflection built from your cutout. Adjust opacity, softness and distance.

MARKETPLACE-READY IN ONE TAP
Presets for Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, Shopee, Mercado Livre, Vinted, Depop and Instagram. Cutora resizes and centers your product, then checks the rules: pure white background, product fill, minimum size, nothing cropped. Fix everything with one tap.

AI WRITES YOUR LISTING
Cutora recognizes your product and its colors and writes a title, five bullet points and search tags that fit each marketplace's limits. English, Spanish, Portuguese and Vietnamese.

PASSPORT & ID PHOTOS
Official sizes for 50+ countries, including US 2×2, EU/Schengen 35×45, UK, Canada, India, China, Japan, Vietnam and more. Face detection crops your photo correctly, replaces the background and checks head size, tilt, eyes and shoulders. Print a 4×6 in or 10×15 cm sheet.

BATCH EDIT
Process up to 50 photos with the same look and save them all at once.

STICKERS
Turn any cutout into an outlined 512×512 sticker for your favorite messaging app.

YOUR EDITS, SAVED
Recent projects are kept on your phone so you can come back and keep editing.

No watermarks on exports, ever. Your photos stay on your device unless you turn on optional Cloud AI (Pro).

CUTORA PRO
HD exports at full resolution, batch editing, unlimited AI listings, printable passport sheets and all studio backdrops. Start with a 3-day free trial.
Not sure yet? Every Free user gets 5 free Cloud AI tries for sharper listings and hair-level cutouts (with your consent; photos are processed, never stored).
• Weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase, charged to your Apple ID / Google Play account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.

Marketplace sizes follow each platform's public photo guidelines; passport requirements can change, so always check the issuing authority.

Terms: https://deskhub.cloud/terms
Privacy: https://deskhub.cloud/privacy

name: CxiwhStoft
description:
CxiwhStoft är en stillsam studie av ljus och svävande partiklar.

Rikta kameran mot en sned ljusstråle: damm, pollen och fjun virvlar långsamt i ljuset som ett litet universum. Stoft vill inte göra väsen av sig – det hjälper dig bara att behålla ögonblicket.

- Fånga: observera kornen i ljuset med kamera eller simulerat läge.
- Läs stoftet: se kornstorlek, Tyndall-styrka och klarhet.
- Stäm: justera ljusets vinkel, täthet, svävning, glöd och transparens.
- Ljusrum: byt mellan morgondis, skymning, zenit, regndis, lampljus och fönster.
- Ett andetag: andas in, håll, andas ut och spara andetaget i dagboken.
- Dagbok: filtrera på sinnesstämning och se tillbaka på dina möten med ljuset.
- Möten: varje gång du öppnar appen kan ett nytt ljuskort dyka upp.

name: CY
description:
CY is an offline workspace for learning stock analysis, building strategy rules, and reviewing simulated results. Start with a lesson, turn an idea into a rule, then see how it would have behaved on a historical price sample.

Explore price charts
Switch between a closing-price line and candlesticks, view volume, and tap a bar to inspect its open, high, low, and close. Use the built-in synthetic sample or import your own historical CSV.

Build and test strategies
Create entry and exit rules using indicators such as moving averages, MACD, and RSI. Set a date range, starting capital, and fees. Review the simulated trades, equity curve, and maximum drawdown, then save and compare results.

Calculate and review
Use calculators for profit and loss, position size, average cost, stop and target prices, rate of return, and risk-to-reward. Link a saved result to a journal entry, attach a chart or screenshot, and record what you would change next time.

Learn at your own pace
Work through short lessons, indicator examples, and quizzes with answer explanations. Keep notes, save favorites, and track your progress.

Your records stay on your device. No account is required. You can export a local backup or share reports when you choose.

CY is for education and simulation. It does not provide live quotes, execute trades, or offer investment advice.

name: Daad - Arabic Keyboard
description:
Daad is an iPhone keyboard for Arabic and English that understands Egyptian Arabic and Franco (Arabizi).
Typing
• Suggestions, autocorrect and next-word prediction that learn your words
• Franco to Arabic: type "ezayak" and get "إزيك" in the suggestions
• Swipe typing in both languages
• Always-on number row, flick up for symbols, hold for Arabic diacritics
• Your own text shortcuts
Control
• Hold and drag the space bar to move the cursor like a trackpad
• Forward delete next to 0, optional arrow keys
• iPhone or Gboard-style Arabic layout
Tools
• Emoji with search, and GIFs
• Clipboard history with pinned texts
• Translate without leaving the keyboard
• Calculator that inserts the equation and the result
• Contacts, text editing and one-handed mode
Make it yours
• Themes and your own background photo
• Keyboard height, font, sound and haptics
• Split keyboard in landscape
Privacy Daad does not collect what you type and never sends it to a server. Learned words and clipboard stay on your iPhone. Full Access is only needed for clipboard, GIFs and syncing settings.
Setup: Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard → Daad.

name: DailyBar
description:
A fast, focused strength-training log for iPhone and Apple Watch.

LOG WORKOUTS QUICKLY
• Add exercises from a library of 200+ movements, or create your own
• Last session's sets, weights and reps are filled in for you — just confirm or tweak
• Warm-up, drop and failure sets, with weights to two decimals
• Edit any past workout

APPLE WATCH
• See the current set, adjust weight and reps with the Digital Crown or a number pad, and complete it with one tap
• Workout overview with every set at a glance
• Rest timer on your wrist with a haptic and voice alert

REST TIMER THAT KEEPS UP
• Keeps counting when the app is in the background or the phone is locked
• Notification, vibration and spoken alert when rest is over

PROGRESS
• Personal records for max weight, reps, volume and estimated 1RM
• Charts per exercise, body-weight tracking and a summary after every workout
• Workout history with calendar view

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Everything is stored on your device — no account, no tracking
• Optional automatic backup to a folder you choose in Files
• Import history from a CSV export, and export your workouts any time
• Saves workouts to Apple Health (optional)

name: DaiQie Tomato: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Forgot your brain? Sit down anyway.

DaiQie is a quiet Pomodoro study timer with a delightfully dim tomato buddy.

FOCUS, THEN TAKE A BREAK
Start with 25 minutes of focus and a 5-minute break. After four completed sessions, take a 15-minute long break. Adjust durations to your own pace. Each next phase starts only when you choose.

NO MID-SESSION INTERRUPTIONS
No nudges or reward popups while you study. Lock your screen or switch apps; the timer keeps running. Optional local reminders announce the end of a phase, and an optional Live Activity shows a lock-screen countdown. Sound and delivery follow iOS notification, silent mode and Focus settings.

WATCH YOUR EFFORT GROW
Every 25 minutes of saved focus grows a ripe tomato. Time from sessions ended early still counts; pauses and breaks do not. Nothing withers if you stop. Complete full focus sessions to unlock original tomato buddies.

KEEP THE LITTLE BITS
Set a daily goal, explore seven-day stats and revisit your study history. Export CSV logs or save a full JSON backup to merge your records onto another device.

A LITTLE APPLAUSE
Your full-screen focus scene changes quietly at 15 and 30 minutes of total daily focus. Finish a session to meet one of 16 original tomato buddies. Open the daily recap to see how much you studied and celebrate beating yesterday or setting a personal best.

Free, with no account, ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Core features work offline. Records stay on your device; there is no automatic cloud sync. English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese follow your iOS app language setting. Your task names stay as you wrote them.

Slow still counts.

name: Daisy: UV & Sunscreen Timer
description:
Make your next break in the sun a little more informed.

Daisy brings together the UV forecast, your skin type, sunscreen and surroundings to estimate a time for your next session outdoors.

YOUR SUN TIME, EXPLAINED
Choose your skin tone on a colour scale or use the skin-type questionnaire. Adjust your SPF and tell Daisy whether you are on land, at the beach or in snow. Daisy accounts for altitude and the UV forecast as it changes through the day.

A COUNTDOWN TO SHADE
Start a session and follow the countdown. Allow reminders to hear when your session ends. On supported iPhones, a Live Activity keeps the countdown on your lock screen. System alarms require iOS 26 or later and your permission; notification reminders are available as a fallback.

SEE THE REASONING
Open Nerd Mode to explore the factors behind the estimate. Recent sessions contribute to your daily UV dose budget, so starting again does not erase the time already spent outdoors.

OPTIONAL APPLE HEALTH
Connect Apple Health to save your sun sessions and UV exposure, and read time in daylight. Health access is optional. Daisy does not upload your Health data to its own servers.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Your skin setting, preferences and recent sessions stay on your device. Daisy has no ads or advertising tracking. Weather requests use your approximate location.

Available in English and Italian, with light and dark appearances.

Daisy provides estimates for information and education, not medical advice or a guarantee against sunburn. UV exposure carries risk even before you burn. Use shade, protective clothing and sunscreen, follow the sunscreen label, and ask a healthcare professional about your individual needs.

name: Damphex
description:
Damphex is a focused lab for second-order phase-locked loop dynamics.

Tune loop bandwidth and damping, set a frequency offset and starting phase, then integrate the classic nonlinear PLL equations on device. Switch between the phase plane, phase error over time, and frequency error over time. Markers call out unlock, pull-in, capture, and cycle slips so acquisition is easy to follow.

Save runs locally, replay a trajectory, overlay a previous run, export CSV when you need it offline, and use built-in presets for textbook lock, ringing, overdamped crawl, and unlock trains. A short Field Guide explains the model and how to read the plots.

Everything runs on your iPhone. No account. No network required for simulation.

name: Dampingin
description:
Dampingin adalah teman bicara untuk urusan hukum sehari-hari. Ceritakan masalahmu dengan bahasamu sendiri, dan Dampingin membantu menjelaskan posisimu serta langkah yang aman untuk diambil. Jawabannya singkat, jelas, dan tidak menghakimi.

MULAI TANPA AKUN
• Langsung cerita tanpa nama dan tanpa daftar.
• Ingin riwayat tersimpan? Masuk dengan nomor WhatsApp kapan saja.

CERITA SOAL APA SAJA
• Gaji telat, kontrak kerja, PHK
• Sewa rumah atau kos, utang piutang
• Belanja online, penipuan, urusan keluarga, dan lainnya
• Butuh penjelasan lebih lengkap? Tekan Rinci.

CEK KEASLIAN
• Pindai QR pada dokumen bersegel Dampingin atau kartu praktisi untuk memastikan keasliannya.

PRIVASI
• Kamera hanya dipakai untuk membaca QR. Gambar tidak disimpan dan tidak dikirim.
• Ceritamu diproses penyedia AI pihak ketiga hanya untuk menyusun jawaban, setelah kamu menyetujuinya.
• Akun dan datanya bisa dihapus langsung dari aplikasi.

PENTING
Dampingin menjelaskan, bukan pengacara. Jawaban di aplikasi ini bukan nasihat hukum. Dalam keadaan darurat, hubungi 112. Layanan ini untuk usia 18 tahun ke atas.

name: Darts 501: Counting Practice
description:
Build confidence counting darts scores with Darts 501.

Study the darts on the board, enter your answer, and check the breakdown. Practice adding a visit total or subtracting it from your remaining 501 score.

• Randomized visits on a clear dartboard
• Two modes: visit total and score remaining
• Per-dart scoring explanations after every answer
• Double-out finishes and bust rules
• Session accuracy and correct-answer streaks
• A built-in guide to singles, doubles, triples, and bullseyes
• A number pad that stays within reach without scrolling

Works offline on iPhone and iPad. No account, advertising, analytics, or in-app purchases. Practice statistics last for the current session.

name: Daykin: GLP-1 Journal
description:
How did today feel? Daykin gives people taking a prescribed GLP-1 medication a small place to keep track.

Save a feeling, a meal, or both. Daykin gives a little hop and your date lights up. Tap an earlier day on the date rail to fill something in or change a note.

• Record how a day felt, with room for an optional meal, shot record or note.
• Take a meal photo, choose one from Photos, type a description or pick from 32 food illustrations. A photo alone is enough.
• Hold to talk on a supported iPhone and language, then edit your words before saving. Speech recognition runs on your device.
• Open Add a meal and tap a previous meal to save it again with its picture.
• Open This week to see your entries together, then share a report with someone you choose.
• Keep your journal on this iPhone and export a copy when you want one.

Daykin Pro is required to use the journal. Choose an annual or monthly subscription. Prices and billing periods appear before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your Apple account settings. Existing customers can restore access through Restore Purchases.

Daykin is a personal journal. For medication or treatment decisions, contact your prescriber.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Deal Chef
description:
Make dinner easier. Spend smarter. Cook your way.

Tired of staring into the fridge wondering what’s for dinner? Meet Deal Chef, your grocery-saving kitchen companion that helps turn local store deals and ingredients you already have into delicious meal ideas.

GROCERY DEALS FROM YOUR FAVORITE STORES

Choose your favorite grocery stores and discover sales in one convenient place. No need to plan your meals around just one retailer. Deal Chef helps you find inspiration using deals from the stores you love.

THREE SMART WAYS TO PLAN DINNER

Weekly Digest — Discover recipe ideas inspired by grocery sales.

Leftover Rescue — Turn ingredients already in your pantry into something delicious.

Dinner Decider — Can’t decide what to cook? Let Deal Chef combine grocery deals and pantry ingredients to suggest meals.

YOUR KITCHEN, YOUR RULES

• Set your dietary preferences and food allergies.
• Adjust recipes from 1 to 8 servings.
• View optional nutritional information.
• Save time with convenient grocery and pantry tools.
• Add recipe ingredients to your shopping list.
• Scan barcodes to help manage pantry and shopping items.
• Scan local grocery flyers for more meal inspiration.

MEET MISS DEE!

Need a little kitchen inspiration? Miss Dee brings personality, helpful hints, and a little Southern sass to your cooking routine.

MORE CHOICE. LESS DINNER STRESS.

Deal Chef isn’t tied to one grocery store or a predetermined meal plan. You choose where you shop, what you cook, and when you cook it.

Whether you’re stretching your grocery budget, using up leftovers, or simply trying to figure out tonight’s dinner, Deal Chef is here to help.

Download Deal Chef and discover a smarter way to plan dinner!

Some features may require a Deal Chef Pro subscription. Grocery sales, pricing, and availability vary by store and location.

name: Decidwell
description:
Most choices don’t have a perfect answer. Decidwell helps you see what you care about, choose without scores or rankings, and stop replaying “what if.”
DECIDE GENTLY
Name the choice, whether it feels small or big. Add your options. Notice the upside, the downside, and what you are afraid of losing. Check them against what you value, then answer a few calm questions. You make the call. Decidwell never scores a winner.
A NUDGE FOR TINY DECISIONS
When the stakes are small, Quick Pick can shuffle your options. It is a gentle nudge, not a verdict. You can override it anytime.
PEACE AFTER YOU CHOOSE
A cool-down pauses the urge to re-examine the decision for 1, 3, or 7 days. A what-if buffer holds the worry, a realistic counterpoint, and a backup plan. A gratitude note asks what has gone well since you chose. Acceptance mantras can be favorited and rewritten in your own words.
A LOG FOR PATTERNS
Write down the situation, how you felt, and link it to a choice. The log is for seeing patterns, not for judging yourself.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No tracking. No cloud. Your choices, notes, and thoughts stay on your device.
Decidwell is a personal reflection tool. It is not medical advice or mental health treatment.

name: Deyim Köprüsü
description:
Deyim Köprüsü, Türkçe ve İngilizce deyim ve atasözlerini karşılaştırarak öğrenmenin en kolay yolu.

• 120 deyim ve atasözü, Türkçe anlamı ve İngilizce karşılığıyla
• Sesli okuma: Türkçe ve İngilizce telaffuz
• Keşfet: anında arama ve kategoriler
• Koleksiyon: favorilerin ve öğrendiklerin
• Oyunlar: quiz ve eşleştirme ile kendini dene
• Günlük seri ve rütbe sistemi

Hesap gerekmez, reklam yok, veri toplanmaz. Her şey cihazında kalır.

name: Dirty Turf Portal
description:
Dirty Turf Portal keeps your turf service information together.

View your service reports and before-and-after photos, check payment details, read turf care instructions, and request your next cleaning. Receive service updates and follow-up messages when you enable notifications.

Customers with multiple properties can view their linked properties. Approved partners can access only the customer properties assigned to their account.

Sign in using the phone number connected to your Dirty Turf account and a verification code. An existing Dirty Turf customer account or approved partner invitation is required.

Dirty Turf provides physical turf cleaning services. Payments are for services performed at your property.

name: Diver Overlay
description:
Put your dive details on your video.

Diver Overlay helps divers, parents and coaches create dive videos with a personalized scoreboard overlay. Choose a video from Photos or Files, or record one in the app. Enter your dive details and scores, choose your colors, and export a finished video.

• Add your name, school or club, dive number, position, board height and degree of difficulty. • Import a dive sheet screenshot, choose a detected dive, and review or correct the details before applying them. • Enter 3, 5, 7 or 9 judges' marks, or use the meet's official dive score. • Customize the card's colors, font, size and position. • Add your own logos from Photos or Files, remove backgrounds, and position them on the video. • Save styles to reuse on your next video. • Trim your clip and add a half-speed or quarter-speed replay. • Save the finished MP4 to Photos or share it using the system share sheet.

Your videos and screenshots are processed on your device. No account, subscription or internet connection is required for editing. Items stored in iCloud or other cloud file providers may need a connection to download.

Please check recognized scores and dive details against your original sheet. Screenshot recognition may require corrections. You can override the calculated dive score with the meet's official score. Keep the app open during export. Videos export in SDR at up to 60 fps; the added slow-motion replay is silent.

name: Domi Gate
description:
Domi Gate turns your phone into your flat's door station.

When a visitor presses your flat at the entrance panel, your phone rings — at home or anywhere else. You see live video of who is at the door before you decide anything, then choose to speak to them, show your own camera, or open the door.

• See before you answer. The video appears as the call opens, with your microphone still off.
• Answer with audio, or with audio and video — your camera is off unless you turn it on.
• Open the door from the call, wherever you are.
• Missed it? A short clip of who rang is waiting for you, viewable by your household only.
• Works on mobile data. Calls are relayed through Domi Gate's server in the EU; your phone is never connected directly to the entrance panel or to a stranger's device.

You need an invitation code from whoever manages your building — Domi Gate is not a service you can sign up for on your own. If your building does not use it yet, this app will not do anything for you.

Privacy, briefly: a door call is live and is never recorded. Short clips recorded at the entrance stay encrypted on the entrance unit itself and delete themselves after about 48 hours. Your door code is stored only as a one-way hash — nobody can read it back, including your building manager and including us. There is no advertising and no analytics in this app.

Full notice: https://domigate.com/privacy

name: Double Downhill
description:
Double Downhill is a two-player skiing game for one phone.

Turn the phone sideways and share it. You take the red skier, your friend takes the blue. Both hold your start buttons and you're off.

- One thumb each. Steer around trees, rocks and everything else on the mountain.
- The slope speeds up the longer you last.
- If one of you crashes, you both go down. Teamwork, or blame. Your call.
- Beat your top score, then share it.

Best enjoyed with headphones.

From Scribbley Games, the makers of Double Drive.

name: Doublebottom
description:
Doublebottom keeps your passwords on this phone and nowhere else.

NO NETWORK, NO ACCOUNT
The app has no internet access. There is no sign-up, no cloud sync, no analytics and no ads.

ENCRYPTED ON THE DEVICE
Entries are encrypted with a key made from your PIN and a secret kept in the device Keychain.
The app's files are not included in device backups.

A SECOND PIN WITH ITS OWN VAULT
In Settings you can add a second PIN. It opens a separate vault with its own entries. Each PIN
shows only its own vault. Before you turn it on, the app explains that laws about device searches
differ between countries and that you are responsible for how you use it.

SMALL THINGS THAT MATTER
- Copied passwords are cleared from the clipboard after 30 seconds.
- The app locks when you leave it, and the app switcher shows a blank screen.
- After five wrong PINs, each next attempt waits longer.

IMPORTANT
Because nothing leaves the device, there is no recovery. If you delete the app, lose the phone
or forget your PINs, your entries are gone.

name: Dr. Glow Up
description:
Welcome to the clinic, doctor! Every patient walks in needing a glow up, and your steady hands get them there.

Press and hold to treat, then let go right on the star. Too early and the job isn't done; too late and things get messy. Nail it and watch their Aura soar.

• 12 treatments: face wash, pimple popping, jaw roller, scar gel, cucumber slices for dark circles, nose job, laser spot removal, posture fix, teeth whitening, hair and brow serum, wrinkle iron and a final glow
• 50 levels in 5 chapters, with new treatments unlocking as you go and a boss patient at the end of every chapter
• A waiting room full of characters, each with their own look and reactions
• A before and after slider to admire your work
• Quick one-thumb play that works offline
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking

Dr. Glow Up is a cartoon game made for fun, not medical or beauty advice.

name: DrainFall: Pipe Drop
description:
DrainFall turns a pipe run length and a slope percent into the fall in inches, then keeps the runs you already checked. Built for drain installers and remodelers who need the drop before they set the pipe.

Enter the run and the grade on the first screen and the fall is shown immediately. Saved runs stay on the device. DrainFall does not collect accounts, analytics, or payments.

Free. No in-app purchases, subscriptions, or ads.

name: Dreamweaver Scan
description:
Dreamweaver Scan turns a walk through a property into a true-to-scale 3D model.

Scan once, and we use it for everything you need: professional photographs, 3D tours, appraisals and videos.

Walk each room slowly, tap send, and we take it from here.

name: DriveKeep
description:
Enter your odometer reading once, then see every service your car needs.
Each service item can be due by distance or by time, whichever comes first.
See at a glance what is overdue, due soon, or on track.
Swipe a service to log it at the current odometer reading.
Keep a dated history for every job, with notes on what was done.
Add your own service items with their own intervals.
Get an estimated due date based on how far you actually drive.
Log each fill-up with the fuel added and what it cost.
Follow your average and latest fuel economy in mpg or L/100 km.
Know what fuel really costs you per mile or kilometer.
Partial fills are counted correctly between full tanks.
Record parking, repairs, insurance, tolls, washes, and other running costs.
Check monthly and year-to-date totals with a six-month chart.
Export your expenses as a CSV file whenever you need them.
Keep insurance, registration, inspection, and warranty details in the Glovebox.
See which documents are expiring soon before they lapse.
Record the pressure of all four tires along with your tread depth.
Spot the tire that needs air on a top-down view of your car.
Look back at earlier tire checks in a dated history.
Read practical guides on sidewall codes, tire age, and wear patterns.
Browse seventeen common wear parts with warning signs and replacement advice.
Turn on optional reminders for service dates, renewals, and monthly tire checks.
Back up everything to a file and restore it whenever you need to.
No account, no ads, and no tracking — your data stays on your iPhone.
Intervals are general guidance, so always follow your owner's manual and a qualified technician.

name: DriverPro - MC Carrier LLC
description:
DriverPro - MC Carrier LLC is the driver app for MC Carrier LLC and other carriers that run on DriverPro TMS. Sign in with the phone number your dispatcher has on file — your loads, documents and pay are already there.

LOADS AND STOP TIMES
• See your current, next and completed loads with pickup and delivery details, reference numbers and driver instructions (including hazmat and reefer instructions).
• Record Time in and Time out at every stop, and mark a load delivered — dispatch sees it in the TMS right away.
• Local jobs: accept or decline yard moves, shuttles and daily runs, record their times and mark them finished.

PAPERWORK
• Scan the BOL and the signed POD with your phone's camera; they are attached to the load in the TMS as a PDF.
• Scan lumper and other payment receipts with a note for accounting.

DOCUMENTS AND PAY
• Permit book: your CDL, medical card and the truck and trailer permits, with expiration dates, ready to show at an inspection.
• Weekly pay statements as PDFs.
• Your performance: on-time pickups and deliveries, miles, loads and hometime.

REQUESTS
• Request hometime with your dates.
• Request Personal Conveyance with your location and an HOS screenshot — approved automatically when it qualifies, or reviewed by Safety.
• Call your dispatcher (or the after-hours line) in one tap, and follow the repairs on your truck and trailer.

Company policy updates arrive in the app to read and acknowledge.

New to DriverPro TMS? Tap "New customer" on the sign-in screen to learn more.

An account is created by your carrier; there is no sign-up in the app.

name: DrumScript - Drum Score Video
description:
Write drum charts on your phone, then put them on your cover videos as a moving score.

WRITE
• Tap a drum to put it in the step you're on: snare, kick, hi-hat, toms, cymbals, percussion
• Write a number on a step to split it or make a tuplet: a 3 is a triplet
• Accents, ghost notes, flams, drags, buzz rolls, crescendos, rehearsal marks, text
• Any meter (numerators 1–16), with groupings for meters like 7/8
• Import .mscz and MusicXML: open them in DrumScript from the Files app
• Engraved the way printed charts are
• Played back with recorded drums, from any section

MAKE THE VIDEO
• Choose a video of you drumming: the score lines up with your first hit by itself
• If it's off, drag it on the timeline
• The preview is the export: scrolling or page turns, four looks for the band
• Add a backing track to the export
• Or record in the app: the count-in, metronome and backing track in your headphones, and the take is in time when you stop
• Save it to Photos or share it

PRO (bought once, not a subscription)
• Take the original drums out of a backing track and play along
• No watermark, or your own handle instead
• No limit on bars, in scores or in videos
• A4 PDF export, ready to print

Free: scores you write up to 25 bars (imported scores come in whole), videos up to 25 bars each, with the DrumScript watermark; drums out for 30 seconds each play.

PRIVACY
DrumScript works offline, needs no account and collects no data. Your scores live in your own iCloud; videos, backing tracks, takes and drum removal stay on your phone.

I make DrumScript on my own; it's monodo's second app, after Rudiments Master. Questions or ideas: monododev@gmail.com

name: Duo Duel: 2 Player Party Games
seller_name: MAS SOFT YAZILIM TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Duo Duel is a pack of quick mini games for two players on one phone. Put the phone on the table between you: the bottom half is Player 1, the top half is Player 2. Pick your names and colors, get ready, and battle it out!

12 LIGHTNING DUELS
• Reaction: tap first when it turns green, but not too early
• Sumo Push: tap fast and push your rival out of the ring
• Air Hockey: slide the puck into the other goal
• Table tennis: keep the ball in play with your paddle
• Tug of War: out-tap your rival to pull the rope
• Color Trap: tap only when the word matches its color
• Quick Math: be the first to answer
• Cowboy Draw: wait for the signal, then shoot
• 1-Button Soccer, Tank Duel, Memory Race and Snake Duel

TOURNAMENT
First to 5 wins takes it all. Every round is a random mini game, with a scoreboard between rounds and a big champion celebration at the end. Want a rematch? One tap.

QUICK PLAY
Pick any game you like and play a short match.

NO RIVAL? BEAT THE AI
Playing alone? Climb the AI Ladder on Easy, Normal or Hard. Every one of the 12 games has an AI opponent. Use boosters like Shield and Slow-Mo to win the tough matches.

MORE TO UNLOCK
The first 6 games are open from the start. Every tournament you finish unlocks the next one, or unlock them with coins. Come back every day for a daily reward.

NO WI-FI, NO WAITING
All games play offline, right on your phone. No accounts, no lobbies.

Duo Duel is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases. There are no banner ads, and you can remove pop-up ads with a one-time purchase.

Questions or ideas? Write to muranocrew@gmail.com

name: Duo Jewelry
description:
Turn your iPhone Duo into an engagement ring box.

Design the box, close your phone and hand it over. When they open it, the lid lifts, a music box begins to play and a sparkling ring waits in the velvet cushion. Tap the ring to lift it out and watch hearts, confetti or rose petals fill the screen.

Make it yours
• Velvet box in the color you love
• Your own words on the lid and a message inside
• Choose the stone, cut, band and metal
• A little figure turning in the lid: a waltzing couple, a ballerina, a wedding cake, hearts, stars and more
• Classic music box tunes
• Pink or gold hearts, balloons, confetti, rose petals or gold stars when the ring comes out
• Save your boxes and open them again any time

Made for the moment: no account, no ads, no internet needed.

On other iPhones, tap the closed box to open it.

Duo Jewelry is for fun and for real proposals alike. The ring is virtual, so you'll still need the real one.

name: Düşünbaz: Zihin Arenası
description:
Her gün birkaç dakika, altı alan, 43 oyun. Düşünbaz, zihnini eğlenceli oyunlarla çalıştıracağın kişisel antrenman arenası.

Baz seni bekliyor: gözlüklü, meraklı bir ahtapot. Hangi alanlara odaklanmak istediğini ve günde ne kadar vakit ayırabileceğini söyle, o da sana her gün yeni bir rutin hazırlasın. Zorluk senin performansına göre ayarlanır; ne çok kolay ne çok zor.

ALTI ALAN, 43 OYUN
• Hafıza: Kart Eşleştirme, Sayı Dizisi, Görsel Hafıza, Sıra Hafızası, N-Geri, Ne Eksik?, Kelime Listesi
• Dikkat: Hedef Avı, Farklı Olan, Sayı Tablosu, Yeşil Işık, Renk Karmaşası, Ok Yönü, Kaç Tane?
• Mantık: Sudoku, Sayı Dizileri, Mantık Problemleri, Örüntü Tamamla, Işıkları Söndür, Terazi, Hanoi Kulesi
• Kelime: Anagram, Kelime Avı, Eş & Zıt Anlam, Harf Çarkı, Eksik Harf, Atasözü Tamamla, Beş Harf
• Genel kültür: Tarih, Bilim, Coğrafya, Sanat & Edebiyat, Günlük Quiz, Doğru mu Yanlış mı?, Bayrak & Başkent, Türkiye’yi Tanı
• Matematik: Zihinden İşlem, Sayı Tahmini, Problem Çözme, Kayıp İşaret, Hedef Sayı, Hangisi Büyük?, İşlem Zinciri

GÜNLÜK RUTİN
• Örnek: Hafıza 2 dk, Dikkat 3 dk, Mantık 3 dk, Genel kültür 4 dk. Toplam 12 dakika.
• Alanları, süreleri ve sırayı sen belirlersin. İstersen daha fazla oynarsın.
• Her gün Günün Kelimesi ve 10 soruluk Günlük Quiz.

YOLCULUK
• Her alanda 12 bölüm, 60 seviye. Yıldız topla, bölüm sınavlarını geç, ipucu kazan.

SERİ VE ROZETLER
• Günlük seri, seri dondurma ve onarma, 30’dan fazla rozet.
• Hatırlatıcı: seçtiğin saatte günde bir nazik hatırlatma.

GELİŞİMİNİ GÖR
• Zihin Puanı ve altı alanlı zihin haritası
• Haftalık süre grafiği, alan eğrileri, takvim, rekorlar, oyun geçmişi

İNTERNETSİZ VE HESAPSIZ
• Oyunlar internet olmadan çalışır. Üyelik yok; ilerlemen telefonunda kalır.

PREMIUM
• Reklamsız oyun
• 6 içerik paketi: Osmanlı Tarihi, Uzay ve Astronomi, Sinema ve Müzik, Zekâ Soruları, Usta Sudoku, Kelime Ustası
• Sınırsız ipucu ve ek hak
• 30 ve 90 günlük istatistikler, bütün oyun geçmişi
• Her hafta bir seri dondurma

Premium aylık ya da yıllık otomatik yenilenen abonelikle sunulur. Yıllık planda ilk 7 gün ücretsizdir. Ödeme, satın alma onayıyla Apple hesabından alınır. Abonelik, dönem bitiminden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse otomatik yenilenir. Aboneliğini App Store hesap ayarlarından yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsin.

Kullanım koşulları: https://taskinyazilim.com/uygulamalar/dusunbaz/kullanim-kosullari
Gizlilik: https://taskinyazilim.com/uygulamalar/dusunbaz/gizlilik

Düşünbaz eğlence ve öğrenme amaçlıdır; tıbbi bir cihaz değildir. Zihin Puanı yalnız oyunlardaki performansını gösterir.

name: Earth MIDI
description:
Earth MIDI turns the living planet into music, live.

Every earthquake rings a bell, pitched by its depth and struck as hard as its magnitude. The solar wind sweeps a synth pad, ocean swell breathes at its real wave period, tides bend a drone, the jet stream howls, and ten cities sing a chord tuned to their temperature right now. When the sun flares, bells ring. The planet's magnetic weather even picks the musical scale.

• Live: hear events as the sensors publish them, or replay the last 24 hours
• An ambient planet for your living room: the controls fade away and it is just the globe and the sound
• Choose which layers you hear: earthquakes, solar wind, ocean swell, tides, the jet stream, the planet chord, the space station and more
• Play and pause from your Siri Remote, with Now Playing on your TV
• AirPlay to any speaker

Real data from USGS, NOAA, NASA, Open-Meteo and Copernicus. AI helped design and build Earth MIDI, including the rules that turn data into sound. But no AI runs while you listen: every note comes from a live sensor reading through the same rule every time.

By Colin Robinson · earthmidi.com

name: Easy outsource
description:
Easy outsource is a CRM for freelancers and small development studios. Clients, projects, tasks with rates and discounts, invoices and documents — in one place, on the web and on iPhone.

PROJECTS AND TASKS
• A project is split into work packages; every task has hours, a rate and a price.
• Discount by percent, by amount or by final total — for a task or a whole package.
• Task list and board: change status and hours in a couple of taps.

INVOICES
• Invoices are issued only for finished tasks.
• See what is awaiting payment, what is paid and what is not invoiced yet.
• While an invoice is active, its tasks are protected from accidental edits.

TEAM AND CLIENT
• Invite teammates and people from the client side by email.
• Roles from observer to client, with separate access to amounts, documents and billing details.
• Comments for the team only or for the team and the client.

DOCUMENTS AND NOTIFICATIONS
• Contracts, acts and attachments next to the client and the project.
• Push notifications about comments, tasks and invoices.

Free plan — up to 5 clients with one project each, files up to 1 MB. Web version: crm.anaxita.com

name: Ebru Atelier: Color Puzzle
description:
Sort the colors, mix them, and reveal a real marbling painting at the end of every chapter.

Ebru Atelier brings the magic of Turkish ebru (paper marbling) art to the classic color sort puzzle. Move the colored drops between glass bottles until every bottle holds a single color. But this atelier has a twist: the Mixing Bowl. Bring two primary colors together and a brand-new color is born. Red and yellow become orange, blue and yellow become green. Sometimes you sort, sometimes you mix.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• The Mixing Bowl: puzzles solved by blending colors, something plain sort games don't have.
• An ebru collection: finish a chapter and paints spread across the water to reveal a new marbling painting. Collect them in the gallery and share your favorites.
• 300 handcrafted levels in 16 chapters: gentle at first, real brain teasers later. Every level is solvable.
• Daily challenge: a fresh puzzle every day. Try to solve it in the fewest moves.
• Play at your own pace: no timers. Undo, take a hint or open an extra tube when you need one.
• Make the atelier yours: unlock new drop patterns, bottle styles and backgrounds with coins.
• Made for everyone: color-blind symbols and a high-contrast palette.
• Play offline: no internet needed to play.

Calm music, soft clinks of glass and colors blooming on water. A relaxing brain game for a short break or a long evening.

The game is free and contains ads. "Remove Ads" permanently removes banner and interstitial ads and includes a one-time bonus of 500 coins. Rewarded ads are always optional.

Privacy policy: https://ouzhaanttnn-afk.github.io/ebru/privacy-en.html

name: EchoDesk - App
description:
EchoDesk is the all-in-one workspace for customer service and business teams. The mobile app brings your company's EchoDesk workspace to your phone, so you can keep work moving wherever you are.

Sign in with your company workspace and your EchoDesk account. The app shows exactly the modules and permissions your administrator has enabled for you.

TICKETS AND BOARDS
• Kanban boards with drag and drop between columns
• Ticket details, comments, checklists, attachments and photos
• My tickets, assignment and time tracking

MESSAGES IN ONE INBOX
• Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram and website chat in one place
• Assign conversations, start and end sessions, use saved replies and WhatsApp templates
• Customer cards with contact details and history

EMAIL
• Your shared mailboxes with folders, threads and attachments
• Reply, forward and compose with your team signature

LEAVE AND HR
• Request leave, see your balance and holidays
• Managers approve or reject requests from the phone
• Substitutes, KPIs and your own payroll view when your company uses them

AND MORE
• Team chat, calls history, bookings, invoices, online-store orders and products
• Company directory, time statistics and the help center
• Push notifications for new messages, assignments and approvals
• Face ID / fingerprint unlock
• Georgian and English, light and dark mode

EchoDesk is a business app: you need an account in an EchoDesk workspace. Ask your administrator for access, or learn more at echodesk.ge.

name: EduLite
description:
EduLite là app quản lý trung tâm giáo dục dành cho chủ trung tâm, nhân viên và giáo viên. Tài khoản do trung tâm của bạn cấp — mở app, nhập mã trung tâm, email và mật khẩu là dùng được ngay.

GIÁO VIÊN
• Xem lịch dạy trong ngày, trong tuần
• Điểm danh cả lớp chỉ vài chạm: có mặt, có phép, vắng
• Nhập điểm, nhận xét giữa / cuối khoá
• Check-in chấm công, xin nghỉ, gửi giải trình

NHÂN VIÊN & KẾ TOÁN
• Theo dõi công nợ học phí: đến hạn, quá hạn, đã nhắc bao nhiêu lần
• Gửi tin báo phí kèm mã VietQR đúng số tiền và nội dung chuyển khoản
• Thu tiền, lập phiếu thu chi, in / chia sẻ phiếu PDF
• Quản lý học viên, lớp học, học bù, khách tiềm năng

CHỦ TRUNG TÂM
• Tổng quan học phí hôm nay / tháng / năm, công nợ, thu chi 12 tháng
• Giao việc, duyệt đơn, thông báo nội bộ
• Lương, lịch làm việc, phân quyền nhân viên
• Chọn màu app theo thương hiệu trung tâm

Thông báo đẩy nhắc giờ vào ca, việc mới, đơn chờ duyệt và báo cáo học bù mỗi sáng. Chữ trong app tự theo cỡ chữ của điện thoại.

EduLite chỉ dành cho trung tâm đã dùng hệ thống EduLite. Chưa có tài khoản? Liên hệ trung tâm của bạn hoặc xem https://edulite.vn

name: eGile
description:
eGile.kz is a workspace for your team: tasks, projects, CRM, chats and an AI assistant in a single app. Everything that used to be scattered across messengers, spreadsheets and notes now lives in one place and syncs between your phone and your computer.

TASKS AND PROJECTS
• Lists and kanban boards — switch to whichever suits you
• Due dates, priorities, assignees and subtasks
• Comments and attachments right inside the task
• Project progress visible at a glance

TEAM
• Direct and group chats with colleagues
• Voice messages, photos and files
• Invite teammates by email
• Roles and access rights within each project

CRM
• A deal pipeline organised by stage
• Owners and full history for every deal
• A project knowledge base for guidelines and how-tos

AI ASSISTANT
• Breaks a large task into clear steps
• Drafts a plan, an email or a task description
• Answers questions about your projects

CREDENTIALS VAULT
• Project passwords, API keys and SSH keys in one protected place
• AES-256 encryption and per-person access grants
• An audit log so the project owner sees who opened which secret and when

SECURITY
• Face ID and Touch ID unlock
• Two-factor authentication
• A list of active sessions, so an unfamiliar sign-in stands out
• No ads and no tracking: we do not follow you around and we do not sell data

The app is available in Russian, Kazakh and English.

Signing up is free. By continuing you accept the terms of use at
https://egile.kz/terms and the privacy policy at https://egile.kz/privacy

name: elbfleet
description:
elbfleet brings together the day-to-day tools of a Royal Air Maroc pilot.

- Roster: your duties, trips, simulator and days off in a calendar.
- Logbook: flights created from your roster, times and landings, PDF export in the EASA logbook format.
- Flight preparation: import your OFP, NOTAM sorted for your flight, METAR/TAF, indicative fuel and weight and balance figures.
- Flight time limitations: duty and flight time totals for a personal check.
- Notes on aircraft and airports, leave plan.

Access is limited to Royal Air Maroc flight crew; each new account is approved manually.

Important notes
This app does not support airline integrations. If your airline does not support a roster download or an OFP download, you cannot use these features of the app.
This app is for information only. The official documents always prevail.
