name: Elijah's Cracker Party
description:
Christmas afternoon, the whole family round one iPad. Pull a cracker to pick the game, pass it to the next player, and race through 30-second mini-games for the paper crown.

HOW A PARTY WORKS
Two players pull a cracker to find out the round's game, with a joke inside every one. Then each player takes a 30-second go while everyone else watches, cheers and shouts advice. Places score party points, the last round counts double, and the winner gets the crown in a family photo you can share.

ELEVEN QUICK MINI-GAMES
Present Catch, Snowball Showdown, Costume Match, Sleigh Dash, Rooftop Run, Present Tower, Snowman Roll, Naughty or Nice, Chimney Drop, Carrot Toss and Bauble Hang. Each needs one move: a tap, a drag, a hold or a swipe.

A FAIR GO FOR EVERYONE
Each player picks a level: Little elf is gentler, Normal is the standard game and Expert is faster. A first-time player can race a grandparent and it is still close.

DRESS UP THE WHOLE FAMILY
Pick a look for every player, mums and dads included, then choose from eight costumes: Snowman, Reindeer, Nutcracker, Elf, Yeti, Gingerbread, Angel and Red Nose. Your players appear in the games themselves.

MADE TO PLAY TOGETHER
- 2 to 6 players on one iPad
- 3, 5 or 8 rounds
- Everything is read out loud, so new readers know what to do
- Works without a connection

Two games are free. One purchase unlocks all eleven, for good. No adverts, no sign-up, nothing collected.

From the Elijah games, alongside Elijah Saves Christmas and Elijah's Halloween Quest.

name: eNalog – work orders
description:
eNalog is the app for workshops, service companies and craftsmen. It is meant for companies that already use eNalog: sign in with your account and have the whole workshop with you.

What it does
• Work orders: open one at intake, assign it to a worker and follow its status live.
• Customers and vehicles: search by name, plate or VIN.
• Photos, mileage and the customer's signature straight on the work order.
• Bookings with SMS reminders.
• Working hours: arrival, departure, lunch and business trips.
• Warehouse: articles, stock and barcode scanning.
• Invoices in eNalog or in your accounting program.
• Team chat with files and mentions.

Only in the phone app
• Encrypted notifications: only your phone can read them.
• Sign in with Face ID or fingerprint.
• Check in at work by tapping an NFC tag or scanning a QR code.
• Scan barcodes and QR codes with the camera.
• Files and PDFs open and save on the phone.

The company account is created by an administrator at enalog.si. Support: info@enalog.si, +386 31 744 268.

name: Ensembly: Rehearsal Planner
description:
Who’s coming to rehearsal? Who’s singing at the concert? And who showed up how often this year?

Ensembly is the tool for whoever plans the dates and keeps the register in an ensemble – chair, conductor, band leader or secretary. For choirs, wind and brass bands, orchestras, bands and theatre groups.

DATES
• Rehearsals, performances and other dates with place, time, note and programme
• Create weekly rehearsals as a series – the whole term in one go
• The next date always at the top, with the line-up at a glance

REPLIES AND LINE-UP
• Note replies fast: yes, maybe, no
• Turnout per voice or section – e.g. “Tenor 1: 3 of 5”
• “Who hasn’t replied?” and “Ask for replies” as ready-made text for your group chat

ATTENDANCE IN SECONDS
• Tap per member: present, excused, absent
• “All present” and “Use replies” – then just fix the exceptions
• Stats: attendance rate per member and section, for the year or only rehearsals or performances

SHARE AND REPORT
• Share the schedule as text – e.g. in your group chat
• As a calendar file (.ics): every member adds the dates to their own calendar with one tap
• Annual report as PDF for the annual meeting: overview, performances with programme, attendance per section and member

FOR EVERY ENSEMBLE
Templates for mixed, men’s and women’s choirs, wind band, orchestra, band and theatre group – or your own sections. Add members one by one or paste a whole list.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no ads, no tracking. All data stays on your device. A backup takes everything to a new device; a handover passes the ensemble on to the next person who keeps the register.

FREE AND SUBSCRIPTION
Free: 1 ensemble with up to 12 members – with all features.
With the subscription (yearly or monthly, try 1 week free): unlimited members and several ensembles.
The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://brightpage.net/probenplaner#datenschutz

name: Epoch Clash
description:
You start with a handful of citizens and their stone axes. By the end of the same match, your tanks stand before enemy cities, your rockets climb toward the Moon and a rival is already building the Time Portal.

Epoch Clash is real-time strategy the way it belongs on a phone: in landscape, under your thumb, without the busywork. You think like a general. Your empire handles the rest.

HOW FAR WILL YOU GO?
Stone Age, Ancient Age, Middle Ages, Industrial Age, Modern Age, Future Age. Every advance changes everything: your cities, your army, even the resources you fight over. Stone and wood lose their worth, oil and uranium become power, and the crystal of the future exists in one place only: on the Moon.

THE MOON BELONGS TO WHOEVER GETS THERE FIRST
From the Modern Age on, build a spaceport and launch rockets. Found bases on the Moon, mine crystal and defend your lead with star fighters and star cruisers. And from up there, an orbital laser can strike any place on Earth your scouts have seen.

YOU LEAD, YOUR EMPIRE WORKS
Your scholars research on their own, and when the next age arrives, you pick a bonus. If you like, your army guards the borders by itself, sends reinforcements and spreads across several fronts. Troops cross the sea in their own boats. A wall takes one stroke of your finger. Your mind stays free for the next move.

THEY WILL LOOK YOU IN THE EYE
Elizabeth I, Bismarck, Lincoln, Ramesses II, Hammurabi, Qin Shi Huang, Oda Nobunaga, Montezuma and Julius Caesar. Nine nations, each with its own architecture and two units no one else has. Their leaders face you full screen, with their own voice and their own music. They trade, forge alliances and make threats. And when one of them declares war on you, you will hear it.

WAR ON EVERY FRONT
Knights break through the lines, sappers blast gaps in walls, priests turn enemy units to your side. Later, submarines lurk beneath your fleets, bombers sweep across the land, and whoever owns a missile silo holds the atomic strike in their hand. In the future, a shield generator spreads over your city.

THE WILD IS ALIVE
Between the empires live tribes and pirates with chiefs of their own. Make them friends, turn them against your rivals or bring them into your empire. Not all of them are peaceful. What lies beyond the fog, only your scouts will show you.

HISTORY IN YOUR HANDS
In the year 2100, Vohr opens the first Time Portal, and the Time Ring shatters into six shards. Chase them, and you land in the middle of history. Kadesh, Trafalgar, Waterloo, Normandy: the battles are inspired by real events. Help the samurai hold the coast until the storm arrives. Break a line of frigates. And at the end, you have twelve minutes to stop an atomic war. 19 missions, fully voiced.

YOUR WORLD, YOUR RULES
Two to six empires on continents, islands, mainland, inland sea, mountains or river land, from small to huge. Set every opponent on its own, from Easy to Extreme. Win by conquest, slay the enemy kings, hold the Time Stone or claim most of the land. Or be the first to complete the Time Portal.

WHAT YOU WON'T FIND HERE
No ads. No account. No tracking. No random purchases. Epoch Clash plays offline, with music that follows the battle and a Hall of Fame for victories and achievements.

FOUR AGES WITHOUT A PURCHASE
Without any purchase you play from the Stone Age to the Industrial Age, the campaign up to chapter IV with 13 missions, seven nations, six map types, four biomes and all game modes. Expansions add the Modern Age with chapter V, the Future Age with the Moon and chapter VI, the Chinese and the Romans, the Earth with real starting locations and six biomes with their own animals and tribes: Eternal Ice, Desert, Jungle, Savanna, Volcanic Land and Highlands. The Founder Pack bundles everything from launch in one purchase. No subscription: once bought, it is yours.

name: Escales VE
description:
Trouvez où dormir… et recharger. Escales VE réunit les hôtels équipés d'une borne de recharge, sélectionnés par la rédaction de Tesla Mag, média indépendant de la mobilité électrique depuis 2013.

• Plus de 150 hôtels avec borne, en France et en Europe, avec le type de recharge et la puissance
• Filtres : Tesla Destination, Type 2, recharge rapide, prise domestique, puissance minimale
• Classement du plus proche au plus loin et carte des hôtels
• Assistant de voyage : décrivez votre trajet, il propose des étapes et des hôtels de la sélection
• Recherche des hôtels avec borne sur Booking dans la ville de votre choix
• Avis des voyageurs : la borne fonctionnait-elle ?
• Favoris et liste consultables hors connexion

Sans compte pour consulter. Un compte Tesla Mag gratuit permet de publier un avis.
Les réservations passent par des liens partenaires signalés : Tesla Mag peut percevoir une commission, sans surcoût pour vous.
Tesla Mag n'est pas affilié à Tesla, Inc.

name: Escalio: Stair Calculator
description:
Building or renovating a staircase and need the right riser height, right now? Escalio calculates while you measure: enter the total rise and the app proposes the exact number of steps, riser height and going, checks comfort with the Blondel rule (2R + G) and draws a dimensioned side view in real time.

FREE, WITH ZERO ADS
• Complete straight-stair calculator: risers, going, angle, stringer length, total run
• Live dimensioned drawing that reacts to every adjustment
• mm, cm or inches — exact figures, never silently rounded
• 100% offline: everything works on a job site with no signal
• No ads, no timers, no account. Ever.

ESCALIO PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• L-shaped (quarter-turn) and U-shaped (half-turn) stairs: landing, flight split, floor footprint
• Spiral stairs: diameter, rotation, going on the walkline, angle per step
• Export the dimensioned plan as a PDF, ready for a quote or the job site
• Every future Pro feature included, for life

BUILT FOR THE TRADE
Carpenters, joiners, builders and serious DIYers: Escalio speaks your language — riser, going, total run, walkline — and follows the rules of the craft: perfectly uniform steps, Blondel comfort between 590 and 650 mm (ideal 610–640).

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no trackers, no data collected. Your calculations never leave your device.

name: Escape Sahur
description:
Tung is in the house. You need to get out.

Escape Sahur is a first-person horror escape game. It's night, the power keeps cutting out, and something is walking the landing. Search the house for keys, codes and parts, build your tools at the old workshop bench, and break out through the attic window before he catches you.

HIDE
Duck into wardrobes, cupboards and under beds, then hold still. He checks the hiding places, so pick yours well.

LISTEN
He hears footsteps. He hears doors. Walk in the dark. Run, and he comes.

SEARCH
Every house is different. Keys, codes and parts are hidden somewhere new every game.

BUILD
Find the parts and build your tools at the workshop bench. Cut the chain, pull the boards, climb out.

SURVIVE THE BLACKOUT
When the lights go, your torch is all you have. Get down to the fuse box in the cellar, if you dare.

CHOOSE WHO YOU PLAY
Sonny, Charlie and Henri each bring their own perk to the escape.

PICK YOUR NIGHTMARE
• Peaceful: nobody is in the house. Learn the rooms and the routes.
• Normal: five nights. He gets faster every night.
• Hard: one night. If he catches you once, it's over.

• Plays fully offline
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts
• Built for landscape on iPhone and iPad

Play with headphones, in the dark.

name: ESLVista: Online English Tutor
description:
Learn English in private lessons with certified teachers, live on Zoom, and keep everything in one simple app.

START WITH A FREE TRIAL
• Book a free 25-minute trial lesson on eslvista.com. No credit card needed
• Try up to 2 teachers before you choose

YOUR LESSONS IN ONE PLACE
• See your next lesson, lessons left and upcoming bookings
• Book, change or cancel lessons up to 12 hours before
• Join your lesson with one tap
• Teacher free now? Book a lesson that can start in 10 minutes
• Follow the study plan your teacher makes for you
• Ask to change your teacher at any time, for free

HOMEWORK AND FEEDBACK
• Get homework from your teacher
• Send it as a photo, a file or a written answer
• See your teacher's marks and notes, and your lesson reports

CHAT WITH YOUR TEACHER
• Message your teacher in the app
• Notifications for messages, homework and lesson reminders

PRACTICE ANYTIME
• 15 free self-study courses with short lessons, games, quizzes and speaking tasks
• English podcasts for learners

COURSES FOR EVERY AGE
Kids English, Teens English, General English, Business English, Free Talk, job interview English, IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC, Cambridge exams, GEPT, HKDSE, IGCSE, IB English and the Duolingo English Test.

FOR FAMILIES
Parents can book and manage lessons for their children. Students under 18 need a parent or guardian's consent.

Questions? Message us on WhatsApp or LINE from the app.

Terms of Service: https://www.eslvista.com/privacypolicy?doc=terms
Privacy Notice: https://www.eslvista.com/privacypolicy?doc=privacy

name: EspressoScanner
description:
EspressoScanner is the AI repair copilot for technicians who keep commercial espresso machines and grinders running.

ASK ANY REPAIR QUESTION
Describe the problem the way you'd say it in the shop, like "group 2 drips when idle" or "grinder stops halfway through a dose", and get an answer grounded in the manufacturer's service manuals and parts books. Answers cite the manual and page, so you can check before you order.

GUIDED DIAGNOSTICS
Pick the machine in front of you and describe the symptom. EspressoScanner asks one question at a time, tells you what a normal reading looks like (pressure, resistance, voltage) and narrows the fault down to the part and the fix.

THE RIGHT PART, FIRST TIME
Search tens of thousands of OEM parts by section, part number or the words techs actually use: gicleur, klixon, group screen, pop-off. See the exploded diagram, the parts often replaced together, and what an error or alarm code means.

YOUR FLEET AND YOUR PAPERWORK
Keep every machine and grinder you service in one place with its history. Company accounts can write up work orders and email invoices to customers.

BUILT FOR THE SHOP FLOOR
- Snap a photo of a nameplate or a part
- Answers in the language you ask in
- Training games that sharpen your troubleshooting

Sign in with your EspressoScanner account to use the app.

AI answers can be wrong. Always check against the manufacturer's documentation and the equipment in front of you before acting on an answer.

name: Ethlocator
description:
Drive a flex-fuel vehicle? Ethlocator shows you where to fill up with E85.

Open the app and every public E85 station around you appears on the map. Planning a trip? Search any city, address or ZIP code in the US or Canada and see what's available when you get there.

FIND E85 FAST
• Stations near your current location load as soon as you open the app
• Search by city, street address or ZIP code
• Pick a search radius of 5, 10, 15, 30, 45 or 60 miles, and the map zooms to fit

EVERYTHING YOU NEED AT THE PUMP
• Tap any station for its name, address and hours
• One tap for turn-by-turn driving directions in Apple Maps

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Location access is optional; you can always search instead
• Only public stations are shown, so you won't drive to a private fleet pump

Station data comes from the U.S. Department of Energy's Alternative Fuels Data Center (AFDC), maintained by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL). Ethlocator is an independent app and is not affiliated with NREL or the Department of Energy. Always confirm fuel availability at the station.

name: EuchreMaster: Euchre Card Game
description:
EuchreMaster is the euchre table you always wanted. Four seats, a real deck, and opponents who play the way good euchre players play. No ads, ever.

PLAY THE AI
Sit down with your partner Marge against a rotating cast of painted characters. The AI counts cards, reads voids, leads trump when it should, and knows when to go alone. There are no difficulty settings to fiddle with. Every computer player plays sound euchre in every mode.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
The Coach reviews every hand you play. It grades your bids and card plays, tells you when another play was just as good, and shows how many points a mistake cost you. Step through each trick and see why. New to the game? Learn Euchre walks you through the deck, the bowers, following suit, bidding, and scoring with hands you play yourself.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
- Daily Deal: the same shuffle for everyone, every day. Race to 5.
- The Circuit: work your way up four tables, from the Rec Room to the top.
- Tournament: an 8-team bracket, single elimination, solo against the AI.
- Blitz: a shot clock on every play. Stall and the Coach plays for you.
- Private Table: play with friends using a table code.
- Ranked Online: sign in with Apple, play four-player games against real people, and climb from Bronze to Master. Every ranked game is dealt and scored on our server, so nobody can peek or fake a win. Rank badges show at the table, and you can tap any name to see their player card. Check the leaderboard to see the top players.

ONLINE TOURNAMENTS
Weekly and Monthly tournaments are always running. Every ranked game you finish counts: 3 points for a win, 1 for playing. Finish in the top 3 with at least 3 games and you earn a title that shows on your player card.

A TABLE WITH SOME LIFE
Play on a 3D table where cards are tossed onto the felt and swept to whoever takes the trick, or switch to the flat painted table. Dozens of painted characters blink, react, and get impatient when you take too long.

FAIR DEALS
The shuffle is fair, and you can check it. Fair Deals compares the strength of the hands you have been dealt with what pure math expects.

YOUR RULES
Stick the dealer, Canadian loner, ace no face, farmer's hand, defend alone, and an optional callable Joker. Resume a game where you left off. Track your stats, streaks, and achievements.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE
Colorblind assist with a four-color card index, jumbo cards, Reduce Motion support, and sounds you can turn off.

FREE, NO ADS
The whole game is free: every mode, every table theme, card back, and avatar. No ads, no subscriptions.

name: Euler: Musical Paths
description:
Euler turns a walk into a composition.

Each direction you can walk leads toward a different musical style, and the paths between them are transitions. As you move, Euler blends those styles live with Magenta RealTime 2, a generative music model from Google DeepMind. Stand still and the music settles.

WALKS
• Around You: a walk laid out wherever you start. Walk about 80 meters in any direction and the music turns into folk guitar, a jazz trio, kalimba or strings, depending on which way you go. Circle around and they blend.
• Pennsylvania, July 4: the first real field walk I made with Euler. Play the recording to hear the music follow the original route without moving, or walk the same shape yourself wherever you are.

MAKE YOUR OWN
Tap the map to place stops around you and give each one a sound from sixteen styles: folk guitar, kalimba, choir, synthwave, bluegrass and more. Then walk it, or preview it without moving. Your walks stay on your phone. Tap Share to send one as a link. Friends with Euler open it straight in the app. A link carries the walk's shape, not where you made it, unless you choose to pin it to a place.

HOW IT WORKS
Your position, speed and heading go to Euler's music server, which steers the model and streams the music back. GPS jitter is filtered and snapped to the walk's paths so the music doesn't flap while you stand still. Walking faster makes the styles change faster. If you lose the connection, Euler keeps playing pre-rendered loops of the same styles until you're back online.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Keep Euler open while you walk. The screen stays on, and the music stops when the phone locks.
• Live music streams over the internet and uses mobile data. Wi-Fi or an unlimited plan is best.
• The server can take up to a minute to start. Loops play in the meantime.
• Watch where you're going. Euler never asks you to go anywhere in particular.

Your location is used only while the app is open, only to steer the music, and is not stored. No account, no ads, no analytics.

Music generation: Magenta RealTime 2 by Google DeepMind (model weights CC BY 4.0).

name: Evalique
description:
Evalique is a quality inspection notebook for the production floor. Version 2.0 adds live charts in Analytics and short animations on the welcome screen, empty lists, and inspection review. Records still stay on this device.

THE PROBLEM
Workshops still track quality on paper, in chat messages, or in a spreadsheet that never reaches the floor. Product sizes get copied wrong. Batches ship without a clear score. Defects are remembered after the shift, then forgotten. Supervisors cannot see pass and fail rates until it is too late to act.

HOW TO USE
Open Evalique and add a product with name, code, category, material, and dimensions. Create a production batch against that product, including quantity, line, shift, and operator. Start an inspection and walk through weighted checkpoints such as surface finish, dimensions, thickness, edges, color, material, structure, and packaging. Mark each check as pass, fail, or needs review. Evalique calculates a quality score from the weights you recorded and applies the passing threshold you set in Settings. Save a draft and finish later, or submit the inspection. Log defects with category, severity, quantity, root cause, and status. Plan upcoming inspections in Planner and turn on a local reminder if you want a prompt on this device. Permission for alerts is asked only when you enable reminders. Use Overview for live counts, recent activity, and items that need attention. Use Products to search, filter, and open both products and batches. Use Inspections for history, defects, and the planner. Use Analytics for pass rate, failure rate, product scores, batch scores, monthly volume, and defect mix, shown as bar, line, and pie charts. Tap a bar to open the matching records. Export inspections as CSV or PDF from Settings. Load labelled sample data to learn the flow, then remove it when you are ready. There is no login, no cloud account, and no internet requirement. Everything stays on this device.

WHO IT IS FOR
Evalique is for furniture and joinery workshops, cabinetry plants, production supervisors, and quality inspectors who need clear batch records on the floor. It is built for small teams that want measured quality without a complex system.

name: Event & Seats: Hochzeit, Feier
description:
Dein Event. Alles im Blick.

Ob Hochzeit, Geburtstag, Firmenfeier, Vereinsfest oder Silvesterparty: Mit Event & Seats planst du deinen Saal, organisierst deine Gäste und findest für alle einen passenden Platz.

Gestalte deinen Saal
Lege runde oder rechteckige Tische an, wähle die Platzanzahl und ziehe sie an die gewünschte Stelle. Hebe den Brautpaartisch hervor und ergänze Tanzfläche, Bühne, Bar, Buffet oder Eingang. Feste Saalmaße, eine Ausrichtungshilfe und die automatische Anordnung in Reihen oder versetzt helfen dir beim Planen.

Jeder Gast am richtigen Platz
Erfasse Familien und Gruppen sowie die Namen der einzelnen Gäste. Hinterlege Kontaktdaten, Sonderwünsche und Notizen – zum Beispiel zu vegetarischem Essen oder Allergien. Platzierungsvorschläge helfen dir, passende Tische zu finden und Gruppen möglichst zusammenzuhalten. Mit Sitzregeln bestimmst du, wer zusammen oder getrennt sitzen soll. Einzelne Plätze lassen sich tauschen; die App verhindert eine Überbelegung.

Erlebe deinen Saal in 3D
Sieh dir deine Planung von oben, auf Augenhöhe oder bei einem Rundflug an. Verschiebe Tische in der 3D-Ansicht und probiere Farben für Tischdecken, Stühle, Schleifen, Servietten und Blumen aus. Die einzelne Tischvorschau zeigt dir die Dekoration aus der Nähe. Die 3D-Darstellung arbeitet mit schlichten Formen.

Zahlungen bei Veranstaltungen mit Eintritt
Für Partys mit Eintritt verwaltest du Preisbereiche, Anzahlungen, Teilzahlungen und offene Beträge. Mit einem Rechnungsvermerk hältst du fest, ob eine Rechnung nötig ist und bereits verschickt wurde. Die App erstellt oder versendet keine Rechnungen. Zahlarten und die Kasse am Abend ergänzen die Übersicht. Bei privaten Feiern wie Hochzeiten und Geburtstagen werden die Finanzfunktionen ausgeblendet.

Drucken, teilen und wiederverwenden
Exportiere deinen Saalplan als PDF mit 3D-Bild, drucke eine alphabetische Einlassliste mit Tischzuordnung oder teile die Gästeliste als CSV-Datei. Gästelisten lassen sich auch einlesen. Übernimm einen Saal aus einem früheren Event und nutze dein Kontaktbuch über mehrere Veranstaltungen hinweg.

Deine Daten bleiben bei dir
Du brauchst kein Konto und keine Anmeldung. Event & Seats enthält keine Werbung und kein Tracking. Deine Daten liegen auf deinem Gerät. Wenn du die optionale Cloud-Sicherung nutzt, speicherst du sie in deinem eigenen Cloud-Speicher. Der Entwickler erhält deine Daten nicht.

Für kleine und große Feiern
Bis zu 30 Personen pro Event nutzt du alle Funktionen kostenlos. Mit Event & Seats Pro entfällt die Personengrenze – für 1 Monat oder dauerhaft. Nichts verlängert sich automatisch. Nach Ablauf des Monats kannst du große Events weiter ansehen, drucken und sichern.

Verfügbar auf Deutsch, Englisch, Türkisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Polnisch und Niederländisch.

name: Evitemiz Hizmet Veren
description:
Evitemiz Hizmet Veren, Evitemiz platformundaki temizlik hizmeti verenlerin işlerini yönetmesi için hazırlanmış mobil uygulamadır. Müşteri uygulaması değildir.

Uygulama ile:
• Bölgenizdeki yeni işleri görüntüleyebilir, sahiplenebilir veya teklif verebilirsiniz
• Üzerinizdeki işlerin durumunu takip edebilirsiniz
• Müşterilerle mesajlaşabilirsiniz
• Hesap bilgilerinizi ve yasal metinleri görüntüleyebilirsiniz
• Yardım gerektiğinde destek talebi açabilirsiniz

description:
This app helps you prepare for confession calmly and thoroughly. The questions follow the examination of conscience of St Ignatius Brianchaninov and are arranged by the eight passions.

WHAT THE APP OFFERS
• Questions for the examination of conscience arranged by theme

name: Experiencia Rural
description:
Vive experiencias que no se olvidan con Experiencia Rural. Descubre el campo colombiano, encuentra un lugar para descansar y conecta con anfitriones que comparten lo mejor de su territorio.

ALOJAMIENTOS RURALES
Explora fincas, cabañas, glampings y otros alojamientos. Consulta fotografías, comodidades, ubicación, disponibilidad y precios en pesos colombianos.

EXPERIENCIAS AUTÉNTICAS
Descubre propuestas de gastronomía, aventura, bienestar y celebración. Revisa las fechas programadas y los detalles de cada actividad antes de reservar.

ENCUENTRA TU DESTINO
Busca por departamento y municipio, ajusta las fechas y la cantidad de personas, y consulta los lugares en mapas de OpenStreetMap.

RESERVA DESDE UN SOLO LUGAR
Gestiona tus reservas y accede a las opciones de pago disponibles con Wompi y PayPal. Comunícate con los anfitriones y consulta la información de tu viaje.

COMPARTE TU EXPERIENCIA COMO ANFITRIÓN
Registra alojamientos o experiencias, administra tus publicaciones y mantén actualizada su información desde la plataforma. Las nuevas propuestas pasan por revisión administrativa.

Experiencia Rural necesita conexión a internet. La disponibilidad, las condiciones y los precios dependen de cada publicación.

Descubre tu destino. Vive el campo colombiano.

name: Expi: Expiry & Warranty Alerts
description:
Expi reminds you before anything in your life expires or is due.

Product warranties, return deadlines, passports and ID cards, driving licences, insurance, subscriptions, food in the fridge and medicine refills: add the date once and Expi gives you a gentle reminder before it is too late.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE EXPI
- One place for every important date in your home
- Warranties: enter the purchase date and length, Expi calculates the end date for you
- Returns: never miss a return window again
- Documents: get reminded months before your passport or ID expires
- Subscriptions: see what you pay each month and when each one renews
- Food and medicine: quick add with +3 days, +1 week, +1 month
- Reminders on the day, 1 day, 3 days, 1 week or 1 month before
- Keep a photo of the receipt or warranty card with each item
- Clear colours: red for expired, orange for this week, green for later

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your data stays on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. No account, no ads, no tracking. Export a backup file whenever you like.

6 LANGUAGES
English, Romanian, German, French, Spanish and Italian.

EXPI UNLIMITED
Use Expi free for up to 15 active dates. Expi Unlimited is a monthly auto-renewing subscription that unlocks unlimited dates, iCloud sync to your new iPhone, a monthly overview and report, receipt photos and backups. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

name: Exyoanz
description:
Dear baker,

You know the recipe. It is the one that says "2½ cups flour" in someone's handwriting, while your kitchen scale sits right there, waiting. Exyoanz was made for that gap.

Type the amount on the baker's keypad (it has ½, ¼, ⅓ and ¾ keys, because recipes do), pick the ingredient, and the scale answers: 2½ US cups of all-purpose flour weighs 300 g. The same scoop is shown in US tablespoons, metric cups, Australian 20 ml tablespoons and millilitres, so a recipe from any country reads cleanly.

Here is what waits in the kitchen.

The raised "g" button opens the Scale. It turns cups, spoons, ounces and millilitres into grams for 48 ingredients, from bread flour and packed brown sugar to two kinds of kosher salt that weigh very differently. US, metric, old imperial and Australian cups and spoons are kept apart, because a US cup is 236.6 ml and a metric cup is 250 ml. Pin your favourites as chips for one-tap weighing.

Recipe holds your recipe ticket. Add lines one at a time, watch the total dough weight, then scale by a multiplier or from the servings the recipe makes to the servings you need. File it in the Recipe box or share it as plain text.

Tins solves the pan problem. Your recipe wants an 8-inch round and you own a 9-inch one? Exyoanz compares the base areas and tells you to multiply every ingredient by 1.27. Round, square, rectangular and loaf tins, in inches or centimetres.

Oven sets conventional °C, °F, fan °C and gas mark side by side, with a gas mark chart. 180 °C is 350 °F and gas mark 4, the "moderate" band for most cakes, cookies and brownies.

The Pantry drawer keeps the rest close: My jars (weigh one scoop of your own spelt or house blend and it joins the shelf), the Scale log of past weighings, Kitchen rules (choose your cup and round to 0.1, 1 or 5 g) and Baker's notes on cups and spoons around the world.

An honest word: ingredient weights are careful averages. How you scoop and pack still nudges the real number, which is exactly why weighing wins.

Everything stays in your kitchen. No account, no connection, nothing sent anywhere.

Warmly,
Exyoanz

name: EzNxT: HRMS, CRM & Team Chat
description:
EzNxT brings attendance, leave, sales follow-ups and team conversations together on iPhone and iPad. Check in, review a request or catch up with colleagues without switching between separate work apps.

Use the EzNxT account provided by your organization. Features depend on your organization's enabled modules and your access permissions.

Take care of everyday HR
Check in and out, review attendance history and use face check-in or location verification when enabled. See your leave balances, apply for leave, follow request status and view company holidays.

Keep decisions moving
Review leave, attendance and cancellation requests in one inbox. Approve or reject requests, add a reason when needed and filter the list to focus on what needs attention.

Stay close to your sales work
Search leads, clients and contacts, add new clients, and update lead stages and ratings. Add lead comments, log sales activities and record follow-up details. Link activities to deals and capture location when available. Open calling or WhatsApp from contact records, review deal activity history and check CRM reports.

Bring the conversation with you
Chat directly with colleagues or in groups. Share voice notes, photos and files. Search conversations, star messages and forward updates, with typing indicators, read receipts and online presence to keep conversations clear.

See what's happening across work
Browse job requisitions, see candidate pipeline counts and update job status. View project tasks and filter by stage, status, priority, owner and date to find the work you need to check.

Find support and colleagues
Create support tickets with attachments, follow their status and read ticket comments. Search the employee directory and see the contact details your account can access.

Stay informed with notifications for team messages and work updates, with layouts for both iPhone and iPad.

name: FahrenFlight
description:
Mark your trips on a globe of your own, relive them as a short film, play the Gate every day and meet the travelers whose routes crossed yours.

YOUR GLOBE
Every trip lights up the countries you've seen. 243 maps, region by region, with dates, photos and places to see near you.

THE GATE, EVERY DAY
Ten questions about the world, thirty seconds to answer. Answer right and earn miles; the faster you are, the more FahrenPoints.

SKY LEAGUE
A new season every month: with FahrenPoints and the days you show up, climb the divisions, from the runway to the stars.

THE WORLD DIARY
Forgotten history, words that don't translate, dates that changed everything: little-known facts, country by country.

YOUR TRIPS BECOME A FILM
Pick the photos and the music: FahrenFlight edits the reel, with the route from home to your destination, and gets it ready for stories.

FLIGHTERS
Were you in Lisbon the same week as someone else? If you have both turned on crossed routes, FahrenFlight tells you. From there you can become Flighters: chat, challenge each other at the Gate and see the trip photos the other chose to show.

GOLD POSTCARD
A photo on the front, a few lines on the back, and it lands in your Flighter's chat. It flips, it shines, and you can send it on WhatsApp too.

YOURS, FIRST OF ALL
- Trips start private: a new trip is visible only to you until you decide to show it.
- The photos you share are resized and stripped of camera data before they leave: no GPS.
- Trip photos are visible only to your Flighters, after an automatic check.
- Crossed routes stay off until you turn them on, and only cover trips that have ended.
- You can report and block anyone, at any time.

Privacy: https://fahrenflight.app/en/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://fahrenflight.app/en/terms/

name: Farepal: Taxi Share
description:
Farepal helps people going the same way share one licensed taxi and split the fare. Post where you're going, or find someone already heading there. It works for trips anywhere in Ireland, starting with Dublin: the airport, train stations, universities and across town.

How it works
• Search: enter your pickup, drop-off and when you want to leave. Trips are sorted by how little your pickup and drop-off add to the host's route, so the easiest match comes first.
• Ask to join: choose your seats and bags and add a short message. The host sees roughly where you'd be picked up and dropped off on a map, then accepts or declines.
• Plan together: once you're accepted, your trip room shows the route, everyone's pickup in order, and each person's contact details with call and message buttons. There's a group chat too.
• Reconfirm: confirm you're still going before the deadline, so nobody is left waiting. Reminders never arrive in the middle of the night.
• Travel: the host books a licensed taxi. Split the final meter fare equally, unless your group agrees otherwise.

Private by design
Before you're accepted, people see only your first name, last initial, photo, reliability record and the area of your pickup and drop-off. Your exact address, phone number and email are shared only with the people on a trip you've been accepted on.

People who turn up
After each trip, everyone answers one question about the others: did they show up? Your profile shows your record, such as "12 trips · 0 no-shows". There are no star ratings.

Airport trips
Sharing a taxi to or from the airport? Add your terminal and flight number. People on the same flight get a "Same flight" badge, and people landing can tap "I've landed" so the group knows when to meet.

Saved alerts
Save a search and get a notification when a matching trip is posted.

Safety first
Farepal is for licensed taxis only: offering a seat in a private car for money isn't allowed. You must be 18 or older. You can report or block anyone from their profile, a trip or a chat message, and the Safety centre has emergency numbers and tips for meeting up.

What Farepal doesn't do
Farepal only connects people. We don't book taxis, set prices or handle payments.

Sign in with Apple, Google or your email address.

name: Farroom: Quiet Focus Worlds
description:
Farroom is a set of quiet, empty places to work in.

A pool after closing. A laundromat in the rain. A station platform after the last train. A footbridge in falling snow. A mall after hours. Each world is a seamless moving scene with its own far-off sound, mixed low so it stays out of the way of your thoughts.

- Seamless loops: no visible cut, no jump in the sound.
- Sound that stays in the distance: room tone, rain, wind, a far announcement. Nothing close, nothing sudden.
- A focus timer with a soft fade at the end.
- Plays alongside your own music or podcasts if you want.
- Lock Screen and Dynamic Island timer, widgets and Siri shortcuts.
- Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Free: two worlds (Night Pool and Rainy Laundromat), with every feature. Each Plus world can be previewed for 3 minutes a day.
Farroom Plus: every world now and every world we add, as one purchase. No subscription. Family Sharing supported.

Some visuals and sounds were generated with AI and edited by AUDINAREE. Farroom is not a medical product.

name: Fat Fish Dsh
description:
Fat Fish is a native mobile client for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), your self-hosted AI agent workspace.

It is built from scratch with native rendering instead of a web view, so the app opens instantly and scrolling stays smooth even in long conversations with code blocks, tool output, and images. The interface follows DSH Web closely — the same layout, the same terminology, the same visual language — so you can move between desktop and phone without relearning anything. Where the desktop relies on a mouse, Fat Fish uses gestures: swipe to reveal the sidebar, drag to open the file panel, long-press and tap targets sized for a thumb.

CONNECT THE WAY YOU ALREADY WORK

• Direct connection over HTTPS to your DSH Host, including self-signed certificates with a fingerprint you verify once.
• SSH connection: Fat Fish logs in over SSH, resolves the DSH token from the instance startup log, and tunnels traffic to 127.0.0.1 on the remote machine — so you can reach a Host that is not exposed to the internet at all.
• Relay support for DSH servers published behind a reverse proxy.

BUILT FOR REAL CONVERSATIONS

• Full transcript rendering: streaming replies, tool calls with arguments and results, plans, questions, and todos.
• Read long answers as Markdown with syntax-highlighted code, or open the raw text side by side.
• Answer questions and approve tool calls inline, review plans, and follow background tasks while the agent keeps working.
• Browse workspace files remotely: directory tree, file contents with real line numbers, and safe image previews.

FAST, LIGHT, AND QUIET

• Native UI, no embedded browser engine — fast launch and a small footprint.
• Light and dark themes that follow your system setting, in English or Chinese.
• Your credentials stay on this device in the app's private storage. They are never uploaded anywhere else, and nothing is sent to us: Fat Fish talks only to the Host you configure.

WHAT YOU NEED

Fat Fish does not provide an AI service of its own. You need an existing DeepSeek Harness Host that you run or that someone runs for you. Without a Host, the app can start but has nothing to connect to.

PRIVACY

The app contains no advertising, no third-party analytics SDK, and no account system of its own. The only network traffic it produces is the connection you configure to your Host.

Trademarks and product names belong to their respective owners. Fat Fish is an independent client and is not affiliated with the vendor of DeepSeek Harness.

name: Fewer: Photo Swipe Cleaner
description:
Fewer shows your photo library one photo at a time. Swipe right to keep a photo, swipe left to delete it.

Fewer is free. There are no ads, no subscription and no limit on how many photos you can sort.

SORT BY SWIPING
• Swipe right to keep and left to delete. Undo with a tap or by shaking your iPhone.
• Each card shows when and where the photo was taken and how much space it uses.
• Choose what to sort: everything in Smart order, which mixes in likely clutter so you clean up fast, a single year or trip, new photos since your last visit, screenshots, videos, or photos from this day in past years.

SIMILAR PHOTOS IN ONE CARD
Photos taken seconds apart, burst frames and several shots of the same spot arrive as one card. Open it to flip between the photos at the same zoom level and keep the best ones.

CLUTTER IN PILES
Fewer finds photos you most likely don't need and shows them as one card:
• Old tickets and boarding passes
• Dark, blurry or accidental shots
• Old screenshots and screen recordings
• Photos of documents and receipts
• Copies of the same picture
• Images saved from other apps
Open a pile to see every photo in it, tap the ones you want to keep, and delete the rest at once.

CONTEXT FROM YOUR TRIPS
Fewer recognizes trips and outings. When a photo has a better version of the same spot from the same trip, the card tells you, for example: "There's a better photo of this spot from day 5."

NOTHING IS DELETED BY ACCIDENT
• Photos you swipe left wait in a tray. Look through them and take some back before you delete them.
• Deleting needs your confirmation and moves photos to Recently Deleted, where they stay for 30 days.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
• Photos are analyzed on your iPhone and never uploaded.
• There is no account, no tracking and no analytics.
• Fewer learns which kinds of photos you tend to delete and shows those earlier. What it learns stays on your iPhone.

name: FidgetRig: EDM DJ Fidget Game
description:
FidgetRig is a fidget toy built from DJ gear. Press, tap and slide, and every bass hit lands as a haptic thump under your thumb.

Feel the bass, not just hear it.

THREE RIGS

The Rig
Put your thumb on the sub cone and hold. The bass pulses through your phone while you press, and sliding up gives you more. Free.

Beat Match
Two tracks, two tempos. Pull deck B's tempo onto deck A, nudge the beats into line and feel them lock together. Every start and every Reset gives you new tempos. Free.

Dub Desk
Build a 16-step loop by tapping, then play bass and wobble over it. Three grooves: D&B, bassline and techno. Sub and wobble cones ride the beat, and every hit is a haptic thump. Dub Desk is a one-off unlock, yours to keep on your Apple ID.

MADE FOR FIDGETING
• Endless: no timers, no scores, no levels
• Reset any rig with one tap
• No account, no sign-in, no ads
• Best on a real iPhone with the sound on

PRIVACY
No account, and nothing that says who you are. It counts anonymous app usage, such as which rig was opened, so we can make it better.

Made by Forgeyard Digital.

name: FileJax Lite
description:

Send photos and videos from your library, or any file or folder. The receiver gets the same files, with the folder structure rebuilt. If a transfer is interrupted, it resumes where it stopped.

Everything stays on your devices. FileJax pairs devices with pinned TLS and collects no data.

• Send and receive files and folders
• Photos and videos from your library
• Find devices on your network, by QR code, or nearby
• Resume after interruption
• No account, no cloud, no data collected

name: FileJax Private
description:
FileJax Private is FileJax Lite plus a locked, encrypted vault for the files you receive.

Send files and folders between your devices over your local network — no account, no cloud, no size limit. When someone sends to your vault, their files arrive encrypted, protected by a password only you and the sender know.

Everything stays on your devices. FileJax pairs devices with pinned TLS and collects no data.

• Everything in FileJax Lite
• Encrypted vault, per sender, password-protected
• Send to vault — the receiver stores it encrypted
• No account, no cloud, no data collected

name: FilmDesk – Film Recipes
description:
Du kennst das: ein schönes Fujifilm Recipe im Netz – und dann zwanzig Minuten Menüs drücken, bis es in der Kamera ist. FilmDesk macht daraus zehn Sekunden.

Fujifilm-Kamera per USB-C ans iPhone oder iPad, Recipe aussuchen, Custom-Slot wählen, senden. Fertig. Und umgekehrt: FilmDesk liest aus, was gerade auf deinen Slots liegt – so verlierst du nie wieder ein Recipe, das du irgendwann mal eingestellt hast.

RECIPES DIREKT IN DIE KAMERA
• Recipes per Kabel auf C1–C7 schreiben – kein Abtippen
• Slots auslesen und in deiner Bibliothek sichern
• Automatisches Backup vor jedem Schreiben – ein Tipp, und alles ist wieder wie vorher
• Kompatibilitäts-Check: passt das Recipe zu deinem Modell? (Filmsimulation, DR, Körnung …)
• Kameradaten auf einen Blick: Modell, Firmware, Seriennummer

DEINE RECIPE-BIBLIOTHEK
• Eigene Recipes anlegen und bearbeiten – mit allen Einstellungen
• Jede Einstellung erklärt: was sie bewirkt und welcher Wert sich lohnt
• Zu jedem Recipe: welche Wirkung, welches Licht, welche Motive
• Beispielfotos zu jedem Recipe
• Collections für Reisen, Street, Portrait, Schwarzweiß – privat oder öffentlich
• Starter-Recipes für den Einstieg

CREATORS
• Recipes anderer Fotografen entdecken – beliebt, neu oder nur von denen, denen du folgst
• Gefällt dir ein Recipe? Ein Tipp in deine Bibliothek, danach in die Kamera
• Teile deine eigenen Recipes und Collections – am besten mit Beispielfotos
• Öffentlich zeigst du nur deinen Benutzernamen – nie deinen echten Namen oder deine E-Mail

35MM FILM-ARCHIV
• Dein analoger Filmbestand: Marke, ISO, Rollen, Haltbarkeit – mit Hinweis, wenn ein Film bald abläuft
• Deine analogen Kameras und welcher Film gerade eingelegt ist
• Verlauf: wann welcher Film eingelegt und entnommen wurde

SAUBER & PRIVAT
• Kostenlos. Keine Werbung. Kein Tracking. Kein Abo.
• Optional „Mit Apple anmelden“ – mit iCloud-Backup deiner Recipes und deines Film-Archivs
• iPhone und iPad, auf Deutsch, Englisch und Japanisch

Für Fujifilm X-Serie-Kameras mit Custom-Slots, z. B. X100VI, X100V, X-T5, X-T50, X-S20, X-E5, X-Pro3 und weitere.

FilmDesk ist ein unabhängiges Projekt und steht in keiner Verbindung zur FUJIFILM Corporation. Alle genannten Marken gehören ihren Inhabern.

Fragen oder Feedback: filmdesk@archive-untitled.com

name: FinallyShell
description:
FinallyShell 是一个手机上的 SSH 客户端，适合需要随时查看和处理服务器的开发者与运维人员。

· 终端：完整的 xterm 终端，带 Esc、Tab、Ctrl、Alt、方向键等额外按键行，支持快捷命令、复制粘贴和字体缩放；可以同时打开多台服务器来回切换。
· 文件：通过 SFTP 浏览服务器文件，上传、下载、重命名、删除，在线编辑文本文件。

· 账号同步（可选）：和电脑版 FinallyShell 登录同一账号，服务器列表自动同步。数据在本机加密后才上传，同步服务器看不到你的服务器地址、密码或私钥。
· 支持密码和私钥登录，中英文界面，亮色与暗色模式。

name: Findable – Device Finder
description:
Your device is on. It's on your Wi-Fi. It still supports AirPlay. But it's missing from the AirPlay list on your iPhone.

Findable fixes that, for speakers, soundbars, TVs and receivers alike.

Some AirPlay devices keep accepting connections but stop announcing themselves on the network, often after sleep, a restart or a router change. Your iPhone can't list what it can't hear. Findable finds those devices and announces them on their behalf, so they show up in AirPlay again.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan your Wi-Fi. Findable lists every AirPlay device it finds and marks each one Visible or Hidden.
2. Add the hidden ones. Findable reads each device's details automatically. No setup codes, no accounts.
3. Turn on "Make devices findable", pick your device in AirPlay and play.

Once your music or video is playing, your iPhone talks to the device directly. You can leave Findable and playback keeps going.

FEATURES
• Wi-Fi scan that spots AirPlay devices hiding from your iPhone
• Visible / Hidden status for every device found
• Save as many devices as you like, each with its own switch
• Add a device by IP address if the scan misses it
• Built-in AirPlay button to pick your device without leaving the app
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widget: one tap makes your devices findable
• Turns itself off automatically after the time you choose
• Short guided intro, available any time from the help button

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Findable works only on your local Wi-Fi. No account, no sign-in, no tracking, and no data leaves your network.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Your iPhone and the device must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
• Findable helps devices that already support AirPlay but have stopped showing up. It does not add AirPlay to devices that don't support it.
• Keep Findable open until you've picked your device. After that, playback continues on its own.
• While Findable is active, other iPhones, iPads and Macs on the same Wi-Fi can see the device too.

Findable is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple or any device manufacturer. AirPlay is a trademark of Apple Inc.

name: Fishing Bait and Lure Guide
description:
Not sure what to put on the hook today? This guide puts 139 natural baits and artificial lures in your pocket, for freshwater and saltwater, and explains each one in plain words.

Choose a bait for your target fish, prepare it the right way, hook it step by step and fish it the way it works. Everything is stored on your phone, so the guide works offline at the lake, on the river bank or on a boat with no signal.

FIND A BAIT IN SECONDS
• Search by name: worm, corn, spoon, crankbait…
• Target fish: non-predatory, predatory or universal baits
• Water type: freshwater, saltwater or both
• Fish size: small, medium or large
• Bait type: natural or artificial
• Sort the catalog A–Z or by popularity

A DETAILED CARD FOR EVERY BAIT
• Photo, bait type, target fish and water type
• Hook size range for each bait, for example #6–10 or #1/0–3/0
• What you can catch: the species that bite on it
• How to prepare: how to get it, cook it and keep it fresh
• How to hook: step-by-step instructions, including rigs such as the hair rig and the knots you need
• How to use: technique, retrieve, depth and where to fish it

NOTES THAT REMEMBER WHAT WORKED
Add your own notes to any bait: spot, date, weather, water temperature, depth, retrieve and result. On your next trip, you'll know exactly what to repeat.

FAVORITES
Save your go-to baits with one tap. They wait for you in a separate tab with its own search.

WHAT'S INSIDE
Natural baits: earthworms, maggots, bloodworms, insect larvae, corn, bread, dough, boilies, shrimp, squid, sea worms and shellfish.
Artificial lures: spoons, inline spinners, spinnerbaits, crankbaits, jerkbaits, swimbaits, soft plastics and jigs.

FOR EVERY KIND OF FISHING
Bass, crappie, walleye, catfish, trout, carp, pike, perch and saltwater species. Float, bottom or lure fishing, from the shore or from a boat.

Made for beginners who are learning how to bait a hook and for experienced anglers who want a quick reference by the water.

name: FLEX – Passe-trappe
description:
Le passe-trappe, le célèbre jeu de palets en bois à élastique, arrive sur votre iPhone !

Attrapez un palet, tirez-le contre l'élastique, visez le trou au milieu du plateau… et lâchez ! Le premier joueur qui vide son camp gagne la partie. Simple à comprendre, impossible à lâcher.

EN LIGNE
• Partie rapide : affrontez un adversaire en quelques secondes
• Créez une partie et donnez le code à un ami pour jouer ensemble
• Réagissez avec des émojis pendant la partie
• Une revanche ? D'un seul bouton !

SUR CE TÉLÉPHONE
• Contre l'ordinateur, avec 3 niveaux : facile, moyen et difficile
• À deux, face à face sur le même téléphone : chacun son côté, et tout le monde tire en même temps

name: FlipBars: Freestyle Rap
description:
FlipBars gives you a beat and a word to land on, bar after bar. Rap your line, end it on the word (or on a rhyme for it) by the fourth beat, and the next word is already on its way. It's freestyle practice that keeps you rapping instead of freezing up.

There are no ads in FlipBars and nothing to sign up for. The beats and word lists are built into the app, so a session runs with no signal at all.

HOW A ROUND GOES
• Pick a beat, or press Go on the one you used last
• The beat builds, a big 3-2-1, then the first word lands on the drop
• Four dots under the word show where you are in the bar. The last dot is the landing beat
• The next word slides in a bar ahead, so you can see it coming (Hard hides it)
• A round is 16 or 32 bars, then a short "round done" card, and you go again

RHYMES BY SOUND
Words are matched by how they sound, not how they're spelled, using the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary: "though", "slow" and "go" land together. They come in pairs (AABB), so you rhyme into a word, or in runs of four (AAAA) to hold one rhyme longer. No word repeats within a round, and every list is screened for swearing and slurs, so it's clean enough to practice anywhere.

PICK YOUR LEVEL AND SPEED
• Easy: common one-syllable rhymes, with a new word every two bars
• Medium: the same kind of rhymes, with a new word every bar
• Hard: slant rhymes count too, a word every bar, and no preview
• Speed: slow any beat down while you learn, or push it faster once you're warm
• Pairs or runs, whichever scheme you want to drill

Five beats come with the app, all made for beginners: a slow boom-bap, a lo-fi groove, a half-time beat, an extra-easy one and a bright party beat. Every level above, every speed and both round lengths work without Pro, with no time limit, and so do each language's Everyday and Party word packs.

RAP IN TAGALOG OR SPANISH
Switch the language and every word on screen is Tagalog or Spanish, grouped by how it rhymes in that language. Everyday and Party packs are free in each.

FLIPBARS PRO
• Fifteen more beats, for twenty in all
• Multis: a level of two-syllable rhymes, like "paper", "later" and "nature"
• Fourteen more English word packs, like Holiday, Money and Movies, and five more each in Tagalog and Spanish: Love, Family, Food, Money and Music
• Endless rounds, or a round length you set
• Record your take over the beat, hear it back with the beat mixed in, keep your recent takes, and send one as an audio clip. Headphones keep the beat out of your vocal

FlipBars Pro is sold as a one-time Lifetime purchase, or as a monthly or yearly subscription, and each one unlocks the same Pro. A subscription renews on its own until you cancel it, at least 24 hours before the current period ends, in your iPhone's subscription settings.

THE MIC STAYS OFF
Only recording a take uses the microphone, and iOS asks you the first time you tap Record. Takes are saved on this iPhone and leave it only when you share one. There's no account, and nothing tracks you.

Made for anyone learning to freestyle, battle rappers warming up, and songwriters who need a way past a blank page.

name: Float Script: Teleprompter
description:
Float Script is a teleprompter that floats over other apps, so you can film in the iPhone Camera app and read your script at the same time.

Paste your script, tap Start and open your camera. Your words stay on top in a small window while you record.

Three ways to scroll:

Fixed speed: the script scrolls at the speed you set, with the microphone off.

AirPods volume: move through your script with your AirPods, with the microphone off.

Your past scripts are kept automatically, and you can change the text size at any time.

No account needed. Float Script doesn't record or save your voice.

name: Focus Cadence
description:
Focus Cadence helps you shape a workday around the things that deserve your attention. Turn an ambitious list into a clear daily plan, choose one task, and give it a focused interval. Whether you are drafting a proposal, studying a difficult chapter, preparing a personal project, or clearing space for creative work, the app brings planning, timing, and reflection into one considered routine.

Keep related tasks together in projects, give each task an estimated focus duration, and add notes or a due date when useful. See what is still open and what you have completed without losing the context behind the work. The daily planner lets you choose and order the tasks you want to make room for, alongside a short intention that keeps the day grounded. Plans can change as your priorities change.

Start a focus interval from a task and use a preset that suits the work ahead. Pause when you need to step away, resume when you are ready, or finish early and record the time you actually spent. The timer uses elapsed time so returning to the app keeps the interval in context. Focus and break intervals have separate roles, helping you protect both sustained effort and a moment to reset. Capture a distracting thought or interruption as it happens, then return your attention to the task.

After an interval, add a reflection and decide what the work moved forward. Session history keeps task context, duration, outcomes, and interruption notes together. Daily and weekly reviews turn those records into readable summaries, showing where your attention went across projects and how your recorded focus compares with your own daily target. Write a weekly reflection to remember what helped and what you would like to adjust.

Make the routine yours with editable timer presets, an adjustable daily goal, and light, dark, or system appearance. Your projects, plans, sessions, and reflections remain available between launches. There is no account to create and no team workspace to maintain. Focus Cadence is a practical place to decide what matters next, work on it with intention, and learn from the rhythm of your days.

name: Fold Gap
description:
Fold Gap keeps one dough on this iPhone. Set the shortest and longest rest, then tap each time you fold.

The first fold only marks the time. Each later fold shows the minutes since the last one. Shorter than the window is early. Inside the window is on time. Longer is late.

Open a dough to see every fold, change the window, remove the last fold, or delete the dough. A photo of that fold stays on this iPhone. Share sends one line: the name, the minutes, and the result. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: FolioFlip
description:
FolioFlip converts supported digital documents into editable Excel workbooks and spreadsheets into readable PDFs.

PAGES TO SHEETS
Extract tables from text-based PDFs or create a Reading Index from PDF and DRM-free EPUB text. Select pages or chapters, review and edit cells, then export an XLSX workbook. A Sources worksheet links extracted rows to their original page or chapter. Source Lens shows extracted text for comparison.

SHEETS TO PAGES
Import XLSX or CSV, choose worksheets or ranges, and create a paginated PDF. Pick Ledger for tables, Brief for reports, or Fieldbook for one record per page. Preview the actual PDF before sharing.

REVIEW AND ORGANIZE
Edit cells and sheet names, save projects in your local Library, and export through your device. No app account is required.

PRIVACY
PDF text extraction requires an internet connection. Your PDF is sent to the conversion service only after you give consent. Other supported imports and file exports are processed on your device.

SUPPORTED FILES AND LIMITS
Import PDF, DRM-free EPUB, XLSX and CSV. Files must be 8 MiB or smaller. PDFs can contain up to 80 original pages and 500,000 extracted characters. Table and workbook limits include 20 worksheets, 2,000 total rows, 30 columns and 50,000 cells. The first applicable limit reached stops conversion.

Scanned PDFs require OCR, which this release does not provide. Password-protected PDFs and DRM-protected books are not supported. Table extraction uses heuristics, so review the output against your source. Formula text is not executed; cached spreadsheet formula results may be stale. Advanced workbook features and original document layouts may not be preserved.

SUBSCRIPTION
FolioFlip is free to download. A subscription provides access to the conversion tools. Eligible new subscribers receive a one-calendar-month free trial, then $25.00 USD per month in the U.S. storefront. Prices in other storefronts are shown in the app. The subscription automatically renews until canceled through your Apple subscription settings. Trial eligibility is determined by Apple. Restore purchases and manage your subscription in the app. Saved Library files remain accessible.

name: Fome Family
description:
Fome is a calm home organiser for everyone you live with. The shopping list, the chore rota, the week's dinners, the school run and the car's next service, all in one place and in sync on everyone's phone.

JUST SAY IT
Tap the mic and talk the way you would to a person. "We're out of milk and eggs." "Swimming for Maya every Thursday at 5." "Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 9." Fome puts each thing where it belongs. Or ask Siri: "Add bread to my Fome list."

SHOPPING THAT KNOWS THE SHOP
• One shared list. Whoever is at the shop sees it, live.
• Items sorted by aisle, so you walk the shop once.
• Heading out? Tap once to tell the household, so they can add what they need while you're on the way.
• What you tick off goes back into the pantry, and Fome tells you when you already have something at home.
• Shopping mode: big tick boxes, and a Live Activity on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island while you shop.
• Snap a receipt to log what you spent.

MEALS AND RECIPES
• Keep family favourites, or snap a cookbook page and Fome types it up.
• Scale any recipe by servings, or by how much of an ingredient you have.
• Send the ingredients to the shopping list, sorted by aisle.

CHORES THAT FEEL FAIR
• Rotas that rotate themselves, with points so nobody does it all.
• Bin day, laundry, cleaning and the garden, with a nudge when it's your turn.
• Start a chore and a timer follows you on the Lock Screen.

THE FAMILY CALENDAR
• Everyone's plans, school runs, birthdays and appointments in one place.
• A Today screen with a clock dial that shows the shape of your day.
• To-dos, shared or private, each with a due time and a reminder.

THE REST OF HOME LIFE
• Car: mileage, fuel, services, MOT and insurance dates, with a heads-up before anything's due.
• Pets: feeding, walks, flea treatment and vet visits, and who did them.
• Pantry and storage: know what's in the cupboard, and print QR labels for boxes and bins. Scan one to see what's inside without opening the lid.
• Projects: bigger jobs broken into steps.
• Spending: bills, subscriptions and pocket money.
• Notes: gift ideas, takeaway orders, the boiler manual.
• Add a photo to your car, recipes, pets, projects and pantry items.
• Search everything, even the words in your photos: the receipt, the vet record, the boiler's model number.

MADE FOR YOUR HOUSEHOLD
• Switch on only the parts you need. A short setup asks what you'd like help with and turns on just those.
• Everyone gets their own view, with their own colour.
• Keep any item private, or share it with just one person.
• In English, Spanish and Portuguese.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads. No tracking. No analytics.
• Your household's data is kept apart from every other household's.
• Two-step verification for your account.
• Words in your photos are read on your iPhone, never by an AI service.
• Delete your account and data from Settings at any time.

FOME PLUS
Fome is free for every part of the app and up to 4 people with the app. Fome Plus adds AI reading, text search in photos, QR box labels, shopping trips, Siri, the Dynamic Island and unlimited people, for the whole household with one purchase: monthly or yearly (each with a 1-week free trial), or once for lifetime. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.

Fome works on iPhone. Live Activities and the Dynamic Island need iOS 17 or later.

description:
Bring your FooSnippets library to your iPhone keyboard. Search by trigger or alias, then tap a result to insert its text into the app you are using.

A keyboard built around your snippets

• Insert text, code, HTML source, line breaks, and emoji exactly as saved.

name: Foreverly: Kids Art Keeper

Scan a drawing with the camera: Foreverly crops the paper, brings the colours to life and saves it with your child's age that day: "Beril, 6 years 1 month". Looking back years later has never felt this good.

EVERY DRAWING HAS A STORY
• Add a voice note in your child's own voice: ask "What's this?" and keep the answer.

WATCH THEM GROW, AGE BY AGE

FOREVERLY PRO

Foreverly collects no data, has no ads and no tracking. Your drawings stay only on your device and in your own iCloud account. Download your whole archive as a zip whenever you like; your data is always yours.

The subscription is charged to your Apple Account when confirmed and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

name: Frame It - Video Creator
description:
A coffee cup in every cafe. The same pose in different places. Doorways from a weekend trip. If you keep noticing it, you can make a video around it.

Frame It helps you line up a series of photos so your subject stays in the same spot while the scene changes. Take your first photo, use it as a guide, and keep shooting. When you're ready, turn your collection into a video.

START WITH A PHOTO
Your first shot can become a faint guide for the next one. Use the first frame, your latest frame, a photo from your library, or a built-in shape. No account or project setup needed before your first shot.

GET THE NEXT SHOT JUST RIGHT
Move, resize, and rotate your guide. Adjust its opacity, try grayscale or inverted colors, and choose a bold color for shape guides. The guide stays out of your saved photos and videos.

KEEP YOUR IDEAS TOGETHER
Give each idea its own sequence. Switch between them while you're out shooting. Each sequence remembers its guide and camera, including the selfie camera and the rear lenses available on your iPhone.

MAKE THE CUT
Reorder your frames and fine-tune their position, rotation, zoom, and perspective. Your original photos stay intact while you edit. Choose 0.1 to 5 seconds per frame, set individual timing, and add up to four extra repeats.

PREVIEW, SAVE, SHARE
Preview your sequence before making the video. Choose vertical 9:16, original 3:4, or square 1:1. Vertical and square formats keep your full edited photo visible with a softly blurred backdrop. Save the finished video or share it, then add music in Instagram, TikTok, or your favorite editor.

YOUR PHOTOS, YOUR CHOICE
Frame It works without an account, ads, or a watermark. It doesn't upload your photos or videos to a developer server. Save extra copies to Photos or a matching album if you want to.

Find something you love. Take it somewhere new.

name: Fresh Again: Peel & Polish

TRY IT FREE

FOR GROWN-UPS
A simple parent area holds a before/after card you can share from the system share sheet. Nothing is sent automatically.

Take your time. Every object becomes fresh again at your own pace.

name: FretMitra Songbook
description:
FretMitra Songbook is where you write and play your own chord songs. Put chords on bars, add your lyrics, and give each section a strumming pattern. Then press Play and follow along as the chords and chord diagrams move with the beat.

PLAY ALONG
• Song Player follows the beat: the playing bar, its chords and chord diagrams stay in view.
• Count-in, tempo control and recorded acoustic guitar strumming.
• Change the key or add a capo; see the chord shapes you play or the chords that sound.
• Choose the strumming pattern you hear, and show or hide the chord diagrams.
• Starts with two public-domain songs: Oh! Susanna and Happy Birthday to You.

WRITE YOUR OWN SONGS
• Build a song: paste lyrics with chords in ChordPro style, such as [Am]word, into Verse and Chorus boxes, or build your own from scratch in Song Creator, bar by bar.
• Define song sections such as Verse and Chorus, and arrange the order they play in. A repeated Chorus is written once and played again, with no duplicated effort.
• Give each section a strumming pattern from the built-in library, or import patterns you made in FretMitra Strum (sold separately).

• Undo and redo, and save your songs on your device.

DESKTOP EDITOR
• Open Song Creator in a web browser on a computer on the same Wi-Fi and edit your songs on a larger screen. Everything you save there is saved on your iPhone or iPad.

SHARE AND BACK UP
• Export a song as a file to share it or keep a backup, and import songs from Files.
• From the computer editor, download a copy of all your songs in one file.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Song Player and Song Creator each have their own help.

No ads, no account, no tracking and no in-app purchases. Everything is included, works offline, and stays on your device.

Made for iPhone and iPad by Secalyx Technologies LLP.

name: FROST: Sesli & Buzlu Tanışma
