FROST, dış görünüşe dayalı yüzeysel kaydırma alışkanlığını tamamen değiştiren, ses odaklı ve etkileşimli Buzul Termometresi (-20° -> 0°) mekaniğine sahip yeni nesil tanışma platformudur.

NEDEN FROST?
Standart uygulamaların aksine FROST’ta hiçbir fotoğraf ilk anda net değildir. Tüm profiller -20° kristal buz katmanıyla başlar. Birini gerçekten tanımak için önce 5 saniyelik sesli tanıtımını dinler, ortak ilgi alanlarını keşfeder ve karşılıklı sohbet ederek aranızdaki buzu adım adım eritirsiniz.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER:
• 5 Saniyelik Sesli Tanıtım (Voice-First): Keşfet ekranında adayların gerçek ses tonunu ve enerjisini dinlemeden beğeni kilidi açılmaz. Sesini dinlediğin her profil +2° ısınır.
• Canlı Sohbet Termometresi (-20°’den 0°’a): Tek taraflı mesajlar buzu eritmez! Yalnızca her iki tarafın birbirine yanıt verdiği samimi ve karşılıklı diyaloglar sohbet sıcaklığını yükseltir.
• 0° Karşılıklı Erime Onayı (Mutual Consent): Sohbetiniz 0° erime noktasına ulaştığında dahi fotoğraflar otomatik açılmaz; her iki kullanıcının da 0° Erime Onayı vermesiyle buzlar kırılır ve fotoğraflar tamamen netleşir.
• Kutup Işığı (Boost) & Özel Buz Kıran (+5°): Profilini 10 dakika boyunca bölgedeki kullanıcıların en önüne çıkar veya Özel Buz Kıran ile sohbeti +5° ısıt.
• Güvenli ve Doğrulanmış Topluluk: Anlık kamera ile Onaylı Profil selfie doğrulaması, otomatik uygunsuz metin filtreleme sistemi, tek dokunuşla Engelle (Block) / Şikayet Et (Report) araçları ve 24 saat içinde aktif moderasyon.

KULLANIM KOŞULLARI VE GİZLİLİK:
FROST yalnızca 18 yaş ve üzeri yetişkinler içindir. Kötüye kullanıma, tacize ve çocuk güvenliği (CSAE) ihlallerine karşı sıfır tolerans politikası uygulanır.

name: Fruit Story: Merge & Story
description:
Merge items, decorate a mansion and unlock a fruit drama, one episode at a time.

Strawberry is a secretary with an ordinary life, until the day she meets Banana, the new "manager". Then there is Lemon, cool and polished, and Madam Grape, who is hard to read, and an old friend who never left. Each of them knows something Strawberry doesn't. Find out what, one episode at a time.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag two identical items together to make the next item up.
- Tap the safe, the flower cart and the drawer to get new items.
- Fill every customer's order before your energy runs out to clear the round.
- Clear a round to see the next scene and earn stars.
- Spend stars to decorate the family mansion and open the next episode.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 9 seasons, 90 episodes and 180 in-game scenes
- Voice acting and cutscenes in English, Korean and Japanese
- The story never interrupts a round: scenes play after you clear it, and you can skip them
- A daily gift, and a story book to rewatch every episode
- Short rounds that play offline

Fruit Story is free to play, with ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: Furnex
description:
Furniture that will not fit the room, or will not pass the door, is an expensive surprise. Furnex lets you check the sizes before you order.
Enter the length and width of a piece and of the room to see whether it fits as placed, or after a quarter turn. Add the doorway width to see whether the narrower side can pass. Add several pieces to see how much floor they take up, and how much is still open.
Switch among centimeters, meters, inches, and feet, and the numbers follow the unit you choose. Every result is a direct comparison of the sizes you enter, so you can measure once more before you buy.
furniture,sofa,room,fit,doorway,measure,space,floor,size,home,move,layout,dimensions,clearance
Furnex helps people compare sizes before they buy furniture. After entering the length and width of a piece, a room, and a doorway, they can see three things: whether the piece fits as placed or after a quarter turn; whether the narrower side can pass the doorway; and how much floor several pieces occupy, and how much remains. The result is only a guide before ordering. A real move can still depend on turns and obstacles.
Open the app on Home. Three cards are shown: Furniture & Room, Doorway Fit, and Space Calculator. The bottom bar has Home, Saved, and Settings.
Tap Furniture & Room. Two size rows appear, each as length × width. Furniture Size is the piece. Room Size is the room. Sample numbers are already filled in and can be changed. Tap the blue Check button. The result below states whether it fits and whether the space is ample or a quarter turn is needed. If it does not fit, the result states how far it sticks out.
Tap the arrow at the top left to return Home, then tap Doorway Fit. Doorway Width is a single number. Furniture Size is the length and width of the piece. Tap Check. If the narrower side is within the doorway, the screen says it can pass. If not, it shows how much is still too wide.
Return Home and tap Space Calculator. Room Size at the top is the room’s length and width. Furniture List below shows each piece’s name, size, and quantity. Use the minus and plus controls on a row to change the quantity. Tap + Add, enter a name, length, width, and quantity, then tap Add. Tap Calculate to see the share of floor used and how much floor remains.
Tap Settings. Under Units, choose cm, m, in, or ft. The current unit is highlighted. The unit at the top right of any check can be changed as well, and the numbers on that screen update.
After a result, the check can be given a name. Open the Saved tab and tap a row to view that check again. A row that is no longer needed can be deleted. The arrow at the top left returns to Home.

name: Gartenzeit - Pflanzkalender
description:
Wann säst du Tomaten vor, wann dürfen sie nach draußen, wann schneidest du den Lavendel? Gartenzeit beantwortet das für 149 Obst-, Gemüse-, Kräuter- und Zierpflanzen – und zwar für deinen Wohnort, nicht für einen Durchschnittsgarten.

FROSTTERMINE FÜR DEINE POSTLEITZAHL
Gib deine Postleitzahl ein, und Gartenzeit weiß, wann bei dir der letzte Frost im Frühjahr meist vorbei ist und wann im Herbst der erste kommt. Berechnet aus den Messreihen von fast 600 Wetterstationen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz und der Höhe deines Orts. Danach richten sich alle Zeiten: In München dürfen die Tomaten Ende April hinaus, in Oberstdorf erst Ende Mai. Wohnst du am Hang oder in einer Frostsenke, trägst du deine eigene Höhe oder deine eigenen Termine ein.

WAS JETZT ANSTEHT
Die Startseite zeigt, was in diesen Tagen vorgezogen, gesät, gepflanzt, gedüngt, geschnitten und geerntet wird – zuerst das, was bald endet. Über das Kalender-Symbol siehst du jeden anderen Monat oder nur deine Favoriten.

PASSENDE PFLANZEN FÜR DEINEN PLATZ
Garten, Balkon, Terrasse oder Gewächshaus? Süd- oder Nordseite, viel oder wenig Sonne, wenig oder viel Platz? Gartenzeit schlägt vor, was zu deinem Platz passt, und sagt dir warum: „Wächst gut im Kübel“, „Liebt Wärme, deine sonnige Lage passt“ – oder warnt, wenn die Saison bei dir zu kurz ist.

ALLES ÜBER JEDE PFLANZE
• Fotos mit Bildnachweis
• Zeiten im Jahr: vorziehen, auspflanzen, ernten, düngen, schneiden, Winterschutz
• Standort: Sonne, Beet, Balkon, Kübel, Gewächshaus, Pflanzabstand
• Boden und pH-Wert, Stark-, Mittel- oder Schwachzehrer, Düngen
• Mischkultur: gute und schlechte Nachbarn zum Antippen
• Pflegetipps, Schädlinge und Krankheiten mit dem, was dagegen hilft
• Bewährte Sorten
• Giftig oder nicht, getrennt für Menschen und Haustiere
• Rezeptideen für deine Ernte, auch als PDF zum Drucken und Teilen

149 PFLANZEN
Obst wie Apfel, Erdbeere und Heidelbeere, Nüsse wie Haselnuss, Walnuss und Maronen. Gemüse von Tomate und Zucchini bis Pak Choi und Topinambur. Kräuter wie Basilikum, Bärlauch und Lorbeer. Kübelpflanzen wie Zitrone, Kumquat und Olive. Zierpflanzen wie Dahlie, Hortensie, Lavendel, Rose und Fuchsie, dazu Gräser und Bambus. Die Suche kennt auch regionale Namen wie Paradeiser, Karfiol und Rüebli, lateinische Namen und Gruppen wie Beeren oder Kohl.

GIESSEN UND PFLANZEN MIT ERINNERUNG
Markiere deine Pflanzen mit dem Herz, und die Glocke auf der Startseite zeigt, was heute zu tun ist: gießen, säen, pflanzen. Pflanzen mit gleichem Gießrhythmus fasst Gartenzeit zusammen – „4 Pflanzen alle 3 Tage gießen“ ist eine Aufgabe, nicht vier. Im Kübel wird öfter gegossen als im Beet, und nur in der frostfreien Zeit. Auf Wunsch kommt morgens um 9 Uhr eine Mitteilung, und die Zahl am App-Symbol zeigt die offenen Aufgaben.

OHNE INTERNET, OHNE KONTO
Gartenzeit funktioniert komplett offline. Es gibt kein Konto, keine Werbung und kein Tracking. Dein Garten-Profil und deine Favoriten bleiben auf deinem Gerät.

Für iPhone und iPad, mit Hell- und Dunkelmodus, großer Schrift und VoiceOver.

Klimadaten: Deutscher Wetterdienst, GeoSphere Austria, MeteoSchweiz (CC BY 4.0). Höhen: GeoNames. Fotos: Wikimedia Commons unter freien Lizenzen, jedes mit Nachweis in der App.

name: Gather – Game Box
description:
Gather turns your TV into the game table for everyone in the room. Apple TV shows the game, everyone plays with their own phone. No app? Just scan the QR code on the TV and play in the browser.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a game on Apple TV – a QR code and a short room code appear.
• Scan the QR code with your camera: if you have the app, Gather opens; everyone else plays in the browser. Or enter the code in the app.
• When everyone is ready, the game begins. The TV shows the board, your phone only what you need – secret cards, roles and dice stay with you.
• Every game comes with its rules right in the app.

19 GAMES
Party games: Village at Night (secret roles, 5+), Say It Different (explain words as a team), Sketch Round (draw and guess), Letter Hunt, Quiz Night, Cover Word (teams and clues), Fib Finder (make up answers and see through others).

Card games: Stack Rush, Crazy Mau with special cards, Rummy, Thirty-One.

Board and dice games: Chess with a clock, Four in a Row, Nine Men's Morris, Checkers, Sea Battle, Five Dice, Little Max.

Racing: Corner Chaos – your phone is the steering wheel. Game controllers can join on Apple TV.

IPAD AND MAC AS THE GAME TABLE
No Apple TV? Your iPad or Mac becomes the game table: it shows the board for everyone, and phones join with a QR code. On the Mac, the game table opens in its own window – perfect for a TV or projector connected to your Mac.

NO TV? NO PROBLEM
Many games run right on iPhone, iPad and Mac: against the computer or with friends who join with a code.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY
• No account, no sign-in.
• The game runs on your Apple TV (or iPad, Mac, iPhone). On the same Wi-Fi, devices connect directly. Over the internet, the relay server at gathergames.de only passes messages through and stores nothing permanently – no names, no IP addresses, no game content.
• Your profile (name and animal avatar) and game history stay on your devices – optionally synced through your iCloud.
• Leaderboards and achievements via Game Center, if you like.
• No ads, no purchases, no tracking.
• The camera is only used to scan the QR code. Images are never stored or sent.

GOOD TO KNOW
• With internet, the QR code leads to gathergames.de, so guests can join from another network too – from a PC or on the go.
• Without internet, Gather keeps working on your Wi-Fi: then all devices need to be on the same network. Guest networks with client isolation block the connection.
• Gather asks for access to the local network so devices on the same Wi-Fi can find each other.
• A game runs as long as Gather is open on Apple TV.

One app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV – in 17 languages.

Questions or ideas? kontakt@dustineden.de

name: Gather Plan
description:
Gather Plan brings the moving parts of a gathering into one thoughtful place. Whether you are hosting a dinner with friends, a birthday picnic or a neighborhood meetup, keep the event details, preparation tasks, guest responses and spending organized around the occasion you are planning.

Start with an event name, date and venue, then build a practical plan around it. Your event overview connects the guest list, preparation progress and budget so you can see what deserves attention next. Keep several gatherings side by side and open the one you want to work on without mixing up its details with another occasion.

Turn preparation into clear, manageable tasks. Give each task a due date and priority, add useful notes, and mark it complete as you go. Review what is still open or look back at finished preparations. A separate task detail keeps the context available when a short checklist label is not enough.

Keep a guest roster with response status, party size and dietary notes. See who is attending, who has declined and whose response is still awaited. An invitation checklist helps you record whether an invitation has been sent and whether you need to follow up. You remain in control of contacting your guests through your usual channels; Gather Plan helps you keep track of the preparation.

Shape the gathering itself with a chronological schedule. Add agenda items with a start time, duration, responsible person and notes, from welcoming guests to serving dinner or wrapping up. Keep vendor arrangements nearby with service details, contact notes, quotes and booking status, so important decisions are easy to find when you need them.

Set a budget for each event and record expenses by category. Compare your limit with recorded spending, see the remaining amount and distinguish paid costs from outstanding items. Vendor quotes stay separate from expenses, helping you avoid counting the same cost twice. Edit entries as plans change and keep useful notes alongside the numbers.

Gather Plan supports light and dark appearance and includes editable example gatherings to help you explore the structure. Create, revise and remove your own events and their related details as your plans evolve. From the first idea to the final checklist, keep the practical details close and make more room to enjoy bringing people together.

name: Gauge – Analog Film Video
description:
Gauge entwickelt dein iPhone-Video wie echten Film: Super 8, 16 mm oder 35 mm.

Jedes Format wird auf seine echte Bildgrösse gerechnet. Korn, Halation und Unschärfe sind in Mikrometern auf dem Film definiert. Dasselbe Material wirkt deshalb in Super 8 grob und weich, in 35 mm fein und ruhig, so wie in echt.

FILM
• 7 Materialien: Tageslicht 50 und 250, Kunstlicht 200 und 500, Umkehrfilm 100, Schwarzweiss Umkehr und Negativ
• Print-Kennlinie pro Farbschicht, warme Lichter, kühle Schatten
• 4 Prints: Kino, Kontrast, Flach, Bleach Bypass
• Halation: rote Glut um helle Lichter, Bloom
• Korn pro Farbschicht, bei jedem Frame neu
• 85er-Filter, Fade, abgelaufener Film

KAMERA UND PROJEKTOR
• Shutter-Unschärfe: Bewegung verwischt wie bei 180° Shutter
• Gate Weave, Flicker, Vignette, Farbsaum
• Staub, Fasern, Kratzer, Haar im Bildfenster
• Lichteinfall und Rollenanfang
• 18 fps für Super 8, Projektor-Ton auf Wunsch

FORMAT
• Voll, Gate mit runder Bildkante oder Overscan-Scan mit Perforation und Nachbarbildern
• 4:3, 1.66, 16:9, 1.85, 2.39, 9:16, 4:5

MAXIMALE BILDQUALITÄT
• Apple Log, Apple Log 2, HLG und SDR werden richtig dekodiert
• 16-bit Gleitkomma, szenen-linear
• Export in ProRes 422 HQ (je nach iPhone), HEVC 10-bit oder H.264, bis Originalauflösung
• Das Original bleibt unverändert, der Look ist jederzeit änderbar

LUTS
• .cube importieren, nach dem Film oder statt der Filmfarbe (für Apple-Log-LUTs)
• Eigenen Look als .cube exportieren für Resolve, Final Cut oder Blackmagic Camera

WORKFLOW
• Filmen in der App mit Live-Vorschau, Apple Log und 180° Shutter
• Trimmen, mehrere Rollen zu einem Film mit Klebestellen
• Vorher/Nachher-Split, Histogramm, False Color
• Eigene Looks sichern

Keine Konten, kein Abo, kein Tracking. Deine Videos bleiben auf deinem iPhone.

name: Gb African Store
description:
Shop Gb African Store from your phone: the African and Caribbean groceries you grew up with, at fair prices.

• Browse over 800 products by department: flours and grains, spices and seasonings, oils and sauces, plantains and yams, dried fish and meat, frozen foods, drinks, snacks, beauty and household.
• See deals, new arrivals and a pick of the week as soon as they land.
• Search by product or brand, or scan a barcode.
• Choose how you get it: free pickup, local delivery (free on orders over $35), or shipping. Every item shows when it can be ready, like "Today, as soon as 2:30pm".
• Ask Ara, our AI assistant, about products, deals, store hours, delivery or your order.
• Pay at pickup or with a card you saved to your account.
• See your orders and their status in your account.

Prices and stock come straight from the store, so what you see is what's on the shelf.

name: GeneralShare
description:
GeneralShare 让同一 Wi-Fi 下的 iPhone、iPad 把文件与剪贴板文字发送到电脑，并从电脑取回剪贴板文字。

- 扫码或输入 6 位配对码连接设备
- 接收端确认后才开始传输
- 从 iPhone / iPad 发送文件、照片；剪贴板文字双向同步
- SHA-256 校验与断点续传
- 系统分享面板发送
- 可选提醒：在用户授权后显示已配对设备经局域网转发的通知
- 文件保存在接收端指定的下载目录

配对、接收和传输都在本地网络完成。

请只在可信的局域网使用。当前版本未启用 TLS，请勿在公共 Wi-Fi 传输密码、证件或私密照片等敏感内容。

本应用不读取本机的短信、通话、iMessage、微信/QQ 聊天数据库，也不读取本机通知。提醒卡片只显示已配对设备经局域网转发的通知内容，不提供短信回复或通话音频接听。

name: Genevet Partner
description:
جينات للأطباء — تطبيق الطبيب البيطري المرخّص.

استقبل طلبات العملاء القريبين منك، وقدّم استشارتك بالصوت أو الفيديو من مكانك،
وحدّد خدماتك وأسعارك، وتابع مستحقّاتك — من تطبيق واحد.

هذا التطبيق للأطباء البيطريين ومقدّمي الخدمات البيطرية المرخّصين. إن كنت تبحث
عن طبيب لحيوانك فحمّل تطبيق «جينات» للعملاء.


■ الطلبات
تصلك طلبات العملاء القريبين منك ما دمت متاحاً للعمل. تقرأ الحالة قبل أن تقبل،
وتقبل ما يناسبك، وتتابع الطلب حتى تنهي الخدمة.

■ جلسة الاستشارة
ملف الحالة أمامك: نوع الحيوان، وعمره، ووصف صاحبه للأعراض، وما أرفقه من صور
ومقاطع وتسجيلات صوتية. وتكتب تقرير الجلسة عند إنهائها.

■ المكالمات
مكالمة صوتية أو مرئية مع العميل من داخل التطبيق، وتصلك المكالمة حتى والتطبيق
مغلق. لا يتبادل الطرفان أرقام الهواتف — الاتصال داخل التطبيق وحده.

■ المحادثة
محادثة مكتوبة على كل طلب، تُرفق فيها الصور والمستندات، ويبقى سجلّها مع الطلب.

■ خدماتي وأسعاري
تختار الخدمات التي تقدّمها وتضع سعرك لكل واحدة، وتحدّد أقسام الاستشارة التي
تستقبلها. ما تضعه هو ما يراه العميل.

■ الإتاحة للعمل
مفتاح واحد: متاح أو غير متاح. ولا تصلك الطلبات إلا وأنت متاح.

■ الوثائق والتوثيق
ترفع ترخيص مزاولة مهنة الطب البيطري وشهاداتك لتراجعها الإدارة، وتتابع حالة كل
وثيقة. لا يُفعَّل الحساب ولا تصلك الطلبات قبل اعتماد وثائقك.

■ عقد الشراكة
تقرأ العقد وتوقّعه إلكترونياً من داخل التطبيق، وتحتفظ بنسختك منه.

■ تقييماتي
تقييم العملاء لخدماتك بعد كل طلب، وتقييمك العام الذي يراه العميل.

■ المحفظة والمستحقّات
رصيدك وحركاته، ومستحقّك عن كل طلب بعد العمولة، وطلب السحب إلى حسابك البنكي
المسجّل، ومتابعة حالة كل تحويل.

■ الدعم والإشعارات
تفتح تذكرة دعم وتتابع الردّ عليها، ويصلك تنبيه عند كل طلب جديد أو قرار على
وثيقة أو تحويل.


■ حسابك وخصوصيتك
بياناتك وطلباتك تظهر لك وحدك بعد تسجيل الدخول. يمكنك مراجعة بياناتك وتحديثها،
والاطّلاع على سياسة الخصوصية والشروط من داخل التطبيق، وحذف حسابك وبياناتك
الشخصية نهائياً في أي وقت من «ملفي ← حذف الحساب». تبقى سجلّات الطلبات
والمعاملات المالية كما يلزم النظام.


■ الأذونات ولماذا نطلبها
الموقع الجغرافي: لعرض الطلبات القريبة منك وأنت متاح للعمل، ولحساب المسافة بينك
وبين العميل. يُقرأ أثناء استخدامك التطبيق فقط، ولا يُتتبَّع موقعك في الخلفية.
الميكروفون: للتحدّث مع العميل في المكالمات، وللرسائل الصوتية في المحادثة.
الكاميرا: لظهورك في مكالمة الفيديو، ولتصوير ترخيصك وشهاداتك لرفعها.
الصور والملفات: لاختيار وثيقة أو صورة من جهازك وإرفاقها.
الإشعارات: لتنبيهك بطلب جديد أو مكالمة واردة أو ردّ على تذكرتك.


■ تنبيه
التطبيق أداة لتنظيم الخدمات البيطرية وتقديمها، ولا يغني عن مسؤوليتك المهنية.
القرار الطبي والمسؤولية عنه يبقيان للطبيب المعالج، ويلزمك أن يكون ترخيصك
سارياً طوال عملك على المنصّة.

name: GenLog
description:
GenLog to profesjonalne narzędzie terenowe dla brygadzistów elektrycznych i osób zarządzających zasilaniem tymczasowym. Pomaga prowadzić rejestr pracy agregatów, zużycia paliwa i obwodów zasilania, aby koszty paliwa na budowie pozostały pod kontrolą.

CO MOŻESZ ZROBIĆ

• Rejestr agregatów — dodawaj jednostki z modelem, mocą znamionową (kW), pojemnością zbiornika, normą zużycia (L/h), lokalizacją i statusem.
• Sesje pracy — zapisuj start i koniec zmiany, godziny pracy, zużyte oraz uzupełnione paliwo, operatora oraz powiązany obwód zasilania.
• Obwody zasilania — prowadź listę pętli/rozdzielnic: nazwa, obszar obciążenia, prąd wyłącznika i status aktywności.
• Alerty anomalii paliwa — GenLog porównuje rzeczywiste L/h z normą agregatu i Twoim progiem alertu; oznacza nadmierne zużycie z poziomem ważności i wskazówkami kontroli.
• Kokpit kosztów — przeliczaj litry na szacunkowy koszt według ceny paliwa na placu; śledź godziny, paliwo i wydatki w bieżącym miesiącu.
• Statystyki — podsumowania według agregatu, aktywność obwodów i trendy efektywności na potrzeby zdania zmiany i kontroli kosztów.
• Ustawienia progu — dostosuj cenę paliwa, próg anomalii (%) oraz domyślną normę L/h do standardów placu.

Dla kogo?
Dla brygadzistów elektrycznych, kierowników robót i osób odpowiedzialnych za agregaty prądotwórcze oraz koszty zasilania tymczasowego.

Dlaczego GenLog?
Szybki zapis w terenie, czytelny układ Futuristic Flat, dane lokalne na urządzeniu — bez konta do podstawowej pracy z rejestrem. Od agregatu, przez sesję i obwód, aż po alert i koszt: pełny cykl kontroli paliwa.

name: Get Wrapping
description:
Get Wrapping makes daily tefillin a habit you look forward to.

WRAP. GROW. REPEAT.
Every day you put on tefillin, log it with one tap. Your avatar's beard grows with your streak: stubble, then a full beard, then a beard to the floor. Earn sefarim for your bookcase along the way, and keep them forever.

BUILT FOR THE JEWISH CALENDAR
• Knows your daily window, from misheyakir to sunset, for where you live
• Goes quiet on Shabbat and Yom Tov: no reminders, and your streak never breaks
• Chol Hamoed, Rosh Chodesh and Tisha B'Av handled by your customs
• Gentle reminders in the morning, after school, and before sunset

KEEP EACH OTHER GOING
• Start a Chavruta with friends, your class or your shul, and invite them with a code
• See who wrapped today, give kudos and send a cheer like "Chazak!" or "Yasher koach!"
• Misses are never shown, only the days people wrapped
• Group leaders can check in friends at minyan who don't have their phones
• Friendly leaderboards: your friends, groups against groups, and an optional public board

LEARN TO WRAP
• Step-by-step guides for Ashkenaz, Sefard, Chabad, Edot HaMizrach and Teimani
• The brachot in Hebrew, with transliteration and translation
• A mirror to check your head tefillin is centered
• How to care for your tefillin, and fun facts

APPLE WATCH
Log from your wrist. Kids with a watch and no iPhone can use Get Wrapping on the watch alone.

HOLIDAY CHALLENGES
Wear tefillin on every day of Chanukah, the Omer, Elul and more to win themed prizes for your shelf, new every year.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking. Your history stays on your device and in your own iCloud. Your location only sets your zmanim, and photos never leave your phone.

Get Wrapping is a friendly guide, not a psak. When in doubt, ask your rabbi.

name: Giáo Xứ Vinh Hoà
description:
Giáo Xứ Vinh Hoà giúp bạn tra cứu Giờ Lễ, tìm nhà thờ và tìm hiểu đời sống giáo xứ trong một ứng dụng dễ sử dụng.

GIỜ LỄ
• Xem lịch Giờ Lễ của Giáo xứ Vinh Hoà theo ngày trong tuần.
• Tra cứu Giờ Lễ Nhà Thờ Gần Bạn dựa trên vị trí hiện tại.
• Xem thông tin nhà thờ, chia sẻ lịch lễ và mở chỉ đường bằng ứng dụng bản đồ.

DANH BẠ NHÀ THỜ
• Tìm kiếm nhà thờ và tra cứu theo tỉnh, thành phố.
• Khám phá nhà thờ trên bản đồ và xem lịch lễ của từng nhà thờ.

KHÁM PHÁ GIÁO XỨ
• Tìm hiểu lịch sử, các cộng đoàn và giáo họ của Giáo xứ Vinh Hoà.
• Đọc tin Giáo hội và tin sinh hoạt từ nguồn Giáo phận Ban Mê Thuột.

Ứng dụng không yêu cầu đăng nhập. Quyền vị trí được sử dụng khi bạn tìm nhà thờ hoặc giờ lễ gần mình. Bạn vẫn có thể tra cứu lịch lễ và danh bạ khi không cấp quyền vị trí.

Lịch lễ có thể thay đổi vào các dịp lễ hoặc theo sinh hoạt địa phương. Vui lòng xác nhận với nhà thờ trước khi đến tham dự.

name: Gift Shuffle: Secret Santa
description:
No slips of paper, no one drawing their own name, no "I already know who has me".

Secret Santa is the name generator for your family Christmas, office gift exchange or friends' holiday party. It draws the names and keeps the result a secret, even from the person holding the phone.

Two ways to reveal
Pass the phone: each person taps their name, holds the envelope until it opens and sees who they are giving to. It hides again by itself a few seconds later and the name gets marked as seen.
Organizer sends: you send each person a secret link. Their result stays hidden, so you can play too.

What else is in the box
• Quick start templates for family, office and friends
• Exclusions, one way or both ways: couples, siblings, last year's pairs
• A wishlist for every participant, shown only to whoever draws them
• Budget ($25, $50…), exchange date and a note with the rules
• Countdown to the exchange on every group
• Works for Christmas, Hanukkah, holiday parties, Kris Kringle and any gift swap
• Draw again whenever you need, as many groups as you like
• The classic rules, in case someone asks
• Next year's edition with one tap: same people, and nobody gets the same person as the last two years
• Reminders a week and a day before the exchange
• Gift ideas for every budget

Your groups stay on your phone
No account and no internet needed to draw. Groups, names, wishlists and draws are stored only on this device.

name: Glimt: Your Child's Year Film
description:
You don't have to remember to film. Glimt finds the day's best second in the videos and Live Photos you already took – the second where your child is in the picture – and does it all on your iPhone.

Day by day, the seconds become a film of your child's month or year, with the date on every second. Save it to Photos or share it – with no watermark.

HOW GLIMT FINDS THE SECOND
• Glimt looks through a day's videos and Live Photos and shows the best first: sharp, well lit, with faces clearly seen
• Add a few clear photos of your child's face, and Glimt prefers the seconds where that child is in the picture rather than a brother, a sister or a friend. It compares each day with photos from about that age, so it keeps up as your child grows
• "Find the missing days" fills the gaps in a month by itself, straight from your camera roll
• Not the right second? Pick another video from the day, or move the second with a slider
• Rather film it yourself? "Film now" records up to three seconds with the camera

YOUR CHILD'S YEAR, DAY BY DAY
• One project per child – or for anything you want to follow: the garden, the new house, the first year somewhere new
• A calendar for each month with a picture for every day, so the gaps are easy to spot
• A gentle reminder in the evening, only on days when a second is still missing
• 1, 2 or 3 seconds per day
• Films of a month, a year or any dates you choose, with the date on every second and the clips' own sound if you like

PRIVATE
Everything happens on your iPhone. Glimt reads your videos where they already are in Photos and copies nothing but a small thumbnail. The photo of your child's face never leaves the iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking and no data collected. (If your videos are in iCloud Photos, Photos may fetch one from your own iCloud.)

PAY ONCE. THAT'S IT.
Glimt is one purchase: every feature and every future update, with no subscription and no watermark. Extra app icons and a silly little game are included for everyone.

Glimt works in English, Danish, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian and Brazilian Portuguese.

name: Globetale: Travel Globe Map
description:
Light up every country you’ve been.

Globetale turns your travel photos into a glowing 3D globe and beautiful cards you’ll want to share. Pick photos from your trips — Globetale reads where each one was taken, sorts them by country, and lights that country up on your globe.

■ A 3D GLOBE YOU’LL LOVE TO SPIN
Drag in any direction, pinch to zoom, and tap a country to open its photos. Visited countries glow in emerald, even on the night side.

■ YOUR TRIP, SHAPED LIKE THE COUNTRY
Every country becomes a card made from your own photos, shaped like the country itself. Faces and subjects are framed automatically.

■ 18 DESIGNS
Silhouette mosaic, contact sheet, boarding pass, passport visa page, vintage luggage labels, view from orbit, neon sign, Swiss grid, retro poster, postcard, topo map with photo pins, magazine cover, stamps, scrapbook and more. Post (4:5) and Story (9:16) sizes.

■ SORTED AUTOMATICALLY
Photo locations find the country for you — including tiny ones like Vatican City and Monaco. Photos without a location can be assigned in a tap.

■ PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos and location data stay on your device and are never uploaded.

■ PREMIUM — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Buy once, keep forever. No subscription.
• All 18 designs (and future ones)
• Up to 150 photos per card
• No logo on your cards
• 2× resolution export (2160px)
Your globe and all your travel records are free.

Terms of Use: https://playmind-site.vercel.app/terms/globetale
Privacy Policy: https://playmind-site.vercel.app/privacy/globetale

name: Gondoly
description:
Gondoly moves photos, videos and any file between your devices with a QR code. iPhone to Windows, Android to Mac, phone to a friend's laptop: it works in every direction, and the other side doesn't even need the app — the browser at gondoly.app is enough.

HOW IT WORKS
1. On one device, choose Show code. A QR code appears.
2. On the other, choose Scan code (or just point the camera). The two are connected.
3. Send photos, videos and files either way: phone to computer or computer to phone, without scanning again.

MADE FOR EVERY DAY
• iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows and any browser
• Original quality: no compression, nothing resized
• Photos and videos go straight to your library
• On the same Wi-Fi, devices send directly to each other, as much as you want

PRIVATE FROM THE START
Every transfer is end-to-end encrypted. Your files and their names never pass through our servers.

GONDOLY PRO
Send from anywhere, even when the devices are on different networks, with no monthly limit, on as many devices as you like. Free on the same Wi-Fi; 3 sends a month between different networks on the free plan.

Gondoly Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://gondoly.com/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://gondoly.com/en/privacy/

name: Gordie's Field Book
description:
Gordie's Field Book is a private journal for hunting, fishing and maple sugaring. It was built for a grandfather who hunts, fishes and makes his own maple syrup.

Keep everything on a real map:
• Trips: a hunt, a day on the water, or a boil in the sugar shack. Record your route, add stops, and keep photos and notes together.
• Harvests: a buck, a stringer of perch, the first run of sap or a batch of syrup. Save the species, size or amount, and how you got it.
• Spots: tree stands, ground blinds, fishing holes, trail cameras, your sugar bush and tapped trees. Mark them, find your way back, and check the weather there.

Log a visit each time you hunt, fish, scout, check a camera, collect sap or boil.

Your journal stays private on your phone and works without service in the field. No account is needed. If you like, sign in with Apple or Google in Settings to back up your entries and see them on another device. Export your spots as GPX at any time.

name: GracePath: Bible & Prayer
description:
GracePath is a calm, private companion for your daily walk with God: Scripture, prayer and reflection in one quiet place.

READ AND LISTEN TO THE BIBLE
• Public-domain Bible translations, available offline
• Gentle narration using the natural voices built into your iPhone
• Verse of the day, highlights, bookmarks and notes
• Reading plans through the Gospels, Psalms and more

PRAY EVERY DAY
• Morning, evening and bedtime prayers
• Traditional prayers for Catholic, Orthodox and Protestant Christians, including the Rosary
• Write your own prayers and set gentle reminders

A QUIET SANCTUARY
• Light a candle, hold an intention and pray with soft soundscapes
• Guided meditations on Scripture

YOUR PRIVATE JOURNAL
• Devotions, SOAP studies, gratitude and prayer cards
• Stored on your iPhone, with optional Face ID lock

Available in 15 languages. No ads. No tracking.

GRACEPATH PRO
Free forever: the Bible with narration, the verse of the day, daily and traditional prayers, reminders, the journal and one sanctuary space.
Pro adds every sanctuary space, the complete soundscape library, advanced reading plans, deeper devotional statistics, more personalisation and journal export.
• GracePath Pro Monthly (US$3.99/month) or GracePath Pro Yearly (US$29.99/year). Prices vary by country and are shown in the app before you buy.
• Eligible new subscribers can try Pro free for 1 week.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

GracePath is a companion for personal devotion. It does not replace the sacraments or your church community.

name: Grade: Photo Editor & LUTs
description:
Grade edits your photos and grades your videos on your iPhone, automatically or by hand.

PHOTO
• Magic: light fixed and a filter picked for the scene, in one tap.
• Suggested filters for every photo, with adjustable intensity.
• Areas: sky, skin, subject, each retouched on its own.
• Tools: eraser, background blur, new sky, portrait, colorize.
• Edits saved in Photos, always reversible. Live Photos keep their motion for color adjustments.

VIDEO
• Apple Log footage fixed on import: light, white balance, skin tone.
• Cinematic looks, to try on your own video.
• Editing: templates, silence removal, subtitles, music.
• Export for Reels, YouTube HDR or maximum quality.

LUT
• Export one look or all your looks as .cube files for Blackmagic Camera, Final Cut, LumaFusion or CapCut.

PRIVACY
Edits and grading are computed on your iPhone. The smart features may use Apple's private cloud, which keeps nothing (can be turned off). No account, no ads.

One purchase, every feature, no subscription.

name: Grand Piano 88
description:
A simple piano app with the sound of a real grand piano, covering all 88 keys.
Loop a phrase right after you play it and practice along with it. For example, let your left-hand accompaniment repeat while you work on the right-hand melody.

■ Play
• 88 keys (A0–C8). Use the overview at the top to choose which part of the keyboard you see and how large the keys are (2–3 octaves)
• Split the keyboard into two rows to play distant ranges with your right and left hands
• Play with as many fingers as you like, and slide your finger for a glissando
• Choose the reverb, touch sensitivity, and pedal
• Show note names (C D E or Do Re Mi) on the keys
• Play with an external keyboard connected to your iPad or iPhone

■ Practice with loops
• Record a phrase from the start of a bar, in time with the metronome
• The phrase loops, lined up with the bar lines
• The keys being played light up, and a timeline shows how long each note sounds

■ Metronome
• Tempo 40–200, in 3/4 or 4/4 time

■ Record and share
• Record what you play and listen back later
• Export as MP3 (audio) or MIDI (note data), then send it with AirDrop or Messages or save it to the Files app. MIDI files can be edited in GarageBand and other apps

■ Also
• Plays sound even when your device is in silent mode
• Works fully offline. No ads, no account, and no data collection
• Available in English and Japanese

Piano sound: Salamander Grand Piano (Alexander Holm, CC BY 3.0)

name: Granule for ClickHouse
description:
Tens of millions of rows, and Granule doesn't freeze. On a Mac, 30 million rows from a server arrive in under a second, then sort or search in under half a second.

Granule is a native client for ClickHouse on the Mac, iPad and iPhone, made for results of any size. Rows appear while the query still runs, and you can scroll them at once.

RESULTS
• Rows show as they arrive, with the rows read of those expected, the memory used and the server's own figures when the query ends. Stop ends the query on the server too.
• Sort by any column, search every column, and see totals.
• Values look the way ClickHouse writes them: times in their column's time zone, exact decimals, arrays, maps, tuples and JSON. NULL is shown apart from an empty string.
• Charts of a result: lines over time or bars by category, for millions of points.
• Number columns as data bars or a heatmap.
• Export to CSV, TSV, Parquet, Arrow or JSON Lines, written by the server, or the rows as shown to Excel or CSV.

THE EDITOR
• Highlighting, and completion from your server's functions, settings and formats and from your tables and columns.
• Statements are checked as you type by the server itself, so syntax, names and types follow your server's version, with the names a misspelled one may be.
• Query parameters, run all statements of a script in one session, saved queries and a history you can search.
• Format a statement, and see a run's time, rows and memory next to the run before it.

SAFEGUARDS
• On a production connection, a statement that drops, deletes or rewrites data runs only once you type the connection's name.
• Read-only connections write nowhere.
• A query the server estimates to read more than a billion rows asks first.

THE SERVER
• Health on one page: replicas behind, partitions with too many parts, failing mutations, disks nearly full, failed dictionaries and more.
• Running, recent, failed and heaviest queries; merges, mutations, replicas and their queue; errors, disks, settings and metrics. Live views refresh by themselves, and a query can be stopped from its row.
• On a cluster, every view can cover all of its servers at once.

EXPLAIN
• The plan as an outline that shows what the indexes skip, and the pipeline drawn as a graph.

CONNECTIONS
• HTTP and HTTPS, including ClickHouse Cloud.
• Pinned certificates, your own certificate authority, and client certificates.
• Servers behind an SSH bastion, with a key or a password.
• Import the connections clickhouse-client keeps. Passwords and keys stay in the Keychain.
• No server yet? Try it on ClickHouse's public playground, from the empty list.

Granule collects no data and has no tracking. It talks only to the servers you add.

English and Russian.

Granule is open source (MIT): github.com/d-polikhranidi/Granule. Its table is Gingham, our table engine for Mac, iPad and iPhone apps: github.com/digitalglobeby/Gingham

ClickHouse is a trademark of ClickHouse, Inc. Granule is an independent client and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by ClickHouse, Inc.

name: Greca FM 99.4
description:
Ο Greca 99,4 αποτελεί τον κορυφαίο ραδιοφωνικό σταθμό και σημείο αναφοράς για την ελληνική μουσική στη Δυτική Ελλάδα.

Με κέντρο εκπομπής στο Φραγκοπήδημα Ηλείας, εκπέμπει με πανίσχυρο σήμα εξασφαλίζοντας κρυστάλλινη κάλυψη σε ολόκληρο τον Νομό Ηλείας (Πύργος, Αμαλιάδα, Γαστούνη, Λεχαινά, Κρέστενα, Ζαχάρω, Ανδραβίδα), καθώς και σε μεγάλες περιοχές των νομών Αχαΐας, Μεσσηνίας, Αρκαδίας και στα νησιά του Ιονίου, τη Ζάκυνθο και την Κεφαλονιά.

Greca FM 99,4 - Μόνο Επιτυχίες!

name: Green Valley: Lawn Care
description:
Start a lawn care business and take the controls in first person. Pick a contract, set off from your van and watch tall grass give way to a freshly cut strip in a single pass.

Spend your earnings on equipment. Dethatch and aerate lawns, prepare soil, sow seed and water it in. Multi-stage contracts bring you back to the same lawn with your next machine. Grow your company from small gardens to orchards, farms and estates.

name: Gridlight: Spark Runner
description:
Become a living spark and race along the city's power lines!

Swipe to switch wires, jump over gaps, duck under low bridges and dodge everything the city throws at you. Grab energy orbs, fly through the glowing x2 gates, steer clear of the minus ones, and at the end of every level pour all your voltage into the Gridlight Tower. Light up its 30 floors and earn up to three stars!

TEN DISTRICTS TO LIGHT UP
Start in sunny Downtown, then travel through Sunset Heights, the Harbor, the Neon District, the Old Town, the snowy Alpine Peaks, the Desert Sun, Green Park, the Ironworks and the shimmering Aurora City. Each district has its own streets, sky and mood.

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
Low bridges, arc flashovers, swinging wrecking balls, ziplines, tunnels, laser drones, surge waves and single-wire spans keep every level fresh. Every 10th level is special: Orb Rush, Storm Chase, Night Blackout or the Gauntlet, with bigger rewards.

POWER-UPS
Magnet, Shield, Overcharge, x2 Coins and Slow-Mo.

ENDLESS RUN
How far can you go? Chase your best distance in Endless mode.

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock 24 spark skins and 14 trails, upgrade 11 abilities, open Power Crates, complete daily missions and weekly challenges, master every district and climb the 60-tier Grid Pass.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- One-thumb swipe controls
- Plays offline, no account needed
- Sharp graphics, with a LOW setting for older phones

Gridlight is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases. Power Crates with random rewards are only won in play, never sold (the odds are shown in the game). The No Ads purchase removes the ads between levels; reward videos stay optional.

Privacy policy: https://vanguardsystems.hu/gridlight/privacy/
Terms of use: https://vanguardsystems.hu/gridlight/terms/
Support: vanguardsystemskft@gmail.com

name: GroomerBook
description:
The grooming book built for mobile dog groomers.

Remember every dog. Win every rebook.

GroomerBook keeps your clients and their pets organized — so the next visit starts from the last recipe, not from memory.

▸ DOG PROFILES
Grooming recipe (blade, shampoo, style) written once and reused. Bite-risk flags. Vaccine expiry tracking. Special tools to bring — never forget the large dryer again.

▸ CLIENT PROFILES
Phone, email, service address — tap to call, tap to navigate. Family contact notes. Preferences and do-nots. No-show counter with a deposit hint when a client has a history.

▸ APPOINTMENTS
Multi-pet visits. Drive-time buffer. Up to 3 reminders per appointment (1-10 hours before) so you leave on time.

▸ MONTHLY SUMMARY
Visits, revenue and mileage for the month — your bookkeeping starts here.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No cloud. No ads. No analytics. No network access at all — your records never leave your device.

FREE AND SIMPLE
Unlimited clients, unlimited pets, all features free. Deleting the app removes everything instantly — because nothing was ever sent anywhere.

name: GTDC EPMS
description:
GTDC EPMS Mobile – Enterprise Performance & Operations Portal

Stay connected, organised and productive with the GTDC Enterprise Performance & Operations Portal (EPMS) Mobile App.

Designed for employees and management of the Ghana Tourism Development Company (GTDC), EPMS Mobile provides convenient access to essential workplace services and organisational activities, all from your mobile device.

- Check in and check out from your designated office or approved duty location.
- Record field assignments, official meetings, site inspections and remote duties.
- Add notes to attendance records.
- Use device location services to support location-based attendance verification.

2. Task Management
- View assigned tasks and responsibilities.
- Monitor task progress and updates.
- Stay informed about outstanding assignments and deadlines.

3. Leave Management
- Submit leave requests conveniently.
- View leave records and request statuses.

- Receive notifications about meetings, tasks, approvals and important organisational activities.

GTDC EPMS Mobile supports a more connected, accountable and efficient workforce by bringing essential employee services and operational activities together in one convenient platform.

Whether you are in the office, attending an official meeting or carrying out field duties, GTDC EPMS Mobile helps you stay connected with your organisation.

Ghana Tourism Development Company (GTDC)
Enterprise Performance & Operations Portal.

name: GTX Store
description:
Welcome to GTX Store – Your Digital Shopping Destination!

GTX Store brings together gaming products, digital gift cards, and social media services in one convenient platform.

Discover a wide selection of digital products and explore available services through a simple, easy-to-use interface.

KEY FEATURES

GAMING SERVICES
Browse gaming-related products and services for popular games, including PUBG MOBILE, Call of Duty Mobile, and more.

DIGITAL GIFT CARDS

name: Gulltråd
description:
Gulltråd er et lite verksted med to benker. På trekkbenken setter du drag, glød og tråd, og leser jevn og brudd. På klypebenken holder du mellomrom, loddpunkt og fyll, og leser feste og sig.

Ett trinn om gangen. Ingen liv, ingen klokke, ingen reklamer og ingen konto. Det du skriver, blir på denne enheten.

• 64 trekktrinn — sett draget og les jevnheten
• 78 klypetrinn — hold mellomrommet og les festet
• Protokollen tar bare løsningene du selv beholder
• Stien går i rekkefølge; lukk dette trinnet, så åpner det neste
