Gulltråd samler ikke inn og sender ikke data. Ingen analyse og ingen reklamer. Sletter du appen, tømmes verkstedet.

name: Halo Hugs: Cozy Ring Puzzle
description:
Turn. Line up. Hug!

Halo Hugs is a cozy thinking puzzle. Three rings of squishy jelly pals circle a little heart. Swipe a ring to turn it one step. When three pals of the same color line up on a spoke, they share a big hug and float away. Clear every pal to win.

Every move counts, but nothing is rushed: no timers, no lives, and Undo is always free.

• 10,000 puzzles in 202 chapters, getting cleverer as you go
• New twists as you go: Buddy Gears, Star Pals, Sleepy Rings and Twin Pals
• Every puzzle checked by a solver: always fair, with a move target for 3 stars
• A fresh Daily Hug puzzle every day
• Free hints that show the next best move
• Earn stardust and trophies to unlock 80+ charms: expressions, ring decorations, hub charms, hug bursts and stickers
• Light and dark themes, color symbols for color-vision accessibility, Reduce Motion and VoiceOver support
• Plays offline, no account needed

Made by Moonlit Arcade.

name: HareMail
description:
Welcome to HareMail, a gentle postal flight journey set across tranquil ocean archipelagos. Take to the skies as a devoted little rabbit courier, guiding light deliveries through whispering sea breezes and picturesque coastal islands.

FLOAT WITH GENTLE BREEZES
Master intuitive, touch-guided flight physics. Press and hold to adjust your glide altitude, tilt through ascending thermal currents, and release to let the wind carry your parcel safely forward. Collect floating dandelion seeds along your route to maintain gentle momentum and glide gracefully past sea stacks, coastal cliffs, and fluttering flags.

EXPLORE 36 SCENIC ROUTES
Embark on 36 hand-crafted postal expeditions across three distinct regional chapters:
• Whispering Shallows: Calm coastal flats, gentle tailwinds, and shallow turquoise bays.
• Timber Bluffs: Towering pine ridgelines, sweeping drafts, and winding forest valleys.
• Sunstone Atoll: Sparkling open waters, dynamic oceanic currents, and golden horizon sunsets.

DISCOVER BOTANICAL POSTCARDS
Every completed route delivers more than just letters—it unveils memories of the archipelago. Unlock beautifully illustrated botanical postcards documenting rare flora, coastal landmarks, and quiet island moments. Each postcard preserves a unique flight log with time records and wind ratings.

TAILOR YOUR POSTAL RUN
Visit the Flight Yard to inspect and customize your flight gear:
• Adjust flight coats and aerodynamic scarves.
• Toggle tactile controls and visual assist cues to match your flight style.
• Practice specialized glide maneuvers in the open training yard.

POSTMASTER CHARTER
Open the entire archipelago with the optional Postmaster Lifetime Charter—a single, one-time unlock granting immediate access to all 36 routes, golden heraldic seals, and full archive access.

A PEACEFUL ATMOSPHERE
Immerse yourself in hand-crafted papercraft aesthetics, responsive ambient nature audio, soft acoustic melodies, and relaxing gameplay designed to bring calm and delight to every spare moment.

Fasten your mail satchel, feel the direction of the wind, and take flight with HareMail today!

name: Harmotwine: Relaxing Puzzles
description:
Move a sphere. Hear a string. Find the moment when everything connects.

Harmotwine is a relaxing puzzle game about sound, space and balance. Drag glowing spheres until every thread is in harmony at the same time. Begin with simple shapes, then discover deeper spatial puzzles as new ideas unfold across six sound worlds.

72 HANDCRAFTED PUZZLES
Explore six worlds with twelve puzzles each. Learn to tune strings, balance connected shapes, follow movement paths, rotate your view, hold a string in place and move paired spheres together.

THINK AT YOUR OWN PACE
There is no countdown. Experiment, undo a move or ask for a focused hint when a thread has you puzzled. Later worlds introduce a rotating 3D view so you can see the same puzzle from a different angle.

SEE AND HEAR THE HARMONY
Soft string tones, glowing threads and optional haptic feedback respond to your moves. Color and symbols show whether a string is too loose, too tight or in tune. Sound is optional; the puzzles remain playable with audio off. Reduced effects and camera controls let you adjust the experience.

BUILD A SOUND COLLECTION
Every solved puzzle adds a sound sculpture to your collection. Revisit its shape and play its sound whenever you choose.

START WITH 24 AD-FREE LEVELS
The first two worlds are free and require no ads. For later levels, choose an optional rewarded video to unlock a pack of up to five levels, or buy Harmotwine Pro once to play the entire included 72-level campaign without ads. No subscription. Normal puzzle progression still applies.

Progress and video unlocks are saved on your device. Pro purchases can be restored using the same store account. No Harmotwine account is required. Unlocked puzzles can be played offline; ads, purchases and restoring purchases require internet access.

Support: https://harmotwine.app/support/
Privacy: https://harmotwine.app/privacy/

name: Hatim Kardeşim
description:
Hatim Kardeşim, Kur'an-ı Kerim'i kardeşlerinizle cüz cüz paylaşarak birlikte hatim etmeniz için hazırlandı. Uygulama ücretsizdir.

HATİM GRUBU KURUN
• Grubunuza bir ad ve niyet verin, hatim süresini seçin.
• Karma, sadece hanımlar veya sadece beyler için grup açın.
• Arkadaşlarınızı uygulama içinden davet edin ya da grup kodunu paylaşın.

GRUBA KATILIN
• Katılabileceğiniz açık grupları listeleyin; en az cüzü kalan gruplar önde.
• Grup adıyla arayın ya da en yeni grupları görün.

CÜZÜNÜZÜ ALIN VE OKUYUN
• 30 cüz tek ekranda: boş, alınmış, okunan ve okunmuş cüzler renkleriyle görünür.
• Cüzünüzü uygulama içinde, mushaf sayfa düzeninde okuyun; sayfalar kitap gibi çevrilir.
• "Okumaya başladım" ve "Okudum" ile durumunuzu bildirin.
• Hatim bitince hatim duası Arapça metni, anlamı ve sesli okunuşuyla açılır.

KUR'AN OKU
• Sureler ve cüzler listesi, kaldığınız yerden devam.
• Diyanet İşleri meali, yazı tipi, kâğıt rengi ve yazı boyutu seçenekleri.

HER GÜN
• Günün ayeti ve günün hadisi.
• İlinize göre ezan vakitleri, vaktinde veya 15 dakika önce ezan bildirimi.
• Kıble pusulası.
• İstatistikler: tamamlanan hatimler, okunan cüzler, ayın en çok okuyanı.

KARDEŞLİK
• Grup üyelerine arkadaşlık isteği gönderin, bir sonraki hatme birlikte başlayın.
• Arkadaşlarınızın okumalarına hazır tebriklerle karşılık verin.

Türkçe, İngilizce ve Arapça dil seçenekleri vardır. Hesabınızı istediğiniz an uygulama içinden silebilirsiniz.

name: Health Export Tool
description:
Apple Health holds years of you: every run, every night's sleep, every heart-rate reading your watch ever took. Health Export Tool puts all of it in one zip that you keep.

WORKOUTS AS FIT FILES
Every workout becomes a FIT file in one folder, the format Garmin Connect, Strava, Intervals.icu and TrainingPeaks import. Choose them all and upload them in one go. Routes and heart rate come too.

EVERYTHING ELSE, AS SPREADSHEETS
Heart rate, HRV, resting heart rate, sleep stages, steps, weight, blood pressure, VO2 max, and more. One folder per kind of data, plain CSV files you can open in Numbers or Excel, with a readme in each folder saying what every column means.

A COMPLETE COPY, BEFORE YOU CHANGE APPLE ID
Moving to a new account, or just want a backup that is yours? The export keeps each record's source, device and original ID, so nothing is lost or mixed up.

NO MEDICAL RECORDS
HET reads what is in Health, but never your clinical health records.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No account, no server, no analytics. The zip is made on your iPhone and goes only where you send it.

The first 100 workouts and 100 days of health data are free, and the allowance never resets. A single purchase removes the limit. It is not a subscription.

name: Hedgebook: Tarot & Spells
description:
Hedgebook makes tarot part of your day. Each morning it deals you a single card, face down. Turn it over to read what it means, upright or reversed, with a question to sit with, then write about it in your journal. Over the weeks your journal fills with the cards that came up and what they meant to you on those days.

When you want to look something up, the tarot dictionary covers all 78 cards with Pamela Colman Smith's 1909 art. Spells holds twelve simple rituals for protection, rest, love, courage and the phases of the moon, using things most homes already have, and a template lets you write your own. The lexicon keeps notes on herbs, spices, crystals, colors and moon phases, and you can add your own.

A home screen and lock screen widget keeps the day's card close, and an optional reminder nudges you on days you haven't turned it yet. Pick one of three looks: Midnight Almanac, The Kitchen Book or Hedge Witch. Anything in the book can be shared as a picture or as text.

Everything stays on your iPhone, and there's no account to make. Hedgebook is optimized for the iPhone Duo: open it and the book lies flat as two facing pages.

name: HedgehogBits - secret vault
description:
A private vault for your photos, notes and documents, hidden behind a set of calm brain games.

Everything is encrypted on your iPhone and stays there. No servers, no accounts, no sync: your files stay in your hands.

ONE QUESTION AT THE DOOR
The app opens with a hedgehog and a single question: "Who is playing?"
• Type your vault password and your vault opens.
• Type anything else and the app says hello by that name and offers ten games.
• The app switcher only ever shows the hedgehog.

WHAT YOU CAN KEEP
• Photos and videos from your library, with the option to remove the originals afterwards
• Photos and videos taken with the in-app camera, never saved to your photo library
• Scanned documents: passports, cards and contracts become one PDF
• Notes, encrypted every time you save
• PDFs and other files from the Files app
• Folders, with drag and drop

FIND AND ORGANISE
• Search the whole vault by name. Nothing goes to Spotlight.
• Grid or list view, sorted by name, date, size or kind
• Select several items to move, export or delete them at once
• Rename anything

A DECOY FOR PRYING EYES (Plus)
Made to open the app? Give a second password. It opens a separate, ordinary vault, and nothing shows that another one exists.

LOCKS ON ITS OWN
• Put your iPhone face down on a table and the vault locks.
• Leave the app and it locks at once.

SECURITY
• Your password is turned into a key with Argon2id, using 256 MB of memory per guess, so guessing is slow and expensive.
• Every file, thumbnail and folder name is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, each with its own key.
• Videos play by decrypting small pieces in memory. A full plain copy is never written to storage.
• The vault is left out of iCloud and computer backups. Export an encrypted backup file whenever you choose, and restore it on a new iPhone.
• There is no password recovery and no back door. Not for you, and not for us.

THE GAMES
Ten real, complete mini games, that can justify the existence of the app

FREE AND PLUS
Free: up to 25 notes, photos, videos and files (folders don't count), with every security feature, the scanner, search and backups.
Hedgehog Bits Plus removes the limit and adds the decoy vault. Buy it once, or yearly. Nothing you've stored is ever locked away: with or without Plus, you can always open, export and back up everything.

The yearly plan renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the year. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy policy: https://hedgehogbits.com/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Heftly: Gym Log
description:
Heftly is a simple gym log. Start a workout, tick off your sets, and see exactly what to beat next time.

BUILT FOR THE GYM FLOOR
- Your sets start from last session, so you only change what moved
- A rest timer that starts when you finish a set
- New bests are celebrated the moment you tick the set
- Works offline, so a bad signal never costs you a set
- Your training syncs across your devices

LOG YOUR TRAINING
- Weight, reps, time, distance and calories
- A long list of built-in exercises, plus your own
- Templates for the workouts you repeat, with starters ready to go
- Notes on exercises and sets
- Kilograms or pounds, in English or Greek

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Your full workout history
- Time, sets, volume and new bests for every session
- Progress for each exercise

HEFTLY FOR GYMS
Join your gym with a code or link and train from your coach's templates. With your agreement, your coaches can see the workouts you log and help you progress. Leave at any time.

No ads and no tracking. Log in with a code sent to your email, with no password to remember. Delete your account and data at any time from the app.

Heftly is a training log, not medical or coaching advice. You train at your own risk.

name: Helfo : help in minutes
description:
Helfo - Help in Minutes

Need reliable help at home? Helfo makes it simple to book everyday home services whenever you need them. From cleaning and household help to laundry and other daily home needs, Helfo connects you with service professionals through a simple, convenient booking experience.

Whether you need help immediately or want to plan a service for a later time, Helfo gives you the flexibility to choose a service, select a convenient time slot, and manage your booking from one place.

HOME HELP AND HOUSEHOLD SERVICES

Get convenient help for your everyday household needs. Book professionals for tasks that make your home cleaner, more organized, and easier to manage.

Services may include:

- Home Cleaning
- Deep Cleaning
- Kitchen Cleaning
- Bathroom Cleaning
- Floor and Surface Cleaning
- Window Cleaning
- Fan Cleaning
- Dusting and General Cleaning
- Kitchen Organizing
- Home Organizing
- Plant Watering
- Other everyday household assistance

LAUNDRY SERVICES

Take care of your laundry without the hassle. Helfo helps you book laundry-related services based on your requirements and preferred schedule.

COOKING AND DAILY HOME HELP

Need assistance with everyday household tasks? Helfo is designed to make regular home help easier to access. Depending on service availability in your area, you can request services such as cooking assistance and other daily household support.

BOOK NOW OR SCHEDULE FOR LATER

Your time matters. With Helfo, you can choose between available service slots based on your requirement.

Need help right away? Select an available instant service slot.

Planning ahead? Choose your preferred date and time and schedule your booking for later.

SERVICE AVAILABILITY

Helfo is built for convenient local home services. Enter your location in the app to discover the services and time slots currently available in your area.

SIMPLE BOOKING EXPERIENCE

Booking a home service with Helfo is designed to be quick and easy:

1. Choose the service you need.
2. Enter or confirm your location.
3. Select an available date and time.
4. Review your booking details.
5. Confirm your booking.
6. Track your service and stay updated.
7. Get the service completed at your chosen location.

TRACK YOUR SERVICE

Once your booking is confirmed, you can stay updated on your service. Helfo provides booking and service information so you know what is happening with your request and when your service professional is expected to arrive.

RATE AND REVIEW

Your feedback matters. After your service is completed, you can rate your experience and share your feedback. Reviews help us improve the Helfo experience and help customers make better choices.

BOOK AGAIN

Need the same service again? Rebooking is simple. Use your previous service details to book again whenever you need help.

CONVENIENT AND TRANSPARENT BOOKING

Helfo is designed to make the home-service experience straightforward, from selecting a service and time slot to reviewing your booking details and completing the service.

WHY CHOOSE HELFO?

- Convenient home services in one app
- Easy service discovery and booking
- Instant and scheduled booking options
- Choose a convenient date and time
- Service tracking and booking updates
- Simple digital booking experience
- Rate and review your service experience
- Easy rebooking for recurring needs
- Multiple household services in one platform

Helfo is your convenient home-help platform for everyday household needs. Whether you need cleaning, laundry, cooking assistance, organizing, or other available home services, Helfo helps you find and book the right service through a simple app experience.

Download Helfo today and make everyday home help easier.

Helfo - Help in Minutes.

name: HelixNote
description:
Keep the setup, the observations, and the lessons from every tapping job together.

HelixNote is a local fieldbook for metric tapping estimates, parameter studies, broken-tap cases, and workshop records. Brushed titanium surfaces, gunmetal controls, and brass details bring a workshop feel to your notebook.

ORGANIZE A TAPPING JOB
Create a work order with a drawing reference, target hole count, stage, and closeout note. Link saved setups, field runs, incidents, and studies on a timeline so you can revisit a job's history.

CAPTURE THE COMPLETE SETUP
Start with M3–M20 coarse-thread presets or enter a custom diameter and pitch. Include stock condition, through or blind holes, pilot diameter, depth, tap geometry, and lubricant. View theoretical torque, a reference rpm range, and synchronized thread feed. Record your chosen speed, save snapshots, and compare setups side by side.

EXPLORE ONE CHANGE AT A TIME
Inspect 21 calculated samples for pilot diameter or thread depth, or compare six lubricant categories from the same baseline. Save the baseline and results for later reference. Compare two observed runs in an A/B record with your hypothesis, declared change, other recorded differences, and conclusion.

BUILD A BROKEN-TAP CASEBOOK
Capture the thread, material, pilot, depth, and lubrication conditions. Add reported speed and torque, measurement sources, break location, suspected causes, recovery history, and workpiece outcome. Find related cases by thread and material to revisit earlier observations.

RECORD PER-HOLE CHECKS
Save the gauge reference and part or batch details. Enter separate GO and NO-GO observations for each hole and assign your own disposition. Filter entries needing follow-up, recheck, or rework, and link the inspection to a setup, run, or work order.

KEEP YOUR OWN WORKSHOP LIBRARY
Maintain material references for individual stock and heat-treatment conditions. Save lubrication products, mixtures, delivery methods, and observations. Track tap batches, manually logged uses, wear marks, and notes.

WORK OFFLINE AND EXPORT LOCALLY
Use HelixNote without an account. Generate PDF field reports, export CSV data, and back up or restore records with JSON files. Save a plain-text work-order handover for your own files.

name: Help Me Mark
description:
Help Me Mark is an AI marking assistant for teachers, tuition centres and parents. Upload your question paper, your marking scheme and your students' handwritten scripts, and Help Me Mark marks every script against your own scheme: real ticks, crosses and margin notes on the page, with the reason for every lost mark.

You stay in charge. Review each script, change any mark, annotate with Apple Pencil and add your own comments, then send each student their feedback.

FOR TEACHERS
• Marks handwritten Maths, Science, Humanities and English scripts against your scheme (M1, A1, B1, follow-through, levels and bands)
• Real annotations on the student's page: ticks, crosses, circles and short margin notes
• Clear feedback for every question: what went wrong and how to fix it
• Class analytics: score distribution, common mistakes and question-by-question results
• Scan scripts with the camera: pages are found, flattened and joined into one script
• Apple Pencil support with pressure, palm rejection and double-tap or squeeze to switch to the eraser
• Follow-up practice questions written for each student's mistakes
• Share view-only feedback links with students and parents

FOR TUITION CENTRES
• One shared credit balance for all your tutors
• Progress reports to parents under your centre's name

FOR PARENTS
• Check your child's practice papers at home, with one account for all your children

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your marking is saved in your own storage, never on our servers: your Google Drive if you sign in with Google, or your own iCloud if you sign in with Apple, so it's the same on your iPhone, iPad and computer. Scripts are held only briefly while they're being marked.

CREDITS
New accounts get 20 free credits. One credit marks a script of up to 6 pages. Credit packs are available as in-app purchases, and credits never expire.

Terms of Service: https://helpmemark.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://helpmemark.app/privacy

name: Help Me! My Pet!
description:
A line of poorly pets is waiting at your clinic door again!
Wash the muddy pup, thaw the kitten stuck in ice, and bandage the bunny's sore leg.
Spend your earnings to expand the clinic and hire nurses, and your little neighbourhood practice grows all the way to a second clinic by the beach.

■ A real dog joins the game!
Baektul, the developer's own beloved dog, appears as a special VIP patient. Meet the fluffy white Pomeranian with a red ribbon and nurse him back to health!

■ Seven ailments to treat
Soap baths, shots, bandages, ice packs, syrup, pills and even scissors for tangled fishing line. Pick the right tool for every patient.

■ 22 adorable patients
Cats, dogs and rabbits, plus parrots and turtles, in lots of different breeds.

■ Two clinics
Complete your neighbourhood clinic to open a breezy beach clinic.

■ Hire and train nurses
Nurses carry patients and help with treatment. Make them faster and stronger.

■ Decorate every ward
Plants, pictures, rugs and a cat tower, themed for each species.

■ VIP guests and a pet album
Meet VIP guests like Baektul, Hoppy and Chatty, collect every patient you cure in your album, and earn rewards from daily missions.

Grow your own cozy animal hospital in Help Me! My Pet!, a relaxing one-handed tycoon game.

* This game is free to play and contains ads and optional in-app purchases (such as ad removal).

name: Hesed: Prayer & Bible Journal
description:
Hesed (HEH-sed) is the Hebrew word for God's steadfast, loyal love. This app helps you live it out: spend a few quiet minutes with God, pray for the people in your life, and let them know you did.

PRAY FOR THE PEOPLE YOU LOVE
Keep a simple prayer list of people and requests. Hesed reminds you who to pray for today, and when you've prayed for someone a few times it nudges you to reach out. After you pray, it suggests a fitting verse and a short message you can text in one tap. Got a prayer request in a text? Share it to Hesed and it becomes a request, or tap "Ask how I can pray" to check in with someone.

PRAY TOGETHER
Share a prayer list with your spouse, family or small group. Everyone can add requests and mark them answered, privately through iCloud.

QUIET TIME, MADE CALM
A gentle, full-screen time with God: be still, read, pray, write and reach out. Breathe with a guided rhythm, pick how long you have, and let a Quiet Time Focus silence everything else. Start it with Siri and listen in the car.

VERSE AND REFLECTION CARDS
Turn today's verse, or something God is teaching you, into a beautiful card in modern line art, watercolor and linen designs. Share it as an Instagram Story, a post or a square, or save it as a Lock Screen wallpaper.

A JOURNAL YOU CAN TYPE OR SAY
Write a line or two, or just talk and Hesed types it for you. Drop daily thanks into the Gratitude box, add a photo to remember the moment, and sort entries and requests into folders. Now and then, Hesed brings back a "Remember when…" memory from your journal.

THE FAITHFULNESS WALL
"Thus far the Lord has helped us" (1 Samuel 7:12). Every answered prayer and every thank-you lands on your wall, so on hard days you can look back and remember.

THE WHOLE BIBLE, OFFLINE
Read the Berean Standard Bible, King James Version or World English Bible, all free and stored on your phone. Follow a reading plan, including New to Faith (21 days) and Coming Home (14 days) for anyone starting out or finding their way back.

WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME AND LOCK SCREEN
Keep today's verse, your reading plan and who to pray for one glance away.

SYNCED WITH ICLOUD
Your journal and prayer list follow you between your iPhone and iPad, stored in your own private iCloud.

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
"Hey Siri, add a prayer request in Hesed." "Hey Siri, start quiet time." "Hey Siri, what's today's verse?"

FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no account, no subscriptions. Your prayers and journal stay on your iPhone and iPad and in your own iCloud. We never see them.

name: Hibong
description:
Hibong is a stamp-style photo journal for photography lovers and travelers.

Capture moments through playful shapes, decorate with stickers and paper themes, then keep everything on a calm day-by-day calendar. Share your favorite stamps on a community wall and revisit your collection anytime.

• Shoot through creative frames — hearts, stars, circles, stamp edges, and more
• Decorate with stickers and scrapbook-inspired paper backgrounds
• Save stamps by day on a travel-friendly calendar journal
• Publish to a public wall to browse and like community stamps
• Sign in with Apple or Google to sync and post securely

Perfect for trip diaries, weekend getaways, café walks, and anyone who loves aesthetic photo journaling.

No ad tracking. Stamp photos are used only to display your journal and wall inside the app.

name: Hiragana Chart Keyboard: Kanji
description:
This is a keyboard for typing Japanese (hiragana, katakana, and kanji).

Hiragana Chart Keyboard lays out its keys just like the hiragana chart (gojuon) you learn from: あいうえお, かきくけこ, さしすせそ… No flicking and no romaji. Just tap the kana you see, in any app: Messages, LINE, Mail, Notes, Safari, and more.

■ Who it's for
• Japanese learners who want to type the kana they are memorizing
• Anyone who finds flick input or romaji input hard
• Kids learning hiragana, and families who write to each other in Japanese
• Anyone who likes typing with the chart in front of them

■ What it does
• Type hiragana in chart order (あいうえお, かきくけこ…)
• Kanji conversion and predictive suggestions (turn them off to type hiragana only)
• Tap "More" to see every suggestion
• Katakana, English letters (ABC, ⇧ for capitals), numbers, symbols, emoji, and kaomoji
• The ゛゜小 key adds dakuten, handakuten, and small kana (か→が, は→ぱ, つ→っ)
• Bigger keys: split the chart into 3 or 2 parts, and choose from 4 key heights
• Side tabs flip to the rest of the chart

■ Private by design
• The keyboard never goes online, and it does not need Full Access
• It never collects or sends what you type
• Kanji conversion runs entirely on your device

■ Getting started
1. Open the app and try the practice keyboard inside it
2. Start Premium (the first week is free)
3. Go to Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard… and choose "ひらがな表"
4. Wherever you type, tap the globe key to switch to "ひらがな表"

■ Premium (auto-renewable subscription)
Premium lets you use Hiragana Chart Keyboard in every app, with kanji conversion, emoji, and big keys included. We add new words to the dictionary every month.
• Monthly and yearly plans, each with a 1-week free trial
• Family plans let up to 6 people in your Family Sharing group (including you) use it on their own devices
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase
• Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Cancel anytime in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions
• If you cancel during the free trial, you won't be charged
• Without Premium, you can still use the practice keyboard inside the app

The app is available in English and Japanese.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://yoneapp.com/jp/privacy-policy/1.0.0

name: HogDash: Product Analytics
description:
HogDash is a mobile app for PostHog that puts your product analytics in your pocket. Connect with a read-only Personal API key and see live KPIs, your saved insights and dashboards, and drill down into people and events, from US Cloud, EU Cloud or self-hosted instances.

HOME AT A GLANCE
• Total events, active users, sessions and page views, with change vs the previous period
• Today, yesterday, 7/30/90 days, this or last month, this year or all time
• User distribution on a world map
• Recent activity, persons and errors

YOUR INSIGHTS AND DASHBOARDS
• Every saved insight with its own date range: trends, bar charts, funnels, retention and breakdowns
• Your PostHog dashboards imported as they are
• Scrub charts with your finger and see exact values

DRILL DOWN INTO ANYTHING
• Open a person to see every property, distinct ID and event
• Open an event to see all of its properties
• Filter events by name, session, page, country or error
• Infinite scroll through all your data

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your key stays in the iOS Keychain and is sent only to your PostHog host
• Your analytics data goes straight from your phone to PostHog, never to us
• Optional Face ID lock
• No account, no ads

TRY IT WITHOUT A KEY
Tap "Continue with demo data" to explore the app with fictional sample projects.

HOGDASH PRO
The free version includes one PostHog connection and one project. HogDash Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited connections and projects and the Overview mode, which combines projects side by side. No subscription.

HogDash is an independent app and is not affiliated with PostHog Inc. PostHog is a trademark of PostHog Inc.

name: HOLD MY NOTHING
description:
HOLD MY NOTHING is an absurd game about a single dot that talks, takes offence, lies, files official applications and pays taxes on itself. The whole app is a dot and some text.

16 handcrafted levels, then endless random ones: tap the dot, don't touch it, hold it ("hold my nothing"), chase a dot that runs away, type an apology, find the real dot among eight fakes, get form K-1 stamped, leave the app and come back, choose which letter the dot should dot (i / ż / ं / ب / ü), pay dot tax with interest, reconcile a dot split into two, and survive a fake ending.

Haptics, dot confetti after every level, a background that changes colour each level, and text that types itself.

Four languages, each marked with its flag: Polski, English, हिन्दी and العربية (fully right-to-left).

The first 3 minutes of play are free. After that, one-time purchase unlocks infinite nothing forever. No subscription. No ads.

name: Hollr: Family Walkie-Talkie
description:
Hold one button, say it, and let go. Hollr sends your voice to your family on iPhone and Apple Watch, including kids' watches that have no iPhone of their own. It's free for you and one other person, and Hollr Family brings in up to 12.

For the quick things: "I'm outside." "Dinner's ready." "Call me when practice ends."

TALK IN ONE PRESS
• Hold the big talk button, speak, and let go to send. Slide away to cancel.
• Talk to everyone at once, or tap a face to talk to just one person.
• When Hollr is open and you're Listening, new messages play out loud as they arrive. Switch to Muted and they wait for you.
• Changed your mind? Tap Undo right after sending, or delete a recent message you sent, for everyone.

ON THE WRIST
• The Apple Watch app has the same big hold-to-talk button, plus recent messages and reactions.
• A child's watch set up with Family Setup joins with a 6-character code and works without an iPhone.
• Your own watch picks up your family from your iPhone, with no setup.

WHEN YOU CAN'T TALK
• Read a message when you can't listen. Transcripts are made with Apple's speech recognition, on the device where your language supports it.
• React with an emoji instead of replying, including one that means "heard you, can't talk right now."
• React straight from a message alert on your Lock Screen or Apple Watch, without unlocking.

EVERYONE AT A GLANCE
• See who's listening and who's busy.
• Invite your people with a 6-character code or link. They need iCloud, not Family Sharing.
• A Home Screen widget shows how many are listening and what's new. Lock Screen widgets count new messages and open the talk button.
• Add a Talk control to Control Center or the Action button, or ask Siri to "Talk in Hollr." Each one opens Hollr on the talk button.
• The Activity tab shows how your family talked this week.

FREE, THEN HOLLR FAMILY
Your first week after you download Hollr includes everything in Hollr Family. There's no sign-up and no payment, and nothing is charged when the week ends. After that, Hollr stays free for you and one other person in one space.

Hollr Family adds:
• Up to 12 people in a space
• Up to 6 spaces: your family, the grandparents, the carpool, each with its own people and code
• Lock Screen talk: a talk button on the Lock Screen, and in the Dynamic Island on iPhones that have one, powered by Push to Talk
• Quiet hours: pick a time each day when new messages don't play out loud

One plan covers your Family Sharing group. The size of a space comes from the plan of the person who started it.

Hollr Family is an auto-renewable subscription, billed monthly or yearly to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings. Subscribing during the free week starts your plan that day.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No accounts to create, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Voice messages, transcripts and reactions are kept in iCloud and shared with the people in your space. They never go through servers of ours.
• Invite codes and alerts go through Hollr's public iCloud database so they can reach people. They carry things like a first name and the space's name, never audio or anything you said.
• Spaces are invite-only. Report a message or a person from inside Hollr, or block them. A report reaches only us, never includes audio, and includes what was said only if you choose. Blocking stays on your devices, and they aren't told.
• The microphone records only while you're sending a message, for up to 60 seconds.

Talking with real people needs an iCloud account on each iPhone or watch. Not signed in yet? Hollr starts you with a demo family so you can hear how it works.

Terms of Use: https://jasoneliphalet.com/hollr/terms
Privacy Policy: https://jasoneliphalet.com/hollr/privacy

Download Hollr, tap Get started, and say hi to your family.

name: Hometown
description:
Hometown shows you what's happening around you on one live map of your city: markets, shows, trivia nights, gigs, classes and community events.

• See what's on today near you, ranked by what's starting soon and close by.
• Tap any pin for the details, directions in Apple Maps, and who's going.
• Plan a night out: answer three quick questions and Hometown builds a plan from what's on.
• Invite friends, RSVP and chat in one place, with a group chat for every event plus direct messages.
• Scan a poster off a bulletin board and turn it into an event in seconds.
• Host your own event and share it with a link.
• Get a heads-up when friends invite you or plans change.

Hometown is invite-only while we grow. Ask a friend who's on Hometown for an invite code.

Keep it kind: you can report any event, person or message and block anyone, and we review every report within 24 hours.

name: HopeCityClockIn
description:
HC Clock-In is the time clock for contractors who work for Hope City, a church in Houston, Texas. It uses the same accounts, PINs and records as Hope City's clock-in page at clockin.hopecity.com.

Hope City staff set up each contractor's account. To sign in, use the phone number and PIN Hope City gave you. There's no sign-up in the app.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Clock in and out with one tap, with a live timer for your shift and an optional note when you clock out
• See which campus you're at, or that your group can clock in from anywhere
• See when your shift will end if you have a daily hours limit
• Check each pay period: status, hours or days, amount and deposit day
• Send missed shifts when you forgot to clock in, and see your supervisor's decision
• Sign in with Face ID instead of typing your PIN
• Use an iPad as a shared clock-in station at a campus

YOUR PRIVACY
Your location is saved only when you clock in and out, so your supervisor can check shifts away from a campus. It isn't tracked during your shift. If your campus clocks you out automatically when you leave, the app asks your iPhone to watch that campus only while you're clocked in. Face ID is checked by your device; the app never sees your face. Hope City doesn't use your information for advertising and doesn't sell it.

Questions about your hours or pay? Ask your supervisor or the Hope City church office.

name: Hushfall: Mafia & Werewolf
description:
Put the phone in the middle of the table and let it run the night.

Hushfall is an offline narrator for the party games Mafia and Werewolf. One phone hands out the roles, tells every night and every dawn out loud, times the debate and runs the vote - so nobody has to sit out as game master and everybody gets to play.

HOW A ROUND WORKS
- Add the players (5 to 20), pick Mafia or Werewolf and follow the suggested role mix, or build your own.
- Pass the phone around. Each player holds to see their secret role, lets go to hide it, and passes it on.
- Night falls. The narrator wakes each role in turn: a spoken voice, a soft ambient soundscape and big buttons for the choices made in the dark.
- Dawn: the morning report names who is gone. Hunter shots, poison and the lovers' grief are handled for you.
- Debate with a timer you set (1 to 10 minutes), then vote.
- The end recap shows who won, every role and a night-by-night story of what really happened. Play again with the same players in one tap.

TWO GAMES, ONE APP
Mafia: mafioso, townsperson, detective and doctor. Premium adds godfather, vigilante and jester.
Werewolf: werewolf, villager, seer, doctor (protector), witch and hunter. Premium adds cupid, elder and village idiot.

BUILT FOR REAL TABLES
- House rules: reveal roles on death or not, win on parity, no repeat protection, the witch may heal herself.
- No giveaway noises: at night everyone drums softly on the table and the soundscape swells while someone picks up the phone.
- "Call dead roles anyway" keeps everyone guessing: the narrator still wakes roles whose players are already out.
- Big tap targets, haptics, portrait mode, and the screen stays awake during a game.
- Works offline. No account, no ads, no data collected.
- English, German and French: the app follows your iPhone language.

FREE TO START, PREMIUM FOR MORE
Both games and the core roles are free to start. Premium unlocks the extra roles and the extra soundscapes (Storm, Village) as a weekly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Weekly $3.99, yearly $24.99, lifetime $39.99 (US prices; other regions are shown in the app). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Weekly and yearly plans renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your Apple ID account settings.

name: i-Diag - 기기 진단 유틸리티
description:
i-Diag는 내 아이폰이 정상적으로 동작하는지 한 번에 확인하는 기기 진단 앱입니다.
중고 기기를 사기 전, 수리를 받은 후, 혹은 기기가 이상하게 느껴질 때 바로 점검해 보세요.

■ 센서 점검
• 가속도, 중력, 자이로스코프, 자기장, 기압(고도) 센서 값을 실시간으로 확인
• 센서가 정상 반응하는지 기기를 움직이며 바로 테스트

■ 화면 점검
• 화면 주사율(Hz) 측정
• 디스플레이 상태 확인용 화면 테스트

■ 하드웨어 점검
• 카메라 동작 확인과 손전등 켜고 끄기
• 마이크와 오디오 입력 테스트
• 햅틱(진동) 동작 테스트

■ 무선 점검
• Wi-Fi 등 무선 연결 상태 확인

■ 생체인증 점검
• Face ID / Touch ID 사용 가능 여부와 인증 동작 확인

■ 이런 분께 추천해요
• 중고 아이폰·아이패드를 사거나 파는 분
• 액정이나 배터리 등을 수리한 후 정상 동작을 확인하고 싶은 분
• 기기 센서와 하드웨어가 궁금한 분

■ 개인정보
점검 결과는 기기 안에서만 처리되며 외부 서버로 전송하지 않습니다.
카메라, 마이크, 모션, Face ID 권한은 해당 기능을 점검할 때만 사용됩니다.

name: I-Heard: Live Captioning
description:
I-Heard gives you Closed Captions for Real Life — a private, non-fiddly hearing helper and live transcription notepad written on warm, familiar paper right on your iPhone screen.

Built for the deaf, hard of hearing, people with hearing loss, seniors, families, and students who want an effortless speech-to-text companion — whether used on its own or right alongside a hearing aid or cochlear implant — without wearing extra gear or trusting private conversations to the cloud.

NO CLOUD. NO ACCOUNTS. NO SAVED RECORDINGS.
If you distrust cloud AI and internet listening devices, I-Heard was built for you:
• 100% On Your iPhone: All live transcription and voice recognition happen inside your own phone's chip. It works even in Airplane Mode with Wi-Fi and cellular turned completely off.
• Zero Audio Recordings Kept: Spoken words are converted to live captions on your notepad in a split second and the audio is immediately discarded. No voice recordings are ever saved on your phone or anywhere else.
• Nothing Fiddly: No logins, no passwords, no Bluetooth pairing, and no complicated menus. Just open the app and set your phone face-up on the table.

WORKS WHERE HEARING AIDS STRUGGLE MOST

Even the best hearing aids amplify background clatter in noisy rooms. I-Heard works as a visual hearing helper on the table:

• In a Busy Restaurant:
Set your iPhone face-up by your plate. When dining rooms get loud, I-Heard writes down what everyone at your table is saying in large, high-contrast serif print.

• Watching a Movie with Family Who Want to Talk While It Plays:
TV closed captions only show the movie — they don't show what your family is saying on the couch! Set I-Heard on the coffee table during family movie night so you never miss the jokes, questions, and side conversations while the movie plays.

• At a Conference, Meeting, or Doctor's Office:
Place your phone flat on the conference table or desk. Up to 8 different voices automatically get their own ink color (Royal Blue, Forest Green, Terracotta, Plum, and more), and the screen stays awake the entire time.

• At School or in Study Groups:
Set your phone on your desk beside your notebook for live transcription of teachers and classmates as they speak, even when a second person chimes in mid-sentence.

SIMPLE, COMMON-SENSE CONTROLS FOR DEAF, HARD-OF-HEARING & SENIOR USERS

• Clear Labeled Buttons: Every button at the top is clearly labeled in plain English (New Page, Notes, Help, Pause, Settings).
• Tap a Person to Name Them: Tap "Person 1" once to write someone's name (like "Sarah", "Dad", "Dr. Patel", or "This is Me"). Your phone remembers their voice across pages.
• Tap Any Word to Fix It Everywhere: If a family name, medication, or technical term is spelled wrong, tap it once to fix every instance across your notes.
• Pinch to Zoom: Pinch with two fingers to make the words and ruled notebook lines as large as you like (up to 42 pt print).
• Optional Room & Sound Alerts: Turn on visual page alerts for doorbells, knocks, alarms, or dogs barking, plus a soft edge glow showing which direction around the table a voice is coming from.
• Smart Microphone Etiquette: Keeps your screen awake while on the table, continues listening if you lock the screen, and automatically lets go of the microphone the moment you switch to another app.

7 DAYS FREE. NO COMMITMENT.
Start the 7-day free trial with a free ($0.00) Apple purchase confirmation. No subscription and no automatic charge when the trial ends. After 7 days, live captioning and new notepad sessions require the optional one-time Full Unlock purchase ($2.99 once). Your saved transcripts always remain accessible. Restore Purchases is available anytime in the Trial & Unlock sheet.

name: I'm Alive: Daily Safety Check
description:
Live alone? Tap one button a day. If you stop, I'm Alive emails the one person you trust and asks them to check on you.

It's for anyone who lives on their own: after a move, a divorce, a loss, or simply by choice. If something happens, a fall, an illness, an accident, nobody may notice for days. I'm Alive makes sure someone does.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set up in one screen: your first name, one contact's name and email, and how long to wait: 1, 2 or 3 days.
• Each day, open the app and tap the big green button. Or say "Hey Siri, check in with I'm Alive", or tap "I'm OK" right on the reminder without opening the app.
• Miss the time you chose and we email your contact once, in your name, with when you last checked in and a plain suggestion to reach you or ask for a welfare check.
• Check in again and they get an all-clear straight away.

NO SURPRISES FOR YOU
• A daily reminder at the time you pick.
• Warnings 3 hours and 30 minutes before your contact is emailed.
• Going away? Pause until the day you're back.

NO SURPRISES FOR THEM
• After setup, the app gives you a ready-made message so your contact knows what to expect.
• Every email has a link to stop future emails. If they use it, the app tells you so you can choose someone else.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no password. We keep only your first name, your contact's name and email, your time zone and your check-in times. No location, no contacts list, no ads, no tracking. Turn it off in Settings and everything is deleted from our server.

One price, once. No subscription.

I'm Alive isn't an emergency service. If you're in danger, call your local emergency number.

name: iAzkar
description:
iAzkar is a calm, focused companion for the daily remembrance of Allah. It brings together the morning and evening adhkar and other authentic supplications from Hisnul Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), with the Arabic text, an English transliteration and an English translation for each one.

FIVE COLLECTIONS
• Morning Adhkar (Adhkar al-Sabah)
• Evening Adhkar (Adhkar al-Masa)
• Prayer, Wudu and Mosque remembrances
• General supplications
• Benefits of Remembrance: Quranic verses and hadith on dhikr

READ AND RECITE
• Clear Arabic in the Amiri typeface, set right to left
• Transliteration and translation you can switch on or off
• Three text sizes
• The number of repetitions shown for every dhikr
• A tap-to-count counter with haptic feedback that remembers where you stopped
• Previous and Next buttons to move through a collection, with optional auto-advance when a dhikr is complete

BUILD A DAILY HABIT
• Mark a collection as completed for today
• Daily and per-collection streaks
• Statistics: today's progress, adhkar recited, best streak and days active
• Morning and evening reminders at the times you choose

FIND AND KEEP
• Search every supplication in Arabic, transliteration or English
• Bookmark the supplications you return to most
• Export your progress and bookmarks to a backup file and restore it later

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works fully offline: all content is on your device
• No account, no ads, no tracking and no in-app purchases
• Reminders are scheduled on your iPhone; nothing is sent to a server

iAzkar follows your iPhone's light or dark appearance.

Content source: Hisnul Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), compiled by Sa'id bin Ali bin Wahf al-Qahtani.

name: idman: Sports Club Manager
description:
idman is a club management app that lets sports clubs of any discipline run their daily work in one place. It offers dedicated screens for archery, basketball and table tennis, plus shared club-management tools for more than 50 sports, including all Olympic disciplines. Club managers, coaches, athletes, parents and referees each see the screens that fit their role.

CLUB MANAGEMENT (all sports)
• Members, athletes and parents; join requests and approvals
• Parent accounts for young athletes
• Training schedule, attendance and participation tracking
• Fee plans, payments and the club cash book
• Equipment inventory, orders, consumables and fixed assets
• Announcements, notifications and club chat rooms

SPORT-SPECIFIC SCREENS
Archery
• Create competitions, accept applications and assign targets
• Enter scores end by end by placing arrows on the target face (modern and traditional target faces)
• Live results, category rankings, head-to-head and team finals, club medal table
Basketball and team sports
• Team and roster management, leagues, fixtures and standings
• Game score and statistics entry, player and team statistics
• Tactics board
Table tennis
• Competition and match management, set and point entry
• Match and competition results

LIVE TRACKING
• Home-screen widget: Live Score
• Live competition tracking on the lock screen (Live Activity)

STATISTICS AND PROGRESS
• Athlete and club statistics, training and competition comparisons

MORE
• Optional AI assistant (works only with your explicit consent)
• Interface in Turkish, English, German, Arabic and Russian
• In-app help videos
• Explicit consent management; minor athletes are represented by a parent account
• You can delete your account from within the app

Note: sport-specific screens appear according to the sports your club has chosen and your role.

name: Idol Otaku: Auto Calls & MIX
description:
An idol otaku who listens to whatever is playing and shouts MIX and fan calls right on the beat — even on songs he has never heard.

It recreates what veteran fans do at a live show: read the song's structure and drop the classic calls in the right places, using real-time beat tracking and simple rules.

WHEN TO USE IT • Listening to music at home • At karaoke while someone else sings • Whenever you want the live-house feeling on your own

WHAT IT DOES • Follows the beat and the downbeat in real time and shouts exactly on time • Intros and interludes: MIX (Japanese MIX, Ainu MIX, Chikipa MIX) • Verses: PPPH. Pre-chorus: "Oh-ing" leading into "Se-no!" • Chorus: "Hai!" on or off the beat • The word being shouted flashes on screen so you can shout along • On stage, the otaku bows his head for MIX and grins blissfully through PPPH

HOW TO USE

Play a song
Tap START
Once the beat is locked, leave the rest to him
SETTINGS • Call volume • Turn each kind of call on or off • "Hai!" on the beat or off the beat • Timing trim (±50 ms)

GOOD TO KNOW • Calls are shouted in Japanese, just like at a Japanese idol show. • It never uses song titles or lyrics — only the sound. It values fun over precision, so if it misses, laugh along. • Microphone audio is processed on your device only. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent. • Works best with music playing from another speaker or a karaoke system. • Supports tempos from 70 to 200 BPM.

CREDITS Voices:  VOICEVOX:白上虎太郎 (Kotaro Shirakami)

name: If Anything Happens
description:
Some things are easier to say while you can. iah helps you leave a message for the people you love, to be sent only if you stop checking in.

HOW IT WORKS
- Record a video telling them how much they mean to you.
- Add a photo of when you are happiest.
- Tell your story in your own voice.
- Answer the ten questions families most often wish they had asked.
- Choose who receives it, and name one safety person.

Every few months, tap one big heart to say "I am here". That is all. If you ever stop, iah reminds you, then asks your safety person to check on you. Only if nobody can reach you, and after a long waiting period, is your message sent.

BUILT WITH CARE
- Nothing is sent while you are checking in.
- Your safety person can stop a release with one tap.
- The people who receive your message see a gentle warning first, and open it only when they are ready.
- You can change or delete anything, or your whole account, at any time inside the app.

Your message is stored securely and only released as you chose. iah is not a will or a legal document, and it does not replace one.

iah is a one-time purchase for five years, made on ifanythinghappens.app with Apple Pay or card. No subscription, no ads. Tap Get iah in the app to buy, and when you come back iah is ready for you to finish setting up.

Questions? info@ifanythinghappens.app

name: IG Meet
description:
IG Meet is the classroom app for IG HUB. Sign in with your IG HUB account to see your classes and join live with one tap or from a class link.

In class you can:
• See and hear your teacher and classmates with live video and audio
• Share your screen
• Chat with everyone, message your teachers, or send private messages
• Raise your hand and follow along on the shared whiteboard
• Get reminders before your scheduled classes

Teachers get host tools: mute participants, lock the room, Focus Mode, monitor students, schedule classes and end sessions.

Fully available in Arabic (right-to-left) and English, on iPhone and iPad.

name: iKho
description:
iKho là kho đồ cá nhân. Bạn giữ những món đồ hay ho của mình, kèm câu chuyện của chúng, và trao tay cho người khác khi muốn: bán, đấu giá, trao đổi hoặc cho tặng. Hoạt động toàn quốc, giữa cá nhân với cá nhân.

KHO ĐỒ CỦA BẠN
• Lưu mọi món đồ bạn có: ảnh thật, video, tình trạng, mô tả và câu chuyện riêng của từng món.
• Chỉ cần mô tả tự nhiên, iKho giúp gợi ý tên, danh mục và thông số để bạn xem trước khi đăng.
• Món đồ đi theo đồ vật qua nhiều chủ, lịch sử món được lưu lại.

BỐN CÁCH TRAO TAY
• Bán: đặt giá và nhận đề nghị từ người quan tâm.
• Đấu giá: để món đồ tìm đúng giá của nó.
• Trao đổi: đổi món này lấy món khác.
• Cho tặng: trao món đồ cho người cần.

TÌM ĐỒ DỄ DÀNG
• Bảng tin gợi ý theo sở thích và khoảng cách.
• Tìm kiếm bằng câu tự nhiên, lọc theo hình thức, khu vực, giá và tình trạng.
• Xem đồ gần bạn, khoảng cách được làm tròn để bảo vệ riêng tư.

NHẮN TIN VÀ GIAO DỊCH AN TOÀN
• Trò chuyện, thương lượng và chốt giao dịch ngay trong app.
• Gửi ảnh và chia sẻ vị trí khi cần hẹn gặp.
• Nhận thông báo khi có tin nhắn hoặc đề nghị mới.
• Không công khai số điện thoại hay địa chỉ của bạn.

UY TÍN LÀ ƯU TIÊN
• Đánh giá sau mỗi giao dịch.
• Người dùng đáng tin được ưu tiên hiển thị.

iKho không phải chợ rao vặt: món đồ có trong kho trước, giao dịch khi chủ muốn.

Tải iKho và bắt đầu giữ, kể chuyện và trao tay những món đồ của bạn.

name: Image Revive
description:
Give every photo a second life with Image Revive.

Image Revive is a lightweight AI studio for enlarging and cleaning up your images - right on your device. Bring out sharp, natural detail with up to 4x upscaling, and remove distracting objects, or passersby with an intelligent eraser that rebuilds the background for you.

AI UPSCALE UP TO 4X
Enlarge any photo up to 4x with AI models trained to add crisp, believable detail - not just stretch pixels.

8 SPECIALIZED MODELS
- Standard: balanced 4x for everyday photos
- Lite: light and fast

name: iMuninn
description:
iMuninn turns your iPhone into a networked sensor for robotics, research and data collection.

Open the app and your computer can connect to it over the local network (Wi‑Fi or USB). iMuninn streams:

• ARKit 6‑DoF pose with per-frame camera intrinsics, up to 60 Hz • IMU: accelerometer and gyroscope, 100–200 Hz • H.264 video up to 1920×1440 at 60 fps • LiDAR depth with confidence on Pro models, 60 Hz • Device health: thermal state, battery, actual frame rates

On the computer, receive the data with the open-source Python package (pip install imuninn), the C++ library, or the web viewer. Record MCAP files, visualize in Rerun, feed your robot stack, or let an AI agent use it through MCP.

Every setting — sample rates, resolution, lens, exposure, white balance, focus, bitrate — can be changed remotely from the computer. Several computers can connect to the same phone at once.

Privacy: iMuninn has no account and no server and never connects to the internet. Data goes only to computers you connect on your own network.

iMuninn is open source (MIT OR Apache-2.0). Documentation: imuninn.projects.weijinqi.com

name: In-Law Bingo
description:
For the things your family always says... that drive you crazy.

In-Law Bingo turns the family dinner's greatest hits into points. You, your partner, and whoever else is in on it each get a bingo card of the things your in-laws, aunts, uncles and cousins always say. Mark a square when you hear it. First full line wins.

Once someone calls bingo, every card is revealed, along with the lines that came up most. Look back at them on the ride home, and at least some sighs turn into laughs.

HOW IT WORKS
• One person starts a game and picks the cards: In-laws, Thanksgiving, Professors, or a deck of your own.
• Everyone else joins with a 4-letter code or a link. Guests don't need an account, and can even play from their browser.
• Each player gets a different shuffled card on their own phone.
• Tap a square when it's said, and again each time it's repeated. A "+3" on "You look tired" says it all.
• The first full line calls BINGO! and reveals every card.

MADE FOR THE HOLIDAYS
• Feel every mark and every bingo with haptics
• Invite the table from your phone's share sheet
• Add a card mid-game when someone comes up with a new one
• Make decks of your family's classics and share them
• Deal another round for dessert

KEEP IT FRIENDLY
It's for laughing, not for being cruel. A word filter, host controls to remove players or cards, and reporting keep it that way.

Hosting needs a free account (18+); joining doesn't.

Privacy policy: https://inlawbingo.com/privacy
Questions: support@inlawbingo.com

name: InnateSurf
description:
Search spots from the Spots tab, revisit recent spots, or keep favourites close. Browse by region and sub-region, including Maldives atolls. The Map tab shows spots as pins; tap one to open its forecast.

A spot page starts with estimated breaking-wave face height. When confirmed reports support it, you also see an observation-adjusted estimate. Check the model tier, three largest swells, wind and tide. Choose from ten days, then read the day's face-height, tide and wind graphs or the hour-by-hour table. Times use the spot's local 24-hour clock. The satellite map shows the spot pin, and source and model details are available on the page.

Create a spot by placing its pin, then add a name, short description and break type. It starts private. You can request a public listing, which needs operator approval. You can suggest a different name for a spot, with a reason.

Add photos of a spot's wave. You see your upload immediately; other members see it after operator review. Approved photos can be reported to gabe@innatetocreate.com. Log the face height or flat conditions you saw, with optional notes. Your own logs appear in Log and can wait on your phone until a connection returns.

Device location is optional. Nearest-first ordering uses it on your phone. Accounts need operator approval. Delete your account in Settings. Privacy details: https://innatesurf.com/privacy.

name: Innovvision
description:
Your INNOVV dash cam, right on your iPhone.

Innovvision connects to your INNOVV camera over its own Wi-Fi so you can watch both cameras live, find and replay any recording, save the moments that matter, and change every camera setting. No internet connection is needed to use your camera, and it keeps recording the whole time.

Works with the INNOVV K3, K5, K6/RC6 and K7. The app recognises your model as soon as it connects.

CONNECTIONS
Open the app and join your camera's Wi-Fi manually the first time. After that it on your next use it connects while the opening video plays. It remembers your camera, so most days you're connected before you've even looked at the screen.

LIVE VIEW
See what the front and rear cameras see right now: front, rear, or both together. Ideal for lining up your cameras after fitting them.

EVERY CLIP, SORTED
Recordings are grouped the way your camera saves them:
• Continuous Videos: normal loop recording
• Parking Videos: saved when the camera felt a bump while parked
• Accident Videos: saved after a sudden jolt, such as hard braking
• Protected Videos: clips you kept with the button so loop recording won't erase them
• Pictures: photos taken with the button

Front and rear recordings are shown together as one recording, with thumbnails in a list or grid. Lists open instantly because the app reads the card ahead while you connect.

PLAY FRONT AND REAR
Watch the front or rear camera on its own, side by side, or picture-in-picture. Drag the slider and the video follows your finger. Pinch to zoom in on a number plate or road sign. Turn your iPhone sideways for full screen. Play on into the next clip without stopping.

SEE WHERE IT HAPPENED
For clips with GPS, follow the route on a map with the nearest town names.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save clips and photos to the INNOVV album in Photos, the same album the INNOVV app uses. Export front and rear together as one video, side by side or picture-in-picture, ready to share.

CARD READER SUPPORT
No Wi-Fi? Put the camera's microSD card in a card reader on your iPhone and browse, play and save exactly as you would from the camera.

TIDY UP
Delete continuous clips you don't need, one by one or by date and time range, front, rear or both. Two confirmations keep you from deleting by accident, and the newest recording is always protected.

EVERY SETTING
Change everything the camera offers, laid out the way INNOVV owners know:
• Wi-Fi name, password and band
• Video resolution, bitrate and image orientation
• Loop recording length, microphone volume
• Date, time, speed and GPS watermarks, plus your own watermark text
• Parking monitor and G-sensor sensitivity
• Set the camera's clock from your iPhone
• Card space, format and card status
• Firmware and lens versions
If the camera is recording, the app asks before pausing it to change settings, and starts it again when you're done.

DIAGNOSE
Having trouble? Describe the problem and Diagnose emails INNOVV Support everything they need: your camera's settings, clip counts and dates for each folder, plus any screenshots and video frames you choose to add. You see the whole email before it's sent, and your Wi-Fi password is never included.

HELP AND SUPPORT
Built-in help explains every screen and every setting, with a link to the user manual and support page for your model. The Support screen gathers INNOVV's website, forum, email, Facebook and YouTube in one place.

PRIVACY
The app collects no personal data, needs no account and shows no ads.

Requires an INNOVV K3, K5, K6/RC6 or K7 dash cam.

name: Interactive Biochemistry LTE
description:
Interactive Biochemistry brings together thirteen programs from the Educational Technology Laboratory (LTE), Institute of Biology, University of Campinas (Unicamp, Brazil), to study and teach biochemistry at university level: experiment simulators, animations of cellular processes and interactive books, used for years in courses of Biology, Medicine, Pharmacy, Nutrition, Physical Education and other health sciences.

BIOENERGETICS
• Electron transport chain — choose substrates and inhibitors and follow electrons and protons.
• COM — an oxygraph on screen: mitochondria, substrates, inhibitors and uncouplers.
• Glycolysis in action and Krebs cycle in action — build the pathways reaction by reaction.

METABOLISM AND INTEGRATION
• Metabolism in exercise and fasting — where the energy comes from in each situation.
• Nutrition — nutrients, energy and food.
• Insulin and leptin — obesity and hormonal signaling.
• Muscle contraction — from muscle to myofilament, with proteins in 3D, the animated sarcomere and the biochemistry of exercise.

PROTEINS AND ENZYMES
• eProteins — amino acids and real proteins in 3D, structure and function (content in Portuguese).
• Enzymes — structure, function and kinetics.
• Enzyme kinetics — a virtual lab with test tubes and a stopwatch.

SIGNALING AND OXIDATIVE STRESS
• Cyclic AMP — the pathway from receptor to cellular response.
• Free radicals — reactive oxygen species and antioxidant defenses.

FOR STUDENTS AND TEACHERS
• Works offline on iPhone and iPad.
• In Portuguese, English and Spanish.
• Continue where you left off and mark your favorite programs.
• "For teachers" sheet in each program, with suggested classroom use.
• Share a program with your class through social networks or e-mail.
• No sign-up, no ads and no data collection.

The programs are also available in the browser, on LTE-IB-Unicamp's BIOCHEMISTRY 30 years website.

name: Interleaf: Reading Journal
description:
Interleaf is a quiet home for your reading life.

Remember the book, the page you reached, and a thought you want to keep. A quick entry when you close your book turns small reading moments into a story of your own.

LOG A LITTLE READING
Choose a book and enter your starting and ending pages. Add minutes, a time of day, or a note if you like. No timer to start and no target to meet. A record button in the tab bar keeps your next entry close at hand.

MAKE YOURSELF A BOOKSHELF
Keep books you haven't started, books in progress, and finished books together. Search by title or author, revisit each book's reading history, and mark it finished with a completion date.

LOOK BACK AT YOUR DAYS
Explore your reading calendar, add past sessions, and edit existing entries. See your progress through a yearly book wall, monthly page totals, reading time, and reading streaks.

KEEP YOUR RECORDS CLOSE
No Interleaf account is required. Your library stays on your device by default. Choose optional iCloud sync, export a complete library backup, or import and export reading sessions with Excel.

MAKE ROOM FOR YOUR OWN RHYTHM
Choose a color palette, app icon, and paper texture. Enjoy light and dark appearances, optional reading reminders, and a Face ID app lock.

No race. No rankings.
Just a little space for reading.

Support: https://interleaf-app.github.io/interleaf-legal/en/support/

name: InvestoriaX

name: Inviato – regia remota

Inviato è il telecomando e il collegamento remoto per chi fa radio con MB Studio. Dal telefono o dal tablet ti colleghi alla regia, vedi cosa è in onda e intervieni in diretta, come se fossi in studio.

IN ONDA, A COLPO D'OCCHIO

• Livello del microfono sempre visibile, anche fuori onda

PARLA E VAI IN ONDA

• Vai in onda: il tuo collegamento diventa l'elemento in onda
• Fine e seguente, Seguente, Chiudi collegamento: un tocco e la regia riparte

PLAYLIST SEMPRE SOTTO CONTROLLO

PENSATA PER IL CAMPO

Inviato si collega direttamente a MB Studio, con l'indirizzo, la porta e la password che usi per i collegamenti remoti. Non ci sono account né server intermedi: l'audio e i comandi vanno solo alla tua regia.

Inviato è un'app indipendente, compatibile con MB Studio. Non è affiliata a MB Soft né da essa approvata. MB Studio è un marchio dei rispettivi proprietari.

name: IP Tools: Ping & Traceroute
description:
IP Tools is a fast, no-nonsense network toolkit for iPhone and iPad: ping, traceroute, and a visual BGP map that shows how the Internet reaches any IP address, prefix or AS number, with your own route drawn in blue.

PING
• Ping any IPv4 or IPv6 address or hostname
• Live round-trip time chart
• Min / avg / max, jitter and packet loss at a glance
• Choose how many pings (5 to 100, a custom count, or until stopped), interval, timeout and packet size

TRACEROUTE
• Trace the route to any host, hop by hop, over IPv4 or IPv6
• Reverse-DNS hostnames and response times for every hop
• See which network (ASN) each router belongs to: spot where your ISP hands off to a transit provider or CDN
• Ping or map any hop with one tap

BGP MAP: AS PATH VIEWER
• Enter an IP, prefix or AS number and get a top-to-bottom graph of the AS paths down to the origin AS
• Your path in blue: the networks your own traffic crosses, measured from your device, drawn right on the map
• Built from live routes seen by RIPE RIS route collectors around the world: a looking glass in your pocket
• See upstreams, transit providers and peers, with line thickness showing how many routes use each link
• Tap any AS for its name, role and every path through it
• Accessible list view for VoiceOver users

MADE FOR NETWORK PEOPLE
Network engineers, sysadmins, NOC staff, ISP support, gamers chasing lag, and anyone curious about how the Internet is wired together.

PRIVATE AND OPEN SOURCE
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected
• Ping and traceroute run entirely on your device
• BGP and ASN data comes from the public RIPEstat API by the RIPE NCC
• MIT-licensed source code on GitHub: github.com/ahmadrezaei/ip-tools

Supports Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, iPad split view and keyboard shortcuts.

name: iQuran - القرآن الكريم
description:
رفيقك اليومي لقراءة القرآن الكريم والاستماع إلى التلاوات والأذكار.

name: iShopCenter+
description:
iShopCenter+ is a sales viewer for businesses using the ShopCenter POS system.
Head-office and store managers can check sales for every store, wherever they are.

DAILY
- Real-time figures during the day and closed figures after closing
- Sales, customers and average spend compared with last year or budget
- Sales by store in a chart and a list

MONTHLY
- Month-to-date totals and a daily trend chart
- Tap a day in the chart to see its breakdown
- Switch between by-day and by-store views

CATEGORY
- Drill down from divisions to see the sales mix
- Daily or monthly trend charts, by sales amount or quantity
- Filter by period and store

CONVENIENCE
- Switch tax and service charge included/excluded in Settings, without reloading
- Multiple accounts

- Shows the last fetched figures when offline

name: ISO Week Calendar
description:
ISO Week Calendar shows today's week number in the compact "Wyyww.d" format.

Example: W2644.5 means week-based year 2026, week 44, Friday.

FORMAT
• yy – week-based year (last two digits)
• ww – week number (01–53)
• d – day of week (Mon=1, Tue=2 … Sun=7)

WEEK NUMBERING RULE (ISO 8601)
• Weeks run from Monday to Sunday.
• Week 1 (W01) is the first week containing at least 4 days of the new year — the week that contains January 4.
• Around New Year the week-based year can differ from the calendar year
  (e.g. 2025/12/29 (Mon) is W2601.1, 2027/01/01 (Fri) is W2653.5).

CALENDAR WITH WEEK NUMBERS
• A Monday-first month calendar below today's week number
• Week numbers (W45 etc.) at the left of every row
• Scroll up and down through 10 years in each direction; tap Today to jump back
• Saturdays and Sundays in red
• Tap a date to open it in the Calendar app

WIDGETS
• Home Screen: small, and medium (shows this week from Monday to Sunday)
• Lock Screen: inline and rectangular
Widgets switch automatically at midnight (timing is managed by iOS).

PRIVACY
• Works completely offline
• No personal data collection, no ads, no analytics
• No permissions required

Calculated using the date, time and time zone set on your iPhone.

name: JBS Studio
description:
JBS Studio is the private workspace for the Jack Bosch content team. It brings ideas, scripts, the content calendar, video review, publishing and results into one place, with AI employees working alongside the people on the team.

- Chat as a team, with voice notes, and talk with 15 AI employees

Each person sees their own work, their own notes and what they can approve. Anything that uses a person's likeness waits for that person's approval.

name: Jef for Lawyers
description:
Jef records your meetings on your iPhone and gives you a clear summary within minutes.

By lawyers, for lawyers: Jef takes the notes while you focus on your client.

• Start recording in one gesture, from the app, Siri, the Action button or Control Centre.

name: JoinPDF - Merge PDF & Photos

Merge PDFs and photos into one PDF. Every page sits on one board, so you see the result before you save.

PLUS

TIMED MOCK EXAMS

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE

FREE AND PRO

name: Juju: Explore & Share Journeys

name: K2 Wallet
description:
K2 Wallet là sổ thu chi cá nhân dành cho người Việt: ghi nhanh, dễ hiểu, dữ liệu do chính bạn giữ.

GHI MỘT KHOẢN CHỈ VÀI CHẠM
