• Thông báo của K2 Wallet có sẵn nút danh mục: nhấn giữ thông báo, chọn danh mục là khoản vào sổ.
• iOS 17 trở lên: tự ghi khi thanh toán bằng Apple Pay, từ tin nhắn và email của ngân hàng.
• Hoặc ở màn biên lai của ứng dụng ngân hàng, bấm Chia sẻ → K2 Wallet: ứng dụng đọc chữ ngay trên máy, lấy số tiền, nơi chi, ngân hàng và ghi vào sổ.
• Nhận diện thông báo của nhiều ngân hàng và ví điện tử phổ biến tại Việt Nam; chọn nguồn tiền một lần, các lần sau tự nhận đúng tài khoản.
• Tự học nơi chi: lần sau cùng nơi chi, khoản tự vào đúng danh mục. Khoản chưa chắc nằm ở mục Chờ xác nhận, chạm một lần là xong.
• Một khoản về qua nhiều đường không bị ghi hai lần. Bỏ qua giao dịch không thành công, tin OTP, tin khuyến mãi; hỏi lại khi có khoản nghi trùng.

QUỸ CHUNG CHO VỢ CHỒNG (KHÔNG BẮT BUỘC)
• Mỗi người vẫn giữ sổ riêng. Khi cần, bật thêm một quỹ chung để cả hai cùng thấy: ai góp, quỹ chi gì, còn bao nhiêu.
• Ghi khoản "ứng giùm" khi một người tự trả trước cho việc chung; quỹ ghi nợ tới khi trả lại, trả một phần cũng được.
• Hai điện thoại cập nhật cho nhau bằng tin nhắn đã mã hóa do chính bạn gửi – không qua máy chủ, không cần đăng nhập.
• Khoản góp quỹ và tiền ứng được ghi là chuyển tiền trong sổ riêng, không tính chi tiêu hai lần.

BÁO CÁO RÕ RÀNG
• Tiền đang có = tiền mặt + ngân hàng − nợ thẻ.
• Thu, chi, còn lại từng tháng; chi theo danh mục kèm tỷ lệ và so với tháng trước; biểu đồ 12 tháng; xem riêng sổ cá nhân, quỹ chung hoặc cả hai.
• Ngân sách tổng và theo danh mục, nhắc khi chạm 80% và khi vượt.
• Thẻ tín dụng: biết nợ bao nhiêu, hạn trả ngày nào; trả thẻ được ghi là chuyển tiền, không tính chi hai lần.
• Khoản định kỳ (tiền nhà, điện nước, học phí) tới ngày là nhắc.
• Xuất Excel trình bày sẵn, có trang tính riêng cho quỹ chung.

DỮ LIỆU CỦA BẠN
• Dữ liệu lưu trên điện thoại của bạn; không có máy chủ lưu dữ liệu người dùng, không quảng cáo, không theo dõi.
• Không lưu số tài khoản, số thẻ đầy đủ hay số dư ngân hàng.
• Khóa ứng dụng bằng mã PIN 6 số, mở bằng Face ID hoặc Touch ID; che nội dung khi chuyển ứng dụng; tùy chọn ẩn số tiền trên thông báo.
• Sao lưu lên Google Drive của chính bạn khi muốn; khôi phục khi đổi máy.
• Tùy chỉnh giao diện Sáng / Tối và màu theo sở thích.

K2 Wallet do Sổ Tay Tài Chính và Công ty TNHH Kế Toán Bảo Lộc đồng phát triển. Góp ý và hỗ trợ: info@ketoanbaoloc.com.

name: Kakei Garden
description:
Kakei Garden is a calm puzzle game about water. Turn the bamboo flumes on their little wooden trestles, join them into one channel, and lead spring water from the stone cistern to every thirsty corner of the garden.

When the water arrives, the garden answers: a wooden tub fills, a rice paddy shines, irises bloom, a mill wheel starts to turn and its lanterns light up, koi gather in the pond.

A YEAR OF GARDENS
• 96 gardens on 12 floating islands, one for every month of the year
• Cherry blossom in spring, lotus ponds in summer, red maples in autumn, snow and hot springs in winter
• Deer in the meadows, snow monkeys in the steaming pool, cranes over the islands
• The last island climbs a spiral hill to a pagoda, and the year ends with a temple bell

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
• No timer, no rush: think as long as you like
• Some gardens give you only so many turns, or a cistern that slowly runs dry — or switch on "Relax mode" in the settings and every garden is relaxed
• Undo and gentle hints whenever you need them
• Stars for elegant solutions, if you like a challenge

MADE TO RELAX
• Soft low-poly worlds in warm light and long shadows
• A quiet score and the sounds of water, wind and wood
• One-finger play, landscape, works offline

After the year is complete, a second year with new gardens and an endless Zen garden open up.

name: Kandil: Namaz ve Zikir
description:
Kandil, günlük ibadetini sade ve huzurlu bir düzende takip etmen için hazırlandı.

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ VE EZAN
• Türkiye'deki her ilçe için Diyanet ayarlarıyla hesaplanan vakitler, internet olmadan da çalışır
• Vakitten önce hatırlatma ve vakit girince bildirim; Ney, Kandil, Huzur gibi sesler
• Uygulama açıkken vakit girince ezan
• Yurt dışında bulunduğun ülkenin yaygın hesap yöntemi

KIBLE
• Konumuna göre kıble yönü ve pusula
• Pusulanın manyetik sapması otomatik düzeltilir

KUR'AN-I KERİM
• Arapça metin ve Türkçe meal
• Ünlü kârilerden ayet ayet dinleme, meal dinleme
• Cüz cüz okuma, kaldığın yerden devam, yer imleri
• Okuma takibi ve hatim planı

ZİKİR
• Gül, Menekşe, Lale ve daha fazla temalı zikirmatik
• Tam ekran modu, hedef seçimi (33, 66, 99, sınırsız)
• Zikir çektikçe çiçekler açar ve bahçene tohum kazanırsın

BAHÇEM
• Kıldığın her namaz ortadaki çiçeği büyütür; 15 vakitte çiçeğin olgunlaşır
• Olgunlaşan çiçekleri bahçene yerleştir, çiçek defterini doldur
• Bahçeni bir kartla paylaş

DAHA FAZLASI
• Günün ayeti, günün duası ve günün hadisi
• Dualar, namaz tesbihatı, abdest ve namaz kılınışı
• Dini günler ve hicri takvim
• Ana ekran ve kilit ekranı widget'ları
• Çocuklar için öğrenme köşesi
• Açık ve koyu tema

GİZLİLİK
Kandil hesap açmanı istemez. Konumun yalnızca telefonunda, vakit ve kıble hesabı için kullanılır; hiçbir sunucuya gönderilmez.

Kandil ücretsizdir. Dilersen uygulama içinden gönüllü destek olabilirsin; destek hiçbir özelliği kilitlemez veya açmaz.

name: Kennan
description:
Kennan helps you understand the colors in your wardrobe. Photograph a garment beside known color references, zoom in to sample the fabric and reference patches, and estimate the fabric’s color.

ZOOM AND SAMPLE
Pinch to zoom and drag to pan for precise placement. Add several samples of the same fabric color and of each reference color; Kennan averages each group. Adjust or remove individual samples before saving.

LOOK UP YOUR REFERENCES
Search the offline reference library by paint name, swatch code, or brand. Review the source and select the matching patch without entering HEX values. You can also label a reference and enter a known sRGB color manually.

BUILD YOUR WARDROBE
Save garments with a photo, category, calibrated color estimate, and the references used. Search your collection by name or color and edit or delete entries whenever you like.

COMPARE OUTFITS
Select pieces you might wear together and see a color-harmony score with an explanation. Scores describe color relationships; they are a guide to experimenting with your wardrobe.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
Kennan processes images and stores your wardrobe locally. No account, advertising, or subscription is required. Color lookup works offline.

GET THE BEST ESTIMATE
Use matte reference patches under the same even light as the fabric. Match the exact reference code and avoid shadows, glare, metallic surfaces, folds, and seams. Published digital colors can differ from physical paint chips and packaging. Kennan provides a color estimate, not a laboratory measurement.

name: KeptPagor
description: How much of the last book you loved could you explain today? For most readers, a few weeks later, not much. KeptPagor is a reading companion that turns what you take from a book into short recall sessions, and shows you, book by book, how much of it stays.

name: KezvoriTulmash
description: A dragline excavator calculator for earthworks and mining industry job sites. Calculate boom reach and dump height, bucket load and swing, cycle time and cycles per hour, production in loose and bank measure, wire pull and reeving, ground bearing pressure under the machine, and engine power requirement. Plan and optimise dragline excavator lifts and digging.

name: KickoffMe: Idea to Plan
description:
Have a business idea but don't know how to explain it to a developer?

KickoffMe asks you nine clear questions, one at a time, in plain language: your idea, your user and their problem, the one core action, the data involved, how it could make money, and any constraints. No jargon, no long forms.

After the last answer, KickoffMe drafts a business plan (with SWOT, competition and risks tables and a roadmap) and a builder brief: a functional specification with use cases, a PRD, a BRD, a design direction and a plain-language checklist of things worth sorting out early.

You get one free plan every week (one per install), with limited capacity. KickoffMe is free and has no purchases. No account is needed. Saved plans stay on your device.

Please note: your answers are sent to an AI service to write the draft. The result is an AI-generated starting point, not legal, financial or professional advice, and it should be reviewed by whoever builds your app.

name: KidneyPaw
description:
KidneyPaw helps you care for a cat with chronic kidney disease (CKD), one day at a time.

• Plain-English lab results — see what creatinine, SDMA, phosphorus and more mean, and how they change over time
• Medication & fluid reminders — every dose, every bag, with who gave it
• Daily log — appetite, weight, vomiting, litter box, blood pressure
• Food phosphorus — compare cat foods on a dry-matter basis
• "Is my cat okay?" — a calm guide that tells you when to call the vet
• One-page vet report — share trends with your veterinarian
• Family & sitter sharing — everyone sees the same log

KidneyPaw does not diagnose or treat. Always follow your veterinarian's advice.

KidneyPaw Premium: monthly ($4.99), yearly ($34.99 with a 7-day free trial), or lifetime ($79.99). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://kidneypaw.pages.dev/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://kidneypaw.pages.dev/privacy/

name: Kids Remote Link
description:
Kids Remote Link is the child-side companion to Kids Remote. A parent sets up the family and links this phone with a QR code.

See your jobs, mark them complete and track your points towards payday. Parents manage the family from Kids Remote.

When a parent enables supported Banjo AI features, linked-phone text can be processed by xAI using the family’s API key. Separate xAI usage charges may apply.

Free during launch. A paid subscription may be required later. You won’t be charged unless you choose to subscribe.

Setup guides and help: https://help.kidsremote.app

name: KikenNova 危険物乙4 一問一答・模擬試験
description:
KikenNova（キケンノバ）は、危険物取扱者試験 乙種第4類の対策アプリです。法令・物理化学・性質消火の 3 科目を、テキスト・一問一答・模擬試験で一つのアプリで。弱点の分析と合格予測が、次に何をやるかを決めてくれます。法令は 2026 年 4 月 1 日時点の内容です。

■ 今日の学習（弱点の分析と合格予測）
一問一答の正誤と模擬試験の採点結果を単元ごとに集め、正答率の低い単元を弱点として出します。復習の期限が来た問題（忘却曲線: 1 → 3 → 7 → 14 → 30 日）、弱点の単元、まだ解いていない問題を 20 問に組んだ「今日の学習」をホームに用意します。本番の科目ごとの問題数に出来を当てはめた合格予測の点も毎日更新されます。

■ テキスト（33 本）
単元ごとに、要点・数字の表（指定数量・保安距離・保有空地・届出の期限など）・「ここが出る」を短くまとめました。読んだらそのまま単元の問題へ進めます。

■ 一問一答（427 問）
・危険物に関する法令（183 問・13 単元）: 危険物の定義と類別、指定数量と倍数、製造所等の区分、許可・届出・承認、免状と保安講習、保安監督者、予防規程と定期点検、保安距離と保有空地、製造所等の基準、貯蔵・取扱いの基準、運搬と移送、消火設備・警報設備・標識、措置命令
・基礎的な物理学・化学（127 問・10 単元）: 燃焼の理論、燃焼の形態、引火点・発火点・燃焼範囲、消火の理論、熱、静電気、物質の変化、原子・分子・物質量、酸・塩基・腐食、有機化合物
・性質・火災予防・消火（117 問・10 単元）: 第1〜6類の概要、第4類の共通性質、火災予防、消火方法、特殊引火物、第一石油類、アルコール類、第二石油類、第三石油類、第四石油類・動植物油類
本番と同じ 5 肢択一のほか、○× と計算（指定数量の倍数・熱量・物質量）も。間違えた問題とブックマークで、苦手なところだけを繰り返せます。

■ 模擬試験（本番形式・15 回分）
法令 15 問・物理化学 10 問・性質消火 10 問の 35 問、120 分。本番と同じく科目ごとに 60% 以上で合格の目安です。筆記と同じ流れで解き、自動で採点して科目ごとの合否を出します。全問の正解と解説で見直せ、その回で落とした単元はテキストにつながります。
問題冊子・答案用紙（マークシート）・採点表を印刷して紙で解き、答えを入れて採点することもできます。

■ 通知
毎日のリマインダー（時刻を選べます）は、その日の復習の数と弱点の単元を本文にします。本番の日を入れると、ホームに残り日数が出て、1 週間前・3 日前・前日・当日にも知らせます。

■ 記録
合格予測（科目ごと）、弱点の単元、科目ごとの正答率、模擬試験の点の推移、日ごとの学習量を残します。

■ 料金
無料: 各科目の最初の 20 問と最初の単元のテキスト、模擬試験の第1回（印刷・紙の採点を含む）。弱点の分析・合格予測・通知は無料で使えます。
すべての問題（買い切り ¥980、1 回払い）: すべての一問一答・テキスト・模擬試験。今後の版で増える問題も追加料金なしで使えます。
・サブスクリプションではありません。自動更新はなく、お支払いは 1 回だけです。
・機種を変えたときは、同じ Apple ID で「購入を復元」を押すと引き継げます。

■ 安心してお使いいただくために
通信をしません。アカウントも広告もありません。記録はこの iPhone の中だけに残り、通知もこの iPhone の中で組みます。

■ 問題について
問題と解説はすべて当社の書き下ろしで、実際の試験の過去問ではありません。法令は 2026 年 4 月 1 日時点の消防法・危険物の規制に関する政令・規則にもとづいています。改正があれば更新します。誤りに気づかれた場合は、サポートページからお知らせください。

危険物取扱者試験は一般財団法人消防試験研究センターが実施する国家試験です。本アプリは同センターの公式アプリではなく、承認や推奨を受けたものではありません。

利用規約（EULA）: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
プライバシーポリシー: https://ars-sys.github.io/kikennova-legal/

name: Kinda Sus – Imposter Game
description:
Everyone knows the word. Except one.

Kinda Sus is the party game where you pass one phone around. Everyone gets the same secret word, except the imposter. Say one word each, suspect each other and vote out whoever is a little too sus.

HOW TO PLAY
• Add everyone who plays, 3 to 20 people.
• Pass the phone around. Each player holds the card to see their word in secret.
• The imposter gets no word, just a vague hint if you want.
• Say one word each, talk and vote. Get it right and you win. Otherwise the imposter wins.

MADE FOR PARTIES
• One phone is enough. No internet, no accounts.
• One or more imposters, and a timer if you like.
• Whoever was the imposter won’t be it again straight away.
• English, Swedish, German, Spanish, French and Arabic.

KINDA SUS PRO
Pay once, no subscription:
• All categories: food, animals, places, sports, countries, free time and new ones as they arrive.
• Own word: write the word yourselves.
• Chaos: a secret number of imposters.
• All sus: sometimes everyone is the imposter, and nobody knows.

Free: the categories Things at home and Jobs.

No accounts, no ads and no tracking. Everything stays on your phone.

Privacy policy: https://kindasus.pages.dev/integritet?sprak=en

name: Kinh Lăng Nghiêm Giảng Giải
description:
Đọc Kinh Lăng Nghiêm bằng Hán văn cùng âm Hán–Việt và tìm hiểu lời giải thích tiếng Việt.

• Đọc kinh theo quyển; chọn Hán văn, âm Hán–Việt hoặc hiển thị cả hai. Điều chỉnh cỡ chữ, phông, nền và kiểu đọc.
• Chạm chữ Hán để xem âm đọc và các nghĩa từ điển hiện có. Các nghĩa là thông tin tra cứu chung, không mặc định là nghĩa trong câu kinh.
• Đọc sách giải thích của Hòa thượng Tuyên Hóa, bản dịch Thích Nhuận Châu. Tìm trong Hán văn hoặc lời giải thích; mở đoạn từ kết quả tìm kiếm.
• Lưu vị trí đọc, dấu trang và ghi chú trên thiết bị.
• Nghe các bản thu từ kênh Trạch Pháp Nhãn; tải bài nghe về thiết bị để nghe không có mạng sau khi tải. Với những bản và đoạn có mốc, mở sách ở chỗ đang nghe hoặc chọn nghe đoạn sách.

Nội dung đọc và tra cứu được đóng trong ứng dụng. Tải âm thanh cần kết nối mạng và dung lượng trống.

Nguồn chính: CBETA T19n0945; Kinh Lăng Nghiêm Lược giải của Hòa thượng Tuyên Hóa, Thích Nhuận Châu dịch; Từ điển Phật học Đạo Uyển, Unihan và CC-CEDICT cùng các nguồn tra cứu khác. Xem “Nguồn và giấy phép” trong ứng dụng để biết nguồn và điều kiện sử dụng từng bộ dữ liệu.

name: Kinship: Family Calendar
description:
Keep family plans together with Kinship, a shared calendar for the everyday moments that matter.

PLAN TOGETHER
Create a calendar, add your family members, and keep appointments, school activities, outings, and reminders in one place. Switch between week and month views and filter plans by person.

FROM PAPER TO PLANS
Photograph a school announcement or choose an image to find possible dates and events. Review and edit every suggestion before adding it to your calendar. Text recognition happens on your iPhone; photos are not uploaded to the sharing service.

SHARE ONE CALENDAR
Invite your family with a calendar link. Everyone with the link can add and edit events in the app or browser. Changes sync online, while saved plans and offline edits stay available on your device. Keep your calendar link within your family.

REMINDERS AND WIDGETS
Choose a reminder before an event and see today’s upcoming plans with small and medium Home Screen widgets.

No account is required. Create a new calendar or join an existing one to get started.

name: Kiosk to Kingdom
description:
Start with one kiosk in Lagos or Accra and build a 12-floor kingdom.

Kiosk to Kingdom is an idle tycoon game set in two of West Africa's busiest cities. Tap to serve your first customers, open new floors and hire the managers who keep the hustle going while you are away.

GROW YOUR TOWER
- Twelve hand-drawn floors, from a pure water stand to Kingdom HQ
- Hire a manager for each floor and let them run it
- Keep earning while you are away

RIDE OUT CITY LIFE
- Power cuts, traffic, okada rushes and market days
- Spray time, a daily lucky spin and daily rewards
- Aunties, elders and cousins with something to say

MAKE THE BIG MOVE
- Sell up and move to the next city for Clout that multiplies your income
- Your kingdom keeps every city you build in
- Your title comes from the best floor you have ever reached

NO ADS
Kiosk to Kingdom has no ads. Rewards cost diesel, which refills over time, and gold can be earned in the game or bought in the Shop.

Questions or ideas? support@kiosktokingdom.com

name: Kirya
description:
Kirya è l'app riservata ai clienti e ai collaboratori di Kirya Technologies.
L'accesso avviene con le stesse credenziali della piattaforma Kirya: l'app non permette di registrarsi e gli account sono creati da Kirya.

PER I CLIENTI
• Riepilogo immediato: importo da pagare, fatture scadute e prossima scadenza
• Tutte le fatture e i preventivi, con dettaglio delle righe e PDF scaricabile
• Avanzamento dei progetti e delle attività in corso
• Documenti personali (contratti, fatture, preventivi) sempre a portata di mano
• Avvisi per nuove fatture, scadenze e preventivi in attesa

PER IL TEAM KIRYA
• Fatturato, incassi, crediti aperti e scaduti con confronto sul periodo precedente
• Elenco clienti con fatturato, ricorrente mensile e posizioni aperte
• Scheda cliente con grafico storico, contratti, fatture, preventivi e attività
• Attività con scadenze e ritardi, da spuntare direttamente dal telefono
• Analisi: ricavi e costi mensili, ripartizioni per cliente e categoria, conto economico e stato patrimoniale

FILTRI E SICUREZZA
• Filtri globali per periodo, cliente, stato delle fatture e ricerca libera
• Sblocco con Face ID o impronta digitale
• Tema scuro e chiaro
• Connessione cifrata, sessioni con scadenza, blocco dopo tentativi di accesso errati
• Ogni utente vede esclusivamente i propri dati

L'app è distribuita su invito: per ricevere l'accesso contatta contact@kirya.ch.

name: Klara SFI – Lär dig svenska
description:
Viktigt: Klara SFI är en självständig övningsapp från Micro App Sweden AB. Appen är inte knuten till någon skola, kommun eller Skolverket. Övningsproven är inte de officiella nationella proven i SFI.

Lär dig svenska i din egen takt. Klara SFI är för dig som studerar svenska för invandrare (SFI) och vill träna på ord, meningar och läsförståelse mellan lektionerna.

Fyra kurser med 15 lektioner vardera
• Kurs A – Dina första ord
• Kurs B – Vardagen i Sverige
• Kurs C – Svenska i vardag och arbetsliv
• Kurs D – Svenska för delaktighet och vidare studier

Kurs A och B ger övning på nivå A1–A2. Kurs C och D ger övning på nivå A2–B1. Nivåerna beskriver appens övningsinnehåll.

Så fungerar appen
• Välj rätt svar, lyssna, skriv, ordna ord och matcha ordpar.
• Träna läsförståelse med texter och frågor.
• Lyssna på inspelat ordljud och uppläsning med enhetens talsyntes.
• Repetera ord med intervall som hjälper dig att minnas dem längre.
• Sätt ett dagligt mål och följ hur många dagar i rad du övar.
• Slå på en valfri daglig påminnelse som lokal notis på din enhet.
• Gör tidsbegränsade övningsprov i kurs C och D.
• Spara dina framsteg med ditt konto och synkronisera dem mellan enheter.

Språkstöd
Gränssnitt och stöd för ordens betydelse finns på svenska, engelska, dari, arabiska, somaliska och tigrinja. Övningarna tränar svenska.

Gratis att ladda ner, utan reklam
Hela kurs A är gratis. Med engångsköpet ”Lås upp alla kurser” får du tillgång till kurs B, C och D. Ingen prenumeration.

Konto krävs. Logga in med e-post eller med Logga in med Apple. Dina framsteg sparas med kontot.

Källor och officiell information
För officiell information om SFI och nationella prov, se Skolverket: https://www.skolverket.se/
Appens lektioner och övningsprov är fristående övningsmaterial. Vänd dig till din skola för information om dina studier och prov.

Support: support@microappsolution.com
Integritetspolicy: https://microappsolution.com/privacy/klara
Användarvillkor: https://microappsolution.com/terms/klara

name: Klorsematsa
description:
Klorsematsa: Valo Peli on rauhallinen ja selkeä logiikkapeli. Edessäsi on valoruudukko. Jokainen kosketus vaihtaa ruudun ja sen naapurien tilan. Tee ruudukosta samanlainen kuin tavoitekuvio ennen kuin siirrot loppuvat.

NELJÄ LUKUA, 60 TASOA
• Ensivalo – 4 × 4 ruudukko ja Risti-sääntö
• Revontuli – isompi 5 × 5 ruudukko
• Vinot säteet – Vino-sääntö: kosketus vaihtaa kulmanaapurit
• Kivikko – kivet, jotka eivät koskaan syty, ja sääntö, joka vaihtuu tasosta toiseen

TÄHDET JA PISTEET
Jokaisella tasolla on ihannemäärä siirtoja. Ratkaise taso ihanteessa ja saat kolme tähteä. Säästetyt siirrot tuovat lisäpisteitä, ja paras tuloksesi tallentuu.

VIHJE, KUN JUMITTAA
Vihje näyttää yhden ruudun, joka on vielä kosketettava. Se maksaa vähän pisteitä, ja sitä voi käyttää kerran tasoa kohden.

SKANDINAAVINEN MINIMALISMI
Tumma pohjoinen sävy, hehkuvat turkoosit valot ja kevyt tuntopalaute jokaisesta kosketuksesta. Kaikki grafiikka on piirretty suoraan sovelluksessa.

REILU PELI
• Ei mainoksia eikä sovelluksen sisäisiä ostoja
• Ei rekisteröitymistä, toimii ilman verkkoyhteyttä
• Ei tietojen keräämistä – edistyminen pysyy laitteellasi

name: Knowliva
description:
Knowliva helps you keep what you learn instead of losing it across scattered notes and forgotten flashcards.

Many people study with loose files, random notes, and cards that never return at the right time. A few days later the same material feels new again. Knowliva brings topics, notes, flashcards, and a revision schedule together in one offline iPhone app. There is no account and no internet requirement. Your library stays on this device.

How to use Knowliva.
Open Home to see your daily learning goal, cards waiting for review, and recent activity. Create a topic for a subject you are studying. Write notes with a title and as much detail as you need. Pin the notes you want to keep at the top. Make a flashcard deck, then add a question on the front and an answer on the back.

When you are ready to practice, start a review. Read the question, flip the card, and choose Again, Hard, or Know It. Knowliva updates the next review date at once. Weaker cards come back sooner. Stronger cards wait longer. You can also open a deck and study it whenever you want.

Set a daily target and watch progress on Home. Open Insights to see real totals for topics, notes, flashcards, reviews, study streak, and weekly activity. New users see empty states until they add their own material. Nothing is invented.

Use Library to search, sort, and filter by topic. Optional daily reminders can prompt you to study. Permission is requested only if you turn reminders on. From Settings you can change your goal, theme, reminder time, and clear local data.

Who it is for.
Knowliva is for students, exam candidates, language learners, teachers building personal decks, and anyone who wants a private place to organize knowledge and review it with a simple routine.

name: Koi Keeper: Cozy Idle Pond
description:
Every koi is completely one of a kind. Like a fingerprint, their pattern, colors and fins are theirs alone, even among koi of the same family. Bring an overgrown garden pond back to life, and attract wild koi from up the stream to come visit! Win them over, name them, and grow a collection like no one's ever seen!

• BRING THE GARDEN BACK. Net the neglect, clear the fallen branches and freshen the water. The more beautiful your garden, the rarer the koi who come to see it!
• COLLECT 31 VARIETIES. Kohaku, Showa, Asagi and the rest, with rare forms to discover, and no two koi the same.
• RAISE AND NAME THEM. Feed them by hand, earn their trust and watch them grow, some into giants.
• LEARN THEIR SECRETS. The closer you grow to a koi, the more you learn about them, from their temperament to their hidden grade. Fill your Koi-Dex and learn about real koi!
• PLAY YOUR WAY. Over 75+ perks to choose from and level up! YOU shape how YOUR pond grows.
• MAKE THE GARDEN YOURS. Dig the pond, upgrade your equipment, plant trees, ferns, and more to create your dream pond!
• VISIT FRIENDS. Add friends, visit their ponds, feed their koi!
• AT YOUR OWN PACE. The pond carries on while you’re away, so there’s always something new when you come back. No ads, no energy timers, nothing to buy. Play as a guest, or sign in to play across devices.

Genji-san is waiting for you!
Accounts and Friends are for ages 16 and up.

name: Konstruksi Field
description:
Konstruksi Field adalah aplikasi resmi operasional lapangan PT Leo Jaya Konstruksi Indonesia untuk memfasilitasi Project Manager, Site Supervisor, Pelaksana, dan Mandor dalam mengelola kehadiran presisi berbasis geofencing GPS, memverifikasi anggota tim kerja, dan memonitor realisasi pekerjaan harian proyek secara real-time.

Fitur Utama Operasional Lapangan:
• Absensi GPS Geofencing: Check-in dan check-out mandiri dengan validasi koordinat GPS radius proyek (999m) disertai bukti swafoto (selfie) terenkripsi.
• Verifikasi Kehadiran Tim: Antrean verifikasi kehadiran harian pekerja lapangan, mandor, dan subkontraktor dengan aksi persetujuan cepat.
• Manajemen Tim Lapangan: Pantau jumlah personil aktif di dalam lokasi proyek, daftar hadir, dan koordinasi instan via panggilan WhatsApp.
• Realisasi Task & S-Curve: Catat volume realisasi harian, unggah dokumentasi foto progres berkala, berikan penilaian mutu/waktu/K3/kerapian, dan pantau kurva S deviasi jadwal.
• Notifikasi & Instruksi: Dapatkan pemberitahuan penugasan baru, revisi pekerjaan, dan catatan persetujuan langsung dari Project Manager.
• Keamanan Akun & Kepatuhan Store: Dukungan penuh iPhone & iPad, sesi terenkripsi, verifikasi OTP WhatsApp, dan penghapusan akun mandiri.

Dikhususkan untuk tim internal dan personil lapangan resmi PT Leo Jaya Konstruksi Indonesia.

name: KouNeyrr
description:
▸ In a shoe shop in Milan
The box says EU 42.5. Is that you? Open SHOES, choose Men, and read every label at once: US 9 · UK 8.5 · EU 42.5 · JP 27, with the foot length (26.2 cm) the chart is built on. Tap any label to read from it instead.

▸ At an online checkout
The dress lists IT and FR sizes, and you think in UK. GARMENTS covers women's tops and dresses, men's suits and jackets, and men's shirt collars, so a single size line shows US, UK, EU, FR, IT and JP side by side.

▸ The night before a wedding abroad
Need a jacket or a shirt in a hurry? Suits are matched by chest, shirts by neck, so you can start from the tape measure when the label is no help.

▸ Choosing a ring as a surprise
RINGS lines up US, UK/AU, EU/ISO and JP sizes with the inner diameter in millimetres, the number a jeweller trusts.

▸ Shopping for the kids
Kids' shoes have their own wall. In FAMILY, give each person a fitting card and add the sizes that fit them, with which chart and label they came from. Next time you are in a shop, their sizes are one tap away in your bag.

▸ Back home
The menu keeps a Wishlist of pinned sizes, Recently tried, your home sizing choices (centimetres or inches) and a tape-measure guide for feet, chest and bust, and collar.

A straight answer about sizes
KouNeyrr uses standard conversion charts, and it treats your body measurement as the ground truth. Real brands vary, sometimes by half a size or more, so when the label and the tape measure disagree, trust the tape and try it on. The menu explains why labels disagree.

Your family's cards stay on this iPhone. No account, no sign-in, no signal needed.

name: Kovi Fencing
description: Review fencing bouts from your match videos. Import a video from your photo library and select the fencer to review. Explore score changes, key exchanges, and training suggestions. Replay the full bout or jump to individual touches.

name: KRemote Mobile
description:
KRemote is a native SSH terminal, RDP remote desktop and SFTP client for iPhone and iPad. No account, no relay, no cloud in the middle: the app connects to the servers you add, and to nothing else.

SSH TERMINAL
A real PTY, not a command runner. htop, vim, tmux and full-screen applications work, colours and resize behave, and the terminal is drawn by a proper emulator rather than a text view.

BECOME ROOT
One action in the session menu sends sudo -S -i with the stored password. With no stored password it sends plain sudo -i and lets sudo ask, so you are never retyping a password on a phone keyboard.

SNIPPETS
Save small scripts with named parameters. Values are asked for before each run and are never remembered from the previous one, because the answer to "which server" changes. A confirmation sheet shows exactly what will run.

REMOTE DESKTOP (RDP)
The desktop takes the whole screen and understands touch: tap to click, long press for right click, two fingers for middle click. The keyboard row adds Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Escape, Tab and the arrow keys with sticky modifiers, and a hardware keyboard sends real scancodes. The clipboard works in both directions, and the desktop is sized to your panel rather than scaled up from a smaller one.

FILES OVER SFTP
Browse the same host, preview text and images, upload from the Files app, download and hand a file to another app. Rename, delete and create folders.

SAVED CONNECTIONS
Folders with inherited defaults, so a group of servers shares a user name, port or key without repeating it. Search, duplicate, and import an mRemoteNG .confCons file.

PRIVACY
No account. No analytics. No crash reporting. No advertising. Passwords are encrypted with a key held in the iOS Keychain and never written to the connection file. Deleting a connection deletes its password.

Built for people who already know what SSH and RDP are, and want them to work properly on a phone.

name: Kude
description:
Kude reúne en un solo sitio todo lo que necesitas para preparar tus clases.

• Cursos, asignaturas y unidades con sus materiales: PDF, presentaciones, enlaces y notas.
• Planificador semanal y horario, con tus clases en el calendario.
• Libretas para escribir a mano con Apple Pencil: muchos tipos de papel, marcadores, imágenes y exportación a PDF.
• Anota tus PDF y proyéctalos en clase mostrando solo la página, sin los botones.
• Exámenes y rúbricas listos para imprimir.
• Semáforo de ruido para la clase, con retos, ruleta de premios y tarro de canicas por grupo.
• Sincronización opcional con tu iCloud privado entre iPad, iPhone y Mac.

Sin cuentas, sin anuncios y sin seguimiento: tus datos son tuyos.

El semáforo de ruido muestra decibelios aproximados y orientativos; no es un sonómetro certificado.

name: Kuhn Sinks
description:
Kuhn is the app of Kuhn Seramik, makers of handmade vessel sinks in İzmir, Turkey.

SEE A KUHN SINK IN YOUR BATHROOM
• Five handmade sink models: Lapis, Vital, Runde, Helm and Gondola.
• Pick a color or pattern and see it in place on a photo of your own bathroom.
• Every sink is a countertop vessel sink with an unglazed natural clay exterior and a drain cap in the same color.

REDESIGN YOUR BATHROOM WITH AI
• Redesign the whole room with a Kuhn sink, or redesign any bathroom with any sink.
• 40 ready styles, from natural to modern, or create your own.
• Change only what you want: walls, tiles, floor, vanity, mirror or fixtures.
• Hold the image to compare before and after. Ask for another idea in the same style.

KEEP AND SHARE
• Your designs are saved on your phone in My Designs.
• Save them to your gallery or share them.

REQUEST A QUOTE
• Send your chosen model and color to Kuhn Seramik by WhatsApp or email.

FREE TO TRY
5 free designs with Kuhn sinks and 1 free design with any sink. After that, design packs are available as an in-app purchase. Placing a Kuhn sink in your photo and requesting a quote are always free.

No account needed. No ads.

name: Kur'an-ı Kerim: Türk Mushafı
description:
Kur’an-ı Kerim’i Türkiye’de basılan mushaflardaki imlâ ile okuyun; meali, kelime anlamlarını ve tilâveti aynı ekranda bulun. Uygulama ücretsizdir; reklam, uygulama içi satın alma ve izleme aracı içermez.

KUR’AN-I KERİM
• Türk mushafı imlâsıyla sakin ve okunaklı okuma ekranı
• Diyanet İşleri Meali ve Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır Meali (bir kez indirilir, sonra internetsiz çalışır)
• Kelime kelime sözlük: kelimeye basılı tutun; anlamını, okunuşunu ve kökünü görün
• Abdülbasit Abdüssamed, Mişari Raşid el-Afasi, Mahmûd Halîl el-Husarî, Abdurrahman es-Südeys ve Suud eş-Şureym tilâvetleri; okunan kelime ekranda takip edilir
• Yer imleri ve kaldığınız yerden devam
• Açık, sepya ve koyu okuma temaları, ayarlanabilir yazı boyutu

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ
• Türkiye’deki 973 ilçe için namaz vakitleri ve sıradaki vakte geri sayım
• Vakit bildirimleri; geleneksel makamlarda hazırlanmış bildirim sesleri
• Ana ekran widget’ları: sıradaki vakit, bugünün vakitleri, günün ayeti, günün hadisi

GÜNLÜK İBADET
• Bugün ekranı: sıradaki vakit, günün ayeti ve hadisi, dinî günler, hava durumu
• Virdlerim: günlük okuma ve zikir programınız, hatırlatmalar (ücretsiz hesapla)
• Zikirmatik
• Hatim planı: bitiş tarihini seçin, her gün okunacak cüzü görün
• Ramazan: imsakiye, fitre ve fidye tutarları, kaza orucu takibi

TOPLULUK HATMİ
• Açılan hatimlerden cüz alın, okuduğunuzu işaretleyin
• Katılmak için ücretsiz bir hesap yeterli; dilerseniz adınızı gizleyebilirsiniz

KİTAPLIK
• Riyâzü’s-Sâlihîn, Delâilü’l-Hayrât, Evrâd-ı Kudsiyye ve Hizbü’l-Bahr
• Arapça asıllarıyla, Kur’an ile aynı okuma ekranında

GİZLİLİĞİNİZ
• Kur’an, meal, namaz vakitleri ve kitaplık hesap açmadan kullanılabilir; hesap yalnız topluluk hatmi ve Virdlerim için gerekir.
• Okuma konumunuz, yer imleriniz ve ayarlarınız cihazınızda kalır.

Bu uygulama bağımsız, gönüllü bir çalışmadır; Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı ile resmî bir bağı yoktur. Kullanılan meal, sözlük, ses ve yazı tipi kaynakları uygulamadaki Hakkında ve Lisanslar bölümlerinde belirtilmiştir.

name: Kurdele: Gift Wishlist
description:
The right gift, one link away. Collect everything you wish for in one list, share the link, and let friends quietly claim a gift so nobody buys the same thing twice.

ADD FROM ANY STORE
• Copy a product link in any store app and paste it in Kurdele: the name, picture and price fill in by themselves
• Or browse a store inside the app and tap "Add to list" on the item you like
• Not in a store? Take a photo and give it a name
• Add notes like size or colour, and mark what you really want

SHARE ONE LINK
• Send your list over WhatsApp, iMessage or Instagram
• Friends do not need the app: the link opens in any browser
• Whoever taps "I'll get it" claims the gift, and everyone else sees it is taken

THE SURPRISE STAYS SAFE
You never see what was claimed. Friends see each other, you just open your presents. Turn on "Show me what is taken" if you would rather know.

A LIST FOR EVERY OCCASION
Holidays, birthdays, weddings, a new home, a baby on the way, graduation, or things you will buy one day. Give each list a colour and a date; a countdown reminds friends when it is.

FRIENDS' LISTS
Lists sent to you open in the app too and stay there, so the gifts you claimed are always in one place.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Only people with the link can see a list. Delete all your data from Settings with one tap.

Terms of use: https://metehanbicer.com/apps/kurdele/terms/
Privacy: https://metehanbicer.com/apps/kurdele/privacy/

name: Lanka Explorer: Sri Lanka Map
description:
Ayubowan! Vanakkam! Welcome to Sri Lanka.

Lanka Explorer puts the whole island on one beautiful shaded-relief map. Pinch and zoom anywhere, tap a province to fly in, and every place opens with a photo and the essentials you need to plan your trip.

EXPLORE REGION BY REGION
• All 9 provinces and 25 districts on a smooth, native map
• 211 hand-picked places, from Sigiriya and Ella to quiet beaches and ancient monasteries
• Photo labels on the map; nearby places group together and open up as you zoom in

FIND YOUR KIND OF SRI LANKA
• Beaches, heritage sites, wildlife parks, hill country, nature, culture and cities
• Best time to visit, time needed and a local tip for every place

DISCOVER SRI LANKA
• Heritage, faiths and visitor numbers, with sources
• Travel basics: ETA visas, Tourism Police, the two monsoons, money

PLAN YOUR TRIP
• Save the places you love; no account needed, everything stays on your phone
• Travel kit with Sinhala and Tamil phrases and tap-to-call emergency numbers

Every map, photo and page works offline.

Photos from Wikimedia Commons contributors (credited in the app). Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors and geoBoundaries; relief from Copernicus GLO-30. Always check opening hours, fees and seasonal closures locally before you travel.

name: Lapio · Sight Reading Trainer
description:
Lapio teaches you to read notes on the instrument you play. A note appears on a page of sheet music, you play it, and Lapio listens through the microphone.

What you play shows up on the staff in pencil. Hold the right note and it turns to ink. At the end of a session you get the whole page back, with the notes you missed circled in pencil, ready to go over again.

A session lasts three to five minutes, twelve notes by default. Notes you miss or answer slowly come back more often. No timer, no score, no streak to protect, no notifications.

5 instruments
Piano, guitar, flute, clarinet and alto sax. Each one starts with three to five notes around a landmark you already know (the open strings on a guitar, for example). Then the range grows: more of the staff, ledger lines, sharps and flats, short tunes from traditional songs.

Treble and bass clefs. The grand staff for piano.

On clarinet and alto sax you read the written note and Lapio checks the note that sounds. Guitar is written an octave above its sound, as in real scores.

Play the right note in the wrong octave and Lapio tells you which octave you played. If the room is too noisy, it says so.

Without your instrument
Answer by tapping the note names, with sharp and flat when the session has them. The mode is on the home screen and one tap away during a session. Handy on the train or late at night, when you can't play out loud.

Also in the app
A tuner with the note name in large type and the offset in cents. Reference A adjustable from 430 to 450 Hz. MIDI keyboards for piano, wired or Bluetooth. Note names as C D E, do re mi, or with H. Light and dark appearance, VoiceOver reads each note on the staff, Dynamic Type.

Privacy
The microphone only opens during a session or in the tuner. Nothing is recorded or sent. No account, no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases. Lapio collects no data.

One price, everything included.

name: Laptower: Race Timing
description:
Laptower is a timing screen for single-seater racing fans who want more than the result.

FOLLOW IT LIVE
During race weekends, follow practice, qualifying, sprints and races with a full timing tower: positions, gaps to the car ahead or the
leader, lap and sector times, mini-sectors in purple, green and yellow, tyre history and pit stops. Flags, safety cars and red flags light up the header
the moment they happen. Running behind your stream? Set a TV delay of up to a minute and the timing stays in sync.

REPLAY ANY SESSION
Every session since 2023 can be replayed exactly as it unfolded. Play, pause, jump and speed up to 16×, with safety car, red-flag and
yellow-flag periods marked on the timeline. Watch overtakes happen as rows slide into place, and follow knock-out zones in qualifying.

KNOW WHAT'S GOING ON 
• Race Control messages, with new ones highlighted 
• Penalties, investigations and track limits on each driver's row 
• Team radio with playback and on-device transcripts 
• Track a driver to keep them highlighted throughout the session

DIG INTO THE RACE 
• Lap chart and lap times
• Tyre strategy and tyre degradation per stint 
• Race pace, overtakes and pit stop rankings 
• Championship standings with points progression 
• Season stats: fastest pit stops, positions gained, qualifying head-to-heads

BUILT FOR THE PHONE
A dark, compact timing layout that fits the whole field, a landscape mode with Race Control alongside, and smooth performance during
busy sessions.

Laptower is free, has no ads and no accounts, and collects no personal data.

Laptower is an unofficial fan app. It is not associated with, affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Formula One World Championship Limited, Formula
One Management, Formula One Licensing B.V., the FIA or any team. Historical data via OpenF1 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).

name: Lavha – Video Editor
description:
I couldn't find a small, fast video editor that simply shows the audio waveform, so I made one.

Lavha is about 1 MB. It opens videos from Photos instantly and shows the waveform under the timeline by default, so you can see exactly where speech starts and stops and cut right there.

TRIM
• Drag the start and end handles over thumbnails and the waveform
• Hold a handle to zoom in and trim frame by frame
• Trim-only saves copy the original video data: no re-encoding, no quality loss, done in about a second

CROP
• Freeform crop, or Original, Square, 9:16, 16:9 and 4:5
• Exported at the cropped size

SAVE
• Save Video replaces the original in Photos (Photos keeps it, so you can revert)
• Save Video as New Clip keeps the original untouched
• Share straight to any app

ALSO
• Plays sound even when your iPhone is on silent (toggle it off any time)
• Works great with screen recordings
• No account, no ads, no watermark

name: Laya: Personal Health Coach
description:
Laya is a personal coach for your body. It reads what your watch and apps already save to Apple Health and shows the impact of everything you track: how you slept, how you are recovering, and how your days line up with how you feel.

TODAY
One clear read each morning: last night's sleep, your recovery against your own usual, and what your body is ready for.

SLEEP
Stages, timing and consistency, night by night, with the patterns that move them.

BODY
Resting heart rate, HRV, breathing and temperature against your own normal range, plus your body age and what changes it.

ACTIVITY
Steps, workouts and heart load in one place, from any app that writes to Apple Health.

YOUR LIFE
Log caffeine, alcohol, a late meal or how you feel, and Laya shows what each one does to your sleep and recovery over time. Pattern, not proof.

WORKS WITH WHAT YOU WEAR
Apple Watch and any watch, ring or app that saves to Apple Health. Everything is worked out on your iPhone.

LAYA PLUS
Deeper patterns, experiments, yearly reports and more. Monthly, yearly or lifetime, with a 14-day trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage them in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Laya is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

Terms of Use: https://layahealth.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://layahealth.app/privacy

name: LED Scroller: Scrolling Text
description:
Turn your phone sideways and scroll your message like a real LED sign.
Hold it up at a concert, tell a driver their headlights are off, or greet someone at the airport — in letters big enough to read from far away.

■ Open it and play
The first screen is the text field. Type, tap Play, and your message scrolls full-screen in landscape. No sign-up.

■ Sharp characters, even complex ones
Most LED banner apps draw text with coarse on/off dots, which blurs detailed characters. This app uses about 28 dots per letter and dims each dot by how much of the stroke it covers, so complex Japanese, Chinese, and Korean characters stay readable.
Still messages wrap automatically and use a finer grid when they get long.

■ Made for switching at concerts
Your messages glow on the home screen, ready to go. Tap one to play it, then swipe left or right to switch to the next. The order never changes while you play, so you can follow your plan in a dark venue.

■ Make it yours
• Colors: red, orange, yellow, lime, green, sky blue, blue, purple, pink, white, rainbow
• Motion: scroll or still
• Speed and blinking
• Dot size: large, normal, fine
• Font: sans or rounded

■ Great for
• Concerts and fan signs
• Telling a driver "Your headlights are off"
• Thanking a driver who let you in
• Airport and station pickup signs
• Quiet places like hospitals and front desks
• Birthday surprises

■ While playing
• Switches to full-screen landscape automatically
• Keeps the screen awake at full brightness (you can turn this off)
• Pause, change the speed, or move between messages

Your messages are saved only on this iPhone.

Note: Some venues don't allow light-up items. Please follow the venue's rules.

Terms of Use: https://tsuzukit.com/ledbanner/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://tsuzukit.com/ledbanner/privacy.html

name: LetterLattice
description:
Το LetterLattice είναι παζλ λογικής όπου γεμίζεις ένα τετράγωνο με γράμματα και ακολουθείς τις υποδείξεις στα περιθώρια.

Κάθε σειρά και κάθε στήλη πρέπει να περιέχει όλα τα γράμματα του παιχνιδιού χωρίς επανάληψη. Τα γράμματα στο άκρο του πλέγματος είναι υποδείξεις: δείχνουν το αλφαβητικά πρώτο γράμμα κατά μήκος της αντίστοιχης γραμμής ή στήλης.

Διάλεξε μέγεθος από 6×6 έως 11×11, ή δοκίμασε το παζλ της ημέρας. Πάτα κελί, διάλεξε γράμμα από τη λωρίδα στο κάτω μέρος της οθόνης. Αν εμφανιστεί κόκκινο περίγραμμα, υπάρχει διπλότυπο.

Κράτα στατιστικά νικών και καλύτερων χρόνων ανά μέγεθος. Διάβασε τους κανόνες και τις οδηγίες στην εφαρμογή, όλα στα ελληνικά.

Δωρεάν. Χωρίς λογαριασμό. Για iPhone, iOS 15 και νεότερα.

name: LetterMelt: Word Art Maker
description:
Turn a word you love into art.

A name. A hometown. A tiny inside joke. LetterMelt layers the letters of your word in one place, turning familiar shapes into something worth a second look. Where letters overlap, the artwork grows stronger. The lighter edges let you see through the stack.

Start small. Hi, LM and YES are great places to begin.

MAKE IT YOURS
Explore five fonts, from Thin to Papyrus, and seven color palettes. Keep it simple with Ink or mix things up with Neon, Prism, Dusk, Garden, Tide and Ember. Choose a cream, white or midnight background, switch to uppercase, and adjust how much of each letter shows through. Your artwork responds as you make changes.

WATCH IT COME TOGETHER
Tap Replay to start with a blank canvas and add each letter in order. Export a looping GIF to share the same little reveal.

TAKE YOUR WORD WITH YOU
Save or share a JPEG, a PNG with a transparent background, or an animated GIF. Every export is the full artwork, with no watermark.

SMALL APP. ROOM TO PLAY.
LetterMelt is free, with no ads, purchases or account required. Artwork is made on your device, and your last design is saved locally so you can pick up where you left off. LetterMelt does not collect your data.

Made for iPhone and iPad by Stoked Logic.
Small apps. Thoughtfully made.

name: LicenceTaxi.fr – Licences taxi
description:
LicenceTaxi.fr, la marketplace des licences taxi en France, dans votre poche.

• Consultez toutes les annonces de licences taxi (ADS) à vendre, en location-gérance, en location-vente, ainsi que les remplacements, véhicules et équipements taxi
• Recherchez par ville, département ou référence, filtrez par budget et triez par prix

name: Lift Balance: Workout Log
description:
Most workout logs tell you what you lifted. Lift Balance tells you what is falling behind.

It puts your push, pull and legs on one scale, shows which area lags, and suggests the extra work for next week. You review every change before it goes into your plan.

ONE SCALE FOR YOUR WHOLE BODY
• Compares push, pull and legs as bench-press equivalents
• Marks any area more than 10% behind your strongest
• Shows how each number is calculated, in plain language
• 12-week trend, with 30-day and 90-day windows
• Strength levels from novice to elite, based on bodyweight

A PLAN THAT RESPONDS
• Answer a few questions to get a plan for 2 to 6 days a week
• Works for a full gym or dumbbells at home
• Suggested changes for weak areas, ready to apply or undo
• Suggested weights based on what you did last time
• Edit any day: exercises, sets and rep ranges

BUILT FOR THE GYM FLOOR
• One tap per set, with large buttons for between sets
• Rest timer with a Live Activity and a notification
• Plate calculator for kg and lb
• Swap or reorder exercises in the middle of a workout
• Resume a workout if you leave the app

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Personal records after every workout
• 16-week training calendar and full history
• Charts for estimated 1RM, top set and volume on every exercise
• Library of 84 exercises, searchable in English and Chinese

SHARE AND TAKE IT WITH YOU
• Share cards for your balance and your workouts
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Import workouts from a CSV exported by other workout apps
• Export to CSV or JSON at any time

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• The app makes no network connections
• Everything stays on your iPhone

Strength ratios and levels are approximate references for training. Lift Balance does not give medical advice.

name: Ligature
description:
Ligature är en svensk bänk för reguljära uttryck. Du skriver mönstret, lägger under en text och ser vad som fastnar.

På bänken provar du uttryck mot egen text. Träffar markeras i löpande stycke, grupper listas, och du kan ersätta eller spara mönstret.

På hyllan finns färdiga mönster för svensk vardag: postnummer, personnummer, organisationsnummer, mobilnummer, registreringsskylt, bankgiro, belopp, IBAN, e-post och mer. Varje kort visar ett exempel som passar och ett som inte passar.

Kontrollsiffran räknar steg för steg om personnummer eller organisationsnummer har rätt kontrollsiffra enligt Luhn. Teckenguiden visar punkt, stjärna, grupp och andra symboler med levande exempel.

I övningen skriver du uttryck som måste hålla för flera rader i följd. Sparade mönster ligger kvar till nästa gång.

Ingen konto. Gratis. Kräver iPhone med iOS 15 eller senare.

name: Lilt: Read Aloud PDF & Books
description:
Lilt reads your documents aloud — PDFs, EPUB books, notes and anything you paste — in a natural voice that runs on your iPhone. It works offline, never uploads your files, and never counts your characters.

READS LIKE A PERSON, NOT A PDF
• Two-column papers are read one column at a time
• Running headers, page numbers and footnotes are skipped
• Words hyphenated across lines are joined back together
• Tap any paragraph to jump there; the spoken word is highlighted as you go

LISTEN YOUR WAY
• Speeds from 0.75× to 3×
• Every voice installed on your device, including Apple's free Enhanced and Premium voices
• Keeps playing with the screen locked, with Lock Screen controls
• Every document remembers exactly where you stopped

FREE
• Unlimited listening — no minutes, no character cap
• PDF, plain text, RTF and pasted text
• 3 new documents a month
• Never any ads

LILT PRO — $4.99 ONCE
• Unlimited imports
• EPUB books (DRM-free)
• Export a document to an M4A audio file
• Sleep timer

Great for study notes and textbooks, research papers, work reports, long articles and language practice.

Private by design: your documents stay on your device and are spoken by Apple's on-device voices. No account, no ads, no subscription. Family Sharing included.

Questions or ideas? antogs99@gmail.com

name: Lindenhaus Player
description:
Lindenhaus Player is a film magazine in a cosy cinema – run by box cats. No account, no ads, no tracking.

• The Box: films and series to discover – critics' favourites, Oscar winners, fresh from the cinema, family evenings, film series and hidden gems
• The Box Office: what the film world reads about right now, country by country – charts with covers and trends, and the star show with the faces of the week, their busy paws, paw grades and blockbusters
• Whisker Buzz: everything about a title in one card – the story, critic scores, box office, Oscars, who is in it, the trailer, and where to watch it
• Sneak Purrview: trailers of films just out and coming soon, in three picture palaces
• The Cat Foyer: who in the film world has a birthday today and which films opened on this day
• Star Sniffer: follow an actor, actress or director from film to film
• Free TV: the free live streams of public broadcasters and YouTube live channels, right in the app
• Pawprints: send a film tip to a friend
• Meet the staff of the Lindenhaus Cinemas – Prof. Purr, Glamourpuss, Clawdio, Sir Hisskins, Zoomie, Pip and Katja
• Dark cinema look, choosable colours and cat styles; made for iPhone and iPad; English and German

Film facts come from Wikipedia and Wikidata, reading trends from Wikimedia, series posters from TVmaze, trailers through YouTube's own player. Lindenhaus Player does not sell or provide films.

name: Lindoku Duel: 3D Sudoku Cube
description:
Lindoku is Sudoku on a cube. Spin it, follow the glowing lines around its corners, and fill every side.

THE RULES IN ONE BREATH
Every side holds 1 to 9 once. Every line wraps across three sides and holds 1 to 9 once too. A short guided lesson turns a flat Sudoku into the cube right before your eyes, so you'll be playing in about a minute.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Start a duel for 2, 3 or 4 players and share a 6-letter code. Friends can join from this app or from any web browser at lindoku.com, so everyone can play, whatever phone or computer they have. Players take turns on one shared cube:
• Every correct number scores its value.
• Finish a side and everyone's numbers on it pay again.
• Gold squares, anchor 1s and the most of a line earn bonuses.
• A wrong guess costs points and your turn.
Plan moves ahead while you wait, send quick reactions, and pick a turn timer of 1, 2 or 3 minutes, or none.

A NEW CUBE EVERY DAY
The Daily gives everyone the same puzzle. Solve it and post your time to the leaderboard.

COZY BY DESIGN
• Easy, Medium and Hard cubes whenever you want one
• Hints, undo, pencil marks and no timer unless you turn it on
• Three looks: Dusk, Morning and Cat
• Soft sounds, and a sleepy goldendoodle who wanders the stand

No account needed. Pick a name when you want to duel or post a Daily time, and play.

name: Literica
description:
Literica e un joc de cuvinte în limba română, liniștit și prietenos.

Găsește 5 cuvinte în grila de litere și treci la nivelul următor. Apeși literele în orice ordine, de oriunde din grilă. Cuvintele lungi aduc mai multe puncte, iar cuvântul de lungime maximă aduce un bonus și o mică sărbătoare.

• Cuvântul zilei: un cuvânt nou în fiecare zi, cu indiciu, același pentru toți. Ai 3 minute și o singură încercare.
• Patru ritmuri: fără grabă, ușor, mediu sau greu.
• Tot mai greu pe măsură ce urci: cuvinte mai lungi, mai puține litere, puncte înmulțite.
• Clasament pentru fiecare ritm, cu toți jucătorii.
• Ajutor și Amestecă, pentru când te blochezi.
• Litere mari, contrast puternic și memento zilnic opțional.
• Peste 100.000 de cuvinte acceptate, din Lista Oficială de Cuvinte a limbii române.

Fără reclame. Fără cumpărături. Fără cont și fără e-mail.

name: Litmus NVR
description:
Search hours of CCTV footage in seconds. Connect the cameras you already have, and Litmus NVR organizes every person and vehicle so you can find them by appearance, face, or plain words.

Get started at litmusnvr.com.

name: Live Tape Lite Remote
description:
Live Tape Lite Remote turns your iPhone or iPad into a remote for Live Tape Lite – show playback for walk-in music, breaks, intros and music for the programme.

Leave the computer at the desk and still run the music: from the stage, from front of house or from backstage.

• Play / Pause, Stop, Fade out, previous and next song
• The same playlist and times as on the computer: what is playing, time left, what comes next
• Choose the next song, skip a song or move songs
• Hold a finger on a song: Stop after this song
• Pair once with a PIN – next time it connects by itself, also after a Wi-Fi dropout
• Switch between several devices with Lite, for example a main and a backup computer
• Works on the venue Wi-Fi or over your iPhone's personal hotspot – no internet needed
• Large buttons and a dark screen made for a dark stage

Requires Live Tape Lite on a Mac or an Android tablet – free for 14 days at live-tape.com. The remote is free.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Live Translation by DimX
description:
Live Translation helps you communicate across languages with three simple tools.

TALK
Share one iPhone for a face-to-face conversation. The two sides face opposite directions so each person can read comfortably. Hold to speak or type your message, then hear the translation aloud. Replay translations and review today’s conversation history.

PHOTO
Translate text from signs, menus, and photos. Freeze the camera view or choose an existing photo, then see translations beside the detected text. Select a specific area, zoom, and pan for a closer look.

PASTE
Paste or type text, choose your target language, and translate. Copy the result or listen to it aloud.

ONLINE AND OFFLINE
Use online translation with an internet connection, or supported Apple on-device translation on iOS 18 or later. Offline availability depends on the language pair, device, and downloaded language packs. Some languages require an internet connection.

Microphone, speech recognition, and camera access are requested when you use the relevant features. Online translation sends text to translation providers.

name: Loadout Log
description:
Every item accounted for. Every handover documented.

Loadout Log is a native equipment-control app for film crews, audio and camera owners, event producers, rental teams and independent professionals. Keep a clear record of what you own, what went out, who received it and what came back.

EQUIPMENT WITH AN IDENTITY
Track serialized equipment individually and bulk accessories by quantity. Keep manufacturer, model, serial number, replacement value, purchase date, storage location, condition, notes and your own photographs in an equipment passport. Search, filter and switch between compact lists and visual grids.

KITS THAT ARE ACTUALLY VERIFIED
Create reusable kit templates and identifiable physical kits. Assign components, record substitutions and extras, and confirm the required quantities. Add a real case photograph and position packing markers. Each component must be verified; scanning a kit label does not mark all its contents complete.

HANDOVERS YOU CAN REFER BACK TO
Create jobs with clients, locations, operators and return dates. Verify selected equipment, record checkout condition, capture the recipient's signature and review the handover before dispatch. Historical manifests preserve the equipment details recorded at checkout.

RETURNS WITHOUT GUESSWORK
Receive equipment in partial batches. Compare checkout and return photographs, document damage, explicitly record missing units and see what remains outstanding. Flagged equipment stays unavailable until inspected.

QR IDENTIFICATION AND PRINTABLE LABELS
Identify equipment and kits using native camera scanning, with manual reference entry when needed. Generate QR labels and A4 or US Letter label sheets.

RECORDS READY TO SHARE
Preview and share handover and return PDFs. Export your inventory as CSV or create a complete JSON backup that includes photographs, signatures and saved workflow drafts. Unfinished handovers, inspections and returns can be resumed.

MADE FOR YOUR WORKING DAY
Choose System, Light or Dark appearance and select from a searchable currency list. Currency labels values; it does not convert them. Use adaptive layouts on iPhone and iPad.

No account is required. Core workflows operate without an internet connection. This release stores your ledger on one device and does not include team accounts or automatic cloud synchronization. Keep regular exported backups.

Explore the separate demo ledger to learn the workflow before creating your business records.

name: LocalLinkNest
description:
LinkNest lets people nearby share original-quality photos and videos at local-network speed—even when there is no cell signal or the public network is too weak to use.

Gather close. Enjoy the moment.

THE PROBLEM
• On a mountain trail, in a canyon, or deep in a scenic area, there is often no signal. Chat apps cannot send, cloud sync never starts, and the landscape shots you just took stay trapped on each phone until you get back to civilization.
• On a tour bus, in an underground garage, on an island, or at a campsite, a weak or missing connection turns “share the originals now” into spinning uploads, compressed failures, or “waiting for network.”
• Chat apps often compress images. AirDrop works for a few devices, but becomes tedious in a larger group.
• You should not need a new account or a third-party cloud just to pass photos across the trail or the table.

HOW IT WORKS
1. The Host creates a temporary shared space in the app. No public internet is required: turn on a personal hotspot, or join the same Wi‑Fi, to form a small local network.
2. Guests join that hotspot or Wi‑Fi, then enter the space via LAN discovery or by scanning the space QR code.
3. Upload selected photos and videos. Everyone can browse the gallery and save originals back to their own library. Transfer happens between nearby devices, not over the internet, so it stays fast even on a mountain with no signal.
4. Guests without the app can open the Host’s browser fallback for basic upload, browse, and single-file download.

WHAT YOU GET
• Fast sharing with no cell service and on weak public networks: files move directly between nearby devices, without a cloud.
• Original-byte transfer: no compress, no transcode—keep capture detail.
• Live Photos stay paired as one media item for upload, browse, and save (shown as Live).
• No public account. Media does not pass through developer servers or a third-party cloud.
• Files remain on the Host device; after sharing ends, the Host can still manage spaces in local history.
• Multiple history spaces, resume sharing, and on-device participation records.

BEST FOR
• Hiking, climbing, and camping: trail companions swap the day’s original landscapes over a phone hotspot when there is no signal.
• Travelers exchanging photos at a scenic spot, on a bus, or back at the lodging.
• Class gatherings and family dinners, saving group shots and kids’ photos on the spot.
• Exhibitions and shows where the public network is congested and almost unusable.
Whenever people are nearby on the same hotspot or Wi‑Fi, you do not need the internet.

PLEASE NOTE
• All devices must be on the same hotspot or Wi‑Fi (a temporary LAN). Cellular service and public internet are not required, and there is no internet relay or cross-network sync.
• iOS cannot auto-enable Personal Hotspot. The Host must turn it on in Settings when guided, then return to LinkNest.
• Sharing expects the app to stay in the foreground; locking the screen or backgrounding may pause the local service.
• Share QR codes, space codes, and media only with people and networks you trust.

LINKS
Marketing & FAQ: https://wakamda.fun/linknest/
Privacy: https://wakamda.fun/linknest/privacy/
Open source & issues: https://github.com/wakamda6/LinkNest

LinkNest is open source (Apache License 2.0). No in-app purchases, no ads, and no analytics or crash-reporting SDKs.

name: Locatube
description:
Explore travel videos on a map with Locatube.

Find the places travel creators have visited, right on the map. One travel video often covers several cities and spots, so Locatube splits each video by place: choose a spot on the map and watch from the moment that place appears.

How you can use it
· Before a trip, plan your route: move the map to the city you are headed to and see that area's videos in a list. Zoom out and videos group by city. Filter by language, theme (sightseeing, relaxation, activities, food, shopping, nightlife and more) and length, and sort by most viewed.
· On the ground, see what is near you: Locatube lists videos filmed close to where you are. Choose a radius from 1 km to 20 km.
· Not sure where to go, tap the lucky button: one tap picks a suggested destination and its top video.
· Tap the heart on videos you like and find them again in your account.

Plain facts
· Videos play in the official YouTube embedded player. Locatube does not download or re-host videos. If the owner has blocked playback outside YouTube, or a region or age restriction applies, a video may not play in the app, and you can open it in YouTube instead.
· Place names and locations are extracted automatically from public video descriptions, so some can be wrong. If you spot a mistake, email support and we will fix it.
· We are starting with Japan and Southeast Asia. Right now most videos are from Japan (Fukuoka and more) and Vietnam (Da Nang, Hanoi and more); other regions have only a few videos or none yet and can look empty. We add regions over time.
· Locatube is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC.

Privacy
· You can browse the map and watch videos without signing in. Favorites and watch history are saved only when you are signed in.
· Sign in with Apple or Google; in South Korea, Kakao too.
· Location is used only when you use Nearby, with "While Using the App" permission, and Locatube does not store it. The map works without location permission.
· No advertising SDK and no tracking. You can delete your account in the app under Account > Delete account.
· Place data © OpenStreetMap contributors

Contact: devs7udio@gmail.com
Privacy Policy: https://locatube.devs7ud.io/en/privacy
Terms of Use: https://locatube.devs7ud.io/en/terms
Operated by 데브스튜디오(devs7udio)

name: Lockpo
description:
Lockpo keeps the photos and videos you'd rather not show behind a PIN and Face ID — in a private vault that stays on your device.

LOCK IT DOWN
• 4- or 6-digit PIN plus Face ID or fingerprint
• Locks the moment you leave the app
• Wrong-PIN cooldown after repeated attempts
• Pro: decoy PIN that opens an empty vault, and a break-in log of failed attempts

HIDE PHOTOS IN SECONDS
• Pick photos from your library — they're copied into the vault
• Choose whether to delete the originals from your Photos app
• Organize into albums with covers
• Pro: hide and play videos, unlimited photos and albums

VIEW, EXPORT, SHARE
• Full-screen viewer with pinch to zoom
• Export back to your Photos app or share anytime
• Delete items permanently with one confirmation

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays in the app's private storage on your device. No account, no cloud, no uploads — we can't see your photos. Remember your PIN: we can't recover it.

LOCKPO PRO
Unlimited photos and albums, video vault, decoy PIN and break-in log with a subscription. Weekly with a free trial or yearly. Payment is charged to your store account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.
