name: LOG Fitness Member
description:
LOG Fitness Member is the members' app of Lord of Gyms Fitness in Hetauda, Nepal.

See your membership at a glance: the days you have left, your plan and when it ends. Ask the front desk to renew with one tap. Nothing is charged in the app.

YOUR MEMBERSHIP
• Active, expiring or expired status, with the days left
• Your plan, end date and card number
• Request a renewal in one tap and the front desk will call you

ATTENDANCE
• A calendar of your visits: green for present, red for absent
• Days off and holidays are shown, so you are never marked absent for a closed day

CHECK IN AT THE DOOR
• Scan the QR code on the gym's door screen with your phone to check in and open the door

PAYMENTS AND MESSAGES
• Your invoices and payment history
• Messages from the gym

MADE FOR LOG MEMBERS
• Sign in with your card number or phone and the 6-digit PIN from the front desk
• English and नेपाली
• Light and dark themes

You need a membership at Lord of Gyms Fitness to use this app. Ask the front desk for your PIN.

name: Logic Daily: Shikaku
seller_name: MAS SOFT YAZILIM TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
A new Shikaku every day. Quiet, like paper.

Split the grid into rectangles: every rectangle holds exactly one number, and that number is its size. Cover the whole grid with no overlaps and no gaps. Drag across cells to draw, tap to erase.

• Three sizes every day: Easy 5×5, Medium 7×7 and Hard 10×10. Easy takes about a minute.
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution and can be solved by logic alone. No guessing.
• Keep your streak: solve any size of the day's puzzle to keep it going. Missed days stay playable in the archive.
• Calendar, archive and stats: your times, averages, best streak and a colorful month.
• Undo, hints and an optional auto-check that shows a broken rectangle and says why.
• Pause hides the grid so the clock stays fair. Turn the timer off if you just want to relax.
• One gentle reminder a day if you want it. Dark mode. English and Turkish.
• Share your result: the image shows the shape, never the numbers. No spoilers.

The daily puzzles are always free. Optional one-time purchases: Remove Ads (no ads between puzzles), Archive Pass (every past puzzle, Expert 12×12 every day, replays) and hint packs. No subscriptions, and streaks are never for sale.

name: Logística 360
description:
Logística 360 es la app de los conductores de las empresas que usan el sistema de gestión de transporte Logística 360. Lleva al celular los despachos del día y todo lo que pasa en cada entrega.

• Conéctate con el código de tu empresa e ingresa con la placa de tu vehículo.
• Mira tus despachos y pedidos: cliente, dirección, productos y cantidades.
• Confirma cada entrega (completa, parcial o no entregada) con fotos como evidencia.
• Reporta novedades: producto dañado, faltante, cliente ausente o dirección equivocada.
• Registra devoluciones a bodega con la persona que las recibe.
• Reporta gastos de viaje (combustible, peajes, comida) con la foto del comprobante y sigue su aprobación.
• Ve tus entregas en el mapa con la ruta sugerida y abre la navegación en Waze o Google Maps.
• Funciona sin señal: guarda todo en el teléfono y lo envía cuando vuelve la conexión.
• Comparte tu ubicación con tu empresa mientras tienes la sesión iniciada, para el seguimiento de la ruta.

La app se usa con la cuenta de una empresa que tenga Logística 360: el código de empresa y el vehículo los asigna la empresa. Logística 360 es un producto de Logos Smart SAS.

name: Loop Orbit
description:
One finger. Endless orbit.

Your ball circles a glowing ring. Tap at the right moment to launch it to the next one. Land dead center for a Perfect, chain them for Fever – and watch the world speed up around you.

FEATURES
• Classic – endless runs through Space, Neon City, Underwater, Lava, Sunset and Storm
• Campaign – 80 handcrafted levels with moving rings, portals, time pressure, a hunter drone and burning fuse rings
• Tournament – beat 8 players in quarterfinal, semifinal and final
• 1 vs 1 – challenge a friend with a code
• Skins – dozens of balls and rings with their own trails and landing animations
• Collection – grab crystals, comets and phoenix feathers mid-flight
• Chill lo-fi soundtrack that grooves with your landings

FAIR BY DESIGN
No loot boxes. No fake timers. No streaks that punish you for taking a break. Most skins unlock just by playing.

Easy to learn, hard to master. How far can you loop?

name: LOOPS
description:
LOOPS עוזרת לכם לצאת מהבית ולהיפגש באמת.

יש לכם רעיון לערב, לטיול או לקפה? פותחים פעילות, והיא תופיע רק לאנשים שבחרתם לחשוף במעגל שלכם. חברים מצטרפים בלחיצה.

מה אפשר לעשות:
• ליצור פעילויות שמוצגות רק לאנשים שבחרתם לשייך למעגל
• לשייך כל חבר למעגל קבוע מראש, לפי מידת הקרבה, ולהחליט כך מי רואה מה
• להצטרף לפעילויות של אחרים ולהתעדכן בזמן אמת
• לתאם בצ'אט קבוצתי לכל פעילות
• לקבל התראות על הצטרפויות והודעות חדשות
• להתחרות בליגה שבועית ידידותית עם החברים
• לדווח על תוכן או משתמש ולחסום, בכל עת
• למחוק את החשבון והנתונים בלחיצה אחת בהגדרות

הפרטיות שלכם חשובה לנו: פעילות מוצגת רק לאנשים שבחרתם לחשוף במעגל.

תנאי שימוש: https://loopsapp1.github.io/loops-legal/terms.html
מדיניות פרטיות: https://loopsapp1.github.io/loops-legal/privacy.html

name: Loquin
description:
Loquin puts your website's conversations and phone calls in your pocket.

If you use Loquin.io to answer visitors on your WordPress site, the Loquin app lets you stay on top of it from your iPhone: take calls when they're passed to you, read what visitors asked, and catch up on calls and voicemails you missed.

name: Lotsnip: Background Remover
description:
Lotsnip turns a pile of product photos into clean listing photos, the whole batch at once.

Shoot your products on any table. Pick 24 photos, choose a marketplace size, and Lotsnip removes every background on your iPhone, puts each product on pure white, centers it and sizes it to fill the frame. Then it checks every photo with real measurements, so you only fix the few that need a look.

BATCH, NOT ONE BY ONE
- Remove backgrounds from a whole lot of photos in one go
- Review the batch on one grid with before and after
- "Needs review" shows only the photos that need a look
- Export the whole lot in one tap, with file names in order

PURE WHITE, SIZED FOR YOUR MARKETPLACE
- True white background (255, 255, 255), not off-white
- Product centered and filling the frame by the percentage you pick
- Size presets for Amazon, eBay, Shopify, Etsy, Poshmark, Depop, Mercari and Walmart, plus transparent PNG
- Every photo checked: white background, fill and pixel size, measured on the exported file

FIX EDGES BY HAND
- Erase and Restore brush with a magnifier
- Keep or remove detected objects, like a hand holding the product
- Undo, redo and Reset to auto
- Move, rotate and auto enhance

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
- Backgrounds are removed on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded
- Works without internet
- No account, no ads, no watermark
- Saving adds finished photos to your library and never reads it

LOTSNIP PRO, PAY ONCE
Included for everyone: up to 10 photos a day in lots of up to 10 photos, every marketplace size, white background, JPG and PNG.
Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription:
- Unlimited photos and lots up to 200 photos
- Soft shadow
- Background colors
- Custom sizes and file name patterns
- ZIP export

Presets follow each marketplace's published guidance. Check your marketplace for the latest rules. Lotsnip is not affiliated with any marketplace.

name: Loyna
description:
Loyna est l'application des commerçants clients de LOYNA, la carte de fidélité dans Apple Wallet et Google Wallet.

Au comptoir, scannez la carte de votre client avec l'appareil photo : le passage est validé en une seconde, avec une vibration et le solde du client à l'écran. La récompense est prête ? Elle s'affiche, vous la remettez d'un geste. Une erreur ? Annulez dans les secondes qui suivent.

Suivez vos clients : qui revient, qui ne vient plus, qui a une récompense en attente. Préparez vos campagnes et vos messages automatiques (anniversaire, relance, avis Google), et retrouvez le rapport de votre mois.

Votre équipe a son propre accès, avec les droits que vous choisissez. Le téléphone du comptoir peut s'ouvrir directement sur le scanner, et Face ID garde votre espace fermé aux autres.

Loyna s'utilise avec un compte LOYNA. Vos clients, eux, n'ont rien à installer : leur carte est dans leur téléphone.

name: Lumi: Baby Health Records
description:
Lumi helps parents keep a clearer view of their child’s checkup measurements and growth over time.

SEE GROWTH OVER TIME
View weight, length or height, head circumference and BMI charts by age. See measurements from different checkups together, then select a record to view its date and values.

EXPLORE WHO AND CDC REFERENCES
Switch between WHO and CDC growth references within their supported ages and reference populations. View growth curves and percentile bands while keeping your child’s original measurements unchanged.

KNOW THE SOURCE
Open the official sources used for the growth references. When an applicable reference is unavailable, Lumi shows that limitation rather than inventing a value.

FOCUS ON YOUR CHILD’S OWN GROWTH
Use clear charts to review measurements over time and support conversations with your child’s pediatrician.

Lumi is a recordkeeping and reference tool. It does not provide diagnosis or treatment advice. Growth charts and percentiles alone cannot determine a child’s health. Consult a qualified healthcare professional with medical questions.

name: Luminthyr
description:
Luminthyr is a quiet collection of Christmas puzzle games for calm winter play. No accounts. No ads. No social feed. Just frosted boards, festive icons, and clear English guidance.
PLAY EIGHT DISTINCT MODES
• Ornament Pairs — flip tiles and match holiday motifs
• Wreath Turns — rotate nested rings until they align
• Lantern Lattice — slide tiles into peaceful order
• Chime Sequence — remember and replay glowing bells
• Parcel Sort — stack gifts into tidy matching columns
• Garland Words — untangle Christmas words letter by letter
• Stocking Order — hang stockings in ascending order
• Snowflake Spot — find the flake that breaks the pattern
DAILY LATTICE
Each day brings one seeded lantern challenge. Finish it locally to keep your streak — no internet required.
PROGRESS THAT STAYS WITH YOU
Track clears, stars, focus time, and keepsakes on this device. Adjust haptics, reset confirmation, and motion preferences in Atelier.
DESIGNED FOR QUIET FOCUS
Cool winter colors, soft panels, and hand-drawn festive icons create a minimal Nordic holiday mood without clutter or noise.
Privacy note: Luminthyr does not track you, show ads, or require an account. Progress and preferences remain on your iPhone.

name: Madina Express
description:
Madina Express, c'est le grand marché de Guinée dans votre téléphone.

Vêtements, chaussures, beauté, maison, électronique, cadeaux : choisissez parmi des milliers d'articles des commerçants de Madina et toute la Guinée, commandez en quelques touches, et un livreur vous apporte le colis chez vous, partout à Conakry et à l'intérieur du pays .

POURQUOI MADINA EXPRESS
• Plus besoin de traverser la ville ni de chercher une place au marché.
• Payez comme vous voulez : Orange Money, Paycard, Carte bancaire MTN MoMo, ou en espèces à la livraison.
• Suivez votre commande en direct, jusqu'à votre porte.
• Indiquez votre porte avec une épingle sur la carte : même sans nom de rue, le livreur vous trouve.
• Deux codes secrets protègent chaque colis, du commerçant jusqu'à vous.
• Réduction pour les étudiants.

NOTIFICATIONS UTILES
Commande confirmée, colis en route, livreur à la porte : vous êtes prévenu au bon moment.

POUR LES COMMERÇANTS ET LES LIVREURS
Vendez sur Madina Express ou devenez livreur partenaire depuis l'application : votre espace, vos commandes et vos courses au même endroit.

Madina Express est une entreprise guinéenne, née à Conakry.

name: MaskCopy: Safe ID Copies
description:
Landlords, employers, hotels and agencies often ask for a copy of your ID. Most of them don't need your personal number, document number, photo or the machine-readable zone. MaskCopy makes a copy with those parts covered, marked with who it's for, and never sends your document anywhere.

FOUND AND COVERED
• Scan with the camera, or pick a photo or a PDF of up to four pages
• MaskCopy straightens the document and suggests what to cover: personal and document numbers, the machine-readable zone, the card access number, addresses, barcodes and the photo
• Personal numbers are recognised by their check digits, for example BSN, fødselsnummer, personnummer, PESEL, codice fiscale, NRIC, MyKad and Chinese resident ID numbers

YOU DECIDE
• Every suggestion is a box you can see before anything is shared
• Turn a kind on or off, drag a box to move it, tap it to zoom in and adjust its corners, or add your own
• Recognition varies by document version and photo, so check every box before you share

A COPY FOR ONE RECIPIENT
• The recipient, the purpose and the date are written across the document, so the copy can't be passed on as yours somewhere else
• Covered parts are painted over, never blurred
• Save or share as JPG or PDF, without location or camera details

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your iPhone with Apple's on-device text and image recognition
• No account, no analytics, no tracking, no uploads
• Nothing is kept: the document is forgotten when you finish
• Open source, so anyone can check

Passports, national ID cards, residence permits and driving licences from 27 countries are recognised field by field: the Netherlands, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Italy, Spain, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Belgium, Poland, Ireland, Switzerland, Austria, Portugal, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Singapore and Malaysia. Passports from other countries still have their machine-readable zone found.

MaskCopy is free. Made by TangSpark.

name: Mastello Olbia
description:
Mastello Olbia tells you every evening which bin to put out, based on your street's collection calendar in Olbia, Sardinia.

• YOUR STREET, YOUR CALENDAR – Search your street (or use your location) and the app finds your collection zone from the official street list, even when it depends on the house number. Households and businesses, winter and summer calendars.
• TONIGHT AND TOMORROW MORNING – The home screen tells you whether a bin goes out tonight and which one. Tap "Done, it's out" and no more reminders that evening. On collection morning it reminds you to bring the empty bin back in.
• REMINDERS THAT WORK – A heads-up the evening before and one when you can put the bin out. Tap "Done" right in the notification.
• YOUR BINS – Scan the barcode on your bins (e.g. OLBB…) and save them with a name and address, so the code is always at hand. Stored only on your phone.
• MASTELLO OLBIA COMPLETE – 7-DAY FREE TRIAL – Home and Lock Screen widgets, reminders that keep going until you tap "Done", morning alert for glass, summer/winter calendar alert, weekly summary, bulky-item reminders, export to your calendar and Siri. Try them free for 7 days, then unlock them forever with a single purchase. No subscription, no automatic charge.
• ALWAYS FREE – Your street's calendar, the evening reminder, your bins, eco-points and special waste.
• CLEAN OLBIA – Staffed eco-points (CAM) on the map, open daily 6am–midnight, with directions.
• SPECIAL WASTE – Recycling centre hours and accepted items, bulky-item pickup reminders, where to take batteries, medicines, cooking oil and clothing.
• PRIVACY – No account, no ads, no tracking: your data stays on your phone. The camera only reads the code on your bins and saves no photos.

Independent app, not affiliated with De Vizia Transfer S.p.A. or the Municipality of Olbia. Zones, streets and times come from public calendars; if in doubt, the official calendar (linked in the app) prevails.

name: matchpicks.bar
description:
Turn every match into a game, wherever you're watching.

matchpicks.bar runs at sports bars and pubs, watch parties and brand events on match days. Scan the QR code on your table or the screen, pick a name and you're on the leaderboard. Call the winner and the score before kickoff, then keep playing while the match is on. The top of the board wins the prize.

CALL IT BEFORE KICKOFF
Pick the winner, the final score and a few extra calls, like first scorer or total corners. Change your mind any time until the match starts.

PLAY ALONG LIVE
Quick picks drop during the match and you have about 90 seconds to answer. Fill in your match bingo card as things happen, answer trivia at half-time and vote for player of the match.

WARM UP BEFORE THE GAME
Five quick games before kickoff, from guessing higher or lower to spotting the odd one out, with their own warm-up board.

CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD
Every bar and every event has its own table, match by match and across the season. Come back each match day and your points carry on.

WIN REAL PRIZES
The host sets the prizes: a free round, a tab, a shirt, tickets to the next big game. Win, show your prize screen and it's yours. Order bonuses give you extra points for a photo of your drink or food.

NEVER MISS A MATCH DAY
Turn on match-day alerts and we'll buzz your phone when your bar is hosting a game, when a quick pick opens and when you win.

BRAND GAMES AND EVENTS
Drinks brands and sponsors run matchpicks.bar games at events, watch parties and across groups of bars, with their own prizes. Some include codes on packs or coasters that unlock rewards.

FOOTBALL, NFL AND MORE
Soccer, American football, basketball, baseball, rugby and cricket, at venues and events around the world.

matchpicks.bar is free for players. Bars and brands sign up at matchpicks.bar.

name: MAYFAIR ROSE
description:
England, 1889. Lily has come home. Move an armchair into the light, set a record spinning, and settle down for tea. How you spend the day is up to you.

Make the morning room yours
Move and turn the furniture, then try a different wallpaper, floor or set of curtains. Choose a recording on the gramophone as you settle in.

Take tea in the garden
Arrange flowers and garden furniture to make a quiet corner of your own. Set a bench near a table, take a seat and ask for tea outdoors.

Explore the manor
Walk down the corridors, chat with the household, and return to the desk for letters and newspapers. Display the cups you collect along the way in your cupboard.

Play in English or Japanese. No account is required. Progress is saved on your device so you can return to your room where you left off.

name: Maylo: Daily Brain Puzzles
description:
Swap mindless scrolling for a puzzle that makes you sharper.

Maylo is a swipeable feed of quick logic, word and trivia puzzles, and most take under a minute.

42 kinds of puzzles, a Daily Challenge and streaks. No ads, no account.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 42 kinds of puzzles in four families: logic, words, knowledge, space and moves
• Logic: Takuzu, nonograms, minesweeper, Towers of Hanoi, logic gates, magic squares
• Words: anagrams, word search, four-by-four word groups, analogies
• Knowledge: guess the percent, what names mean, foreign alphabets, music notes
• Space and moves: mazes, laser mirrors, pipes, crates to push

EVERY DAY
• Daily Challenge: the same 4 puzzles for everyone, and you can share your score
• A goal of 15 puzzles a day, day streaks and points
• Difficulty that grows with you
• An optional evening reminder

SIMPLE AND CALM
• No account and no ads
• In 7 languages: English, Greek, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian
• Maylo, the yellow piece at the heart of the maze, cheers every solve

The name? It's the Greek word for “mind”, μυαλό (myalo), with two letters swapped. Your first puzzle.

name: MeasureLite: AR Ruler & Tools
description:
Keep useful dimensions close at hand, from the first measurement to a shareable record.
Ruler Lite brings AR measurement, photo annotations, furniture cards and project folders together for furniture shopping, moving and everyday dimension notes.

Start with free measurement
Aim at a surface, choose the start and end points, and save the length with its image. View, rename and share your records without creating an app account.
Free use also includes one stored furniture card, one dimension annotation per photo and up to three projects.

Get more with Pro
• Multiple measurements: keep several dimensions in the same camera view.
• Paths and perimeters: mark consecutive corners to total a path, or close it for a perimeter.
• Photo annotations: add more arrows and enter the real dimensions you already know.
• Furniture cards: keep more length, width and height cards, using measured or manually entered values.
• Projects: organize records into more folders by room or purpose.
• PDF export: share an individual record or a project dimension list.

Practical records, on your device
Photo annotations and furniture cards do not automatically calculate real dimensions from an image. Measurements and saved photos stay on your device. There are no ads, third-party behavioral analytics or app cloud sync.
AR measurement requires an ARKit-capable iPhone and camera permission. Lighting, surface texture and point placement affect results; glass, mirrors and plain surfaces can be difficult to detect. Verify important dimensions with a physical ruler before purchasing, cutting or fitting.

About Pro subscriptions
Pro is an auto-renewing weekly subscription at the local price shown in the purchase screen. Eligible new subscribers can receive a 3-day free trial. Unless cancelled, the trial converts to a paid subscription at the displayed weekly price and renews automatically. Apple determines trial eligibility.
Apple handles payment. Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial or current subscription period ends to avoid the next renewal. Manage or cancel in iPhone Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. Restore Purchases is available in the app. Existing records remain viewable and shareable after Pro expires; creating or editing beyond the free limits and exporting PDFs requires active Pro access.
