name: Media Studio Box
description:
Media Studio Box is a recorder, an audio editor and a beat maker in one, made for creators, singers, podcasters and churches.

RECORD CLEAN
- Clean voice takes the room's noise, hiss and rumble out of every take, with any microphone
- Works with the iPhone's own mic, EarPods, AirPods, USB-C, Lightning and creator microphones
- Keeps recording with the phone locked
- Play each take back first, then keep it or throw it away
- Save as WAV, MP3 or M4A

EDIT IN SECONDS
- Cut the start and end, fade in and out
- Louder, quieter or auto level, and a small EQ for bass, voice and treble
- Import audio, or the sound from a video, and edit it
- Share or save anywhere

MAKE BEATS AND SONGS
- Make a beat from nothing, from a groove, or describe it for Ife AI
- Duplicate, rename and arrange bars and parts
- Record your vocals over the beat, or let The Psalmist sing your words
- Keep your beats in your own private cloud

WITH MEDIA STUDIO BOX ON YOUR COMPUTER
- Send songs between your iPhone and computer, even with no internet, over the same Wi-Fi or your iPhone's hotspot
- Use your iPhone as a remote: record, stop and save on the computer from across the room

PLANS
Recording, editing and making beats by hand are free. Free also gives 3 AI beats a day and 3 Psalmist songs a month.
- Starter: 10 AI beats and 5 Psalmist songs a month, 500 MB in the cloud
- Pro: 40 AI beats and 20 Psalmist songs a month, 3 GB in the cloud
- Church: 100 AI beats and 60 Psalmist songs a month, 5 GB in the cloud
Monthly or yearly (two months free). Add extra cloud (5 GB or 20 GB a month) on top of any plan, and credits for more AI beats or Psalmist songs whenever you need them. One plan works on your iPhone, iPad and computer.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, in your Apple Account's subscription settings.

ALSO
- A dashboard of what you have made, kept only on your device
- Light and dark looks, iPhone and iPad

TERMS AND PRIVACY
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Global Datai terms: https://gdatai.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy policy: https://gdatai.com/privacy-policy2/software-app-privacy-policy/

name: MeetApp
description:
MeetApp は、友達との待ち合わせのためのアプリです。
予定を作って友達を招待すると、予定の時間が近づいたときだけ、おたがいの現在地と到着予定時間が自動で共有されます。

待ち合わせの時間だけ、自動で位置を共有
・予定の「何分前から共有するか」を予定ごとに選べます（「常に」も可）
・全員そろうか、予定の時間が過ぎると自動で共有が終わります
・自分で終えることも、その日だけ止めることもできます

「あと何分？」がひと目でわかる
・友達それぞれの到着予定時間を、徒歩・電車・車に合わせて表示
・遅れそうな人がいると通知でお知らせ
・「Googleマップで経路を見る」で、すぐに道案内

カレンダーで予定を見わたせる
・年・月・拡大の3つの見え方。2本指で広げる・つまむだけで切りかえ
・祝日も表示。日付を長押しするだけで、その日の予定を作れます
・iPhoneのカレンダーの予定も重ねて表示できるので、空いている日がすぐわかる

日程調整もアプリの中で
・候補日をいくつか出して、メンバーが「行ける」「微妙」「行けない」で答えるだけ
・いちばん都合のいい日を教えてくれます。決めると全員の予定に反映

招待はQRコードかメッセージで
・QRコードを見せるか、リンクを送るだけで参加できます
・よく会うメンバーは「グループ」にしておけば、予定を作ると全員に自動で追加
・グループの予定は、だれが時間を変えても全員に反映

チャットとワンタップ返信
・「今向かってる」「あと5分！」「少し遅れます」をワンタップで送信
・リアクションも付けられます

安心して使える
・位置は、同じ予定・グループのメンバーにしか見えません
・広告・トラッキングはありません
・Apple / Google でサインインすると、機種変更しても予定が戻ります

name: MeetMaze: The Way Home
description:
“Don’t be afraid. I’ll bring you home.”

A storm leaves Xiaotuan and Xiaohe on opposite sides of a door. Follow the traces of their journey through five chapters and 100 mazes, as a story of searching, loss and companionship unfolds.

A pure maze adventure
Enter at the bottom left and find the exit at the top right. Every maze is connected and has no loops, giving its entrance and exit exactly one correct path. There are no switches or traps to operate: move with the direction pad or a swipe, and focus on finding your way.

A story before each new level
Read the next part of the story before entering its maze. Five distinct cartoon environments and automatically playing story scenes bring the journey to life.

Make your own maps
Change the size and theme in the Workshop, preview your maze, save multiple favorites, and recreate a map from its complete map code.

Remember each journey
Story levels record your fastest active play time, fewest clear steps and number of clears, with exploration badges to earn. Workshop clears show a summary for that attempt.

Play in landscape, with pinch zoom and two-finger camera dragging. Music and ambience have separate controls. The interface and full story support Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese and Spanish. Start in your system language or choose one in Settings.

Play offline without an account. No ads, in-app purchases or online leaderboards. Progress, saved maps and settings stay on your device.

The story includes themes of separation, loss and death. Please consider your own comfort when choosing to play.

name: MekuFlip: Comic & Manga Reader
description:
Your comics. Your bookshelf. The feel of turning a real page.
MekuFlip is a comic and manga reader for your own PDF, archive and image files.

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
See the cover when closed, then open into your story. Page curls reveal both sides of the sheet. Standard iPhone reads one page at a time in portrait; iPad supports portrait and landscape.

BRING YOUR OWN COLLECTION
Import ZIP, RAR, CBZ, CBR, PDF, images and folders through Files, Open In, or the built-in browser. Cloud locations such as iCloud Drive are supported when available in the Files app.

A LIBRARY THAT FEELS LIKE YOURS
Group volumes into series. Drag to reorder or move books together. Set covers and titles, choose a bookshelf theme, resume your reading and jump with the page slider. At the end, continue to the next volume.

SHARE WITH A NEARBY MEKUFLIP
The sender shows a QR code; the receiver scans and approves. Send books, series, custom covers and browser bookmarks without an intermediary file-storage server. Keep both apps open, Wi-Fi enabled and local network access allowed.

LEARN BY DOING
An interactive tutorial walks you through the controls. A detailed guide is in Settings. Try the original sample comic and import exercise offline. Your saved books are available offline too.

FIVE BOOKS FREE. A ONE-TIME PRO UPGRADE.
Store up to five of your own books for free. Each volume counts separately; included samples do not count. Delete a book to free a slot. Buy MekuFlip Pro once for unlimited stored books, with no subscription. Restore an existing purchase from Settings.

MekuFlip is a file reader, not a commercial comic subscription or catalog. Import and share only content you have the right to use. Some files, including password-protected files, are unsupported. Comic text and book titles are not translated.

name: MelodIA Piano
description:
MelodIA turns music into an interactive piano roll and sheet music, so you can learn every piece note by note.

100% FREE, EVERYTHING INCLUDED
Every feature is free: no in-app purchases, no ads, no credit card.
• Already more than 900 piano rolls created by the community: over 500 different pieces in every style, from classical to pop and film music
• Add the pieces you love from your account on melodia-piano.app: our AI automatically turns them into a piano roll and sheet music, for free, then play them here in the app

PLAY ALONG
• Falling notes on a full keyboard, left and right hands in different colours
• Classic sheet music that follows the playback
• Rich, high-quality grand piano sound

PRACTISE AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Slow down or speed up any piece
• Loop a tricky passage with A/B markers
• Play hands separately, or step through chord by chord
• Show fingering and chord names on screen

YOUR REPERTOIRE
• Sort your pieces into Mastered, Practising and To start
• Discover trending pieces and the community catalogue
• Edit notes and add your own annotations

One account for the app and the website: your library follows you on iPhone, iPad and computer.

name: Memoqwin: Visuelles Gedächtnis
description:
Always saving things and never finding them again? Memoqwin is your visual memory for the internet. Share a link, video, image or screenshot from any app, and Memoqwin keeps it beautiful, searchable and private.

SAVE IN A SECOND
• From any app via Share → Memoqwin
• Screenshot inbox: new screenshots are detected, their text is read, you decide with one tap
• Voice notes, plus notes with images, video and handwriting

FIND WHAT YOU NEED
• Search titles, notes, text in images and video transcripts
• Automatic categories and tags
• Time machine: year → month → day
• Spotlight and Siri: “Search Memoqwin”

MEMO – YOUR AI ON IPHONE
• Ask Memo anything about what you saved – with sources
• Summaries, key points and study cards
• Smart connections show what belongs together
• Runs on device with Apple Intelligence

FROM SAVING TO DOING
• A recipe becomes a shopping list in Reminders
• A training plan becomes events in Calendar
• Places become destinations in Apple Maps

THE RIGHT MOMENT
• Weekly digest: the three key ideas of your week
• “On this day” and forgotten treasures
• Home Screen widgets

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking
• Text recognition, transcription and AI run on your iPhone
• Export everything – any time, with all original files
• Videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Vimeo only through their official players

Memo uses Apple Intelligence (supported device, language and region required). Without it, saving, search and every other feature work as usual.

Made with care in Germany.

name: MendMark
description:
MendMark is your personal repair logbook for the things you rely on. Keep maintenance and repair history organized in one place.

• Add vehicles, bikes, appliances, and other belongings
• Record service dates, parts, costs, mileage, and notes
• Attach photos to your service records
• Track upcoming due dates and mileage
• Review your service history and total costs
• Export records as a CSV file and share photos  

Your logbook is stored on your device and works offline. Internet access is needed to load ads.

MendMark is free to use with ads. You can remove ads with a one-time in-app purchase.

name: Mente Viva: Word Guess
description:
Guess the 5-letter word in 6 tries. No ads, no coins and no timer: type a word, tap "Check" and watch the letters change color.

HOW TO PLAY
- Green: the letter is in the word, in the right spot
- Yellow: it's in the word, but in another spot
- Gray: it's not in the word
The keyboard changes color too, so you can see at a glance which letters are left. Only real words count: if you type one that isn't on the list, the app tells you and the try isn't used up.

THE WORD OF THE DAY
A new word every day, the same for everyone, and always free. When you finish, share it: you share the colored squares without the letters, so the answer stays secret.

FREE PLAY IN THREE LEVELS
Easy, Medium and Hard, as many games as you like, at your own pace.

THE MEANING AT THE END
Win or lose, you see the word with its definition.

EASY TO PLAY
- High contrast: orange and blue instead of green and yellow
- Statistics and streaks, for the word of the day and for free play
- A sound when you guess the word, which you can turn off
- Light and dark mode
- Works without an internet connection
- On iPhone and iPad

NO ADS, NO SUBSCRIPTION
The word of the day is always free, and you get 3 free-play games to try it out. The full version is a single payment that unlocks unlimited games in all three levels. No subscription, no ads and no charges later.

Your progress stays on your device. No accounts, no sign-up.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://foundryappsglobal.github.io/legal/mente-viva-word-guess/privacy.html

name: Mentoki
description:
Mentoki bündelt digitale Werkzeuge für den Unterricht an einem Ort – sortiert wie in einem guten Buchladen. Von der Grundschule bis zur Berufsschule findest du Arbeitsblätter, Generatoren, interaktive Übungen und Organisationshilfen, die du sofort einsetzen kannst.

WERKZEUGE FÜR JEDEN BEREICH
• Grundschule, Sekundarstufe I und II, berufliche Bildung und Schulorganisation
• Generatoren erzeugen Übungsblätter auf Knopfdruck – jedes Blatt ist anders, auf Wunsch mit Lösungsblatt
• Interaktive Werkzeuge, Simulatoren und Trainer für Beamer, iPad und iPhone
• Arbeitsblätter als PDF speichern und drucken

MIT DER KLASSE ARBEITEN
• Kurse anlegen und Werkzeuge über einen Kurs-Code mit der Klasse teilen – Schülerinnen und Schüler brauchen dafür kein Konto und geben keine Daten an
• Live-Runden: Die Lehrkraft zeigt am Beamer, die Klasse spielt mit dem Tablet oder Handy mit

FORTBILDUNGEN
• Schulungsmaterialien, Übungen und Austausch für Teilnehmende von mentoki-Fortbildungen

SOFORT AUSPROBIEREN
• Ausgewählte Werkzeuge kannst du ohne Konto nutzen
• Mit einem kostenlosen Konto speicherst und druckst du deine Ergebnisse
• Den vollen Katalog nutzen Lehrkräfte, deren Schule mentoki einsetzt. Der Zugang kommt über die Schule – in der App gibt es keine Käufe und keine Werbung.

SICHER UND DATENSPARSAM
• Anmeldung mit Passwort und zweitem Faktor oder mit Passkey
• Server in Deutschland, Datenverarbeitung nach DSGVO
• Keine Werbe- oder Analyse-Cookies, keine Weitergabe an Dritte
• Deine Daten kannst du jederzeit unter „Konto & Sicherheit“ herunterladen oder dein Konto löschen

IMMER AKTUELL
Neue Werkzeuge und Verbesserungen erscheinen automatisch in der App – ohne Update.

Mentoki richtet sich an Lehrkräfte, Trainerinnen und Trainer sowie Schulen. Fragen und Anregungen: info@mentoki.de

name: Menvigo
description:
¿Necesitas volar en helicóptero entre Ceuta y Málaga y está completo? Menvigo vigila la disponibilidad por ti y te avisa con una notificación en cuanto se libera una plaza.

CÓMO FUNCIONA
• Elige el trayecto (Ceuta → Málaga o Málaga → Ceuta) y la fecha.
• Vigila un vuelo concreto o todo el día.
• Cuando alguien cancela y queda una plaza, recibes un aviso al momento. Si otra persona la coge antes y se vuelve a liberar, te volvemos a avisar.
• Pulsa «Reservar» y entras directamente en la web de la compañía con tu fecha ya elegida.

QUÉ NO HACE MENVIGO
Menvigo no vende billetes ni gestiona reservas, y no cobra nada. Es una app independiente, sin relación con la compañía que opera los vuelos: solo te avisa para que no pierdas la plaza.

ADEMÁS
• Las últimas noticias de Ceuta de El Periódico de Ceuta.
• Tus avisos se desactivan solos cuando pasa la fecha.
• Puedes borrar tu cuenta y todos tus datos desde la propia app, en «Cuenta».

PRIVACIDAD
Solo guardamos tu nombre de usuario, tu correo, tus avisos y el identificador de notificaciones del móvil. Sin ubicación, sin pagos y sin publicidad.

name: MeowMate: Shared Cat Care
description:
Who fed the cat this morning? Is the litter done? When is the vaccine due? MeowMate answers for the whole household, on every iPhone.

A SHARED SCHEDULE
• Meals, water, litter, medication: everyone sees what’s left to do and ticks “Done” in one tap.
• The log keeps track of who did what, and when.
• Outdoor cat: “Went out” and “Came in” in one tap, evening curfew.
• Recurring tasks, swap a slot in one message; with Plus, automatic rota and upkeep (fountain, brushing, claws).
• Today, Week and Month views; a widget that ticks the litter, Siri: “Moka has eaten”.

ALL THEIR HEALTH IN ONE PLACE
• Vaccine, deworming and parasite-treatment reminders, in good time.
• Symptoms, medication and supplements ticked by anyone.
• With Plus: vet records with attached reports, weight curve with ideal weight, alerts when vomiting, appetite or litter habits change, medication stock, and a PDF health record for the vet.

GO AWAY WITH PEACE OF MIND
• Cat-Sitting Mode with visits: pick the dates and one or two visits a day. The cat-sitter ticks off each visit and can add a photo; you’re alerted if a visit is missed. Their access closes on its own when you’re back.
• Vacation sheet: meals, litter, medication, hiding spots, instructions, emergency contacts.
• Shared custody between two homes.

YOUR CAT, IN DETAIL
• Identity, microchip and registry, allergies, diet, house rules, lifestyle and hiding spots.
• A “lost cat” sheet ready to share.
• With Plus: food and litter stock, expenses, documents.

YOUR TEAM, YOUR RULES
• Invite your family, a neighbour or your cat-sitter: they use MeowMate for free.
• Everyone has their own rights: who ticks what, who sees health and documents.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your data stays in your iCloud and is shared through Apple’s iCloud sharing. No account to create, no MeowMate server, no ads.

FREE OR PLUS
Free: one cat, up to 5 people, the last 30 days of the log, vaccine, deworming and parasite-treatment reminders.
MeowMate Plus: several cats, unlimited people, full history, complete health, Cat-Sitting Mode with visits, rota, stock, expenses and export. Yearly with a 1-month free trial, monthly, or lifetime in a single payment. Your invited people get it for free.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase; manage or cancel the subscription in iPhone Settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Meowtangle Ring Puzzle
description:
Two rings can hold each other in place. The opening is there; the puzzle is finding how to use it.

Drag a ring to rotate it. Look at its gap and the pieces around it, then turn until it has a clear way out. As the linked pieces separate, the arrangement opens up.

Meowtangle Ring Puzzle starts with a simple pair and moves on to larger arrangements of colorful rings. Pay attention to which piece can turn and which one is holding another in place. A useful move begins with a closer look.

Need a little help with a tangled arrangement? The Laser Gun lets you choose a piece to remove. Launch a Rocket and let it pick a piece to break away.

Once Star Shop unlocks, use stars collected through play to add Laser Guns and Rockets to your inventory. Browse the backgrounds and preview a new look directly on your puzzle before choosing one to keep. Try the soft clouds of Cloud Dream, the planets of Galaxy Voyage or the glow of Aurora Night.

Glossy rings and colorful backdrops keep each puzzle easy to follow, from the first linked pair to the next arrangement.

name: MeraParichay
description:
MeraParichay is an offline-first digital business card app for iPhone. Create your professional profile once, then share it anytime with an NFC card, QR code, or VCF contact file — with no account, no cloud, and no online profile page.

What you can do

Create and manage one or more business profiles on your iPhone
Write your contact details to a compatible NFC tag
Generate a self-contained QR code from your vCard
Share as QR image, VCF file, or plain-text summary
Scan QR codes and read NFC cards to preview and save contacts
Export and import a local backup when you change phones
Privacy by design
Your data stays on your device. Sharing happens through iOS share features and physical NFC/QR media — not through a server.

Perfect for networking events, meetings, and anyone who wants a modern visiting card without depending on the internet.

name: METAPHRAME
description:
METAPHRAME brings digital art exhibitions to your Apple TV through cinematic, pre-recorded exhibition films. Choose an exhibition with your remote, settle into the space, and let the artworks unfold on your screen.

NEW EXHIBITIONS EVERY MONTH
New 4K exhibition films arrive every month through app updates. After updating, you can watch the added films offline and return to your favorites whenever you like.

TWO EXHIBITIONS INCLUDED
001 — SOFT SYSTEMS
Luminous forms, imagined ecologies, and matter in motion. Featuring Yu.a.Ye, byt3b10om, JAZAINI, and Lucy Mazzini.

002 — Digital Latency & Organic Traces
Four artistic worlds meet in a shared exhibition space. Featuring Airiquel, DAMN TRUE, Daniel Varela, and jihoon Sun.

MADE FOR UNHURRIED VIEWING
• Two complete 4K exhibition films included with the app.
• Offline playback after installation, with no additional video downloads.
• Repeat one exhibition or loop the full collection.
• Use your remote to pause, skip forward or back, and switch exhibitions.
• Mute playback or keep the original sound.
• English and Simplified Chinese interfaces.

No account is required. METAPHRAME presents filmed journeys through virtual exhibitions; navigation follows the recorded camera path.

name: Mevoya
description:
ميفويا تطبيقك للمشاوير الذكية في السعودية.

اطلب رحلة الآن أو جدولها لاحقاً، أضف توقفات للتسوق في الطريق، وتابع السائق لحظة بلحظة حتى الوصول.

• طلب رحلة فوري أو جدولة لاحقاً
• تسوق من المتاجر على مسار رحلتك
• تتبع مباشر للسائق والمسار
• محفظة رقمية للدفع وإعادة الرصيد
• تنبيهات فورية لكل خطوة في الرحلة والطلب
• عناوين محفوظة ومتاجر مفضلة وكوبونات

ادفع من المحفظة، راجع رحلاتك النشطة والمكتملة، وأدر حسابك من مكان واحد.

ميفويا — رحلة أوصل، وتسوق أوفر.

name: Mevoya Captain
description:
ميڤويا كابتن هو تطبيق السائق لإدارة الرحلات والأرباح في مكان واحد.

استقبل الطلبات وأنت متاح، تابع موقعك على الخريطة، وأكمل الرحلات بخطوات واضحة من القبول حتى التسليم.

ماذا يقدّم التطبيق؟

• استقبال الرحلات
فعّل وضع «متاح لاستقبال الرحلات» وابدأ البحث عن الطلبات القريبة منك.

• الخريطة والموقع
شاهد موقعك والوجهة مباشرة على الخريطة أثناء الرحلة.

• سجل الرحلات
راجع الرحلات الجارية والمكتملة، مع المسافة والمدة والتكلفة.

• الأرباح والتقارير
اطلع على أرباح اليوم والأسبوع والشهر: أجور الرحلات، البونص، الحوافز، الإكراميات، والعمولة والصافي. ويمكنك تحميل كشف الأرباح PDF.

• الحوافز الأسبوعية
تابع تقدمك نحو الحافز الأسبوعي وأكمل عدد الرحلات المطلوب.

• أداء الكابتن
نسبة القبول، الرحلات المكتملة، ومعدل الإلغاء في لوحة واحدة.

• الإشعارات
تنبيهات فورية لتقييمات العملاء، الرد على الشكاوى، والتنبيهات الإدارية.

• الحساب والمستندات
تابع صلاحية الهوية، رخصة القيادة، استمارة المركبة، والتأمين، وحدّث معلوماتك الشخصية والمركبة والحساب البنكي.

ميڤويا كابتن مصمّم للكابتن اللي يحتاج وضوح في الطلبات والأرباح بدون تعقيد.

name: MezmurFaith
description:
MezmurFaith is a peaceful, easy-to-read home for Orthodox Tewahedo hymns.

Browse more than 600 Tigrinya hymns by category or singer, along with a collection in English. Every Tigrinya hymn can also be read in English letters, for those who speak Tigrinya but find the Ge’ez script harder to read.

• Search titles and lyrics
• Save your favorites and build your own collections
• Adjust the text size for comfortable reading
• Follow the feast and fasting calendar
• Suggest a hymn or report a correction from inside the app

No account is needed. MezmurFaith is free and contains no advertising.

name: Mi Simplifies
description:
Encuentra barberías, peluquerías, cejas y pestañas y peluquerías caninas cerca de ti, mira sus horas libres y reserva en segundos.

• Busca por lugar, servicio o ciudad, o mira los que tienes más cerca.
• Elige el servicio, con quién y la hora que te acomoda.
• Donde atienden con fila, pide tu prioridad de turno: al llegar, pasas primero.
• Ve todas tus horas en un solo lugar, agrégalas a tu calendario y llega con Mapas, Google Maps o Waze.
• Recibe un aviso al reservar, el día antes y antes de cada hora.
• Suma 1 punto por cada $1.000 que pagas en tus visitas.
• Guarda tus lugares favoritos y compártelos.

Entras con tu correo, sin contraseña.

name: Mihwaar: Customer Inbox
description:
Mihwaar is the mobile app for teams that run customer conversations on the Mihwaar platform. Every chat from your business channels lands in one shared inbox, so your team can reply, assign and follow up from anywhere.

ONE INBOX FOR EVERY CHANNEL
• Conversations from WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and your website chat in a single list
• Tabs for open, mine, unassigned, overdue, snoozed and closed chats, with search and filters
• Assign conversations, add internal notes, snooze, close and reopen

REPLY FAST, KEEP IT PERSONAL
• Text, voice notes, photos and files
• Ready replies with "/" and approved message templates
• Delivery and read status, retry for failed messages

AI THAT HELPS, NOT REPLACES
• Suggested replies, rewriting, translation and conversation summaries
• AI agents that answer common questions and hand over to your team

KNOW EVERY CUSTOMER
• Customer profiles with history, tags, stages, notes and purchases
• Calendar for appointments and events, including clinic bookings
• Quotes, payment links and invoices you send to your customers

STAY ON TOP
• Home overview: open chats, unassigned, today's appointments and response times
• Reports on volume, channels and team performance
• Push notifications for new messages, with quiet settings per category
• Face ID / fingerprint app lock

Built Arabic-first with full right-to-left support, plus English, light and dark mode.

Mihwaar is a business tool: sign in with the account your company created on the Mihwaar platform. Questions? Contact info@tarawud.com.

name: Mind Level: Brain Games
description:
Mind Level is a collection of 30 short games to train and have fun. A round takes a few minutes, and each game climbs step by step with you.

MEMORY
Repeat sequences of lights, find the hidden pairs, remember the rooms and the steps you just took.

ATTENTION
Tap the numbers in order, choose between color and word, spot the odd one, follow the rule that changes.

LOGIC
Fill in grids and pens, find the one path, work out what comes next and which digits are hidden.

ARITHMETIC
Flash sums, target numbers, the right change, more or less, quick estimates.

WORDS
Hidden words, one letter at a time, letters to reshuffle.

HUMAN BODY
Where an organ sits, bones in place, the journey of blood, true or myth: basic anatomy as a game.

AN HONEST LINE
Every game has a card with its rules and a line that says what the game asks of you and what science has not shown. Progress in a game does not show any benefit outside the game.

SUBSCRIPTION
Eight games are complete without a subscription. In the other twenty-two, the first three steps are open to everyone. The subscription, monthly or yearly, opens every game at every step. You see price and length in the app before you confirm. Payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can cancel any time in your Apple account settings.
Terms of use: https://docthebrain.com/mindlevel/condizioni
Privacy: https://docthebrain.com/mindlevel/privacy

YOUR DATA
Your records stay on your phone. The app asks for no account and collects no data. You need no network to play.

Mind Level is for entertainment purposes, not diagnostic. It is not a medical device.

name: MindPaint: Coloring Book
description:
MindPaint is a coloring book that lives on your iPhone and iPad. Pick a page, pick a color and start. There are no wrong colors and no numbers to follow, so every page you finish is all yours.

THREE WAYS TO COLOR
• Tap to fill: choose a color and tap a section to fill it. Every enclosed area fills on its own, even the tiny ones.
• Guided brush: paint freely while your color stays inside the lines.
• Free brush: paint anywhere, with pressure and tilt on Apple Pencil and other styluses.
Switch between them whenever you like, on any page.

HUNDREDS OF PAGES
• Animals, dinosaurs, ocean life, space, vehicles, fantasy, food, holidays, mandalas and more.
• Four levels of detail, from simple pages with big sections to intricate ones for a long evening.
• Every page shows how detailed it is and about how long it takes.
• Search by name or browse by category.

COLOR YOUR WAY
• Color sets, a custom color picker and your recent colors.
• Undo, redo and an eraser.
• Zoom in for the smallest details.
• Pick up where you left off in Continue and keep your finished pages together.
• Save finished pages to Photos, share them or print them.

TURN YOUR IDEAS INTO PAGES
With a free account you can describe anything and MindPaint draws a new coloring page for you. Choose the level of detail and a style: cartoon, storybook, realistic, mandala or stained glass. You can add up to three photos for it to draw from. Pages you make stay in My Pages for your whole family.

Making a page uses credits, which you can buy in the app. A page with photos uses 2 credits and any other page uses 1. To draw a page, MindPaint sends your description and any photos to OpenAI. Photos are deleted as soon as the page is finished.

MADE WITH FAMILIES IN MIND
• A grown-up creates the account, then adds a profile for each child with an optional PIN.
• Each child keeps their own coloring.
• Grown-ups decide whether a child can type their own ideas or add photos. Both start off.
• Saving, sharing and printing from a child's profile ask for the grown-up's password unless you turn that off.
• No ads and no third-party trackers.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED TO COLOR
Browse the catalog and start coloring without signing up.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@mindpaint.app.

name: MIOMANDO
description:
MIOMANDO is a simplified remote control for compatible Haier air conditioners. It lets you quickly use the main functions from your iPhone, without searching for a separate remote and without draining its batteries.

To sign in, you must always log in to the proprietary Haier/hOn system with the account already linked to your air conditioner. MIOMANDO does not create, replace, or modify the Haier/hOn account. Your password is used for login and is not stored in the app; session data is protected in the iOS Keychain.

MIOMANDO is in no way intended to replace the original Haier/hOn app. It is a simple, fast alternative interface: commands are sent through the Haier/hOn service and depend on the availability of the network, the service, and a compatible model.

The app is intended exclusively for the compatible Haier air conditioner it has been set up for. It is not a universal remote control and does not guarantee operation with other devices or models.

Haier and hOn are trademarks of their respective owners. MIOMANDO is an independent application and is not sponsored, endorsed, or affiliated with Haier.

name: Mishkah: Lower Your Gaze
description:
Mishkah helps Muslim men break free from the habit that keeps pulling them away from Allah, and return to a clean heart.

Rooted in the Qur'an and Sunnah, Mishkah gives you a calm older-brother mentor, a Panic Button for the hardest moments, and a 40-day path to rebuild your haya, your salah and your self-respect.

PANIC BUTTON
When the urge hits, one tap opens a mirror of your own face, breathing with dhikr (SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Astaghfirullah) and the words of Allah. Your reasons rise in front of you while the wave passes. Already slipped? Go straight to the tawbah steps: no shame, just a fresh start.

A 40-DAY PATH
One short lesson a day on lowering the gaze, triggers, tawbah, salah and strength, with every ayah and hadith referenced.

10 ISLAMIC LEVELS
Climb from Niyyah through Tawbah, Sabr, Mujahadah, Ghadd al-Basar, Taqwa, Arba'in, Istiqamah and Ihsan, all the way to Nur. Every clean day lifts you higher.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
A live clean-days timer, your best streak, a 16-week calendar of clean days and salah, and the urges you rode out.

DAILY CHECK-IN
A 20-second check-in each morning and night: how strong is the urge, how is your heart, what is around you. Spot your triggers before they spot you.

SALAH TIMES AND REMINDERS
Prayer times calculated on your phone, gentle reminders at each adhan, and a night guard for the late hours.

WIDGETS
Keep your streak, your level and a daily verse on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, and add the Panic Button to Control Center.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no email. Face ID lock, hidden in the app switcher, a neutral app icon, and reminders worded so nobody can tell what they are for. Your journey is backed up only to your own private iCloud.

MISHKAH PRO
The Panic Button, the urge helper, the tawbah steps, your streak, salah times and the first 7 days of the path are free forever. Mishkah Pro unlocks the full 40-day path, the guided voice, all 10 levels, progress insights, Face ID lock, alternate icons and widgets.
- Yearly (with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) or Monthly.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://mishkahapp.pages.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mishkahapp.pages.dev/privacy

"Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp." (Surah An-Nur 24:35)

name: MoaBook: Photo Cleanup
description:
Clean up photos with Moa.

Photos keep piling up, and it's hard to know where to start. MoaBook starts with one recent trip and shows you just the photos worth sorting.

■ An album for every trip
MoaBook finds your trips from when and where your photos were taken, and makes an album for each trip with one tap. Revisit your trips on the map and in the list.

■ Keep just one of similar shots
Rapid shots and similar photos within a trip are shown in groups. Pick the ones to keep, and the rest go to the Trash.

■ Sort as you swipe
Push a photo up to send it to the Trash, tap the check button to keep it, or drop it on an album below. Swiped the wrong way? Undo brings it right back.

■ Free up space without deleting
Choose a quality for each video to make it smaller, and convert Live Photos to stills. You'll see how much you'll save first.

■ More you can do
· Clean up screenshots, one-time screenshots like verification codes, duplicates, documents and receipts, and large videos, sorted by type.
· Finish one month at a time, and get a done stamp for each finished month.
· Send a trip as a card with its name, dates, and photos.

■ The more you sort, the tidier the room
Your chosen friend lives in a pixel room that gets messy with unsorted photos and tidier as you sort. Complete challenges to earn items, and change the app icon to your friend.

■ Your photos stay on this device
Finding trips and similar photos happens on your iPhone. Photos are never sent to a server. Photos in the Trash aren't deleted until you empty it yourself, and even then they stay in Recently Deleted in Photos for 30 days.

name: Mogna Games: Play & Chat
description:
Mogna Games invites you to play casual online games with friends. We make games that will pull you right in. Voice chat is built right into the game, so you can feel the team spirit. Unwind with your friends after work or school in one of our games:

Cosmo Trio. Three astronauts, one station, a mountain of cargo. Line it up in threes, pass it through the airlock and bail each other out with boosters. Clear one bay and the whole crew lifts off.

Pirates: Treasure Hunt. An island of face-down squares hiding gold, traps and crocodiles. Lead your crew through the jungle and haul the coins back to your ship. 20–40 minutes a match, and every island is new.

Fox Trails. Three to five minutes, three players, nobody waits for a turn: everyone plays at once, and short cooldowns set the pace. Empty the burrows, lay the moonstones phase by phase — and the win is shared.

Cheese Farm. Cats milk the cows, rats cook the cheese, and everyone has exactly five minutes to get the orders to the fair. One farm for the whole world each day: a daily leaderboard and a streak you won't want to break. You can even start solo.

Memory and  Memory: Kitchen. The classic matching game and its cooking edition, where cards come together into recipes. Seven to ten minutes, solo start allowed — perfect for the friend who never plays anything.

Tycoon. The city of big deals: buy up blocks, raise hotels, collect rent and haggle down to the last taler. The winner is whoever is still standing. An evening game for up to six.

HOW YOU PLAY TOGETHER

• Rooms by code: send it and your friends are in.
• Quick match when your friends are offline.
• Friends, online status and one-tap invites.
• Voice and text chat right inside the game.
• Close the app and the game waits for you.

See you in the game!

name: Mogu JLPT: N5-N1 Flashcards
description:
Nearly 8,000 Japanese words for every JLPT level, N5 to N1, in lessons short enough to finish on a coffee break.

Mogu JLPT turns the JLPT vocabulary lists into 841 bite-size lessons of up to 10 words each, grouped into everyday topics. 
Meet the words, hear them, then take a quick quiz. Any word you miss comes back until you get it right.

HOW IT WORKS 
• Complete: all five levels, from 718 words at N5 to 2,699 at N1 
• Organized: words grouped into 23 topics, like Food & Drink, Work & School and Society & News, so related words stick together 
• Short: 10 words or fewer per lesson, so you can always fit one in 
• Checked: a quiz after every lesson, and missed words repeat until you know them 
• Always clear what's next: progress for every level and topic, with your next lesson one tap away

EVERY WORD COMES WITH 
• Its kanji, with the kana reading shown above 
• The English meaning 
• Audio from your iPhone's built-in Japanese voice. Tap to hear it, or turn on auto-play

FOCUSED BY DESIGN 
• Free, with no ads 
• No account or sign-up 
• No streak pressure. Study when it suits you 
• Works offline, and your progress stays on your iPhone 
• Light and dark mode


LEARN WITH MOGU Mogu, a small onigiri, is learning Japanese right alongside you and cheers on every little step forward. 
Learn Japanese, one word at a time.



Vocabulary is based on widely used community JLPT word lists. 
Mogu JLPT is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Japan Foundation or Japan Educational Exchanges and Services (JEES), which run the JLPT.

name: Mole Detective: Gem Logic
description:
Grab your lantern and help the mole detective dig for gems!

Each rock hides a ruby, an emerald, an amber, an amethyst — or nothing at all. Number tiles tell you how many matching gems are nearby. Read the clues, cross out what can't be, and place every gem without guessing.

• 1,000 stages across 20 mine zones that change as you dig deeper
• A new gem or clue appears every few stages, explained step by step
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution you can reach by logic
• Try mode lets you test an idea without penalty
• Hints walk you through one deduction in three steps
• Three lanterns per stage — the lanterns you keep become your stars
• Today's Vein: a fresh daily puzzle once you have met every gem
• Play offline, no account needed, 10 languages

Purchases: hint packs, a one-time starter pack, and Remove Ads (removes banners and automatic full-screen ads for good and adds 20 free hints every day).

Privacy Policy: https://gwangmaek.vnamu.com/privacy/en
Support: help@vnamu.com

name: MONEY GANG PADEL
description:
MONEY GANG è l'app per il tuo gruppo di padel: tutto quello che serve per organizzare le partite, seguire il punteggio in diretta e tenere la classifica.

PARTITE SENZA GIRI DI MESSAGGI
Crea una partita, scegli campo, giorno e ora, e gli amici si iscrivono con un tocco. Chi arriva dopo finisce in lista d'attesa e prende il posto di chi si ritira. Quando siete in quattro l'app propone le coppie più equilibrate in base al livello.

CLASSIFICA ELO E A PUNTI
Inserisci il risultato set per set e la classifica si aggiorna subito: punteggio ELO per ognuno, oppure classifica a punti. Statistiche personali, miglior compagno, avversario più duro e testa a testa con ogni amico.

CAMPIONATO A SQUADRE
Squadre fisse da due: scegli il compagno, proponilo oppure estrailo a sorte (e se non ti va hai 24 ore per rifiutare). Calendario all'italiana, classifica a squadre, titolo e penitenze a scelta del gruppo.

PARTITA LIVE, INVITI E STATISTICHE
Ogni squadra ha il suo segnapunti: un tocco aggiunge o toglie un punto, con le regole del padel (set, tie-break, vantaggio, cambio campo). Gli amici seguono il punteggio in diretta. Chi crea la partita invita gli amici con una notifica. Vedi chi è online e apri le statistiche di ogni giocatore: serie di vittorie, ELO, compagni e avversari, set e game, giorni e orari in cui gioca.

UN PERSONAGGIO TUTTO TUO
Scegli tra 15 personaggi animati in stile cartone: ognuno ha le sue mosse, lo smash, la bandeja, la víbora, l'esultanza. Chi arriva primo in classifica diventa il numero 1, con corona, Sala dei campioni e un look speciale per tutta l'app.

NOTIFICHE UTILI
Ti avvisiamo quando qualcuno ti sfida, ti invita a una partita, ti propone di fare coppia, si iscrive alla tua partita, la partita è al completo, parte la partita live o viene inserito un risultato.

PRIVACY
Nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento. Ti iscrivi con il codice del gruppo, scegli un nome utente e un PIN, poi rientri solo con nome utente e PIN: niente email. Puoi eliminare l'account in qualsiasi momento dall'app.

name: Month Minder: Plan Ahead
description:
Bring all your Life Admin Minder apps together in one view.  

Month Minder is a companion app.  It gathers what your other Minder apps already know and shows it together, one month at a time. It doesn't hold any data or dates of its own. If you use two or more Minder apps, this is where you'll see everything that's coming up. If you don't use any Minder apps yet, start with one of those, and come back to Month Minder when you're ready to bring them together.

The mental load isn't only remembering each thing. It's holding them all at once: the birthday in the same week as the car registration, the insurance renewal landing just before the school holidays. Each Minder app holds one part of your life admin. Month Minder shows you the whole month in one view, so the busy weeks show up before you're in the thick of them.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See everything coming up this month from your Minder apps, in date order, each in its own app's colour/icon
• Look ahead, month by month, up to a year
• Anything late stays at the top of this month until it's dealt with
• Tick off a to-do right from the month view, and it's ticked off in the app it came from too
• Tap any item to open it in the app it belongs to
• Choose which apps to show, so you only see what you want to see
• Add a home screen widget in small, medium or large, so your month is there without opening anything
• Try an example month first, to see how it all works before you've set anything up
• See every Minder app, and what each one does, in one place

WORKS WITH YOUR MINDER APPS
• Date Minder: birthdays, anniversaries and other dates that matter
• Task Minder: to-dos with due dates
• Insurance Minder: policy renewals
• Vitamin Minder: a heads-up when supplies are running low
• Contacts Minder: gentle nudges to keep in touch
More Minder apps will join as the family grows. Sharing with Month Minder is free in every Minder app.

HOW IT WORKS
Month Minder is a subscription, monthly or yearly, and your first month is free, so you can see your own month come together before you pay. It renews automatically until you cancel, and you can cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. The example month and the list of Minder apps are free to use without subscribing.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://craftsense.co.nz/lifeadmin-privacy/

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Month Minder doesn't need an account, doesn't use analytics or ads, and doesn't send anything to a server. It only reads what your Minder apps share with it, on your own device.

Month Minder is part of Life Admin Minder, a small family of apps from Craft+Sense Studio built to take the things you usually have to hold in your head and keep them in your phone instead.

name: Moonletter: Breakup Letters
description:
Some words are better written than sent.

Moonletter is a quiet place for the days after a breakup. Write what you can't say, get through the urge to text, and count the days you choose yourself.

UNSENT LETTERS
• Write to them, to yourself, or to the person you were
• 20 gentle prompts for when you don't know where to start
• Seal a letter and lock it for 30 days, then read it again and see how far you've come
• Turn a few lines into a beautiful image to share. Their name is always hidden

DRAFT A TEXT, NEVER SEND IT
Type the message you want to send. It stays here. Nothing ever leaves the app.

NO CONTACT, WITHOUT THE GUILT
Count the days since you last talked. A slip is noted, never a reset to zero. Milestones at 3, 7, 14, 30, 60 and 90 days.

SOS WHEN THE URGE HITS
One tap: breathe slowly, read the reasons you wrote yourself, then write instead of texting. SOS is always free.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in
• Your letters stay on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded
• Lock the app with Face ID
• No ads. We never sell data

Moonletter is not therapy and does not promise to bring anyone back. It's a place to feel it, write it, and keep going. If you're in crisis, the app points you to people who can help right away.

MOONLETTER PRO
Unlimited letters, unlimited unsent texts, the 30-day lock and all 20 prompts. Choose Lifetime (pay once), Monthly or Weekly. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://hantd-studio.github.io/moonletter/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hantd-studio.github.io/moonletter/privacy

name: Moonwish
description:
Speak one wish before bed. Moonwish turns it into a personalized affirmation audio that stays with you all night.

Most manifestation apps hand you a generic playlist. Moonwish asks for one sentence and three quick taps, then builds a bedtime ritual around the life you are actually trying to live. The script streams on screen, then the audio plays in a calm voice over a theta wave or 432 Hz soundscape. Close the app, lock the phone, and keep listening.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Create a personalized affirmation audio from a wish you speak or type.
- Choose a life area: Love, Money, Career, or Myself.
- Answer three tap-only questions. No forms, no long typing.
- Watch your script appear line by line before the audio begins. The affirmations are written in second person, present tense.
- Play a seamless loop with lock-screen controls.
- Save every session in My Channel, grouped by the wish that created it.
- Browse a Moon Library of 20+ ready-to-play sessions for sleep, confidence, abundance, love, and calm.
- Write 369 journal entries, scripting pages, or gratitude notes, with optional voice dictation.
- Build a vision board with up to nine photos and turn it into an audio session.
- Set a Time Capsule date and celebrate with a shareable card when it happens.
- Review a weekly report of the days you showed up.
- Keep a forgiving moon streak. A monthly grace card covers a missed night instead of resetting everything.
- Protect your wishes and journal with Face ID.
- Back up wishes, journal entries, and streak data to your private iCloud database.
- Export your wishes and journal as a folder with a JSON manifest and your audio files.

FREE TIER
- Unlimited on-device manifestation sessions.
- 20+ Moon Library sessions.
- Vision board, 369 journal, streak, weekly report, and Time Capsule.
- Three basic soundscapes and system voices.
- Private iCloud backup and data export.

MOONWISH PLUS
- Eight-hour overnight mode with a gentle fade-out sleep timer.
- All 21 soundscapes and rituals.
- 30 deep cloud sessions each month.
- Personal Voice narration when your device supports it.
- A Cloud Booster adds 30 cloud sessions for $1.99.

AI FEATURES
- Scripts can be generated on-device with Apple Intelligence when available, through Moonwish Cloud on Plus, or with your own API key from any compatible provider.
- AI generation is unlimited with your own key. Your key is stored securely on your device and never sent to our servers.
- If no engine is available, Moonwish uses its built-in composer so you always receive audio.

PRIVACY
- No tracking, no ads, and no analytics SDKs.
- Audio is rendered and stored on your device.
- Moonwish is motivational and mindfulness content. It does not provide medical advice.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

Download Moonwish and give your intention somewhere to sleep.

name: Morphora: Plant Collection
description:
Morphora keeps a permanent record of your plant collection, the way a botanical garden keeps one.

Every plant gets an accession number the day it arrives. It also gets a record card with its botanical name, source, price and light, a photo log that builds into a visual diary, and a history of every watering, feeding and repot. No streaks, no guilt, no ads.

GROW MORE FROM WHAT YOU HAVE
• Propagation: track every batch of cuttings from mother plant to potted-up
• Sowing: seed batches from packet to pot, with germination counted as it happens
• Tissue culture: flask to windowsill, stage by stage

TODAY, AT A GLANCE
A short set of tiles for what actually needs doing. Flip one to see the fix, then tap to finish it.

FOR COLLECTORS WHO SELL
An optional selling mode adds live stock counts, supplies and cost tracking, sales from any platform, orders and invoices, an availability list, and a shareable product page for each plant.

GO AS DEEP AS YOU LIKE
Nerd Mode unlocks taxonomy: hybrid parentage, cultivars, accepted names, and a family-tree view of your collection.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Export everything any time, as a full backup file or a readable spreadsheet.

name: Moss & Morrow
description:
Moss & Morrow on kuvitettu oppimispeli arjen ympäristöteoista ja luonnosta. Lähde Verson kanssa tutkimaan koulua, kotia, puistoa ja naapurustoa. Päätä, mitä tekisit tutussa tilanteessa, lajittele tavaroita ja katso, miten valintasi vaikuttavat tarinan kulkuun.

Ympäristölaboratoriossa pääset kokeilemaan itse. Säädä hanan aukioloaikaa ja vertaa veden määrää kahdessa astiassa. Käännä käytetty paperi ja kokeile sen tyhjää puolta. Tutki, millaisia jälkiä eri reiteistä jää nurmikolle, tai siirrä vanhat kirjat hyllyyn odottamaan uusia lukijoita.

Puutarhan kuusi havaintokorttia näyttävät luonnon pieniä muutoksia vaihe vaiheelta. Seuraa mehiläisen matkaa kukasta toiseen, katso, miten kastepisara muodostuu, ja tutki, minne tuuli kuljettaa voikukan siemeniä.

Kerää tietokortteja ja merkkejä, palaa kertaamaan haastavia tehtäviä ja katso, miten puutarhasi kasvaa. Voit tarttua päivän haasteeseen tai poimia pelistä pienen teon kokeiltavaksi omassa arjessasi.

name: MotoX-Fi Commercial
description: MotoX-Fi Commercial gives businesses a focused view of every GPS-equipped truck, trailer, and piece of equipment. Monitor live device locations on an interactive map, see fleet status at a glance, review routes and stop durations, and configure speed, battery, and offline alerts. Built for teams that need dependable equipment visibility from the field to the office.

name: Mreader - EPUB & PDF Reader
description:
A serene, private reading room for your books and documents.

Mreader is a clean, focused reading app designed for book lovers who appreciate refined typography and privacy. Supporting EPUB, PDF, and TXT formats, Mreader delivers an elegant Ink & Paper aesthetic, powerful self-hosted cloud connectivity, and distraction-free reading on both iPhone and iPad.

【Versatile Formats & Refined Typography】
- Seamlessly opens EPUB, PDF, and plain text (TXT) files, with instant loading for large volumes.
- Choose between continuous vertical scrolling or authentic page-curl navigation.
- Curated reading palettes including classical Ink & Paper, warm cream, soft green, and true dark mode.
- Customize fonts, line spacing, margins, and text alignment; import custom fonts via Wi-Fi.

【Connect Your Private Cloud & NAS】
- Local Network Access: Connect directly to your home NAS or server via SMB (SMB2/SMB3).
- Self-Hosted Storage: Native support for WebDAV servers, as well as Jellyfin and Emby media libraries.
- Fast Wi-Fi Transfer: Easily upload books and custom fonts from your computer’s browser without cables.

【Notes, Highlights & Bookmarks】
- Highlight meaningful passages, record personal thoughts, and look up definitions or translations.
- Export beautiful stationery-style quote cards to share with friends or save to your reading journal.
- Full-text search across book chapters and personal reading notes.

【Thoughtful Companion Tools】
- On-Device Read Aloud: Listen to your books using high-quality system speech synthesis with synchronized sentence highlighting.
- Reading Statistics: Track your reading sessions and cumulative hours spent across all your books.
- Public Book Lists: Discover curated titles inspired by Goodreads and Douban reading lists.

【Private by Design】
- No accounts, no sign-ups, no ads, and no tracking.
- All credentials stay securely stored in your device’s keychain. Your library is entirely yours.

name: MT VISUALS AU
description:
The MT VISUALS AU app is the client portal for MT VISUALS AU, a photography, drone and video studio serving Werribee, Wyndham and Melbourne's west.

Real estate agencies, property managers and other clients use it to:

• Book a shoot in seconds: pick the service, enter the address and choose from live available times
• See every job for their office in one list, with dates, times, key pick-up and status
• Change the time or cancel a booking they made
• Get a notification when a shoot is booked, moved or delivered
• View, flag and download finished photos straight from the app
• Leave notes on a photo (for example "brighten the kitchen") so changes are sorted quickly

For MT VISUALS AU, the app also runs the day: today's jobs with navigation, one-tap job progress updates, the week calendar and new bookings, so clients are kept up to date automatically.

Signing in uses a secure login link sent to your work email, with no password to remember. New to MT VISUALS AU? Tap "Try the demo" on the login screen to explore the portal with sample jobs.

name: Mushafy - Scroll the Quran
description:
Turn your scrolling into remembrance.

Mushafy is a calm, daily Quran habit for people who reach for their phone a hundred times a day, so that a few of those moments can be with the Quran.

READING IS FREE, ALWAYS
• The classic reader: all 114 surahs in the Uthmani script, with translation in English, Turkish, German, Albanian or Bosnian
• Continue exactly where you left off
• Listen to a verse or a whole surah from renowned reciters
• Save the verses that move you
• Daily goals of 5, 10, 20 or 50 verses, with streaks. Each verse counts once a day, so your progress stays honest

READ TOGETHER
• Create a family circle or a circle of friends with a simple invite code
• See each other's daily totals and send a verse to someone you love
• Chat privately, only with people you share a circle with, with block and report built in
• Leaderboard: "Race to good deeds" (2:148) with your circles or everyone. You can hide yourself anytime
• Take a juz in any khatm and every verse you read counts toward it automatically

YOUR PRIVACY
Which verses you read stays private unless you choose to share it. No ads, no tracking, and we never sell your data.

MUSHAFY PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)
• Scroll Feed: one full-screen verse per swipe
• Topics and moods like patience, hope and gratitude
• Home and Lock Screen widgets and calm color themes
• Beautiful verse share cards
• Fajr alarm and reading insights
• Start your own khatm for a loved one
• Share Premium with up to 4 people in your family circle at no extra cost

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with a free trial on the yearly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Quran text: Tanzil.net (Uthmani), unmodified.

Terms of Use: https://mushafy-production.up.railway.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mushafy-production.up.railway.app/privacy

name: My Life Square
description:
My Life Square (MLS) is a personal life reflection and planning app designed to help you develop a balanced and meaningful life.

Explore four key areas:
• Health – Reflect on physical well-being and daily habits.
• Belief – Review personal values, purpose and reflection.
• Knowledge – Track learning and personal development.
• Relationships – Reflect on connections with family, friends and others.

KEY FEATURES
• Starting Balance assessment
• Daily activity updates
• Active Life Planning (ALP)
• Long-term Life Planning (LLP)
• Progress tracking by life area
• Multiple language options
• Personal backup and restore

My Life Square helps you understand your current life balance, identify areas for improvement and monitor changes over time.

Your life. Your balance. Your progress.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: My Nail Notebook: Nail Records
description:
My Nail Notebook keeps your self-done and salon nails with photos and a record for each finger.

- Per-finger records: tap a finger on the hand illustration to note color, brand, art and parts. Copy a color to other fingers or a whole hand.
- Any color: pick from the full color range, including nudes, white, gray and black. Find looks later by color family, including gold and silver.
- "Want to try" list: collect designs you love and move them to your records once you've done them.
- Easy to look back: filter by color and tags (seasons, office, Korean style, Chinese style, and your own tags). Note how many days it lasted, costs and time.
- Backgrounds: clear aurora, magnet, milk, candy and more. Tilt your iPhone to see the depth move.
- Salon Edition (in-app purchase): client records (things to watch out for, nail condition, visit history, next visit) and a full-screen Show-to-client mode.
- Privacy: records, photos and client details stay on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no analytics. Lock the app with Face ID. Export a password-protected backup when you change phones.

Pricing
Basic recording is free.
- Pro (one-time): finger beautify (slightly slimmer, longer-looking fingers with softened wrinkles and brighter skin; nail shape and color unchanged), color reading from photos (a guide), all backgrounds
- Salon Edition (one-time): client records, Show-to-client mode, everything in Pro
- Background packs (one-time), tips

Finger beautify and color reading may not work well depending on the photo. Your original photo can always be restored.

name: My Pet: passaporto animali
description:
My Pet è il passaporto digitale del tuo cane: tutta la sua salute in un'unica app, sempre in tasca.

PASSAPORTO E VACCINAZIONI
• Scheda del cane con foto, razza, data di nascita, peso, microchip, allergie e terapie
• Vaccinazioni e antiparassitari con scadenza calcolata in automatico
• Promemoria una settimana prima e il giorno della scadenza
• Riepilogo del libretto sanitario in PDF, da stampare o inviare al veterinario

REFERTI E DOCUMENTI
• Scansiona referti, analisi e fatture con la fotocamera
• Tutto ordinato per categoria e data
• Il totale delle spese veterinarie sempre sotto controllo

CLINICHE VETERINARIE VICINE
• Trova i veterinari intorno a te o in qualsiasi città, sulla mappa
• Chiama, ottieni il percorso o apri il sito con un tocco
• Filtro per pronto soccorso e cliniche H24
• Salva i tuoi veterinari di fiducia

POLIZZE E RIMBORSI
• Le tue polizze con massimali, franchigie e scadenze
• Compila la denuncia di sinistro e la richiesta di rimborso delle spese veterinarie
• La lettera in PDF viene preparata con i dati della polizza e le fatture già caricate
• Inviala per email con gli allegati già pronti e segui lo stato della pratica

CANE SMARRITO
• Crea in pochi secondi il volantino con foto, dati e il tuo numero
• Condividilo subito su WhatsApp, nei gruppi di quartiere e sui social
• I consigli su cosa fare se il cane si è perso o se ne hai trovato uno

PRIVACY PRIMA DI TUTTO
Nessun account e nessuna pubblicità. I tuoi dati restano solo sul tuo iPhone.

My Pet non sostituisce il veterinario né il passaporto europeo per animali da compagnia. In caso di emergenza contatta subito un veterinario.

name: My Quiet Bible
description: My Quiet Bible is just a Bible: more than 100 public-domain and openly licensed versions in many languages, with nothing else in the way. No plans, no ads, no tracking. Read offline, search in plain words (“love your enemies”), hear any chapter read aloud, and pray with one button. Your spoken prayers stay on your phone. If you like, share verses and prayers with a small private circle of people you invite. An account is optional.

name: MySootra Guide
description:
The partner app for astrologers and pandits on MySootra.

This app is for practitioners only. If you are looking for a consultation, download MySootra instead.

Apply to join
Register with your details, the services and topics you practise, your languages and your experience. Our team reviews every application, including a phone conversation, before a profile goes live.

Control when you are available
Separate switches for chat and video. Go online when you are free, offline when you are not. Customers only see you as available when you say you are.

Take consultations
Receive requests and consult over chat or video. See the customer's birth details and their question before you begin. Your full consultation history stays in the app.

Track what you earn
See what each consultation earned, your running balance and your payout history, at the per-minute rate set for your profile.

Build your profile
Your photo, bio, experience, languages and verified badge are what customers see first. Ratings and reviews from completed consultations appear on your profile.

Available in English and Hindi.

Access requires an approved MySootra partner account. Applications are reviewed by our team and approval is not guaranteed. Rates and commission are set by MySootra and shown in the app before you go online.

name: Nachtdorf: Party Game Narrator
description:
Moon Wolves are hiding in Night Village. At night they chase people out of the village; by day they play innocent. Which of you is one of them?

Nachtdorf is the party game of secret roles for 6 to 18 people around a table – and the app runs the game. Nobody has to sit out to narrate: everyone plays.

HOW IT WORKS
• Enter the names and the app suggests a role mix – change it as you like.
• Pass the device around: everyone secretly looks at their role card with a short explanation.
• The night: the app announces nightfall and calls each role – with voice and large text. Whoever is called opens their eyes and taps their choice.
• The day: the app announces who was chased out during the night. You discuss with a timer, point at someone on three and tap in the votes. A tie leads to a runoff.
• At the end: the recap shows who was who and what happened each night.

TWO NIGHT MODES
• Device in the middle: the app calls every role. Roles that are already out are still called for show – so the flow gives nothing away.
• Pass the device: everyone holds the device for a moment at night. Roles without a night task tap something to keep up appearances – nobody can tell who has a role.

BASE GAME (FREE)
6 roles: Neighbor, Moon Wolf, Stargazer, Lamplighter, Herbalist and Sleepwalker – in the world "Night Village". Play as often as you like, no ads.

PACKS
• Extended Roles: 8 new roles – Mist Wolf, Siblings, Blacksmith, Bridgekeeper, Dreamer, Heir, Stranger and Accomplice.
• Scenarios: 3 worlds with their own narration and colors – Gullport, High Pasture and Selene Station.
• Everything: both packs together.
Each pack is a one-time purchase, no subscription. Purchases can be restored at any time.

MADE FOR THE GAME TABLE
• Natural voice in English and German (your iPhone/iPad’s voices), adjustable volume or switched off
• Several versions of every announcement – each round sounds different
• Large text, large tap targets, iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
• Your game is saved in case the phone rings
• Atmospheric but never brutal: whoever is out is simply chased out of the village or banished

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no ads, no analytics. Nachtdorf works completely offline; names stay on your device.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://brightpage.net/nachtdorf#datenschutz

name: NadiAI Atlas
description:
NadiAI Atlas brings your company's Atlas agents to iPhone. Talk or type to Mira, your AI assistant, and get answers from your own Salesforce and Slack, wherever you are.

REVENUE BUDDY — TALK TO YOUR PIPELINE
• Ask out loud: "How is my pipeline this quarter?", "What's past its close date?", "Biggest three deals closing next month?"
• Mira answers from your own Salesforce, in plain words, with links to the records.
• Need a change? Mira reads it back and updates one field only after you say yes.

SLACK AGENT — CATCH UP AND REPLY
• "What's waiting on me?" — the threads and mentions that need your answer, across the channels you're in.
• Find the decision, the owner or the latest on a deal, and connect it to the pipeline.
• Ask Mira to draft a reply: you see the exact text on a card and nothing is posted until you tap Post.
• Chat or voice — switch any time.

BUILT FOR WORK
• Invite-only: your company's Atlas administrator adds you. Sign in with your work email and password, or Google.
• Two-factor authentication when your account has it on.
• Mira works as you, with your own connections and permissions — never anyone else's.
• You stay in control: every post, email or Salesforce change waits for your approval, and you can stop Mira at any time.
• Your voice and questions go to AI service providers only after you give permission, which you can withdraw in Profile.

Atlas requires an account at a company that uses NadiAI Atlas. To learn more, visit nadiai.ai.

name: Nameling: Baby Names
description:
Find a baby name you both like, with real numbers from the US Social Security records.

Nameling shows you one name at a time. Swipe right on names you like, left on the ones you don't, and up on the ones you love. Invite your partner with a link or a short code and Nameling shows you the names you both like. No account, no ads, no subscriptions and no limit on swipes.

Real names, real numbers
• More than 30,000 names given to babies in the US
• How many babies were given each name in 2025, its rank, and whether it's rising or falling
• How likely another child in the class is to share it
• Its history back to 1880
• In the UK? Switch to the official figures for England and Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland. Somewhere else? Nameling adds the UK and US records together

Choose together
You each swipe on your own phone, in your own time. When you both like a name, it joins your matches, and a name you both love gets two stars. Neither of you sees the other's passes. Nameling also suggests names close to what you've each liked.

Narrow it down
• A shortlist of every name you've liked or loved
• Name-off: pick between two names at a time to rank your favorites
• See each name with your last name and a middle name, and check the initials

When you've decided
• Tap This is the one, add the middle name, and share the news with a picture for the family chat
• Add the due date and Nameling can remind you on the day
• Then make a birth announcement card with the date, time and weight

The story behind the numbers
• The real top 10, with every spelling counted: together, Sophia and Sofia are the most popular girls' name, well ahead of Olivia
• When most people with each name were born, and how its last few years have gone
• Names that switched from boys to girls, how name endings have changed, and the year's biggest climbers
• Names that are big in the US but rare in the UK, and the other way round

Ideas when you're stuck
• The top 100 for any year, and how far each name moved
• Names back from the 1900s, names rising fast, and more
• Names like any name you're drawn to, and a deck that learns from your likes
• Search by letters, meaning, origin, popularity, trend, length and syllables, or tap Surprise me
• Browse by origin, or from A to Z

Leave out what you'd never choose
Hide hyphenated names, other spellings, nicknames, names given to both boys and girls, or whole origins, so your deck only shows names you might pick.

Where names come from
Where nearly every name comes from, what most of them mean, and how to say them.

Made for iPhone
Every name and number is built in, so it works offline. Haptics as you swipe, the share sheet for links and name cards, shortcuts from the Home Screen, a reminder on the due date, and text that follows your iPhone's text size.

Private by design
No account and no tracking. Your swipes stay on your phone unless you pair with a partner. If you agree, Nameling counts how it's used, with nothing that identifies you, and you can change your mind in Settings.

Numbers from the US Social Security Administration, and for the UK from the Office for National Statistics, National Records of Scotland and the Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency (Open Government Licence v3.0). Nameling is independent and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by any of them.

name: Nardella: Bible for Women
description:
Copy a verse by hand. Pray by name. See what God answered.

Nardella is a quiet place for Scripture writing and prayer, made for women. Each day gives you one verse to write out with your finger or Apple Pencil. Every page you finish is saved to your own journal. Your prayer list keeps the people and things you are praying for, and when a prayer is answered you mark the date and keep the story.

WRITE IT OUT
- Copy the day's verse by hand on a lined page, with faint guide letters you can turn off
- Three ink colors, finger or Apple Pencil, or type instead
- Each page is saved to your Journal with a calendar of the days you wrote
- Share a page as an image

A PRAYER LIST THAT REMEMBERS
- Add prayers for family, friends, work, church, yourself or the world
- Mark a prayer Answered with the date and how it was answered
- Each day Nardella brings up three prayers from your list so none are forgotten
- Share an Answered card

14-DAY PLANS FOR REAL SEASONS OF LIFE
Nine short plans, one reading a day: Rooted, Wife, Mother, Working Woman, Single and Whole, Waiting, Grief, Anxious Heart and New Season. Each day has a verse, a short reflection, a prayer and one question to write about. The plans are gentle and neutral between Christian traditions.

READ THE BIBLE
- The full Bible in the World English Bible (WEB) or the King James Version (KJV), both public domain
- Tap a verse to write it out
- Search by reference, such as Ps 23
- Listen to the day's reading with your choice of voice and speed

MORE
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with the day's verse
- An optional daily reminder, easy to turn off
- Adjustable reading text size, light and dark looks
- No ads, no account, no tracking. Everything works offline and stays on your device.

FREE TO START, PAY ONCE
Nardella is free to download. The Rooted plan, the first three days of every plan, the full Bible, listening, widgets, reminders, 10 saved pages and 12 open prayers are free. One purchase, Nardella Full, unlocks all nine plans, unlimited pages and prayers, and Answered cards. It is a single payment, not a subscription.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Nardella is in English. The app menus are translated into several languages, but the Bible text (WEB and KJV), the plans, reflections and prayers are in English only.
- The reflections and prayers were written for this app. They are a companion to your faith, not a replacement for your church, pastor or professional care.
- Bible text: World English Bible and King James Version, public domain. Sources are listed in Settings.

name: Navbat.uz
description:
Navbat.uz — O‘zbekistondagi joylarni topib, bir necha bosishda bron qilish uchun ilova. Qo‘ng‘iroqsiz va navbatsiz.

• Sartaroshxona, go‘zallik saloni, manikyur, spa, sport zali, klinika, avtoservis, o‘quv markazi va boshqalar
• Bugungi bo‘sh vaqtlar, narxlar, ustalar, rasmlar va xaritadagi manzil

name: Nawaa - نواة
description:
نواة هو تطبيق الموظفين للمؤسسات التي تدير مواردها البشرية عبر منصة نواة.

  • اطلب إجازة وتابع كل مرحلة من مراحل الموافقة
  • سجّل حضورك وانصرافك وراجع سجل دوامك
  • اطّلع على قسائم راتبك وكتبك الرسمية وعقودك
  • قدّم طلبات الخدمة وتابع حالتها
  • اقرأ إعلانات الشركة وابحث عن زملائك في دليل الفريق
  • يراجع المديرون طلبات الإجازة والعمل الإضافي والطلبات أينما كانوا

  متوفر بالعربية والإنجليزية والكردية السورانية مع دعم كامل للكتابة من اليمين إلى اليسار.
