name: NC Wizard
description:
NC Wizard puts CNC program editing and toolpath visualization in your pocket.

Designed for machinists, CNC operators, programmers, and hobbyists, NC Wizard provides a convenient way to inspect, edit, and review CNC, NC, and G-code programs directly on your iPhone or iPad.

FEATURES

• CNC Code Editor — View and modify CNC programs with touch-friendly editing controls.

• Toolpath Visualization — Examine programmed movements with zoom, pan, and playback controls.

• Split View — Work with CNC code and its corresponding toolpath graphic together.

• File Management — Open compatible programs using Apple's Files picker and save or export working copies.

• Editing Tools — Find and replace text, manage lines, and use formatting tools.

• Machine Profiles — Work with supported CNC program formats and machine configurations.

• Multilingual Interface — Access major navigation and editing controls in multiple languages.

• Sample Program — Explore NC Wizard using an included sample without requiring a CNC machine.

Built for practical use, NC Wizard brings code editing and graphic inspection together in a mobile workspace.

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

NC Wizard is an assistance and visualization tool, not a substitute for machine-specific verification. Always review and independently verify programs, coordinates, tool offsets, machine settings, and safety conditions before machining. NC Wizard does not directly operate CNC machinery.

Developed by Project 828.

name: Neon Dash: Laser Parkour
description:
Leap across glowing rooftops, ride moving platforms, and time your jumps through lasers and traps. Neon Dash is a 3D parkour game with 300 levels across six worlds, from Neon City to The Void.

• Master obstacle courses and special stages with their own hazards.
• Collect hidden coins and unlock robot skins with different perks.
• Face six bosses and return to beat your best times.
• Play in landscape with a virtual joystick, swipe-to-look camera and jump button.

name: NeuVall
description:
Bereid je wintersportreis naar Andorra voor met NeuVall. Vul je skigebied, reisdata, vervoer, verblijf en verzekeringsdekking in. Je ziet hoe ver je bent met je voorbereiding en welke zaken als eerste aandacht vragen. Vink taken af voor vertrek, onderweg en ter plaatse, of voeg je eigen taken toe.

Vergelijk uitvalsbases in de gids en schat het risico van een bergpas in op basis van je route, sneeuwval, temperatuur en voertuiguitrusting. Bij een afgesloten pas, autopech of een ongeval op de piste kun je het bijbehorende noodplan stap voor stap volgen en je voortgang bewaren. Je hebt geen account nodig. Je reisgegevens blijven op je toestel. De inschatting gebruikt je eigen invoer. Raadpleeg vóór vertrek de officiële verkeersinformatie, het weerbericht en het lawinebulletin.

name: Newslog
description:
Newslog는 읽은 기사를 옮겨 적고, 생각을 포스트잇으로 붙여 두는 기록장이에요.

빠르게 스쳐 가는 뉴스 대신, 하루 한 편이라도 천천히 읽고 내 것으로 만들고 싶은 분께 맞춰 만들었어요.

■ 기사 옮겨 적기
· 기사 원문을 한 문장씩 직접 옮겨 적어요. 몇 자를 옮겼는지도 알려 드려요.
· 링크를 붙여넣으면 기사 제목과 언론사를 자동으로 채워요.
· Safari에서 공유 버튼을 누르면 바로 Newslog에 담을 수 있어요.

■ 포스트잇 메모
· 생각이 떠오를 때마다 기사에 포스트잇을 한 장씩 붙여요.
· 원문에서 문장을 골라 인용으로 담거나, 그 문장에 대한 포스트잇을 붙일 수 있어요.
· 붙여 둔 포스트잇은 '포스트잇 모아보기'에서 벽에 붙인 것처럼 한눈에 볼 수 있어요.

■ 매일 쌓이는 기록
· 달력에서 기사를 읽은 날이 차곡차곡 채워져요.
· 오늘 몇 편, 이번 달 몇 편, 며칠 연속 기록했는지 보여 드려요.
· 한 달이 지나면 '이번 달 돌아보기'로 많이 읽은 섹션과 언론사를 돌아볼 수 있어요.
· 홈 화면 위젯과 하루 한 번 알림으로 기록 습관을 이어가세요.

■ 나에게 맞게
· 나눔명조, 함렛, 나눔고딕, 나눔손글씨 펜 등 서체를 고를 수 있고, 기기에 설치한 서체도 쓸 수 있어요.
· 포스트잇만 손글씨 서체로 바꿔 진짜 메모처럼 꾸밀 수 있어요.
· 다크 모드를 지원해요.
· 아이패드에서는 왼쪽에 기록, 오른쪽에 기사를 나란히 펼쳐 볼 수 있어요.

■ 아이폰·아이패드·Mac에서 함께
· 같은 Apple ID로 로그인하면 iCloud로 아이폰, 아이패드, Mac의 기록이 자동으로 맞춰져요.
· 기록은 내 기기와 내 iCloud에만 저장돼요. 개발자를 포함해 누구도 볼 수 없어요.
· 전체 기록을 Markdown 파일로 내보낼 수 있어요.

name: NEY Link
description:
NEY Link هو أداتك للحلول البديلة والإصلاحات في أنظمة السيارات الحديثة، الكهربائية والهجينة وغيرها.

كثير من السيارات الحديثة تأتي بواجهات لا تعرض كل الخيارات: لغة غير مناسبة، أو وقت وتاريخ ومنطقة زمنية غير صحيحة، أو إعدادات لا تجد طريقها إليها. NEY Link يتصل بنظام سيارتك عبر شبكة Wi-Fi المحلية للسيارة ويساعدك على الوصول إلى هذه الخيارات وإصلاحها بنفسك.

ماذا يقدّم لك:
• اتصال بضغطة واحدة: ابحث عن السيارة في الشبكة واتصل تلقائياً.
• اختصارات للإعدادات: اللغة، والتاريخ والوقت، والشاشة، والصوت، والبلوتوث، وWi-Fi، والتخزين وغيرها — مفيدة للسيارات التي لا تظهر فيها هذه الخيارات.
• إجراءات سريعة على شاشة السيارة: رجوع، وإغلاق كل التطبيقات، وعرض التطبيقات المفتوحة.
• أدوات تطوير وإصلاح جاهزة: تثبيت أدوات موثّقة تحسّن تجربة الشاشة في السيارة، مع منح الصلاحيات اللازمة تلقائياً.
• يعمل دون إنترنت داخل السيارة: نزّل ما تحتاجه مسبقاً ثم ثبّته لاحقاً.
• واجهة عربية وإنجليزية، مع الوضع الليلي والنهاري.
• خصوصية: الاتصال يبقى داخل شبكة السيارة المحلية، ولا يُرسل أي بيان عن سيارتك.

الاشتراك:
تنزيل الأدوات من القائمة يتطلب اشتراك NEY Link الشهري. يتجدد الاشتراك تلقائياً ما لم يُلغَ قبل 24 ساعة على الأقل من نهاية الفترة الحالية، ويمكن إدارته وإلغاؤه من إعدادات حساب Apple.

تنبيه: استخدم التطبيق والسيارة متوقفة. التعديلات على نظام السيارة على مسؤوليتك.

شروط الاستخدام: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
سياسة الخصوصية: https://neylink.netlify.app/legal/privacy.html

name: Nineplay
description:
A Nineplay é um player de vídeo que transforma a sua lista de canais e vídeos em uma experiência de streaming de verdade, com capas, sinopses, guia de programação e perfis para toda a família.

IMPORTANTE: a Nineplay é apenas um reprodutor (player). Ela não inclui, vende nem indica canais, filmes, séries ou listas. Para assistir, você conecta a sua própria lista (link M3U/M3U8 ou servidor Xtream Codes), recebida de quem tem o direito de transmitir: sua operadora ou provedor de internet, uma emissora, a TV corporativa do seu hotel ou empresa, ou o seu próprio servidor de mídia. Use apenas conteúdo que você tem direito de assistir.

TUDO ORGANIZADO SOZINHO
• Sua lista vira Início, TV ao vivo, Filmes e Séries
• Capas, sinopses, ano, nota e elenco preenchidos automaticamente
• Destaque, Top 10, Em alta, Lançamentos e Mais bem avaliados no Início
• "Chegou na sua lista", com selo Novo para o que acabou de entrar
• Canais agrupados por emissora e por estado, com o que passa agora e a seguir
• Gêneros como categorias de filmes e séries

FEITO PARA ASSISTIR
• Continuar assistindo de onde você parou
• Próximo episódio automático e botões para pular abertura, resumo e créditos
• Escolha de áudio e legenda
• Reproduz HLS, MP4, MPEG-TS, MKV e outros formatos
• AirPlay para a TV
• Busca rápida, sem se preocupar com acento ou maiúscula

PARA A FAMÍLIA
• Perfis "Quem está assistindo?", cada um com a sua Minha lista e o seu histórico
• Controle dos pais: conteúdo adulto separado e protegido por PIN
• Página de cada título com temporadas, elenco, títulos semelhantes e sagas

UMA CONTA, VÁRIAS TELAS
A mesma conta Nineplay funciona no iPhone e na Smart TV. Entre com a Apple ou com o seu e-mail.

SEUS DADOS PROTEGIDOS
Os dados de acesso da sua lista ficam guardados só neste iPhone, no Keychain. Você pode desconectar a lista ou excluir a sua conta a qualquer momento, dentro do app.

ASSINATURA
A Nineplay funciona com assinatura, mensal ou anual:
• Individual: 1 tela assistindo por vez
• Família: até 3 telas ao mesmo tempo
O pagamento é cobrado na sua conta Apple. A assinatura renova automaticamente, a menos que a renovação seja desativada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período atual. Você gerencia e cancela a assinatura nos Ajustes do iPhone. Quando oferecido, o período de teste grátis vale para novos assinantes elegíveis.

Termos de Uso: https://conta.nineplay.com.br/termos/
Política de Privacidade: https://conta.nineplay.com.br/privacidade/

name: NIST Score
description:
NIST Score is an independent educational app by George Foster for practicing and recording classroom drone flights on iPhone and iPad.

SET UP A CONSISTENT SESSION
Record the pilot, observer, instructor, aircraft, lane configuration, and classroom scoring target. Note adapted layouts so you can compare attempts fairly.

SCORE AND REVIEW
Use Level 1 and Level 2 scoring based on the supplied NIST 2023A reference sheets. Record flight time, score individual targets, document safety stops, and add a debrief for the next practice session. Passing targets are instructor-selected classroom targets.

KEEP A RECORD OF PROGRESS
Save attempts on your device, search flight records, and reopen a trial for review. Scoring and recordkeeping work offline. No account is required.

EXPORT YOUR RESULTS
Save a PDF report with item scores or a CSV for Excel and Numbers. Choose a local folder or a supported provider in Apple Files, including Google Drive when its app is installed, signed in, and enabled. Sharing and cloud uploads require the relevant service and may require internet. Export and restore JSON backups to transfer complete app records between devices.

FREE FOR CLASSROOM PRACTICE
No ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Records are stored locally, with no automatic cloud sync or developer-operated account service. You choose when and where to export a copy.

EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY

NIST Score is an independent educational tool created by George Foster for classroom instruction and practice only. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, approved by, or endorsed by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), the U.S. Department of Commerce, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or its Science and Technology Directorate (S&T), ASTM International, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), or the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT). Scores and reports are classroom practice records only; they do not constitute official certification, accreditation, pilot licensing, flight authorization, or a determination of compliance. Organization names and reference materials identify their sources only; no endorsement is implied.

The app does not control aircraft, assess airspace, or provide flight authorization. Users remain responsible for safe operations and applicable local requirements. The app and first release listing are in English.

Support: george.a.foster1@icloud.com

name: Niveau 2
description:
Un niveau 2 par jour. Presque impossible.
Toute la France joue le même niveau, et presque tout le monde le rate. Toi, tu le réussis ?
Chaque victoire fait grimper ton département au classement.

LE DÉFI DU JOUR
Touche une tuile libre : elle file dans ta barre de 7 cases. Trois pareilles s'envolent. Vide le plateau pour gagner. Barre pleine : perdu.
Simple à comprendre, très dur à finir. Tu réessaies autant que tu veux, toute la journée. À minuit (heure de Paris), un nouveau défi arrive.

JOUE POUR TON DÉPARTEMENT
Choisis ton département : ta 1re victoire du jour lui donne +1 vainqueur.
Classement du jour, du mois et de tout le temps. Les petits départements ont leur chance : on compare les vainqueurs pour 100 joueurs.
Le 13 contre le 59, le 29 contre le 2A : à toi de jouer.

LE NIVEAU 3, POUR LES VAINQUEURS
Tu as réussi le niveau 2 ? Le niveau 3 s'ouvre : 300 tuiles, de nuit, pour la gloire.

38 TIMBRES À COLLECTIONNER
Séries de 3, 7 ou 30 jours, victoire en moins de 3 minutes, plus rapide de France, Noël, 14 Juillet… Et 10 niveaux à franchir, de Recrue à Immortel.

DES AIDES QUAND ÇA COINCE
Sortir 3, Annuler, Mélanger, Se relever : une fois chacune par partie, contre une courte pub, ou sans pub avec l'offre « Aides sans pub ».

TES TUILES, TA RÉGION
Packs Bretagne, Provence, Ch'ti, À la plage, Noël, Halloween : joue avec les tuiles qui te ressemblent.

PARTAGE TA VICTOIRE
Une image prête à envoyer : « Le 13 a gagné ! ». Invite tes amis : chaque ami qui crée son compte te donne une aide.

Gratuit, sans inscription pour commencer. Crée ton compte (Apple, Google ou e-mail) pour que tes victoires comptent pour ton département.

Niveau 2 contient des pubs et des achats intégrés facultatifs.

name: NivqaroSeltrox
description: A measurement tool for forwarders: trailer volume, load mass, cycle time, productivity, fill rate, slope and fuel consumption. Calculate real-time values and export data in PDF, CSV or DXF format.

name: NoRetakes AI
description:
Post your best take, every time.

Talk to the camera the way you naturally do: repeat a line until it lands, pause to think, say "um". NoRetakes AI finds the retakes, false starts, filler words and long pauses and cuts them for you, so only your best take is left.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a video from your library, or record one in the app.
• NoRetakes AI transcribes it and marks what to cut: earlier tries of a line you repeated, false starts, stutters, filler words and dead air.
• Review the edit in the transcript. Tap a word to jump to it, double-tap to cut it or bring it back. Undo anything.
• Save the finished video to Photos at full quality, up to 4K, in the same format you filmed it in. Or optimize it for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube or WhatsApp.

FEATURES
• Keeps your best take: said a line three times? The AI keeps the one that worked.
• Edit by text: every cut shows in the transcript, so fixing an edit takes seconds.
• Timeline: trim, crop, split and cut ranges by hand when you want full control.
• Animated captions: five styles that follow your edit. Burn them in, or share an .srt file.
• Overlap audio (Pro, Ultimate): each clip's sound runs briefly under the next, so cuts feel smooth.
• Batch edits (Pro, Ultimate): pick up to 20 videos and get a notification as each one is ready.

LANGUAGES
Works with English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Czech, Slovak, Slovenian, Croatian, Bulgarian, Romanian, Hungarian, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian and Maltese. More languages are on the way.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your video never leaves your iPhone. To make the edit, NoRetakes AI sends only the sound, which is deleted from our server as soon as the edit is ready. An AI model reads the transcript text to find the cuts. No ads, no tracking.

PLANS
Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial (up to 10 AI edits during the trial).
• Starter: 50 AI edits a month, videos up to 15 minutes.
• Pro: 150 AI edits a month, videos up to 30 minutes, overlap audio, batch edits.
• Ultimate: unlimited AI edits (fair use), videos up to 60 minutes, overlap audio, batch edits.
Monthly and yearly options are available; prices are shown in the app.

name: Noviscan
description:
Noviscan turns the cameras you already own into a watch that tells you who is at your door — and stays entirely yours.

This app is the mobile companion to a Noviscan server that you run yourself. It does not work on its own: you install Noviscan at home or on your own hardware, and this app connects to it.

WHAT IT DOES

• See your alerts, with the photo and the video clip that triggered them.
• Recognise the people you know. Noviscan learns the faces you name — family, neighbours, the postal worker — and tells you when someone is not among them.
• Review unknown faces at your own pace, and name them in one tap.
• Watch your home from anywhere, over a direct encrypted link to your own server.
• Lock the app behind your fingerprint or face.

HOW IT IS DIFFERENT

Your recordings never reach us. There is no Noviscan cloud account, no subscription inside this app, and no advertising. Faces are recognised on YOUR server, and the videos stay there. When you are away from home, the app opens a direct, end-to-end encrypted connection to your own machine — our rendezvous service introduces the two ends and then steps aside; it never sees your images.

PAIRING TAKES ONE SCAN

Open Noviscan on your computer, display the pairing QR code, scan it with this app. The app then talks to your server over TLS, validated against a certificate authority unique to your installation.

WHAT YOU NEED

• A Noviscan server, installed on your own machine.
• Cameras already connected to it.

Noviscan is published by Secufor, a French company. The app is available in English and French.

name: Noyzimp
description:
NOYZIMP · STUDIO MATH RACK

FORMAT
Four rack modules on a side rail, plus the Patch Bay drawer. iPhone, landscape. Works offline. No account.

01 · CLOCK
In: tempo from 10 to 999 BPM by keypad, fader, NUDGE ±1 or TAP (four taps or more).
Out: note lengths in ms and Hz, straight, dotted and triplet.
Ref: 120 BPM, 1/8 dotted = 375.00 ms.

02 · TUNER
In: a note from C-1 to G9, or any frequency from 8 to 13 000 Hz.
Set: A4 reference from 415 to 466 Hz, cents trim from −50 to +50.
Out: nearest note and cents, MIDI note number, period, wavelength in air at 20 °C, octaves, fourths and fifths.
Ref: A4 440 Hz, period 2.27 ms.

03 · METER
In: level in dB, or a voltage or power ratio.
Out: voltage ratio, power ratio, dBFS with 16-bit and 24-bit peak values, headroom, and analog line-up in dBu (EBU R68 and SMPTE RP155 references).
Ref: +6 dB ≈ 2.00× voltage ≈ 3.98× power.

04 · BUFFER
In: a length in samples, milliseconds or beats.
Set: sample rate from 44.1 to 192 kHz.
Out: the same length in the other two units.
Ref: 128 samples at 48 kHz = 2.67 ms.

PATCH BAY
Song Recall: save a song's tempo and key, then recall it onto every module.
Scribble Strip: hold any readout tile to pin it.
Console Setup: session sample rate, decimal places, note-length display.
Engineer's Notes: delay and reverb timing, modulation, instrument fundamentals, frequency bands, levels and latency.

HANDLING
Tap a tile to copy its value. Hold to pin. Bad input shows a plain-language fault instead of a wrong number.

NETWORK: none. ADS: none. DATA: stays on device.

description:

A FEW MINUTES A DAY
• 62 short lessons: one key idea, a few cards and three takeaways.

Lessons, quizzes, reviews and practice exams are free, with a banner ad that never appears during a question. Octo Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription) adds the Mega Quiz and removes all ads.

Octo doesn't replace your instructor or your training in the water. When in doubt, your instructor's word comes first.

In English and French.

name: ONEUP: Push-up Counter

description:
Floor or Back. One set, from the first count to the saved record.
ONEUP lets you choose where your iPhone goes while keeping the same spoken-count, finish and review flow. Open the app and start a set without choosing a training plan or rep target.

CHOOSE YOUR PHONE PLACEMENT
• Floor: place your iPhone face-up on the floor under your face. The phone stays on the floor while distance sensing counts your push-ups.
• Back: rest your iPhone screen-up on your mid-back. Motion sensing counts the rise and fall, and spoken counts let you follow the set when the screen is out of sight.
Both placements use the same controls, voice feedback and workout records. Choose a mode, tap Start and get into position during the 3-second countdown.

HEAR THE COUNT, FINISH THE SET
Voice and haptics give feedback as the count advances. You can tap the large number to add a missed rep manually.
After at least one rep, 8 seconds without another rep automatically ends and saves the set, without needing to reach for the end control. You can also hold the end control to finish it yourself.

LOOK BACK AT THIS SET
Your result brings together the count, duration and a chart of the intervals between counts. See how the pace changed within the set, then start another set or make a result card to share or save to Photos.
If the record cannot be written, ONEUP marks it as not saved and offers a retry. Keep the app open until saving succeeds; pending records are held in memory.
History shows weekly totals, your streak, your best set and the latest 3 sets for free.

LAYOUTS FOR IPHONE DUO
The compact outer-display layout keeps setup and controls accessible. On the inner display in landscape, the result places set metrics beside the interval chart. Counting, history and sharing also adapt to the available space. Automatic counting depends on the sensors and permissions available on your device.

SENSORS AND ACCESS
Floor mode uses a supported front TrueDepth camera to measure changes in distance. If the camera is unavailable or access is denied, it uses the proximity sensor, which requires a much closer approach. Back mode requires motion sensors. If sensing is unavailable or interrupted, the app shows recovery guidance and the manual-count option.

YOUR RECORDS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
Counting and history work offline, with no account, ads or analytics. The depth camera processes distance data without recording, saving or uploading images.

ONEUP PRO (optional, one-time purchase)
Both counting modes, voice feedback, weekly stats and the latest 3 sets are free. Pro unlocks the month view, full history and two extra share-card themes. No subscription.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese.

Questions or feedback: oneup@cometseek.com

name: ONIT: Campus Gigs
description:
ONIT is a campus marketplace for college students, starting at UC Berkeley. Find a hand when you need one, offer what you're good at, and earn money from gigs a few minutes away.

GET HELP ON CAMPUS
Post what you need, like moving a desk, tutoring before a midterm or a package pickup, and hear back from students nearby.

EARN BETWEEN CLASSES
Browse open requests on the campus map, send an offer, agree on a price and time in chat, and get booked.

ASK YOUR FRIENDS FIRST
Turn on Friends first and your friends see your request for 30 minutes before the rest of campus.

PAY EACH OTHER DIRECTLY
Students pay each other with Venmo, Zelle or cash. ONIT never holds your money and there is no checkout.

A RECORD YOU CAN TRUST
When a job is done, the worker marks it done and the poster confirms the amount paid and how. Both of you rate each other, and your earnings and history stay in one place.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Sign up with your school .edu email or Sign in with Apple. Hide your name on posts, report any post, profile, chat or message, block anyone, and delete your account at any time.

Privacy Policy: https://onit-campus.web.app/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://onit-campus.web.app/terms.html

name: ONPOS AI
seller_name: CENTRIX PLUS INTEGRATED COMPUTER SOLUTIONS LLC
description:
ONPOS AI is a fast, reliable point of sale for restaurants, cafés and shops, connected to your Odoo back office.

TAKE ORDERS YOUR WAY
• Dine-in by table, takeaway and delivery orders
• Floor plan with live table status, bookings and deposits
• Product photos, variants, modifiers and add-ons, notes for the kitchen

SPLIT AND PAY
• Split a bill by moving items to new bills — totals and discounts stay right
• Split equally between 2 to 10 guests
• Tips of 5%, 10%, 15% or a custom amount
• Cash with quick "cash given" buttons and change, card and KNET payments
• On-screen and printed receipts with English and Arabic labels

KITCHEN
• Send orders to the kitchen display and kitchen printers
• Hold items and fire them when the guests are ready
• Mark items sold out per branch in Odoo — every iPad updates within half a minute

SCAN
• Scan product barcodes with the camera or a barcode scanner
• Weight and price labels from your scale
• Customer and loyalty cards

DISCOUNTS, LOYALTY AND PRICELISTS
• Order and line discounts with manager approval
• Coupons, loyalty cards and gift cards
• Pricelists per customer and quantity breaks

BUILT FOR THE REAL WORLD
• Works offline — sales are saved on the iPad and sync to Odoo when you are back online
• Employee PIN and Face ID sign-in, manager approval for voids and refunds
• Till report, cash in/out and session closing

ONPOS AI needs an ONPOS-enabled Odoo server. Contact Centrix Plus to get started.

name: Onyx: Local AI Notes
description:
Your private second brain. Talk or type, and Onyx turns it into a beautiful, organized note with headings, checklists and tables, then files it in the right folder. Automatically.

- AI that runs on your device, never on a cloud AI
- Your notes stay on your devices and your own iCloud, never on our servers
- No account, no ads, no subscription
- Made for iPhone Duo, iPhone and iPad

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap the mic and talk, or type a quick note
- Onyx writes it up: a title, headings, bullet points, checklists and tables
- It files the note in the right folder, or makes a new one. No setup.
- Works offline, even in airplane mode: speech to text and AI formatting both happen on your device

EVERYDAY NOTES, DONE FOR YOU
- Meetings: decisions and action items, with a checklist of who does what
- Trips: packing lists and an itinerary by day and time
- Recipes: ingredients and steps, from a quick voice memo
- Journal entries, study notes, to-do lists and ideas

ASK ONYX TO EDIT, BY VOICE OR TEXT
- "Add sunscreen to my Vegas trip list" updates the note you already have
- "Make this a checklist", "Use bullet points", "Make this a table"
- "Fix grammar", "Translate to Spanish", "Make it more formal", "Shorten"
- Preview every change, then Keep or Undo. Version history saves your last 20 versions.

CAPTURE FROM ANYWHERE
- Scan documents, whiteboards and receipts, or add photos
- Import your notes from Apple Notes
- Save to Onyx from the share sheet in any app
- Siri and Shortcuts: "New Onyx note", "Add to Groceries in Onyx"

FIND ANYTHING
Search finds notes by meaning, not only exact words. Ask "what did we decide about the launch?" and Onyx answers from your own notes, with links to them.

BEAUTIFUL ON EVERY SCREEN
- iPhone Duo: unfold for folders and notes side by side with the note open
- iPad: a full split view with keyboard shortcuts
- Light and dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver
- Swipe to pin, share, move or delete. Deleted notes wait 30 days in Recently Deleted.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Formatting runs on Apple Intelligence on your device
- Your voice is turned into text on device. Audio is never uploaded.
- We never see your notes
- Optional iCloud sync goes to your own private iCloud. Onyx has no servers.
- No account, no ads, no tracking. Data Not Collected.
- Check it yourself in Settings > Privacy & Security > App Privacy Report

FREE, WITH A ONE-TIME PRO
Free: unlimited notes, pictures and scans, AI formatting and filing, Ask Onyx, search, sharing, iCloud sync, and voice notes up to 3 minutes.
Onyx Pro is a single $14.99 purchase, not a subscription: voice notes of any length, your own folders and filing rules, templates, PDF and Markdown export, gemstone themes with matching app icons, and wallpapers. Family Sharing is on.

Good to know: AI formatting needs a device that supports Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro or newer, or an iPad with an M1 chip or later) with Apple Intelligence turned on. On other devices Onyx saves your notes as written, and everything else works.

name: Open Sky Collective
description:
Open Sky is the home of the Open Sky Collective: eight voices, nine albums, and one idea. Every song ends on its feet.

Soul ballads and country soul, modern pop and melodic rap, a duo and a modern worship choir, all singing about getting back up: the morning after, the second shift, the long way home, and the people who stay.

LISTEN YOUR WAY
• Play everything, shuffle, or start from any artist or album
• Keeps playing in the background and with your screen locked
• Lock screen, Control Center, AirPods and AirPlay controls
• Up Next queue, Play Next and Add to Queue
• Repeat one song or the whole list

READ ALONG
• Lyrics for every song
• Lyric videos where available

MEET THE ARTISTS
• Artist pages with bios, photo galleries and full discographies
• Album pages with complete tracklists, including what's still to come

MAKE IT YOURS
• Favorite songs and build your own playlists
• Download a song, an album or a whole artist to listen offline
• Dark or light theme

No account, no sign-in, no ads. Your favorites, playlists and downloads stay on your iPhone.

ABOUT THE COLLECTIVE
The members of the Open Sky Collective are virtual artists. Their voices and photographs are created with AI, and their stories are written for them. No real person's name, likeness or voice is used, and every release carries an AI-content disclosure.

name: OpenTodo
description:
OpenTodo is an open-source task manager you host yourself. This app opens your OpenTodo server and adds what only a phone app can do:

- Reminders on time, scheduled on the phone, with no push service in between
- Share links, text, photos and files from any app into a new task
- A Today widget on the home screen
- Unlock an end-to-end encrypted account with Face ID or Touch ID

You need your own OpenTodo server: enter its address on the first screen. The self-hosting guide is on the project's website, and demo.open-todo.app lets you try it without an account.

The app needs a connection to your server to start. For offline use, add OpenTodo to the home screen from Safari instead.

No trackers, no analytics, no ads. The app talks only to the server you enter.

name: Opeo for Staff
description:
Opeo for Staff is the mobile app for teams using the Opeo system — salons, studios, clinics, shops and other businesses that take appointments or run an online shop. The front desk and team members run today's day from the phone (Work mode); owners and managers keep the overview, revenue, stock and finance at hand (Manage mode).

Today
• Today's agenda with a "now" line: what is happening, what is waiting for approval, one-tap confirm or complete straight from the row.
• Quick actions: new booking, block time, search.
• "Needs attention": bookings to approve and orders to handle.

Calendar and bookings
• Team, Day, 3 days, Week and Month views; move or extend a booking by dragging, with undo.
• New booking by tapping an empty slot: branch, service and variant, team member, free slots, existing client.
• Detail with client contact (call, e-mail), payment and change history; reschedule to another slot.
• Cancel with a reason, no-show, complete — always with confirmation. Block time with one form.
• Approval queue across days and booking search by name, phone or e-mail.

Clients and team
• Client card with contacts, visits, upcoming bookings and consents; add a client or edit details.
• Team: each member's agenda and days off.

E-shop: orders, products and stock
• Orders by status, order detail, mark ready, hand over and ship with the tracking number scanned from the label.
• Pick an order item by item with the scanner and print or share a pick list PDF.
• Products: search by name, SKU or barcode, stock per warehouse, camera barcode scanner.
• Goods receipts and issues by scanning, stocktake at the shelf, stock alerts and a list of items running low.
• Bulk actions on orders and products (ready, publish, category, brand, discount).

Overview, cash register and finance
• Overview: revenue for a day, week or month broken down by branch, team member or day; e-shop revenue and orders.
• Cash register: today's sales, sale detail, day summary before closing and gift card balance.
• Finance: daily sales journal, finance overview and team payouts.

Reliability and privacy
• Changes made without signal are sent as soon as the connection is back — nothing is lost or duplicated.
• Calendar, orders and cash register update live when a colleague changes something.
• Notifications about new and cancelled bookings and new orders; confirm a pending booking right from the notification.
• App lock with Face ID / Touch ID for a shared reception phone; light and dark appearance.
• Data stays in your company's Opeo system and the app tracks nothing; crash reports contain only technical details, no names or contacts.

What you see depends on your business's subscription and your role.

Sign in with your workspace (your business address in Opeo, e.g. my-business.opeo.app), the e-mail and password of the account your administrator created. The app is for Opeo customers; it cannot be used without an account.

name: Orbis Field
description:
Orbis Field is the daily working app for medical and commercial field teams — representatives, supervisors and managers who spend their day visiting doctors, pharmacies and stores.

YOUR COMPANY PROVIDES THE ACCOUNT
Orbis Field is used by companies, not by individuals. Your administrator creates your account and gives you your sign-in details. If your company does not use Orbis Field yet, you can request a free 30-day trial from the app's sign-in screen — no credit card, and nothing is charged.

FOR THE REPRESENTATIVE
• See today's visits the moment you open the app
• Check in at the doctor or pharmacy and prove you were there
• Record the outcome, the samples you left and the order you took, in one flow
• Plan next month's visits and arrange them across the week
• Take orders, propose returns, and record collections
• Everything above keeps working with no signal, and sends itself when you are back online

FOR THE SUPERVISOR AND THE MANAGER
• One inbox for the plans, orders and accounts waiting on you
• See where the team is today and what they have finished
• Approve a month's plan, with the samples it will consume shown before you agree
• Set targets, follow attainment, and see the exceptions rather than the noise
• A library of reports covering visits, coverage, orders, returns, samples, collections and field costs

BUILT FOR THE REGION
• English, Arabic and Kurdish, with the whole app switching direction
• Iraqi governorates and territories, not a foreign map bolted on
• Prices and figures in Iraqi dinars throughout

WORKS WHERE THE SIGNAL DOES NOT
A representative's day does not stop because a pharmacy is in a basement. Check-ins, completed visits, unplanned visits, orders and new accounts are all saved on the phone and sent when the connection returns. The app tells you what is still waiting to be sent — it never claims work was saved when it was not.

ABOUT LOCATION
Orbis Field records your precise location ONLY when you check in at a visit, or when you choose to add it to a shelf check, so your company can confirm where the work happened. It does not follow you in the background, and it does not record your location at any other time. If your phone genuinely cannot get a location, you can still record the visit by writing down why — your supervisor is told, and the visit is not counted as verified.

ABOUT YOUR DATA
The company you work for is the owner of the records you create. Each company's data is kept in its own separate database. You can read what is held about you, and ask for your personal details to be removed, in the app's About screen or at field.orbis-iq.com/privacy.

Orbis Field is made in Iraq, for the way field teams here actually work.

name: OrbitCraft
description:
In high-velocity knowledge domains, professional capabilities decay according to a predictable half-life curve. OrbitCraft transforms professional mastery from passive recollection into active mathematical calibration.

Engineered with a local-first architecture, OrbitCraft computes empirical retention indices and visualizes multidimensional competence on an interactive orbit radar, empowering knowledge workers and practitioners to sustain peak capabilities through calibrated deliberate reps.

KEY CAPABILITIES

1. Multidimensional Orbit Radar
Visualize competency balance across technical, architectural, leadership, and cognitive domains. Real-time polygon geometry reflects live retention scores and orbital equilibrium.

2. Empirical Decay Modeling
Every registered skill node features personalized half-life parameters. OrbitCraft computes mathematical decay curves based on elapsed days, highlighting nodes drifting toward threshold boundaries.

3. Deliberate Practice Workshop
Engage in structured focus sessions calibrated across Quick Pulse (15m), Target Drill (30m), and Deep Mastery (45m). Record subjective friction ratings to recalibrate retention resistance.

4. 14-Day Trajectory Telemetry
Stay ahead of cognitive attrition. The predictive decay chart forecasts aggregate performance over two weeks, warning you before critical skills deteriorate.

5. Granular Node Vault
Organize, filter, and search your entire skill portfolio. Update learning objectives, review historical practice frequency, and trigger instant 15-minute reinforcement pulses.

6. Local-First Sovereignty
OrbitCraft operates entirely on your device. Zero cloud dependency, zero external analytics, and complete offline capability with full JSON data export.

name: Orbits Observer
description:
Watch the Solar System move in real time. Orbits Observer puts the Sun, the eight planets, Pluto, 19 moons, asteroids and comets on a living 3D timeline that you can turn, zoom and speed up — anywhere from the year 1700 to 2200.

EXPLORE IN 3D
• Tap any planet, moon, asteroid or comet to fly to it, then orbit it with your fingers.
• Run time forwards or backwards at the speed you choose, or jump straight to a date.
• Switch between illustrated and true-scale sizes and distances to see how vast space really is.
• Tour the structure of the Solar System, from the asteroid belt to the Kuiper Belt and the Oort Cloud.

THE SKY ABOVE YOU
• The ground sky view shows the sky from where you stand: 9,096 real stars, the 88 constellations and the Milky Way.
• Hold up your iPhone or iPad and the sky follows it, using the gyroscope and compass.
• Check sunrise and sunset times and the Moon's phase for your location.

SKY EVENTS
• Find upcoming solar and lunar eclipses, see the whole path of the Moon's shadow across the globe, and check whether an eclipse can be seen where you are.
• Plan for planetary oppositions, transits of Mercury and Venus, and a month of Moon phases.
• A guide to meteor showers, supermoons, conjunctions, equinoxes and more explains what to look for and when.

GRAVITY SANDBOX
• Turn the real Solar System into a Newtonian N-body simulation. Change a planet's mass, add new bodies or bring in the large moons, and watch every orbit respond.

AN ENCYCLOPEDIA OF THE SOLAR SYSTEM
• Every body has its own profile with key physical facts, imagery and links to the sources behind them.

BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Everything ships inside the app and works offline. No account, no ads and no tracking.
• Share an observation through the share sheet or save it to Photos.
• Haptic feedback on iPhone.
• On iPad: Split View, Slide Over, Stage Manager and hardware keyboard shortcuts.
• Available in 12 languages.

ABOUT ACCURACY
Positions of the Sun, the Moon, the planets, Pluto and Jupiter's four large moons are computed with Astronomy Engine. Other moons, asteroids and comets follow published mean orbital elements, so they are good approximations rather than precision forecasts, and some visual effects such as comet tails are illustrative.

CREDITS
Planet textures: Solar System Scope (CC BY 4.0). Orbital elements: JPL Small-Body Database. Stars: Yale Bright Star Catalogue. Each profile lists its own sources.

name: Orbity: Weekend Countdown
description:
Orbity counts down to the moment your work week actually ends: Friday at 18:00, or whenever your last shift before time off is over.

WATCH YOUR WEEK FILL UP
A glass orb fills with violet as the week goes by. When time off starts, it turns lime and slowly drains back toward Monday. Tap it for a new line about your week.

A COUNTDOWN THAT KNOWS YOUR SCHEDULE
• Set your workdays and shift hours.
• Public holidays for your country load automatically and work offline.
• A Wednesday holiday counts down to Tuesday evening. A Friday holiday turns your weekend into a long one.
• Mark vacation days and extra working days in the calendar.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Small and medium widgets show the countdown, the orb and a progress bar. They stay up to date even when the app is closed.

EVERY WEEKEND GETS A PARTY
When time off starts, Orbity greets it with a "Weekend!" screen and confetti.

A BADGE FOR EVERY WEEK
Earn badges for the weekends you reach, from your first Friday to a full year, plus a few special ones.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your schedule stays on your phone.

In English and Russian, in light and dark mode.

name: Origami Wallpapers
description:
Origami creates beautiful, one-of-a-kind wallpapers right on your device — designed for iPhone Duo, closed and open, and great on any iPhone or iPad.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Closed: sized for the outer screen
• Open: sized for the big inner screen, standing up or lying down
• Save both Duo screens at once, with matching art

7 STYLES, 9 COLOR PALETTES
• Fold — mirrored paper folds with a crease right in the middle
• Aurora — soft flowing light
• Origami — faceted folded paper
• Waves — layered hills of color
• Glass Orbs — floating glass bubbles
• Topography — map contour lines
• Bauhaus — bold geometric tiles
Tap Shuffle for endless variations: every wallpaper is unique.

A NEW WALLPAPER EVERY DAY
Use the "Create Origami Wallpaper" action in the Shortcuts app with "Set Wallpaper", and let an automation give you fresh art every morning, when your alarm stops or when a Focus turns on.

AND MORE
• Live lock screen preview with clock
• Darker option for easy reading
• Favorites
• Share with friends
• English, Português and 日本語 — switch anytime inside the app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything is created on your device.

name: Ornellion
description:
Το Ornellion είναι ένα μικρό εργαστήρι με δύο πάγκους. Στον τόρνο ρυθμίζεις ταχύτητα, βάθος, λάδι και κόκκο, και διαβάζεις στρογγυλάδα και γυαλάδα. Στο δέσιμο ρυθμίζεις τάση, κόμπους, κερί και σειρά, και διαβάζεις κούνια και κόλλημα.

Ένα βήμα τη φορά. Χωρίς ζωές, χωρίς χρονόμετρο, χωρίς διαφήμιση και χωρίς λογαριασμό. Ό,τι γράφεις μένει σε αυτό το τηλέφωνο.

• 64 βήματα τόρνου — γύρνα την ελιά και διάβασε τη στρογγυλάδα
• 78 βήματα δεσίματος — πέρασε την κλωστή και διάβασε την κούνια
• Το τεφτέρι κρατά μόνο τις λύσεις που διαλέγεις εσύ
• Το ίχνος ανοίγει με τη σειρά· κράτα το παράθυρο και ανοίγει το επόμενο

Το Ornellion δεν συλλέγει και δεν στέλνει δεδομένα. Χωρίς ανάλυση και χωρίς διαφήμιση. Αν σβήσεις την εφαρμογή, το εργαστήρι αδειάζει.

name: OtoAsistan: Araç Bakım Takibi
description:
OtoAsistan, aracınızın bakım, muayene, sigorta ve masraflarını tek yerden takip etmenizi sağlayan dijital garaj asistanıdır.

BAKIM TAKİBİ VE HATIRLATICILAR

• Muayene, trafik sigortası, kasko, MTV ve periyodik bakım tarihleri için otomatik hatırlatıcılar
• 30 gün, 1 hafta, 1 gün kala ve son gün bildirimi
• Kilometreye göre bakım uyarıları (yağ, filtre, lastik, fren)
• Birden fazla araç için ayrı kayıt: otomobil, ticari araç, motosiklet ve traktör

HARCAMA VE YAKIT TAKİBİ

• Yakıt, bakım, sigorta, vergi ve diğer giderleri kategorilere göre kaydedin
• Aylık bütçe hedefi, harcama grafikleri ve yakıt tüketimi (L/100 km) analizi
• Tekrarlayan giderler otomatik eklenir
• PDF rapor ve CSV (Excel) dışa aktarma

CANLI AKARYAKIT FİYATLARI

• Bulunduğunuz ilin benzin, motorin ve LPG fiyatları
• Zam veya indirim olduğunda bildirim
• İl, konumunuza göre otomatik seçilir veya elle değiştirilir

AKILLI ÖZELLİKLER

• Fiş, ruhsat, kilometre göstergesi ve gösterge lambalarını kamerayla okuma
• OtoAsistan AI: Araç bakımı, arıza ışıkları ve masraflar hakkında sorularınızı yanıtlar
• Ekspertiz kaydı ve piyasa değeri tahmini (bilgilendirme amaçlı)
• Bakım skoru ve günlük sürüş önerileri, bulunduğunuz yerin hava durumuna göre

KOLAYLIK

• Ana ekran widget'ları: süreler, garaj, skorlar ve akaryakıt fiyatları
• Türkçe, İngilizce, Almanca, Arapça, Rusça ve Azerbaycan Türkçesi
• Kayıtlarınız öncelikle telefonunuzda saklanır; isteğe bağlı bulut yedek

OtoAsistan Pro ile reklamsız kullanım ve sınırsız AI sohbet. Ücretsiz sürümde sohbet hakkınızı ödüllü videoyla artırabilirsiniz.

Not: Akaryakıt fiyatları ve araç değeri tahminleri bilgilendirme amaçlıdır; resmi bir kurumla bağlantımız yoktur.


Kullanım Koşulları: https://otoasistanai.web.app/kullanim-kosullari.html

Gizlilik Politikası: https://otoasistanai.web.app/gizlilik-politikasi.html

name: Ourtrait: You & Your Pet Art
description:
Ourtrait paints you and your pet in one work of art.

Add one photo of you and one of your dog, cat or other pet. Pick a style. In about a minute you get four painted versions of the two of you together, ready to keep, print or give.

STYLES
Oil after the old masters, soft watercolour, ink and brush, a royal court, the Renaissance and a cozy Christmas Eve.

MADE FOR GIFTS
Turn on "This is a gift", add a note and choose when it opens. You get a private link to send; your friend sees the portrait on the day you picked.

HOW IT WORKS
- Your first preview is free.
- Keep the portrait in full resolution with no watermark, one at a time or in a pack.
- Not quite right? Repaint once for four new versions.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY YOURS
- Your photos are used only to paint your portrait and are never used to train AI.
- Original photos are deleted within 30 days.
- Delete everything in the app at any time.
- No sign-up needed: start as a guest, or sign in with Apple to keep your portraits.

Ourtrait is for adults. Only use photos of people who are over 18 and happy to be painted.

PLANS
- One portrait: one-time purchase.
- 5 portraits: one-time pack that never expires.
- Monthly: 20 portraits a month. Yearly: 240 portraits a year.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple ID settings. Terms: https://ourtrait.ysylabs.com/terms

name: Outfit Archive
description:
Outfit Archive helps you see the wardrobe you already have and turn individual pieces into outfits you want to wear again. Build a personal collection of shirts, trousers, dresses, outerwear, shoes and accessories, then keep the details that make each item useful: color, season, size, brand, notes and a favorite marker. A visual wardrobe makes it easier to find a familiar piece, remember a forgotten layer and plan around what is ready to wear.

Create outfits from your saved garments and give each look a name and occasion. Keep an everyday combination close at hand, save a work look for a busy morning or collect evening ideas before an event. Each outfit brings its pieces together in one place, with room for notes about fit, layers and the small changes that make a combination work. Schedule a saved outfit on a day in the planner and mark it worn when the day is done.

The planner connects upcoming choices with a history of what you actually wore. Review a week, open a day for its outfit and notes, and use your history to notice useful patterns. Insights summarize wear counts and frequently used pieces, so the collection becomes a record of real habits rather than a catalog that stands still. Care reminders keep washing and maintenance beside the garments they belong to, with clear instructions and a simple way to mark a piece ready again.

Capsules help you bring a smaller selection into focus for a season or a particular purpose. For travel, prepare a packing list from your wardrobe, group the pieces by category and check them off as you pack. Keep a separate wishlist for ideas you are considering, including priority, a possible cost and a note about why the piece would help. Outfit Archive is designed for thoughtful outfit planning, practical preparation and a clearer relationship with the clothes you own.

name: Overdew: Last Done Tracker
description:
Some things don't belong on a calendar. You change the furnace filter "every few months", descale the coffee maker "when you remember", and give the dog flea medicine "about monthly". Then you can't remember when you last did any of it.

Overdew remembers for you.

Add a task, choose roughly how often it should happen, and tap the check mark each time you do it. Overdew shows how many days it has been, when it's due next, and moves anything overdue to the top. A colored ring fills up as each task gets closer to due, so you can see what needs attention at a glance.

MADE FOR THE THINGS YOU FORGET
- Home: filters, smoke alarms, dryer vent, fridge, bed sheets
- Car: oil changes, tire pressure, washes
- Pets: flea and tick treatment, nail trims, tank cleaning
- You: haircuts, toothbrush, backups, calling family
- 20 ready-made tasks to start from, or create your own

SIMPLE BY DESIGN
- One tap to mark something done, with Undo if you slip
- Due-date reminders, right on time
- Dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no sign-up
- No ads, no analytics, no tracking
- Your tasks stay on your iPhone and work offline

OVERDEW PRO: ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
The free version tracks up to 6 tasks. Overdew Pro adds:
- Unlimited tasks
- History and insights: see every time you did it, log dates you forgot, and see how often you really do each task. Overdew suggests an interval that matches your real rhythm.
- Smarter reminders: choose your reminder time, get a heads-up days before, and a nudge while something stays overdue
- Backup and export: save everything to a file or a spreadsheet, and move it to a new iPhone

Family Sharing is supported.

Questions or ideas? Tap Support on the App Store page. I read every message.

name: Ozoon Noctiphara
description:
Ozoon Noctiphara is a calm, elegant logic puzzle about cracking codes. There is no timer, no rush, only a locked vault, a few rows to work with and the quiet pleasure of thinking clearly.

Every code is a short row of glowing glyphs. You choose them from eight shapes, each with its own colour: a dot, a triangle, a square, a diamond, a plus, a star, a hexagon and a half-moon. Fill a row, press Enter and the vault answers. A mint dot means one of your glyphs sits exactly where it belongs. A gold ring means the glyph is part of the code but hides in another slot. Row by row the possibilities fall away, until only one code is left and the lock finally gives way.

The campaign leads you through thirty vaults. The first doors are gentle, with three slots and four glyphs. Later the codes grow longer and the choice of glyphs wider, until the final vaults guard six slots, all eight glyphs and symbols that may repeat. Every vault has its own row limit and its own par, and pays out up to three stars: one for cracking the code, one for doing it within par and one for solving it entirely on your own. If a vault ever feels impossible, a hint will quietly reveal one slot of the code, though the third star is the price you pay for it. Each vault you open unlocks the next.

When the clock strikes midnight, a new daily vault appears. It holds one code that is the same for every player, and its size and rules change from day to day. Hints are switched off here, and it is just you and the lock. A log of your last fourteen nights shows how many rows each code took you, and every day you crack it in a row adds to your streak.

Between heists you can step into the archive, a short quiz on the long history of secret writing. Ten questions are drawn from twenty-five true stories, from the Spartan scytale and the Caesar shift to Al-Kindi and the first frequency analysis, from Enigma, Bletchley Park and Turing's Bombe to the Navajo code talkers and the public keys that protect the modern world. After every answer a short note tells you a little more of the story.

Your progress is always within reach. See how many codes you have cracked, your average rows, the hints you have used, your stars and streaks, your fewest rows for every code size and your highest quiz score. Twelve badges wait to be earned along the way, from your very first crack to opening all thirty vaults.

The world of Ozoon Noctiphara is painted in deep night blues and lit by colourful glyphs, with a slowly turning cipher wheel drifting behind every screen. Gentle haptic clicks follow your taps, and both the clicks and the animation can be switched off in settings. The game works completely offline, asks for no account and shows no ads, and it feels just as comfortable in portrait as in landscape, on any screen size.

The door is closed and the code is waiting.

name: PainlessPWC
description:
PainlessPWC turns your iPhone or iPad into a virtual personal weather station without the expense or hassle of buying, installing and maintaining weather-station hardware. It brings local conditions, forecasts, rainfall information and weather alerts together in one convenient display. It also doubles as a dimmable bedside clock.

Your personal weather station, virtually
Choose your Home area using optional foreground location or enter coordinates manually. PainlessPWC brings together information from existing reporting stations, forecasts and precipitation estimates for your selected area. See current temperature and wind, forecast highs and lows, precipitation chances, sunrise and sunset.

Keep track of rain and changing weather
See available precipitation estimates for the past 24 hours, 7 days and 14 days. Explore up to three reporting rain gauges within 100 miles of saved Home and current-conditions stations on the map. Open Current Conditions for more detail and a forecast summary. Linked radar and nearby water-level reports open provider websites in your browser. Missing or stale information is identified. Weather coverage is focused on the United States; international support is not promised.

Read National Weather Service alerts
Open an alert to read its full text, timing and instructions for your selected area. Choose the alert-check interval in Settings. Weather updates while the app is visible and when you open or resume it, subject to refresh limits.

A weather display that also serves as a bedside clock
Use portrait or landscape and adjust the display's brightness. While the app is on-screen, the display stays awake automatically when charging or connected to power with a full battery. You can also keep it awake on battery power. Optional display shifting reduces static edges while the display stays awake.

One-time wake-up alarm or notification reminder
Choose a wake-up time and sound, and preview the sound before scheduling. Depending on device and system support, the app offers a one-time system alarm or a clearly labeled notification reminder. Apple controls system alarm presentation and volume; the app's volume slider controls sound previews. Notification reminders may be silenced by Focus, Silent Mode or notification settings. Set the alarm or reminder again for another day; it does not repeat automatically.

Check the device clock after travel
An offline warning reminds you to confirm the device's date, time and time zone. The app cannot detect the airplane-mode switch or independently verify the clock. Weather uses saved Home; alarm scheduling uses the device clock and time zone.

Free, with no ads
No PainlessPWC account is required. Review the Apple privacy policy in the app for local storage, optional location, and requests to independent weather and map providers.

Weather information sources:
National Weather Service / NOAA: https://www.weather.gov/
NOAA National Water Prediction Service: https://water.noaa.gov/
PainlessPWC does not represent any government entity.

Weather information and alarm delivery can fail or be delayed. Follow official weather warnings and use an independent backup alarm when missing one could have serious consequences. Dimming and display shifting cannot guarantee prevention of screen wear.

Published by Painless Codeworks, LLC.
Support and privacy questions: support@painlesscodeworks.com

name: Panic Climber: Jump & Climb
description:
Tap to jump. Try not to panic.

Panic Climber is a one-tap climbing game where the mountain fights back. Your little climber runs on his own: tap to jump, and tap at the end of each ledge to climb to the next one. Simple to learn, hard to master.

THE MOUNTAIN WANTS YOU DOWN
• Floors crack and crumble under your feet
• Blocks of rock fall from above: escape their shadow
• Rolling rocks, grumpy goats, icy ledges, wind, birds and lightning
• Every threat gives a warning first: fair, but fast

10 MOUNTAINS TO CONQUER
Climb from a pine forest to a red canyon, a snowy wall and a stormy summit. Each mountain brings a new danger and gets harder as you go up.

CAMPS, LIVES AND STARS
• Reach a camp to save your way back
• 3 lives per mountain: fall and you return to the last camp
• Earn up to 3 stars and a score on every summit

PLAY YOUR WAY
• One-finger controls, perfect for quick sessions
• Retro arcade music and sound effects
• Watch an optional ad or use a coin for an extra life

Panic Climber is free to play. It contains optional ads and offers coin packs as in-app purchases.

name: PanPanNotes
description:
Keep meeting audio, transcripts and notes together on your iPhone.

Record sound around you or import an audio file. Review timestamped transcripts, listen back to a passage, correct the text, add highlights and assign speaker names manually. Use a local glossary to preview and confirm terminology corrections.

With supported Apple speech and translation capabilities, transcribe audio and view the original text, a translation or both. Interface languages include English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Recognition and translation availability vary by device, language and installed models.

Create meeting notes manually from transcript passages, with source references and editable action owners and deadlines. On eligible devices, you can optionally generate notes with Apple’s on-device model after enabling the feature and confirming the input. Apple Intelligence must be enabled and its model available. Generated notes can contain mistakes and should be checked against the source. Manual notes remain available when automatic generation is unavailable.

Search your records and export audio or UTF-8 text through the iOS share sheet. Recordings and app records are stored locally; the app does not upload them to a developer-operated server or provide cloud sync.

Requires iOS 26 or later. Language-model downloads may require an internet connection. Automatic speaker identification and cloud/PCC summaries are not available. The microphone records nearby sound, not computer system audio or sound confined to headphones. Obtain any required recording permissions and respect other participants’ privacy.

name: PapiDuo: 2 Player Family Games
description:
Put the phone (or tablet) between you: one side each, face to face, and off you go!

PapiDuo brings together 12 "pencil, paper and dice" games designed for a parent and a child aged 4 to 10 to play together on the same screen. Every game builds a skill, and each game lasts about 5 minutes.

THE GAMES
• Treasure Grid — build a crossword together: every word you place reveals its picture and its definition. Over 140 words to discover!
• Guess My Drawing — one draws with a finger, the other guesses. You score as a team!
• The Hungry Robot — program your robot with arrows to grab the cake. A real first step into coding from age 4.
• Multi-Dice — roll the dice, calculate (times tables or addition) and line up 4 counters.
• Line Them Up! — tic-tac-toe, Drop Four and Five in a Row.
• Magic Shapes — fill the silhouette with shapes… and it comes to life. Play together or race.
• Dice Monsters — every number on the die adds a part to your monster. Collect them all!
• Sound Hunt — listen to the word and buzz first: first sounds, rhymes, spelling.
• Number Hide & Seek — find the hidden numbers and remember where they are.
• Air Duel — steer your missile with the die and shoot down 2 planes.
• Shut the Box — add up the dice and shut the right tiles.
• Dots and Boxes — draw lines, close boxes, don't give any away!

SO YOUR CHILD HAS A REAL CHANCE
• Levels from age 4 to 10 in every game.
• Adjustable head starts to balance parent and child.
• Hints that explain instead of punishing ("4 times 6: 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 24").
• A voice that reads instructions for children who can't read yet.
• A "play against the computer" mode (3 levels) for solo play.

WHAT IT PRACTISES
Numbers, mental math, times tables, phonics and spelling, memory, logic, coding, shapes and space, strategy, creativity… and teamwork.
On the home screen, choose what your child wants to practise: PapiDuo shows you the matching games.

NO ADS, OFFLINE, NO ACCOUNT
No ads, no purchases, no trackers, no data collection. Everything works without an internet connection.
Available in English, Spanish and French.

• Warm transfers let a colleague brief you before connecting the call

EVERY CALL IN ONE PLACE

TEXT FAMILIES

Paragon Phone is for staff at schools that use Paragon CRM. You'll need a Paragon account from your school to sign in.

name: Parking Wars: Outpark
description:
Parking Wars is a two-minute strategy game played on a crowded parking lot.

Every turn you drive one vehicle. Cars go straight, bikes cut diagonals, autos squeeze through gaps and trucks block the way. Drive onto a spot and you still have to survive one turn before you can park it, so your rival always gets a chance to bump you back to the garage. Choosing when to commit is the whole game.

• Lots across Mumbai, from a housing society to Marine Drive, with boards growing from 5×5 to 10×10, and more lots on the way
• Solo puzzles with a par and three stars for the perfect solution
• Matches against a rival that gets sharper every zone, with a boss every ten levels
• Pass and play with a friend on one phone
• Works offline; sign in with Apple or email to keep your levels and stars on every device
• No ads, no purchases

SCAN OR TYPE

• Works with EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, Code 128, Code 39, QR, PDF417, Aztec and more
• The barcode is shown large and the screen brightens automatically, so it scans quickly

RECOGNISES 150+ SHOPS

• While scanning, the app reads the text on the card and suggests the matching shop

WEEKLY OFFERS

• The shops you have a card for come first; open a card to see its deals

BACKUP, SYNC & APPLE WALLET

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your cards stay on your phone. Optionally sign in with Apple to back them up and sync them across your devices (stored on our EU server, deletable at any time)

DUTCH & ENGLISH
• The app follows your phone's language

SEE YOUR ACTIVITY

· Recettes : recherche, filtres par terroir et couleur, favoris, suppression

Pour ateliers, artisans, chercheurs en textile et cours de teinture.

name: PaverBed: Paver Sand Bed
description:
PaverBed helps hardscape crews mark patio paving zones and recommend screed sand bedding depth before ordering material.

Tap grid cells to outline walkways, pool decks, and aprons. Paver size, traffic load, and base prep update bedding depth and cubic-yard sand estimates instantly.

Save layouts on the Plan tab for repeat jobs. Offline, no account required.

name: PC Remote & Mouse: NotchPixel
description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a wireless mouse, keyboard and remote control for your Windows PC. NotchPixel Deck is a PC remote with a real trackpad, media controls, shortcut keys and power buttons, and it connects straight to your computer over your own Wi-Fi.

Use your phone as a mouse from the couch, control music and videos from bed, click through slides in a meeting, or lock and shut down your PC from across the room. It works with Windows 11 and Windows 10 desktops and laptops running NotchPixel.

USE YOUR PHONE AS A MOUSE AND TOUCHPAD
• A big trackpad: move the pointer, tap to left-click, two-finger tap to right-click
• Two-finger scroll, like a laptop touchpad
• Press and hold to drag, select text or move windows
• Left and Right mouse buttons, with gentle haptics

USE YOUR PHONE AS A KEYBOARD
• Type on your PC with your phone's keyboard: search boxes, chats, documents and video sites
• Copy, Paste and Undo keys one tap away

MEDIA REMOTE AND VOLUME CONTROL
• See what is playing on your PC, with cover art, title and artist
• Play, pause, next, previous and seek
• PC volume slider and mute
• Works with music and video apps and browsers that show their playback in Windows

PRESENTATION REMOTE
• A slide clicker for your talks: start, next slide, back, black screen and end, with a timer for your talk

SHORTCUT KEYS FOR GAMES, MOVIES AND WORK
• Game: Game Bar, screenshot, save clip, screen recording with a live timer, switch windows, mic mute
• Movie: play, skip back and forward, mute, full screen
• Work: snip, all windows, switch, copy, paste, undo, close window, show desktop

APP LAUNCHER
• Open the apps you use most on your PC with one tap, and choose which ones appear

PC POWER AND STATS
• Lock, Sleep, Restart and Shut down your PC from your phone. Restart and Shut down need a hold, so nothing happens by accident
• CPU, GPU and memory use, with temperatures where the PC reports them

PRIVATE AND SECURE
• Connects directly to your PC on your local Wi-Fi. No account, no cloud, no ads, no tracking
• Every connection is encrypted and checked against your PC's own certificate
• Each phone has to be allowed on the PC, and you can remove it at any time

SET UP IN ABOUT TWO MINUTES
1. Get NotchPixel for Windows from the Microsoft Store
2. On the PC, move the mouse onto the island at the top of the screen, open the Deck tab and press Turn on
3. Scan the code it shows with this app
4. Press Allow on the PC
New to NotchPixel? The app walks you through it, or open notchpixel.com/deck on your PC.

Works in portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad, with Frosted, Dark, Light and Auto looks.

What you need: a Windows 11 or Windows 10 PC with NotchPixel installed and PC Deck turned on, on the same Wi-Fi network as your phone. It does not work over mobile data or from outside your home network.

name: pCube Dashboard
description:
pCube Dashboard is the companion app for stores that run pCube point of sale. Sign in with an enrollment code from your store's Dashboard and run your store from your iPhone or iPad.

HOME
Net sales for today, the previous day, this month or this year, compared with the same time before. Orders, average sale, items sold, tax, top products, card versus cash and sales by register, and what needs your attention.

ALERTS
Every refund, voided sale or item and no-sale drawer opening, by day, with the employee, the register and the receipt.

HISTORY
Find any sale by receipt number or amount and open its receipt.

REPORTS
Sales by category and tax, gross profit and margin, shift and daily reports with expected and counted cash, shifts open right now (force close one left open), low stock, employee actions, promotions, inventory value and counts. Share any report as a PDF.

INVENTORY
Search or scan a barcode, add products, change prices, stock and stock alerts, see how many sold in the last 30 days, and share barcode labels.

VENDORS AND INVOICES
Keep your vendors and enter their invoices, scanning each item's barcode.

PROMOTIONS AND CUSTOMERS
Set up promotions, and see your loyalty members and their points.

TEAM AND EMPLOYEES
Who's working now, leave requests to approve, timecards, and your employees' details and roles.

REGISTERS AND SETTINGS
See your registers and devices, and change the store's settings.

The app is free. Each phone or tablet signs in with its own code, and you can sign it out from the Dashboard at any time.

name: Pearl Pocket: Jewelry Maker

Open an oyster and discover your next little treasure. Polish your pearl, add it to your collection, and turn your favorites into jewelry in Pearl Pocket, a cozy offline collecting and crafting game.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT PEARL
Let a pearl grow inside your oyster, then open the shell to reveal it. Discover six pearl colors and different levels of rarity as your collection grows.

POLISH IT TO A GLOW
Gently rub each pearl to reveal its shine. Enjoy a simple, hands-on moment before deciding what to make with your discovery.

MAKE SOMETHING YOURS
Choose your pearls and pair them with gold or silver. Create pendants, rings, bracelets, stud earrings, drop earrings, and brooches. Unlock more designs as you play.

A LETTER, A LITTLE CREATION
Follow twelve letters with jewelry-making requests. Choose your own colors and bring each piece together, one pearl at a time.

KEEP YOUR FAVORITES CLOSE
Build your pearl collection, name your discoveries, and mark your favorites. Return whenever you feel like opening another shell or making something new.

PLAY OFFLINE
Enjoy Pearl Pocket without an internet connection. No ads, no accounts, and no in-app purchases.

A little discovery. A gentle polish. Something made by you.

name: Pebble Vudo
description:
A calm logic puzzle about islands and water, set along a river journey .

Each number on the grid is an island and shows how many land tiles it has. All other tiles are water. Your task is to shade the water so that every island has exactly one number, all water tiles connect into one river, and there are no 2×2 blocks of water. Every level has exactly one solution and can be solved with logic alone.

The journey has 64 levels in 8 chapters, with grids from 5×5 to 12×12. Each chapter has a short story. A new chapter opens after you solve 4 levels of the previous one.

Tap a tile or drag across several tiles to shade water. Use the Land tool to mark tiles you know are land. You can undo moves, use Check to highlight tiles that need another look, and use up to three hints per level. Solve a level without hints or mistakes to earn three stars.

The Daily Challenge gives you a new puzzle every day and keeps track of your streak. River Lore is a quiz of 8 questions per round about rivers and lakes. By playing you unlock 6 board themes and 12 stamps.

name: Peek Notes — Notes Widget
description:
Peek Notes is a tiny notes app for the short things you look up all the time: the Wi-Fi password, the gate code, the boiler reset, the plumber's number.

Put notes into numbered folders, give each one a symbol and a colour so it's recognisable at a glance, then add a widget for any folder. Small and large widgets list the notes in one column, medium ones in two, and when a folder has more notes than fit, arrows on the widget page through them.

• Folders of short notes, numbered like an index and reorderable with drag and drop
• Any SF Symbol and any colour for each note
• Home Screen widgets in every size, one folder per widget
• Lock Screen widgets for a whole folder or a single note
• Paging arrows right on the widget when there's more to see
• Tap a widget to jump straight into that folder
• iCloud sync, so your notes follow you to your iPad, your Mac and a new phone
• On iPad: folders and notes side by side, and an extra-large widget
• On Mac: the same notes in their own Mac app
• On Apple Watch: your folders and notes, plus complications for your watch face
• A clean, typographic look, in light and dark
• Nothing collected, no accounts to make, no third-party ads

Peek Notes comes with room for three folders with three notes in each. Peek Notes Unlimited, a one-time in-app purchase, lifts both limits and removes the banner for the developer's other apps, on all your devices.

name: Peepsakes
description:
Bad with names? Peepsakes is built for the moment right after you meet someone, when the name is still fresh and about to slip away.

CAPTURE IN SECONDS
Tap the glass tile, or say the name out loud. Peepsake drops a pin where you met, so you remember the place as well as the person. Only a name is required. Add a note, a photo, a quick finger sketch, or a few details whenever you like.

A HOOK THAT STICKS
Tap "Try an AI Hook" and Peepsake builds a fun nickname from their name and where you met, like "Dancing Dave from Denver". It is written on your device by Apple Intelligence, so nothing is sent anywhere.

REMEMBER WITH REMINDERS AND A QUIZ
Choose when to be nudged: after an hour, a day, a week and more. Reminders can simply show who it is, or open a quick quiz card with Got it and Missed it buttons right on the notification. The Quiz tab shows where you met and your cues, and you recall the name before you flip the card.

SEE WHERE YOU MET PEOPLE
Browse people by folder, by place, or on a map with a name on every pin. Make a folder for a trip, a conference or a neighborhood.

FOLLOW UP
Add a follow-up date, like "Coffee Thursday", and Peepsakes reminds you.

FOR YOUR WRIST
The Apple Watch app lets you add someone in a few taps, by voice, and browse the people you have saved. People you capture on the watch reach your iPhone automatically, even if your phone is out of range at the time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking. Lock Peepsakes with Face ID, hide details on the Lock Screen, back everything up to a file, or export a printable PDF of everyone you have met.

MORE
- Widgets, Control Center and the Action button start a new person with one tap
- Save someone, with their photo, to Apple Contacts
- Birthdays by month and day, with no year to dig up
- A warning if you already know someone with the same name

FREE TO TRY
Your first three people are free. Peepsakes Unlimited is a one-time purchase, with no subscription, that lets you add as many people as you like. Everything else is free.

name: Peer Review App
description:
Peer Review is where people in academia and research meet: grad students, postdocs, faculty, clinicians and staff scientists, plus researchers in industry and government and the policy, grants and science-writing people who work alongside them.

NETWORKING
Get three introductions a day to people near you, with the reasons you'd get along: same field, a shared hobby, or a free evening in common. Tap once to suggest a time.

CONFERENCES
Going to a meeting? Check in to see who else is attending, mark the coffee, lunch and poster slots you're free, and line up conversations before you arrive. Only people checked in to the same meeting can see you there.

DATING (OPTIONAL)
Turn on Dating to meet other single academics and researchers. Your filters work both ways: you only show up for people who fit what you're looking for, and who you fit too. You can hide from faculty, students, or people at your own institution.

BUILT FOR ACADEMIC LIFE
• Deadline mode hides your profile while you're writing, then brings it back
• Verified badges through a work email or ORCID iD
• End-to-end encrypted messages
• Block people, or block phone numbers from your contacts
• Reports are anonymous

Peer Review is for people 21 and older.

name: Peertje
description:
Peertje helpt je gezin gezonder eten, zonder calorieën te tellen.

SCAN EN BEGRIJP • Scan een streepjescode en zie meteen een score voor elk gezinslid, afgestemd op hun doelen: cholesterol, bloeddruk, bloedsuiker, gewicht en meer. • Maak een foto van je bord of beschrijf wat je eet; Claude (AI) schat de voedingswaarde. • Allergieën en ingrediënten die je wilt vermijden worden altijd gemarkeerd. • Na een lage score stelt Peertje gezondere producten uit dezelfde categorie voor.

DAGBOEK EN DIËTIST • Hou per persoon bij wat er gegeten wordt, met dagtotalen en je bord volgens de Gezonde Schijf. • Importeer het advies van je diëtist: Peertje houdt er rekening mee bij elke score. • Weekoverzicht om te delen met je diëtist.

WATER • Een persoonlijk waterdoel, met Peertje die zich vult naarmate je drinkt. • Kies je eigen snelle drankjes; koffie, thee en soep tellen mee. • Widgets op je beginscherm en toegangsscherm, met een knop om meteen een glas toe te voegen.

SAMEN • Deel het gezin via iCloud: iedereen logt op zijn eigen iPhone. • Boodschappenlijst, ook gekoppeld aan Home Assistant. • Een kindvriendelijke weergave met stickers in plaats van cijfers.

PRIVACY Geen account, geen advertenties, geen tracking. Je gegevens blijven op je iPhone en in je eigen iCloud. Foto's en beschrijvingen gaan alleen naar Claude als je dat toestaat, met je eigen API-sleutel.

Peertje geeft algemene richtlijnen, geen medisch advies.

name: Penthouse Seafood
description:
Explore Penthouse Seafood Menu, a multilingual restaurant menu for seafood hot pot and other dishes.

• Switch between Korean, English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
• Browse dish photos, descriptions, sizes and prices in Korean won.
• Navigate by category, contents, page buttons or swipe gestures.
• Download the complete menu and images while online, then browse the cached menu offline. Reconnect to check for updates.
