Please confirm current prices and availability with restaurant staff.

name: Per My Last Email
description:
Say what you mean. Send what won't get you fired.

Per My Last Email is an AI email translator for work. It turns the message you want to send into the one you should send, and tells you what everyone else really meant.

MAKE IT PROFESSIONAL
Type it, paste it or dictate it, swearing included. Tap "Make sure I don't get fired" and get a calm, polite, professional email that says the same thing without the career risk. Every line shows what you said next to what we wrote.

WHAT THEY MEAN
Paste the email that ruined your morning. Get the plain-language version, line by line, with a passive-aggression score so you know exactly how worried to be.

PICK WHO YOU SOUND LIKE
Write as a Middle Manager, a Very British colleague, a LinkedIn Guru or Passive-Aggressive Finance. Turn the spice up or down, from polite to Friday drinks.

SURVIVE THE MEETING
A fresh corporate jargon bingo card every day, plus a Phrase of the Day that decodes one classic line each morning.

KEEP THE GOOD ONES
Copy, share as a card, or listen to any result. Your history stays on your phone, never on our servers.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Two free translations every day, plus an optional short video for one more. Premium removes ads, raises the daily limit and unlocks the Startup Founder and HR Compliance Bot personas. Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly through your App Store account. It renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can manage or cancel it in your account settings.

For people aged 16 and over. Contains strong language and corporate sarcasm. Please don't paste confidential information: your text is processed to produce the translation and is not kept.

Terms of use: https://games.ntam.es/per-my-last-email/terms/
Privacy policy: https://games.ntam.es/per-my-last-email/privacy/

name: Perpetuum: Watch Timegrapher
description:
Behind a simple, friendly design is our most advanced engine for measuring mechanical watches. Calibrated with professional equipment on dozens of watches from popular and rare brands, from mid-range to high-end luxury: Swiss classics, complex manufacture calibres, high-beat movements and more. Shows rate, amplitude, beat rate and beat error, with multi-position measurement.

Your whole collection with you: serial numbers, accuracy log, trend analysis, service dates, smart reminders and a short health summary of your favourite watches.

HOW IT WORKS
Put your watch next to the microphone of your iPhone or iPad (the app is calibrated specifically for Apple microphones), keep the room quiet and tap Start. In seconds you see how much the watch gains or loses per day, the amplitude of the balance and the beat error. Add your watches to the collection and keep the important details with you. Keep a measurement log by following a few simple steps — the app tells you how healthy the movement is and reminds you when service is due. Everything stays on your device. Sound is analysed in real time and never saved. No unnecessary accounts, no tracking.

PERPETUUM+
Quick measurement and measurement cards are free. Perpetuum+ unlocks the collection, multi-position measurement, trend analysis, reminders and Heart of the movement: a yearly subscription or a lifetime purchase, 7 days free with no card required.
The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your Apple ID settings.

Perpetuum is for information only and does not replace a watchmaker. Always follow your watch manufacturer's instructions.

Terms of Use: https://phantommachines.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://phantommachines.com/privacy/

name: Pet Booklet: Pet Health Log
description:
Everything about your pet. In one booklet.

When was the last vaccination? When is the next dewormer due? What was the microchip number again? Pet Booklet keeps everything important about your dog, cat, rabbit, bird or horse – clearly organised, on your device and without an account.

A PROFILE FOR EVERY PET
• Photo, species, breed, date of birth and age
• Microchip and passport number, colour and markings
• Insurance and vet practice with phone number
• Food, allergies and intolerances – allergies clearly highlighted

HEALTH AT A GLANCE
• Vaccinations with the next due date
• Deworming and flea/tick treatments with your interval
• Vet visits with notes, costs and follow-up appointment
• Medication with a dosing schedule (exactly as prescribed by your vet)
• Weight chart

REMINDERS
Pet Booklet reminds you on your device before vaccinations, dewormers and vet appointments are due – with the notice you choose – and at medication times. The “Due dates” tab shows what’s coming up and what’s overdue.

A CARE SHEET FOR THE SITTER
Food, feeding times, walks, habits, medication, vet, emergency numbers and your contacts on one sheet – as a PDF to print or send to a pet sitter, family or boarding kennel.

COST OVERVIEW
What does your pet cost per year? Vet, vaccinations, medication, food, insurance, grooming and more – by pet and category.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your device. A backup file lets you take pets, photos and entries to a new device.

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Free: 1 pet with all health features, reminders, weight chart and backup.
Full version (one-time purchase, no subscription): unlimited pets, pet care sheet PDF and cost overview.

IMPORTANT
Pet Booklet is your personal notebook. It does not replace an official pet passport or the vaccination record from your vet, and it gives no medical advice. If you have questions about your pet’s health, please ask your vet.

name: Petly
description:
Aqui o protagonista é o seu pet. Ele ganha um perfil, faz amigos e mostra os lugares por onde passa.

CADA PET COM O SEU PERFIL, E COM AMIGOS
Fotos, um @ que é só dele, outros pets para seguir e hashtags para achar a turma. O perfil pode ser aberto ou fechado.

QUANTO MAIS ELE AJUDA, MAIS ELE SOBE DE NÍVEL
Avaliar um lugar, mandar uma foto ou indicar um lugar novo leva o pet de Curioso a Lenda da Petly.

O PARQUE É SEGURO? A CLÍNICA É BOA?
Parques, clínicas, pet shops e hotéis de São Paulo e do Rio, com a avaliação de quem já levou o pet lá.

SE ELE SUMIR, A VIZINHANÇA FICA SABENDO
Um alerta com foto para quem está por perto, e quem vê o pet avisa o tutor, sem expor o próprio endereço.

A CARTEIRA DE VACINAÇÃO NO BOLSO
As doses registradas e um lembrete antes da próxima, para nenhuma passar do prazo.

AMIGOS DE PELO, PENA E ESCAMA, EM TODO BAIRRO
Encontre os pets da vizinhança, siga a turma do parque e descubra lugares novos com quem já esteve lá.

POR QUE A PETLY EXISTE
Tudo começou ouvindo amigos pais e mães de pet. Toda semana alguém perguntava: "aquele parque é seguro?", "alguém indica uma clínica de confiança?". A resposta vinha de quem lembrava, quando lembrava. A Petly nasceu para essa ajuda não se perder na conversa: um lugar onde cada pet tem o seu perfil, e onde quem já foi conta para quem vai. — Jessica Carvalho, fundadora

Grátis, para maiores de 16 anos.

Tudo para o bem-estar do seu pet, pertinho de você.

name: Photo Mirror Sync
description:
Photo Mirror Sync keeps your own photo server identical to your iCloud Photos library. Not a backup that only ever grows, but a true mirror.

• New photos and videos are uploaded as originals: HEIC, ProRAW, 4K video and Live Photos with their motion.
• Edited photos are replaced with the current version, and favorites follow along.
• Photos you delete in iCloud go to the server's trash too. Nothing is deleted for good, and large deletions wait for your confirmation.
• Your iCloud albums become albums on the server, including those in folders. Albums you create on the server yourself are never touched.

MADE FOR SELF-HOSTERS
Photo Mirror Sync works with your self-hosted Immich server (version 3.3 or later). Photos go straight from your iPhone to your server: no other cloud, no account with us, no tracking.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Start with a dry run: see what would happen, estimate the upload size and check which photos are already on the server.
• Photos already on the server are recognized by checksum and linked instead of uploaded twice.
• Interrupted? The next run continues exactly where it stopped.

RUNS IN THE BACKGROUND
Start a sync and keep using your iPhone; progress shows on the Lock Screen. A nightly sync can run while your iPhone charges, and a notification tells you what changed.

Photo Mirror Sync is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Immich project.

name: Photon Students
description:
Photon Students is the app of Photon Academy (ibtuition.sg), a tuition centre in Singapore. It brings a student's classwork, marked reports and course materials into one place, gives tutors a fast way to set work and review marks, and offers Photon's notes and e-books to everyone.

WHO IT IS FOR
Sign in with Google, Apple or an emailed code. It is the same account as on ibtuition.sg.
- Photon Academy students: the centre links your account to your courses, and your courses decide what you see. Your course materials come with your enrolment.
- Tutors at the centre: set work and review marks for your own students.
- Everyone else: the Resource Centre, with free samples of every subject and e-book, and in-app purchases to unlock more.

CLASSWORK FROM YOUR TUTORS
Today shows your next class and the work due soon. The Work tab lists everything your tutors have set, with due dates, a note from your tutor and what is already done. Open a test, a worksheet, a timed quiz, a task, a link or a question to answer, and mark it done when you are finished.

HAND IN BY SCANNING YOUR PAGES
Finished a test on paper? Scan your pages with the camera, choose photos or attach a PDF, check each page and send. Your tutors can see your working alongside your marks.

AI-MARKED REPORTS
Your hand-in is marked by Photon's AI marker, and the report appears as soon as marking finishes, usually a few minutes later. It shows your total, the marks for each question, what went well, the mistakes to fix and tips for next time. Your tutor can review the report, adjust marks and add a note, and you are notified. When your tutor releases the mark scheme, you can open it too.

RESOURCE CENTRE
- Notes and worksheets by topic for Maths AA and AI, Physics, Chemistry and Biology, SL and HL: notes, cheatsheets, masterclass guides, Basics, tutorials and Mastery
- E-books: the Photon Guidebooks, opened in the full reader with your place saved

UNLOCK SUBJECTS AND E-BOOKS
Every subject has free samples: two topics in full, and cheatsheets. Every e-book has a free sample. With in-app purchase you can unlock a subject for 12 months, or buy an e-book for 2 years of access from the day you first open it. Purchases do not renew. What you buy belongs to your account, so it opens on every device where you sign in, and it also works on ibtuition.sg when you sign in with the same account. Restore purchases is in the Me tab.

NOTIFICATIONS YOU CHOOSE
For students: get a notification when new work is set, when your work is marked and the day before something is due. Switch each one on or off and set quiet hours. Tap a notification to open that exact item.

FOR TUTORS
Set a test, a worksheet, a PDF you upload or a task for a whole class or chosen students. See who has handed in, review the AI marks question by question, adjust them and write a note to the student. You see only your own students.

IPHONE AND IPAD
Made for every iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape and in Split View, with a side-by-side marking screen on iPad.

FOR PARENTS
Your child signs in with their own account. What a student hands in is seen only by their tutors and the centre's staff, never by other students, and is marked by Photon's AI marker. Purchases go through the App Store, so Ask to Buy and Screen Time limits apply.

PRIVACY
No ads and no tracking. Payments are handled by Apple. You can turn notifications off at any time and delete your account from the Me tab.

Photon Students is an independent study aid from Photon Academy. It is not endorsed by or affiliated with the International Baccalaureate Organization. IB and International Baccalaureate are trademarks of their owner.

Questions? Visit ibtuition.sg/contact-us/.

name: PhotoVideo: Compress & Convert
description:
PhotoVideo: Compress & Convert is the ultimate, privacy-first media utility designed to drastically reduce file sizes and convert formats directly on your device. Free up gigabytes of storage on your iPhone and prepare photos and videos for instant sharing via WhatsApp, Mail, AirDrop, and social media.

All processing is performed 100% on-device. Your personal photos and videos are never uploaded to any remote server or third-party cloud.

KEY CAPABILITIES

1. ADVANCED PHOTO COMPRESSION
- Smart lossy and lossless compression reducing image sizes by up to 96%.
- 4 tailored compression presets: Light, Balanced, High, and Ultra.
- Dynamic downsampling: Scales excessive camera resolutions down to clean, high-density formats while preserving visual sharpness.
- Automatic metadata and EXIF removal for maximum file size savings.
- Live size estimation: Preview projected savings before starting the compression.

2. HARDWARE-ACCELERATED VIDEO COMPRESSION
- Built on Apple hardware acceleration for maximum speed and zero battery drain.
- 4 compression tiers: 720p HD, 540p, 480p, and Ultra Small.
- Compress 200MB+ high-bitrate 4K/HD video recordings down to compact, shareable files in seconds.
- Real-time compression progress indicator.

3. UNIVERSAL FORMAT CONVERSION
- Photo formats supported: JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP, and multi-page PDF.
- Video formats supported: MP4, MOV, and M4V.
- Preserve original image fidelity without quality degradation.
- Convert modern HEIC photos to universal JPG or PNG for maximum compatibility across Windows, Android, and web platforms.

4. BATCH PROCESSING
- Select and process up to 20 photos or videos simultaneously.
- Multi-core concurrent engine processes batch media in parallel.
- Automated memory management prevents system slowdowns during large batch tasks.

5. BUILT-IN ZIP ARCHIVING & EXTRACTION
- Archive multiple photos, videos, and documents into a clean .zip file.
- Inspect and extract incoming ZIP archives directly on your iPhone.
- Quick share extracted or archived files via AirDrop, Messages, Mail, or Files.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
- 100% offline: Works completely in Airplane Mode without an internet connection.
- Zero server traffic: Your files remain entirely on your iPhone hardware.
- No analytics, no user tracking, and no external SDKs.
- Clean and clutter-free interface inspired by Apple iOS spatial design.

Reclaim your iPhone storage and take full control of your media library today with PhotoVideo: Compress & Convert.

name: Photovisi: Photo Collage Maker
description:
Create beautiful photo collages quickly and easily with Photovisi. Completely free, with no subscriptions, in-app purchases, or paid upgrades.

Choose your favorite photos, find a layout you love, and make it your own.

EASY PHOTO COLLAGES
• Select photos from your library
• Explore a variety of collage layouts
• Add stylish frames
• Arrange and customize your collage
• Save your creation to Photos
• Share it with friends and family

SIMPLE BY DESIGN
Start creating without an account. Pick your photos, choose a design, and bring your memories together without unnecessary complexity.

FOR EVERY OCCASION
Capture a holiday, celebrate a birthday, collect family memories, or put before-and-after pictures side by side.

EVERY DESIGN INCLUDED
Enjoy every layout and frame without unlocking extras or paying for upgrades.

name: Phượng Hải config
description:
Phuong Hai Config (pH Config App) là ứng dụng chuyên dụng phục vụ công tác cài đặt, cấu hình, chẩn đoán và quản lý trạm quan trắc tự động Datalogger cùng hệ thống cảm biến môi trường do Công ty Cổ phần KHKT Phượng Hải nghiên cứu và sản xuất.

Ứng dụng cho phép các kỹ sư, kỹ thuật viên môi trường và cán bộ vận hành dễ dàng giao tiếp không dây với trạm Datalogger qua kết nối Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) và mạng lưới BLE Mesh tiêu chuẩn công nghiệp.

CÁC TÍNH NĂNG CHÍNH:

1. KẾT NỐI KHÔNG DÂY BLE STANDARD
- Quét nhanh và nhận diện các trạm Datalogger, module truyền thông trong bán kính gần.
- Đo lường cường độ tín hiệu (RSSI) và hiển thị trực quan trạng thái kết nối.
- Kết nối bảo mật và đọc thông tin thiết bị: Model, Serial Number, phiên bản phần cứng, phiên bản Firmware.

2. CẤU HÌNH TRUYỀN THÔNG & GATEWAY (GATT CONFIG)
- Cấu hình module 4G/LTE: APN nhà mạng, kiểm tra trạng thái sóng và địa chỉ IP.
- Thiết lập cổng mạng Ethernet LAN (chế độ DHCP hoặc IP tĩnh).
- Cấu hình thông số giao tiếp Modbus RTU / RS-485 Master kết nối với các cảm biến đầu đo (pH, DO, TSS, COD, Nhiệt độ, Độ đục,...).

3. QUẢN TRỊ MẠNG CẢM BIẾN BLE MESH
- Khởi tạo và thiết lập mạng lưới BLE Mesh (Mesh Provisioner) cho toàn trạm quan trắc.
- Phân bổ địa chỉ Unicast, quản lý cấu hình các Node cảm biến và Relay điều khiển.
- Giám sát topology mạng lưới và đường truyền tín hiệu đa chặng giữa các điểm đo.

4. HIỆU CHUẨN & GIÁM SÁT CẢM BIẾN TRỰC THỜI
- Đọc giá trị đo thời gian thực trực tiếp từ cảm biến (giá trị pH, điện thế mV, nhiệt độ ATC).
- Hỗ trợ quy trình hiệu chuẩn cảm biến (Calib chuẩn 1 điểm, 2 điểm hoặc 3 điểm).
- Thiết lập dải đo, chu kỳ lấy mẫu và ngưỡng cảnh báo vượt quy chuẩn kỹ thuật quốc gia.

5. TRUYỀN DỮ LIỆU ĐẾN MÁY CHỦ SỞ TN&MT
- Cài đặt thông số truyền dữ liệu định kỳ qua giao thức FTP / SFTP về máy chủ quản lý dữ liệu môi trường.
- Tương thích định dạng file dữ liệu theo đúng Thông tư 10/2021/TT-BTNMT của Bộ Tài nguyên & Môi trường.
- Kiểm tra lịch sử gửi tin, nhật ký kết nối và mã phản hồi từ server.

6. NÂNG CẤP FIRMWARE KHÔNG DÂY TỪ XA (MULTI-NODE OTA)
- Cập nhật Firmware mới nhất cho thiết bị trạm Datalogger và các Node cảm biến qua sóng BLE / BLE Mesh.
- Hỗ trợ nâng cấp đồng thời nhiều Node trong mạng Mesh nhanh chóng, an toàn với cơ chế xác thực checksum integrity.

BẢO MẬT & QUYỀN RIÊNG TƯ:
- Ứng dụng sử dụng quyền Bluetooth để quét và kết nối thiết bị Bluetooth Low Energy.
- Không thu thập hay chia sẻ thông tin cá nhân của người dùng cho bên thứ ba.
- Dữ liệu cấu hình được mã hóa và bảo vệ an toàn trên thiết bị.

THÔNG TIN ĐƠN VỊ PHÁT TRIỂN:
Công ty Cổ phần Khoa học Kỹ thuật Phượng Hải
- Địa chỉ: 103/23 Nguyễn Hữu Dật, P. Tây Thạnh, Q. Tân Phú, TP. Hồ Chí Minh
- Hotline kỹ thuật: 0836 72 74 76 - 0916 063 766
- Website: https://phuonghai.com
- Hỗ trợ kỹ thuật: support@phuonghai.com

name: Piano Metronome Tuner: Pianino
description:
Pianino puts three everyday practice tools in one small app: a piano, a metronome and a tuner. All three share one concert pitch, so if your orchestra tunes to 442 or 443 Hz, the piano keys and the tuner follow the same A.

ONE CONCERT PITCH FOR EVERYTHING
Set A4 anywhere from 415 to 466 Hz (quick buttons for 438, 440, 442, 443 and 444). Baroque at 415, the opera house at 443, Bayreuth at 444: an ordinary upright piano can rarely be tuned that high, but Pianino plays at exactly the pitch you sing and play at.

PIANO
• Play in landscape, on one row of keys or two, with a sustain pedal
• Slide along all six octaves with the range strip or the octave buttons
• 6 sounds: two concert grands, an upright, a vintage electric piano, an electric grand and a harpsichord
• Every sample is measured and corrected to equal temperament, within a cent
• Note names on the keys: C D E, Do Re Mi (Fa Sol or Fa So La Ti), German (H), Korean
• On iPad the keys sit under a polished black grand piano lid

METRONOME
• Tempo, time signature and tap tempo
• Accents for every beat: strong, normal or silent
• Subdivisions and 4 click sounds
• Keeps ticking while you play the piano, and you can set it right from the piano

TUNER
• For voice and every instrument, from a five-string bass to the piccolo
• Note and cents on a needle, plus a pitch graph that shows your intonation and vibrato over the last seconds
• Reference tone to sing or tune against, picked on a small keyboard
• Transposing instruments: Bb, Eb and F
• Listens only on your device; nothing is recorded or sent

DISPLAY
3 colour themes (emerald, wine, midnight blue), dark mode, and 8 languages: English, Korean, German, Italian, French, Spanish, Chinese and Russian.

No sign-up and no purchases: every feature is free. Your settings stay on your device.

Looking for a singing or piano teacher? welegato, the music-lesson platform by Vicino Labs (the makers of Pianino), connects you with teachers and musicians across Europe.

name: PICOBOY: AI Retro Handheld
description:
PICOBOY is a retro handheld that lives in your phone. Turn it sideways and the d-pad, buttons and touchpad are right under your thumbs, like holding a real console.

SAY IT, PLAY IT
Hold the AGENT key and say what you want to play: "make a fruit-catching game", "make the hero a cat", "make it a bit easier". Let go and the Agent gets to work. Keep playing something else; it tells you when your game is ready, and puts it at the top of your feed.

SWIPE THROUGH GAMES
Swipe up for the next game. Each one opens with a highlight; press any key to jump straight in. No downloads, no waiting. A line at the bottom tells you how to play and what each key does.

IT LEARNS WHAT YOU LIKE
How long you play, what you skip and what you like all shape the next pick. On first launch you choose one of three games, and within minutes the feed knows your taste.

MAKE IT YOURS
Press MENU to edit: code, sprites, map and sound. See every change in the game at once, undo any time, or restore the original.

A THOUSAND PIXEL GAMES
Classic PICO-8 style games of every kind: platformers, shooters, puzzles, racers, relaxing ones. Search by title, author or type, or tap a tag.

RETRO FEEL
Grained plastic, domed keys, pixel fonts and a light tap on every press. The screen stays on while you play, and the sound works in silent mode.

Good to know:
- No sign-up: open it and play.
- Before the Agent makes anything, it asks your permission to send what you say to an AI model. Without it you can still browse and play everything.
- See something that isn't right? Report it from MENU, or block the player who made it.

name: Pingtide
description:
Pingtide shows you what's on your network. Tap Scan and within seconds you see every device on your Wi‑Fi or Ethernet – with its name, type, open ports and latency.

FIND EVERY DEVICE • Fast sweep of your whole network using ICMP ping, TCP checks for devices that ignore ping, and Bonjour • Recognises routers, computers, phones, TVs, speakers, printers, NAS drives, cameras and smart-home gear • Reads service banners such as web page titles and SSH versions to tell devices apart • Flags new devices since your last scan, so you notice when something unexpected joins • Name, favourite and annotate devices; your labels stick even when IP addresses change

LOOK CLOSER • Live latency graph, jitter and packet loss for any device • Open ports with service names, plus a full port scan on demand • Hostname, Bonjour services and how each device was found

NETWORK TOOLS • Ping – continuous latency, jitter and loss to any host • Traceroute – every router between you and a destination • Port Scanner – TCP connect scan of any host • DNS Lookup – A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, PTR and SRV • Subnet Calculator – CIDR, masks and host ranges • Host Monitor – keeps an eye on your favourites and notifies you when one goes offline

VLANS AND MORE NETWORKS Add other subnets by hand or let Pingtide find them, then scan one network or all of them at once.

HISTORY Every scan is saved on your device, so you can compare what was online then and now. Export any scan as CSV.

BUILT FOR iOS • Liquid Glass design for iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad • Home Screen widgets and a Live Activity while scanning • Start a scan from Control Center, Siri or Shortcuts • Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Scan results never leave your device. Showing your public IP address and your Wi‑Fi name are optional and off by default.

name: PinMemo - ロック画面に留めるメモ
description:
「あとでやろう」と思ったことを、ロック画面に留めておくためのメモアプリです。

ピンメモは、書いたメモをローカル通知でロック画面／通知センターに表示し続けます。一般的なリマインダーのように時間が経って埋もれたり消えたりしません。完了（削除）するまで、ずっとそこにいます。

■ 主な機能
・即メモ：起動するとすぐ入力欄にフォーカス。思いついた瞬間に書けます
・ピン留め表示：メモがロック画面に残り続けます
・ピン差し直し：誤って通知を消しても、一覧からワンタップで再表示
・リマインド：日時を指定すれば、その時刻に音付きでお知らせ
・ウィジェット：ホーム画面／ロック画面から最新メモを確認、そのまま入力へ

■ 料金
・無料：メモ1件＋広告を見て増やせるストック枠（最大5件）
・Pro版（買い切り）：件数無制限・広告なし

■ プライバシー
メモは端末内だけに保存され、外部のサーバーには送信されません。アカウント登録も不要です。

name: Pinpoint: Who or What
description:
Think you can read minds? Pinpoint is the yes or no guessing game where every question counts.

A secret card hides on the board. Ask smart questions, rule out cards and find it before your questions run out. Play against an AI that runs right on your iPhone, or pass the phone and challenge a friend.

PLAY VS AI
• The AI secretly picks a card from the board
• Tap a suggested question or type your own
• You have 20 questions. A wrong guess costs 3
• Score a point for every question you have left

PASS AND PLAY
• Two players, one phone
• Each player secretly picks a card from the same board
• Take turns asking out loud and ruling out cards
• Guess right to win, guess wrong and you lose

9 DECKS, A NEW BOARD EVERY GAME
Everyday Things, Famous People, Sports, Vehicles, Nature, Music, Clothes, Holidays and Fantasy. Choose 12, 18, 24 or all cards and every game deals a fresh board.

PLAY WITH YOUR OWN PHOTOS
Turn photos of family and friends into a board. Pinpoint spots simple things like hats, glasses or the outdoors right on your iPhone, so you can ask about them. Your photos never leave your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign up. Typed questions are answered by Apple Intelligence on your device.

Perfect for family game night, road trips, classrooms and parties. Available in English, German, French, Spanish and Russian.

Typed questions need an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence. Suggested questions work on every device. Pinpoint is free to play and supported by ads.

name: Pipa Desk: Remote for Mac
description:
Pipa turns your iPhone and iPad into a remote for your Mac. See your Mac's screen, use trackpad gestures and type as if you were sitting in front of it.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Trackpad mode: drag the pointer like on your Mac's trackpad, or tap right where you want to click
• Mac gestures: 3 or 4 fingers switch desktops and open Mission Control; pinch to zoom
• Right click, click and drag, and smooth scrolling
• A key bar with ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧, Esc, Tab and arrows, plus one-tap Mac shortcuts
• On iPad, the Magic Keyboard's keys and trackpad work just like on a Mac

AT HOME AND AWAY
• On the same network, Pipa finds your Mac on its own and connects directly, with low latency
• Away from home, it connects directly over the internet through a secure rendezvous service; Tailscale remains an advanced option
• Switch between your Mac's displays, hear your Mac's sound and wake your Mac from your iPhone
• Shared clipboard with your Mac, if you want it

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account and no Pipa server in the middle: the connection goes straight from your iPhone to your Mac
• Encrypted with TLS 1.3
• Each device pairs with a QR code and is approved on the Mac, and you can revoke it anytime

GETTING STARTED
1. Install Pipa Host on your Mac, free, from pipadesk.com
2. Grant the Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions it asks for
3. Scan your Mac's QR code with Pipa on your iPhone or iPad

FAIR PRICING
Free for 20 minutes a day, no card needed. For unlimited use, a one-time purchase, no subscription, at a launch price.

name: Pitchmori: Ear Training Daily
description:
Pitchmori gives everyone the same note each day. You listen to it in the morning, carry it through the day, and in the evening you sing it back without listening again. Your iPhone measures how far your voice drifted, in cents.

Any octave counts, so a low hum and a high voice are measured the same way. Day by day you can see whether the note stays with you longer.

[How it works]
• Today's note: one of the 12 notes, the same for everyone
• Morning: listen as many times as you like until you have it
• Evening: sing it back without listening. Pitchmori shows the drift in cents and whether you were sharp or flat
• Compare: today next to yesterday, a week ago and your first day
• Drift: your results for the last 7 days
• Reminders: a morning reminder and a sing-back reminder at times you choose

[Premium]
• A second sing-back at night
• Practice any of the 12 notes, as often as you like
• Piano, guitar, voice and sine tones
• All-time drift and the per-note table, showing which notes you hold most easily
• No ads

Free users can watch a short video to open one practice session a day.

[Your voice stays on your iPhone]
The sound from the microphone is analysed on this iPhone and is never recorded or sent. There is no account to create.

[About subscriptions]
• Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically. At the end of the free trial or of each period, the price of the chosen plan is charged to your Apple ID
• A subscription renews at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• You can cancel in Subscriptions in your App Store account settings
• Lifetime is a one-time payment and does not renew

Terms of Use: https://crelve-today-tone.web.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://crelve-today-tone.web.app/privacy.html

name: Pixel Mines: Reveal Art
seller_name: BeeMob Technology and Services Company Limited
description:
The classic tile-sweeping logic game, where every tile is a pixel of a hidden picture.

Open the safe tiles, flag the ink bombs, and watch the picture appear piece by piece. Finish the board and the whole artwork lights up and goes into your album.

NEVER GUESS
Every board can be solved with pure logic from the very first tap. No more 50/50 coin flips.

FROM SNACKS TO MASTERPIECES
• 60 hand-made pixel pictures in 5 chapters
• Pictures grow rarer as you go: Common, Rare, Precious and Legendary
• Chapter 4: world wonders, from the Pyramids to the Statue of Liberty
• Chapter 5: legendary paintings, from The Starry Night to Mona Lisa
• A new daily picture with streak rewards

RELAXED AND FAIR
• No timers, no energy, no waiting
• Hint lamp and shield when you get stuck
• Hold a tile to flag, tap a number to open around it
• Save finished pictures to Photos
• No ads, no account, no data collected, plays offline

Chapters 1 to 3 are free. Chapters 4 and 5 and coin packs are optional in-app purchases.

name: Pizza Plummet: Drone Delivery
description:
Pizza Plummet is a drone pizza delivery physics arcade game with one-thumb controls and loose cargo. Lift off with a stack of pizza boxes, weave through the city, and reach each rooftop customer before dispatch catches up. The pizzas are loose. The drone is wobbly. Every delivery is a balancing act.

FLY THE DRONE. SAVE THE DINNER.
Hold the throttle to spin up the rotors, then slide your thumb to lean left or right. Small corrections keep the cargo steady; a wild turn sends a box tumbling into the street. Simple controls make it easy to start, while carrying a full rack takes practice.

DELIVER THROUGH A CITY THAT PUSHES BACK
Fly past suburban rooftops, downtown construction sites, and highway routes. Dodge power lines, streetlights, moving trucks, birds, cranes, hanging signs, and tight gaps. Wind rocks the load, rain makes the deck slippery, and the changing light takes your route from daylight into the night. Each run creates a different combination of obstacles.

KEEP THE STACK. EARN THE CASH.
Complete orders to earn game cash and tips. Deliver the whole order for a better payout, or salvage a partial delivery when the flight goes wrong. Each lost pizza costs $1 of game cash; your balance can go negative. After every delivery, the next order is loaded in a fresh stack on a level drone. Game cash has no cash-out value.

THREE HEARTS. MORE CHANCES.
Each free shift starts with three hearts. Crashes spend one; rare animated floating hearts restore one, up to three. Continue the current order while hearts remain, or start a fresh shift for free. An optional rewarded video can give you one heart and another chance after a fail.

CHOOSE YOUR DELIVERY REWARD
After a delivery, choose a video to double that delivery's cash, or choose a video for one heart. One completed video earns one selected reward per delivery. Full hearts and unlimited-heart passes do not bank extra lives. You can always keep flying without watching.

YOUR DRONE. YOUR RIG.
Earn delivery cash for taller rack walls, a grippy mat, bigger rotors, and Midnight, Pepperoni, or Gold drone skins. Individual skins are also available as optional one-time purchases. Skins change your look, not your flight performance.

OPTIONAL PACKS, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS
The Delivery Boss Pack permanently unlocks all three current premium skins. It includes 10 sticky mats, 10 high-side boosts, and 7 days of unlimited hearts. Activate either boost in Extras; each lasts one shift, including rescues. High sides help steady the load, while birds and obstacles can still knock pizzas off.
The 24-hour Heart Pass includes unlimited hearts for 24 hours and $600 game cash. Repeat purchases extend remaining time and add $600.
Both timers start at purchase and run in real time, including time away. Neither pack renews automatically. Prices are shown in your local App Store currency before checkout. Permanent bundle unlocks restore with the same Apple Account; spent items are not replenished. Cash and unused boosts stay on this device.

MORE THAN PIZZA
Later orders add tall soda bottles, fragile cakes, wide party subs, or little boxes. Different shapes shift the balance and change your approach to the next gap.

DOES PIZZA PLUMMET HAVE ADS?
Only optional rewarded videos that you choose. No banners, forced interstitials, or app-open ads. Ads need an internet connection. Closing early earns no reward. Privacy choices are available where required.

CAN I PLAY OFFLINE?
Yes. Core gameplay, earned upgrades, local scores, and an already activated heart pass work offline. Store purchases, restoration, and videos require internet.

DO I NEED AN ACCOUNT?
No game sign-in is required. Local progress does not sync between devices. Share the fail opens the iOS share sheet with a short game clip or still image. It never records your camera or microphone.

Support: support@rivetssoftware.com
Rivets Software LLC

name: Plan Awaryjny
description:
Plan Awaryjny is a calm, practical family emergency plan. Meeting points, contacts, your go bag, home supplies and a simple SOS mode live in one place, ready for a bad day. Made for Poland: Polish emergency numbers, regional maps and guides.

WHO IT IS FOR
Parents and guardians who want to prepare for a power cut, flood, storm or evacuation before anything happens. The app walks you through the essentials; you can skip any step and come back later.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Family plan: a main and a backup meeting point, ways to get in touch, who does what. Export the plan to PDF and print it.
- Emergency contacts: 112, emergency numbers and your loved ones. One tap to call, but only after you confirm, and through the regular phone app. The app never places a call by itself.
- Go bags: checklists from ready-made templates, quantities and expiry dates. See at a glance what is packed and what is missing.
- Home supplies: water, food, first aid, lighting, power. Check whether they last 3, 7 or 14 days.
- Reminders: for expiry dates, checks and your own tasks, scheduled by the phone itself.
- My home: where the gas and water valves and the main power switch are. No searching when time matters.
- Readiness gauge: shows how complete your preparation is and what to add. It is a hint, not a safety rating.
- Large text: standard, large or extra large, comfortable for seniors too.

SOS MODE
One button opens crisis mode. Pick a situation (evacuation, power outage, no communication, flood, storm) and follow the guide step by step. The guides are built into the app and work in airplane mode.

OFFLINE MAP
Download the map of your voivodeship (about 50-210 MB, best over Wi-Fi) and keep it with you without internet, with your important places marked.

ACCOUNT AND SHARED PLAN
An account is required. Adults sign in with a one-time code sent by e-mail, no password. A guardian links a child's phone (no account, no e-mail) and confirms the child's age. The plan is shared between family phones, and family data is encrypted on the phone before it reaches the server (end-to-end encryption). You can delete your account in the app.

PRIVACY
You save medication or allergy information only if you want to, and only after giving consent. You can withdraw consent and delete your account in the app settings.

IMPORTANT
- Plan Awaryjny is not an official or government app and is not affiliated with any emergency service.
- It is not a warning system. It does not replace official announcements or the 112 emergency number. Always follow instructions from the emergency services and official announcements. If life or health is at risk, call 112.
- The app is not a medical device, does not diagnose anything and does not replace a doctor.
- Guide content is based on official guidance; the sources are listed in the app.

Privacy policy: https://planawaryjny.app/polityka-prywatnosci/

name: PlaqueWalk
description: Welcome to PlaqueWalk. We care about making city strolls feel more memorable, and if you run into trouble we hope you will reach out. PlaqueWalk helps you collect the plaques you notice on buildings, corners, and quiet streets, then turn them into gentle walking routes you can reopen later. Discover gathers titles, people, inscriptions, streets, and themes such as arts or civic life, while Walks lets you group favorite stops into a route with a short summary and personal notes. Passport keeps a soft record of visits with mood and date so you remember which places you already stood beside, and Atlas gives a wider view of what you have saved. Everything stays on this device with no sign-in wall before the first plaque. Screens stay compact so you can add one find after a walk, plan a short route for the weekend, and put the phone away. There are no ads or in-app purchases, and the habit of notice, save, and revisit remains calm enough for everyday exploring.

name: Plusik: Matematyka dla dzieci
description:
Plusik: Matematyka dla dzieci to gra, w której dziecko ćwiczy liczenie razem z własnym smokiem. Za każde dobrze rozwiązane działanie smok rośnie, dostaje nowe stroje i przechodzi kolejne ewolucje – a dziecko utrwala materiał z klas 1–3 szkoły podstawowej.

CZEGO UCZY SIĘ DZIECKO
• dodawanie i odejmowanie do 20 i do 100, przekraczanie progu dziesiątkowego
• tabliczka mnożenia i dzielenie
• brakująca liczba, kolejność działań, ułamki
• porównywanie liczb: większe, mniejsze, równe
• zadania z treścią
• odczytywanie godzin na zegarze
• figury i bryły
• pieniądze: monety, banknoty, zakupy i reszta

SPOSOBY GRY
• Przygoda – 20 krain z mapą, bossami i pamiątkami do jaskini smoka
• Klasyczny – poziomy w każdym dziale i gwiazdki za dokładność
• Arena – pojedynki z 15 smokami na szybkie odpowiedzi
• Przetrwanie – graj, aż się pomylisz, i bij swój rekord
• Dobrze czy źle?, Wpisz wynik, Większe czy mniejsze?, Zegar, Figury, Pieniądze

MÓJ SMOK
Smok wykluwa się z jajka i rośnie razem z postępami dziecka. Trzeba go karmić, można go przebierać i zmieniać mu tło w jaskini.

POSTĘPY I MOTYWACJA
• cele dnia i seria dni nauki
• Wyzwanie dnia z działu, który sprawia najwięcej kłopotu
• odznaki za każdy dział i wykres minut z całego tygodnia
• po błędzie krótkie przypomnienie zasady – bez karania

DLA RODZICA
• Panel rodzica: minuty nauki z ostatnich 7 dni, skuteczność i tematy do powtórki
• dzienny cel w minutach i przypomnienie o nauce
• bez reklam, bez czatu i bez zbierania danych
• zakup trzeba potwierdzić w oknie płatności Apple (Face ID albo hasło)
• działa bez internetu, na iPhonie i iPadzie, w pionie i w poziomie

PEŁNA WERSJA
Za darmo: 5 pierwszych poziomów każdego działu Klasycznego, 4 krainy Przygody, 5 przeciwników na Arenie, 3 poziomy każdej z pozostałych gier, jedna gra dziennie w Przetrwanie i Wyzwanie dnia. Pełna wersja otwiera wszystko:
• subskrypcja miesięczna – 9,99 zł / miesiąc
• zakup na zawsze – 29,99 zł, jedna płatność

Subskrypcja odnawia się automatycznie, chyba że zostanie wyłączona najpóźniej 24 godziny przed końcem okresu. Opłata za kolejny okres jest pobierana z konta Apple w ciągu 24 godzin przed jego końcem. Subskrypcją można zarządzać i anulować ją w ustawieniach konta Apple.

Warunki użytkowania (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Polityka prywatności: https://runcode.pl/matematyka/prywatnosc

name: Pocket Aces (3830a5)
description:
Pocket Aces — Poker Faces Optional. Personality Required.

Welcome to Pocket Aces, where good cards, great company, and a little friendly competition come together!

Pocket Aces is a free-to-play Texas Hold’em poker league serving Columbia County, Florida. Whether you’re a seasoned player or just learning the game, there’s always a seat at our table.

With the Pocket Aces app, you can:

* View upcoming poker nights and game information.
* Register for the league and reserve your seat.
* Check current season standings and player rankings.
* Follow your points throughout the season.
* Explore poker hand rankings, league rules, and blind schedules.
* Stay connected with the Pocket Aces community.

Play for fun. Compete for bragging rights.

Pocket Aces brings players together through friendly competition, sportsmanship, and a shared love of Texas Hold’em.

No gambling or cash prizes. Just free-to-play poker, good company, and plenty of personality.

Pocket Aces — Good Cards. Great Company.

name: Pocket Level Log
description:
Level a shelf today. Check the same spot tomorrow. Pocket Level Log turns your iPhone into a bubble level and keeps a record of what you measured, where you placed the phone, and how the angle has changed.

• Measure along one edge, check a surface in two directions, or view tilt in three directions with a live 3D gauge.
• Set Home to use any steady position as your zero. Use device calibration when you have a known level surface.
• Hold a reading before moving your phone. Set a target and choose how close you want to get, with an optional vibration when you have a steady match.
• Save readings to named projects. Add a placement note or take a reference photo so you can find the same spot later.
• Open a saved reading and compare it with the live angle. Export a project’s angles and notes as a CSV file when you need a copy.

Use it for hanging frames, checking shelves, or setting up an angle you want to repeat. For the best comparison, use the same edge, spot, and direction each time. Readings display in tenths of a degree; actual accuracy depends on your iPhone and how it’s placed.

The app works offline. No account, ads, or cloud sync. Your readings, notes, and photos are stored on your iPhone.

name: Podlirly
description:
The light at the waterfall is perfect for about twenty minutes.

You meter the scene: f/11, 1/125 s, ISO 100. You want the water to turn to silk, so you thread on a 10-stop filter. Now the question every landscape photographer knows: how long?

Podlirly's ND TIMER answers before you've finished framing. ND1000, OD 3.0, 10 stops: 1/125 s becomes 8 s. Longer than your camera's 30-second limit? Set Bulb, press OPEN, and the bulb timer counts the exposure down, with a beep when it's time to close the shutter and the screen kept awake while you wait.

Happy with it, you pack the scene in your Camera Bag, "Waterfall, ND64, f/11" or whatever you call it, ready for the next trip.

That is one afternoon. The rest of the kit:

METER
Lock an exposure as metered, then change aperture or ISO and read the new shutter speed in ⅓ or ½ stop clicks, with the scene's EV shown alongside.

LENS
Pick a body (full frame, APS-C 1.5× or 1.6×, Micro Four Thirds, 1-inch or medium format 44×33) and a focal length. Podlirly shows the full-frame look, so a 50 mm on APS-C 1.5× frames like 75 mm, with matching depth of field, angle of view and hyperfocal distance on a contact sheet for every format.

PRINT LAB
Paper to pixels, or pixels to paper, at 50 to 1200 dpi. An 8×10 in print at 300 dpi needs about 7.2 MP. Sizes in centimetres or inches.

THE MENU
Camera Bag for saved setups, the Exposure Log of recent work, Custom Functions (dial clicks, your body, print units, bulb beep, screen awake), and Field Notes.

No account, no network, nothing uploaded. It works at the bottom of a canyon just as well as at home.

name: Podsy.fm
description:
Podsy.fm turns your iPhone into a classic click-wheel music player for the music files you already own.

The whole screen is the player: a crisp menu display on top and a big, tactile wheel below. Slide around the ring to scroll, press the centre to choose, and tap MENU to go back. Skip and play/pause sit right where your thumb expects them, with gentle haptic clicks as you go.

YOUR MUSIC, YOUR FILES
• Import songs from the Files app, iCloud Drive, or any cloud drive that appears in the file picker
• Open a ZIP of an album and the audio inside is added for you
• Share or "Open in" audio files from Mail, Safari downloads and other apps
• Plays MP3, AAC/M4A, Apple Lossless (ALAC), FLAC, WAV and AIFF, including hi-res files
• Your original files are never changed; Podsy.fm keeps its own copy so everything plays offline

A LIBRARY THAT FEELS FAMILIAR
• Browse Songs, Artists, Albums, Playlists and Favourites from the wheel
• Search across titles, artists and albums
• Create, rename and reorder playlists
• See how much space your library uses and tidy up in one place

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Works completely offline
• Nothing you import ever leaves your device

FREE CLASSIC, OPTIONAL PRO
The Classic player and every listening feature are free, and you can try every Studio tool for free. Lifetime Pro is a single one-time purchase (no subscription) that lets you apply, save and export the players you design in Studio: colours, materials, patterns and more.

Podsy.fm is an original app inspired by classic click-wheel music players. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any device maker. Copy-protected (DRM) songs, such as streaming-service downloads, can't be played. Please import only music you have the right to play.

name: Poker Card Monsters
description:
Welcome to the Eight Arenas Tournament!

In Poker Card Monsters, every card in your deck is a creature. Build poker hands to attack: pairs, straights, flushes, full houses… The better your hand, the harder your creatures hit. Three of a kind or better summons a creature onto the field to shield you from counterattacks.

A STRATEGIC CARD ROGUELIKE
• 8 arenas, 24 fights, 8 champions with unique rules
• Trainers with permanent bonuses, a shop and a workshop to train your cards
• Chips × mult: every choice matters, every run is different

150 CREATURES TO COLLECT
• 50 families across 4 types: Fire, Shadow, Crystal, Nature
• Rank up your cards to watch your creatures evolve and gain new abilities
• Catch them all, then hunt down their shiny versions

A REAL ADVENTURE
• An 8-chapter story campaign: help Master Pik and Lila unravel the mystery of the Moonless King
• A tutorial that explains each idea right when you need it

DOZENS OF HOURS OF PLAY
• Daily Challenge: the same run for everyone, one attempt a day
• Champion Rush: all 8 champions in a row, in as few hands as possible
• 8 challenge levels, 6 starting decks, 64 achievements, 60 levels, card backs and titles to unlock

Fully playable offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected.

Poker Card Monsters is made by an independent developer. Thank you for your support!

name: Popo Glow
description:
Turn the paths, connect three lights, and brighten your day with Popo. A cozy puzzle for the little breaks in your day.

A small break. A lovely little challenge.
Easy to pick up, with plenty to think about. Take one puzzle at a time, without racing a clock.

Little steps, brighter paths.
Six levels take you from 4 × 4 to 6 × 6 puzzles. Everyone starts with the same 90 stages. Finish every stage in a level to unlock the next. Clear level 6 to earn the Legend title. Then keep going with fresh sets of 20 stages at the same difficulty.

A little more Popo, every time.
Clear each level to unlock a new outfit and expression. Tap Popo for a soft, bouncy hello.

Three little lights. One bright idea.
Each tap turns a tile clockwise by 90 degrees. Connect all three lights at once within the move limit to clear the stage. Popo and the lights stay in place. You only turn the paths. Not every path needs to be used.

Can I stop in the middle of a puzzle?
Yes. Progress is saved on your device so you can pick up where you left off. Deleting app data may erase your progress; there is no separate cloud-save account.

Keep Popo close on Apple Watch. Choose an unlocked outfit, then tap Popo to see a smile, a wink or a happy hop.
Popo stays still on the watch face. Tap the complication to open the Watch app, where Popo moves. A paired iPhone and a compatible complication slot are required.

name: PostRun: Fence Post Spacing
description:
PostRun builds a numbered stake list from a fence run length and the spacing you choose. Fence crews get post positions along the line instead of a generic unit conversion.

The first screen walks through the run and shows the post list. Spacing and saved runs stay on the device.

Free. No in-app purchases, subscriptions, ads, or accounts.

name: Potenzen & Wurzeln lernen
description:
Potenzen und Wurzeln so, wie es in der Schule gemacht wird – Schritt für Schritt, mit klaren Regeln und viel Übung. Für die Oberstufe, die Eingangsklasse und alle, die Potenzgesetze endlich sicher können wollen.

SO LERNST DU
• Entdecken: Erst probierst du aus, was beim Rechnen mit Potenzen passiert.
• Merke: Jede Regel kurz erklärt, mit Beispielen, die sich Schritt für Schritt aufbauen – das Potenzgesetz steht gleich über dem Gleichheitszeichen.
• Üben: Du rechnest wie im Heft – mit allen Zwischenschritten. Kommst du nicht weiter, hilft dir „Schritt für Schritt“.
• Check: Besiege den Endgegner des Kapitels und gewinne einen Würfel für deinen Turm.

8 KAPITEL
Potenzen wiederholen · hoch 0 und hoch minus · Potenzgesetze mit negativen Exponenten · Zehnerpotenzen und wissenschaftliche Schreibweise · Rechnen mit Wurzeln · teilweise Wurzel ziehen · Brüche im Exponenten · Vereinfachen mit Wurzeln und Potenzen. Am Ende: Abschlusstest mit Urkunde und Trainingsnachweis.

MEHR DRILL, MEHR SPASS
• Blitzrunde: 60 Sekunden – du wählst die Kapitel
• Grundlagen-Turbo: Quadratzahlen, Wurzeln, Hoch 3, Zweierpotenzen, Exponenten-Sprint
• Spiele: Potenz-Memory, Wurzel-Schätzer, Größer-oder-kleiner-Duell
• Wiederholungskiste: Was noch nicht klappt, kommt nach 1, 3 und 7 Tagen wieder
• Endlos üben, Tagesziel, Serien, Level und 24 Erfolge
• Game Center: Ranglisten mit deinen Freunden
• Zwei Designs: Hell und Neon

DURCHDACHT
• Eigenes Tastenfeld mit Minus und Komma – keine Handy-Tastatur im Weg
• Exponenten und Wurzeln werden direkt an der richtigen Stelle eingetippt
• Funktioniert komplett ohne Internet
• Keine Werbung, kein Konto, keine Datensammlung

Entwickelt von einem Mathelehrer.

name: POUR CYCLE™
description:
Set it up. Release it all.

POUR CYCLE™ is a short-session drink puzzle game set at a stadium drink stand.

Select ingredients from the rotating cycle, read the incoming orders, and store what you need in your HOLD BUFFER.
When the timing is right, RELEASE your stock and process multiple orders in a satisfying CHAIN.

It is not just about serving as fast as possible.

Do you use an ingredient now?
HOLD it for a future order?
Or wait for the right moment to RELEASE several ingredients in a row?

Managing your limited HOLD BUFFER is the key.

Keep customers waiting too long and they will leave for the RIVAL stand.
Serve more orders, earn more SALES, and beat your RIVAL to clear the level.

Features

• Simple SELECT and POUR&ON controls
• Tilt your device to HOLD ingredients or move backward through the cycle
• Store different ingredients in the HOLD BUFFER
• Build satisfying RELEASE CHAINs
• Short puzzle sessions based on timing and preparation
• Compete against a RIVAL stand for SALES
• Progressively challenging LEVELS
• PRACTICE mode
• No ads
• No gameplay data collection
• No social media integration

Every level is designed to be short and complete.
Read the flow, prepare your ingredients, and release them at the right moment.

HOLD. RELEASE. CHAIN.

All drinks in this game are fictional and non-alcoholic.

name: Pour Decisions: Water Puzzle
description:
A few jugs. A precise order. One satisfying solution.

Pour Decisions is a water-jug logic puzzle set in a bright, cheerful diner. Tap a source, then a destination to pour. Each pour continues until the source is empty or the destination is full. Your job is to fill every glass to its target, using the vessels on the counter to measure the right amount.

START SIMPLE, THINK AHEAD
Learn the rules through six introductory puzzles, then work through a 240-level campaign across six venues. New orders introduce multiple glasses, limited supplies and layered drinks where the order of the liquids matters.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
There is no countdown and no lives to lose. Try an idea, undo a move or restart the puzzle. Aim for the fewest pours and earn up to three stars.

MAKE IT A DAILY HABIT
Unlock the daily puzzle after completing the first ten levels. Build your streak and revisit eligible past daily puzzles.

A LITTLE HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Earn coins by solving puzzles and exchange them for hints. Hints show the next move from your current position, so you can keep learning as you play.

MAKE YOURSELF COMFORTABLE
Choose larger text, liquid patterns or reduced motion in Settings, and adjust sound effects and haptics. Your puzzle progress is saved on your device.

No ads, no in-app purchases and no account required.

name: Practice Us: Mini Games
description:
Practice Mode is the training ground for daily mini game challenges.

Every game is a short test of reflexes, timing or focus, and plays exactly like the real thing: same speeds, same timing, same scoring. Warm up here and be ready when it counts.

• 20 mini games and counting: Rocket Run, Cup Shuffle, Dart Spin, Speed Dial, Tap Frenzy, Juggle, Noodle and more
• True-to-life timing, measured frame by frame
• Personal bests, your last-10 average and a progress chart for every game
• A quick "how to play" card before each game
• New games added regularly

FREE TO PLAY
2 free tries per game every day. Watch a short video for 3 more.

PRACTICE MODE PRO
Unlimited tries on every game, no ads, every new game included. Monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

name: Préau : Cockpit Famille
description:
Préau est le cockpit familial conçu pour simplifier le suivi de la scolarité de tous vos enfants (Primaire, Collège et Lycée) au sein d’une interface unique, claire et apaisée.

FONCTIONNALITÉS PRINCIPALES :
• Aujourd’hui (Cockpit Quotidien) : visualisez en un coup d’œil la préparation du prochain jour d’école, la checklist intelligente du sac du soir, le radar des prochaines évaluations et les actions parents prioritaires extraites des messages.
• École (Devoirs, Emploi du temps, Notes & Vie scolaire) : suivez l’agenda des devoirs par matière et par enfant, cochez les exercices terminés en temps réel avec votre co-parent, consultez les moyennes et simulez l’impact des prochaines notes.
• Carnet de liaison photo : photographiez un mot ou un devoir papier dans le carnet pour l’ajouter instantanément à l’agenda familial.
• Administratif (Messagerie, Finances & Documents) : centralisez les messages des enseignants et de la direction, les certificats de scolarité et le suivi des échéances financières.
• Foyer Familial chiffré de bout en bout (E2EE Zero-Cloud-Clair) : partagez l’accès avec le Père, la Mère, les Grands-parents ou l’Élève par QR Code sécurisé avec validation de l’administrateur du foyer. Les identifiants scolaires sont chiffrés en AES-256-GCM directement sur votre appareil.

MENTION D’INDÉPENDANCE :
Préau est une application indépendante développée pour les familles et n’est ni affiliée, ni éditée, ni soutenue par Aplim / ÉcoleDirecte ou TouteMonAnnée.

name: Presetta DSP
description:
Presetta is a remote for the Sennuopu HIFI X12 car audio processor. Your installer stores up to six sound presets in the processor, tuned for your car and speakers: a reference curve, a daily setting, a highway preset against road noise, more bass. Presetta lets you switch between them in a second, without a laptop or the manufacturer's mini-program.

ONE TAP
Six large buttons, M1 to M6, with your own names. The active preset lights up as soon as the processor confirms the switch.

WIDGETS AND CARPLAY
Add the Presetta widget to the Home Screen. On iOS 26 the same widget appears in CarPlay, so you can switch presets on the car's display without picking up the phone.

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
"Presetta M2" or "Switch Presetta to Highway". Works with your preset names and with the iPhone locked.

ALWAYS READY
Presetta connects to the processor in the background as soon as the car is on, so the widget and Siri respond right away.

BUILT TO PROTECT YOUR SPEAKERS
An empty preset has no crossover filters and can damage the tweeters at volume. Presetta asks which presets your installer has set up and keeps the others locked in the app, the widget and Siri.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Presetta never connects to the internet; your settings stay on your iPhone.

Compatibility: Sennuopu HIFI X12 with its Bluetooth module. iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Widgets in CarPlay need a touchscreen car display.

Presetta switches between presets already stored in the processor and never changes their settings. Switch only to presets your installer has set up: an empty preset may damage the tweeters.

name: PressGrain Ledger
description: அச்சுக்கு முன் அளவுகளை இந்த போனிலேயே மாற்றுங்கள்: பிக்சல், உண்மையான அளவு, வினியோகத் தெளிவு (PPI), பெருக்க விகிதம், வெட்டு·ப்ளீட்·சேஃப் மண்டலம். பொதுவான காகித அளவுகள் உள்ளுறு; அலகு மாற்றம்; திட்டங்களை சாதனத்தில் சேமித்து மீண்டும் பயன்படுத்தலாம். விரைவான தொடக்கத் திரை இல்லை—திறந்ததும் உடனே கணக்கிடலாம்.

name: Pro Headspa
description:
L’application des clients professionnels Pro Headspa : vos formations en ligne et le service après-vente de vos équipements, au même endroit.

FORMATIONS
Retrouvez les formations incluses avec vos équipements et vos formations Pro Headspa : protocoles head spa, prise en main de la Table Headspa Ultra, du Mist Pro, du Dôme Sauna Ultra ou de la caméra LinaVision. Chaque leçon associe une vidéo, des explications et des supports à télécharger. Votre progression est enregistrée : reprenez exactement où vous vous étiez arrêté, sur votre téléphone ou sur ordinateur.

SAV
Un problème avec un équipement ou une question ? Décrivez la situation, ajoutez des photos ou une vidéo prises avec votre téléphone, et envoyez votre demande au SAV Pro Headspa en un geste, par WhatsApp. Le SAV vous répond 6 jours sur 7, et vous êtes prévenu dès que votre demande avance.

CONNEXION SIMPLE
Pas de mot de passe : saisissez l’adresse e-mail de votre compte Pro Headspa et recevez un code de connexion.

L’application est réservée aux clients Pro Headspa. L’accès est créé par Pro Headspa lors de l’achat d’un équipement ou d’une formation.

name: ProcMar
description:
ProcMar is the complete system for marine spares suppliers and ship chandlers. Run your whole business, from the first RFQ to the final payment, from your phone.

SEND RFQS IN SECONDS
Pick the client and vessel, add the parts with part numbers and quantities, and email the RFQ to every supplier at once. Suppliers quote back through a simple link, so prices land straight in ProcMar.

QUOTE AND WIN ORDERS
Compare supplier prices, lead times and condition, then send your client a clean, branded quotation. Track every quote from open to order received, and record the reason when one is lost.

TRACK EVERY ORDER
The operations board follows each order through proforma, purchase order, supplier ready, dispatch, bill, invoice and payment, and flags any step that is running late. Add the carrier and AWB number and open tracking with one tap.

INVOICE AND GET PAID
Create proformas, sales orders, invoices and credit notes in any currency. See balances and due dates at a glance, record payments and send statements to clients.

KNOW EVERY VESSEL
Keep each ship's machinery, makers, models and serial numbers, and see its full RFQ history. Find which vessels carry a given maker in seconds.

ALSO INCLUDED
- Clients, contacts, suppliers, makers and products
- Stock levels, stock adjustments and product photos
- Tasks, call logs and follow-ups for your sales team
- Dashboard with revenue, pipeline and conversion
- Staff logins with role based access
- Works with the ProcMar web portal: the same data, everywhere

ProcMar is a business service. Companies sign up on procmar.com; your team then signs in to the app with their ProcMar account.

name: ProntoPlanner
description:
Organiza qualquer evento sem stress. Do jantar de amigos ao casamento ou ao evento da empresa, o Pronto junta num só lugar as tarefas, as datas, os convidados e o orçamento.

COMO FUNCIONA
1. Cria o evento: nome e data, em menos de 30 segundos.
2. Adiciona as checklists: escreve as tarefas ou escolhe um modelo pronto.
3. Acompanha e conclui: marca o que está feito e vê o progresso a crescer.

TUDO O QUE PRECISAS
• Checklists com progresso — várias por evento, com prazos, prioridade, notas, responsável e subtarefas.
• Modelos prontos — casamentos, aniversários, viagens, mudanças, eventos empresariais e mais.
• Calendário — vista mensal, semanal e diária, com todos os prazos num só lugar. Adiciona eventos ao Calendário do iPhone.
• Lembretes e notificações — eventos próximos, prazos a terminar e tarefas atrasadas.
• Convidados com confirmação por link — cada convidado responde sem precisar de conta e tu recebes logo a notificação.
• Orçamento e fornecedores — controla gastos e contactos (planos pagos).
• Colaboração — convida família, amigos ou colegas, ou partilha um link só de leitura.
• Event Assistant (IA) — ajuda a planear o evento e a criar tarefas.
• Exportação para PDF e pesquisa global.
• Sempre sincronizado — começa no computador, continua no iPhone.

ENTRA COMO PREFERIRES
Com a Apple, com a Google ou com email. A tua sessão fica guardada.

PLANOS
O plano Free é gratuito para sempre. Os planos Plus, Pro e Business são subscrições mensais com renovação automática, com mais eventos, créditos de IA e funcionalidades. O pagamento é cobrado na tua conta Apple ao confirmar a compra; a subscrição renova-se automaticamente, exceto se for cancelada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período. Podes gerir ou cancelar em Definições › o teu nome › Subscrições.

Termos de Utilização: https://prontoplanner.com/termos
Política de Privacidade: https://prontoplanner.com/privacidade

name: Prospect id Hockey
description:
Prospect id is the professional hockey ecosystem. The app is for league and team staff who already have access to their workspace on prospectid.ru.

League office
• Players at every level, KHL, VHL, MHL and RHL, with search and filters.
• Teams and rosters, the All-Star Game, statistical leaders.
• Full player analytics: the Prospect id index, rank among league players, what to improve to move up, player type, consistency across seasons, recent form and game-by-game numbers.
• Video: a player's highlights open right in the app.
• Watch list and notes.

Team workspace
• Game and tournament calendar with "I'm going" check-ins.
• Roster, prospects, player search and favourites.
• Purchases and finished evaluations, with PDF reports inside the app.
• Player analytics for teams with Analytics enabled.

Every day
• Sign in with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Notifications about new evaluations, messages and team events. Tap a notification to open the right section.
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo: on a large screen the list and the player's card sit side by side.
• Light and dark appearance.

Sign in with the username and password of your prospectid.ru workspace. There is no sign-up in the app: access is granted by the Prospect id team.

Available in English and Russian.

name: Proud Clients Workforce
description:
Proud Clients Workforce is the staff communications app for authorized Proud Clients team members.
Access staff text conversations, communicate with teammates, make and receive business calls, and review recent call activity and voicemail.
An authorized Proud Clients staff account is required. This app does not offer public registration.

name: Psalmbrush: Bible Coloring
description:
Color a Bible scene. Read its verse. Pray.

Psalmbrush is a quiet place to color Scripture by number. Every one of the 100 pictures is a Bible scene, from the first light of Creation to the empty tomb, and each comes with its verse, a short retelling of the story and a one-line prayer. Tap a number, pick the matching color, and watch the picture appear a piece at a time.

COLOR BY NUMBER
- 100 hand-picked Bible scenes in 10 collections: Creation and Eden, Noah and the Flood, The Patriarchs, Exodus and Wilderness, Kings and Prophets, Psalms and Wisdom, Birth of Jesus, Parables and Miracles, Easter and the Early Church, Verses to Live By
- Three levels: Gentle (big regions, relaxed), Classic and Detailed (small regions, for steady hands)
- Numbers scale as you zoom, and a button finds the regions you missed
- Free color mode on any picture if you would rather choose your own colors
- Progress is saved stroke by stroke, so you can stop any time

A PICTURE FOR EVERY DAY
- Today shows a new picture each day, always free to color
- Every picture has its Bible verse, a short story and a prayer to read as you finish
- Share your finished picture with its verse as an image
- Home Screen widget with today's picture

READ THE VERSE IN YOUR LANGUAGE
The verse on each picture follows your device language where a public domain Bible is available: English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Japanese and Chinese. In other languages the English verse is shown.

MADE FOR QUIET TIME
- No ads, ever
- No account and no sign-in
- Works fully offline
- Your pictures and progress stay on your device and sync through your own iCloud
- Scenes show people small and gently, with no close-up portraits of Jesus, to keep the focus on the story

START FREE, UNLOCK ONCE
Psalmbrush is free to download. Today's picture and 24 starter pictures are free, including free color mode and sharing. One purchase, Psalmbrush Pro, unlocks all 100 pictures and the Detailed level forever. It is a one-time purchase, not a subscription, and Restore Purchases is in Settings.

BIBLE TEXTS
English: Berean Standard Bible (public domain). Other languages use public domain or openly licensed Bibles, such as Reina-Valera 1909 (Spanish), Bíblia Livre (Portuguese, CC BY 4.0), Lutherbibel 1912 (German), Louis Segond 1910 (French), Diodati 1885 (Italian), Shinkaiyaku 1965 New Testament (Japanese) and the Chinese Union Version. The full list is in Settings.

The stories and prayers were written for this app as a companion to your faith, not a replacement for church or pastoral care. The pictures were created by the developer.

name: Purazi: Farm Records
description:
Purazi helps small-scale farmers in Zimbabwe run their farm from their phone, even with no network.

KEEP FARM RECORDS • Record crops and what you did: planting, fertiliser, spraying, weeding, harvest and sales • Record animals: vaccines, treatments, births, deaths and sales • Big picture buttons, easy to use

RUN YOUR FARM • See what to expect from a crop or animal group: harvest or selling date, yield and profit • Fields, store room, equipment and season budgets • Workers, monthly pay, payslips and tax • Who owes you and who you owe • Compare how your crops and animals perform

STARTER GUIDES, NEWS AND EVENTS • Step-by-step guides with costs and profit for new projects like broilers or tomatoes • Farming news and events for Zimbabwe

TRACK YOUR MONEY • Write down money you earn and spend in USD or ZiG • See what each crop or animal group costs and earns • Share a farm report as a PDF

REMINDERS AND NOTIFICATIONS • Get reminded to vaccinate, spray, weed or sell, even without network • Get told when someone messages you, replies, mentions you or calls

FARMER GROUPS • Group chats for your area: send messages and photos, reply, react and mention other farmers

MARKET • Sell your crops and animals, or find what others are selling nearby • Chat with the buyer or seller inside Purazi and send photos • Call them inside Purazi over the internet, without sharing your phone number

BUY FARM INPUTS • Order seed, fertiliser, chemicals, feed and vet medicine from farm suppliers • Compare seed varieties, collect or ask for delivery, and chat with the company • No payment in the app: pay the company the way you agree

ASK A QUESTION • Ask farming questions by typing or speaking, and get simple answers, even from a photo of your crop • Answers come from Claude AI, only after you allow it

SAFE FOR EVERYONE • Report and block anyone who breaks the community rules

WORKS WITHOUT NETWORK • Your records are saved on your phone and backed up when you have signal

In English, ChiShona and isiNdebele.

name: Purestrike: AI Golf Coach
description:
Purestrike watches your golf swing through your iPhone's camera and gives you one clear thing to work on next.

Prop your phone up and swing. Purestrike notices each swing by itself; seconds later it shows you exactly what went wrong, pictures the correct position and tells you how to fix it, while a coach's voice gives you the one thing to feel next. The score is big enough to read from your hitting position.

Analysis runs on your phone, so it works at the range without a signal, and your videos stay on your phone.

LIVE COACH
• A live skeleton drawn over the camera picture, face-on or down the line, right- or left-handed
• Automatic swing detection and a running swing count for the session
• An instant slow-motion replay of each swing with its overlays
• Tag where the ball went in one tap, or skip it
• Optional impact sound to time the strike

SEE IT, THEN FIX IT
• A "You vs. Goal" picture for every fault: your position as a ghost, the goal position moving into place, and an arrow showing exactly what to change
• Step-by-step "How to fix it" instructions, one swing thought to take to the next ball, and a drill to groove it
• The misses each fault causes (slice, hook, fat, thin), so you know why it matters to your scores
• Before/after frames from your own swings and a progress meter that fills as the fix takes hold

SWING REVIEW
• Frame-by-frame scrubbing with markers for each phase of the swing, from address to finish
• Skeleton overlay, automatic spine, head and hip lines, and your own drawings
• Slow motion and side-by-side or ghost comparison
• Export a short clip with the overlays and share it

PRACTICE PLANS
• A weekly plan of short sessions built around your fix: drills with rep targets, then a range check to see if the change holds
• It moves you on as your fix improves

HOME PRACTICE (NO BALL NEEDED)
• Drills such as pause at the top, feet together and toe up to toe up
• Mirror view with the front camera, automatic rep counting and pass or fail haptics

PROGRESS AND LIBRARY
• Sessions over time, each measurement's trend, your miss pattern, weekly streaks and "Fixed" badges
• Every swing in one place, filterable by club, angle and fault

WHAT IT CAN AND CANNOT SEE
Purestrike estimates body positions from video. It cannot see the club face or the ball, and does not measure distance or speed. Its numbers are estimates for spotting patterns, not lab measurements.

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads and no tracking.
• Your swing videos are recorded, analyzed and stored on your phone.
• Impact sound is checked on your phone and never recorded or sent.
• Optional AI coach notes (Pro), off until you turn them on: you choose to send measurements only, or measurements plus 3 or 4 small stills. Video and audio are never sent.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 10 analyzed swings a week, the live skeleton and swing cards, Your Fix, Home Practice drills, and Swing Review with phase markers, the skeleton and half-speed slow motion.
Purestrike Pro adds unlimited analysis, optional AI coach notes, automatic lines and the drawing tool, slower slow motion, comparisons, clip export and your full progress history.

Purestrike Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. The price is shown in your currency before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Restore Purchases is in the app.

Warm up and swing within your comfort. Purestrike is a practice aid, not medical advice.

name: Puzzles: Calm Logic Games
description:
Five kinds of calm logic puzzles in one beautiful app. No rush, no clutter — just you, a cup of tea and a puzzle that clicks.

CATS
Place one cat in every row, column and colored area. Cats never touch — not even diagonally. A cozy twist on the classic star battle puzzle.

SUDOKU
The timeless number puzzle in 6x6 and 9x9, with notes, highlights and smart hints.

NONOGRAM
Fill in the grid using the number clues and watch a picture appear. Pinch to zoom on big grids; the clues stay in view.

COLOR SORT
Pour colored layers between glass tubes until every tube holds a single color.

CONNECT
Join each pair of matching dots with a line. Lines can't cross, and every cell must be used.

MADE FOR RELAXING
- Easy, Medium and Hard for every puzzle — your progress is kept separately for each
- Hundreds of levels on every difficulty — each one checked to have exactly one solution you can reach by pure logic
- Daily puzzles: the same puzzles for everyone, every day, on every difficulty
- Day streaks — and a free hint for every 7 days in a row
- Gentle hints when you're stuck, undo and restart anytime
- A short walkthrough for every puzzle type
- Light and dark themes, calm music and sounds, haptics
- Large, clear text

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
- Daily leaderboards: fastest times for today's puzzles
- Weekly leaderboard: most puzzles solved this week
- Share a puzzle with a friend and race the same board
- Invite friends: you both get 5 free hints

FREE TO PLAY
Puzzles is free. Here's how it's paid for:
- Ads: a short ad may appear between puzzles. You can also watch an optional video for a hint or an extra life.
- Puzzles Plus (optional subscription — weekly, monthly or yearly, with a free trial): no ads between puzzles, unlimited offline play, and 3 free hints every day.

Every puzzle can be solved without paying.
