name: Qiwa World 365
description:
Qiwa World 365 helps company employees, HR managers, and authorized staff communicate with support teams and manage administrative and financial support requests in one place.

FOR EMPLOYEES
• Create support tickets and describe your requests.
• Attach images and documents to provide supporting information.
• Track ticket status and view responses.
• Reply to tickets and provide additional details.
• Enable notifications to stay informed about ticket updates.

FOR HR MANAGERS AND AUTHORIZED STAFF
• View tickets within your assigned projects and permissions.
• Communicate with employees and respond to requests.
• Update ticket status and assignments according to your access permissions.
• View documents and images attached to tickets.

Available features depend on your user role and assigned permissions. Access requires an employee record registered with the company or an authorized user account. An internet connection is required.

Qiwa World 365 is an internal company support application. It is not a government application and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any government entity.

name: QueenRadar
description:
QueenRadar turns your phone camera into a honeybee comb scanner. Point it at the comb and the app highlights the queen and queen cells in real time — running entirely on your device.

▸ Live, on-device detection
All analysis runs offline on your phone. No account, no sign-up, no internet required for detection, and camera frames are never uploaded.

▸ What it detects
• Honeybee queen — marked and unmarked
• Queen cells

Everything the app detects is free. There are no subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

▸ Magnifier mode
Zoom in and read the number on the queen's marking disc — the number is also read aloud.

▸ Session history
Every scan is saved on the device: counts, duration and the photos you chose to keep.

▸ Help improve the model (optional)
You can voluntarily submit comb photos from the app to help train and improve detection. It's optional, requires no account, and you can withdraw your consent and have your uploads deleted at any time.

▸ More classes coming
Varroa, brood and DWV detection are in training. We add a class to the app only once it is accurate enough to be useful in the apiary.

QueenRadar is an assistive tool — it helps you inspect the comb faster and catch signals worth a closer look. A detection is not a diagnosis and does not replace professional veterinary or beekeeping judgment.

name: Quiz 80·90·00
description:
The lights go up, the clock starts ticking, and the question is for you.

Quiz 80·90·00 is a trivia game in the style of a TV game show, about the three decades we loved: the ’80s, the ’90s and the ’00s. Retro movies, songs, TV series, video games, sports, technology and everything that happened in the world back then. A nostalgia quiz with questions that start easy and get harder step by step.

12 CATEGORIES, 12,000 QUESTIONS
Movies • Music • TV • Theatre • Books • Comics & animation • General knowledge • History & news • Pop culture • Sports • Technology • Video games

1,200 LEVELS
Each category has 100 levels of 10 questions, from easy to hard. Get 6 right to unlock the next one and collect up to 3 stars on every level.

DAILY ROUND
10 questions from different categories, once a day. Play every day to grow your streak and share your score with friends, since everyone gets the same questions.

QUICK GAME
10 random questions whenever you like. Pick categories, decade and difficulty, and chase your record. Questions you saw lately are kept aside.

JUST LIKE ON TV
• 20 seconds per question, with bonus points the faster you answer
• Three lifelines every round: 50:50, Swap question and +10 seconds
• Stage lights, sounds and haptics on every answer
• At the end, see the questions you missed with the right answer

FOR EVERYONE
• A short walkthrough at the start, which you can skip
• Time per question: 20 or 40 seconds, or no limit
• Labels for screen readers, and zoom
• Report a mistake in any question

GREEK AND ENGLISH
Every question is available in both languages. Switch with one tap.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. Works offline.

name: QuizBoz: Trivia Adventure
description:
Take your Boz on a trivia adventure, one round at a time. Pick an answer, read a short explanation and revisit mistakes before completing each stage.

800 rounds, eight themes
Explore 8,000 questions about food, fashion, travel, film and TV, music, games, sports, and animals and nature. Follow 800 mixed-topic rounds or choose a theme dungeon. Both journeys use the same question bank. Start with easier questions and meet more challenging ones as you progress.

A daily quiz and check-in rewards
Try one daily question from a separate collection of 365 check-in quizzes. Collect your base check-in reward and answer correctly to double that day's check-in points. After an incorrect answer, watch an ad to try again.


Make your Boz your own
Use points earned through play for random cosmetic items and equip your favorites. Cosmetics change your Boz’s appearance. There are no paid point top-ups.

No sign-up. Progress stays on your device.
Your progress, points and items are saved on your device. Export a backup in Settings and import it when needed. Without a backup, progress may be lost when the app is deleted or you change devices. Automatic cloud sync is not provided.

Ads or a one-time purchase
Your first new stage each day is free. Further new stages require an ad. Previously completed stages can be replayed for free. Remove ads with a one-time purchase; there is no subscription. Restore that purchase through the store where it was made. Ads and purchases require an internet connection.

Play in Korean, English, Spanish or Brazilian Portuguese.

name: Quran Pocket App
description:
Quran Pocket App is a simple, calm app for reading the Holy Quran.

READ OFFLINE
The Arabic text and translations are stored on your device. You do not need an internet connection to read.

VERSE BY VERSE
Read one verse per screen and swipe up to continue. The app remembers where you left off.

ORIGINAL TEXT AND TRANSLATION
See the original Arabic text together with a translation.

DARK AND LIGHT APPEARANCE
Choose the appearance that is comfortable for you. Your choice is saved.

PRIVACY
There is no sign-in and no account. Your reading progress, favorites and notes are stored on your device. The app contains no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

ABOUT THE CONTENT
The Arabic text comes from Tanzil (tanzil.net) and the translations from QuranEnc (quranenc.com). The app never generates, edits or machine-translates verses or translations.

Quran Pocket App is not a religious authority and does not provide interpretation or religious rulings.

name: Race Zero
description:
Race Zero is a race against the clock, not against traffic.
You enter a destination. The app suggests a time for driving, cycling, or walking. Before the start you may shift that time by only three minutes. Then the countdown runs. At the destination it measures whether you were early or late. The difference stays on your account. Plus means late, minus means early. The goal is zero.
On the way, the time left also appears in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen while your maps app shows the route.
Your profile has a name, a country, and one of ten faces. The name can be used only once. On the world ranking, the players closest to zero are at the top. After each route you see whether you gained places. Finish very close to the route time and you collect an animal: a rabbit, a turtle, or a snail.
Location is used only during a route. Your name, country, profile picture, and time appear on the public iCloud ranking and are visible to other players of this app. There is no tracking and no sale of data.
If you want, you can buy minutes closer to zero, or earn them by finishing daily routes.

name: Radi li danas
description:
Nedjelja je, trebaš mlijeko, a ne znaš radi li išta u blizini? Radi li danas pokazuje na karti koje su trgovine otvorene upravo sada i koje rade sljedeće nedjelje – za Spar, Interspar, Kaufland, Lidl, Konzum i Studenac.

ŠTO APLIKACIJA RADI
• Zeleno je otvoreno, crveno zatvoreno – na prvi pogled, bez pretraživanja.
• „Sada“ pokazuje trenutno stanje i do kada trgovina radi.
• „Nedjelja“ pokazuje koje trgovine rade sljedeće nedjelje i u koje vrijeme.
• Lista najbližih trgovina s udaljenošću i statusom, filtriranje po lancu i samo otvorene.
• Detalji trgovine: radno vrijeme za sljedećih 7 dana, najavljene nedjelje, navigacija jednim dodirom.
• Podaci dolaze izravno sa službenih stranica trgovačkih lanaca i redovito se osvježavaju.

BEZ RAČUNA, BEZ OGLASA, BEZ PRAĆENJA
Lokacija se koristi samo na uređaju da ti pokažemo najbliže trgovine. Ne prikupljamo nikakve podatke.

Radno vrijeme nedjeljom ovisi o odlukama trgovačkih lanaca i objavljuje se tjedan–dva unaprijed; aplikacija prikazuje ono što je lanac objavio. Preporučujemo provjeru prije većeg puta. Aplikacija nije povezana s navedenim trgovačkim lancima; nazivi lanaca koriste se samo za opis podataka. Lokacije Studenca: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

name: Rafiq Al-Quran: AI Assistant
description:
Rafiq Al-Quran is a free companion for reading, listening to and studying the Quran. The complete Quran, all 114 surahs, is bundled inside the app with the Arabic text and nine translations, so reading, search and study work fully offline.

The app is Quran-only. It never writes or invents verses: every verse, translation and reference you see comes from the dataset bundled with the app, and each translation is labelled with its source and translator.

READ
- All 114 surahs, offline
- Book view and card view, with juz and page markers
- Nine translations, shown alone or side by side with the Arabic
- Light and dark themes and adjustable text size
- Find any surah by name or number

LISTEN
- Verse-by-verse recitation streamed from Quran.com, with the reciter's name and source shown
- Play, pause, replay, seek and automatic advance to the next verse
- Lock-screen and Control Centre playback controls
- Reciters: Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Abdul Basit Abdus Samad and Muhammad Siddiq Al-Minshawi

ASK
- Ask a question in your own words and the assistant finds the relevant verses in the bundled Quran
- When it cannot find a confident match, it says so instead of guessing
- Requests for rulings, fatwas or tafsir are politely declined and pointed to qualified scholars
- Voice input and read-aloud using your device's own speech services
- Attach a text or Word document and search the Quran for its themes, read on your device

STUDY
- Bookmark collections, personal notes, saved searches and reading plans with progress
- Everything stays on your device, and you can export it to share

Optional AI assistance is off by default. When you turn it on and agree, it helps with short small talk, suggesting search words and reading text from an image. It never supplies Quran text, translation or interpretation.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Recitation and the optional AI assistance need an internet connection; everything else works offline.

Rafiq Al-Quran is a reading and search assistant, not a religious authority. It does not issue rulings or authoritative interpretation. Please consult qualified scholars where interpretation is needed.

name: RC Music Trivia Mayhem™
seller_name: What It Is What It Do LLC
description:
Hello, everybody! Welcome to Music Trivia Mayhem!

Step into the neon studio with your host, Richard Cheeseburger, and his announcer, Gus Tortellini, in the music trivia game show where the decades roll by behind the board and every answer is a question.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a category and an amount. Richard reads you into it.
• When the clue is up, BUZZ in first and pick the right question. Right: the money is yours and you pick next. Wrong: you lose it, and your opponent can steal.
• It's All You is hidden on the board, once in Round 1 and twice in Round 2. Find it, wager what you dare, and answer it alone.
• Round 2 brings six new categories and doubles every value.
• Final Mayhem: wager on the category, then type your answer, as a question, before 30 seconds run out. A close spelling still counts.
• Most money wins. The champion keeps playing, and the board gets tougher with every win.

THE QUESTIONS
• About 1,800 questions from the 1940s to the 2020s, with no softballs.
• Witty categories, plus one for every chart year from 1958 on.
• Rebus Rockers: picture puzzles that spell bands and singers.
• Nothing repeats until you've seen every question, on any device.

THE SHOW
• Richard reads every category; Gus opens the show, calls the money and signs off with a different line every time.
• A neon 80s studio, the show's own music, and the closing credits rolling at the end.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Play the computer at Easy, Normal or Hard.
• Play online with Quick Match, or start a private game and send a friend the 4-letter code.
• Sign in with Apple (no password) and pick a username: the same account as Richard Cheeseburger's Double Take.
• Worldwide leaderboards: top earners, this week, longest reign, biggest show, Final Mayhem gamblers, rebus solvers and more.

FREE TO TRY
• Your first 3 shows against the computer are free.
• One purchase unlocks the full show. No ads, no subscription, and Family Sharing is included.
• Playing online is always free.

All characters are fictional. Money and scores are all make-believe. Artists and songs named in questions belong to their owners, who are not connected with the game.

name: Realtime Translation: Captions
description:
Read live captions in the spoken language and your chosen translation. Translate microphone speech, a selected media file, or audio from supported apps. Speech recognition and translation run on your device after the required language models are installed.

Save, rename, export, or delete conversations. Sync history and preferences through your private iCloud account, or turn either option off. Share live captions with your nearby devices signed in to the same Apple account.

Pro unlocks translation through a monthly auto-renewing subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Eligible new subscribers can start a three-day free trial. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled. Restore purchases using the Apple account used to buy Pro.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Recharge: Power Nap Timer
description:
Wake up from your nap feeling sharp, not groggy.

Research shows a 10–20 minute nap boosts alertness for hours, while longer naps drop you into deep sleep and leave you foggy. Recharge builds that research into every timer, wakes you with an alarm you can trust, and learns which nap works best for you.

THE NAP
• Presets for every situation: Power nap (20 min), Quick reset (10), Coffee nap (20) and Full cycle (90)
• Every timer includes about 5 minutes to fall asleep
• Brown noise, white noise or silence, fading in and out gently
• A near-black screen with a slow, breathing moon to help you drift off
• Tips on the best time of day to nap, and a heads-up when a nap could cost you tonight's sleep

THE ALARM
• A real system alarm that rings on the lock screen, through silent mode and Focus
• Soft chimes that build gently instead of jolting you awake
• No snooze, because going back under is how you end up groggy

LEARN WHAT WORKS FOR YOU
• Rate each nap: groggy, okay or sharp
• See your streak, weekly minutes and how you usually wake up

RECHARGE PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• Find out which nap length leaves you sharpest, plus your nap patterns
• Apple Health: save naps as sleep, and get a nap suggestion from last night's sleep
• One-press start from Siri or the Action button: "Start a power nap in Recharge"
• Pay once, keep it forever. No subscription.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your naps stay on your iPhone.

Recharge is a nap timer, not medical advice.

name: Reddress Mailroom
description:
Reddress Mailroom is the staff companion for authorized Reddress mailroom clerks and branch managers.

Sign in with your employee code to access Requests, Check in, Shelf and Customers. Review mail-handling requests, manage incoming items and keep branch operations moving from your phone.

Receive notifications for new forwarding, scanning, shredding, pickup, recycling and return-to-sender requests assigned to your branch. Tap a notification to open Requests. Use Lock to sign out when your shift ends.

An active Reddress staff account is required. This app is for staff; mailbox customers should use the Reddress member app.

For help, contact support@reddress.app.

name: Remind & Record
description:
Remember to do things, and remember that you did them. 

Remind & Record is a clean, native iOS app designed for anyone who wants to stay on top of recurring routines, daily habits, or quick one-off checks without the clutter of traditional to-do lists.

KEY FEATURES:

• Quick Check-ins: Log things instantly on demand—like locking the door, checking the garage, or turning off appliances—without setting up complex schedules so you can easily verify "did I?" later.

• Flexible Scheduling: Set up custom reminders tailored to your exact routine. Choose from interval-based reminders (several times a day), weekly slots, monthly dates, or yearly reminders.

• Live Relative Timers: See at a glance exactly how long ago you last completed an activity right on your main list.

• Actionable Notifications: Receive rich local notifications with quick action buttons allowing you to mark complete, snooze for 5 minutes, or skip right from your lock screen.

• Detailed History Log: Review past completions and skips to audit your habits and stay consistent.

• Built-in Starter Templates: Jump right in with pre-configured templates for common tasks like hydration, chores, and household routines.

• Privacy First: All of your data stays secure on your device using local SwiftData storage with no account required.

Built natively with SwiftUI for fluid performance, light/dark mode support, and seamless iOS integration. Download Remind & Record today and bring peace of mind to your daily routine!

name: Reply in DM
description:
Reply in DM automatically sends a direct message to everyone who comments on your Instagram or Facebook posts. Pick a post, choose a keyword (or reply to every comment), write the message, and the app does the rest, 24/7.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Comment-to-DM automation: when someone comments a keyword like "GUIDE" or "LINK", they instantly get your link, discount code or freebie in their inbox.
• Public replies and likes: reply to the comment publicly and like it, so the thread keeps the algorithm happy.
• Story replies: register a story and answer every reply with a DM.
• Subscriber lists: let followers opt in with a trigger word and build an audience you own.
• Broadcasts: send a message to a whole list at once, with images and buttons.
• Scheduling and calendar: create and schedule posts with their reply rules attached, and see them all in a calendar.
• Default rules for new posts: set your rules once and every new post is covered automatically.
• DM assistant: an AI that answers common questions in your inbox using your own instructions and past replies.
• Team workspaces: invite colleagues and manage several pages and accounts in one place.

WHY CREATORS AND BUSINESSES USE IT

• Never miss a lead hidden in your comments.
• Turn "comment LINK below" posts into real conversations within seconds.
• Grow a list of engaged followers you can reach again without paying for ads.
• Works with Instagram Business and Creator accounts and Facebook Pages.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Sign in and connect your Instagram or Facebook account.
2. Pick an existing post or create a new one.
3. Add a rule: keywords, the DM text, an optional button and public reply.
4. Watch the DMs go out and track comments, replies and subscribers in your dashboard.

Reply in DM uses the official Meta APIs. Your account stays secure and nothing is posted or sent without a rule you created.

Questions? Email support@replyindm.com.

name: RepTerra
description:
RepTerra on rauhallinen ja monipuolinen treenisuunnittelija kaikille, jotka haluavat rakennetta ilman ylimääräistä hälyä. Muuta tavoitteesi selkeäksi viikkorytmiksi, seuraa jokaista treeniä reaaliajassa ja ymmärrä, miten harjoittelusi kehittyy ajan myötä.

SUUNNITTELE TARKOITUKSELLA
• Saat henkilökohtaisen aloitusohjelman tavoitteesi, kokemuksesi ja välineidesi mukaan
• Tutustu kahdeksaan ohjattuun ohjelmaan voiman, liikkuvuuden, kestävyyden ja hallinnan kehittämiseen
• Rakenna oma ohjelma valitsemistasi liikkeistä, aikataulusta ja vaikeustasosta
• Näe viikon rakenne, liikejärjestys, sarjat ja tauot ennen aloitusta

SEURAA JOKAISTA TREENIÄ
• Seuraa nykyistä liikettä, sarjaa, toistoja ja lepoaikaa keskittyneessä treeninäkymässä
• Merkitse sarjat valmiiksi ja tallenna rehellinen rasittavuusarvio sekä muistiinpano
• Pidä hyödyllinen treenihistoria ilman, että jokaisesta päivästä tulee kilpailu
• Aloita nopea minitreeni mistä tahansa liikekirjaston liikkeestä

LIVE-TOIMINTO iPHONESSA
iOS 16.1:ssä ja uudemmissa voit pitää treenin näkyvissä lukitusnäytöllä ja Dynamic Islandissa. RepTerra näyttää nykyisen liikkeen, sarjojen edistymisen ja kuluneen ajan samalla, kun sovelluksen ajastin jatkaa seurantaa. Live-toiminnot riippuvat laitteen asetuksista ja järjestelmän tuesta.

NÄE SUUNTASI
• Tarkastele treenejä, minuutteja ja valmiita sarjoja 7, 30 tai 90 päivän ajalta
• Tutki viikon aktiivisuutta, kuormituksen kehitystä ja johdonmukaisuuden ruudukkoa
• Tasapainota harjoittelua voiman, liikkuvuuden, kestävyyden ja hallinnan välillä
• Avaa käytännöllisiä virstanpylväitä rutiinien vahvistuessa
• Lue koko treenihistoria milloin haluat

ARKEEN SOPIVA
• Selkeä englannin- ja suomenkielinen käyttöliittymä
• Valinnaiset, rauhalliset treenimuistutukset valitsemillasi päivillä
• Vie ohjelmat ja historia JSON-tiedostona
• Pääsovellus tukee iOS 15:tä ja uudempia
• Ei tiliä, mainoksia, analytiikkatyökaluja tai pilvisynkronointia

YKSITYISYYS LÄHTÖKOHTANA
Ohjelmasi, asetuksesi ja treenihistoriasi tallennetaan paikallisesti iPhoneen. RepTerra ei kerää terveystietoja, seuraa sinua sovellusten välillä eikä myy henkilötietoja.

LIIKETTÄ, EI LÄÄKETIETEELLISTÄ NEUVONTAA
RepTerra tarjoaa yleistä kuntoiluohjausta. Se ei ole lääkinnällinen laite eikä diagnosoi, hoida tai ehkäise sairauksia. Liiku mukavalla liikeradalla, lopeta jos jokin tuntuu väärältä ja kysy tarvittaessa pätevän ammattilaisen neuvoa.

RAKENNA RYTMI, JONKA PYSTYT PITÄMÄÄN.

name: ResbixPOS
description:
ResbixPOS is an enterprise restaurant operations and point-of-sale management terminal designed for restaurant owners, branch administrators, order takers, and delivery riders.

ResbixPOS streamlines daily restaurant operations with dedicated role-based portals:

• FOR RESTAURANT OWNERS & EXECUTIVES:
- Real-time sales monitoring across all restaurant branches.
- Daily and monthly net sales, gross revenue, cost price, and net profit analytics.
- Real-time tracking of open deliveries and dine-in vs. takeaway order volume.
- Branch performance breakdowns with refund and expense auditing.

• FOR BRANCH MANAGERS & ADMINS:
- Monitor live branch orders, kitchen status, and staff activity.
- Track daily operating expenses and inventory purchase logs.
- Manage branch employees, shifts, and salary records.

• FOR ORDER TAKERS & WAITERS:
- Rapid table selection and fast short-code item search for fast-paced service.
- Dynamic modifier/variant selection and custom item instructions.
- Instant order printing and automatic Kitchen Display System (KDS) submission.
- Real-time order status tracking with configurable reopen and edit windows.

• FOR DELIVERY RIDERS:
- Clear list of assigned delivery orders with customer delivery address.
- Seamless status updates: Mark Picked Up and Mark Delivered.
- Cash On Delivery (COD) tracking and real-time commission earnings calculations.

DESIGNED FOR EFFICIENCY:
- Full support for both Light and Dark modes.
- Optimized for iPhone and iPad in high-pressure restaurant environments.
- Secure terminal session authentication.

Note: ResbixPOS is an internal terminal for registered restaurant personnel. Accounts are issued and managed directly by your restaurant organization administrator.

name: Résidence Feuille Pro
description:
Résidence Feuille Pro brings every Résidence Feuille service in Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo, into one place: yours.

Individuals and companies follow everything from their phone:
- Hotel: stays, bookings and invoices.
- RFcar: vehicle rental, with or without a driver.
- Kokoma: sourcing from China, quotes, tracking and delivery.
- Kotinda: courier and meals from partner restaurants.
- Paraphe: office supplies.
- Also custom furniture, 3D printing, websites and management software.

What the app adds:
- A tour of the services on first launch.
- Notifications: a quote is ready, an invoice, a message from the team.
- Face ID: lock your space when you leave the app, if you wish.
- Documents by photo: company registration, tax number, licence or any attachment, from the camera or your files.
- Sharing: send an invoice or a quote by email, WhatsApp or to Files in one tap.
- Companies: your team, roles and spending limits, approvals and accounting per service.

Same account as Kokoma. Sign in by email, WhatsApp code or with Apple. The app is in French.

name: Restaurant Studios Owner
description:
Restaurant Studios Owner is the app for restaurants that work with Restaurant Studios on menu design and printing, restaurant websites, online ordering and point of sale.

Everything for your restaurant in one place:

• Menu proofs: see each new design as soon as it is ready.
• Invoices: see what is due and what is paid.
• Print orders: follow your order from printing to delivery, with tracking.
• Messages and calls: reach your Restaurant Studios team in one tap.
• Notifications: know when a proof is ready, an invoice arrives or your order ships.
• Your services: see your website, online ordering and other services, and ask about new ones.

Sign in with the Apple account your Restaurant Studios contact added for you. New to Restaurant Studios? Visit restaurantstudios.com to get started.

name: RetroBinder
description:
Combien vaut ta collection de cartes à collectionner ? RetroBinder te donne la cote du jour de chaque carte et la valeur totale de tes classeurs.

COTE DU JOUR
• Toutes les cartes depuis 1999, en français, anglais et japonais
• Prix mis à jour chaque jour (Cardmarket et TCGplayer), avec moyenne 24 h, 7 jours et 30 jours
• Graphique d'évolution du prix de chaque carte
• Bandeau des cotes qui défile et mouvements de la semaine

SCANNER
• Passe ta carte devant l'appareil photo : elle est reconnue en direct, avec sa cote
• La lecture se fait sur ton téléphone, aucune image n'est envoyée

TES CLASSEURS
• Range tes cartes dans des classeurs personnalisés (version, état, langue, quantité)
• Note tes dépenses (boosters, displays, ETB…) et vois ton bénéfice ou ta perte
• Liste de souhaits, sauvegarde et export

EXTENSIONS ET PRODUITS SCELLÉS
• Toutes les séries et extensions, avec la valeur de chaque set et ta complétion
• Prix des boosters, bundles, ETB, displays et coffrets

MARCHÉ ENTRE COLLECTIONNEURS
• Vends, achète ou échange tes cartes avec d'autres collectionneurs
• Messagerie, avis après chaque échange, abonnements aux membres
• Recherche et filtres (langue, état, prix, ville)
• Signalement et blocage sur chaque annonce et chaque profil

RetroBinder est une application indépendante, non affiliée à Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, Creatures ou GAME FREAK. Les noms et illustrations des cartes appartiennent à leurs propriétaires respectifs.

name: Revitag: Inspections & QR
description:
Revitag is your maintenance and inspection logbook, in your pocket. Add each piece of equipment with a photo, stick on a QR label printed on your own printer, and Revitag reminds you of every check the regulations call for. Inspect in two taps and export a signed PDF report.

For gyms, apartment buildings, hotels, offices, restaurants, schools, workshops, construction sites and safety officers. No account, no per-user pricing, and it works offline.

HOW IT WORKS
• Take a photo: Revitag reads the equipment nameplate (brand, model, serial number, year and capacity) and suggests the template and the checks it needs.
• Stick on its QR: print labels on standard US Letter or A4 sheets, or on label-printer rolls. Anyone can scan them with their phone camera.
• Check it and prove it: scan, tap "All OK", sign, and the report is ready for the inspector, the fire marshal or the insurer.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Checklists with big buttons: OK, fail or N/A. Something wrong? Mark the item, add photos and an issue is opened.
• PDF reports per inspection, per item or a compliance report for a whole site: up to date, due soon, overdue and open issues. With photos, the technician's and manager's signatures, date and a SHA-256 fingerprint.
• PPE: hand over gear to each worker with size, expiry date and an on-screen signature, get a PDF receipt and reminders for periodic checks (like the yearly harness inspection).
• Reminders before every due date, widgets, Siri and Shortcuts.
• Import your inventory from CSV or Excel and export everything whenever you like.
• iPhone and iPad with one purchase; your data syncs between your devices through your iCloud.

REGULATIONS BUILT IN
More than 140 templates for the US, the UK, Spain, France, Italy and Germany, each with its frequency, who does it (you, your service company or an inspection body), checklist and legal reference:
• United States: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.157 and NFPA 10 for portable fire extinguishers (monthly, annual, 6-year and 12-year), emergency lighting (NFPA 101), fire alarms (NFPA 72), eyewash stations (ANSI/ISEA Z358.1), forklifts (OSHA 1910.178), AEDs, first aid kits, ladders and more.
• Plus the UK, Spain, France, Italy and Germany.
Add a fire extinguisher and Revitag already knows its monthly, annual and hydrostatic test dates from the year of manufacture. Every frequency is editable.

name: Ricochet: Neon Angles
description:
Draw one line and send a glowing pulse into the portal. Pick the angle, catch the sparks, and try for a three-star shot.

Play 30 Journey levels across five chapters, see how far you can chain portals in Endless, or take on the five-puzzle Daily Shot. Daily Shot changes at midnight UTC. Play offline on iPhone or iPad and pick up where you left off.

name: Rin: Habit Garden
description:
A habit tracker for people who start strong and stop.
You start with good intentions. A few days go well. Then life gets busy, you miss a day, and suddenly it feels like you're back at the beginning.
Rin is built for what happens next.
Instead of chasing perfect streaks, you grow goals through small, everyday habits. Each goal becomes a flower. Every day you show up, it grows. When you don't, nothing resets.

ONE GOAL. DIFFERENT WAYS TO GET THERE.
Want to move more? Go for a walk, stretch, or do a short workout.
Choose up to three habits for each goal. Complete just one that's due, and the day counts. On harder days, the smallest step is still progress.

NO STREAKS. NO STARTING OVER.
Miss a day, or a whole week. Your progress stays.
Your flower may fade a little while you're away, but it never dies. When you return, it starts growing again.
And when life gets in the way, you can pause a goal without losing what you've built.

WATCH YOUR PROGRESS BLOOM.
Every goal grows its own flower, hand-drawn using text characters.
Watch it develop from a tiny sprout into a full bloom as your progress builds. Explore your garden, where every flower tells the story of a goal you've worked towards.

UNDERSTAND HOW HABITS FORM.
Building a habit takes time. Research suggests habits often take around two months to feel automatic. Some take less, others much longer.
Rin guides you through five phases of habit-building, with gentle explanations of what to expect along the way.
There's no deadline for growth.

NOTICE YOUR PATTERNS.
Which habit helps you show up most often? How has your week been going?
Rin offers small, personal observations to help you understand your routines, not just count completed days.

MADE FOR YOUR EVERYDAY.
• Grow up to three goals at once
• Choose daily, weekday or weekly habits
• Explore your garden and year of progress
• Tick off habits directly from your home screen
• Choose from five colour palettes
• Use light or dark mode
• Set a daily reminder and receive a weekly recap
• Export your habit history as a CSV file
• Sync privately between your devices with iCloud

YOUR HABITS STAY YOURS.
No account. No ads. No subscriptions.
Your goals and habits stay on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud. We can't read them.
Rin is completely free.
You don't have to be perfect to make progress.
Just keep growing.

name: Ring Round: Wedding Games
description:
You’re the best man, maid of honour or a good friend – and you’re in charge of the games at the wedding? Ring Round has everything you need: tasteful, family-friendly and without drinking games.

COUPLE QUIZ: WHO’S MORE LIKELY?
The classic shoe game: the couple sit back to back and raise the shoe of the person each question fits. Over 60 questions to choose from, plus your own. If you like, both partners answer secretly on the phone beforehand – at the reveal everyone sees on the big screen whether they agree.

GUEST QUIZ ABOUT THE COUPLE

PRINTABLE GUEST BINGO

TASKS AND PHOTO TASKS

SCHEDULE WITH TIMER
Plan the running order with times and lengths. The timer shows big how much time is left and what comes next.

BIG ON THE TV

FOR EVERY COUPLE
Choose names and titles freely: bride & groom, groom & groom, bride & bride or completely neutral. Add a photo of the couple to make it personal.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your device.

FREE AND WEDDING PACK
Free: 10 questions each in the couple quiz and the guest quiz, 1 bingo card, 5 tasks, the schedule with timer and the big screen.
Wedding pack (one-time purchase, no subscription): unlimited questions, bingo cards for every guest, all tasks and any number of weddings.

PET FACE-OFF
Your pet deserves a crown. Snap your cat, dog, bunny or bird and go paw to paw in Pet Face-Off, where the cutest pet wins, no AI needed. Every pet battle win scores a point for your pet's team in the weekly Team War: Dogs vs Cats, with bunnies and birds fighting for Other Pets. When the week ends, everyone on the winning team earns bonus clout.

WEEKLY CLASH CUP
Every Friday, one theme. One knockout bracket. Battle your way through the rounds and see who takes the Cup.

THEME CROWNS
Win a theme and you become its King. Your crown shows up on your profile so everyone knows who ruled that look.

KEEP IT FRESH
Unlock mystery themes, build your daily streak, and share 9:16 reveal videos made for your stories.

KIND BY DESIGN
RoomClash is built to feel good. Losses are kind: you'll see what share of voters loved your room, never who voted against you, and voters are never shown. Reports go to a human review team within 24 hours, and faces require a live selfie to keep things real.

Ready for your glow-up? Download RoomClash, snap your first morph and claim your crown today!

name: RosterCheck: Model Trains
description:
Do I already own this one?
At a train show or hobby shop, type the road number and RosterCheck answers in seconds: how many you own, which box they're in, and whether it's on your want list. It works offline, so a weak signal on the show floor doesn't matter.

■ Check: "Do I own it?"
The first screen is one big search box. Type a road number, an item number or a reporting mark. "4014", "CVRR 4014" and "CVRR-4014" all match. The answer comes in four kinds:
· YOU OWN: how many, which box or shelf, when you bought it and for how much
· ON YOUR WANT LIST: with the max price you set
· SIMILAR: for example, other boxcars of the same road with different numbers
· NOT IN YOUR ROSTER
If some cars have no number yet, RosterCheck tells you to check their photos instead of saying "you don't own it."
Tap Read label, take a photo of a box label, and pick the number it finds. The text is read on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.

■ Bought it: log it on the spot
Tap Bought it on the answer, enter the price, and save. The road and number come from what you typed. The car goes into today's show, your budget goes down, and the matching want-list item is checked off. Add photos and the box later at home.

■ Train show mode
Before a show, set a budget and pick what to find from your want list. At the show, see what's left of your budget and which finds you've checked off. Get a reminder the evening before. When you're done for the day, share your haul as an image card.

■ Roster: every car, by box
Cars are grouped by tub, case, shelf or drawer, so you always know where each one lives. Switch to Accessories (track, buildings, power packs) or your Want list. Filter by type, scale, road or tag, and sort by road and number, type, scale, purchase date or price. Select several cars and move them to a box at once.

■ One page per car
Reporting mark, road number, item number, maker, type, scale (N, HO, S, O, G, Z, TT, OO), era, paint scheme, original box, condition, purchase date, price, where you bought it, DCC address, tags, notes and a photo album.
A number, an item number or just a photo is enough to save. "Missing info" shows what to fill in later. Duplicate a car to enter the next one with only the number changed. RosterCheck warns you about duplicate road numbers and DCC addresses. Log simple maintenance for locomotives.

■ Want list
Set a max price, a priority, and a release date for pre-orders, with a reminder on release day. Print your want list as a PDF to take to the show.

■ Stats and PDF lists
Car count, total value, breakdowns by type, scale and road, prices by where you bought, cars by year, and what's in each box with the free space. Make an insurance list (PDF) with photos, or a box-by-box list (PDF) so your family knows what's where.

■ Bring your spreadsheet
Import a CSV from Numbers, Google Sheets or Excel. Match the columns, set the type, scale and box for all rows at once, and skip rows that look like cars you already have.

■ Your data stays on your iPhone
No account. Nothing is sent to a server. Export a backup (ZIP) with all your cars, accessories, want list, shows and photos, and use it to move to a new iPhone.

■ Pricing
Every feature is free. The free version holds up to 20 cars. Accessories, want list items, boxes and shows don't count.
Hit the limit at a show? Bought it keeps up to 10 purchases as pending, and Check still finds them.
RosterCheck Pro is a one-time purchase. It removes the 20-car limit and the watermark on share cards. No subscription.

WHAT YOU GET

• Movement since last week, shown with an arrow, a number and words

FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no account and no tracking: your team is saved on your phone. If you turn on alerts, we keep an alert address for your phone, the team you follow and the last alert we sent it. Turn alerts off in the app and we delete them.

name: Rug Reveal
description:
Every rug has a secret. Yours is buried under mud, hair, gum and things we will not name.

Rug Reveal is a satisfying cleaning game. Drag your tools across a filthy rug, watch the grime come off layer by layer, and uncover the hilarious picture woven underneath: a cat in a business suit, a hot dog astronaut, a goose emperor demanding bread.

HOW IT WORKS
- Dust and pet hair sit on top, so vacuum and rake them first.
- Mud, food, gum and worse hide in the middle. Scrape, scoop and soak them.
- Stains, grease, mold and paint are ground into the fibers. Spray the right solution and scrub.
- Rinse the rug, squeegee the water, and the picture comes to life.

PICK THE RIGHT TOOL
Vacuum, rubber rake, scoop, scraper, sponge, scrubber, steam cleaner, wet vac and a whole shelf of cleaning solutions. Every kind of dirt has a best tool, and using the right one is much faster. Earn coins on every rug and upgrade your gear.

BOSS RUGS
Every fifth rug is a giant two-sided boss: more dirt, more kinds of dirt, and a bigger reward. Clean one side, flip it, and finish the other.

WATCH IT BACK
Every rug records a timelapse of your cleaning. Share the video with friends.

MORE FUN
- Eleven kinds of dirt and a shelf of tools to master
- Cute, funny hidden pictures to discover
- Short rugs for a quick break, bosses for longer sessions
- Relaxing, no timers, no punishment for taking your time
- Works offline

FREE TO PLAY, HONESTLY
Rug Reveal is free. Here is how it is paid for:
- Ads: a short ad may appear after you finish some rugs. You can also watch an optional ad to get a free Super Cleaner boost or double your coins.
- Remove Ads: a one-time purchase that removes the ads between rugs. Optional ads for rewards stay available, because they are your choice.
- Turbo: optional purchases (1 day or 7 days) that make every rug clean twice as fast.
- Invite friends: share your personal link. When a friend installs the game, they get 24 hours of Turbo free, and you get 24 hours of free Turbo when they finish their second rug.

Nothing in the game is required to be bought. Every rug can be cleaned without paying.

name: Rumi: Tiny Stories

Your story, but tiny.

EVERY ROOM IS A MEMORY
The first apartment, the ramen place, the rainy trip, the proposal. Each one becomes its own little room.

THE TINY PEOPLE ARE YOU
Your hair, your glasses, your outfits, your pets. Tap anyone and they talk the way you actually talk.

PLAY IT AS A STORY
Put the rooms in order and press Play. The house walks through them one story at a time, and a reveal room can stay wrapped like a present until the very end.

Made for iPhone and iPad.

name: SafeStay Radar
description:
Checking into a hotel, resort, vacation rental, or Airbnb? SafeStay Radar is a privacy-first room inspection toolkit designed in clear, everyday language so anyone can inspect their room in just 3 minutes.

WHY COMBINE MULTIPLE INSPECTION TOOLS?
No single smartphone sensor can detect every covert device (for example, an offline SD-card camera will not appear on Wi-Fi). SafeStay Radar guides you through a transparent 4-layer cross-check:

1. ROOM WI-FI CAMERA SCANNER
• Discover all devices connected to your room's local Wi-Fi subnet.
• Identify hardware vendors (MAC OUI) and inspect common video streaming ports (RTSP, ONVIF, HTTP).
• Live "Unplug to Identify" monitor: Alerts you the instant a suspicious device drops offline as you unplug a bedside clock, wall adapter, or lamp.

2. OPTICAL LENS GLINT & IR NIGHT-VISION FINDER
• Combines your camera, safe low-frequency torch pulse (max 2Hz), and 4 high-contrast optical filters to help spot tiny pinhole lens reflections.
• Helps detect invisible infrared (IR) night-vision LEDs in darkened rooms.
• Capture locally encrypted evidence snapshots stamped with room & time metadata.

3. 3-AXIS MAGNETOMETER & BLUETOOTH (BLE) TRACKER RADAR
• Reads your phone's 3-axis magnetometer (µT) with audio pitch guidance when sweeping smoke detectors, vents, frames, or outlets.
• Scans nearby Bluetooth Low Energy signals with hot/cold distance tracking to locate unknown wireless trackers or hidden audio bugs.

4. 18 HIGH-RISK SPOTS CHECKLIST & TWO-WAY MIRROR TEST
• Step-by-step room checklist across Bedroom, Bathroom, TV Desk, and Entryway.
• Illustrated fingernail reflection test for checking two-way mirrors.

5. MULTILINGUAL AI DEVICE ASSISTANT (EN • JA • DE • FR • ES • VI)
• Unsure what a cryptic model number or Wi-Fi hostname means? Ask the AI Assistant for a plain-language explanation and visual verification steps in English, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, or Vietnamese.

100% LOCAL PRIVACY FIRST
• Wi-Fi scanning, camera preview, magnetic readings, and encrypted evidence photos stay 100% local on your device. No GPS tracking, no ad SDKs, and no personal data collection.

OPTIONAL PRO SUBSCRIPTIONS (SAFESTAY PLUS & VIP)
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://dungnp4.github.io/safestay-radar-legal/terms_disclaimer.html
• Privacy Policy: https://dungnp4.github.io/safestay-radar-legal/privacy_policy.html

Transparency & Disclaimer: No mobile app can guarantee 100% detection of every covert device (such as powered-off or offline SD-card cameras). SafeStay Radar is an assistive inspection reference tool provided "as is" and does not replace professional TSCM sweeps.

name: Salah: Key to Jannah
description:
WHY I MADE IT
I wanted an iPhone app that just works. Open it and it keeps the record: tick each prayer, find the Qibla easily, and see all your Qaza in one place. Most of us don't know how many prayers we missed in the past. You don't need to know. Each time you pray a Qaza for an old missed prayer, add it with one tap, and the app keeps the count for you. The wheel shows your whole year at a glance, so you can see quickly how many days were prayed, made up or missed. No account and no hassle. Your record stays on your iPhone, with a copy in your own iCloud, so it is there on your next iPhone too.

The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said that salah is the key to Jannah (Tirmidhi, Ahmad). Most of us try to pray every prayer, but few of us keep a record of the ones we miss.

Salah: Key to Jannah keeps that record for you. Tick each prayer as you pray it. When a prayer's time ends without a tick, it goes on your Qaza list by itself, so you always know exactly what you owe. Make them up one at a time, until your list is clear, in sha Allah.

No points, no pressure. No account, no ads, no tracking.

QAZA (QADA) THAT LOOKS AFTER ITSELF
• Missed prayers are added as soon as their time ends
• Make-ups recorded one by one, most recent missed prayer first
• Make-ups of prayers from before you started, counted separately
• How many are still owed and how many you have made up, at a glance

PRAYER TIMES FOR WHERE YOU ARE
• Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha for your location, worked out on the phone
• 11 calculation methods, including Moonsighting Committee, ISNA, Umm al-Qura, Karachi and Muslim World League
• Standard or Hanafi Asr, and a high-latitude rule for places like the UK
• A reminder when each prayer starts, for the prayers you choose
• Your mosque's jamaat times, and reminders at the jamaat time if you prefer

QIBLA
• A compass that shows how far to turn, and a tap from your iPhone when you face the Qibla
• True north when location is allowed, and the distance to Makkah

TODAY AT A GLANCE
• Each prayer with its time window, and a sky that follows the time of day
• The Hijri date, the moon phase and Ramadan times
• Mark a prayer as distracted to see your khushu, and record sunnah prayers if you switch them on
• Essential mode keeps only the day's arc and the five prayers

CALENDAR AND INSIGHTS
• Your year in a wheel, by month or by Hijri month. Press and hold the wheel to zoom in
• The prayer you find hardest, your best month, and how often you pray on time and with khushu
• Save a month as an image

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics
• Your records stay on your phone
• A copy in your own iCloud for a new iPhone, which you can switch off
• Backup and CSV export whenever you want

30 DAYS FREE, THEN ONE PAYMENT
Everything is open for 30 days. Nothing is charged automatically. After that your history, calendar, Qaza list, insights and backups stay open, and recording prayers needs a one-time unlock. No subscription. The unlock also brings gold accents and a choice of app icons.

name: Sati Chant
description:
Read and listen to a library of Pāli chants with English translations and clear, adjustable reading views. Sati Chant is an offline companion for personal recitation and study.

• Browse chants by collection and search the library.
• Follow Pāli alongside English, or focus on one language at a time.
• Listen to recordings for selected chants and follow verse timing in supported texts.
• Build personal practice routines and save favorite chants.
• Continue where you left off with recent texts and on-device practice history.
• Adjust text size, appearance, and reading layout to suit your practice.
• Choose English, 简体中文, or 繁體中文 for the app interface and available translations.

Core library and practice preferences are available offline. Personal routines, bookmarks, reading preferences, and practice history are stored on your device.

Sati Chant is a reading and chanting aid. It is not a substitute for guidance from a qualified teacher or community.

name: Satz – Gym Planner
description:
Satz is your workout plan for the gym and for home. Pick a plan, tick off your sets, get stronger.

THE RIGHT PLAN
Eight ready-made plans: Beginner Basic, Full Body 3×, Home, Weight Loss, Endurance, Upper / Lower, Push / Pull / Legs and Strength 5×5. The plan finder picks the right one in three questions. Copy any plan and make it your own.

LOG YOUR SETS
Enter weight and reps, tick the set, done. The rest timer starts on its own and adjusts with a tap. Satz remembers your last numbers and tells you when it's time to add weight. Your current set and rest show on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

37 ANIMATED EXERCISES
Every exercise comes with an animated figure, form, breathing, tempo, common mistakes and alternatives.

PROGRESS
Calendar, weekly volume, records with estimated 1RM and milestones, from your first workout to the 100 kg club.

FOOD
Your calorie and protein needs for building, maintaining or losing weight, with protein sources for every diet, vegetarian and vegan included.

• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your data stays on your iPhone, with a daily backup in the Files app
• Light and dark mode
• Pay once, keep it forever

In English and German.

name: SayMend
description:
SayMend helps you communicate with picture cards when speaking is hard. Tap a card and your phone speaks the phrase clearly—simple, fast, and ready when you need it.
Build a personal communication board with everyday phrases for help, water, rest, and more. Add your own cards, edit the wording, attach photos, and record custom voice clips. Arrange the board and choose a layout that feels easy to use.
Care ID shows your name, photo, and key contacts in large, readable text so helpers can quickly understand who you are and how to reach someone important.
Need attention nearby? Play a loud attention sound to alert people around you.
SayMend is a practical companion for clearer everyday communication—at home, while traveling, and in moments that matter most.

name: Scanevol Labels: Barcode Maker
description:
Make QR codes and barcodes in seconds, then print them on standard label sheets.

MAKE A CODE
QR, EAN-13, UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, ISBN, Code 128, Code 39, ITF-14, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec and GS1 Digital Link.
The check digit is added for you, and a wrong one is caught before you print.

PRINT LABELS
Choose A4, Letter or a label roll, then the label size and how many copies. Print, or save the PDF.
Sheets match common Avery layouts, with more sizes in the list.

IMPORT A LIST
Print a whole product list from a CSV file: code, name and copies on each line.

KEEP YOUR CODES
Save codes on your phone and find them again with search.

WORKS OFFLINE
No account. Your codes stay on your phone.

FREE AND PRO
Free: make, share and save codes, and print one sheet.
Pro, paid once: every page, list import and no watermark.

name: School Workbench
description:
School Workbench puts a student's whole school day in one calm place. It brings in assignments, due dates and calendar events from your school's Google Classroom and Google Calendar, then helps you decide what to do tonight.

PLAN MY DAY
Tap Plan my day and get a timeline for tonight: what to start first, how long each thing should take and when you'll be done. It works around practice, dinner and anything else on your calendar, and it learns how long your work really takes.

GABRIEL, YOUR STUDY COACH
Gabriel is an AI study coach. It explains ideas, helps you outline and checks your thinking, but it won't write your assignments or hand you answers to turn in. Before you use Gabriel, the app shows exactly what is sent to the AI model, and you choose whether to allow it. Your school can review Gabriel chats.

NOTIFICATIONS AND WIDGETS
Get a heads-up when a teacher posts something new, an evening reminder about what's due tomorrow and, if you want it, a short plan for your day at the times you pick. Home Screen widgets show what's due next.

FOR PARENTS
When your school sets it up, parents can see their child's schedule, assignments, grades and attendance, and get a notification about absences.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Read-only access to Google Classroom and Calendar
• Your data stays with your school, and is never sold or used for ads
• Never used to train AI models
• Delete your account any time from Settings

School Workbench is provided through your school. Students sign in with the Google account their school gives them.

name: Schrödinger Roulette
description:
(No ads)

Just when you think it’s settled, a cat swats the game sideways. A well-timed paw can send a ball off course or knock a dart into a different slice. Add your choices for dinner, turn order, or whatever’s up for debate. Turn a quick spin or ladder draw into a mini-game worth watching to the last bounce.

• Bomb Tag — When two balls collide, the bomb changes hands. The last ball standing wins.
• Golf Smash — Follow the balls up into the sky and back down. The one that rolls closest to the flag wins.
• Pinball Escape — Watch the balls ricochet off bumpers and spinning bars. First through the exit wins.
• Dart Throw — Follow the dart as it flies toward a spinning wheel. The slice it lands in decides the winner.
• Ring Survival — Be the last ball inside a shrinking ring. A bounce off the outer bar might send you back in.

Make a pick with Ladder Draw, Wheel Spin, or Coin Toss, or share one device for a round of Push the Line or Reaction Speed.

Bomb Tag is free. Try Golf Smash, Pinball Escape, and Ladder Draw once each. A single purchase unlocks all nine extra modes.

name: Scrapwalker: Fortress Survivor
description:
A tiny scrap shack walking on mechanical legs. Ram into scrap heaps and abandoned machines to swallow them — floors stack up, legs multiply, and it evolves into a towering war fortress.

● Parts that fire on their own, a beam you fire
Gun, saw, plate, tesla coil, missile pod, magnet — mounted parts shoot the raider swarm by themselves. Your hands only move and fire one special: hold the pressure gauge to charge, release, and the boiler beam pierces the swarm across the screen.

● A giant boss with its own trick every stage
A drill fortress that charges and gets stuck, a crane that hooks you in, a cannon train racing on rails, an icebreaker shielding its front, and a scrap king that pulls scrap to revive. Each boss has its own way to dodge and its own opening to punish with the beam.

● Grow in style
From a tier-1 shack to a tier-5 war fortress. Parts change shape as they level up, and two grown parts combine.

● A five-terrain run
Meadow, factory marsh (beam the oil pools to set them ablaze), sand desert (sandstorms), ice tundra (slippery ice) and ash volcano (erupting cracks). Fail and you keep the scrap you gathered — permanent garage upgrades make you stronger every run.

● No ads, plays offline
No ads, no data collected. Plays offline.

name: Scroll the Epics: The Ramayan
description:
The Ramayana is one of the great stories of the world: a prince sent into exile, a wife carried off, a monkey who leaps the sea, and a long road home. Now you can read it the way you read everything else, one card at a time.

Scroll the Epics retells all seven Books of Valmiki's Ramayana in modern English. Every card is read aloud, so you can read, listen, or do both.

THE WHOLE STORY
From the boy princes of Ayodhya and Sita's choice of husband, to fourteen years in the forest, Ravana's golden deer, Hanuman's leap to Lanka, the war, the return, and the hard last Book that many retellings leave out. Choose the main story, or the full story with its side tales.

VALMIKI, AND THE STORIES AROUND HIM
The cards follow Valmiki's poem. Well-loved tellings that aren't in it, like Urmila's long sleep, appear on their own marked cards, so you always know which is which. Explain notes open up names, places and Sanskrit ideas, and how readers have argued over the hardest passages.

MADE FOR READING
• A family tree that grows as you meet people, without spoilers
• My Journey, a map of your progress through the seven Books
• Saved cards and progress through every episode
• Speed, music and colour settings, with a clean screen at a tap
• Every card's narration is in the app, so it all works offline

START FREE
Read all of Book 1 and the first half of Book 2 for free, up to the night King Dasharatha dies. Then unlock everything with a single payment. No subscription.

Scroll the Epics is an adaptation, not a translation.

name: ScrollJam
description:
ScrollJam gives your music a tactile way to move. Browse albums, songs, and playlists through a flowing artwork carousel, turn the scroll wheel, and settle into what is playing.

YOUR LIBRARY, UP FRONT
Explore your music with large cover artwork and clear titles. Connect your music library to browse and play your albums, songs, and playlists.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Keep a single player when closed. Open in landscape to browse and control playback on the right while lyrics fill the left. In open portrait, enjoy a spacious full-screen player.

LYRICS AS YOU LISTEN
Open lyrics inside the player screen on iPhone. Supported songs include synchronized highlighting and tap-to-seek. Lyrics are provided by LRCLIB or embedded in your local files; availability varies by recording.

BRING YOUR OWN MUSIC
Import audio folders from Files as albums or playlists. ScrollJam copies supported audio into its library, reads embedded artwork and metadata, and supports local lyric files.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from a small collection of body colors and scroll-wheel finishes, with Cobalt as the default. Enjoy firm scrolling haptics, shuffle, scrubbing, and background playback.

Apple Music catalog playback may require an active subscription and Sync Library. Local audio playback does not require an Apple Music subscription. ScrollJam is an independent music player.

name: Sealkeep: Private Vault
description:
Sealkeep is a private vault for the things that shouldn't sit in your camera roll: photos, videos, documents and notes, encrypted on your iPhone with a key only your passcode can unlock.

No account. No servers. No tracking.

REAL ENCRYPTION, NOT A PIN SCREEN
• AES-256-GCM for every photo, video, file, thumbnail and note
• A key derived from your passcode with 1,000,000 rounds of PBKDF2
• Unlock with Face ID, or with a 6-digit or custom passcode
• A recovery key you keep, so a forgotten passcode isn't the end

HIDDEN VAULTS
• Give a second passcode its own decoy vault with its own photos, files and notes
• Nothing in the app reveals how many vaults exist
• Optional duress passcode that silently erases every other vault

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Photos and videos in albums, with favorites and a full-screen viewer
• Import from your library, then delete the originals in one step
• A private camera that saves straight into the vault, never to your camera roll
• Documents of any type, in folders, with built-in preview and a document scanner
• Encrypted notes for codes, account numbers and private thoughts
• Add items from any app through the share sheet
• Search across file names and notes

PROTECTION THAT STAYS OUT OF THE WAY
• Locks when you leave the app, or when you place your iPhone face down
• The app switcher and screen recordings never show your vault
• Break-in alerts after three wrong passcodes, with an optional silent photo of the intruder
• Discreet alternate app icons

ENCRYPTED ICLOUD BACKUP
Turn on backup and your vault is copied to your own private iCloud, already encrypted. Restore on a new iPhone with your passcode or recovery key. We can't read it, and we never see it.

FREE AND PRO
Sealkeep is free for up to 50 items. Sealkeep Pro unlocks unlimited items, hidden vaults, the duress passcode, iCloud backup, intruder photos and alternate icons. Choose a yearly plan with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. No account is needed: your purchase is tied to your Apple Account.

The yearly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Sealkeep terms and disclaimer: https://sealkeep.vercel.app/terms/

name: Seat Logic: Party Puzzle
seller_name: MAS SOFT YAZILIM TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Seat Logic is a cozy logic puzzle about the trickiest job at any party: deciding who sits where. Every guest has wishes. One wants a window seat, one wants to sit next to the dog, and someone must stay away from the baby. Find the one seating plan that makes everyone happy!

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a guest onto a seat, or tap a guest and then a seat.
• Each wish turns green when it is met and red when it is broken.
• Make every wish green to win.
• Long-press any guest to read their wishes and see which seats they mean.

12 KINDS OF WISHES
Window seat, aisle seat, front row, back row, next to someone, not next to someone, next to the dog, away from the baby, same row or table, across the table, not behind a tall guest and sits alone. New wishes appear as you play, each with a short, clear explanation.

SIX VENUES, 400 LEVELS
Cinema, School Bus, Wedding, Airplane, Office and Dinner Party. Puzzles grow from 4 to 16 guests, from easy to expert.

FAIR AND RELAXING
• Every level has exactly one solution, checked by a solver
• Solvable with pure logic, no guessing needed
• No timers, no move limits and no penalty for a wrong seat
• Solve a level without hints to earn its star
• Stuck? A hint seats one guest in the right place
• 40 charming characters (yes, the dog is a guest too)

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Play the Daily Puzzle, keep your streak going and share your result without spoilers. Come back every day for a daily reward with free coins and hints.

Seat Logic is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases. You can remove pop-up and banner ads with a one-time purchase.

Questions or ideas? Write to muranocrew@gmail.com

name: Seat of Power
description:
You have just been elected. Nobody knows your name, your party tells you how to vote, and the next election is already coming.

Three countries, each with its real rules. In the United Kingdom, small parties decide close votes and the Lords can send a bill back. In the United States you climb from the House to the Senate, where it takes 60 votes, and then run for President state by state. In Germany nobody governs without a coalition, and a party list may carry you back in if you have been loyal.

Every term you vote on bills, speak, lobby party leaders, trade favours and promises, write laws of your own, and answer for all of it at home. Go back to your seat in recess. Run a committee hearing. Face three voters in a TV debate and stand on your record, if you have one.

Rise to committee chair, minister, party leader and head of government. Or leave your party, sit alone, and found one of your own. Lose your seat and fight to win it back from outside.

The parties and the people are invented. The rules are not.

- Three countries: United Kingdom, United States, Germany
- 30 bills and 34 events
- Three careers saved side by side
- Every result tells you why it happened
- Free to play. A short advert between terms and a small banner on the menu. Watch an optional advert for one more move or a look behind the polls.
- One purchase removes every advert and gives you those extras for free.

name: SecretPerf
description:
SecretPerf is een lokale ontwerpstudio voor de iPhone, volledig in het teken van postzegels. Het creatieve proces is onderverdeeld in drie specifieke werkruimtes: de "Smeltwerkplaats" (creatie), de "Vitrine" (expositie) en het "Archief" (naslag en waardebepaling). Alle gegevens worden lokaal op je apparaat opgeslagen; registratie of inloggen is niet nodig en de app maakt geen gebruik van cloud-synchronisatie.

In de "Smeltwerkplaats" ontwerp je een postzegel in vijf stappen: kies de vorm en het papiertype, bepaal het thema, bewerk de lagen (patronen, kleuren, positionering, schaal en rotatie), pas de perforatie aan en geef de postzegel tot slot een titel en zeldzaamheidsgraad voordat je deze "uitgeeft". Via gespecialiseerde onderdelen kun je de fysieke textuur verfijnen, perforatiesjablonen opslaan en kleurenpaletten beheren. Jouw makershandtekening wordt automatisch op elke uitgegeven postzegel geplaatst, terwijl onvoltooide ontwerpen als lokale concepten bewaard blijven.

In de "Vitrine" worden jouw uitgegeven postzegels tentoongesteld op een galerijmuur. Je kunt ze filteren op thema, details over de uitgifte en de versiegeschiedenis bekijken, ze exporteren naar je fotobibliotheek, certificaten inzien, gesimuleerde waardebepalingen uitvoeren of zelfs een uitgegeven postzegel weer intrekken. Daarnaast kun je postzegels onderverdelen in series, productiedoelen instellen om je voortgang bij te houden en je eigen privésalon inrichten – waarbij je de naam van de galerij, de muurkleuren, de verlichting en de presentatie-elementen naar wens aanpast.

Het "Archief" fungeert als een centrale plek waar je dagelijkse ontwerpopdrachten ontvangt, een bibliotheek met wereldwijde postzegelstijlen en -patronen verkent, opgeslagen kleurenpaletten hergebruikt, gesimuleerde veilingwaarderingen uitvoert en je "boodschapper"-tijdlijn en uitgiftecertificaten bekijkt. Let op: de veilingfunctie is uitsluitend een speels scoresysteem; er vinden geen echte transacties of betalingen plaats.

Belangrijkste kenmerken: Een uitgebreide, verhalende ervaring in het ontwerpen van postzegels – van het kiezen van de papiervorm tot het toekennen van serienummers en het officieel uitgeven van de postzegel. De workflow "Ontwerpen – Exponeren – Archiveren" vormt een naadloos en volledig op zichzelf staand proces. Kleurenpaletten en perforatiesjablonen kunnen in meerdere projecten worden hergebruikt. Dagelijkse ontwerpopdrachten bieden gestructureerde inspiratie voor nieuwe creaties. De volledige ervaring vindt lokaal op je apparaat plaats; dit is ideaal voor gebruikers die houden van de esthetiek van postzegels en de voorkeur geven aan een creatieve omgeving die offline werkt. Toelichting op de reikwijdte: SecretPerf is geen platform voor het afdrukken of versturen van echte postzegels, en evenmin een e-commercesite, sociaal netwerk, tool voor samenwerking in de cloud of een op AI gebaseerde tool voor het genereren van afbeeldingen. Ontwerpen worden gecreëerd door binnen de applicatie symbolen (glyphs) en lagen met elkaar te combineren.

name: Sentimental Path
description:
Sentimental Path turns the text conversations, messages and photos that mattered into a beautifully typeset digital keepsake book you can download and keep.

YOUR DATA. YOUR MEMORIES. YOUR CONTROL.
Everything happens on your iPhone. Importing, arranging, the family-safety check and the finished book are all made on your device. Your conversations stay on your device. We never upload or store them.

BRING IN WHAT YOU NEVER WANT TO LOSE
• WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and Instagram exports
• iMessage exports from Mac or PC tools, Android SMS backups, CSV spreadsheets, or pasted text
• Photos from the conversation or your library, placed where the memory belongs

MAKE IT YOURS
• Eight cover designs: ready-made, customize a template, or use your own photo
• Four interior styles: Clean Transcript, Traditional Memory Book, Story Flow and Photo Journal
• Eight interior moods with three decoration levels, from clean to keepsake
• Chapters by month, year or conversation; a photo storyline editor; dedication, introduction and closing words
• A real, watermarked preview of your pages before you buy

SIMPLE, HONEST PRICING
Each finished volume is $19.99. A volume holds up to 10,000 messages, 250 photos, 500 MB and 500 pages; larger stories become more volumes, and you always see the count and total before you purchase. No subscription. No account. Digital download only (PDF, 6 × 9 in).

BELLA, YOUR GUIDE
A friendly bluebird can walk you through every step with captions and an optional voice, or stay out of the way.

Family-safe by design: a content check runs on your device before a book is made. Affection, family and medical conversations are never flagged.

name: Shaktiv AI - Your AI Tutor
description:
Shaktiv AI is a free, friendly AI tutor for Indian school students from KG to Class 12, built by a non-profit initiative.

Ask any question from your syllabus and get a clear, step-by-step answer pitched at your class level.

Features:
• Answers for every subject: Maths, Science, Social Science, English, Hindi and more
• Answers in your language: ask in English, Hindi or Hinglish and Shaktiv remembers your choice
• Remembers the conversation, so you can ask follow-up questions
• Interactive simulations: tap "Try the simulation" to explore a concept hands-on
• Select answers and export them to PDF or Word to make your own notes
• Thumbs up / down on each answer to help us improve
• No sign-up, no ads, free to use

Shaktiv AI is designed for learning: it explains concepts simply, shows the working, and encourages students to think for themselves.

name: ShelfNest
description: Glad you opened ShelfNest. We keep polishing small details so finding things at home feels less stressful, and if something blocks you please tell us. ShelfNest is a quiet home inventory helper for listing what you own, where it lives, and who borrowed it for a while. Home gives a simple overview, Items lets you add a name, category, quantity, value, and a short note, and Spaces maps drawers, closets, bins, and rooms so each object has a clear place. Loans tracks who took something and when it should come back, which helps when tools or kitchen pieces leave the house. Edit counts when stock changes, update a space after a tidy day, and mark a loan returned when the item is home again. Data stays on this phone with no account required before you start. Screens stay light so you can log one box after cleaning, check a shelf later, and move on. There are no ads or in-app purchases, and the loop of store, locate, and lend stays small enough for ordinary days.

name: Shelfside
description:
Shelfside is a reading journal that feels like a room you want to sit in.

Your finished books line up on a real wooden shelf, spine by spine. Your current read waits on the desk. Press start, let the rain fall, and read. Shelfside keeps the time, the pages and the streak for you.

YOUR SHELF
• Every finished book becomes a spine on your bookcase, colored from its cover
• Switch between what you've read, what's next and everything
• Scan barcodes to add a whole stack at once, or search by title, author or ISBN
• Move your entire Goodreads library in, ratings and reviews included

A ROOM MADE FOR READING
• One tap starts a reading session with a calm timer
• Ambient rain to read by, or perfect silence
• A Live Activity keeps your session on the Lock Screen
• See your pace and how long is left in the book

YOUR READING JOURNAL
• A calendar that fills with the colors of the books you read
• Streaks, yearly goal and whether you are ahead of schedule
• A vintage library card that stamps every book you return
• Your year in books, told as a beautiful story you can share

QUOTES WORTH KEEPING
• Point your camera at a page and save a line in seconds
• Turn quotes into elegant cards to share

WIDGETS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for your goal and current book

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your library lives on your iPhone and is yours to export any time.

SHELFSIDE PRO
Make the room yours: shelf woods from white oak to dark academia, companions like a cat or a candle, and more sounds to read by, including a crackling fireplace and deep focus. Choose a yearly plan with a free one-week trial, or unlock Pro once, for life.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
