Privacy Policy: https://aquatic-alto-bc9.notion.site/Shelfside-Privacy-Policy-4125ee35e47980d198f7f12429af6e74

name: Shiba Days
description:
Shiba Days is a virtual pet app where you live with a Shiba Inu modeled on a real dog named Kibi.

Welcome a puppy, then pet it, feed it and take it for walks every day. Life with a true-to-life Shiba starts right on your iPhone.

■ For everyone who wants a Shiba but can't have one
・You live in an apartment or rental where dogs aren't allowed
・You worry whether you could care for a dog for its whole life, at your age
・In your country, it's hard to welcome a Shiba Inu into your family
If you love Shibas but can't live with one, this app is made for you.

■ Every Shiba quirk you love
・Hates being picked up, and plants its feet at the end of a walk (the famous "Shiba refusal")
・The happy "Shiba smile," and the big shake after a bath
・Usually lounging around or rolling belly-up. Touch it and it gets up to greet you
・Leave it alone and it sulks, but it never dies. A little care and it forgives you right away

■ Daily care
・Before meals: sit, paw, wait… OK! Some days it's just not in the mood for "paw"
・Treats change with the seasons: strawberries, watermelon, sweet potato, pumpkin
・Brush it with your finger. In shedding season the fur piles up, and you can make another dog out of it
・Baths, nail trims and tooth brushing, complete with very Shiba-like complaints

■ Real walks
・Go outside and your distance and steps become your Shiba's walk
・Set a goal by distance or by time (like 30 minutes)
・Check your progress on the Lock Screen (iOS 18 or later)
・Your distance, time and steps are saved every day in the Walk Log. See totals for this week, this month and all time, a 7-day chart and your walking streak
・Your Shiba writes a diary about each day
・While you walk, your Shiba asks for things like "I want to sniff that pole!" Tap to let it sniff or enjoy the breeze
・Your location never leaves your iPhone and is deleted when the walk ends

■ Travel around Japan
・Autumn leaves in Kyoto, cherry blossoms in Tokyo, Mt. Fuji from Enoshima, the Okinawa sea, Kusatsu hot springs, the thousand torii gates, summer fireworks and a New Year's shrine visit
・Take souvenir photos and selfies with your Shiba, with the background swapped to the scenery
・Pose at a Japanese face-in-hole board, side by side with your Shiba, and share it right away
・Collect local souvenirs

■ Wake-up alarm and Apple Watch
・Set the alarm and wake up to the sound of a puppy running around the room
・See your Shiba and your walk distance and time on Apple Watch

■ Gentle by design
・Free for 7 days with every feature. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks it forever (no subscription)
・No ads. No sign-up (no email, no password)
・No data collected. Everything stays on your iPhone
・Works offline
・Silent except for notifications and the alarm, so you can play anywhere
・Supports larger text sizes

The Shiba artwork and videos were made with generative AI. Created with Grok

name: Shiban: Fasting & Pixel Pets
description:
Shiban brings an eating-window timer and pixel companions together, adding a little company to your daily routine.

Your time, your pace
• Choose 12:12, 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, or a custom 12–18-hour fasting period.
• Switch between elapsed and remaining time without changing your start time.
• Adjust the actual start, finish early, or take a rest day. Schedule edits apply to your next session.
• Timers recover from saved timestamps when you reopen the app.

Grow together
• Earn virtual seeds by taking part and checking in.
• Exchange seeds for companion treats, accessories, and new pets.
• Feed your companion to gain growth experience and wear several accessories together.
• Each pet keeps its own outfit. Resting and finishing early earn the same participation rewards; longer fasts do not earn more.

On your wrist and Home Screen
• Start, finish, rest, and switch timer modes on Apple Watch. Changes sync with your iPhone when connected.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your current timer.
• English and Simplified Chinese, local reminders, session history, and JSON export.

No account, calorie tracking, weight logging, ads, or real-money purchases. Records stay on your devices and paired watch.

Shiban is a time-management and virtual-companion tool, not medical advice. Fasting is not suitable for everyone. Seek professional guidance if you are under 18, pregnant, breastfeeding, have an eating-disorder history, or take glucose-lowering medication.

name: Shine School Teacher
description:
Shine School Teacher is the phone app for teachers at schools that use Shine School.

Use the app to:
• See today's lessons, with the lesson on now and the next one at the top.
• Take each lesson's register in a few taps: everyone starts as present, and children whose parent phoned the school are already excused.
• Add the homework for the lesson.
• Ask a colleague to take one of your lessons, and accept or decline their requests.
• See your week's timetable.
• As a class teacher, see who missed a lesson today and call the family.
• Write notes about a child, read families' notes to you and reply.
• Get a notice when a note or a reply comes, a lesson is handed to you, or the school is off.
• Use the app in English or Kurdish, in light or dark colours.

Shine School Teacher is not a public registration service. Your school creates your account and gives you your sign-in details; the timetable, classes and children you see come from the school.

For support, contact schoolsbus97@gmail.com.

name: Shiru
description:
Edit the words in any PDF, in their own font. Convert photos, video, audio and documents.
All on your iPhone, iPhone Duo or iPad. Nothing uploaded. Pay once, no subscription.

EDIT PDFS
• Retype any line to fix a typo, name or date
• Keep the original font, size and colour, or the closest match
• Add text anywhere on the page

USE IT ON IPHONE DUO
• Fold it like a book: tools on one side, the page on the other
• Stand it up like a laptop: the page above, tools below
• Open it flat to see every page beside the one you edit

SIGN AND MARK UP
• Sign with your finger
• Fill in forms
• Highlight and draw

ORGANISE PDFS
• Merge, split and reorder pages
• Add page numbers or a watermark
• Crop, protect, unlock and repair
• Compress and see how much you saved

CONVERT PHOTOS
• Turn HEIC into JPG, PNG or WebP
• Turn photos into a PDF
• Scan paper with your camera

CONVERT VIDEO AND AUDIO
• Convert MP4, MOV, GIF, MP3, M4A, WAV and FLAC
• Shrink videos to share them
• Keep using other apps while it works

CONVERT DOCUMENTS
• Convert PDF, Word, Markdown, HTML and text
• Convert CSV, Excel and JSON

READ PDFS AS EBOOKS
• Turn PDFs into EPUBs that reflow
• Open them in Apple Books

STAY PRIVATE
• Work offline, even in Airplane Mode
• Skip the uploads, accounts, ads and tracking

PAY ONCE
• Try it free: 3 conversions a day (up to 5 files, 2-minute videos), signing, adding text and 3 tries of any Pro feature
• Unlock Shiru Pro once: unlimited conversions, big batches, long videos, PDF text editing and every option. Family Sharing included
• Keep everything you make free of watermarks

Made by one person. Leave a tip if you want to say thanks.

name: Shotfolio – Screenshot Memory
description:
Keep screenshots, links and notes from getting lost in your gallery. Shotfolio collects them in one place, makes them searchable by the text inside, and reminds you at the right time.

• Add with one tap from the Share menu or Photos
• Smart suggestions: a collection, reminder, price and store, suggested on your device
• Organize into collections: shopping, travel, recipes, tickets, bills…
• Set reminders for return windows, events or "look later"; follow along with Live Activities and widgets
• Search by text inside images (read on-device)
• Lock with Face ID; hide sensitive notification titles
• Back up and restore
• Spotlight, Shortcuts and widget support

Free for up to 30 saves. Shotfolio Pro unlocks unlimited saves with a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Privacy: no account, no server, no ads. Everything stays on your device.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Shvili
description:
The best places are often the ones someone recommends to you.

Shvili brings travel recommendations, personal maps, and the people behind them together. Discover places worth visiting, save the recommendations that inspire you, and turn your saved places into trips you can actually plan.

DISCOVER THROUGH PEOPLE

Explore places recommended by travelers, with photos and tips that give you more than a pin on a map. Browse by destination or category, and find inspiration in the maps people share.

SAVE THE PLACE AND THE STORY

Save recommendations to your own maps while keeping the original recommender and their tip connected to the place.

MAKE A MAP FOR EVERY ADVENTURE

Create personal collections for weekend escapes, dream destinations, food spots, or favorites near home. See your saved places on a map or in a list.

TURN SAVED PLACES INTO A PLAN

Organize stops by day with a private trip checklist. Check off the places you've visited and keep the rest ready for what comes next.

SHARE WHAT YOU LOVE

Post your own recommendations with photos and tips. Share public maps, follow other travelers, and help someone discover their next favorite place.

From Barcelona cafés to Thailand sunsets, good places are better shared.

name: Side Hustle: Job Gacha RPG
description:
■ Who will you be in this life? 
Draw a job card, live that one life, trade goods with other players, then reincarnate and be reborn into a brand-new job.
Every rebirth starts a whole new game.

■ Job Card Gacha
• Pick 1 of 3 cards to decide your job for this life
• Common · Rare · Legendary grades, with Strength · Dexterity · Wisdom · Luck · Charm stats
• Get lucky and roll traits like 'Critical Strike' or 'Hammer Master'

■ Every Job Plays Differently
■ Hero: Smash monsters and face a boss every 10 kills
■ Miner: Dig through rock - the deeper you go, the more mithril and gems
■ Blacksmith: Three hammer strikes on the beat, hit Perfect for a masterpiece weapon
■ Alchemist: Stir and keep the heat just right to brew potions (too hot and BOOM!)
■ Merchant: Prices differ in every town - buy low, sell high
■ Lord: Set the tax rate and build up your town

■ One Market Shared by Everyone
• Blacksmiths forge weapons from materials heroes bring in, and heroes buy those weapons back
• When your listing sells, the gold arrives by mail
• Weapons you craft bear your name. You might meet your past life's masterpiece again in the next!

■ The Lord's Crown
• Press 'Crown Queue' to become a candidate for the next lord
• The tax rate the lord sets becomes everyone's trading fee
• When the term ends, the lord steps down from the throne and is reborn

■ Rebirth and the Soul Tree
• Hit your growth limit, reincarnate and collect Soul Stones
• Grow the Soul Tree with Soul Stones to power up every job
• The more you play, the more new branches keep sprouting
• Your past-life job grants a special bonus in your next life

■ Storage and Idle Progress
• Items kept in storage stay with you through rebirth
• Mercenaries, mine carts, apprentices and stills keep working while you're away

■ A Town Together
• Chat with other players in the chat window and on the free board

What job will you live today? Draw your first card now!

* The game offers in-app purchases with real money, such as odds-boost packs. Odds for each job card grade are shown in the in-game shop.

name: Sigmatorium
description:
Sigmatorium is a home for your comic collection. Track every issue you own, see exactly which ones you’re missing, and connect with collectors who love the same series.

EVERY ISSUE, ACCOUNTED FOR
• Browse a large comic catalogue with search, detailed filters and sorting
• Add comics to your collection one at a time, or many at once
• Record condition, rating, purchase price, date acquired and private notes for each comic
• Filter your shelf by what’s missing from your series and fill the gaps
• See your collection stats at a glance

WISHLIST
• Keep a wishlist of the comics you’re hunting for
• Move a comic from your wishlist to your collection the moment you get it

FOLLOW WHAT YOU LOVE
• Follow series, publishers and creators
• Get notified when a new comic you’d care about joins the catalogue

READS, REVIEWS AND LISTS
• Mark the comics you’ve read and show what you’re reading now
• Rate and review comics, and join the conversation in the comments
• Create lists of your favourites, ordered your way, and browse lists by other collectors
• See who owns a comic and who is still looking for it

COLLECTORS
• Follow other collectors and see their activity in your feed
• Like and comment on collections, lists and shelf photos
• Share photos of your shelves and pick your favourite comics for your profile
• Climb the monthly leaderboard and unlock achievements, like completing a series
• Block anyone you don’t want to hear from, and report content that breaks the rules

NOTIFICATIONS
• Stay up to date on new followers, likes, comments, replies and mentions
• Find out when a comic you suggested is added to the catalogue
• Tap a notification to jump straight to the right place

HELP THE CATALOGUE GROW
• Can’t find a comic? Suggest it, and follow the status of your suggestions

MADE FOR YOU
• Light, dark or system theme
• Available in English, Serbian (Latin and Cyrillic), Montenegrin, German, Italian, Spanish, French and Russian
• Your settings are saved to your account

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED TO LOOK AROUND
Browse the catalogue, popular comics and collectors’ profiles as a guest. Create a free account whenever you’re ready to start your collection.

PRIVACY
Sigmatorium has no ads and no third-party tracking. You can delete your account and all its data at any time from Settings.

Privacy policy: https://sigmatorium.com/privacy

name: Signet Optics
description:
Signet is the companion app for Signet eyewear.

TONIGHT
With your permission, Signet reads this evening's events on your iPhone and checks each venue against the map: how many official and community-reported cameras sit within about two blocks. Nothing leaves your phone.

MAP
A 3D map of Chicago with three looks: Day, Dusk and Night.
- Official: the City of Chicago's published speed and red light cameras.
- Community: cameras mapped by OpenStreetMap volunteers, clearly marked as community-reported and possibly out of date.
Every layer shows where its data came from and when.

PAIRS
Your Signet frames, with finish, serial number and certificate. A demo pair is included so you can see a certificate before your frames arrive. The Collection shows Ready-to-Wear, Made-to-Measure, Bespoke and programs for protection firms. Requests go to a Signet concierge. Nothing is charged in the app.

PRIVACY
Signet never collects your face. No face scans, no photos of you, no account. Location is used only while the app is open, and only if you allow it.

name: Signeto
description:
Signeto lets you approve or deny what your AI agents do, from your iPhone.

When an AI coding agent wants to do something sensitive, such as merging a pull request into the main branch on GitHub, your Signeto gateway sends the exact action to this app. You read it on a card and decide.

HOW IT WORKS
• Your agent asks your Signeto gateway to perform an action.
• The app shows you that action: the repository, the pull request number, the target branch, the merge method and the exact commit.
• You approve or deny it with Face ID.
• Your approval is a signature made with a key held in your iPhone's Secure Enclave. The gateway checks the signature, and only then runs the action, using a credential scoped to that one action.

WHAT YOU GET
• A card for every request that shows exactly what will happen.
• Approve or deny with Face ID.
• A History tab with your past decisions.
• Every decision is recorded in a tamper-evident ledger.

ONLY YOUR PHONE CAN SAY YES
• Approvals are signed by a key in your iPhone's Secure Enclave.
• The Signeto server (the relay) cannot approve anything. Only your phone's key can.
• The app holds no GitHub credential.
• Notifications carry no action content. The app fetches the details when you open it.

GETTING STARTED
Signeto works with a Signeto account and a Signeto gateway.
1. Sign in with a passkey for your Signeto account at signeto.dev.
2. Run the signeto command-line tool and scan the QR code it shows to pair the app with your gateway.
Setup guide: https://signeto.dev/docs/quickstart/

The app is free. Signeto is in early access; join the waitlist at https://signeto.dev.

Questions: hello@signeto.dev
Security reports: security@signeto.dev

name: Simply the Recipe
description:
Ask for any dish and get the recipe: the ingredients, the steps and a few tips, with nothing to scroll past.

If someone has asked for it before, it's ready right away. If not, we'll write it for you in about half a minute and keep it on the shelf for the next person.

A new recipe is yours to tweak for a day. Ask for a change, or approve it as it is.

What you can do:
• Ask in your own words, like "chicken tikka masala" or "dairy-free chowder"
• Browse the shelf by category, or search for "soup" or "weeknight"
• Tick off ingredients as you cook
• Save recipes to your phone so they open without a connection
• Print a recipe, or send it to a friend
• Share a photo of how yours turned out, with no name attached

Nobody signs in and nothing tracks you. The recipes you save stay on your phone.

Recipes are written by AI and checked by nobody but you. Use your judgment, and cook meat to a safe temperature.

name: Sistrans 1A Pasajero
description:
Sistrans 1A Pasajero es la aplicación de Transporte y Turismo 1A para cotizar, pedir y seguir servicios de transporte de pasajeros en Colombia.

COTIZA TU VIAJE SIN CREAR CUENTA
Cualquier persona puede usar la app desde el primer momento, sin registrarse. Indica de dónde sales y a dónde vas —escribiendo la dirección o señalándola en el mapa—, elige el tipo de vehículo y verás el valor estimado del servicio. Si te conviene, envías la solicitud desde la misma app y el equipo comercial de 1A te contacta.

PIDE UN VEHÍCULO AHORA
Para los viajes que no dan espera, solicita un servicio inmediato: la app busca un conductor disponible y te muestra los datos del vehículo asignado apenas acepte.

SIGUE TU SERVICIO EN EL MAPA
Consulta en qué va tu solicitud, revisa el detalle de cada servicio y mira la ubicación del vehículo durante el recorrido. Sabes quién te va a recoger y en qué vehículo antes de que llegue.

ENTÉRATE SIN ESTAR PENDIENTE
Recibe una notificación cuando se asigne el conductor, cuando inicie el servicio y cuando termine.

CON TU CUENTA DE CLIENTE 1A
Si tu empresa trabaja con Transporte y Turismo 1A, inicia sesión y además podrás:
• Programar servicios con fecha y hora
• Consultar el historial de solicitudes y órdenes
• Aprobar órdenes con tu firma
• Calificar el servicio al terminar
• Registrar tu subida al vehículo con el código QR
• Seguir en vivo las rutas programadas

Sistrans 1A Pasajero es parte de la plataforma TMLand de TM Solutions.

name: Site Survey by DaevTech
description:
KEY FEATURES
• Survey projects: photos, video, notes, PDFs and systems for every job, with reports (PDF, Word, HTML) carrying your company logo
• Place Markups on plans: drop device symbols, count them by sheet, and build legends and device schedules automatically
• Pick tools by voice: say a tool's name and it is ready to place
• Measure with the camera and LiDAR: distance, path and area, with corner snap, photos and video
• Compare Sheets: overlay an old and a new plan to see exactly what changed
• Work from your own files: open PDFs from iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box and more, and save your markup back to the original

PLANS AND MARKUP
• Pen, highlighter, line, arrow, square, circle, cloud, text, callout, measure, stamp and photo tools, with undo and redo
• Device tool sets you can customize, copy, merge, import and export (.btx)
• Layers, bookmarks, sheet scale, show or hide by subject, and a sortable Markups List
• Find text and markups anywhere on the plan, with case-sensitive and whole-word options
• Select, copy and paste markups in place across sheets

SURVEY AND SHARING
• Share, back up and restore whole projects
• Favorite projects and plans, plus Home Screen widgets for recent and favorite projects and PDFs
• Add your company logo, colors and startup sound, or enter a Branding ID

MORE TOOLS
• Travel Calculator with mileage and labor totals
• Parts catalog with barcode scan, photos and vendor import
• Maps, calculator, compass, level, flashlight and schedule

BUILT FOR IPAD AND IPHONE
• Keyboard shortcuts, mouse zoom and pan, and external display support on iPad
• One-handed rail and haptic feedback on iPhone

FREE AND PRO
Free includes 3 projects and the survey and measuring tools, with simple markup. Unlimited Projects removes the project limit. Site Survey Pro adds Place Markups and the full plan tools. One-time purchases, no subscription, no account needed.

Your projects stay on your device unless you choose to share or back them up.

name: Skyglint: Satellite Tracker
description:
Skyglint tells you when the International Space Station and other bright satellites will cross your sky, and only lists the passes you can actually see with your own eyes.

TONIGHT AT A GLANCE
Open the app and the next visible pass is right there: how many minutes until it starts, where it appears, how high it climbs and how bright it looks, in plain words. "Very bright. North-west, then overhead."

ONLY PASSES YOU CAN SEE
A satellite is only visible when it is lit by the Sun while your sky is dark. Skyglint checks both for every pass, plus the height above your horizon, so you are not sent outside for nothing. Passes that start or end in the middle of the sky, when the satellite enters Earth's shadow, are marked "appears" and "fades out".

LOOK UP
Hold up your phone and a big arrow turns you toward the right spot, tells you how high to look and counts down the seconds. Tap "I saw it!" when you spot it.

ALERTS
Get a heads up a few minutes before a bright pass, with the direction in the notification.

SPACE STATIONS AND BRIGHT SATELLITES
The International Space Station, Tiangong and about 150 of the brightest satellites are free. See where the space station is right now on the live map.

YOUR SIGHTINGS
Every pass you mark as seen goes into your log. Earn badges for real milestones: your first space station, your first satellite train, a dawn pass, ten sightings.

SKYGLINT PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
Fresh satellite trains right after launch and the full Starlink constellation, any active satellite by name or catalog number, alerts for any satellite you follow, more saved places and a Live Activity countdown. Family Sharing supported. No subscription.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All predictions are computed on your iPhone. Your location never leaves your device. No account, no ads.

Predictions come from public orbit data and are refreshed several times a day; satellites can change orbit, so times may shift by a minute or so.

Orbital data: CelesTrak (celestrak.org). GP data originates from the U.S. Space Force via Space-Track.org.

name: Skywake: Wave Rider
description:
Skywake: Wave Rider — hold the rope and fly!

A boat tows you over the open sea on a parachute. Climb, swoop and dodge seagulls, dolphins and harbour posts, then rise into the trick zone for flips and spins. Land clean to bank your combo — but strain the rope too hard and it snaps!

HOW TO PLAY
• Stick: push up and down to climb or dive, left and right to swing
• Above the TRICK line, hold FLIP or SPIN — let go to land upright
• Chain tricks for a bigger multiplier; a perfect landing slows time
• Prefer swiping? Switch to drag controls in Settings

AROUND THE WORLD
Fly under the Bosphorus Bridge past Galata Tower, along the white cliff houses of Santorini at sunset, over the lagoons of the Maldives, beside the paragliders of Oludeniz and past the volcanoes of Hawaii. Dolphins leap beside you and whales surface on the horizon.

ON THE WATER TOO
Water ski, wakeboard and jet ski: carve across the wake, hit the ramps and flip in the air.

70 LEVELS AND BEYOND
Earn up to three stars on every level, then keep going in an endless career. Grab power-ups — magnet, shield, double coins, double tricks — and upgrade your rope, agility and magnet.

RIDERS, BOATS AND STYLE
Six riders with their own abilities, three tow boats including a jet ski and a speedboat, and dozens of suits, parachutes and paints in the shop.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily course — the same course for every player
• Daily missions and a 7-day reward calendar
• Weekly tournament and endless mode
• A new season track every month

GAME CENTER
Four leaderboards: all-time, weekly tournament, today's daily course and endless best.

Free to play. Short rounds, big views.

name: Sloresematu
description:
واحة: القفز لعبة مهارة وتوقيت تدور أحداثها في ليل الصحراء.

قُد كرة الضوء المتوهجة فوق منصات رملية تطفو وتتحرك بين الكثبان. اضغط مطولاً ليمتلئ مؤشر القوة ثم يفرغ من جديد، وارفع إصبعك في اللحظة المناسبة لتقفز. كل منصة تتحرك بإيقاعها الخاص، فراقبها جيداً واختر توقيتك بعناية.

• تحكم بلمسة واحدة: اضغط، انتظر، ثم اقفز
• الهبوط في منتصف المنصة يمنحك نقطتين
• وضع لا نهائي تزداد صعوبته مع كل قفزة
• ١٢ مستوى بأهداف ووقت محدد
• اهتزاز لطيف مع كل هبوط ناجح
• مسار تصويب قابل للإيقاف من الإعدادات
• واجهة عربية بالكامل
• بلا إعلانات، بلا تتبع، وتعمل دون إنترنت

name: SnapStop - Train & Bus Widget
description:
Minutes to your usual train or bus — right on your Home Screen.

You take the same train or bus almost every day.
Why open a transit app every time just to check the next one?

Register your usual line once, and SnapStop's widgets keep showing
your next departure and how many minutes are left — on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

▸ Paste a URL: paste the URL of a station or bus stop timetable page. AI reads the times, train types, destinations and schedules (weekday / Saturday / Sunday & holiday). Check the result, then save.
▸ Or add departures one by one, if you only take a few.
▸ Count only what you ride: filter by train type and destination.
▸ Weekday, Saturday and Sunday/holiday schedules switch automatically. Japanese public holidays are used when the device is set to Japan time.
▸ Small, medium and large widgets, plus three Lock Screen widgets.
▸ Your timetables stay on your device. No account. No location access.

Please note
▸ Times follow the published timetable. Delays and cancellations are not shown.
▸ Timetables published only as images or PDFs, or built by scripts after the page loads, can't be read. Add departures one by one instead.

Plans
▸ Free: 1 train or bus line, 3 URL imports (with ads)
▸ Premium (one-time purchase): unlimited lines and imports, no ads

Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sobreviva
description:
Sobreviva é um guia de sobrevivência em português, feito para as situações que acontecem de verdade no Brasil: enchente, apagão, deslizamento, tempestade, incêndio em casa, correnteza no mar, perdido na trilha. Tudo funciona sem internet, porque na hora que você mais precisa é quando a rede cai.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA

• Emergência agora: os telefones 193, 192, 199 e 190 com ligação em um toque, o que dizer ao atendente e a sua posição GPS para ditar ao resgate.
• O que aconteceu?: atalhos para faltou luz, enchente e perdido na trilha, com os primeiros passos em ordem.
• Guia completo com 10 capítulos: Primeiras horas, Água, Primeiros socorros, Orientação e sinalização, Fogo e calor, Abrigo, Comida, Situações do Brasil, Energia e comunicação, Dinheiro em crise.
• Listas com progresso: mochila de 72 horas e casa preparada para duas semanas. Marque o que já tem; fica salvo no aparelho.
• Ferramentas que usam só o celular: bússola, sinal SOS pela tela, minha posição (GPS, sem internet) e código Morse.
• Monitorar: alertas da Defesa Civil por SMS, avisos do INMET, mapa do Cemaden, tábua de marés da Marinha, queimadas do INPE. Fontes oficiais, nada de boato.

FEITO COM FONTE OFICIAL

Os capítulos de água e primeiros socorros seguem as orientações públicas do Ministério da Saúde (SAMU 192, cartilha de enchentes, soro caseiro, animais peçonhentos), do Corpo de Bombeiros e da Defesa Civil Nacional. Cada capítulo mostra as fontes no fim da página.

SEM CADASTRO, SEM RASTREIO

O app não pede conta, não coleta dados e não tem anúncio. A localização só aparece na sua tela, para você passar ao resgate, e não é guardada nem enviada.

AVISO

O Sobreviva é um guia educativo. Ele não substitui treinamento, atendimento médico nem as ordens da Defesa Civil e dos Bombeiros. Em emergência, ligue 193 ou 192.

Um app da Rádio Bitcoin, Marataízes, Espírito Santo.

name: Sociedad del Viento
description:
Sociedad del Viento: el viento de tus spots, para tu deporte.

Casi 900 spots de kitesurf, wingfoil, windfoil y windsurf en España, Portugal, Francia e Italia, cada uno con su color según el viento de los próximos 7 días.

• Tus favoritos de un vistazo: viento, dirección, rachas y la mejor franja de cada día.
• Aviso en el móvil la tarde anterior o esa misma mañana cuando hay viento en tus spots.
• Previsión hora a hora que integra varios modelos y se comprueba cada hora con estaciones reales.
• Estación en directo cerca de cada spot.
• Graba tus sesiones con Apple Watch o Garmin: distancia, velocidad, saltos y el viento que hacía.
• Comparte tus sesiones y tus spots con tu gente.

Sociedad del Viento es un proyecto independiente, hecho por riders para riders. Gratis, sin publicidad y sin vender tus datos. La comunidad decide hacia dónde crece: cuéntanos qué quieres ver y lo construimos juntos.

Las cifras de viento son una previsión: antes de salir al agua, mira siempre las condiciones reales del spot.

name: Softbell: Time Blindness Timer
description:
Softbell is a visual timer that rings, with routines built in. Watch time drain from a soft clay bell, hear it ring when a step ends, and move on without checking the clock. Made for ADHD brains and anyone who loses track of time.

SEE TIME LEAVE THE BELL
Each step fills the bell. As the minutes pass, it drains with a slow wave, so a glance tells you how much is left. An optional soft chime marks the halfway point and the last 2 minutes.

A REAL ALARM WHEN A STEP ENDS
Every step ends with a real alarm, so you notice the time without watching the screen, even with your iPhone locked. Stop it or add 2 minutes right from the alarm. You can turn ringing off for any routine.

BREATHING ROOM BETWEEN STEPS
When a step ends, you get 2 minutes of Breathing room to wrap up calmly. Then the next step starts on its own. Need longer? Add 2 minutes, or start the next step now.

SURVIVAL MODE FOR HARD DAYS
Mark up to 3 steps as Essential. On a rough morning, switch to Survival mode and run only those. A Survival run still counts.

ROUTINES THAT SHOW WHEN YOU'LL BE DONE
Build a routine in a minute or start from a ready one: Quick Morning Reset, Leave the House or Wind Down. Before you begin, Softbell shows when you'll be done if you start now.

YOUR WEEKS, WITHOUT STREAKS
A calm 12-week view of your Momentum Days. Plain days stay plain: nothing resets and nothing is ever marked missed.

LOOK AND SOUND
Soft bell sounds, light and dark appearance, warm palettes, and optional brown or pink noise while a routine runs.

name: Sparkfold
description:
Most puzzle games hurry you. A timer ticks. An ad covers the board. Your score shouts at you. Sparkfold does not do that.

You get a quiet sheet of paper with a few colored sparkles on it. Each color appears twice. Your only task is to fold the sheet so every pair lands on the same spot. The smaller side always folds onto the larger side. If two different colors would meet, that fold is blocked. You stop. You look. Then you fold again.

How to play
1. Tap a dashed line. That is where the paper can crease.
2. Tap the handle to flip the smaller side over.
3. Stack every pair of the same color. When no color sits in two places, you win.

You have a fold limit, unlimited undo, and no clock. A hint can mark a useful crease. If a path is stuck, undo and try another way. Reset starts the level clean.

Who it is for
Sparkfold is for people who want a calm logic puzzle. It fits a short pause on a train or a longer sit at night. It is for players who like origami more than speed. It is for anyone who is tired of loud games. Color-blind symbols can sit inside each sparkle so color is never the only clue. Reduce motion replaces the paper flip with a short fade.

There are 120 levels. Early sheets are small. Later sheets grow and carry more pairs. Each local day has one Daily Fold. A streak counts days you finish, not days you open the app.

When you want to look back, open Progress on the home screen. A ring chart marks how much of the 120 you have finished. Three quiet numbers show levels, stars, and your Daily Fold streak. A bar chart fills with stars in each world: Petal, Meadow, Dusk, Aurora, Starlight, and Lunar. Reset in Settings clears the charts too.

Progress stays on this iPhone. Puzzles are made on the device. There is no account, no ads, no tracking, and no in-app purchases.

Fold the paper. Match the sparkles.

name: SpeedAware GH
description:
SpeedAware GH tells you the speed limit on the road you are on, warns you calmly before you are fined, and thanks you when you are back within the limit. Built for Ghana's roads and the TraffiTech-GH enforcement programme.

- Lane-aware limits for Greater Accra, with school, market and settlement zones and your vehicle's own cap (taxi, trotro, bus, goods vehicle).
- A calm voice: one clear line, two reminders at most, silence the moment you brake.
- Camera and speed-check awareness from verified data and the driving community, including the stretch after a camera.
- Two-tap reporting of cameras and checks; your reports help every other driver.
- Your drive log stays on your phone and can be exported as evidence if a notice arrives.
- No account, no name, no tracking of who you are. Erase everything at any time.

Independent road-safety app created by Alfred Rich Bennett of DriveEV Ghana - Gye-Me. Not affiliated with the Ghana Police Service, MTTD, NRSA, DVLA or the TraffiTech-GH operator. Limits shown may be statutory defaults or community data; road signs and the law always take precedence. Keep your eyes on the road.

name: Spill: Skincare Scanner
description:
Spill reads the back of your skincare bottle so you don't have to. Scan a barcode or snap a photo of the ingredient list, and Spill tells you what's actually in it, in plain words.

A SCORE YOU CAN READ IN A SECOND
Every product gets a report-card grade from A to D and a score out of 100: Skin-safe, Pretty chill, Iffy or The ick. Under it you get the red flags, the green flags, and every ingredient explained. Tap any ingredient to see what it does and why it matters.

WORKS ON ANY BOTTLE
No barcode, or a brand no database knows? Photograph the ingredient list. Spill reads it on your iPhone. The photo never leaves your phone. Then you can share the list so the next person who scans that barcode gets the result instantly.

CATCH ROUTINE CLASHES
Add what you use in the morning and at night. Spill puts your products in the right order and tells you when they fight each other:
• Retinol and acids on the same night
• Benzoyl peroxide with retinol or vitamin C
• Two exfoliating acids in one routine
• Retinol or acids with no sunscreen in your morning
It also tells you when the internet is wrong. Niacinamide and vitamin C are fine together.

SCORED FOR YOUR SKIN
Tell Spill about your skin and every score changes to match:
• Sensitive: fragrance and irritants count double
• Breakout-prone: pore-clogging ingredients count extra
• Dry: drying alcohol and harsh cleansers count extra
• Pregnant or breastfeeding: retinoids and other ingredients to pause are flagged

NO FAKE CLEAN-BEAUTY PANIC
Spill flags what dermatologists actually worry about: fragrance and its listed allergens, essential oils, harsh sulfates, drying alcohol, pore-cloggers, formaldehyde-releasing preservatives and ingredients banned in the EU. It also busts myths: parabens, silicones and phenoxyethanol are fine.

WHAT ACTIVES DO
See which actives a product has, like retinoids, AHAs, BHAs, vitamin C, niacinamide, azelaic acid, peptides and sunscreen filters, what each one does, and when to use it.

FREE AND PRO
Scanning is free, forever: unlimited barcode scans, unlimited label scans, scores for your skin, and the clash check for up to 3 products. Spill Pro is one yearly plan where you pick the price that feels fair. Every price unlocks the same things: your whole shelf checked for clashes, your own ick list called out on every scan, and offline access to everything you've scanned.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your skin settings, shelf and history stay on your iPhone.

Product data comes from Open Beauty Facts, a free database anyone can add to. Ingredient notes are based on public sources such as the EU Cosmetics Regulation, the US FDA, the American Academy of Dermatology and IARC, listed in the app. Spill explains ingredients; it isn't medical advice. For skin conditions or pregnancy questions, ask a dermatologist or your doctor.

name: Srpski: Serbian Words
description:
Learn Serbian words the way you'll actually use them.

Srpski is a flashcard app with thousands of everyday Serbian words in Latin script, grouped by part of speech and topic: family, food, home, work, travel, the city and much more.

EVERY CARD SHOWS THE WORD IN USE
• Nouns: gender through a living form (ta kuća, taj sto, to dete), singular and plural, and the key cases as short phrases: nema kuće, vidim kuću, u kući, sa kućom. Plus counting: dve kuće, pet kuća.
• Verbs: the present tense table, aspect and its pair, past tense forms.
• Adjectives: masculine, feminine and neuter forms and the comparative.
• Example sentences with a translation for every word.

LISTEN AND SPEAK
• Every word is voiced in a natural Serbian voice.
• Record your own pronunciation, or ask a native speaker to record it, and the word will play in that voice.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Add your own picture to any word: copy an image in the browser and tap Paste on the card.
• Create your own sets of words to study.

A LITTLE EVERY DAY
• Spaced repetition brings each word back right before you would forget it.
• Pick a daily goal and see when you will reach the A1, A2, B1 and B2 vocabulary.
• Keep your streak going day after day.

Interface in English and Russian.

SRPSKI PREMIUM
Without a subscription, the first two topics of every part of speech and two sets of your own are free. Srpski Premium unlocks every topic and unlimited sets. Choose a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. New subscribers get a 3-day free trial; unless canceled at least 24 hours before it ends, the paid subscription begins. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

name: SSL
description:
SSL est l'application officielle du club Santé Soccer Longueuil. Elle réunit au même endroit tout ce dont les joueurs et le bureau ont besoin pour organiser les séances de soccer.

ACCÈS RÉSERVÉ AUX MEMBRES
Pour utiliser l'application, il faut le code du club, remis par le bureau. Sans ce code, aucune donnée n'est accessible.

SÉANCES
• Consulte les prochaines séances, avec le lieu et l'heure.
• Signale ta présence en un geste.
• La séance s'ouvre automatiquement 1 heure avant le début et se ferme 6 heures après.

MODE HIVER
• Forme plusieurs équipes et suis les victoires.
• Classement avec 3 points pour une victoire, 1 pour un match nul et 0 pour une défaite.

MODE ÉTÉ
• Deux équipes, un match, avec buts et passes décisives.
• Choix de la formation (4-3-3, 5-4-1, etc.) avec un terrain animé.
• Classement des buteurs et des passeurs.

MODE COMPÉTITION
• Matchs amicaux et tournois gérés par le bureau.
• Convocation des joueurs avec notification, et confirmation de leur présence.
• Composition d'équipe sur un terrain interactif, avec cartes de joueurs.
• Statistiques de match : buts et passes comptent double au classement.

TON PROFIL
• Photo, position, pied fort et note.
• Carte de joueur personnalisée.
• Statistiques personnelles et classements du club.

NOTIFICATIONS
Reçois une alerte quand une séance ouvre, quand tu es convoqué à un match ou quand le bureau publie une annonce. Tu les actives ou les désactives quand tu veux.

CONNEXION RAPIDE ET SÉCURISÉE
• Connexion par Face ID ou Touch ID.
• Compatible avec le gestionnaire de mots de passe de ton iPhone.
• Tu peux supprimer ton compte et tes données à tout moment, directement dans l'application.

VIE PRIVÉE
Tes données sont protégées conformément à la Loi 25 du Québec. La politique de confidentialité est disponible dans l'application.

Une application faite par et pour les joueurs du club Santé Soccer Longueuil.

name: StandSigmaLevel
description:
Quality questions become clearer when the numbers have a place to belong.
StandSigmaLevel brings Six Sigma calculations and saved quality work together.
DEFECTS & CAPABILITY
Calculate sigma level to examine process quality through the selected method.
Review defect rates using the counts and opportunities you provide.
Explore process capability against the specifications used in your assessment.
Keep defect frequency and capability as distinct ways to view performance.
SPREAD & PROCESS LIMITS
Use standard deviation to examine how observations vary around a mean.
Calculate variance for another measure of statistical dispersion.
Review confidence intervals with the inputs required by the chosen method.
Explore control chart limits when process variation needs context.
Distinguish calculated control limits from customer specification limits.
PROBABILITY & RELATIONSHIPS
Work with Z-scores to place a value within a normal-distribution scenario.
Examine normal probability using the parameters entered for the calculation.
Use Pearson correlation to explore linear relationships between values.
Apply linear regression for a separate view of a fitted relationship.
Remember that a correlation does not establish cause and effect.
PROJECTS & LOCAL RESULTS
Create quality projects to organize the calculations you want to revisit.
Save calculation results locally for later reference.
Open saved details to see the numbers behind an earlier result.
Share findings when you need to discuss a calculation with others.
Change inputs to compare a second scenario without changing the question.
Each answer depends on its entered data and statistical assumptions.
Use the toolkit for learning, process review and preliminary analysis.
StandSigmaLevel helps turn quality measurements into organized decisions.

name: Station Talk Hotel
description:
Station Talk Hotel lets hotel staff and guests talk in their own languages. The staff device speaks Thai; the guest device speaks the guest's language.

• Hold to talk: speak, release, and the guest gets the full translation within about a second.
• The guest never types. Everything is spoken and tapped.
• The guest device reads the translation aloud, with Play again and Play slower.
• The staff device reads Thai aloud, so staff can follow the guest without looking at the screen.
• Nearby pairing: connect a staff device and a guest device directly, encrypted, with no router. Re-pair a guest device to another staff device at any time.
• Emergency screen with ambulance 1669 and police 191.

You need two devices: a staff iPad or iPhone and a guest iPhone or iPad. No account or sign-in. Speech translation needs an internet connection.

Machine translation can be wrong. For urgent or medical matters, call emergency services or ask staff in person. Station Talk Hotel is not an emergency service.

Privacy: speech and text are sent to Voyiro's own servers only to translate them. Audio samples are off by default. No ads, no tracking.

name: Stave Attack
description:
Stave Attack teaches you to read music a few minutes at a time, then turns it into a game.

LEARN, A COUPLE OF NOTES AT A TIME
Fourteen short chapters take you from your first note to reading the whole treble and bass clef, with sharps and flats. Each chapter has a one-minute video, a hands-on lesson on a piano keyboard, then a game using only the notes you've met. Miss a note and the game pauses to show you how to count to it from a landmark note.

PLAY REAL TUNES
Ode to Joy, Jingle Bells, Eine kleine Nachtmusik, Für Elise, Pachelbel's Canon, In the Hall of the Mountain King and a secret tune to unlock. Race the clock: the notes wait for you, tap each name as fast as you can and beat your best time. Rhythm: the notes fall in time with a remix in house, pop, disco, lo-fi or trap style, and you play them on the beat.

ARCADE
A disco stage with sweeping lights, a mirror ball and a dance floor that pulses with the beat, and a room that changes colour every round. Pick your notes and your starting round (readers can jump straight to Round 10), or take the sound check: read five notes with no letter names and you skip to Round 5 as a reader. Not reading yet? A thirty-second trick (Every Good Boy Deserves Football, FACE in the space) is a tap away, and Learn mode takes it from there. Then see how far you get as the rounds speed up. Every note you read fills the Disco meter; fill it and Disco Fever hits: ten seconds of triple points, notes raining down, nothing gets through, and its own disco tune. Your streak sets a ×2, ×3, ×5 multiplier. Every fifth round sets a goal, every tenth round opens with a DJ bonus, and power-up notes drop in now and then: Fast forward skips you a round, and the harder you spin its jog wheel the bigger the bonus; Slow motion gives you four seconds to catch up; a Heart gives one back. Best scores for each clef and note set.

MADE FOR LEARNING
• Notes show their letter names until you know them, and again after a slip
• Every right answer drops the note onto its piano key, so stave and keyboard connect
• Bonus rounds, gold crowns and certificates for real skill, never for time spent
• A family table: up to six players on one device, each with their own progress
• Certificates with your name to save, print or show your teacher
• Suggests a break after 20 minutes

TREBLE AND BASS
Start on the treble clef, or choose the bass clef if you play cello, trombone, bass guitar or tuba. Both clefs together at the end.

FREE TO TRY
Six chapters, three tunes and the first 15 Arcade rounds are free. One £2.99 purchase unlocks every chapter, every tune, all the Arcade notes and every round beyond 15, for every player on the device and the whole family through Family Sharing. No adverts, no subscriptions, nothing else to buy.

PRIVACY
Stave Attack collects no data. Scores, names and progress stay on your device.

Made by Daniel Hodkinson, a secondary school head of music and working DJ, part of Mix-Ed.

name: SteadyTone
description:
SteadyTone is an app to help vocalists, wind and string players to hold long notes. When you play or sing a note a timer will start once the pitch settles. It then tracks how long you can hold the note for and how steady the pitch and volume are. You can even use it as a tuner!

Save your scores to track or share your progress.

name: Stealth Print: Steganography
description:
Steganography that survives printing. Hide a URL or short message inside a photo, then print it. Point your iPhone at the paper and the message appears. No visible code, no sticker, no extra space on the page.

Many hidden-message apps work only with image files. Stealth Print is built for ink on paper.

EMBED
• Choose a photo and type a URL or message
• Pick a print size: L print, postcard, A5 or A4
• Choose how subtle the pattern should be
• A read-back check runs after embedding
• Save, print at exact size, or share as PNG

READ
• Hold your iPhone 20-30 cm from the print. It reads automatically
• Works at an angle and when only part of the image is in view
• Turn on the flashlight in dark rooms or under warm bulbs
• Read from a photo in your library

PASSWORD PROTECTION (PRO)
Protect a message with a password you agree on separately. Unlocking is free, so anyone you give the password to can read it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your device. Photos, messages, passwords and camera video are never sent anywhere. No account needed.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Up to 64 bytes on an L print. A password uses 16 bytes
• The pattern may show as faint grain on smooth areas. Choose Subtle if you notice it
• Results depend on the printer, paper and light
• The app can tell that a message exists. A password protects only the text

Pro is a one-time purchase.

name: Steckies Pro - クラウド付箋メモ
description:
Macの定番「スティッキーズ（付箋）」の気軽さはそのままに、iPhone・iPadとのiCloud同期と整理機能をプラスした進化系付箋アプリ「Steckies Pro」が登場しました。

「Macのデスクトップに貼ったメモを、外出先のiPhoneでも見たい」
「iPhoneでサッとメモした内容を、帰宅後にMacの画面に付箋として出しておきたい」
そんな日常のちょっとした不便を、Steckies Proがシンプルに解決します。

■ 主な特長

【Mac × iPhone / iPad をiCloudでシームレス同期】
・面倒な会員登録やログインは一切不要。お使いのApple ID（iCloud）だけで自動的に同期されます。
・データはあなた自身のiCloud（プライベートデータベース）にのみ保存されるため、プライバシーも安心です。
・バッテリーに優しい省電力設計で、変更があった時だけスマートに同期します。

【Mac：本物の付箋のようにデスクトップへ自由に配置】
・ウィンドウの四隅・四辺から自由なサイズにリサイズ可能。
・ワンクリックでタイトルバーだけのコンパクト表示に「しまう／出す」ことができ、作業の邪魔になりません。
・「最前面にピン留め」機能で、他のアプリで作業しながら常にメモを参照できます。
・マネージャー画面から、すべての付箋の一覧確認・検索・表示／非表示の切り替えも簡単です。

【iPhone / iPad：外出先でも素早くメモ＆快適整理】
・付箋らしいカラフルなカード一覧で、探しているメモがひと目でわかります。
・起動してすぐに書き始められる軽快なレスポンス。
・ピン留め機能で重要なメモを常に上部へ固定できます。

【フォルダ分け＆6色のカラーテーマ】
・イエロー、ピンク、ブルー、グリーン、パープル、グレーの6色から気分や用途に合わせて色分け可能。
・カスタムアイコン付きのフォルダを作成して、仕事・プライベート・買い物リストなどをすっきり整理できます。
・ゴミ箱機能を搭載しているため、誤って消してしまった付箋も後から復元できます。

■ こんな方におすすめ
・Macの標準スティッキーズが好きだけれど、iPhoneと同期できなくて困っていた方
・高機能すぎるノートアプリよりも、パッと開いてすぐ書ける「付箋」の手軽さが好きな方
・ToDoリスト、買い物メモ、アイデアの断片、一時的なコピペ置き場をMacとiPhoneで共有したい方

毎日のメモをもっと軽快に、もっと便利に。
Steckies Proで、デスクの上とポケットの中をつなぎましょう。

name: STEP – Doodle Diary
description:
STEP – Doodle Diary turns your everyday photos into sweet crayon drawings and keeps them as a diary: one doodle a day.

• Pick today's photo and tap "Create Doodle" - AI draws it in under a minute
• Day cards in a deck: swipe through your days, tap to flip to the real photo
• Write a few words for each day
• A monthly calendar full of doodles
• A postcard rack for every month you can spin all the way round
• Share your doodles or save them to your photos
• Day streaks and an evening reminder so you don't forget
• Back up to a .zip file to move to a new phone

STEP+ (subscription)
• Every drawing style: soft crayon, watercolor, anime, risograph and Van Gogh
• Every background, and new ones as they come
• Automatic cloud backup
• Yearly calendar
• More doodles every day

STEP+ comes monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

name: STEPLOG: Stepper Step Counter
description:
STEPLOG counts and records your steps on a stepper or on stairs. Just keep your iPhone in your pocket.

Stepping in place on a mini stepper is hard for your iPhone's built-in step counter to pick up. STEPLOG reads the rhythm of your steps with the motion sensors, counts every step, and saves each finished workout to the Health app automatically. The steps it counts are added to your step count in Health, too.

JUST START STEPPING
Start a recording, put your iPhone in your pocket, and step. When you stop for a while, STEPLOG pauses on its own, and it picks up again as soon as you start stepping.

KEEPS COUNTING WHEN LOCKED
Recording continues with the screen off. Your steps and time show on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island on supported models.

STEPPER OR STAIRS
Record twist steppers and other home steppers, or a workout on real stairs. Choose the type on the Home screen, and your next recording starts with the same one.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
The Home screen shows this week's activity and your streak. Weekly step charts and minute-by-minute pace show how you're doing, and the calendar takes you back to any past workout.

Make stepping a daily habit with STEPLOG.

name: Stickwork
description:
Stickwork turns drum grooves into practice sheets you can see, hear and play along with.

Write a groove by tapping a grid, one row for each part of the kit. Stickwork engraves it as proper drum notation as you go, so what you tap is what you read. Change the tempo, add swing, switch between eighths, sixteenths and triplets, and mark accents, ghost notes, flams and sticking.

PLAY ALONG
Open any sheet in play along mode and the music scrolls with you, line by line, with the bar you are on lit up. Tap a bar to jump there. Turn the click and the count-in on or off, slow it down or speed it up, and go full screen so the music is all you see.

PRACTICE THE HARD PARTS
Long-press a bar to loop it, or long-press two bars to loop everything between them. The speed trainer starts you where you are comfortable and nudges the tempo up every few passes until you reach your goal.

A LIBRARY TO START FROM
Stickwork comes with sheets ready to play: rock basics, funk and sixteenths, shuffles and half-time, Latin and reggae grooves, and the essential rudiments with sticking. Add any of them to your sheets and change them however you like.

READ A PRINTED PAGE
Take a photo of a page from a drum book and Stickwork reads it into a sheet you can edit and play. It shows each line under the photo so you can check it and fix anything it missed.

SHARE
Send a sheet as a PDF to print, as MIDI for a drum machine or another app, or as a Stickwork file a friend can open.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your sheets stay on your device.

name: Still: Voice for Your Photos
description:
Your camera keeps what it looked like. Still keeps what it felt like.

Still lets you tell the story behind any photo in your library, in your own voice. Pick a photo, tap once and talk. Still keeps your voice with the photo, writes down your words as you speak and notices how it felt, so the moment is never just a picture again.

THE DAY YOU WERE BORN
A photo of a hospital room says very little. Your voice saying "36 hours of labor, and you grabbed my finger" says everything. Still is for the stories that only you can tell, kept for the people who will want to hear them someday.

ONE TAP TO TELL IT
Open any photo and tap the button. Your words appear as you speak. Stop when you are done, listen back, and save it or record again.

A LITTLE HELP TELLING IT
Every untold photo comes with a question to get you started and a short story tip, like starting in the moment or saying what people actually said. Telling a good story is a skill, and every memory is practice.

ONE QUESTION A DAY
Turn on the daily prompt and Still picks one older photo you have not told yet. Never more than one, and none on days you already told a story.

FIND IT AGAIN
Search everything you have said. Filter by feeling. See what happened on this day in past years.

SEND IT TO FAMILY
Turn a memory into a short video of the photo with your voice, ready for Messages.

ALWAYS YOURS
Export everything at any time: every voice note as a sound file with its words as text. Free, always.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign in. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your photos never leave Apple Photos. Your voice notes stay on your iPhone, or in your own private iCloud if you choose.

WORKS WHERE YOU ARE
Start a story from the Photos share sheet, the Lock Screen, Control Center, the Action button or Siri.

STILL+
Recording, listening, the words, editing and Export everything are free. Still+ adds iCloud sync and backup, your words on the videos you send, videos without the Still end card, Home Screen widgets and every past prompt. Try it free for a week.

Still+ is billed to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings.

Terms: https://getstill.io/terms.html
Privacy: https://getstill.io/privacy.html

name: Stillgaze: Focus Training
description:
Stillgaze is a daily focus practice. You look at a candle flame for a few minutes, then you close your eyes and watch the glow fade.

This practice is called trataka. It is simple: one point, one breath at a time, and the next time your mind drifts, you bring it back to the flame.

ONE TAP TO START
Open the app and the flame is there. Pick 1, 3, 5 or 10 minutes and tap Begin. Nothing else is on the screen while you gaze. No timer, no status bar, no notifications.

CLOSE YOUR EYES
When the time is up, a soft chime tells you to close your eyes. Rest while the after-image fades. A second, quieter chime tells you when to open them.

A STREAK THAT IS KIND
Each day you sit adds a flame to your week. Miss one day and your streak stays. Set a reminder for the same time tomorrow, and it skips the days you have already sat.

MADE TO BE SAFE AND PRIVATE
The flame moves slowly and never flashes. If flickering light affects you, turn on Still Flame. Stillgaze has no account and no ads, and it does not collect any data. It works offline.

STILLGAZE PLUS
Plus adds three scenes, water, fire and dusk, and sittings of 15 and 20 minutes.
- Yearly: $24.99 a year, with a free week to start

name: Stitch & Bead: Cross Stitch
description:
Turn a favorite photo into a cross-stitch pattern, or start with a blank canvas and draw your own. Stitch & Bead keeps the whole process on your device, with no account, ads or subscriptions. Fuse-bead tools share the same worktable.

DESIGN YOUR PATTERN
Choose exact dimensions, preserve the photo's proportions or crop to fit. Adjust color budget, brightness, contrast and isolated-color cleanup. Compare your photo and chart before saving. Draw continuous strokes, erase, fill, pick colors and undo a whole stroke at once. Pinch to zoom and use two fingers to move the chart while drawing.

PRO DESIGN TOOLS
Mirror, rotate and resize the canvas without stretching stitches. Copy and paste rectangular selections, place text and add backstitch segments. Transformations keep completion marks aligned. Cropping warns before removing filled cells or lines, and changes can be undone.

MATERIALS THAT MATCH YOUR CRAFT
Includes attributed community palettes: DMC, Perler, Hama Midi, Artkal S, Artkal Mini and MARD 221. Match photos only to the material colors you select. Pro adds quantity records: calculate missing beads against unfinished work, or record thread skeins without pretending stitch counts determine thread length.

KEEP MAKING
Focus one color, see what remains, find exact X/Y coordinates or jump to the next unfinished cell. Mark progress by dragging, selected region, row or bead board. Track backstitch segments separately. Save and resume locally.

PRINT AND BACK UP
Export A4 or US Letter PDF charts with symbols, material codes, full-stitch and backstitch counts, page labels and global coordinates. FREE DOWNLOAD AND OPTIONAL PRO

Pro is a one-time lifetime in-app purchase for unlimited saved projects up to 240x240, advanced design tools and material quantities, in both crafts. No subscription or recurring trial charges. Restore with the same Apple Account.

name: Stone & Glaze
description:
Your audio keeps playing and there are no ad breaks. Stone & Glaze is a drop-and-merge game with glazed pottery, made to sit under your podcast.

Aim a pebble, let it go, and watch it settle into the bowl. Two alike merge into the next size, up through 11 glazes, from a small honey pebble to a white moon mended with gold. Keep the pile below the rim. If a piece stays over it, the run ends.

YOUR AUDIO STAYS ON
Stone & Glaze never stops the sound of another app. Your podcast, audiobook or music carries on, and game sounds can be turned off.

NO AD BREAKS
There are no ads at all, and no ad code in the app. Nothing interrupts a run.

A FREE DAILY BOWL
One bowl a day, and every player gets the same pieces. Play it to keep your streak going, with one missed day a week forgiven. It's free every day and never uses one of your free runs.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Quit whenever you need to. Every piece is saved exactly where it was and carries on moving when you come back.

A SHELF OF GLAZES
Each new glaze you make goes on your shelf, next to your best score, your daily streak and your achievements.

GAME CENTER, ICLOUD AND YOUR HOME SCREEN
Compare your best score and today's bowl on Game Center leaderboards. Your shelf and best score follow you to another iPhone through iCloud. A Daily Bowl widget shows today's score and the next glaze to find, and you can start today's bowl from Shortcuts or a Control Center button. An optional daily reminder, one quiet note at a time you pick, stays off unless you turn it on.

MAKE IT YOURS
Glazed pebbles, a speckled stoneware bowl and a limewash wall are included. Optional one-time extras change only the look or the sound, never the game or the score: six stone styles (River Stones, Gemstones, Precious, Collector, Winter Frost and Autumn Amber), four bowls (porcelain, raku, marble and walnut), four scenes (a potter's studio, a beach at dusk, a rainy window and a night shelf) and three background sounds (rain, a crackling kiln and soft chimes), which stay off while another app is playing. Buy them one at a time, the four classic stone styles together, or everything at once in the Complete Collection.

ONE PRICE TO PLAY
Your first 3 full runs are free, and the daily bowl stays free. After that, one purchase lets you play for as long as you like. There's no subscription, no trial, no coins and no continues for sale, and a run in progress is never cut off. Purchases work with Family Sharing, and Restore purchases brings them all back.

NO ACCOUNT
No sign-up, no tracking and no internet needed to play. Game Center and iCloud are optional and run through Apple. We collect nothing.

name: Striessu
description:
5:00 per km is 12.0 km/h. Spin the wheels and Striessu says so instantly.

Same effort, every unit: min/km, min/mile, km/h, mph, m/s and treadmill speed.

Finish line at this pace: 5K, 10K, half and full, plus your own course.

6:00 per km brings you home in a marathon at 4:13:10.

Put in your last race, get a forecast. A 25:00 5K predicts about 52:07 for 10K.

The fatigue factor behind that forecast is yours to adjust in the Kit Room.

Even split or negative split? The Lap Board prints your halves and laps.

Lap every 400 m, 1 km, 1 mi or 5 km. You choose.

Training zones from one 5K time: easy, marathon, tempo, interval, repetition.

Lock a pace in the Pace Locker and pull it back onto the wheels later.

Log a race on Race Day and it lands in TROPHIES, on your podium of personal records.

Pin a goal, share your cabinet, clear it when the season ends.

Tenths on the clock if you want them: 4:29.7 instead of 4:30.

Kilometres or miles, set once.

No account. No GPS. No signal needed. Your races stay on your iPhone.

Four tabs: PACE · RACE DAY · LAP BOARD · TROPHIES.

Predictions are estimates. Your legs get the final say.

name: stringy - catalog editor
description:
Stringy is a fast, native editor for Xcode String Catalogs (.xcstrings). Open a catalog, see every key and every language at a glance, and translate without opening Xcode.

Made for developers, translators, and anyone who ships an app in more than one language. One app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

FIND AND EDIT
• Search keys, source text, translations, and comments from a single field
• Edit translations in place, with the source text right beside them
• Add translator comments that stay with the key
• Rename keys without losing their translations
• Add and remove target languages, or change the source language
• Undo and redo every change

TRACK EVERY LANGUAGE
• See translation progress for each target language
• Filter by Missing, Needs Review, Source Changed, Translated, or Not for Translation
• Jump to the next or previous string from the keyboard
• Mark strings that should not be translated

HANDLE THE HARD PARTS
• Plural variants: zero, one, two, few, many, and other
• Device and width variations
• Substitutions with their own variants

YOUR FILES STAY YOURS
• Stringy edits the original .xcstrings file, so it keeps working directly in Xcode: no import, no export, no conversion
• Catalogs stay where you save them, on your device or in iCloud Drive
• Your catalogs are processed on your device. Stringy does not upload your translations or collect analytics

Stringy edits String Catalogs in format version 1.0.

name: Subnet Trainer: Daily Drills
description:
172.16.45.200/21 – where does the subnet start, where is the broadcast? In the exam you have seconds. At work, someone is waiting on the phone.

'Subnet Trainer: Daily Drills' trains subnetting until you do it in your head. Not by explaining. By making you calculate, a few minutes a day.

FILL IN THE TABLE
Every problem is new: an IP address with its prefix. You work out the network address, first host, last host, broadcast and next subnet – on a keypad made for addresses, not the phone keyboard.

HINTS THAT FIND YOUR MISTAKE
Wrong? The hint names the actual slip: "that is already the first address of the next subnet", "network addresses always lie on multiples of the block size". Need more? "More help" shows the rule with the numbers of your problem, and the solution walks through every field step by step.

13 EXERCISES FOR THE EXAM AND THE JOB
• IPv4 subnetting: network, hosts and broadcast for any address
• Mask converter: prefix, mask, wildcard, block size, hosts
• Prefix for a number of hosts or subnets
• Prefix from two addresses
• Same subnet?
• The n-th subnet
• VLSM planner
• Route summarization
• Wildcards & ACLs
• IPv6 short and full form
• IPv6 subnetting: /48 into /56 and /64
• EUI-64 / SLAAC
• Binary & hex as a warm-up

Made for exam preparation such as Cisco CCNA and CompTIA Network+, and for everyday work in network administration.

KEEP YOUR STREAK
Every problem you solve in a row without help counts. Reach a milestone and share it with your team. A daily reminder, only on days you haven't practiced yet, keeps you going.

FREE TO START
IPv4 and IPv6 subnetting are free without limit. Every other exercise has 5 free problems, again 12 hours later. The free version shows ads. Pro removes the ads, unlocks every exercise without limits and works fully offline – a one-time purchase, no subscription.

No account. 15 display languages.

TRY IT FOR FREE NOW!

Cisco and CCNA are trademarks of Cisco Systems, Inc.; CompTIA and Network+ are trademarks of CompTIA, Inc. Neither company is affiliated with this app.

name: Subsi: Budget & Subscriptions
description:
Subscriptions, bills and card payments in one place. Subsi catches price hikes, shows the subscriptions you don't use, and works out how much you can spend each day until payday. It never connects to your bank and needs no account; everything stays on your phone.

SUBSCRIPTION TRACKER AND PRICE HIKES
• Flags a subscription that got more expensive: "price up +20% · +$6/yr".

READS SCREENSHOTS AND PDFS
• Add a screenshot of your subscriptions list, a bill, or a card statement PDF, and it finds the subscriptions and spending.
• Opens password-protected PDFs on your phone. Send things from the Share menu or paste text.
• Reading happens on your phone; images and files are never uploaded.

DAILY BUDGET UNTIL PAYDAY, AND "WHAT IF?"
• See how much you can safely spend each day until payday, and how your balance will change day by day.
• Ask before you spend: what if I pay only the minimum, buy something today, pay in installments, prepay my loan, or cancel what I don't use?

BILL REMINDERS
• Local notifications before subscription renewals, bills, card due dates, trial endings, loan payments and planned payments.
• Pick the time and quiet hours; get a weekly summary if you like.
• The next 30 days of payments on one calendar.

SPENDING · INCOME · ACCOUNTS
• Spending, income, bills, installments, loans and card statements, all added from one "+" button.
• Category budgets that warn you when you're on pace to overspend.
• Your savings: cash, bank, foreign currencies, gold, and money owed. Track how close you are to your goals.
• Monthly report and year in review.

WIDGETS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: upcoming payments, daily budget until payday, subscriptions, this month, and quick add (an expense or income in one tap).

CURRENCIES
• Choose your main currency. For subscriptions or savings in other currencies, you enter the exchange rate yourself; the app never fetches rates from the internet.

PRIVACY
• No bank connection, no account, no sign-in.
• The app never goes online and collects no data.

One-time purchase: no subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases. Share it with your family through Family Sharing. Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: Sudder: Meal Planner & Recipes
description:
What's for dinner tonight? Sorted. Sudder plans your week, writes the grocery list and cooks along with you. Smart with Apple Intelligence, and everything stays private on your device.

PLAN YOUR WEEK IN ONE SENTENCE
Just say what you want: "Curry at least once this week, something quick on Wednesday, no fish." Apple Intelligence understands your sentence right on your device, and Sudder turns it into a meal plan from your own recipes. No Apple Intelligence on your iPhone? Planning with a sentence still works.

SUDDER PLANS YOUR WEEK
Sudder picks the dishes and takes your preferences into account: how often you'd like fish or vegetarian, family favorites, days with time to cook, something quick on busy evenings, plenty of variety and dishes in season. Not quite right? Move a day, swap a dish or pick one yourself.

EVERY RECIPE IN ONE TAP
Save recipes from any website, Instagram, TikTok, Safari or Photos with the Share button, or snap a page of your cookbook. Apple Intelligence pulls out the ingredients and steps, even from a caption without headings. The photo and the source stay with the recipe. Search by ingredient when you have half a zucchini left.

THE GROCERY LIST WRITES ITSELF
Everything for the week on one list, by aisle in the order of the store, with quantities added up and sensibly rounded. What you always have at home stays off the list. One tap sends it to a shared list in Reminders.

COOKING MODE
Big steps, big type, and the screen stays on, even with flour on your hands. Tap a cooking time to start a timer that keeps running on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Scale servings for two or for eight, with quantities that make sense.

TOGETHER ON IPHONE AND IPAD
Share recipes, meal plan and groceries with your partner or family through iCloud, just like a shared note. No account needed. On iPad, Sudder becomes a planning board: drag dishes between days and plan four weeks ahead. Widgets show "Tonight" and "This Week" on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, and you can ask Siri what's for dinner or find a recipe in Spotlight.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sudder has no account and no server of its own. Your recipes and meal plans live on your devices and in your own iCloud. Apple Intelligence runs on your device, so what you type or import goes nowhere. No ads. Sudder only measures anonymously how the app is used, never what you cook.

SUDDER PLUS
Sudder is free with up to 15 recipes: plan your week yourself, cook with timers and use the grocery list. Sudder Plus plans every week for you with your preferences in mind, imports unlimited recipes (including with Apple Intelligence), lets you plan together through iCloud, sends your groceries to Reminders, and adds widgets, Siri and the four-week view on iPad. One subscription covers the whole family with Family Sharing. Try it free for 7 days. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; cancel anytime in Settings.

Set up your week in a minute. Sudder does the rest.

Available in English, Dutch, French, German, Spanish, Danish, Norwegian and Swedish. Made in Belgium.
