name: Sudoku Universal
description:
A little space to think.

Sudoku Universal brings native Sudoku to iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Begin with a mini 3×3 board using numbers 1–3, grow into 6×6, or settle into a classic 9×9. Guided mode explains each next step and helps you avoid repeated numbers. When you’re ready, choose Easy, Medium, or Hard.

LEARN ONE SQUARE AT A TIME
Guided lessons introduce rows, columns, and boxes through short, hands-on exercises. Pencil notes, undo, and optional hints help you keep exploring. Smart notes fills possible numbers from the current board in one undoable step. Remaining-number counters show what is left to place. Revealed numbers carry a lightbulb so you can always recognize a hint.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from five palettes, three number styles, and different board designs. Every theme adapts to light and dark mode. Sound effects and visual effects have separate switches; animated game effects respect Reduce Motion. Enlarge the board to 2× when you want bigger numbers and notes.

A LITTLE CHALLENGE EACH DAY
Try the daily puzzle, build a streak, and discover milestones in your collection.

KEEP A FEW PUZZLES ON THE GO
Your games keeps separate puzzles with their own notes, undo history, hints, and timers. Switch whenever you like; the previous game pauses automatically. Find your library in the iPad and Mac sidebar or the Your games picker on iPhone.

TRY A TIME CHALLENGE
Choose a countdown from 1 to 30 minutes and try to finish before it reaches zero. The clock pauses when you switch games or leave active play. If time runs out, keep your puzzle and continue without the timer. Filter Statistics to see challenge wins.

TAKE A BREATHER
Pause whenever you like. Your puzzle is hidden, the clock stops, and your place is waiting when you return.

SEE YOUR PRACTICE GROW
Track completed puzzles by board size and difficulty. Explore best and average active play times, date filters, and a six-month view. Your history stays on this device, and you can reset your statistics whenever you like.

MADE FOR YOUR DEVICE
Enjoy touch controls on iPhone and iPad, adaptable iPad layouts, and keyboard shortcuts on iPad and Mac. Your current puzzle saves automatically between visits.

No account is required. Play offline. Your puzzles, lessons, preferences, and statistics are stored locally on each device.

name: SudokuKudos
description:
Sudoku, but make it a race.

SudokuKudos is a free Sudoku game where you can race up to 35 players on the exact same puzzle, in real time. Fastest correct solver wins the Kudos. Prefer to play at your own pace? There's plenty for you too.

RACE LIVE
- Join a public lobby, create your own, or share a code with friends
- Everyone gets the identical puzzle, from Very Easy to Expert
- Chat in the lobby, watch the leaderboard, and see who finishes first
- Earn Kudos for completing rows, columns and boxes first, and for finishing on the podium
- Every puzzle has exactly one solution, and you get a limited number of mistakes per race

SOLO LEVELS
- Travel a colourful world map through 1,000 levels, with puzzles that get steadily harder
- Earn up to three stars on every level for finishing, finishing fast and finishing flawlessly
- Use power-ups when you're stuck, including hints and fill-a-number
- Unlock new worlds as you go

DAILY PUZZLE
- One new puzzle every day, the same for everyone
- Climb the daily leaderboard and build your streak
- Missed a day? You can spend Kudos to restore a lost streak

PRACTICE AND LEARN
- Unlimited practice puzzles at six difficulty levels, with personal bests and streaks
- New to Sudoku? The interactive tutorial teaches the rules and the key techniques step by step
- Pencil marks, hints and a pause button for relaxed solving

PLAY OFFLINE
- No signal? Tap Play offline and get a fresh puzzle at your chosen difficulty, made right on your device

MAKE IT YOURS
- Spend the Kudos you earn on avatars and board themes
- Unlock achievements and climb the all-time leaderboard
- Add friends, invite them to races and see how far they've got on the Solo map

STAY ON TRACK
- Optional reminders for the Daily Puzzle, yesterday's result, Practice and your streak
- Choose which ones you want and when. They're limited so you never get spammed

FREE TO PLAY
- Jump straight in as a guest, or create a free account to save your Kudos, streaks and progress
- Kudos are earned by playing and spent on cosmetics. There is nothing to buy

Questions or feedback? Email hello@sudokukudos.com. We'd love to hear from you.

name: Suomi Daily
description:
Always wanted to speak Finnish, not just collect words? Suomi Daily turns twenty minutes a day into real Finnish, from your first "hei" to B2.

Every day a fresh lesson is waiting. No planning, no piles of flashcards, no wondering what to study next. Open the app, follow today's steps, and the day counts.

YOU'LL REMEMBER EVERY WORD Each new word arrives with a photograph taken in Finland, native Finnish audio and an example sentence. A café window, a birch path, a sauna porch: you remember the place, and the word comes with it. Then spaced repetition brings every word back just before it slips, so review stays short and nothing you learn is lost.

HEAR IT, THEN SAY IT Before you speak, seven short lessons tune your ear and mouth to Finnish: long vowels, double consonants, ä, ö and y. Then you talk with Aino, a friendly colleague from Tampere, in a guided conversation that uses only words you know. Nobody grades you. You just get braver every day.

WRITE AND GET BETTER Write three sentences with today's words. Your tutor corrects them and explains each change in plain English, so the same mistake doesn't come back.

READ REAL FINNISH Short dialogues between named characters, with the translation hidden until you want it. Tap any word to see its meaning and form.

TAKE FINNISH FOR A WALK Every lesson comes with 15 to 30 minutes of listening in native Finnish voices. Download it for a walk or a commute: the conversation, the day's words with space to repeat them, and older words returning right on time.

A PATH, NOT A PILE Five phases take you from sounds and survival through daily life, stories, opinions and independence. Each one ends with something you can actually do: introduce yourself, talk about your day, tell a story, argue a point, read the news.

BUILT ON HOW MEMORY WORKS Spaced repetition, retrieval practice, a daily habit, and learning through pictures and sound. No points, no coins, no gimmicks. Just the methods research shows work, in one calm daily routine.

A STREAK WORTH KEEPING Finish today's lesson and the day counts. Miss a day and your streak waits for you tomorrow. Join the optional leaderboard if you like a little company, or keep your progress to yourself.

YOURS ON EVERY DEVICE iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your progress lives in your own iCloud and syncs between your devices.

Start with three days free.

name: Supperbox: Meal Planner
description:
Cook once, eat twice.

Supperbox plans tomorrow’s lunch from tonight’s dinner. Cook a little extra, set it aside, and lunch is sorted. The few extra things it needs go straight onto your shopping list.

TONIGHT’S DINNER, ALREADY PICKED
Open the app and dinner is waiting: a pick from 100 tested recipes, sized for your household, with the lunch it makes.

YOUR WEEK IN ONE TAP
Say how many dinners, how quick, and what needs using up. Supperbox fills the week. Swap anything you don’t fancy.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
Share a link from any recipe site, paste a video caption or scan a cookbook page. Supperbox reads it on your phone and lets you check every line.

ONE LIST, SORTED BY AISLE
Every dinner and lunch adds up to one shopping list. Amounts are merged and the things you always have are left out. Share it with your household through iCloud.

COOK MODE
Big steps, timers picked up from the recipe, and a screen that stays on.

ALSO
• Recipes in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Japanese
• Metric or US units
• Widgets for tonight’s dinner and your week
• Works offline. Your recipes stay on your device and in your iCloud.

SUPPERBOX PRO
Lunches from every dinner, the whole library with a new chef’s special every day, unlimited saved recipes, cookbook scans and caption import, one-tap week plans and a shared household list. Choose yearly or weekly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in Settings.

name: Surchiolor
description:
Surchiolor: Tornitasapaino on nopea ja selkeä fysiikkapeli tornin rakentamisesta. Lohko heiluu nosturin koukussa – napauta oikealla hetkellä, niin se putoaa tornin huipulle.

TASAPAINO RATKAISEE
• Jos lohkon keskikohta jää alemman lohkon reunan yli, lohko putoaa ja menetät yhden yrityksen.
• Jos tornin yläosan painopiste siirtyy liian kauas, koko torni kaatuu.

Pudota lohko täsmälleen edellisen päälle, niin saat "Täydellinen!"-bonuksen. Peräkkäiset täydelliset osumat kasvattavat bonusta.

KASVAVA HAASTE
Joka kahdeksas kerros nostaa tasoa: koukku heiluu nopeammin ja lohkot kapenevat.

ENNÄTYKSET
Kymmenen parasta tulostasi tallentuu korkeuden ja päivämäärän kanssa. Riittääkö taitosi uuteen ennätykseen?

TUNNELMA
Yötaivas, hehkuvat oranssit lohkot ja tuntopalaute jokaisesta pudotuksesta ja osumasta. Kaikki grafiikka piirretään suoraan sovelluksessa.

name: SwatchSpan

name: SwingFit: Golf Arc & Angle
description:

- Multi-Club Profile Storage: Save custom swing metrics for your driver, fairway woods, irons, and wedges offline.
- 100% Offline Field Access: Optimize your swing geometry directly on driving ranges, remote courses, or practice bays without cellular signal.

Designed for:
- Golfers fixing slice/hook patterns by visualizing swing path and face angle ratios.
- Golf instructors demonstrating swing plane biomechanics during offline lessons.
- Players matching club loft specs to their natural swing speed.

name: SwipeAchieve: Photo Cleaner
description:
Free up iPhone storage by swiping through your photos and videos.

SwipeAchieve is a photo and video cleaner that feels like a game. Each photo or video appears as a card. Swipe left to delete it. Swipe right to keep it. Gigabytes freed in minutes instead of weekends.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick Photos & videos. No account needed.
2. Swipe through your items: left = delete, right = keep.
3. Watch your storage free up while your streak grows.

PHOTO AND VIDEO CLEANER
- Swipe through your camera roll, newest or oldest first, with filters for All, Photos or Videos
- Cards match the real shape of each photo or video, so you see the whole picture
- Pinch to zoom before you decide
- Safe by design: deleted photos and videos wait 30 days in Recently Deleted, and iOS asks you to confirm before anything is removed
- Works without any account and your photos never leave your iPhone

EMAIL CLEANING (ICLOUD, YAHOO AND MORE)
- Connect iCloud, Yahoo or any IMAP email with an app password, or try the labelled sample inbox first
- Swipe cards show sender, subject, size and age at a glance
- Scroll the email preview right on the card to read more before you decide
- Safe by design: left moves mail to your Trash folder, it never permanently deletes. Trash keeps mail for about 30 days, so you can restore anything
- Undo your last swipes in one tap
- Set a daily goal, build a combo and keep your streak alive, with an inbox-zero celebration at the end

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your photos and emails are processed on your iPhone, not on our servers
- We never sell your data or use it to train AI
- Remote images are blocked by default to stop tracking pixels
- Your email password is an app password stored in the iOS Keychain. Remove an account in Settings, or revoke the app password at your provider, any time

FREE TO DOWNLOAD, PRO OPTIONAL
- Free: 25 swipes every day
- SwipeAchieve Pro: unlimited swipes, Sender Sweep (move everything from one sender to Trash) and Smart sort (biggest, oldest or newsletters first)

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
SwipeAchieve Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: $2.99 per week or $29.99 per year. Both plans start with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, then renew at the price shown. Prices are in USD and may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://swipecleanphone.app/privacy

iCloud is a trademark of Apple Inc. Yahoo is a trademark of Yahoo. SwipeAchieve is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple or Yahoo.

name: TableRelay
description: Set up a table with two to twelve players and arrange their seats. See whose turn it is and which round you are in. Pass the turn or undo the last step. Finish a table to keep its completed turn counts by player, or return to an active table after a break. Sessions are saved on your device.

name: TableTap Dashboard
description:
TableTap Dashboard is the app for restaurants and cafés that have signed up with TableTap. A TableTap partner account is required to sign in — the app has no public sign-up.

When your guests order from their phones through TableTap — at the table, for pickup or curbside — the order lands here instantly, and your phone alerts you even when the app is closed.

LIVE ORDERS
• Every new order on one board: New, Accepted, Preparing, Ready, Served
• Accept, update and serve orders with a tap
• Cancel with a reason the guest sees straight away
• Full order details, items, options and notes

NOTIFICATIONS
• Time-sensitive alerts for new orders and waiter calls, with a chime
• Tap an alert to open that exact order

MENU, TABLES AND QR CODES
• Edit menu items, photos, prices and options
• Mark items or add-ons out of stock in seconds
• Create table QR codes and share or print them

INSIGHTS
• Sales, orders and average order value for today, this week or this month
• Top-selling items, order and table insights
• Export orders to CSV

YOUR TEAM
• Restaurant owners can give their staff their own logins, limited to the screens they need

Interested in TableTap for your restaurant? Contact us at tabletappk.com/support.

name: Tangly: Daily Logic Puzzles
description:
Four new logic puzzles every day. Each one takes a few minutes, has exactly one solution, and never needs guessing.

THE PUZZLES
• Crowns — place one crown in every row, column and colored region. Crowns never touch, not even diagonally.
• Mini Sudoku — a quick 6×6 sudoku: 1 to 6 once in every row, column and box.
• One Line — start at 1, pass the numbers in order and fill every square with a single line.
• Two Colors — fill the grid with two colors: no more than two alike in a row, and equal counts in every row and column.

EVERY DAY
• New puzzles at midnight, the same for everyone.
• Easy at the start of the week, harder toward the weekend.
• Keep your streak going and share your time without spoiling the solution.
• Gentle help when you need it: undo, hints and instant rule checks.

TANGLY PLUS — one-time purchase
• Unlimited puzzles in free play
• Choose difficulty and grid size
• The archive: play the days you missed
• Statistics: best times, streaks and progress
No subscription. Family Sharing supported.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone.

Questions or ideas? app.tangly@gmail.com

name: Teen Drive Hours Tracker
description:
Teen Drive Hours Tracker keeps the practice log your teen needs for a driver's license.

Start a timer when you pull out, stop it when you park, and the drive is saved with the date, time, supervising adult and car. Forgot to start the timer? Log a past drive in a few taps.

TRACK WHAT YOUR STATE ASKS FOR
• All 50 states and DC, with each state's current requirement and a link to its DMV page
• Set your own total and night-hour goals
• Instructor hours, for states that require time with a driving instructor
• Optional goals for freeway, rain, city, parking and other conditions

LOG TOGETHER
• Invite another parent through iCloud, and both of you add drives from your own iPhones
• Keep separate logs for more than one teen

TURN IT IN
• Export a printable PDF with a signature line
• Export a spreadsheet (CSV)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts and no tracking. Your log lives on your phone and in your own iCloud.
• Route tracking is optional and off by default.

Requirements change. Always confirm the current rules with your state DMV. Teen Drive Hours Tracker is not affiliated with any DMV.

As an Amazon Associate, Teen Drive Hours Tracker earns from qualifying purchases.

name: Tendlets Weather
description:
The weather, with a little friend.

Pick one of thirteen Tendlets as your weather buddy, and they’ll dress for whatever the sky is doing. Sunglasses when it’s sunny, a raincoat and umbrella in the rain, a bobble hat and hot chocolate in the snow, and fast asleep at night.

MEET THE GLOOMS
The clouds are Glooms: grumpy little puffs that sniffle in drizzle, have a good cry in the rain and grumble in a storm. Tap one to pop it and cheer it away. Collect all nine kinds, including the rare golden Gloom, and earn titles as you go.

EVERY PET HAS A PERSONALITY
Froad refuses an umbrella because rain is the best. Snowble melts on hot days and is overjoyed when it snows. Spookle stays up all night when everyone else is asleep.

THE FORECAST AT A GLANCE
The temperature, what it feels like, wind, the next 24 hours and the week ahead, for where you are or any place you search for. Save a few places and swipe the sky to move between them.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add the widget to see your buddy dressed for the weather right on your home screen, with the next few hours. On iPhone there are lock screen widgets too.

A MORNING HEADS-UP
Switch it on and your buddy sends a note at 7:30 on days worth knowing about: rain on the way, snow, storms, frost, heat or a gale. Ordinary days stay quiet.

SPECIAL DAYS
Christmas, New Year, Valentine’s, Easter, Pride, Halloween and Bonfire Night bring their own outfits, party hats for the Glooms and fireworks after dark.

SHARE THE WEATHER
Send a picture of your buddy and today’s sky to friends.

KIND BY DESIGN
• Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
• No accounts, no tracking, nothing sold.
• Your location is only used, roughly, to fetch the weather.

From the makers of Tendlets, the self-care pet.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com.

Questions? hello@tendlets.com

name: Tenortrainer: Jura Examen
description:
Tenorieren, bis es sitzt.

Der Tenortrainer übt die Urteilsformel für das zweite juristische Staatsexamen – an immer neuen Fällen. Hauptsache, Kosten und vorläufige Vollstreckbarkeit baust du Baustein für Baustein selbst. Nach jedem Baustein siehst du, was stimmt: mit Musterlösung, Begründung und dem Rechenweg.

JEDER FALL IST NEU
Zahlen, Daten, Parteien und Konstellationen werden bei jedem Fall neu gewürfelt. Du lernst also die Regel, nicht die Lösung auswendig.

89 FALLTYPEN AUS DREI URTEILSARTEN
• Zivilurteil: volle und teilweise Stattgabe, § 709 und §§ 708 Nr. 11, 711 ZPO, § 713 ZPO, Zinsen, § 92 II ZPO, Hilfsaufrechnung, Haupt- und Hilfsantrag, Klagerücknahme, Erledigung, Anerkenntnis, Versäumnisurteil, Urkundenprozess, Zug um Zug, Feststellung, Räumung, Widerklage, Gesamtschuldner, Baumbach’sche Formel, Streithelfer, Herausgabe, Unterlassung, Willenserklärung, Stufenklage, Teil- und Grundurteil, §§ 767 und 771 ZPO, Arrest und einstweilige Verfügung, Berufung und Arbeitsgericht
• Strafurteil: Schuldspruch mit Regelbeispiel, Tateinheit und Tatmehrheit, mehrere Angeklagte, Geldstrafe, Gesamtstrafe und nachträgliche Gesamtstrafe, Verwarnung mit Strafvorbehalt, Entziehung der Fahrerlaubnis, Fahrverbot, Einziehung, Freispruch, Teilfreispruch, Nebenklage, Adhäsionsverfahren, Maßregeln, Einstellung, Berufung und Jugendstrafrecht
• Verwaltungsurteil: Anfechtung, Teilaufhebung, Fortsetzungsfeststellung, Verpflichtung und Bescheidung, Feststellungs- und Leistungsklage, Beigeladene, Teilerledigung sowie Eilbeschlüsse nach § 80 V und § 123 VwGO, dazu Normenkontrolle, Untätigkeitsklage und Einstellungsbeschlüsse

VERSTEHEN. ÜBEN. KÖNNEN.
Jede Lektion beginnt mit einem gelösten Beispiel. Danach löst du neue Fälle, so viele du magst. Jeder Fall ohne Fehler und ohne Tipp füllt einen von drei Strichen. Sind alle voll, sitzt die Lektion.

GEMISCHT ÜBEN
Die App mischt deine Lektionen und bringt öfter, was zuletzt schiefging oder länger her ist. Keine Termine, keine feste Fallzahl: Du löst, solange du magst, und siehst am Ende, was du geschafft hast.

KLAUSURMODUS
Gemischte Fälle ohne Tipp und ohne Kostenüberschlag, mit Uhr – geprüft wird erst die ganze Entscheidung, wie in der Klausur.

FORTSCHRITT UND PRÜFPUNKTE
Die App merkt sich, welche Regeln sitzen und wo es hakt – von der Kostenquote bis zur Abwendungsbefugnis – und lässt dich genau diese Punkte gezielt üben.

MERKBLÄTTER, FORMULIERUNGEN, RECHNER
Merkblätter zu Aufbau, Zinsen, Kosten und Vollstreckbarkeit, über 150 Tenorsätze zum Nachschlagen und Kopieren sowie Rechner für Gebühren und Kostenrisiko, für die Vollstreckbarkeit im Zivilurteil und für den Tagessatz.

RECHTSSTAND 2026
Mit der Berufungssumme von 1.000 € seit dem 1. Januar 2026 und den Gebühren nach dem KostBRÄG 2025.

KOSTENLOS STARTEN
Acht Falltypen, alle Merkblätter, Formulierungen und Rechner sind frei. Die Vollversion schaltet alle Falltypen mit einem Einmalkauf dauerhaft frei – kein Abo.

Ohne Konto, ohne Werbung, ohne Tracking. Dein Lernstand bleibt auf deinem Gerät.

Hinweis: Die App ist eine Lernhilfe für Referendariat und Assessorexamen und ersetzt keine Rechtsberatung. Formulierungen weichen zwischen Gerichten und Bundesländern teils ab.

name: Termi: Assignment Tracker
description:
Termi shows you on your Home Screen what's due next and which course it belongs to. Assignments, presentations and exams appear with a course code and the days until the deadline, on the Lock Screen too.

Deadlines, course by course
Every course gets a short code like R&P or STAT and one of 12 colors. The color belongs to the course, not to each entry. Titles stay short, and you can tell the course at a glance, even in the small widget.

A widget for every spot
Small with a big day count, medium and large as a list, extra large in two columns on iPad. On the Lock Screen as a ring, a rectangle or a line above the clock. The month widget shows every day with a deadline in the color of its course. From iOS 27, the semester widget in the 4×6 format adds a timeline. Every widget can be limited to certain courses, and the day count updates after midnight without opening the app.

A deadline in seconds
Course, type, date. The title is optional. When you add a presentation, Termi can add the submission before it as well, 2 days earlier by default. With “Add another”, the course stays selected, so you can enter several deadlines in a row.

Reminders that match the deadline
Termi reminds you 7, 3 and 1 day before at 9:00 AM by default. You choose the days and the time, for all deadlines or just one. Check it off right in the notification. Done items leave the widget and can be brought back at any time. Deadlines with a time show the hours and minutes left during the last 24 hours.

List or month
The list is sorted into Overdue, This week and the months ahead, and a filter shows a single course. One tap switches to the month view, where you see when deadlines pile up.

Start the semester without retyping
Import events from your calendar or from an .ics file. Termi suggests the course from the title and recognizes words like exam, midterm, quiz or presentation. Nothing gets added twice.

iPhone and iPad, no account
Your deadlines sync between iPhone and iPad through your iCloud.

Free, with everything included
Termi has no paywall and no subscription. If the app helps you, you can leave a one-time tip. It comes with three other app icons, nothing else changes.

What Termi is not
Termi is not a class schedule and not a grade tracker. It takes care of deadlines: assignments, presentations, exams and any type you create yourself. A course can also be called Job or Personal.

Add your first deadline. Course, type, date. That's all it takes.

name: Texel - Texture & Grain
description:
Texel does one thing: add real texture and grain to HEIC originals shot on iPhone 16 / 17.

It never overwrites the original, never uploads your photos, and needs no account. Everything runs on your device, and the result is saved as a new photo in your library.

ONLY ADD, NEVER TRANSCODE
• Reads the original HEIC resource through PhotoKit, preserving HDR, EXIF, Styles, and thumbnails
• Adds texture and grain only — no filters, cropping, color replacement, or AI generation
• Reads the saved asset back to confirm it is still HEIC; the original asset is untouched

5 FREE PHOTOS EVERY DAY
• Resets on your device's local calendar day and is shared across every entry point
• Only a successful save or export uses one photo; failures, skips, incompatible files, and cancellations do not
• Texel Pro is a one-time purchase with unlimited photos forever; Restore Purchases is supported

BUILT FOR REAL WORKFLOWS
• Process up to 9 photos at once, with real iCloud download progress and stage-by-stage status
• Cancel a queue safely; photos already saved are never written twice
• View and share the real HEIC from the in-app result page
• The Share Extension and Shortcuts use the same conversion and quota

PRIVACY FIRST
• The developer runs no server; photos are never uploaded to the developer
• No sign-in; photos are accessed only when you select them
• Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese

Works with HEIC originals from iPhone 16 / 17. Live Photos, RAW, JPEG, and PNG are not supported.

name: Text Trick: Chat Riddles
seller_name: MAS SOFT YAZILIM TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Text Trick is a funny riddle game played inside a pretend messaging app. Every level is a chat with a mission: catch a friend's lie, unsend a text before Mom reads it, or get Kai off his tablet. The answer is always hiding in the conversation, or somewhere on the phone itself!

SEVEN WAYS TO SOLVE
• Tap the suspicious message, emoji or detail
• Long-press to unsend, pin, delete or react
• Build the perfect reply from a word bank
• Drag a sticker into the chat
• Put scrambled messages back in order
• Open a photo and zoom in for hidden clues
• Play with the phone itself: Wi-Fi, battery, clock, calls and profiles

NO PENALTIES
A wrong tap just gets a little "hmm…". Solve a level without hints and without mistakes for 3 stars and bonus coins. Every chat ends with a funny final line you can share.

STUCK?
Every level has two hints: first a gentle nudge, then the answer.

WRITTEN FOR EACH LANGUAGE
40 English levels and 40 Turkish levels in 4 chapters, each written with its own jokes, not just translated. The first levels show you every trick step by step.

Come back every day for a daily reward with coins and hints.

Text Trick is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases. There are no banner ads, and you can remove pop-up ads with a one-time purchase.

Questions or ideas? Write to muranocrew@gmail.com

name: Thanksgiving Gobble Clock
description:
Celebrate Thanksgiving with a cute cartoon turkey on your Apple Watch, and watch its tail grow as you move!

Gobble Clock is an Apple Watch app with a friendly turkey standing on an autumn farm. Its big fan tail is your progress: every one of the 12 feathers lights up as you get closer to your goal, and a full tail means you made it. Raise your wrist and see how far you've come today.

THE TURKEY'S TAIL IS YOUR GOAL
• Steps: the tail fills up as you walk towards a daily step goal you choose in the iPhone app (10,000 by default)
• Or Move ring: the tail follows your active calories and the Move goal you set in the Fitness app
• The small grey tail behind it is your battery, one feather for every 10%

FEATURES
• Cute cartoon turkey that blinks, and gobbles when you tap it, with or without banjo music
• Autumn farm with a red barn, pumpkins and falling leaves
• The farm changes with the time of day: day, sunset and night, or pick one you like
• Time and date on a wooden slice, in 12-hour or 24-hour format
• Steps, heart rate, active calories and battery on wooden signs
• Goal progress in percent
• Pick any color for the time, date and stats
• Dimmed always-on look that keeps the time and date easy to read

CUSTOMIZE FROM YOUR IPHONE
Open the app on your watch, then use the companion iPhone app to choose what the tail shows, set your step goal, pick the sky, choose the gobble sound and the color, and switch between 12-hour and 24-hour time.

WATCH APP AND WATCH FACE
Gobble Clock is a watch app: the turkey shows while the app is open on your Apple Watch. From the iPhone app you can also install a matching Apple photo watch face with the turkey on the farm. It includes a complication that opens the app with a single tap. You can also add the complication to your favorite watch face or to the Smart Stack.

Tip: to keep the app on screen longer, open Settings on your watch, go to General, then Return to Clock, and choose After 1 hour.

HEALTH DATA
Gobble Clock reads your steps, heart rate, active calories and Activity summary from Apple Health to show them on your watch. Your data stays on your devices.

HELP AND SUPPORT
The iPhone app includes a FAQ section with answers to common questions and a contact page if you need us. The More tab shows our other animated watch faces.

REQUIREMENTS
Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or newer, paired with an iPhone running iOS 17 or newer.

Gobble up those steps this Thanksgiving!

name: Thrifty Blonde
description:
Thrifty Blonde is the shopper app for Thrifty Blonde Estate Sales, a family-run estate sale company in Charlotte, NC.

See upcoming sales in Charlotte, Matthews, and Mint Hill with their dates, hours, and descriptions. Open any sale to view photos and full details, add the sale days to your calendar, or share a sale with a friend.

No account. No sign-in. No ads and no trackers. Just the sales.

name: ThuqaviZelprik
description: Combine harvester driving: header, reel, grain tank, moisture, distance, grain crop and fuel.

name: Tidebreak Survivors
description:
HOLD THE LAST LIGHT.

Tidebreak Survivors is an offline, single-player arena survival game for iPhone. Guide a lone adventurer through growing monster tides while your fireball automatically aims at nearby enemies.

MOVE, CAST, SURVIVE
Drag the joystick to dodge slimes, bats, ghosts, wisps, ranged eyeballs and the Sentinel's attacks. Piercing fireballs and splash damage help clear the crowd while you focus on positioning.

FORGE YOUR SPELL BUILD
Collect experience shards and choose one of three upgrades at each level. Combine eight unlockable spells with your base fireball: Frost Nova, Chain Lightning, Meteor Rain, Whirling Blades, Venom Field, Arcane Barrage, Gravity Well and Holy Pulse. Freeze foes, pull packs into black holes, launch homing bolts and unleash area attacks. Fourteen upgrade types let you strengthen spells, weapon damage, firing speed, movement and pickups. Combat pauses while you choose.

BREAK THE TIDE
Face escalating packs and wave surges across two arenas. In Neon Harbor, the Sentinel arrives at 02:30. Defeat it to unlock the tougher Coral Rift, whose boss arrives at 04:30. The boss must be defeated to win; the timer alone does not end the run.

RETURN STRONGER
Completed battles award salvage. Spend it in the Forge on permanent Vitality, Spellpower and Swiftness upgrades, each with five ranks. Track your wins, kill records and workshop progress locally. Retreating forfeits that run's salvage.

PIXEL FANTASY, COMPLETE OFFLINE PLAY
Enjoy animated pixel heroes, monsters and spells, framed fantasy menus, kill chains, critical-hit numbers and original ambient music. Sound effects, music and haptics have independent controls. Reduce Motion disables brief combat screen shake.

No account, internet connection, advertisements, analytics, subscriptions or in-app purchases are required. Progress stays in local app storage. Switching apps pauses combat; unfinished runs are not restored after force-quitting. Deleting the app removes local progress.

Pixel animations are rendered from patch-gg/pixelfx under the MIT license. Full credits and notices are available in Codex. The game is independently developed.

English interface. iPhone only. Requires iOS 17 or later.

name: Tidewheel Haven
description:
Every side. One brave little crew.

Your lighthouse haven is surrounded by busy waters, and curious invaders are closing in. Gather a feathered defense, watch every approach, and give each shore the help it needs.

BUILD A LIVING DEFENSE
Eight shore squads protect your island. Every duck adds attack strength and guard. Tap a shore and send in another duck from your reserve. Gather up to six ducks in a squad, recall friends from quiet shores, and move your numbers toward the danger.

WATCH THE INVASION CLOSE IN
Enemies arrive from all four sides and the diagonal channels. They cross open water before reaching your crews. A living squad blocks its shore; an empty defense lets attackers push toward the haven. Watch the red shore markers and reinforce before the line breaks.

PICK THE RIGHT TOOL
Use a Tide Bell to boost a squad, catch attackers in a Bubble Net, grow a Sprout Shield, or sound the Duck Call for fresh recruits. Tools act immediately on your selected shore. Three supplies refresh each wave, so choose the right help at the right moment.

MEET YOUR CREW AND THEIR RIVALS
Six duck roles bring different strengths, from split attacks to armor-piercing lanterns. Meet eight enemy species with bubbles, shells, sprint bursts, and other surprises. Ten distinct chapter bosses test your strongest squads.

EXPLORE 100 SHORES
Defend ten chapters across 100 scripted stages. Surviving squads recover between waves, and four fresh ducks join your reserve. Replay favorite shores to protect more of your crew and improve your stars.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Pause the invasion whenever you need time to think. Assist Mode lets you advance one pulse at a time, with separate local records. Practice without changing your campaign rewards.

MAKE YOUR HAVEN YOURS
Earn Shells from first clears, new stars, and daily gifts. Choose cosmetic garden decorations and compare up to three local profiles. Miss a gift day? Your gift progress stays.

• 100 stages across 10 chapters
• Eight shore squads, up to six ducks per squad
• Four targeted tools available from the first level
• Six crew roles, eight enemy species, and ten chapter bosses
• Tactical pause, manual-pulse Assist Mode, and practice
• Local records, daily gifts, and cosmetic garden decorations
• Offline play with no account, ads, or in-app purchases

Gather your crew. Hold every shore.

name: Tidings
description:
Tidings는 바다 건너 누군가에게 천천히 도착하는 편지 앱입니다.

편지를 쓰고 밀랍으로 봉인하면 유리병이 파도에 실려 수평선 너머로 떠내려갑니다. 병은 거리만큼 시간이 걸려 도착합니다. 같은 나라면 한두 시간, 대륙을 건너면 하루 가까이. 받은 사람은 답장을 쓰거나 병을 다시 바다로 돌려보냅니다.

■ 이렇게 써요
• 편지지를 고르고 20~3,000자의 편지를 씁니다. 사진이나 영상 없이 글만 담습니다.
• 아무 바다로 띄우거나, 낡은 세계지도에서 대륙과 나라를 골라 보냅니다.
• 봉인한 병은 거리에 따라 1시간에서 최대 48시간 뒤 도착합니다. 도착 예정 시각이 함께 표시됩니다.
• 도착한 병을 열면 상대의 필명·나이·성별·나라·사용 언어와 편지가 보입니다.
• 답장은 같은 규칙으로 천천히 건너갑니다. 한 사람과 한 통씩, 1:1 편지 주고받기만 이어집니다.
• 편지를 주고받은 나라의 우표가 우표첩에 모입니다.

■ 느린 편지입니다
실시간 대화가 아닙니다. 입력 중 표시도, 읽음 표시도, 즉시 매칭도 없습니다. 하루에 새 병은 다섯 개까지만 띄울 수 있고, 답장은 자유롭습니다.

■ 안전하게
• 만 18세 이상만 가입할 수 있습니다.
• 상대에게는 필명·나이·성별·나라·언어만 보입니다. 실명·사진·이메일은 공개되지 않습니다.
• 모든 편지는 보내기 전에 자동 검토를 거치며, 편지 단위로 신고하고 상대를 차단할 수 있습니다. 차단하면 편지 교환이 바로 끝나고 다시 연결되지 않습니다.
• 신고는 24시간 안에 확인합니다.
• 앱 안에서 언제든 계정을 삭제할 수 있습니다.

■ 알림
병이 해변에 닿거나 답장이 도착하면 알려 드립니다. 잠금 화면에는 편지 내용이 표시되지 않습니다.

바다 건너 누군가의 하루를 읽고, 당신의 하루를 적어 보내세요.

name: Tied Up! Co-op Rope Climb
description:
Tied Up! is a funny physics climbing game for 2 to 4 friends. Your blobs are tied together with a stretchy rubber rope. Climb to the top as a team... but if one of you slips, the rope drags everybody down with them!

PLAY TOGETHER, YOUR WAY
• One phone: the screen splits into one control strip per player. Drag to walk, tap to jump. 2, 3 or 4 players on the same phone.
• Online: create a room and share the 4-digit code. No account or sign-in needed.
• Voice chat in online rooms: automatic or push-to-talk, and you can mute any player.

TEAMWORK ON A ROPE
• Hold your friend when they fall, swing them across gaps, climb up the rope while hanging.
• Stand on each other's heads for an extra boost.
• Easy and Hard modes. Checkpoints along the way.

40 HANDMADE LEVELS IN 8 WORLDS
Meadow, City, Kitchen, Space, Carnival, Snowy Mountain, Jungle Temple and Pirate Cove, by day, at sunset and at night. Every level has its own trick: ice, bouncy pads, crumbling floors, conveyor belts, wind, doors and buttons, Ferris wheel cabins, spinning platforms, swings, cannons and lifts that only rise when two of you hop on.

FALL, LAUGH, SHARE
• Every fall is counted. The fewest falls wins on the leaderboards: worldwide and by country, separately for teams of 2, 3 and 4.
• Share your result card: "We fell 42 times!"
• 10 achievements, funny ropes (sausage, chain, spaghetti, rainbow), couple costumes and trail effects. Many unlock just by playing.

FAIR PLAY
Every level is free. No energy, no timers and never a forced ad. An optional short ad appears only if you choose to jump back to a checkpoint, and the No-ads pack removes it for good. Purchases are cosmetic only.

Plays in English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Indonesian, Polish and Russian.

How many falls can your friendship take?

name: Tiny Bloom: Flower Garden
description:
Grow flowers, open a tiny flower shop and plant gardens that look like pictures.

Tiny Bloom is a cozy idle game with a relaxing puzzle at its heart. Your flower beds keep blooming even while you're away, and every flower you grow becomes a seed for the next garden your neighbors order.

PLANT THE PICTURE
• Recreate each reference picture on the soil, flower by flower
• Drag to plant, fill whole patches in one tap, and ask Abi the bee for a hint
• Reach 60, 80 and 95% match to earn up to three stars

A PATH OF 40 GARDENS
• Walk through 5 neighborhoods: the square, the vegetable patch, a Japanese garden, the coast and a night garden
• Each one adds a new twist: stones, timed races, fog and exact seeds
• Open treasure chests along the way and finish every big garden for new flowers and decorations

YOUR FLOWER SHOP
• Unlock 22 flowers in the greenhouse and upgrade their beds
• Decorate your shop with awnings, doors, a bench, a flower bike, string lights and more
• Every decoration boosts your flower sales

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
• A garden of the day that's the same for everyone, with a daily leaderboard
• Seasonal gardens and a 7-day daily gift
• Turn your own photos into gardens you can plant
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements, plus a home screen widget

No ads. No account required. Play offline anywhere.

Bloom Club is an optional monthly or yearly subscription with a free trial: x2 flower growth, double storage, 24 hours of offline earnings and double hints in the daily gift. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can manage it in your Apple Account settings.

Play in English or Spanish. The game starts in your device's language.

Terms of Use: https://tinybloom.novusavante.com/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://tinybloom.novusavante.com/en/privacy/

name: TinyTasks: Habit Tracker
description:
Small tasks. Big progress.

TinyTasks helps you build momentum by focusing on doable micro-tasks that take between 2 and 5 minutes. Clear your mind, conquer procrastination, and make real progress in the spare minutes of your day.

Whether it’s replying to a key email, doing a quick stretch, or clearing a small corner of your desk, TinyTasks makes productivity approachable, friendly, and rewarding.

WHY TINYTASKS?
• Zero Overwhelm: Break large daily goals into bite-sized, 2-to-5 minute wins.
• "I Have 5 Minutes" Mode: Tap one button to get an instant, focused quick task with a built-in focus timer.
• Calm & Motivating Design: A warm, premium interface created to reduce stress and inspire action.
• Daily Goal Tracking: Keep a streak going with clear daily targets and celebrated wins.
• Real Local Statistics: Beautiful weekly breakdown charts and category insights calculated directly from your accomplishments.
• 100% Private & Offline: Stored entirely on your device with Apple SwiftData. No accounts, no logins, no cloud tracking.

FEATURES:
- Micro-Task Focus: Curated durations (2 min, 3 min, 5 min) designed to fit your busy day.
- Custom Categories: Work, Home, Wellness, Learning, Personal, and custom categories.
- Built-in Focus Timer: Visual progress ring with start, pause, resume, and completion celebration.
- Daily Goal Motivation: Set your goal (3, 5, 7, or 10 tasks) and watch your daily wins stack up.
- Insightful Statistics: Visual day-by-day bar charts and category distribution donut charts.
- Flexible Organization: Search, sort, filter by category or duration, and swipe to complete or edit.
- Optional Gentle Reminders: Set local notification nudges to keep your momentum going without intrusive alerts.

TINYTASKS PRO
Upgrade to TinyTasks Pro to unlock unlimited tasks, custom categories, advanced monthly & all-time analytics, and custom goal settings.

Subscription Terms:
TinyTasks offers monthly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions, as well as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store Account Settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://vargamark.com/tinytasks/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://vargamark.com/tinytasks/support.html

name: TipSums
description: TipSums helps you calculate tips, split restaurant bills, and see what each person owes. Log checks by typing or speaking, attach voice notes, and search past checks by restaurant, category, or note. You can also print receipt-style summaries.

name: Tishk : تیشک
description:
Tishk is the app of the Tishk Print & Copy shop. Send your documents and photos to print from your phone, follow your order live, and get it at the counter or at your door.

PRINT FROM YOUR PHONE
• Keep your documents and photos in My Files, organised in folders.
• Send PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Photoshop files and photos to print.
• Choose colour or black & white, single or double-sided, pages per sheet, stapling and number of copies.
• See the price before you send.
• Passport and ID photo prints (Jawaz and Mu’amalat).
• Share files to Tishk straight from other apps.

PICK UP OR DELIVERY
• Pick up at the shop, or have your prints delivered to your door.
• Follow every order live: printing, ready, out for delivery, delivered.
• Get a notification as soon as your order is ready.

MARKET
• Books and school & office supplies, by the piece or by the carton.
• Search and filter by category, price and stock.
• Order with cash on delivery and drop a pin on the map for the address.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• Kurdish (Sorani), Arabic and English.
• Light and dark mode.

Sign in with Apple or Google. You can delete your account and all your files from the app at any time.

name: ToDoodle Do
description:
ToDoodle is a calm, private planner for your tasks, notes and ideas. It keeps today clear, the week in view and everything else out of the way.

PLAN YOUR DAY AND YOUR WEEK
• A Today view with what's due, what's overdue and the events and notes for the day.
• A week planner: every day side by side on iPad and Mac, a quick day strip on iPhone.
• A list view grouped by date, with completed tasks tucked away.
• Someday: a place for the things without a date yet.

JUST TYPE IT
Write "Put the bins out every Tuesday at 7pm #home" and ToDoodle sets the date, time, repeat and tag for you. Each detection shows as a chip you can remove before saving.

PROJECTS, YOUR WAY
• Group tasks into projects with a colour and an emoji.
• View each project as a Kanban board, a list or a week.
• Organise projects into folders and drag them into the order you want.

NOTES THAT STAY ORGANISED
• Write in Markdown with headings, checklists, tables and callouts.
• File notes in folders, tag them, pin the important ones.
• Link notes together with [[wikilinks]].
• Export a note as Markdown or PDF.

BOARDS AND COLLECTIONS
• Boards: a freeform canvas for sticky notes, shapes, images and handwriting.
• Collections: simple tables for the things you collect or track, with list, table and card views, filters and sorting.

CALENDAR AND REMINDERS
• An optional built-in calendar with month, week and list views.
• Subscribe to iCal feeds and import or export .ics files.
• Reminders for timed tasks and events arrive as notifications, scheduled on your device.

MADE FOR IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
• A native Liquid Glass tab bar on iPhone.
• A full sidebar layout on iPad and Mac.
• Light and dark appearance that follows your device, six accent colours and a choice of typefaces.
• Swipe to complete or delete, long-press for quick actions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no analytics and no tracking.
• Works offline: your content is kept on your device so you can read and plan without a connection.
• Optional end-to-end encryption: turn it on and your content is encrypted before it leaves your device.
• Two-factor authentication for your account.

USE IT YOUR WAY
ToDoodle works on this device without an account. Sign in to a ToDoodle account to keep your tasks and notes in step across your iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web. Full syncing is available to ToDoodle members.

name: tomaraki. – Tennis & Ranking
description:
tomaraki. is the social network for tennis players. Find a tennis opponent near you, arrange matches, log the score and climb the ranking.

For amateurs and advanced players, for singles and doubles.

FIND AN OPPONENT & PARTNER
Discover players near you and at your level. Send a challenge and book your next match on the court.

LOG YOUR MATCHES
Enter the score set by set and confirm it with your opponent. If they don't respond within 2 days, it is confirmed automatically. Every win counts.

CLIMB THE RANKING (ATT)
An Elo-based ranking: beat a stronger opponent, earn more points. See your rank overall, by city and by gender.

TOURNAMENTS
Join tournaments with groups and knockouts, enter your score from your phone and follow the standings live. As an organizer, create and run your own tournament.

LIVE ATP & WTA
Live scores from the big tournaments, the week's results and the schedule in your own time zone. Turn on score alerts and get every game. Watch highlights from the official channels.

COURTS & ACADEMIES NEAR YOU
A map of courts, academies and players in your area, with the weather at each court.

COMMUNITY
Follow players, share victory photos, comment and message. Earn honors from your opponents (Fair Play, Great Rallies, Good Sport) and keep your streak alive.

Free.
Every match counts.

name: Tonebook: Guitar Tone Recipes
description:
Stop guessing at knobs. Tonebook gives you clear, knob-by-knob guitar tone recipes you can dial into any amp, multi-effects pedal or plugin.

Every recipe shows the full signal chain in order — gate, compressor, drive, amp, cab, modulation, delay and reverb — with the exact setting for every knob, plus the guitar and pickup to use and tips for playing it.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 46 hand-built tone recipes across 20 genres: blues, classic rock, hard rock, metal, djent, punk, grunge, shoegaze, post-rock, funk, neo-soul, jazz, country, surf, worship, ambient, lo-fi and more
• Visual knobs and a gain meter, so you can see a tone at a glance
• Search and filter by genre and mood
• Save favorites to My Tones
• Make your own version of any recipe, or build one from scratch
• Scan settings from a screenshot or photo and turn them into an editable recipe
• Share any recipe as a clean image card

WORKS WITH YOUR GEAR
Recipes use generic amp and effect types (like "British Crunch" or "Tape Delay"), so they translate to tube amps, modelers, multi-effects pedals and amp-sim plugins alike.

TONEBOOK PRO
Unlock the full library, new recipes every month, scanning and unlimited custom recipes.
• Monthly or yearly plans. The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial for new subscribers.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://tonebook-app.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tonebook-app.vercel.app/privacy

Tonebook isn't affiliated with any amplifier or effects manufacturer.

name: Tongkam Marketplace & Auction
description:
Tongkam is Thailand’s dedicated marketplace for buying, selling, and auctioning premium collectibles. Built specifically for the Thai hobby community, Tongkam connects you with verified local collectors to trade high-value items with total peace of mind. Skip the risky social media transfers and experience a secure, streamlined ecosystem designed for serious hobbyists.

HOW IT WORKS:

• Buy Directly: Secure rare items instantly via immediate fixed-price checkout.
• Sell & Consign: List your items to a nationwide network of active buyers in minutes.
• Live Auctions: Bid in real-time or run your own competitive auctions to maximize value.

Trade safely with platform-enforced escrow protection. We support all major Thai Credit Cards and instant QR PromptPay.

Download Tongkam today to access Thailand's collectibles network of buyers and sellers.

name: Tonvyn: Color Analysis, Outfit
description:
Boutique spotlights flatter everything on the hanger—until daylight reveals a washed-out complexion and unworn tags in your closet. Tonvyn brings private-atelier colorimetry, zero-latency garment matching, and objective mirror styling to iPhone for both Women and Men.

CALIBRATED 12-SEASON + SISTER SEASON COLORIMETRY
A live daylight gate guides you into balanced illumination before three precision pins sample malar cheek, iris rim, and natural hair root with a 2.5x loupe. Using CIELAB and ITA° color science across warm, cool, neutral, and olive undertones, Tonvyn reveals your Primary Season plus Sister Season Bridge swatches—eliminating inconsistent cusp results.

LIVE 10HZ IN-STORE RACK MATCHER
Point your camera at any rack for an instant 0–100% CIEDE2000 harmony score in real time, even offline. Snap a garment on a hanger to neutralize warm store spotlights, check palette harmony, and receive three wearable outfit formulas tailored to your personal Style Guardrails—so Tonvyn never suggests necklines, silhouettes, or footwear you refuse to wear.

DRESS CODE MIRROR CHECK & OUTFIT BREAKDOWN
Standing before your mirror for a Wedding Guest, Office, Cocktail, Smart Casual, or Formal invitation? Capture a full-length look for head-to-toe tonal balance and one high-impact refinement tip. Or import an outfit screenshot, tap any piece, and open regional shopping matches in your exact flattering shade.

52-SWATCH STUDIO, MULTI-PROFILE & 10-PIECE CAPSULE
Explore 36 Power Colors, 4 Sister Bridge shades, 12 Washout Colors to avoid, jewelry metals, and full-screen fabric cards for physical rack comparison. Switch effortlessly across up to three profiles (Me, Partner, Friend) with dedicated Women's and Men's modes, and build a 10-piece capsule guarded by CIEDE2000 duplicate alerts before you buy.

PRIVACY & MEMBERSHIP TRUST
Prefer zero photo uploads? Select any of the 12 seasons manually offline anytime. When you opt into AI analysis, face photos have zero server retention (0 seconds stored, never used for AI training), with one-tap Delete All Face & Closet Data in Settings. Includes starter season drape reveal and garment scan; optional Tonvyn Pro unlocks the full 52-swatch studio, multi-profile atelier, and AI styling modes via Apple App Store—cancel anytime in iOS Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://paycyl-hq.github.io/tonvyn-support/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://paycyl-hq.github.io/tonvyn-support/terms.html

name: Tourguide Tools
description:
Tourguide Tools is the fast and reliable guest counter for tour guides on iPhone. Made, shore excursions and hikes.

Count your group every time it boards the bus, leaves a viewpoint or gathers at the mes saved to the same tour, so you always know who is on board and who is still missing.

COUNT THE WAY YOU WORK
• Volume buttons: count without looking at the screen, even with gloves or in a crowd. Both buttons count one guest and your volume stays the same.
• Tap anywhere: one tap on the screen counts one guest when your iPhone is in your hand anyway.
• NFC cards: guests hold their card or wristband to the top of your iPhone. Duplicatesgged instantly. Hold an unknown card again to add it to the group.
• QR codes and barcodes: scan tickets or badges continuously with the Apple scanner on your iPhone. Automatic macro focus for close codes and a torch for dark buses.

KNOW WHO IS MISSING
• Set the group size and count up, or count down to zero.
• See at a glance how many guests are still missing.
• A distinct vibration tells you when the group is complete. No need to look.
• NFC and QR warn you about duplicates and about guests who were not part of the first count.

ONE TOUR, MANY STOPS
• A tour starts with the first count and keeps running until you finish it.
• Save a count at every stop. Boarding the bus again never creates a new tour.
• Undo a count, reset the counter and add guests who join later.
• Press and hold a running tour on the start screen to finish or discard it.
• Resume any archived tour when the day continues.

YOUR TOUR ARCHIVE
• Every tour with date, time, duration, place and all counts.
• Name your stops, rate the tour with four smiley faces and add notes.
• Add up to four photos, automatically compressed.
• Share a tour or your whole archive as text with photos in one tap.
• Swipe to delete, with undo.

MADE FOR IPHONE
• Modern Liquid Glass design in light and dark mode.
• The screen stays on while you count. Portrait lock if you want it.
• Short interactive tutorial on first start.
• Available in English, German, French, Spanish and Norwegian.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything is stored only on your iPhone.
• No account, no cloud, no ads, no tracking.
• Camera and NFC are used only to recognise codes and cards. No images are stored.
• Nothing is shared unless you share it.

name: TOXIC: Who's the Toxic One?
description:
Who's the toxic one in your chat? TOXIC reads years of messages and turns them into a funny, chart-packed story about the two of you. A chat analyzer, love test and relationship test in one app.

HOW IT WORKS
• Export a chat from WhatsApp (or Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, iMessage or email) and share it to TOXIC
• Tell us what you are: partners, exes, a situationship, friends, family, coworkers or roommates
• Tap through your report like a story

WHAT YOU GET
• The Toxic Meter: one score for the relationship and one for each of you
• The verdict: who's the villain, crowned
• The receipts: real quotes from your own chat
• Red flags and green flags, with the messages behind them
• The reply-time race, 3am texts, emoji personalities and top words
• Characters, awards and a forecast
• Share any card as an image

PERFECT FOR
Dating and flirting, new couples, long-term partners, your ex or the chat with your best friend. Toxic relationship or true love? Laughs guaranteed, arguments possible.

FREE TO START
The summary, the Toxic Meter and your texting habits are free. The full case file (the verdict, receipts, red flags, awards, portraits and forecast) is a one-time in-app purchase. No subscription.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your chat is read on your phone. Only statistics and a few short excerpts, with names, numbers and links removed, are used to write your report. Excerpts are deleted once the report is written, and reports expire automatically. Your messages are never used to train AI.

Not sure yet? Open the built-in example report of Sara and Leo before you upload anything.

TOXIC is for entertainment. It is not psychological, medical or legal advice. Only upload conversations you are part of, and keep the report private. If you feel unsafe in a relationship, please contact local support services.

Terms: https://toxicrelation.com/en/legal/terms
Privacy: https://toxicrelation.com/en/legal/privacy

name: TrailLog
description:
TrailLog is a field journal for camping, hiking, and road trips. Plan your itinerary, pack your gear, record what happens along the way, and keep a trip journal you can revisit when you get home.

Plan your next outing
Set trip dates, add waypoints, organize daily activities, and set reminders for departure and preparation.

Pack with confidence
Build a checklist for each trip, track quantities and pack weight, and keep a history of gear use and maintenance.

Capture the trip as it happens
Record GPS tracks separately from planned routes. Save campsite details, photos, field notes, and expenses in the trip they belong to. You can add journal entries offline.

Look back on your adventures
Review distance, elevation, spending, and activity trends. Compare saved tracks, create trip and annual reports, and export routes as GPX, records as CSV, or reports as PDF.

Your journal is stored on your device. No account is required, and you choose when to back up or share your records.

name: TrailormessureX
description:
TrailormessureX on yksityinen ateljeekirjanpito mittatilausräätäleille ja ompelijoille. Jokaisen asiakkaan mitat, jokainen rekissä odottava vaate ja jokainen kangasmetri yhdessä rauhallisessa, huolella tehdyssä paikassa.

MITTAA VARTALOKARTALLA
Jokaisella asiakkaalla on oma mittakartta. Napauta kaulaa, olkapäätä, rintaa, vyötäröä, lantiota, hihaa, pituutta tai sisäsauman pituutta ja aseta arvo liukuvalla mittanauhalla – pehmeä napautus tuntuu peukalon alla jokaisella askeleella. Vaihda senttimetrien ja tuumien välillä milloin tahansa.

SEURAA OMPELUPOLKUA
Jokainen tilaus etenee kuuden vaiheen läpi: Mitattu, Leikattu, Harsittu, Sovitus, Valmis ja Luovutettu. Ompelupolku ompelee itseään eteenpäin työn edetessä, joten tiedät aina, mikä on valmis sovitukseen ja mikä on seuraavaksi vuorossa.

VAATEREKKI
Aloitusnäkymässä jokainen aktiivinen tilaus roikkuu rekissä. Kiinnitetyt muistilaput näyttävät työn alla olevat vaatteet, asiakkaat ja tällä viikolla erääntyvät työt. Mittanauhamittari näyttää kuukauden myynnin suhteessa tavoitteeseesi.

KANGASLASKURI
Tiedä, paljonko kangasta tarvitset, ennen kuin avaat pakan. Valitse vaate, hae vartalon mitat tallennetulta asiakkaalta, valitse kankaan leveys, huomioi yhteen suuntaan kulkevat kuosit tai kohdistettavat ruudut ja saat arvion metreinä ja jaardeina.

ASIAKASREKISTERI
Hae asiakkaita nimellä tai puhelinnumerolla, suodata istuvuuden mukaan, kirjaa sovitusmuistiinpanot, soita asiakkaalle yhdellä napautuksella ja näe kaikki hänen tilauksensa.

YKSITYISYYS ENSIN
Kirjaudu sisään ateljeesi myöntämällä studiotilillä. Kirjanpitosi tallennetaan turvallisesti, ja se näkyy vain omalle tilillesi. Ei mainoksia eikä seurantaa.

Kangasarviot ovat suunnittelun apuväline ja sisältävät saumanvarat; tarkista aina kaavaasi vasten ennen leikkaamista.

name: Tranchant
description:
Tranchant, maison de rasage à Thiers, réunit vingt pièces de rasage manuel et un Atelier qui détermine la tête de coupe adaptée à votre peau, à votre barbe et à votre main.

LA COLLECTION
Rasoirs à peigne fermé, à peigne ouvert, à tête inclinée, modèles en laiton massif, en acier 316L, en titane, en bois d'ébène ou en résine ivoire ; coupe-choux à émouture demi-creuse ou en acier damas ; coffrets et accessoires d'atelier. Chaque pièce est présentée par une photographie et une fiche technique complète : type de tête, écart lame-peigne, exposition de la lame, agressivité, longueur du manche, poids, matière, finition et lieu de fabrication.

L'ATELIER
Cinq questions sur votre peau, la densité de votre barbe, votre rythme, votre expérience et votre prise en main. L'Atelier confronte vos réponses aux paramètres de chaque tête et propose trois recommandations accompagnées de leurs raisons. Le comparateur de têtes permet ensuite de mettre les modèles côte à côte, chiffres à l'appui. Votre diagnostic reste lié à votre compte d'une visite à l'autre.

COMMANDER
Choisissez votre pièce, renseignez vos coordonnées de livraison, puis validez le règlement. Le récapitulatif, le numéro de commande et les étapes de préparation sont réunis dans « Mes commandes », avec le détail de chaque article et de l'adresse de livraison.

VOTRE COMPTE
Un espace personnel pour retrouver vos pièces favorites, votre diagnostic, vos informations et l'historique de vos commandes. Les conditions d'utilisation et la politique de confidentialité sont accessibles à tout moment, ainsi que la déconnexion et la suppression du compte.

name: Translating Charm
description:
Translating Charm translates manga and comics on web pages, right in Safari.

Open a page with manga images and swipe left on an image, or choose Translate Page from the Safari page menu. The text is detected and erased, and the translation is typeset into the speech bubbles. Swipe again to see the original.

ON YOUR DEVICE
• Manga text and bubble detection, Japanese OCR (manga-ocr) and LaMa inpainting run locally with Core ML.
• The app measures the CPU, GPU and Neural Engine on your device and uses the fastest one for each model.
• The models (about 330 MB) are downloaded once and can be removed at any time. Without them, the system's text recognition is used.

TRANSLATE YOUR WAY
• Apple Translation runs on your device, free and without an account (iOS 26 or later).
• Or use your own large language model with your own API key: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible service, including one on your local network.
• Only the recognized text is sent, only to the service you choose, and only after you agree.
• Source language is detected automatically: Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English and more. Translate into Simplified or Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German or Spanish.

FITS THE PAGE
• Translations are fitted to the shape of each bubble, horizontally or vertically like the original.
• Reading order follows the panels.

IN SAFARI
• Translate the whole page from the page menu, or swipe left on a single image.
• The floating ball can translate images automatically as you scroll, remembered per site.
• Long pages can be handed to the app, which keeps working in the background and returns you to Safari.

NEVER TWICE
• The same image, even a resized or re-compressed copy, is translated only once.
• Repeated sentences reuse earlier translations, so names stay consistent.
• Import saved pages from Photos or Files and translate them in the app.
• Sync settings and the translation cache with your own WebDAV server. API keys are encrypted before upload.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. The developer runs no servers and collects no data.

Translating Charm is a reading aid for personal use. Please respect the rights of the works you read.

name: Treasure Map World: Rockhound
description:
Scope: Austria only, for now. Sites in Japan are in a separate app, "Treasure Map Japan: Rockhound".

A map of candidate places along Austria's rivers and in its mountains where you may be able to pick up minerals, selected from ore deposit data and locality records in the scientific literature. It covers 8 minerals (placer gold, quartz, fluorite, lazulite and more) in 7 states, divided into 23 packs.

■ Based on open data and published papers
• Starting from GeoSphere Austria's ore deposit and locality data (MIN4EU) and localities recorded in papers published on ZOBODAT, candidate bands are traced along Austria's river network (GGN)
• Localities recorded only by the name of a mountain, pass or village are marked at that place (the record is from somewhere around it)
• Every band and marker shows the source it is based on (author, year, journal)

■ The rules, not hidden
• Each pack carries a level from checking the federal mining law, the state nature conservation laws and the national park laws (Contains prohibited zones / Check before you go / No prohibition in the sources checked), with links to the original legal texts (RIS)
• Zones where collecting is prohibited, such as national park core zones, are cut out of the bands, and packs with markers in such zones say so in their notes
• "No prohibition in the sources checked" does not mean collecting is allowed

■ Free to use
• Free sample packs: 1 (the same bands, sources and rules as the paid packs, on the map without buying)
• 8 hands-on facilities (tourist sites for gold panning or digging for garnets, and hot springs near gold localities; opening and on-site rules were checked against their official pages)
• Mineral field guide (identification, how each mineral forms, 8 photos)

■ In the field
• All candidate data is stored on your device, so bands, markers, sources and rules work with no signal
• Your records and your location are never sent anywhere
• Paid packs are one-time purchases (9 products, singles and bundles; no subscription)

■ Honestly
• This is a map of candidate sites; it does not guarantee a find
• The width of a band is not a field-checked ranking of how likely you are to find something

name: Ulluaso
description:
Problem: The plan says 9.5 mm and your tape is in inches.
Fix: FRACTIONS converts it, then snaps to the nearest mark on your rule. You pick how fine: 1/16″, 1/32″ or 1/64″. Type 1 3/8 or 0.375 and it understands either.

Problem: The caliper reads 0.136″ and you need the drill.
Fix: DRILLS searches fractional, letter, number and metric bits together. 0.1360″ is a #29 bit, 3.45 mm. Filter by series or browse the whole chart.

Problem: You're tapping a 1/4-20 hole.
Fix: The Shop Manual lists tap drills for UNC/UNF (about 75 % thread) and ISO metric coarse. 1/4-20 UNC wants a #7 bit, 0.2010″ or 5.11 mm.

Problem: A European cable is marked 2.5 mm² and your notes speak AWG.
Fix: WIRE converts AWG 0000 to 40 to diameter and cross-section, alongside IEC 60228 metric sizes.

Problem: "16 gauge" means different thicknesses for different metals.
Fix: SHEET gives it in inches and millimetres for steel, galvanized, aluminum and stainless, each from its own gauge standard.

Problem: You'll forget the sizes by the time you reach the hardware store.
Fix: Pin any reading to the Bench List, name the project ("Shed workbench") and pencil a note. Readings also land in the Shop Log.

Problem: Everyone wants a different number of decimals.
Fix: Bench Setup sets millimetre and inch places and how readings snap.

A note on wire: gauge size is not the same as safe current. The Shop Manual says so first. Follow your local electrical code.

Ulluaso works fully offline in the garage or on site. No account, no signal needed.

description:

Umytpa ("don't forget" in Kazakh) is two apps in one: a minimalist task tracker that gets you to every deadline, and a live countdown that shows how close your weekend is.

TRACKER: DEADLINES YOU WON'T MISS
• Add a task in seconds. Type it the way you say it: "Lab report tomorrow 18:00 #study".
• Categories, subtasks and repeats: daily, weekdays, weekly.
• A Today view with progress, overdue tasks and a weekly recap.
• Reminders before the deadline: 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 1 day, or your own time.
• An alarm at the deadline itself, with your own sound.
• Snooze for 10 minutes or mark done right from the notification.
• Focus timer, stats, streaks and badges to keep you going.

WEEK: THE FINISH LINE IS VISIBLE
• A glowing orb fills up as your week runs out. Tap it for a new line, from cheerful to a little sarcastic.
• Counts down to the next weekend, long weekend or public holiday in your country.
• Already off? The timer flips and counts down to the moment you're back at work.
• Weekend starts: confetti, a moment of glory and an award for the week you survived.
• Collect awards: your first Friday, a month without panic, a year of Fridays, Friday the 13th and more.
• Five-day week, shifts, night shifts or your own odd schedule. Vacation mode keeps your award streak safe.

YOUR VOICE
• Friendly, calm or strict-coach tone, with your name in the greetings.
• English, Russian and Kazakh.
• Light and dark themes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking. The only network request is loading public holidays for the country you choose.

Finish the day. Win the week. Download Umytpa.

name: UN-TIMER
description:
UN-TIMER è il timer per i tuoi workout, fatto da Alessio · UN-COACH. Gratis, senza account e senza pubblicità.

EMOM – Ogni 30, 45, 60, 90 secondi o quanto vuoi tu. Metti più intervalli in un giro (minuto 1 swing, minuto 2 burpees, minuto 3 recupero…) e scegli i round. Oppure Death EMOM: round infiniti finché non dici basta, con le ripetizioni che salgono a ogni giro.

AMRAP – Scegli il tempo, scrivi il workout e premi "+1 GIRO" a ogni giro. Alla fine segni anche cosa hai fatto del giro non finito.

AFAP – Scrivi gli esercizi con le ripetizioni (100 burpees, 50 swing…), segna man mano quante ne hai fatte e spunta quelli finiti. Time cap se vuoi.

HIIT – Lavoro e recupero per i round che vuoi. Puoi ripetere tutto più volte con un recupero tra le serie: 6 tabata di fila? Fatto.

In più:
• Voce in italiano e bip negli ultimi secondi
• Il coach che ti spinge nei momenti giusti ("Manca solo 'n giro, chiudilo!")
• La voce si sente anche col silenzioso e non ferma la tua musica
• Schermo sempre acceso durante il timer
• Salvi i tuoi timer preferiti
• Diario automatico: ogni workout con data, ora e risultato
• Funziona anche senza internet
• Su iPad: timer gigante in orizzontale

Vuoi allenamenti già pronti, con video e programmi? Scopri UN-MEMBER, l'app di Alessio · UN-COACH.

name: Undertones: Write Together
description:
Undertones is a quiet place to write about the day's text with the people closest to you.

Read the day's text, then write a few lines about it. Your family and close friends do the same, and everyone in your circle sees who has written today and how many days in a row you've kept it up together.

• One entry a day, shared with every circle you're in
• Your own streak and your circle's streak, with milestones at a week, two weeks, a month, 60 and 100 days, half a year and a year
• Several circles: family, friends from your congregation, anyone you invite
• Add the scripture you're thinking about, and if you like, the city you're writing from
• Reminders at the time you usually write, and a last call before midnight
• Past Days: a calendar of every day you've written, and what everyone wrote
• Your circle's own color, and your name and picture beside what you write

A day counts toward your streak when you write before midnight on your own clock. Missed one? You can still write about it later; it just won't count.

Private by design. There are no accounts to make and no servers of ours: circles are shared through iCloud, only between the people you invite. Nothing you write is ever sent to us.

Undertones doesn't include the day's text. The Read button opens it in JW Library or on jw.org. Undertones is an independent app and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by jw.org.

name: Unicorn Cat World
description:
Step into Unicorn Cat World, a soft, pastel world of fluffy unicorn cats!

Play as Rainbow Marshmallow, Cinnamon Toast or LilyMily and explore 50 cozy places across five districts:

• Rainbow Town: a cozy house, a bakery, a school, a toy shop, a pet shop and a café
• Fun District: a theme park, a water park, an aquarium, a zoo and a cinema
• Nature District: a magic forest, a butterfly garden, a beach, a treehouse and a crystal cave
• Royal District: a royal castle, a ballroom, a royal library, a treasure room and a royal stable
• Space District: a rocket station, a moon base, Queen Nova Starshine's palace and planets made of candy and crystal

Places open one by one, like levels: clear every activity in a place and the next one opens. Stuck? Coins you earn can skip a place.

Every place is full of things to do:
• Over 1,800 activities: bake, cook, paint, plant flowers, play music, care for pets and host tea parties
• Hundreds of hidden stars to find, and six baby unicorn cats to rescue
• Dress up with crowns, scarves and clips, and collect stickers and space helmets
• Gentle quests from friends, including Queen Nova Starshine, Queen of Space
• A friendly How to play guide that you can open any time

Finish all 50 places to open the Mystery Worlds: 24 more places under the sea, deep underground and in the snow.

Made for little hands and big imaginations:
• Free to play, with no in-app purchases
• No subscription, no ads, no timers and no loot boxes
• Works offline, with no account needed
• No chat and no data collection; progress is kept in your own iCloud
• Grown-up settings are protected by a parental gate

Created by Zainab Waqas, who dreamed up Unicorn Cat World.

name: Up and Down: Making Golf Easy
description:
Win Ugly. The Art of Short Game.

Up and Down helps you explore the shot on and around the green. Set the conditions, see an estimated line or landing area, and make the shot your own.

PUTTING
• Adjust distance, uphill or downhill slope, side slope, grain and green speed.
• See an estimated starting line and plays-like pace relative to the green speed you practise on.
• Read small aiming adjustments in cups or centimeters.
• Set your own step length and choose the distance units that feel natural.

CHIPPING
• Set the ball and hole relative to the green edge.
• Save the clubs in your bag, including irons, wedges from 46° to 60°, and a chipper.
• Get recommendations from your selected clubs, with short descriptions to help you choose.
• Account for the ball’s lie and a bunker between you and the green.
• Compare shot options and calibrate carry-to-roll ratios from your own practice chips.

AUTO SLOPE
Place your iPhone screen-up on the green, with its top pointing toward the cup. Auto uses the phone’s motion sensors to estimate the local slope. Calibrate on a known level surface to adjust for the camera bump or case. Lock the reading before lifting the phone, or use manual slope controls.

CAMERA DISTANCE
Hold to select the ground point at the ball, then the point beside the hole. Release to apply an approximate distance, up to 5 metres, in your preferred units. Requires a supported iPhone and camera permission; LiDAR improves surface validation where available. Manual distance is always available.

MADE FOR PRACTICE
Core calculations work offline. No account, advertising or tracking. Preferences and calibrations are stored on your device. Use simple reset controls to start another shot, or use the standard fields in Menu as an alternative to dragging.

Up and Down provides estimates for practice and planning. It does not measure the full surface between the ball and hole. Changing contours, strike, grass contact, bounce and spin can change the result. High-pitch landing guidance is illustrative; final rollout is not predicted. Follow the rules of your event when using measuring or advice tools.

Support: anton@qmail.ae

name: UR Planner
description:
UR Planner brings your day, your habits and your goals together in one calm place. Plan in the evening, do the work, tick it off — and watch your score and streak grow.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• Tasks and habits for today in one view, with a daily score and a streak
• Split bigger tasks into parts and tick them as you go
• Did something you hadn't planned? Add it as a bonus — it never lowers your score
• Close the day: decide what moves, what's done and what you learnt

HABITS THAT STICK
• Morning, midday and evening routines
• Habits with several ticks, like 8 glasses of water
• Choose the days a habit is due, skip a day without guilt

PLAN YOUR WEEK — AND BEYOND
• Your three most important things, commitments and a weekly challenge
• Week, month, quarter and year pages for the bigger picture
• Weekly review: the good, the bad, the lesson

GOALS BECOME PROJECTS
• Goals with projects and a backlog of tasks
• Progress bars that fill as you work

FOCUS AND TRAINING
• Focus timer with breaks
• Tabata interval timer
• Analytics: trends, best days, habits and focus minutes

YOUR WHOLE LIFE IN ONE APP
• Inbox, notes, journal, library, vision board, budget and travel plans

SMART AND PERSONAL
• A short welcome tour and examples to get started
• Ideas on every page that change as you go
• Repeat a task — like the doctor on the 30th — and UR Planner offers to plan it ahead
• Pin your favourite pages to the round menu
• 14 calm themes, light and dark mode
• English, German and Arabic (right to left)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no tracking
• Export all your data or delete your account at any time

Questions or ideas? Write to info@urplanner.de.

name: URCO
description:
URCO – Urban Connect, le covoiturage sécurisé, économique et communautaire.

VOYAGEZ EN CONFIANCE

RÉSERVEZ SIMPLEMENT

GÉREZ VOS TRAJETS
