Rejoignez la communauté URCO et rendez vos déplacements plus simples.

name: Urvesk
description:
Urvesk keeps your day simple. No points, streaks or badges. No ads. No account.

• Today: your plans for the day, one tap to complete
• Calendar: plan by date
• Routines: repeating plans
• Notes: plan notes and free notes
• Widget: see and tick your plans from the home screen
• Light, dark and green themes, plus your own colors
• 17 languages

Your data stays on your device.

name: USPTO Patent Bar Prep
description:
Prepare for the USPTO patent bar (the registration examination for patent agents and attorneys) with 900 real questions from past official exams, the USPTO's own model answers, and the full Manual of Patent Examining Procedure.

PRACTICE WITH REAL EXAM QUESTIONS
• 900 official questions from nine USPTO registration exams, 1999–2003
• Instant feedback with the official model answer for every question
• Timed mock exams: 50 questions in 3 hours, scored only when you submit, just like test day
• Retry missed questions until you master them
• Bookmarks and full-text search across every question

STUDY BY MPEP CHAPTER
• Every question is filed under the MPEP chapter its answer relies on
• See your mastery for each chapter and target your weak spots
• Hide questions that rely on pre-AIA law, so you focus on what today's exam tests

THE FULL, SEARCHABLE MPEP
• Every MPEP chapter and appendix, with clickable sections
• Old-school find with highlighted matches
• During timed exams, open the MPEP beside the question, just like the real test
• Find in MPEP: see where each question is answered, with the relevant passage highlighted

A PRIVATE AI COACH
• Ask why an answer is right, or why yours wasn't
• Explanations grounded in the MPEP text, with section citations
• Remembers your weak topics and quizzes you on questions you missed
• Runs entirely on your device with Apple Intelligence; nothing you ask leaves your iPhone or iPad
• Requires a device that supports Apple Intelligence

FREE TO START
The October 2003 exam is free. Patent Bar Pro unlocks every exam, mock exams, the MPEP, the AI coach, and review and search.

PATENT BAR PRO
• Lifetime: a one-time purchase
• Monthly: an auto-renewing subscription, with a free trial for new subscribers

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The monthly subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

Patent Bar Prep is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the United States Patent and Trademark Office. Exam questions and model answers are U.S. government works published by the USPTO. This app is for study purposes and is not legal advice.

name: VacLyn
description:
VacLyn er et professionelt værktøj til vakuumkontrol af termokopper og vakuumbeholdere. Registrér vakuum, lækagerate og kapacitet pr. enhed, og lad appen automatisk afgøre, om koppen må i kassen.

• Opret enhedsinspektioner med serienummer, batch, vakuumtryk (Pa), lækagerate, kapacitet (ml), temperatur og note
• Automatisk vurdering ud fra dine kvalitetsgrænser – mangelfulde enheder kasseres og isoleres
• Se historik med filtrering (alle / godkendt / kasseret) og søgning på serienummer eller batch

• Markér godkendte enheder som pakningsklare og bekræft, når de er pakket i kasse

• Gem inspektørprofil (navn, medarbejder-ID og vagtnote)

VacLyn sikrer en lukket arbejdsgang fra måling til vurdering, karantæne og pakning – så kopper uden isolation ikke kommer i kassen.

name: Vanish: Video Object Remover
description:
Remove people, objects and clutter from your videos — with one tap, right on your iPhone.

Vanish finds the object you tap, follows it through every frame, and rebuilds the background behind it. No masking frame by frame, no timeline gymnastics.

ON-DEVICE AND PRIVATE
• Every frame is processed on your iPhone with Apple's Neural Engine.
• Your videos are never uploaded. No account, no sign-in, no cloud.
• Removal works without an internet connection.

TAP ONCE, IT'S TRACKED
• Tap a person, a sign, a passer-by or a stray object.
• Vanish highlights it and follows it as it moves, even when the camera pans.
• Preview a frame before you commit.

CLEAN, NATURAL RESULTS
• The background is filled in frame by frame so the result stays steady.
• Save the finished video to Photos at its original resolution.

BUILT FOR LONG CLIPS
• Processing keeps going in the background.
• If it stops, Vanish continues where it left off.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Unfold to edit and preview side by side; fold to keep going on the cover display.

VANISH PRO
Selecting and previewing are free. Removing and saving a result needs Vanish Pro:
• Lifetime — pay once, yours forever.
• Weekly — auto-renewing subscription.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The weekly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

name: Vault Rings: Unlock Puzzle
seller_name: MAS SOFT YAZILIM TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Vault Rings is a calm, clever logic puzzle about steel rings locked together like a chain. Each ring has one gap. Turn the rings until every gap lines up, then watch them slide free one by one. Clear the board to crack the lock!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a ring to turn it 45° clockwise, or drag it to turn either way.
• A ring is free when its links are open at the gaps.
• Tap or flick a free ring to slide it off the board.
• Remove every ring before you run out of moves.

NEW TWISTS AS YOU GO
• Gears: geared rings turn their neighbour the other way
• Key and locks: locked rings stay shut until the gold key ring is out
• Pins: a ring's gap can never stop on its pin
• From 2 rings up to 9 interlocked rings

300 LEVELS, 30 VAULTS
Every level is a lock, and every 10 locks open a vault. Each vault hides a treasure card for your Treasure Album: crowns, coins, gems and relics across four rarities. Every level is checked by a solver, and solving it in the fewest moves earns all the stars.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Undo any turn
• Restart the board anytime
• A hint shows the next right move
• Out of moves? Get 5 more and keep going

THE DAILY VAULT
Crack a new vault every day, keep your streak going and share your result. Come back daily for free rewards.

Satisfying metal clicks and gentle vibration on every turn.

Vault Rings is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases. You can remove pop-up and banner ads with a one-time purchase.

Questions or ideas? Write to muranocrew@gmail.com

name: Vaultium Finlytica
description:
Some things are worth keeping. Their details are, too.

Vaultium Finlytica is your personal archive for warranties, receipt photos and service records. Keep the paperwork around the things you own in one thoughtful place, right on your iPhone. No account. No internet connection required. No tracking.

KEEP THE DETAILS
Save an item's purchase date, store, price, warranty length, model, serial number and notes. Organize electronics, appliances, furniture, vehicles, tools and other belongings into a collection that makes sense to you.

GIVE RECEIPTS A HOME
Attach up to four photos to each item. Choose photos from your library or take a picture of a receipt or product label. Open a saved photo for a closer look whenever you need it.

SEE THE TIME LEFT
View calculated warranty dates, a clear countdown and active, expiring or expired status. Find upcoming expiries with search and filters. Optional local notifications can remind you before a saved warranty ends.

KEEP THE SERVICE STORY
Record repairs, maintenance visits and useful notes by date. Keep model details, serial numbers and an optional service phone number beside the item they belong to.

UNDERSTAND YOUR COLLECTION
See item counts, category totals and the purchase values you have entered. Everything is calculated on your device.

CHOOSE YOUR LOOK
Enjoy warm paper tones, pine green, copper details and custom archive artwork. Switch between light, dark and system appearance. Subtle motion and tactile feedback bring a little life to everyday paperwork.

KEEP A COPY YOU CONTROL
Export your items and photos together in a backup file. Restore a compatible backup from your device when you need to move or recover your collection. Backups are created only when you choose to export them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your vault is stored locally. There are no user accounts, advertisements, analytics services or developer-operated cloud storage. Vaultium does not upload your collection. Device backups and files you choose to share remain under your control.

Warranty dates are calculated from the information you enter. Notification delivery depends on your permissions and device settings. Keep a backup before changing devices or removing the app.

Keep the details. Enjoy the things.

name: Vega Phone for Teams
description:
Vega Phone is the business phone for sales teams. Calls ring on your iPhone like any call, from your company's own local number, and your Salesforce record opens the moment you answer.

• Call and text from your business number, on iPhone and computer
• Calls ring on your lock screen, even when Vega is closed
• Voicemail with your own greeting, transcribed
• AI recap, action items and a scorecard after every call
• Your Salesforce card on every call, and search Salesforce to dial
• Group texts, picture messages, templates and smart "Needs reply"
• Voice memos written out as text
• STOP, opt-outs and consent handled automatically

Vega Phone is for companies with a Vega account. Your company admin sets up your login and number.

name: Vektor: Goal Vector & Drift
description:
Most knowledge workers do not suffer from lack of effort; they suffer from directional dispersion. In physics, velocity is a vector: magnitude multiplied by direction. If your daily actions are orthogonal to your strategic North Star, your effective output approaches zero regardless of exhaustion.

Vektor introduces classical vector mechanics to executive focus. By computing real-time angular deflection between daily tasks and your True North Anchor, Vektor quantifies true vector efficiency (E = cos θ × 100%) and shields deep flow from distracting tangents.

KEY FEATURES:

1. Gyroscopic Heading Dial
Interactive high-precision compass interface. Visualize active mission alignment, calibrate directional thrust, and log instant waypoints with a single tap.

2. Drift Shield Gatekeeper
Evaluate incoming meetings and side-quests against a 5-point deflection matrix before accepting them. Divert secondary noise to preserve unbroken momentum.

3. Multi-Axis Dynamics & Analytics
Monitor 7-day vector efficiency trends, track cumulative Vector Work Units (VWU), and analyze angular drift distribution across Grade A, B, and C spectrums.

4. Waypoint Ledger & Local Vault
Maintain a local ledger of all strategic decisions. Filter by category, inspect polar coordinates, and export full logs to JSON or CSV anytime.

5. Local On-Device Architecture
Designed with a privacy-focused foundation. Zero external server dependencies and zero account logins required. All computations run exclusively on device.

name: Veloce: 3D Social Shopping
description:
Veloce brings products to life with interactive 3D & 360° shopping, an AI Haggle Deal Agent that negotiates live discounts with you, and Snap & Find visual camera search.

WHY SHOP ON VELOCE?
• Interactive 3D & Video Feed: Swipe through an ultra-fast vertical feed of trending gadgets, home essentials, fitness gear, beauty tools, and lifestyle accessories.
• AI Haggle Deal Agent: Think the price should be lower? Open the live AI Haggle chat on any item and negotiate your own custom discount code in real time.
• Snap & Find Visual Search: Point your camera at any gadget or upload a photo—Veloce's AI Vision matches it to the closest item in our catalog in seconds.
• Smart For-You Personalization: Veloce learns your style as you browse, heart, and shop to curate a personalized feed tailored to your taste.
• Fast, Tracked US Delivery & Buyer Protection: Secure checkout powered by Stripe, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, with real-time order tracking from warehouse to your doorstep.

name: Venthread
description:
The circuit is connected. Can the pulse reach the gate while it's open? In Venthread, you tune throttles and program relays to route signals, meet tight arrival windows, and keep pressure in range.

• Catch the opening. Time pulses to pass through scheduled gates or stop specific bursts. Can you let only the second of three pulses reach the outlet?
• Shape the pressure trace. Keep a node quiet, bring it up to working pressure on cue, and let it cool before the next burst. Route two branches so they charge in turn.
• Diagnose hidden faults. Investigate 16 incidents across four case files. A late receiver might point to a delayed source or a tight throttle. Choose probes that separate the suspects and try to solve each case with fewer readings.
• Replay and refine. Scrub through a run to see where each pulse went, which gate stopped it, and when pressure left its target. Compare layouts and measurements in the Logbook.
• Build your own puzzles. Experiment in Free Workshop. In Design Studio, add closures, supply changes, or silent outlets, then verify and save a private challenge to rebuild later.

Start with 36 campaign levels, then explore offline daily challenges and specialist labs. Revisit puzzles to find a leaner route or earn mastery medals.

Play solo and offline. Progress and custom puzzles are stored on your device. No ads, in-app purchases, or account required. Airflow and pressure follow fictional game rules.

name: Verse Memorizer by RedWord
description:
Learn it by heart.

Find a Bible verse from the words you remember, add it to your list, and practice it until you can say it without looking.

- Find the verse. Type the part you remember, however loosely, or its reference, and the passage shows up.
- Type the first letters. Type the first letter of each word, then the reference. Seven steps take you from the whole verse on screen to typing it from memory, and each verse on your list keeps the step it is on.
- Say it out loud. A card shows the reference. Record yourself saying the verse, flip the card, and hear it back against the text. The recording is never saved or sent.
- Finish the last step with every word right, and the verse is written on a heart.
- Choose your translation: ESV, NLT, KJV or BSB.
- Export your list of references, or read a verse with the verses around it in Verse Finder.

Your list stays on your phone. Only your search, or a verse's reference, is sent to find a verse, and only after you agree. There are no accounts and no ads, and nothing tracks you.

name: VEYA -Design yours unique
description:
A bracelet, composed by you.

VEYA brings bracelet design and a curated jewellery shop into one place. Explore bead materials and colours, arrange your own design, and discover pieces that suit your personal style.

DESIGN AT YOUR OWN PACE
Choose beads and accessories, see your arrangement on the canvas, and adjust it as you go. Switch between single and double strand designs and set your preferred wrist size.

FIND YOUR NEXT IDEA
Browse bracelet designs in the gallery, explore the details, and use the collection as a starting point for your own creativity.

EXPLORE THE BOUTIQUE
Discover finished bracelets with product photography, prices and descriptions. Keep your favourite ideas close and review your selection in your bag.

YOUR DESIGNS, YOUR ACCOUNT
Start browsing and designing as a guest. Sign in with email to access account features, saved designs and orders. English and Simplified Chinese interfaces are available.

VEYA sells physical jewellery. Product availability, prices, delivery options and checkout depend on the selected destination and the live store. Jewellery descriptions are for style and material information and do not provide medical advice.

Questions? Visit veyastone.com/contact or email support@veyastone.com.

name: Viaduct: File Transfer
description:
Viaduct sends photos, videos and files directly between your devices — iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows PC and Meta Quest. No cloud, no account, no size limits.

FAST, LOCAL, PRIVATE
• Transfers go straight from device to device over your home Wi-Fi.
• Hundreds of photos in seconds, large videos at full speed.
• Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Every transfer is end-to-end encrypted.
• The first time two devices connect, both show the same code so you know it's really them.

SAVES RIGHT INTO PHOTOS
• Photos and videos you receive go straight into your Photos library.
• Other files are kept in the Files app, ready to open.

WORKS OUTSIDE, TOO
• No Wi-Fi? Phones find each other nearby and switch to a direct Wi-Fi link for fast transfers.
• iPhone to iPhone works anywhere, even without a network.

MADE FOR MIXED HOMES
• iPhone ⇄ Android, phone ⇄ Mac/PC, phone ⇄ Meta Quest — all in one app.
• Pick from recent photos, filter by images, videos or screenshots, or send whole folders.
• Long-press a photo to preview it before sending.

No ads. No sign-up. Just send.

name: Viavista: Motorcycle Trips
description:
Viavista plans your motorcycle trip day by day, with the cost of your own bike.

Pick one of 20 ready-made roads, 10 in the USA and 10 in Brazil, enter your bike's mileage and tank size, and see:
• how many miles and hours each day has, and when you arrive;
• the trip cost: your bike's fuel, tolls, lodging and food, per day and in total;
• a warning for long stretches with no gas, based on the bike in your group with the shortest range;
• places to stay at every overnight, with phone numbers where available, so you can ask for the price yourself.

RIDING WITH A GROUP?
Set how many bikes, how many people per room and whether you carry a passenger. The app splits lodging by room and shows the cost per person. One tap turns the plan into an image for your group: whoever gets it doesn't need the app.

ON THE ROAD
Viavista is not a GPS: it opens Google Maps or Waze to the day's destination and takes care of the rest. Confirm each cost with one tap, add extras and see what's left. Everything is saved on your phone and works offline. Family at home can follow along with the family link: it only shows the departures and arrivals you tap, with no tracking.

FREE AND PAID
Free: all 20 routes, the cost range, the no-gas warning, the budget and costs, GPX, the group image, the family link and the trip card with the brand.
Paid, per trip or with the 12-month plan: towns to fuel up, places to stay and stops for each day, editing stops and changing overnights, the sunset alert and cards without the brand. No auto-renewal and no sign-up.

WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM
Gas: EIA in the USA and ANP in Brazil, with the date on screen. Tolls checked route by route. Lodging and food are estimates until you enter the agreed price. We have not verified these roads: check conditions before you leave.

name: Virtual Recorder 7Keys
description:
Practice recorder fingering anywhere - no recorder, no sound needed.

Place your device sideways and press the 7 finger holes and the thumb hole on the screen with both hands. The score scrolls by, and when a note reaches the red line, cover the right holes to hear the recorder play.

■ Who it's for
- Students learning the recorder at school, and their parents
- Beginners still learning recorder fingerings
- Anyone who wants to practice anywhere without an instrument

■ Features
- Fingering hints: the holes to press light up in yellow ahead of time
- Automatic thumb hole, half holes and double holes
- German fingering for soprano recorder
- Note names, count-in and metronome
- Tempo control and loop practice
- Judging levels: BEGINNER / NORMAL
- Two layouts (desk / hold) and 5 skins

■ Practice results
When a song ends, you see your results:
- Accuracy and best streak
- PERFECT, GOOD and FAILED counts
- Timing tendency (early or late)
- Bars to review and why notes were missed

■ Songs
Classical, K-pop, pop, OST, animation and children's songs, plus scales - made from Soundpost recorder sheet music. New songs are added regularly.

■ Privacy
No sign-up or login. No microphone or location permissions.

Made by overN

name: Virtual Trumpet 3Keys
description:
Practice trumpet fingering anywhere - no trumpet, no sound needed.

Press valves 1, 2 and 3 on the screen with your right index, middle and ring fingers. The score scrolls by, and when a note reaches the red line, press the right valves to hear the trumpet play.

■ Who it's for
- Beginners still learning trumpet fingerings
- Players who want to practice on the commute without an instrument
- Anyone who wants to learn the fingerings of a new piece before playing it

■ Features
- Fingering hints: circles above the red line show which valves to press
- Note names, count-in and metronome
- Tempo control and loop practice
- Judging levels: BEGINNER / NORMAL
- Accompaniment sounds (piano, strings and more)

■ Practice results
When a song ends, you see your results:
- Accuracy and best streak
- PERFECT, GOOD and FAILED counts
- Timing tendency (early or late)
- Bars to review and why notes were missed

■ Songs
Classical, K-pop, pop, OST, animation and more, plus scales - made from Soundpost trumpet sheet music. New songs are added regularly.

■ Privacy
No sign-up or login. No microphone or location permissions.

Made by overN

name: Vita Meow
description:
Vita Meow is calm mahjong solitaire where every tile is a cat.

Tap two matching cats to send them home together, and clear the board one pair at a time. There are no timers and no pressure. Take a breath, find the next pair, and watch the board open up.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a free cat, then tap its twin. A cat is free when nothing sits on top of it and one side is open.
• Clear the board to win the level.
• Stuck? Use a Hint, Undo or Shuffle.

300 LEVELS, 20 CHAPTERS
Each chapter brings new boards and a new twist: sleeping cats, a locked pair, foggy tiles, frost, a mirror board and the cat basket. The rules arrive one at a time, so the game stays easy to learn and fun to master.

ADOPT A HOUSE FULL OF CATS
Collect 30 cats, each with its own look and personality. Bring up to three companions into a level and their abilities help you along.

DECORATE THEIR HOME
Earn Treats by clearing levels and spend them on beds, toys and scratching trees. Arrange three rooms the way your cats like them.

A NEW BOARD EVERY DAY
Play the daily challenge for extra rewards and come back tomorrow for a new one.

MADE TO BE COMFORTABLE
• Large and extra-large tile sizes, high-contrast tiles and reduced motion.
• One-handed mode.
• Plays offline.
• English and Turkish.

Every cat can be earned by playing. Optional Catnip packs are available as in-app purchases.

name: VocalK
description:
Turn your iPhone into a wireless karaoke microphone for your Mac—with no extra hardware, receivers, or tangled cables.

VocalK pairs your iPhone with the free VocalK desktop app on macOS over your home Wi-Fi network, streaming crisp vocal audio straight to your Mac and connected speakers with sub-40ms latency.

KEY FEATURES
• Instant QR Pairing: Open VocalK on your Mac, point your iPhone camera at the room QR code, and start singing in seconds—or join manually via nearby Mac auto-discovery and room PIN.
• Dual-Singer Ready: Connect up to two iPhones simultaneously to the same Mac host for duets with independent microphone levels.
• Adjustable Voice Boost: Dial in natural sound or add up to +24 dB of clean vocal gain right from your iPhone screen.
• Companion Playback Controls: Pause, resume, or skip tracks playing on your Mac without leaving the couch.
• Built-In Acoustic Guidance: Simple first-use mic holding tips help keep vocals clear and minimize speaker feedback.
• 100% Private & Local: Audio streams strictly peer-to-peer across your personal Wi-Fi network using encrypted DTLS UDP. Zero accounts, zero cloud servers, and zero audio recording.

REQUIREMENTS
• Requires the free VocalK companion host app for macOS (macOS 15.1 or later), available for download at https://vocalk.vercel.app.
• Both your iPhone and Mac must be connected to the same local Wi-Fi network.

name: VOID DRIFTER - 宇宙シューティング
description:
エイリアンが太陽を「ダイソン球」で覆おうとしている――。
宇宙を漂流しながら敵を倒し、装備を集めて強くなる、ローグライト・シューティングです。

■ かんたん操作
・画面の下半分をなぞって移動、上半分を左右になぞって旋回
・前進と攻撃は自動。片手でも遊べます

■ 装備を集めて強くなる
・倒した敵から、武器・防具・シールド・エンジンなどの装備がドロップ
・レア度の高い装備ほど強力。いらない装備は分解して素材に
・一時停止中や母艦で、いつでも装備を付け替えられます

■ エリアを攻略
・各エリアのボスを倒すとステージクリア
・ステージクリアで自動セーブ。続きから遊べます

■ ハイスコアランキング
・ランキング名を設定すると、スコアがランキングに載ります（任意）

■ 日本語・英語に対応

■ 料金
・すべての機能を無料で遊べます（ゲームオーバー時に広告が表示されます）
・「広告を非表示にする」（買い切り）を購入すると、広告が表示されなくなります

プライバシーポリシー・サポート：
https://work.sano.shop/spacehack/privacy.html

name: VoL Broadcast
description:
VoL Broadcast is the sender app for Voice of Leader (VoL), a closed-group voice announcement service for hospitals, schools, malls, factories and teams.

Authorised leaders and staff speak once, and the announcement rings on the phones of the members they choose, live, with the voice heard as it is spoken.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Hold the button and speak. Your voice goes live to the selected groups.
• Pick groups, sub-groups or individual people before you go live.
• Send an Emergency broadcast with ready-made templates for your industry.
• Watch the live counter of how many people have heard you, and see who is listening.
• Review past broadcasts and see who heard, who missed and who was off duty. Resend to people who missed it.
• Manage groups, staff roles and member requests, and approve or reject who joins.
• Share a group's QR code so members can join and wait for your approval.
• Check your remaining minutes, monthly reports and the activity log.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Only approved members receive your announcements. Each organisation has its own groups and roles (Master Admin, Group Admin and Staff), and every action is recorded in an activity log.

HOW TO GET STARTED
Your organisation's administrator adds your mobile number. Sign in with that number and a one-time code. Members receive announcements in the separate VoL app.

VoL Broadcast needs a Voice of Leader organisation account. Accounts are set up by your organisation, outside the app.

Support: https://voiceofleader.com

name: Vpanel Tech
description:
Vpanel Tech es la app móvil de gestión técnica para operaciones en campo de vConexion.

Permite a técnicos y supervisores trabajar con órdenes de trabajo, evidencias y comunicación con el NOC desde el dispositivo.

Funcionalidades principales:
• Gestión de órdenes: instalaciones, traslados, retiros y actividades técnicas
• Mapa operativo con ubicación para trabajo en campo
• Notificaciones push de nuevas asignaciones y avisos del equipo
• Mensajería interna entre técnicos y el NOC
• Acceso seguro con autenticación biométrica (Face ID / Touch ID)
• Soporte multi-sede con control de acceso por rol
• Captura de evidencias con cámara, fotos y reportes técnicos

Esta aplicación está pensada para el personal autorizado de empresas que operan con la plataforma Vpanel / vConexion. Se requiere cuenta corporativa para iniciar sesión.

Para soporte técnico, contacta a tu administrador o al equipo de vConexion.

name: Vrocpoqeybu
description:
Vrocpoqeybu: 빛의 탭은 미니멀한 타이밍 반사신경 게임입니다.

화면 곳곳에 빛이 나타나고, 각 빛을 둘러싼 링이 점점 좁혀집니다. 링이 빛과 겹치는 바로 그 순간, 빛을 터치하세요.

게임 방법
• 링이 빛과 겹칠 때 그 빛을 터치하세요
• 정확히 맞히면 3점, 조금 빗나가면 1점
• 너무 일찍 터치하거나 빛을 놓치면 생명이 하나 줄어듭니다
• 생명 세 개를 모두 잃으면 게임 오버
• 8번 맞힐 때마다 레벨 업: 링이 더 빨리 좁혀지고 빛이 더 작아지며 더 자주 나타납니다

특징
• 점수, 생명, 시간을 한눈에 확인
• 최고 기록 10개를 막대 그래프로 보여 주는 기록 보기
• 성공할 때마다 짧은 진동 (끌 수 있음)
• 앱을 벗어나면 자동 일시정지
• 깊은 밤하늘과 네온 블루의 깔끔한 디자인

간단하고 안전하게
광고 없음, 인앱 구매 없음, 계정 필요 없음. 이 게임은 데이터를 수집하지 않으며 오프라인에서 플레이할 수 있습니다.

name: WaChat2PDF – Chat Export PDF
description:
WaChat2PDF turns your exported WhatsApp chats into clean, readable PDF and HTML documents. Everything is created on your iPhone or iPad, and your chats never leave your device.

Use it to keep business records, prepare documents for a lawyer or court, or save years of family memories.

HOW IT WORKS
1. In WhatsApp, open a chat, tap the contact or group name, then Export Chat.
2. Choose Attach Media to keep photos and files, then pick WaChat2PDF in the share sheet. You can also import a .zip or .txt from Files.
3. Read the chat, choose your options and tap Export.

PDFS THAT LOOK LIKE THE CHAT
• Chat bubbles with names, dates and times
• Choose the Standard design or the iPhone bubble design
• Photos inside the PDF, with clear cards for voice notes, videos and documents
• First-page thumbnails for PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files
• See the first page before you export
• Large chats are split into PDFs by month automatically
• HTML export: one searchable page with photos embedded

EVIDENCE LOG AND COURT TRANSCRIPT STYLES
• Evidence Log: every message as a numbered entry with its timestamp, sender and attachments
• Court Transcript: a plain text layout, organized by date
• Optional SHA-256 fingerprints of the attachments and the original export file
Whether a document is accepted depends on your court and local rules, so check with your lawyer. WaChat2PDF does not give legal advice.

READ AND FIND ANYTHING
• A familiar chat view in light and dark mode, even for chats with tens of thousands of messages
• Play voice notes, view photos and videos, and open documents right in the chat
• Search that jumps from match to match
• Filter by people, a day or a date range, and message types, or jump to any date
• Choose whose messages appear on the right
• On iPad, your chats and the open chat side by side

EXPORT ONLY WHAT YOU NEED
• Export all messages, one month or a date range
• Filter by sender or export media messages only
• Choose the photo quality

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your messages, names and media are read and stored only on your device, and are never uploaded
• PDFs are created on your device
• No account needed
The app sends a small amount of technical information, such as a hashed device identifier, a hash of the chat for the free plan, and message counts. See the Privacy Policy for details.

FREE TO START
Export the latest 100 messages of up to 3 different chats on this device, in the chat-bubble style.

UNLIMITED
Unlimited exports with no message limit, Evidence Log and Court Transcript PDFs, and every filter.
• Yearly: auto-renewing subscription, billed once a year

The subscription is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current year. Manage or cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://wachat2pdf.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The app is in English. WaChat2PDF is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc. WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC.

name: Waiting Paws
description:
Waiting Paws makes separation training with your dog calm and precise.

Paste the schedule your trainer sent, check the exits and start. Two big buttons, the same on iPhone and Mac: Outside or Back inside, and False start. The app counts every exit and break, shows only what matters right now — the plan of this exit, or the next one during a break — and a break that runs long turns yellow and counts up. Spotted a mistake in the schedule mid-training? Fix it right there.

• Schedules from your trainer: exits, durations, "or until the dog stands up", breaks after a particular exit or for all of them
• Exit and break timers with an overrun warning
• Live camera while you are behind the door: Xiaomi (Mi Home) cameras or any RTSP or HTTP stream (ONVIF cameras by their RTSP address)
• Video recording of the training, saved with sound and ready to share
• A text log for the trainer, one line per attempt, in the trainer's own notation
• History of trainings and videos
• iPhone and Mac together: the iPhone shows the Mac's camera and drives the same training
• Works without a camera too

Your data stays on your devices: no Waiting Paws account, no analytics, no tracking.

name: WakeForge: No Snooze Alarm
description:
Most alarms fail at the only moment that matters: the moment you decide to go back to sleep. WakeForge removes that decision. Your alarm keeps going until a morning task is verified, and then it stops for good.

Five ways to earn your morning, from fitness reps to photo proof:
- Push-ups counted live by the front camera with on-device Vision. Nothing is uploaded, and half-hearted reps do not count.
- Squats with the same on-device pose counting, so your legs share the work.
- Photo proof for anyone who does not want a workout: the sky through your window, a watered plant, a made bed. Cloud verification judges the scene tolerantly, and the photo is deleted seconds later.
- Step goal verified through HealthKit using today's step count.
- A 30-second mental challenge, generated on device, for mornings when your body says no.

Reliability is the promise, not a feature:
- Every task family has a three-level fallback: retry guidance, switch to another task, then a 90-second cool-down.
- Your alarm always turns off. It never traps you, and it never waits on a network.
- If a physical button stops the alarm early, the app remembers and asks you to finish the task next time you open it.

Built for the morning, not the gym:
- AlarmKit alarms break through Focus and Silent mode, with repeat days and an optional backup alarm two minutes later. Tapping Rise and Fight on the lock screen opens the task screen instantly.
- Free tier: three wakes every week, with every task type available. No trial tricks.
- Streak flame, best streak, weekly report, and milestones. Your lifetime reps add up to something you can brag about.
- Morning Chain: after you earn the morning, three small follow-through steps turn waking up into a routine.
- Share your streak card when you want the extra push.

Heavy sleeper? Bouncing off alarm clock apps is usually an accountability problem, not a willpower problem. WakeForge turns every morning mission into a real commitment: the countdown never lies, the fallback chain never traps you, and the habit you build is yours.

Pro unlocks unlimited wakes, the full cloud photo check quota, custom sounds, and the backup alarm. Prefer your own AI provider? Add your own API key in Settings and cloud checks become unlimited.

Privacy by architecture:
- Camera frames are analyzed on this device and never leave it.
- Photos stay in memory, are compressed under one megabyte, and are discarded ten seconds after verification.
- No account is required, and the app does not track you.

WakeForge is a morning discipline tool, not a medical or weight-loss product. It makes no health claims and gives no medical advice.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

AI FEATURES:
- This app uses your own API key for optional cloud AI features. You can bring a key from any compatible provider.
- AI features are unlimited with your own key, with no usage limits and no in-app token purchases.
- Your API key is stored securely on your device and is never sent to our servers.

HEALTHKIT:
- Step tasks read today's step count from Apple Health through HealthKit. WakeForge never writes health data.

Download WakeForge and earn your next morning.

name: Walkthrough .usdz Model
description:
Walkthrough .usdz Model lets you experience any 3D designs the way they're meant to be experience them: life-size, all around you, in your own space.

Open any .usdz or Reality file from the Files app, or start with the sample model that's included. Buildings, interiors, landscapes and other spatial designs appear at real-world scale, so you get a true sense of proportions, heights and distances that's hard to get from a screen.

CHOOSE WHERE TO START
See your whole model shrunk onto a 1 m × 1 m tabletop preview. Pinch the blue marker and drag it across the model: it follows floors and surfaces and climbs steps as you move it. Place it in a doorway, on a balcony or at the top of the stairs, then select it to begin your walkthrough from that exact spot.

WALK THROUGH YOUR DESIGN
• Walk around for real, or use the on-screen movement pad to travel further. Forward is always wherever you're looking.
• Adjust walking speed from a gentle stroll to a quick 5 m/s.
• Turn smoothly with the rotation control.
• Follow the ground: walk up stairs and ramps and step between levels automatically.
• Or switch ground following off and rise or descend freely to view your design from above.
• Jump back to your starting point at any time.

SEE IT IN THE RIGHT LIGHT
Replace your room with an open sky and ground, and light your model by the sun. Move the time-of-day slider to see how sunlight and shadows fall across your design from morning to evening, watch the sunset, and see the stars come out at night. Or turn the sky off to see your model in your own room.

FIX THE SCALE
Models exported with the wrong units can appear far too large or too small. The scale slider corrects this smoothly, anywhere from 100:1 to 1:100, and shows the model's resulting width, height and depth in metres.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your models stay on your device. The app works entirely offline and collects no data.

Ideal for architects, interior designers, landscape designers, 3D artists, students and anyone who wants to step inside a design before it's built.

name: WallStudies
description:
WallStudies is an offline reference for planning what goes on a wall. It brings display types, mounting methods, layout studies, and a short handbook together with a measured layout studio, so you can compare ideas and shape a wall plan on your iPhone.

Browse display formats, from a single frame to a dense gallery wall, and read how each one uses proportion, weight, density, and empty space. Look through mounting methods by surface, visibility, and typical limits. A finder compares those methods against criteria you choose and explains the comparison. It offers editorial guidance only. It is not an installation certificate, and the right hardware still depends on the product, the wall, and the manufacturer’s instructions.

Study layout arrangements for alignment, rhythm, grouping, and sightlines, then open any layout in Layout Studio. Set the wall size in centimeters or inches, place frames and shelves, snap to a grid, and check spacing and balance with the numbers in front of you. Save the result as a project, duplicate it, or start again from a template. Compare up to three displays, methods, layouts, or projects side by side.

Favorites, collections, notes, tags, and browsing history stay on the device. Export a project as a PNG or PDF, and back up or restore your personal data whenever you want. WallStudies does not require an account or a network connection.

name: Walltank Mobile
description:
Keep a little underwater world close. Walltank brings 16 animated pixel-art aquariums to your iPhone, from grand ocean habitats to cozy home tanks. Every aquarium is included in the app.

Watch the fish, tap to feed them, and wipe the glass in home aquariums. Choose an immersive water view or a framed landscape view. On iPhone Duo, the aquarium adapts as you open or close the display. Your chosen scene and viewing allowance stay with you.

Start with 60 watermark-free viewing minutes. Optional rewarded ads add another hour or unlock a change of aquarium. When the allowance ends, the scene dims and a floating watermark appears. A single non-consumable purchase removes all ads, the watermark and the time limit across every aquarium. Restore your purchase using the same Apple Account.

16 interface languages. All aquarium art is bundled; ads and purchases require an internet connection. Walltank is an in-app aquarium viewer and does not animate your iOS Lock Screen.

name: WamStaff
description:
WamStaff est l’application des employés terrain des entreprises qui utilisent la plateforme WamStaff (horaires, pointage et paie). Votre compte est créé par votre employeur : connectez-vous avec le courriel et le mot de passe qu’il vous a remis.

MA JOURNÉE
• Voyez votre quart d’aujourd’hui, le lieu et l’heure.
• Maintenez le gros bouton une demi-seconde pour commencer, prendre une pause, reprendre ou terminer.
• Plusieurs quarts dans la journée ? Choisissez simplement le bon.

POINTAGE SIMPLE ET JUSTE
• Un selfie confirme votre arrivée.
• Votre position est lue une seule fois, au moment où vous pointez, pour vérifier que vous êtes au bon endroit. Aucun suivi en arrière-plan.
• Pas de réseau ? Le pointage est gardé sur le téléphone et envoyé dès que la connexion revient.

FIN DE QUART
• Trois questions rapides (incident, produits manquants, commentaire).
• Les photos demandées par votre employeur, prises directement avec la caméra.

HORAIRE ET MESSAGES
• Vos quarts des deux prochaines semaines et vos heures de la semaine.
• Écrivez à votre gestionnaire ou à vos collègues.

AIDE
• Assistant Wam vous guide si un pointage bloque (GPS, caméra, réseau).

Conçu au Québec, en français.

name: WAO PR
description:
WAO turns your phone into your business phone. Take and make calls with your business number, see who is calling before you answer, and transfer the call to your team in one tap.

CALLS WITH YOUR BUSINESS NUMBER
• Calls ring like a normal phone call, with the caller's name.
• Call from the keypad or from your appointments: your business number shows up and your personal number stays private.
• Mute, speaker, hold (with music) and notes during the call.

KNOW WHO IS CALLING
• The customer's profile during the call: open deals, next appointment and last message.
• Recent calls and upcoming appointments on the home screen.

TRANSFER THE CALL
• To a teammate who has the app or the Panel open, to a cell phone or to your AI assistant.
• «Announce first» to talk to your teammate before you transfer.

YOUR WAO PANEL INSIDE
• WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email and website chats in one place.
• Contacts and sales pipeline with each customer's full history.

YOU DECIDE WHEN IT RINGS
• «Receive calls» on this phone, only during your business hours, how long to wait before your assistant takes the call, and whether calls are recorded.

In Spanish and English, with light and dark themes.

The app is for businesses that have WAO Phone (waopr.com). WAO gives you your account; the app has no in-app purchases.

name: Wasteline
description:
Wasteline est un jeu de tir à la première personne sur mobile. Préparez votre équipement, retrouvez votre équipe et prenez part à des affrontements tactiques en 5 contre 5.

COMBAT EN ÉQUIPE
Coordonnez vos déplacements, couvrez vos alliés et adaptez votre stratégie à la carte et aux objectifs de la partie. Entraînez-vous contre des bots pour prendre vos repères et affiner votre visée.

VOTRE ARSENAL
Découvrez les armes, choisissez votre équipement et personnalisez votre inventaire avec des éléments cosmétiques. Retrouvez votre progression et vos statistiques dans votre profil.

JOUEZ ENSEMBLE
Ajoutez vos amis, formez un groupe et utilisez les fonctionnalités sociales du jeu pour préparer vos prochaines parties.

Une connexion Internet et un compte Wasteline sont nécessaires. Le jeu propose des achats intégrés facultatifs de monnaie virtuelle.

Assistance : https://wasteline-confidentialite.lemonylute8.chatgpt.site/assistance/
Confidentialité : https://wasteline-confidentialite.lemonylute8.chatgpt.site/confidentialite/
Conditions d’utilisation : https://wasteline-confidentialite.lemonylute8.chatgpt.site/conditions/

name: WatchWeeks: Watch Event Guide
description:
Find your next watch event with WatchWeeks, an independent guide for enthusiasts. Explore city guides, browse fairs and venues, discover participating brands, and see new watch releases where available.

- Plan your Singapore fair visits around opening hours and travel time.
- Shortlist brands, rate your interest and keep track of the brands you've seen.
- Browse previously loaded guides and your checklist offline.
- Share guide links and copy your itinerary.

No account is required. Your personal selections stay on your device. Event schedules may change, so confirm important details with the organizer. WatchWeeks is independent of the listed events and brands.

name: Wattime: Electricity Price Now
description:
When is electricity cheapest today? Wattime shows dynamic electricity prices for today and tomorrow, in 15-minute or hourly steps, and tells you the best time to run the washing machine, the dishwasher or charge your EV.

YOUR MARKET
• Spain: regulated PVPC tariff (Peninsula, Balearic Islands, Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla) with taxes included, plus the wholesale price for indexed tariffs
• Portugal: OMIE wholesale price
• France: day-ahead spot price, and today's and tomorrow's colour for EDF's Tempo option, with days left per colour
• UK: compatible with Octopus Agile tariffs, 14 regions
• Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium and Poland: spot prices for dynamic tariffs
• Denmark (DK1/DK2), Sweden (SE1–SE4), Norway (NO1–NO5) and Finland

FREE FOREVER
• Today's and tomorrow's prices as soon as they're published
• Chart in 15-minute or hourly steps
• Current price marked cheap, normal or expensive, with an icon and text (color-blind friendly)
• Countdown to the next cheap hour
• The best 1, 2 or 3-hour window and how much you save compared with now
• Small Home Screen widget, also in StandBy and CarPlay
• One daily notification with tomorrow's cheapest hours
• Data from official and open sources, with automatic fallback

WATTIME PRO
• Lock Screen widgets, plus medium and large widgets
• Live Activity counting down to the cheap window, on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• An alarm that rings even in silent mode, so you start the washing machine on time
• Appliance planner: washer, dishwasher, dryer, oven, water heater and your own appliances, with a "must be done by" time
• EV charging planner: the cheapest hours before you leave and the total cost

Wattime Pro is available as a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial, or as a low-cost one-time lifetime purchase. Available in 13 languages.

name: Wayloom: Holiday Planner
description:
Wayloom keeps every part of your holiday in one place, without typing it all in.

IMPORT, WE SORT IT
Share or upload a booking email, a PDF ticket, a Wallet pass, a calendar file or a screenshot. Wayloom reads it on your iPhone and sorts it into flights, hotels, parking, car hire, restaurants, activities and transfers. You check it, then add it to your trip.

WHAT YOU GET
- One plan for the whole trip, in date order
- Tags on every booking: Flight, Hotel, Parking, Activity, Restaurant, Car hire, Transport
- Booking numbers, times, addresses and phone numbers kept together
- Apple Maps checks hotel and venue names and fills in the address, and suggests places as you type
- Pick airports from a built-in list (works offline), with airline names filled in
- Weather for each day, with highs, lows and conditions
- Reminders you choose: check-in 24 hours before a flight, airport time, the evening before a stay
- Swipe to mark paid, send, or delete (with Undo)
- Several trips, with archive
- Add your trip to Calendar in a calendar called Wayloom
- Light, dark or match your phone, with large text supported

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no Wayloom account and no Wayloom server. Your trips are saved on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. Bookings are read on the device. Nothing is sold or used for advertising.

Wayloom reads common layouts in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch. Always check what it found before you add it: some documents are unusual, and you stay in control.

Weather data: Apple Weather.

name: Web7 Digitall
description:
The Web7 Digitall app brings your software project together in one place.

For clients
• Project: the current stage, the contracted dates and the sprint timeline, with each sprint's update.
• Needs you: what is waiting on you, like replying to a ticket, testing a version or signing a document.
• Support: open tickets, talk to the team and follow the response time.
• Finance: open invoices, due dates and what has been paid.
• Notifications: alerts on your phone when something changes in your project.
• Documents, delivery reviews and signatures open in a secure window inside the app.

Not a client yet?
Create your account, take the free diagnostic about your idea and book a conversation with Web7. After the meeting, your project shows up in the app.

Privacy
You can ask for your account to be deleted right in the app. The Privacy Policy explains how we handle your data.

Existing clients sign in with the same account as the web7digitall.app portal.

name: WebChecker: Domain Monitor
description:
WebChecker watches your domains, SSL certificates and websites around the clock and alerts you before small problems become outages.

DOMAIN EXPIRATION
• Expiration date, registrar and status from official RDAP registries
• Reminders before the domain expires, plus alerts for transfer locks removed, DNSSEC disabled, registrar or nameserver changes and critical statuses (pending delete, redemption, hold)

SSL CERTIFICATES
• Monitor the certificate of your domain, www and any subdomain (api, shop, mail…)
• Alerts for expiring, expired, invalid or untrusted certificates and for renewals

UPTIME
• HTTPS checks of every monitored host
• Instant alert when a site goes down and again when it is back, with downtime duration

DNS & EMAIL HEALTH
• Watches nameservers, IP addresses and MX records, querying each authoritative nameserver directly
• Detects divergence between nameservers and unexpected record changes
• Checks SPF and DMARC and warns about permissive or missing email security records

MADE FOR TEAMS AND AGENCIES
• Share a domain with teammates
• Tags and notes to organize client domains
• Home screen widget with the status of your domains
• Available in 58 languages

PLANS
Free: 1 domain. Personal, Pro and Business plans add more domains, more subdomains and more frequent checks (uptime every 5 minutes on Business). Paid plans are yearly auto-renewing subscriptions with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

name: WecanServices
description:
WeCan is the store owner's app for WeCan Services fulfilment and delivery in Algeria. Everything you do on the website, now in your pocket.

ORDERS
• See every order by status, search by number, name or phone
• Create orders with products, delivery to home or stop desk, and fees worked out for you
• Confirm customers, reschedule, cancel, and see orders held for review

SHIPPING
• Send orders to the carrier and print labels
• Follow each parcel's journey, with its latest status and location
• Scan parcel barcodes with the camera

RETURNS AND COMPLAINTS
• Track returned parcels and restock them
• Open a complaint on a parcel and follow the conversation with our team
• Ask for a parcel change: new amount to collect, or stop desk to home delivery

MONEY
• Payments and collections with every fee, line by line
• Your client card for cash pick-ups

INSIGHTS
• Revenue, orders, average order and conversion rate
• Best sellers and top places

SUPPORT
• Open a ticket, attach photos or a voice note, and get answers in the app
• Notifications when something needs you

Available in Arabic, French and English, in light and dark mode.

A WeCan Services store account is required. Create one in the app or at wecanservices.com.

name: Weekly Fork
description:
Planning a week of meals shouldn't mean checking every recipe for something you can't or won't eat.

Weekly Fork builds your meal plan around you. Set your allergies and the foods you dislike once, say what you feel like eating, and get a full week of meals plus one combined grocery list.

PLAN YOUR WEEK • Type what you want: "chicken tacos, salmon, a vegetarian curry" • Choose breakfast, lunch, dinner, or any mix • Meal prep mode: cook once, eat 2, 3 or 4 meals • Swap any meal with one tap

BUILT AROUND YOUR DIET • Mark allergies: peanuts, tree nuts, dairy, eggs, gluten, soy, fish, shellfish, sesame • Add foods you don't like, like cilantro or mushrooms • Recipes with those ingredients are never picked for your plan • Flagged ingredients are left off your list, and you can add any back

COOK WITH CONFIDENCE • A Cook tab shows today's meal and your whole week, one tap from Cook Mode • 100+ built-in recipes, each with step-by-step instructions and prep and cook times • Cook Mode: one big step at a time, screen stays on, hands-free • Built-in timers start from the step text and keep running while you move on • Timer alerts ring even if you leave the app or lock your phone • Add your own steps to recipes you save

TURN ANY RECIPE INTO A SHOPPING LIST • Paste an ingredient list from anywhere • Quantities are scaled to the number of people and combined across recipes • Items are grouped by store aisle, with tick boxes for the store

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE • Works without an internet connection • No account, no ads, no tracking • Your recipes, allergies, and lists stay on your iPhone

FREE TO START Plan, filter, and shop for free. Save up to 3 of your own recipes. Weekly Fork Pro is a one-time purchase (no subscription) that unlocks unlimited saved recipes and list sharing.

Important: Weekly Fork helps filter recipes by matching ingredient names. It is not a safety guarantee. Always read labels and follow your doctor's advice about allergies.

name: WeekSlip
description: WeekSlip keeps seven days of words close at hand. Tap a weekday or slide the aligned writing strip, focus on Today and see when words are saved. Thought threads connect exact excerpts from your dated notes with your own interpretation. Revisit current sources, see when their text or date changed, and keep collected words when a source is removed. Write your own synthesis and open question, edit the resulting draft and preview a blank date before adding a new note. Occupied dates and changed previews never overwrite existing words. Reuse seven-day word patterns with explicit fill, append or replace choices; copy, move or swap notes; reflect and carry selected words to next week while keeping originals. Three introduction pages and editable fictional examples help you start;

name: WeekSpoon: Meal Planner
description:
A little plan. A better week.

WeekSpoon helps you spend less time deciding what to cook. Explore 21 original recipes with serving photographs, ingredients and clear cooking steps. A complete sample week is available before subscribing.

WITH WEEKSPOON PLUS
• Plan 1–7 different dinners for 1–6 people.
• Choose a varied, vegetarian, vegan or pescatarian menu.
• Filter dairy, individual ingredients, cooking time and oven use.
• Add pantry ingredients and a budget target.
• Swap one dinner without rebuilding the whole week.
• Update portions while keeping the same dinners.

EVERYDAY HELP
Keep favourites, mark cooked meals, lock your week, tick groceries and share your combined shopping list. Recipes and saved plans are stored on your device. No WeekSpoon account is required.

Budget figures use reference ingredient costs, not live supermarket prices or pack totals. Ingredient filters do not certify meals as allergen-free. Serving photographs are AI-generated illustrations of the recipes.

WeekSpoon Plus is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Your local App Store price is shown before purchase. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

name: WeFlow App
description:
WeFlow is the mobile app for authorised field installers working with Winways Aurora. Sign in with your installer account, view assigned jobs, plan your schedule, and complete work on site—from serial numbers and photos to documents and checklists.

KEY FEATURES
• Jobs — View assignments, nearest jobs, and work in progress
• Schedule — Calendar view to plan your day
• Dashboard — Profile and a quick overview of active tasks
• On-site capture — Photos, files, signatures, and structured forms
• Location — GPS for job-related features when you allow access
• Notifications — Updates on jobs and certificates

WeFlow is a business tool for installation crews. It is not a public consumer app. You need an account issued for installation work.

Support: https://www.weflow.com.au

name: WhereQuest
description:
See the streets. Follow the clues. Pin your guess.

WhereQuest turns real-world streets into geography adventures. Look at buildings, signs and landscapes, then choose a place on the map and discover how close you were.

• Test your knowledge in Country Streak.
• Return for a Daily Challenge.
• Explore five-round Classic games.
• Join a private online Party with a game code.
• Keep local journey history.

Start without an account or device-location permission. Game progress stays on your device and does not sync across devices. Private online Party supports 2–4 players, five rounds and 90 seconds per round.

Privacy: https://bobsun.net/streetquest/privacy
Terms: https://bobsun.net/streetquest/terms
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Whose Bag?
description:
Whose bag is this? The passengers are waiting, the flight is about to leave, and their things are all over the floor. Fit every item into the suitcase before take-off, then guess who it belongs to.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and rotate each item: it has the shape of what it is, from a frying pan to a drumstick.
• Fill the suitcase with no gaps before the clock runs out.
• Look at what you packed and guess the owner: the chef, the drummer, the photographer…?

NEW RULES ALONG THE WAY
• Fragile: can't touch the edge of the suitcase.
• Liquids: can't be turned.
• Customs: some items are already locked in place.
• Excess baggage: one item is too many; find out which one stays behind.

MADE FOR YOU
• Difficulty climbs gently, with easier breather levels between the hard ones.
• Stuck? Get a hint or extra time with coins or by watching an ad.
• No account, no sign-up. Play in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French or Turkish.

Free to play with ads. Remove the ads between levels with a single purchase, or buy coin packs.

name: Wing Vault.
description:
Wing Vault is a clean, fast, and minimalist app designed specifically for aviation enthusiasts, diecast aircraft collectors, and scale model hobbyists. Easily catalogue your entire fleet, track airline liveries, log technical scales, and monitor your personal hangar—all from one secure place.

No complex setup, no forced account creation, and zero ads. Just a pure local database to manage your personal collection of miniature aircraft!

name: Wipago
description:
Morning starts with a number. Grounds on the scale, water from the kettle, a ratio that turns one into the other. Get it right and the cup tastes like the bag promised. Wipago keeps that number honest, quietly, at the counter.

Choose a method and the ratio, grind and kettle temperature come with it. Then set any one thing (grounds, the pour, or how many mugs) and the rest follows. 20 g of coffee for a French press at 1:15 calls for 300 g of water, ground coarse, like sea salt.

– BREW: grounds ↔ water ↔ mugs for seven built-in methods: two pour-overs, French press, an immersion press, moka pot, cold brew concentrate and espresso. Each one is editable, and you can add your own recipe cards.
– SHOT: dose in the basket to target yield. 18 g at 1:2 pulls 36 g in the cup, with a timeline for the shot time.
– REFRACT: TDS, beverage weight and dose give extraction yield, shown on an 18–22 % ideal band.
– CUPPING: a tasting log with method, grounds, a cup score and notes on the palate.
– Absorption: grounds hold back some water, so the cup volume is honest.
– Units: grams or ounces, °C or °F, your mug size and scoop size.
– Barista's Guide: the grind ladder, ratios and extraction, in plain words.

Brewed offline. Your notes never leave this iPhone.

name: WOCOM HUB
description:
WOCOM HUB turns your iPhone into your office extension. If your company uses the WOCOM Hub cloud phone system, sign in once and your extension follows you anywhere with a data connection.

CALLS
• Make and receive calls on your business number over Wi-Fi or mobile data
• Incoming calls ring like a normal phone call, even when the app is closed or the screen is locked
• Keypad, call history, hold, transfer, mute and speaker
• Bluetooth headset, AirPods and CarPlay audio support
• Caller names from your phone contacts (contacts stay on your phone and are never uploaded)

TEAM
• See who on your team is available, busy or on a call
• One tap to call or message a colleague
• Team chat with photos, voice notes and file sharing

MEETINGS
• Join video meetings from your phone
• Camera and microphone are used only during calls and meetings you start or answer

BUILT FOR BUSINESS
• Your administrator sets up your account; there is nothing to configure
• Encrypted signalling and call audio (HTTPS, secure WebSocket, SRTP)
• No ads, no tracking, no selling of your data

WHO CAN USE IT
WOCOM HUB is for staff of businesses that subscribe to WOCOM Hub, the cloud PBX from WOCOM Limited, Jamaica. You need a WOCOM Hub extension to sign in. Ask your company's administrator, or visit wocomja.com to learn about WOCOM Hub for your business.

PERMISSIONS
• Microphone and camera: voice and video calls
• Contacts: show caller names and call people in your address book (read on the phone only)
• Notifications: ring for incoming calls and alert you to new messages
• Bluetooth: route call audio to headsets
• Location: sent only when you dial an emergency number (119, 110 or 911) so responders can find you; optional and never used in the background

name: WordQuest: Descifra y Aprende
description:
¿Y si aprender idiomas fuera un juego de descifrar secretos?

En WordQuest cada nivel esconde una frase en el idioma que estudias (inglés o portugués). Resuelve las palabras-pista, descubre las letras y revela la frase completa. Cuanto más juegas, más vocabulario real aprendes, sin listas aburridas.

CÓMO SE JUEGA
• Cada pista es una definición en el idioma que aprendes: escribe la palabra.
• Cada letra tiene un número: al acertar, se revela en todo el tablero.
• Con las letras descubiertas, adivina la frase oculta.
• Te ayudamos con audio, ejemplos y traducción al español cuando la pidas.

LO QUE TE VA A GUSTAR
• 9 mundos para aprender: Vida diaria, Viajes, Salir, Compras, Fútbol, Expresiones coloquiales y 3 de gramática (pasado, presente y futuro, y formas de las palabras).
• 540 niveles en 3 tramos (20 en cada uno): Básico (A1–A2), Medio (B1) y Avanzado (B2).
• ¿Ya sabes algo del idioma? Haz la prueba de nivel y empieza directamente en B1 o B2.
• Repaso inteligente: la app te recuerda las palabras que te cuestan, en contexto.
• Diccionario personal con todas las palabras que descubres.
• Estrellas, puntos y racha diaria. Cada 20 estrellas, una pista gratis; cada 3 días de racha, otra.
• Escucha la pronunciación de cada palabra.
• Ranking y logros con Game Center.

GRATIS Y JUSTO
• Todos los mundos y niveles son gratis.
• Los anuncios son moderados: uno cada dos niveles, y puedes ver un video opcional para ganar una pista.
• Pistas extra o «Quitar anuncios» con un pago único.
• Pase Experto opcional (suscripción semanal): 20 pistas al suscribirte, 5 más cada día que juegues y sin anuncios.

El audio y las traducciones siempre son gratis.

Suscripción: el Pase Experto se cobra a tu cuenta de Apple y se renueva cada semana hasta que lo canceles en Ajustes › tu nombre › Suscripciones, al menos 24 horas antes de la renovación. Política de privacidad y términos de uso en los enlaces de abajo.

name: Words Pals
description:
Find little words and big smiles in Word Pals, a cozy word puzzle in Thai and English.

Drag through neighboring tiles to connect letters and discover every target word. Connect horizontally, vertically or diagonally, and turn along the way. There is no timer, so you can take your time.

• Thai and English word puzzles
• A gentle journey from small beginner boards to larger challenges
• Hints to help you find your next word
• Musical notes as you swipe, with cute cell celebrations
• Separate saved progress for each language
• Automatic device-language selection and an easy language switch
• Comfortable layouts for iPhone and iPad
• Play offline, with no account, ads or in-app purchases

Sound and vibration can be switched off in Settings. Your game progress stays on your device.

One word, one smile.

name: Wordstep: Word of the Day
description:
One word a day. A step forward every day.

Wordstep puts a new word on your Home Screen and Lock Screen every day. You see it every time you pick up your phone – dozens of glances a day – so it sticks without studying.

Small steps add up: get 1% better every day and you're 37× better in a year.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose the language you speak and the language you want to learn – any pair works.
• Add the widget. Every morning it shows a new word with its reading and meaning.
• Tap the word to hear how it's pronounced.
• Already know a word? Swap it for a new one with one tap.
• A quick review quiz brings back the words you're unsure of, right when you're about to forget them.

20 LANGUAGES, ANY PAIR
English, Slovak, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Polish, Ukrainian, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Chinese (Mandarin), Japanese, Korean, Arabic and Hindi. Learn Japanese from Slovak, Spanish from English or German from Polish – 380 combinations.

MADE FOR READING AT A GLANCE
• Words in other scripts come with a Latin reading (pinyin, romaji, Korean romanization and more); Japanese also shows the kana.
• Nouns come with their article (der, la, le, il…), so you learn them right.
• 365 of the most useful words – a full year of steps.

WIDGETS
• Home Screen: small, medium and large (with your recent words).
• Lock Screen: rectangular and inline.
• Optional quiz mode: the meaning stays hidden until you tap the widget.

CALM AND PRIVATE
• Warm paper design that looks good next to any wallpaper, in light and dark mode.
• No ads, no account, no tracking. Works offline; your progress stays on your device.

name: Wores2Parcel Online
description:
Este hét óra van. A konyhaasztalon egy futárszelvény hever, a telefonodon pedig három üzenet jelzi, hogy valamelyik csomag úton van. Melyiket várta a szomszéd, és melyik érkezik külföldről? A Wores2Parcel Online pontosan az ilyen helyzetekre készült. Egy helyen tartja nyilván az összes csomagot, amelyet elküldtél, vagy amelyre vársz, így nem kell fejben tartanod a számokat.

Az alkalmazás lényege egyetlen lista. Minden sor egy csomag, és mindegyikhez három fontos adat tartozik: a nyomkövetési szám, a szállító és az aktuális állapot. Egy pillantás elég, és látod, mi van még úton, és mire kell még várnod. Minden egy helyen van, nem kell több alkalmazásban vagy üzenetben keresgélned.

A listát érdemes két irányból nézni. Az elküldött csomagokat te adtad fel: egy ajándékot a barátodnak, egy szervizbe küldött készüléket vagy egy visszaküldött rendelést. A beérkező csomagokra te vársz, legyen szó egy megrendelt könyvről vagy egy családtagtól érkező küldeményről. Mindkettő ugyanabban a listában kap helyet, így nem kell két külön jegyzetet vezetned.

Új csomag felvételekor megadod a nyomkövetési számot, a szállító nevét és az állapotot. A nyomkövetési szám a kulcs: ezzel azonosítod a küldeményt, amikor a szállítóval egyeztetsz. A szállító mutatja meg, melyik cég viszi a csomagot, az állapot pedig azt, hol tart éppen. Ha valami változik, a bejegyzést bármikor frissítheted, így a lista mindig a valóságot mutatja.

Az alkalmazás azoknak készült, akik gyakran postáznak vagy csomagot várnak. Például a kisvállalkozónak, aki naponta ad fel küldeményeket, vagy annak, aki rendszeresen alkatrészeket rendel. És persze a vásárlónak is, aki egyszerre több webáruházból rendel, és mindent egy helyen szeretne látni. Számukra ez a lista nem díszlet, hanem valódi munkaeszköz.

A szállító mezőben azt a szolgáltatót rögzíted, amelyik a küldeményt kezeli, így pontosan tudod, kihez fordulj, ha valami nem stimmel. A legtöbb bosszúság abból adódik, hogy az ember egyszerűen nem emlékszik, melyik cég hozza a csomagját.

A nyilvántartás másik nagy előnye, hogy megőrzi a részleteket. Egy hónap múlva már senki sem emlékszik pontosan, mikor adta fel a csomagot, és melyik számmal kell érdeklődnie. A lista megőrzi ezeket az apró adatokat, így a korábbi küldemények részletei sem vesznek el.

A Wores2Parcel Online nem akar több lenni annál, amire szükséged van: egy átlátható, rendezett lista a csomagjaidról. Ha szeretnéd, hogy a postázás és a várakozás kevesebb fejtörést okozzon, kezdd azzal, hogy felveszed az aktuális küldeményeidet. Már az első napon érezni fogod, mennyivel nyugodtabb vagy, amikor nem kell találgatnod, hol jár az a bizonyos doboz.

name: Worleap
description:
Worleap is a language exchange app for real conversation and lasting friendships.

Find people to talk to
Choose from about 80 languages and meet learners who share your interests.

Practice in 10-minute sessions
Pick a topic and take turns speaking each other's language with a shared timer.

Build real friendships
See how many sessions you have shared, plan what to talk about next, and become friends once you both agree.

Learn from corrections
Corrections come with a reason, and helpful ones are saved in your notes.

Stay safe
No one can message you freely until you accept their request. You cannot search by gender or age, and your location is never shown. Worleap warns you about attempts to move you off the app or ask for money. You can report and block anyone, and if your account is restricted you can see why and appeal.

Worleap is for adults 18 and over.

Worleap Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription with unlimited translation and full correction notes. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Terms: https://worleap.com/legal/terms
Privacy: https://worleap.com/legal/privacy

name: Worst Xmas
description:
Worst Xmas is a shared stocking for gloriously bad Christmas movies and series. Start a group with your family or friends, pile in every cheesy holiday mystery, royal romance and Santa-with-muscles disaster you can find, and keep score together all season.

• ADD ANYTHING: Search movies and series, from Mistletoe Murders to A Christmas Prince. Posters, year, runtime or seasons, and where to stream fill in automatically.
• TRACK WHAT YOU'VE SEEN: Mark titles as seen, or keep your place in a series by season.
• RATE THE CHEESE: Score each one from Lump of Coal to Christmas Miracle and compare the group's average with the public rating.
• ROAST IT TOGETHER: Every title gets its own group chat.
• SEE WHO'S WATCHING: Find out what everyone has watched, and who's winning the leaderboard.
• WHERE TO WATCH: Streaming, free, rental and purchase options, powered by JustWatch.
• INVITE FROM CONTACTS: Text an invite link to anyone. Everyone in a group can invite more people.

Groups are private and invite-only. Sign in with Apple or Google. Report and block tools keep the chat friendly.

Movie and series information and images come from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Streaming availability is provided by JustWatch.

name: Wortlauf
description:
Wortlauf verbindet ein Wortspiel mit einem Roguelike. Aus sieben Buchstabenkacheln legst du echte deutsche Wörter. Jedes Wort ist ein Angriff, und je länger und seltener es ist, desto härter trifft es.

DEUTSCH BIS INS DETAIL
• Über 590 000 deutsche Wörter, auch gebeugte Formen
• Komposita bringen Bonus: HAUS + TÜR zählt mehr
• Umlaute, ẞ und Doppelkacheln wie SCH, CH und QU

JEDER RUN IST ANDERS
• Eine Karte mit Weggabelungen: Kampf, Elite, Rast, Händler, Schatz oder Ereignis
• Gegner mit eigenen Regeln: Der Zensor verbietet Buchstaben, der Lektor verbietet gleiche Anfänge, das Schweigen verschluckt deine Kacheln
• 15 Relikte verändern die Wertung: Kurzwörter, Wörter ohne E, Reime, Wortketten, Palindrome …
• Gold, Händler und zwölf Ereignisse mit kleinen Entscheidungen

DU SIEHST, WAS DEIN WORT BEWIRKT
Drei Kreise zeigen vor jedem Zug, wie viel Schaden dein Wort macht und wie es danach um dich und den Gegner steht. Keine versteckten Würfe, nur deine Wörter.

FÜR LANGE ABENDE
• Drei Akte mit drei Bossen
• Zehn Aufstiegsstufen für alle, die es schwerer mögen
• Ein Lexikon mit jedem Wort, das du je gelegt hast, und deiner Statistik
• Freischaltbare Relikte und Ereignisse

FAIR
• Kostenlos: die Einführung, der Kurze Run (Akt 1), Übungskämpfe und das Lexikon
• Einmalkauf „Vollversion“: der Ganze Run über drei Akte und die Aufstiegsstufen
• Keine Werbung, keine Abos, keine Spielwährung zum Kaufen
• Funktioniert komplett offline, ohne Konto

name: Wrambler
description:
Make every walk count with Wrambler.

Wrambler turns your recorded walking workouts into clear summaries, useful comparisons and a history you can explore.
With your permission, Wrambler reads walking workouts from Apple Health. It focuses on walks recorded as workouts, rather than everyday steps or general movement.

See your walking at a glance

• Distance, number of walks, time, average pace and longest walk
• Summaries by day, week, month, year or a custom date range
• Charts showing how your walking changes over time
• A history of your walks, with route maps when route data is available
• Comparisons with previous periods
• Distance goals and personal milestones

Set daily, monthly and yearly distance goals, follow your progress and revisit the walks that make up your record.

Your Health data is used to show your summaries and is not collected by Wrambler.

name: Wrario – Staff Rota & Shifts
description:
Wrario is the simple staff rota for tavernas, restaurants, cafés and bars.

Plan your team's week on your phone, send each person their shifts on WhatsApp, and stop answering "what time am I working?" messages.

YOUR STAFF DON'T NEED AN APP
Each person gets a private link to their own shifts. It opens in any phone browser, in Greek or English, and they can add their shifts to their phone calendar with automatic reminders.

PLAN THE WEEK FAST
• Add shifts in a few taps, or copy last week in one
• Calendar and list views, by month, week or day
• Wrario warns you if someone is booked twice at the same time
• See who's off before you put them on a shift

SEND IT IN ONE GO
• "Send to everyone": WhatsApp opens for each person in turn with their message ready
• Or share the whole week as one picture to your staff WhatsApp group
• SMS works too

KNOW WHEN PLANS CHANGE
• Staff tap "I can't make it" on their link and you get a notification
• Staff can tell you the days or dates they can't work
• Remind tomorrow's team with one tap

HOURS AND COST
• Planned hours per person, per week and per month
• Add hourly rates to see the estimated wage cost
• Send the month to your accountant as a spreadsheet

IN GREEK AND ENGLISH
The app, the messages and the staff pages work in both languages, and you can choose the language for each person.

Wrario is free while in early access. Questions or ideas: support@catercrew.net

name: Wristpoint
description:
O Wristpoint transforma o Apple Watch num controle do Mac.

TRACKPAD
Arraste o dedo na tela do relógio para mover o cursor. Toque uma vez para clicar, duas vezes para o botão direito. Segure parado e arraste para arrastar janelas e arquivos. Gire a coroa para rolar a página.

PULSO

MÍDIA

GESTOS

QUALQUER TELA

name: Writeday
description:
Writeday turns the notes you write into calendar events.

Type "lunch with Sam tomorrow at noon," hit return, and a "lunch with Sam" event appears tomorrow at 12:00 PM. No need to open a calendar app and pick a date and time.

■ Write it the way you'd say it
• tomorrow, next Tuesday, in 3 days, Nov 12, on the 20th
• 2pm, 3:30 pm, noon, at 7
• 2-4pm, next Wed-Thu, from Dec 24 to Dec 26
• Korean works too: "내일 두시 엄마와 쇼핑"

■ Repeating events in one line
Write "every Tuesday 7pm swim" or "rent every month on the 25th" and it repeats. Add an end like "until December".

■ To-dos go to Reminders
Start a line with "todo" — like "todo buy milk" — and it becomes a reminder. Check it off in the note and it's done in Reminders too.

■ Dates become links
Dates in your notes are highlighted. Tap one to jump straight to that day in the calendar.

■ Edit the note, the event follows
Edit a note and its event updates. Delete the note and the event goes with it. No duplicate events.

■ Works with your iPhone calendar
Events go into a "Writeday" calendar in your iPhone's Calendar, so you can see them in the Calendar app and on your other devices.

■ A clean slate every day
Lines that became events and completed to-dos leave your notes the next day and stay in your calendar. Tap a date in the Calendar tab to see that day's notes.

■ Home Screen widget
See what's coming up, and tap to start writing right away.

■ Make it yours
Adjust text size, pick a highlight color, and enjoy dark mode.

■ Your notes stay on your device
No servers, no accounts, no ads. Your notes are stored only on your device.

name: XHarezmi - LGS'ye Hazırlık
description:
XHarezmi, LGS 2027'ye hazırlanan 8. sınıf öğrencileri için hazırlanmış bir çalışma uygulamasıdır. Soru çözdürmekle yetinmez; neyi ne zaman tekrar etmen gerektiğini hesaplar.

MEB MÜFREDATININ TAMAMI

ARALIKLI TEKRAR
Doğru bildiğin soruyu tekrar tekrar çözmezsin. Uygulama her sorunun ne zaman tekrar edilmesi gerektiğini hesaplar: bildiklerinin arası açılır, zorlandığın konular sık sık karşına çıkar.

AI ÇALIŞMA KOÇU

ARKADAŞ GRUPLARI
Arkadaşlarınla grup kurup haftalık gelişim sıralamasını görebilirsin. Sıralama ham puana değil gelişime bakar. Uygunsuz bir adı bildirebilir, bir öğrenciyi engelleyebilirsin.

REKLAM YOK
Uygulamada reklam gösterilmez. Ücretsiz sürümün sınırı reklam değil, günlük soru sayısıdır.

NASIL BAŞLANIR
Uygulamayı açar açmaz çalışmaya başlarsın: kayıt yok, giriş ekranı yok. Devam etmek istediğinde hesabını oluşturursun; o güne kadar çözdüklerin hesabına geçer.

ÜCRETLENDİRME
İlk günler tüm özellikler açıktır. Sonrasında ücretsiz sürümle devam edebilirsin: günlük soru hakkı, ayda bir deneme ve günlük AI ipucu hakkı sınırlıdır.
